title: Medical Martial Arts
description: After making a prince into a cuckold, medical military officer went back to his country. This is a story about Wang Yuwu who can kill anyone he want in this world . Wang Yuwu is unbeatable!

title: Everyone Was Obsessed With Me After I Became the Youngest Princess' Favourite
alt_titles: Mangnae Gongnyeoui Chongaereul Dokchajihaetdeoni, Modu Naege Jipchakanda
description: After dying as a top agent, the protagonist wakes up as their 8-year-old self in a harsh orphanage. They meet a young noble girl and decide to care for her to avoid past regrets. However, their kindness leads to the girl and her powerful family becoming overly attached, creating unexpected challenges

title: Is this Hunter for Real?
description:
In Gangshik Choi's world, monster attacks are a common occurrence. Humanity is protected by hunters with superpowers who stream their fights online, and it is Gangshik's job to get it all on camera as the cameraman for a below-average monster streamer. In a stream gone wrong, he suddenly finds himself in front of the camera... but human viewers aren't the only ones watching him. Now, he is a streamer for the Gods, and more viewers mean more power. With monsters at every turn, how long can Gangshik keep the cameras rolling?
(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Sacred Lord of Scorching Summer
description: Green Li is the weakest in his village, unable to beat a blind, dying old man. But when he leaves the village, he finds out that he is extremely strong. This is the story of a boy who embarks on a journey to become the strongest.

title: Butterfly Love Effect
description: All Sul-Bi has ever wanted is a princess who will love her. This desire of hers ostracizes her from the people around her—all alone, without a friend in the world, Sul-Bi has a chance encounter with a 'princess'. Except there's something off about this princess...

title: Keep a Low Profile, Sect Leader
alt_titles: Keep a Low Profile, Sect Leader
Sect Head, Be a Bit Modest
description:
Traveling to the world of Tian Xuan, can’t believe I’ve become a useless sect’s leader!

Paying money in the city to be reborn in a game’s realm.

Making the players my workers, collecting the main characters from the world as my underlings.

If we’re talking about being pretentious, then I’ll only take the number one spot!

title: I've Been Proposed to by a Villain
alt_titles: I've Been Proposed to by a Villain
I Got a Proposal From a Villain
I Got Married to a Villain
description:
I witnessed a murder scene of a villain. To make matters worse, he caught me. I think I hear the sound of death beckoning. He approaches me, his hand in his coat. I wonder what he’s reaching for. A knife? A gun? I guess it doesn’t matter. There’s only one thing I can think of now.

“I’m going to die.”

I wasn’t expecting what he pulled out of his coat.

“Will you marry me?”

“What?”

---
I witnessed the novel's villain murdering someone - and even got caught witnessing it! I can practically hear the bell signalling the end of my life ringing. However, what he gave me was... "Marry me." A ring. One with a huge gem at that! What's going on here?! Is this not better than dying, My Lady? Let's get married. My newly-wed life with the villainous lead begins now!

---
Whisked away into the novel *The Forbidden Fruit of Isotta* and the body of Regina Blois, our female protagonist has the advantage of knowing how her story unfolds - which is that she is to be murdered by Duke Arsene Graroy! Her death moves the story forward and sets up her good friend and protagonist Isotta in a love triangle with the Emperor and the Duke when she tries to uncover the truth behind Regina’s death. Not wanting to be murdered this time around, our new Regina keeps a low profile. She still manages to catch the eye of the Duke, but when he confronts her this time, it seems he's less interested in murdering her and more interested in... marrying her?

title: Flawless Metropolitan Divine Emperor
alt_titles: Flawless Divine Emperor in the City
description: The first thing that Jiang Feng saw when he opened his eyes, is that his hands are on his class teacher's Breast!! Owwu~ This, this is the time before I cultivate! The Immortal emperor has once again return to the mortal world!

title: Chronicles of the Demon Faction
description:
Chun Hajin, the strongest assassin of the Orthodox Murim’s Righteous Heavenly Alliance. Hajin loses his life as he tries to escape to find freedom.

And then…

‘The divine cult is immortal, may all demons submit. Congratulations on your recovery, third young master!’

He was reincarnated into the body of Murim’s public enemy, the third young master of the Demonic Cult?!

The conquest of the Demonic Murim by Chun Hajin, the strongest secret weapon of the Orthodox Murim, begins now.

title: My Husband, My Sister, and I
alt_titles: The Three Are Living a Married Life
description:
On the night of her fourth wedding anniversary, moans were heard from her husband’s bedroom. 

“Tell me I’m better than her, come on.”

It was the voice of her twin sister.

title: Life Howling
description: Jung Yoon-hwan may be an orphan but he was a college student who was focusing hard on his studies, one day he is brought to a mysterious "White room" to fight even when he does not want to. Every time he defeats these monsters he gains psychic power, magic, and items beyond his imaginations….

title: Hardcore Leveling Warrior: Earth Game
description:
"I’m... back!"

After a comet collides on Earth, a gaming world filled with monsters and dungeons becomes a reality. Amidst the chaos, Gong Won-Ho wakes up as Hardcore Leveling Warrior, an almighty game character with exceptional luck and power.

Once again, he will embark on a journey to become the strongest... but this time, on Earth!

title: Close-Up Yuri
description: Two girls switch bodies after not seeing each other for years. Carefully guarding the secret, they learn the truths of once inexplicable things…

title: Picked up From Another World
alt_titles: I Picked It Up From Another World
I Picked a Mobile From Another World
description:
In the midst of the devastation, only the soldiers’ bones remained.
It’s only a matter of time before the entire world is annihilated. To avoid this, Kyung-Hoon began searching for clues in another universe with the help of a ten-year-old phone he discovered in an abandoned building.

---

---

title: Poisonous Doctor: First Wife's Daughter
description:
The original owner died at the hands of others, the next second the successor of the Heaven's Godly Healing Needle crawled out of the grave!   
Clothes bloodied red; heart ice cold!  
Nasty relatives? No worries! One prick of a silver needle guarantees obedience!  
Appearance ruined and fingers broken? Can’t practice medicine or cultivate?  
Easy! Fix appearance, reform muscles and bones, dazzle and blind every bastard's eyes!  
He, is Xia Dynasty’s most adored official; arrogant and addicted to killing.  
Yet the first time he saw her, he immediately entered wife-pampering mode. She, who returned mightily, with world shocking abilities, relied on her poison needle to aid him in achieving dominance.

title: For My Hero
description:
"Noah, open your eyes! This can't be your last. Please…!"  
  
I was summoned to this world just because I was holding a novel, "The Heart of a Dragon, and I became the second lead character in the novel. And you, the master of the sword and my husband.  
  
Our meeting was so fateful. So I didn't believe your love. Because I thought you loved the heroine, not me.  
  
Unlike the novel, I realized only after you died in vain. I'm a coward. I loved you, but I refused it because I was afraid I would lose you. Now… it's time to settle the debt owed by the Dragon.  
  
The day I came back from the first meeting with you, I decided. I'm not going to let you die this time.  
  
"I'll protect you no matter what. Trust me!"  
  
Even if you're the strongest hero in the world who doesn't need help.  
  
*Promo oneshot based on the webnovel by Danlan*  


---

title: I Heard That Both of Our Empress Dowagers Have Something Together?!
alt_titles: I Heard That Both of Our Empress Dowagers Have Something Together?!
description: Jiang Shu is a graduate student in the history department who accidentally traveled to the Great Qi. Because of her major in history, she knows a lot about the direction of history, and she knows that Qi Changning is a famous demon queen from history. Since her villainy has already been determined by history, Jiang Shu intends to embrace her opponent and be a peaceful licking dog so she can live a good life, but as they come into increasingly close contact she discovers the truth hidden in the history books. It seems that this demon queen is not the way that she thought she'd be.....

title: Blue Archive - 1 Hoshino a Day (Doujinshi)
description: A daily slice-of-life adventure set in Jam To Cham's alternative Blue Archive timeline where Sensei came to help Abydos 2 years earlier.

title: A Dyad of Revenge
alt_titles: Shuang Mian Qian Jin Fu Chou Ji
description: Of the dyad of sisters, one lives a life like a rich piece of black gold—– born with status yet perceived unpleasantly in the eyes of others. The other sister is an illegitimate daughter, who leads a rough life. The fate of these two sisters is tied together by the struggle between the great families. Behind the scenes, a pair of sinister hand pushes the two sisters into the gate of death. Unexpectedly, they were reborn again! Together, they open the road to carve a path towards a dyad of revenge.

title: In Your Eyes
description: Junghyun has a unsociable personality. He shows a strong passion for art in the workshop where he is first introduced to a man named Park Ho. One day when he wasn’t the only one, he could feel a burning gaze…

title: A Post-Apocalyptic Journey
description: The story of post-apocalyptic wasteland filled with depravity. Follow the journey of a smuggler, a ruthless and bloodthirsty man, who is widely regarded as a monster due to his demonic blood as he ventures and smuggles goods in order to survive a world where only the fittest survive.

title: I Can See Your Death
description:
After Eshana Arth got into an accident at a young age, she could see people’s life expectancy and cause of death.

What if a person she bumped into by chance was destined to die the next day?

It was Eshana Arth who had mainly decided to ignore such cases, but because destinies in black were ones that could be changed, she would save the village people from danger from time to time.

However, if they were destinies that couldn’t be changed, they would be seen in red.

Imperial Calendar Year 422, on the afternoon of a peaceful day.

A bloody man had collapsed on their front garden, and his destiny was one even more distinct than blood. 

[Year 427/Cause of death: Eshana Arth]

“I’m ‘Eshana Arth’.” 

The person who is the reason why—

You will die 5 years later.

title: My Teacher Has Chosen My Husband Candidates
alt_titles: Master Has Chosen My Husband Candidates
description:
I first met the teacher when I was born. He claimed to be a distant relative and raised me who was born in an orphanage. I grew up well under his care. I was planning to confess my love and get married to Master when I would finally come of age... But master disappeared on the day I came of age?! After receiving such a huge impact, 5 years passed, and then I received a letter from the teacher!

"I have been searching for a husband for you in the last 5 years." 

I kept the store open and kept waiting for the Master to come back... But none of the men that showed up was the Master. Come back home!

---

title: The Vampire's Plans to Die in Peace
alt_titles: The Villainess Wants to Die Gracefully
description:
Wanting to die, she jumped off the bridge and became a vampire who lived forever. The strongest vampire who appears as the villain in the novel.

'Are you kidding?'

No, wait? Wouldn't it be easier and quicker to die if I pave a flower path for the vampire hunter, the male lead?
First, let's start with the ruined male lead's family.
Spending too much time and money, she saved the male lead's family who was demoted to peasants. At this point, will the male lead grow well?

“Fred… Please come out.”

Then, a 10-year-old male lead became a reclusive loner.

'Why? …?' Please let me die soon!

She became a teacher to the original male lead and a supporter to the original female lead.
I accidentally turned a dying boy into a family member and saved him, but that wouldn't be a big deal. Then I fell asleep for a while and woke up, and 10 years had passed. At this point, I thought I could go to die soon, so I appeared in front of the original characters.

"Teacher. I don't care if you are a monster. So please, stay by my side again.”
“I don't believe in God. The only thing I trust is Unnie who raised me up to this point.”
…Why are they here?
“I made him live as he pleases, he made himself a vampire at his will, and made him tangled up in you, are you going to throw it away now? To what extent are you going to make me miserable?”

Even the kid from the purebred family has changed.
“So you too. Everything you want is in my hands.”

What the hell happened in 10 years?

---

title: Summer Is Hot!
description:
Han Yeoreum, his friend's younger sister, who appeared in front of Black Dragon at Dongdaejeong High School!   
  
Should I keep her unpredictable?

---

- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/CAMPUS/fengkuangxiari/list?title_no=1525)

title: The Basketball Girl
description: The unknown interior designer, Hans Duan (22 years old), was involved in a criminal dispute as he designed the house for one of the members in that group. Unfortunately, he was persecuted as a murderer due to the case and sentenced to death. In the prison, he met a scientist from the government (Code name No.73) who asked him to take part in a human experiment. But the experiment failed and Hans died. His body was buried in a dump in the city. However, the experimental medicine left in his body leads to gene mutation. Hans is revived and changed into a female. What will happen on him (her)?

title: Love Dependency Disease
description:
Love dependency disease: I have a special body condition which will naturally attract some type of people to me, people commonly known as ——”yandere”.  
  
About my story, let me first come down from the surgeon’s table before speaking.  
  
“I won’t let you run away”  
“You’re mine”  
“I won’t let you be handed over to anyone else!”  
“Even if we die, we must still be together in the afterlife, remember that~”  
  
The girls’ words, they still echo around my ears.

title: Cute Princess Strikes: The Panda from Heaven Wants Hugs
alt_titles: Meng Fei Lai Xi: Tian Jiang Xiongmao Qiu Bao Bao
An Adorable Panda Falls From the Sky: The Endearing Princess Attacks!
description: Thanks to a botched job by the King of Hell, Su Ranran was mistakenly killed shortly after her university graduation. To make it up to her, she was promised a new life as Miss Perfect… but became a fatty panda instead!? And to become human again, she needs to revive the heartbeat of a cold-faced prince regent!?

title: I'm Just a Side Character in a Dating Simulation
alt_titles: Turns Out, I'm a Tool-Man Character in a Romance
description: On that day, a girl wearing strawberry underwear fell from the sky. “This place is actually set in a GAL Game world!” And not only was I, who was raised in a prosperous family and was outstanding in everything not the main character, but I was also instead this world’s villainous and antagonistic Eldest Young Master?! I had decided. I shall forge an alliance with the strawberry girl, and together we shall wage war upon the main character for the one true love! I don’t care for his main character’s aura or his Yasashii Strategy. I shall open up a grand path to becoming the main character! I refuse to be a side character in a dating sim!"

title: Lilith
description:
As far as anyone can tell, Jaehee is a shy, hard-working high school teacher. Once she's behind closed doors and drawn curtains, Jaehee enjoys spending her time kneeling at the end of a whip. And no one enjoys holding the handle more than her childhood friend, Huilin.  
   
But, when Sulhwa starts her position as a student-teacher at the school, secrets and feelings long buried start to surface. Now, Jaehee's about to learn just how much pleasure she can pull from pain.

title: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse
alt_titles: Hiding a Logistics Center in the Apocalypse
description: Imagine you are stuck inside a warehouse while the world is experiencing an apocalypse. That’s exactly what’s happening to Jeong-gyeom, except he suddenly awakens a very odd but powerful ability to store anything in a parallel dimension, giving him the tools to defeat the creatures wreaking havoc on the world. But as he ventures into the ravaged city of Seoul, he realizes there is more to this apocalypse than meets the eye as he encounters other survivors and mysterious monsters on his quest to find his family.

title: Shin Angyo Onshi
alt_titles: Phantom Master: Dark Hero from Ruined Empire
description: Based on historical setting of Korea during the Josun Age. Long ago, in Jushin, secret royal inspectors named "Angyo Onshi" wandered the country and restored the order. But now that Jushin is destroyed, only one is still wandering…

title: I Work Nine to Five in the Immortal Cultivation World
alt_titles: I Work 9 to 5 in the Immortal Cultivation World
Wo Zai Xiuxian Shijie Chao Jiu Wan Wu
Wǒ Zài Xiūxiān Shìjiè Cháo Jiǔ Wǎn Wǔ
description: Hua Qingyuan, died suddenly due to being overly exhausted from working the ‘996’ schedule. However, he found himself transported to a fantasy world and became a disciple of the Qingyun Sword Sect. Determined not to repeat the mistakes of his past life, he resolved to work only 8 hours a day and not to spend even a half a minute practicing cultivation. He became an anomaly in the entire Qingyun Sword Sect, lazily lying under a tree while others practiced day and night. He enjoyed his life after work, while others worked tirelessly on their swordsmanship. Nevertheless, his almost abnormal talent in swordsmanship made him a formidable presence. In the face of requests from his master, fellow disciples, and the sect leader, as well as sudden attacks from the demonic sect and challenges from other young talents, he remained resolute: do not bother me until it’s time to work!

title: Vengeance Named Love
description:
This work contains controversial content such as violence and rape.

 Please be advised. Captain 'Leon Winston' of the National Intelligence Division of the Western Command of the Rippon Kingdom. Unlike his elegant and noble appearance, he was the object of both envy and damnation for both his allies and enemies, known as the "Vampire of Camden" who would torture the rebels cruelly.

"Every time I see you, I just want to thrust my gun in your tight space."

Strangely, the maid of the interrogation room "Sally Briston" became the object of his desires, as strong as the rage he has for the insurgent rebels. She was ordinary and nothing special... Perhaps it was simply the smell of blood on her that excited him.

The interrogation didn't take long.

He realized it as soon as he heard her name come out from the rebel spy's lips. He no longer needed to suppress his violent desires.

"I stopped myself from tormenting her because I thought she was a good girl, but now there's no need for that. Thank you, Sally. No... Grace."

If you want to live, then try begging.

You never know.

I might hear you out.

title: Midwood
description:
As the monster slayer troops, also known as 'Sretu', no longer functioned as it used to, humans became monster feed.
'Jin Cheongdo', who has been living in a world full of monsters for his entire life, uses a legendary item 'Midwood', to turn back in time, for the sake of killing 'Ian' who was the centerpiece of this whole mess...

title: The Villainess Empress's Attendant
alt_titles: Exclusive Maid of the Evil Empress
The Exclusive Maid of the Wicked Empress
description:
I, Paresa Menzel, a money-grubbing handmaiden to the infamous Empress. I thought she was the ultimate villainess, but she's nothing more than a prickly cat?! But then I realized that there was a lot more to her than meets the eyes, so I wanted to help her.
"If you are a spy disguised as a maid, I have no choice but to dispose of you."
But I never expected to be noticed by the crown prince. It's bad enough that my heart flutters every time I see the face of the most beautiful one in the empire...! I know I seem suspicious, but my loyalty to the Empress is genuine!

---
Paresa Menzel, lured by the promise of high pay, agrees to serve the empress who is known to be a cruel villainess. Anticipating evil incarnate, she instead finds a complex woman with hidden scars, which makes her solidify her vow to aid her. However, Paresa seems to be hiding something, which causes the crown prince to become suspicious of her. Though his captivating beauty unnerves her and challenges her resolve, Paresa's steadfast loyalty to the empress stands firm. Will her hidden past endanger them, or will it forge unexpected bonds in this dangerous game of deception and loyalty?

title: Eden Game
description: Developed by “God’s Domain Technologies”, virtual reality has taken the world by storm. The virtual world “Eden’s Paradise” is described as a mysterious and flawless universe, and has become the place that every gamer dreams of. Those, in reality, feel disappointment towards the real world, or want to escape from it, or are possessed by greed, or have dreams, or simply feel boredom - people with all these reasons challenge the trials to enter Eden’s Paradise one after the other.

title: Deadline Is Coming
description: A forever would-be writer Ahn-Bom. She did a job interview, but it wasn't for a writer job and instead she got hired as the person in charge?!

title: Love Potion Brewing
description: In order to learn about human society, a witch transfers to a high school and begins living independently. In class, she meets a boy who can see through her invisibility magic. Their relationship quickly deepens. Can the little witch find the friendship that she’s looking for? Will love blossom?

title: The Carefree Life of an SSS-Class Knight
alt_titles: SSSGeup Teukseongeul Badatjiman Jeokdanghi Salgo Sipda
I have an SSS-rank Trait, but I want a Normal Life
description:
Even though strange beings like monsters and constellations appeared, my personal philosophy did not change.
But with the sudden awakening and blessing of an SSS-rank trait, my peaceful life went bye-bye.
I have no choice but to level up if I want to protect myself now!

title: I Don't Want to Play Matchmaker (Pre-Serialization)
alt_titles: I Don't Want to Be the Magpie Bridge
I Don't Want to Be a Magpie Bridge
I Don't Want to Be an Ojakgyo
description:
I was reincarnated as a supporting character in a novel. And on top of that, I had the role of a ‘magpie bridge’ inside the romance story <Hestia’s Boys>.  
  
Anyways, romance was impossible, and my future seemed bleak with my debt-riddled family. After becoming a civil servant, I tried to enjoy the wealth and honor I couldn’t have in my past life, but… Unlike the originals, the male characters seem kind of strange?!  
  
“Imagine, how would Char-Char look blushing and shy while looking at someone she likes?”  
“Wow….. that’d be amazing.”  
Keurigord gets blank-stared, Hylli wants to talk whenever we see each other, and Yves wears an expression and mutters to himself.  
“Should I take you and run away….”  
Sean would cover his face with both hands without saying anything. His blush used to only reach his face but now the red spreads to the tip of his ears.  
  
Why are you guys not obsessing over the female lead and doing other stuff instead?  
  
Charine West, who wanted to live a normal life, and her survival at Char-Char’s reverse harem.

title: I, the Female Robot
description:
Since she was young, Qi Qi has been burdened with an incurable disease that will cause her death before the age of 20. Despite this, she uses her genius intellect to develop robotics in order to defy her fate. However, she is inevitably unable to create a robotic body for herself before her time is up. As her vision darkens, she is not satisfied… Only to awaken again?  


---

title: High Society
description:
**"Please sell me. I will become the most expensive lady in Sant'nar"**

Tired of the troubles brought about by his political marriage, debauchee Cesare coincidentally enters into an unusual  contract Adel, a shoeshiner from the slums.

The deadline is three months.

Expecting this to be his liberation from the tedious strategic marriage, Cesare finds himself becoming increasingly concerned about Adel, who behaves unlike any woman he has ever known...

"In the first place, didn't you bring me here to get me engaged to Sir Ezra?"
"That's right."

Cesare replied obediently for a moment before bursting into a sharp laugh.

"But why do I feel so disgusted?"

title: Corridor of Mirs
description:
One day, a girl woke up from a near car accident, and her name was Baek Nabi. After her chance encounter with a beautiful man, who saved her from the accident, Nabi starts to see things she has never seen before. Creatures who live off from human’s negative emotions are called ‘parasites’ . Nabi’s once normal life has overturned and becomes intertwined with several men all at the same time… “You’re a special existence. You just haven’t remembered yet.” A fantasy romance of Nabi and the mysterious beings around her.  


---

Official English translation by Comico's [Pocket Comics](https://www.pocketcomics.com/comic/208)

title: The Princess Demands a Divorce
alt_titles: I Want to Become the Empress Regnant, so I Need a Divorce
I Want to Become the Emperor, so I Need a Divorce
description:
Born as an imperial princess, Arnoah was forced to marry the pathetic young king of a small neighboring kingdom. Her older brother became the emperor, so what was she supposed to do? And due to the laws of inheritance, even if her older brother and younger brother were to die, she would still not inherit the throne - rather, her good-for-nothing cheater of a husband would!! Any title she inherits would be vested in her husband in accordance to their marriage contract... that is, until he decides to divorce her because his mistress wants to be the official queen.

“I need to get divorced and become the emperor.”

Her now official ex-husband still doesn't seem to get it, so she decided to finally tell him everything she always wanted to say to his face. When he realized the truth, it was already too late. She spoke to her ex-husband who had his mouth agape.

“I told you to keep your head straight. Didn’t you hear me?”

---
Revenge is sweet. Divorce? Even sweeter.

Arnoa is trapped in a loveless marriage in which she has sacrificed both her heart and dignity. In the midst of such matrimonial misery, she receives the chance to claim the Empire as her own. There's just one catch: she needs a divorce to make it happen! Will she succeed in getting the last laugh?

title: The Story of Hua Yan
description:
The almighty crowned prince insists on marrying this young “Overgrown Apricot” lady from the tainted Hua family. When the news broke out in the capital, many hearts were broken but what?! This wicked woman doesn’t even want to be the crowned princess because she wants to drink and run away with another man?!  
  
Lady Hua: I am a tough woman. I’m definitely not suited for you!   
Crowned Prince: Then I’ll make sure that in this world, you can only pick me.

title: Gentleman Devil
description:
Follow the Devil King as he embark on his journey to become a gentleman!  
  
[Working Raws](https://www.ohmanhua.com/12031/)

title: Monster Duke's Daughter
description:
When her mom goes missing, three-year-old Lotilucia stumbles on a magic crest that transports her to the estate of House Frodium, one of the empire’s most powerful noble families. Little Lottie immediately recognizes Duke Damian Frodium as her dad; he is the so-called “Monster Duke” of demon descent. Once taken into the house, Lottie does her best to stay out of his way. But then she stumbles on a magic book that shows her a story about Duke Frodium’s adopted daughter replacing his dead daughter named Lotilucia! Lottie is shocked but also emboldened by the prophetic tale. If she is meant to die anyway, she might as well be her cheeky self and do as she pleases! This new Lottie wins over her demon dad along with his staff, but will she manage to stay alive and thrive as the Monster Duke’s daughter?

---

title: My Temp Job as the Youngest Daughter (Promo)
alt_titles: My Contract as the Youngest Daughter
description:
*Promotion for the novel.*  
  
Emily was a noblewoman who lost her father’s favor and even her life to her younger half-sister. She was killed by them and woke up in the past. Upon realizing this, she runs away from her noble family to save her life. However, while running away, she finds herself in danger of being kidnapped by an unknown assailant. But then, mysterious men who claim to be her ‘father’ and ‘brother’ suddenly appear?!  
  
“Take your hands off my daughter.”  
“If you let my younger sister go, I’ll spare your life.”  
  
‘My father isn’t that young. And I don’t have a brother…?’  
How did it turn into this?  
  
Emily, the mistreated girl of the duke’s family, is reborn as Elizabeth, the pampered youngest daughter of a count.  
  
The new goal of her second life: eat well and live well!  


---

[Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/_yoteh)  
[Illustrator's Twitter](https://twitter.com/tosikou)

title: The Genius Medicinal Mage
description:
Renoc was supposed to be a video game character, so giving him a dying body in exchange for extreme magical prowess felt reasonable. However, when his creator wakes up inside Renoc's body, it doesn't feel like a game anymore!

His life in the game is unbearable until he discovers the mysterious drug Vyper, which gives him the strength to wield his magic to its full potential.

As Renoc walks a fine line with the drug that could save or destroy him, can he find a way to survive in this new world?

title: Solar Eclipse
description:
"You want me to pretend to be the prince's lover? This sounds like an easy payday!" Lai is a man who's known to solve any problem for cash in the underworld, and he has been commissioned by Edwin, head of the noble Theodore family, for a secret mission. He needs Lai to stand in for his missing brother, Ellen; thankfully, the two are nearly identical. The aristocracy is rife with rumors about Ellen's love affair with Prince Hector. Lai, now living as "Ellen" in the royal palace, is subjected to harsh treatment and repeated bullying. Where the hell is the real Ellen? What secrets lurk beneath the relationship between the crown prince and his paramour?  


---

[Official Chinese Translation](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/6575/)

title: Ugly Duckling
description: Ori is the main character of an unfinished story written by "Grandfather". So far, she's lived the life of one being bullied, and hates herself for being unable to stand up for herself. An unnamed male is given the task to finish her story, and we'll see how Ori's life will continue from here!

title: Let's Get Married First
description:
The East. The cursed land where the sun never rises, always engulfed in dreary weather, swarmed with criminals, and where depression is the norm. And the monster who governs over this land is the Duke of Eckard. Hedel, who was on the verge of marrying her cousin, receives a marriage proposal from this monster Duke. Although everyone opposes her, Hedel had no choice but to accept the Duke's proposal...

"I've never had this kind of food before!"

"Ever since Madam's arrival, the sun seems to always set here...!"

"The East can never live without Madam anymore."

It seems Hedel has done very well in taming the people from the East. This is the story of Hedel occupying the East, which starts with a marriage.

---
With her family deep in debt, Hedel Argetnta was looking for any way out of her disastrous situation. Her only option? Marrying the wealthy but monstrous duke of the east, Cassian Ekarde, a total stranger. Upon her arrival in the East, she learns it is a cursed land infested with criminals, and that her new home is full of dangerous servants. Determined to turn things around, Hedel starts to make changes but finds out that the cause of all this mess might be none other than the man she married.

title: Blade of Retribution
description: On the day that Kendo Champion Shiho decided to help out his single mother run a Gukbap restaurant, he received news that his sister, Shiyeon, committed suicide. During the funeral, Shiho realizes that something was wrong. It wasn't a suicide, she was murdered. In order to learn the truth and get revenge for his sister's death, Shiho lifts up his sword once more to begin a war of his own.

title: Kill The Dragon
description:
The human race plunged into a war against dragons, who have invaded the earth. At the same time, among the humans arose people with supernatural powers, called psykers.

Through the countless sacrifices of psykers, the war seemed to be coming to an end with the human race as the victors. But when a psyker with the ability to see the future foretold that the dragons will be returning in 15 years, the people established Ark, a facility to train children born with psychic abilities to prepare for the last war of the human race.

There are only three years remaining until the prophesized war. What will happen next?!

---
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/action/kill-the-dragon/list?title_no=4618)

title: I Just Want to Disappear
description:
“The Blessing of Heaven”, “A Prodigal Genius”, “Edenberg’s Dog”  
  
To win the love of her adopted parents, Elena dedicated her skills to the Edenberg name. If anything posed to harm the family, Elena would even kill the people she loved. In the end, Elena’s “family” chose to sacrifice her. No longer having the will to live, Elena’s dying wish was to destroy the Edenberg family name. Time reset and Elena now has a chance to do just that with the help of the mysterious Emperor who heard her wish.  
  
————————————  
  
A family not connected by blood but with ink. I do not desire these abilities of mine. I only want love from them however, they cruelly used everything I had and abandoned me at the end.  
  
I was offered as a sacrifice.  
“Those eyes.”  
Before death approached after I was sacrificed, I met him.  
“You have no will to live.”  
He breathed in the scent from my neck as if it was the most fragrant thing.  
“Your last wishes, child.”  
  
Those were the last words I heard in this life. I thought that moment was extremely awful. If only I was allowed to live one more time. Then. This time I will throw you people away first. Like a miracle, I returned to the past.  
  
“I come to pick you up.”  
“……”  
“Really, it has been a while, isn’t it?”  
I met him again.

title: Unbalance x2: After Story
description:
Sequel to “Unbalance x2”  
25-year-old Nah Hae-Young is a high school teacher. She’s pretty popular and well-received by her students, but she has one huge secret… She’s actually in a relationship with one of her students, Myung Jin-Ho! This is her story of trying to navigate her life without allowing too many stirrups from her young lustful boyfriend!

title: The Villainous Tyrant Has Returned
description:
"If you wish, I don’t mind dying."

The tyrant Ludwig Magenta has met his end at the hands of Empress Olive Charlotte. The moment he accepted death, he opened his eyes in the garden where he first met her at the age of twelve. 

If he starts again from the beginning, can he change his tragic life? 

Only time will tell if Ludwig’s quest for Olive’s love will succeed.

---
Was there ever a greater tragedy than love turned to hate? Such is the tragic downfall of Emperor Ludwig of Berzantium, as he is betrayed and murdered in a fiery blaze by his empress. Olive Charleterre was once a bright young debutante, until her spirit was broken by the emperor’s cruelty. Yet when Ludwig opens his eyes, he finds he has been sent back in time to his childhood. Whether he uses this boon to reclaim his lost love and forge a new path away from his villainous future -- only time will tell.

title: Strongest Cultivation System
description: Han Hao is your regular working college student. He grinds odd jobs to pay rent, average grades, and wishes to be someone in life. Han Hao got his highschool crush to date him after months of sheer perseverance and is now trying to please his girlfriend… but he one day finds out he’s getting cucked and gets beaten to the ground on top of it. Cursing his luck, he stumbles upon the “Cultivation System”, a game-like feature where he can finally get the strength to do something about his life! Follow Han Hao’s adventures as he develops further as a cultivator!

title: Urban Best Medic
description: The immortal doctor Lu Ning, will reveal the truth and cure the non-curable disease, but the next step is his fiance, the ice cold female president, beautiful and pretty like flowers, and to win her heart. In the future, he have to face counterattack, danger in this big world.

title: Single Dad In Another World
description: One day, my wife disappeared. My young daughter suffers from a rare disease with no cure, and life offers no chance to breathe. Just when I was about to give up on everything— I suddenly found myself transported to another world with my daughter. And not just any world… but the dark, terrifying fantasy novel my wife wrote! I have to save my daughter, no matter what.

title: Nano List
description:
Milo lives in a world where interacting with androids is completely normal. And now, he lives with *two* androids built by his sister. How safe is he living with androids who have deadly strength? Why did his sister gift him a "bodyguard android?" Well, he's about to find out the hard way.
Source: Webtoon

title: I Stayed at Home for a Century, When I Emerged I Was Invincible
alt_titles: I've Been Home for a Hundred Years and I'm Invincible When I Go Out
Wo Zhai Liao Bainian Chumen Yi Wudi
Invincible After a Hundred Years of Seclusion
description:
He clearly transmigrated into the body of the young master of a powerful aristocratic family in the fantasy world, but was sent out of his ancestral home and made to live in a remote courtyard!? But Chu Xuan doesn’t care at all, because he has a system that will help him get stronger! As long as he stay at home long enough, he can become strong! Ding~ Stayed at home for a day, reward- Indestructible Body Technique… Ding~ Stayed at home for a year, reward- Yuxu Celestial Scripture and 100 years of cultivation… Ding~ Stayed at home for ten years,… Since no one wants me to go out, I, Chu Xuan, I’m going to stay at home!

Note: There is no Chapter 102 in the raws.

title: The Divine Urban Physician
alt_titles: The Best Medical God in the City
description:
Five years ago, the Ye family was destroyed, and the trash Ye Chen disappeared mysteriously. Now, and the trash Ye Chen is back! He came back with a cultivating body that penetrated the heavens and the earth and cried, "Ghosts and gods!" 

This time, Ye Chen wants to make the sky fall in awe! Let the Earth tremble! To be in control of everything, to the top of the sky!

title: Amentia
description: Lee Wee Jin has to cope with his tyrant sister on a master-slave basis everyday. Trying to fool himself he evades reality, thinking she's tsundere and that she really likes him. Suddenly, these delusions become all too real.

title: I Will Divorce the Female Lead's Older Brother
alt_titles: I Will Divorce the Female Lead's Siscon Brother
description:
After transmigrating into her favorite novel as Ethel Wallace, she realizes how ridiculous everyone is to fawn over Riena Cassius, her sister-in-law and the original female lead who regressed in the story. Ignored by the family and unable to endure the nonsense any longer, she is determined to divorce her husband and turns toward the marquis, Riena’s future enemy, for help. Will Ethel escape House Cassius? Or will regression trump transmigration? And why does the marquis seem… like a gentleman?

---
Ethel, who reincarnated into her favorite novel, has married the female lead’s brother Liena. She thought her marriage life was genuine, but soon enough she became tired of a husband who cared only for his sister and whose attention was always centered on Liena, yet was cold to her, so she filed for divorce.

“Divorce? Absolutely not!”

However, her opponent is a powerful duke, so she turns to Terrence, the villain of the original story to be her assistant for a smooth divorce.

“The only person I want to have by my side is you, Ethel.”

…But this man’s fate is to be hurt by Liena.

As the more she knew about Terrence, the more he seemed attractive to her?

title: Goddess Personal Coach
description: As a personal trainer, what Li Xiu has to do is to help his members get rid of imperfections! Female star with low back pain? Come, let me give you two private lessons, and help you luminate with youth and vitality! The female president has a stomach ache? Come take my private lessons, I guarantee that you'll break free of this pain's clutches! There are no imperfect women in this world; if there are, it's because they haven't met me.

title: I Became a Doting Father
alt_titles: I Become a Fool When It Comes to My Daughter
description:
I've become a single father!

24-year-old Juwon Lee works part-time at a convenience store and lives alone in his small apartment. One day his uncle passes away and leaves behind a 4-year-old daughter, the cute little Yeondu. Instead of letting her be sent to an orphanage, Juwon steps up and decides to be her new guardian.

title: I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Tyrant
alt_titles: I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Tyrant
My BFF Is a Tyrant in Training
I Raised My Childhood Friend as a Tyrant
description:
I was described as the short-lived childhood friend who turned the male lead into a tyrant in the novel. I died on his behalf, as the novel said. I thought I could now return to my original world. …But why am I back to the age of ten? Is there something wrong with the original story? I can’t help it! I thought I would succeed this time and go back to reality… This tyrant dream is too realistic to be true!

“I don’t care about the throne.”

“What?”

What is it? Did I say this before my regression?

“What are you talking about? Becoming emperor…”

You should meet the heroine and the original story should go on. That way I can go back!

“Viche,” Jade was calling me somewhere with a low voice, “I can’t let you go… for whatever reason.”

There was a soft smile behind Jade’s bleak eyes. …I think he knows something.

---
A young Korean woman is reincarnated inside a novel as Viche Amelian, who according to the story, is to be executed in place of the young prince Jade for assassinating the emperor. After facing her death, she expects to get her old life back, but instead wakes up as a ten-year-old Viche! Could it be that her death failed to turn Jade into a tyrant, as the story foretold? Viche must now figure out where she went wrong, and make sure that this time, Jade becomes the world’s most wicked tyrant!

---

title: The Young Lady Tames the Male Leads
description:
I was reincarnated as the young lady of a Marquis. Emir Sharon, who has no significance in the novel and her goal is to live a peaceful life!

I met the main characters of the original novel as kids in the imperial kindergarten, which I'm currently attending to.

I can't believe that I'm meeting all the main characters!

I was happy for a while but somehow, everyone doesn't seem to be so happy with me. But I can't miss the opportunity to build a strong connection with the future protagonists.

Emir Sharon is on her quest to getting close to the main characters finally begins.

And when I finally come to my senses, I'm in a situation where everyone is keeping each other on check just to take the seat right next to me.

What am I going to do with these kids who already glued themselves to me?

title: The Life of Maria Llewellyn (Pre-serialization)
description: Marie was brought to this world by an accident. God gave her one power, so she can hear the voices of animals! One day, while working hard with little pleasure, Maria hears, "The Prince's leopard hurts a lot. If someone can heal the leopard, the prince will grant any wish." *** "Hey, why do I have to stay in the palace?" "You asked me. You said want to live here." "That's not what I meant" "It's too late." . . .

title: I Dominate a Magical Continent with an Industrial Revolution
alt_titles: Forging an Industrial Empire in a Magical World
description:
This is a **Medieval Fantasy World** brimming with magic and adventure, where various races and cultures coexist. 

The protagonist, a young lord, inherits his family’s lands and wealth, but must overcome many challenges. With the aid of his system, he introduces an industrial revolution to this magical continent and ultimately rises to dominate it!

title: Stuck With the Protagonist
alt_titles: I Will Just Stick to the Protagonist
I Will Just Stick to the Main Character
I Will Be Next to the Main Character
description:
What's so great about being the daughter of a duke anyway? 

As the youngest child of a crazy duke with no empathy for his kids, Elena wants to live quietly and avoid her family’s bullying. But when she ends up being followed by Sirius Hyperion, the illegitimate child of the emperor and the person foretold to bring down her family, Elena decides to sit back and watch their demise. 

But will sticking with Sirius allow Elena to break free from her family, or will she become one of his many victims?

---
**Original Webtoon:** [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%A3%BC%EC%9D%B8%EA%B3%B5-%EC%98%86%EC%97%90-%EB%B6%99%EC%96%B4%EB%A7%8C-%EC%9E%88%EA%B2%A0%EC%8A%B5%EB%8B%88%EB%8B%A4/3239), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60956369)

title: Hyperventilation
description:
Meeting the unrequited love of your 18-year-old self during a class reunion at 27 - that love that has missed its chance to bear fruit… where is it headed to now?  
  
Support the official English version of the animation here:  
- [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/lewin00000)  
- [Laftel](https://laftel.net/g/37902)

title: Beautiful Legends
description:
Beautiful Legends is one of the international special forces. They are a special team composed of various legendary monster. A certain girl who got eternal life because of a painting, a martial arts practitioner, a wolf man, Frankenstein and a vampire. They fight against the villains in various unusual special events.  
  
  
From the artist of [Solo Leveling](https://mangadex.org/title/31477/Solo-Leveling)  
[Oneshot Raw](http://www.comico.jp/challenge/articleList.nhn?titleNo=3850)  
  
**Series axed with 80 chapters**

title: Campus Valkyrie
description: Unlock the seals that have been sleeping for thousands of years, the hurricane that destroys heaven and earth is approaching, and the people who stir up heaven and earth have quietly awakened! The screenwriter of "the ghostly doctor" has opened a new work, please collect more!

title: The Emperor's Concubine
description: Ran is the young empress of the North Empire. In order to protect her empire, she must assassinate the Orhan, the new emperor of the West Empire. Ran plans to ensnare Orhan in a honey trap by guising a beautiful assassin as tribute of good will. It is revealed, however, that the emperor is not interested in any other woman but Ran herself. Rude and arrogant like a savage, the emperor dares to claim the heart of the noble empress. Left without a choice, Ran decides to hide her identity and sends herself as tribute to the emperor. Can the empress win the emperor's trust? Will the empress be able to assassinate the emperor?

title: My Plug-in Spirit  Ring
description: Urban waste material fell into a strange dream, accidentally obtained a mysterious ring, opened the strongest plug-in, and tragic life began to turn around! The cold female president, cute fiancee, and sexy female spy posted one by one! But just when I was about to reach the peak of my life, I found that there were more than one ring in my dream! ? For the mysterious seal, the other holders had to be killed …

title: “Trembling” as I Escape from You
description: Ai Xu, a designer of trendy toys, suffers from extreme social anxiety and despises socializing and teamwork. Once she became an adult, she did her best to find a job where 90% of the time, she only has to be accountable to herself. However, there is one drawback to being a designer for original IP: She still has to attend and speak at a weekly team meeting. Thankfully, she could simply play a presentation without saying much. Today, however, she was paired with the beautiful and dazzling extrovert Zhiyi from marketing to work as partners on a project.

title: Confession Attack
description:
Hana was never first. Always because Han Geon Woo came in first every time!
Hana would do anything to best Geon Woo, even though she can't figure him out.
This time, she tried to shock him by confessing...
He believed and accepted the confession though? 
Does he like me?

title: Global University Entrance Examination
description: This is a test that puts your life at stake. Pass the test and survive. When the two-faced examiner Qin Jiu meets the cold examinee You Huo, the two amnesiacs are put head to head in a fight by the inhumane system. However, they form a tactic agreement. The system collapses after a series of warnings and the erased memories gradually become clearer. It turns out that at the end of this smoke-filled world, you are still the first person I met. The world is brilliant and grand. Welcome home.

title: Serpents' Descendants
description:
Since ancient times, all around the world, there have been myths related to snakes… If they are but an invention of human imagination, how can they be central to all religions? A story parting from an ancient snake-like temple… could actually be true? A girl with a mystical bloodline is about to be awakened and the search of mysterious totem will bring an inevitable change to all…   
“I will break free from this curse and change my destiny.”

title: The Lady and the Beast
description:
*This is a promotional oneshot for the novel of the same name.*
___
Her peaceful life that was different from her previous life was cut short. Astina was sold to Grand Duke Theodore due to her father’s bankruptcy, however, Grand Duke Theodore lived in the form of a beast…

“He got hit and fainted. It’s not a serious injury so he’ll quickly regain consciousness.”

“He… fainted?”

Contrary to everyone’s expectations of her dying in one night, she began to tame the monster Theodore with her fancy swordwork, and tame it as a pet.

“Theo, sit.”

“Woof!”

But one night after telling Theodore how talented he is, she kissed him for just a second…

“…Theo?”

Astina’s wild beast… became human?
  
A full-fledged romance between the deficient monster husband and the thoughtless wife!

title: Dungeon Athlete
description:
Humanity's greatest gym rat. Hansol, lost consciousness during a deadlift. When he opened his eyes, he arrived at a different world. Monsters appeared in front of him, and all that he could see was protein...?

"I'll flip this world by working out!"

title: The Elegant Sea of Savagery
description:
Irina Nodiac, the eldest daughter of the Marquis, was entrusted to Count Elenoa Schuberg after her father's business continued to fail. All rights were handed over to Elenoa, whom she has known since childhood.

"You belong to me. So don't go messing around."
"Are you treating me like an object?"

However, even though she became a maid, her reputation of a "Crazy Bitch" during Academy days will never change. And now, Irina, who is self-disciplined and confident, stands in front of Elenoa.

"I can do more than what meets the eye. I can carry a lot of stuff."

Elenoa, who wants to own her completely, and Irina, who is trying to move forward despite difficult situations. What kind of voyage will they embark on in the future?

title: Welcome to the Nightmare Game
description: Qi Leren unfortunately got a black screen when he cleared the first BE ending in "Nightmare Game". On the way on the bus to repair the computer, the bus collided with a sudden truck, and the injured passengers were taken to the hospital. When he woke up, Qi Leren found out that he was lying in the empty infusion hall, and there was no one to be seen in the huge hospital…

title: Love Jinx
description:
"Because something bad always happens when I kiss…”   
  
Haekyung is handsome, has a great academic background and job, and is charismatic.   
Haekyung, who seems flawless, has a very big weakness: a strange jinx.   
And that is if he kisses anyone, shortly after, he will break up with his lover or get caught in a sticky situation!  
Because of this jinx, he ends another relationship. To make matters worse, his available pool of partners is overflowing with weird men…

title: I Became the Villain of the Otome Game
alt_titles: Hòugōng Jiù Jiāogěi Fǎnpài Nǚ Pèi
Hougong Jiu Jiaogei Fanpai Nv Pei
Hougong Jiu Jiao Gei Fanpai Nv Pei
The Harem Has Already Been Handed Over to the Villainous Supporting Girl
Give the Harem to the Villainess
description: Lin Ci transmigrated into the otome mobile game she created and became the villainess. The only way she can go back to the real world is avoiding the harem ending and letting the heroine, Rutas, end up with one love interest. Otherwise, Lin Ci would be killed according to the plot. To survive, Lin Ci must win over the men from the heroine one by one!

title: [GwangGong Industrial Complex] Barrel
description: A member of the corporate organization, the Jinhong faction, Nam Eunho, is a spy that was planted by the rival organization, the Deokeun faction. In the midst of stealing supplies, to secure funds for her faction, and to manipulate their books, under the orders of the Jinhong faction’s boss, she was tasked in monitoring his daughter, Chun Hee-Min. Hee-Min, who is unknown to the outside world, confuses Eunho through her existence. Behind closed entrance doors of a spacious room, where the air is dry, and nothing but the scent of the two people living there filling it, the two of them build a peculiar bond. But as emotions deepen, and shake their reason, the two of them end up making choices that can not be reversed

title: Boss in School
description:
Seth Kwon was a born fighter. But due to his promise with his mother, he decides to stop fighting, even in self-defense… Everything changes when his father dies and leaves him with a single message: “stop getting your ass kicked”.

(Source: Toomics)

---

title: Zui Wu Dao
description: In a world of martial arts, a young boy namned Wu was unable to practice martial arts due to his special body, will he accept his fate and live his life bullied and looked down by others or will he rise and become a master?

title: The Heavenly Demon Lord Who Doesn't Want to Level Up
description:
"Jin Yuseong, the absolute master of the Middle Kingdom, found life too boring. 'I must be crazy. Just unifying the martial world…'"
"'I should have just been a farmer.'"
"'No, I wish I wasn't born at all.'"
"In 'The Heavenly Demon Lord Who Doesn't Want to Level Up,' one day, he encounters a gate… And upon passing through it, a new world unfolds."
"Jin Yuseong, the top martial deity and leader of the Celestial Demon Cult, arrives in Korea.

title: Jeong-Nyeon
description:
Jeong-Nyeon has no money or education, but she is a Mokpo girl with a talent for singing! Her dream is to join a women's traditional theater company, and make it big. But she has a lot to learn and a long way to go before becoming a lead actor. Will Jeong-Nyeon achieve her dream of becoming a big star and getting rich?  
The story begins in 1956 (post-war Korea) in the southwestern port city of Mokpo.  
  
Winner of the 2019 Our Manhwa of the Year award, and is set to release as as a Drama by the end of 2024.
  
[Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/namonnamon14)  
[Artist's Tumblr](https://jinamong.tumblr.com)  
[Artist's Naver Blog](https://blog.naver.com/babomj14)

title: The Third Ending
description: Suh Yoonseul has had life easy—everyone likes him, he’s good at his job, basically everything has always worked out as smooth as butter. However, there’s something that brings all of his good luck down, and it’s the infrequent dreams he has of Kang Jun. Who knew that rejecting a guy once would hang so heavy on your life? To make things worse, after he runs into Jun the dreams keep on coming daily. At his wit’s end, Yoonseul takes some advice from a friend so that he can free himself from this jinx. It’s simple. Make Kang Jun think that he’s a nice person. That can’t be hard, right?

title: Soundless Cosmos
description: A cold and distant grim reaper and a rational young lady whose fates are entwined by life and death. Through his silent protection, will they be able to overcome the hardships that obstruct their songs of love?

title: The Savior's 30-Day Unstoppable Streak
alt_titles: Qiāndào 30 Tiān Yī Quán Bào Xīng
Qiandao 30 Tian Yi Quan Bao Xing
Signed 30 Days and I Can Destroy a Star With One Punch
After Signing in for 30 Days, I Can Annihilate Stars
description:
The invasion of deities from the other dimension.

10,000 "liberators" have been chosen to enter a hidden world, where the bloodthirsty battles against demonic beasts are streamed live for the whole world to see.

Chu Mo: 
 -What the fuck?! 
 -I'm useless on the side of these powerful people! 
 -It's a crime to put a normal person to fight a demonic beast!

"Active registration system."

Registration Reward - Day 1: The power of a 1000 year old demonic beast.
Registration Reward - Day 2: The legendary God of War experience in combat.

....
....

W-what? Will I become like Saitama with the 30th day reward?!

title: Don't Mess With Me, Miss
alt_titles: Xiao Jie Jie Qiān Wàn Bié Re Wo
description: Due to the betrayal of his close friend and girlfriend, college student Wang Ming sunk into the lowest point in his life. During the time he was at his lowest, he had many conflicts out of anger and a will to strike back with the campus belle who he was co-renting with. However, it was also at this time when he was accidentally drawn into a series of conspiracies and contacted the hidden witchcraft society behind modern society. After the evolving Gǔ insect 'Gold Silkworm Gǔ' treated him as its host, he became unceasingly stronger and each and every formidable enemy also continued to emerge from the depths….

title: Killing Ghosts
description: In this era, demons and monsters roam the streets at night. Humans and familiars work as partners who kill those monsters. Civil servant Fan Xiaotie and the strongest demon girl Linyu of the secret department “Supernatural Affairs Armed Response Team” must face endless crisis.

title: Strongest Leveling
description:
Nothing is impossible with the system in my hands! I want the most beautiful woman! I want to be the most powerful person! I want to have the noblest of statuses! I aim to conquer everything under the sky!  


---

title: Surviving as a Barbarian in a Fantasy World
alt_titles: Surviving as a Barbarian in a Fantasy World
Barbarian’s Adventure in a Fantasy World
description:
Every night, he prayed to wake in a world of magic and adventure. One day, his wish came true, though not in the way he expected. He awoke in a vast, snowy wilderness as a Barbarian, a powerful race feared for their strength and savagery.

Though the world was everything he’d dreamed of, his new form came with challenges. Determined not to live as a mindless brute, he learned the human tongue, studied their customs, and became a registered mercenary. But despite his efforts to belong, his monstrous appearance and overwhelming strength lead most to see him as a threat.

Now, caught between the world he longed for and the one that rejects him, he must fight to prove he’s more than what others fear and uncover the reason he was brought here in the first place.

title: Love Revolution
description: Romance, such thing cannot exist between us!

title: The NOmance I Need
description:
Ahyeon, who has never felt the true romance of a relationship, resented God as she feared that she might forever be alone. But all of a sudden, she started winning over a number of guys…?  

---
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/LOVE/woxuyaodenomanshi/list?title_no=1628)

title: Orange Marmalade
description: Vampires have evolved and don't rely on human blood anymore. They now co-exist secretly as normal citizens even though they are still feared and discriminated against by the society. So what happens to a female vampire trying to live a normal school life when she meets the most popular boy in school and accidentally nips his neck?

title: The Healing Solaris Cleric
alt_titles: Manager Hill - Priest of the Sun
The Healing Priest of the Sun
description:
Han Jungwoo was always picked on for being too nice.

An avid player of MID, the world's most realistic online fantasy game, he spends his time helping those in need rather than completing quests. But when he is unexpectedly given the chance to become a Solaris Cleric, a rare hidden character class, the game actually starts to reward him for doing good deeds.

With ruthless characters all around him though, can this Mr. Nice Guy make it as a top-tier player?

---
- [Webtoon PV](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EmDgbydU_Oc)

title: Your Distance
description: My boyfriend, that was 287km away is now 3km away? Professor Bo Chang Yi used to be good at understanding others but is now no longer humane. The happiness in Ting Shuang’s heart vanished in an instant, leaving only fear, if you think about it, it seems that there will be disaster in the near future.

title: Xian Chan Nu
description: Liu Shiqing, the lady in charge of the escort who loves to play, encounters a cicada to save her when she is out of danger and falls in love at first sight. A story of revenge and loyalty is about to unfold around humans and demons, masters and servants.

title: Homework of the Heart
description:
My first ever love disappeared 13 years ago… and came back as a vampire.  
  
Yi Gyung Jo moves to a new town in hopes of finding a new, quiet life but is quickly thrown into a peculiar situation when she finds out that the said town is inhabited by vampires…

title: Above Ten Thousand People
description: Tens of thousands of big shots grovel at his feet, yet he says, “I’m really just an ordinary mortal, though…”

title: LESSA - Servant of Cosmos
description:
The end time has come…! The last war on which the fate of the world hangs.  
  
*Part 3 of the LESSA series*

title: The Rebirth of Noble: Revenge
alt_titles: Rebirth of the Rich and Wealthy
description: Her father was missing when she was 3 years old; her hand tendon was cut when she was 15; her mother died in a planned car accident when she was 16; she was framed by her relatives when she was 19; she was burnt alive by her newlywed husband and friend when she was 22. Perhaps the god pities her and makes her reborn to the age of 15. She kept a low profile in the previous life but ended up with being betrayed miserably; this time she will not show any weakness and make those who harmed her pay with their lives!

title: Wolf Butler and His Cat Master
The Queen of Killers
alt_titles: Don’t Mess With the Killer Princess
description: She was the most arrogant hitwoman of the 21st century, and was unintentionally killed by her senior, and transmigrated to bingzhou continent. when she opened her eyes, she crawled out of the pond, and threw the woman who hurt her into the pond for a bath. she also met a cold and arrogant beautiful man, as she looked at his disdaining expression… she will forever remember what this cold and arrogant guy said, "when this consort bears this king's child, this king will shall snatch everything under the heavens of this Mingyou nation!"

title: Ni Xi Ba Mo Wang!
description: Leaving behind his throne, his wealth, and his women. The Demon King now disguises himself and start raising heroes in his pen?! He even formed a party to level up "newbies"! Isn't this suppose to be the war between Good and Evil?! Caesar mockingly answers: "Rules? I create the rules!"

title: The Villains' Little Heiress
alt_titles: I'm the Heiress of a Villainous Household
I Am the Heiress of the Villain Family
I'm the Heiress of the Villain Family
description:
Ten years after being reincarnated as an extra in a novel. The day my grandfather, the owner of the house where I grew up, died, of the infamous ducal family of Blasco.

"His Excellency the Grand Duke bequeathed all his assets to the girl Katisha."
"His Highness the Grand Duke."

So my grandfather is the Duke of Blasco? I am struck by the enormity of the inheritance, but it is impossible for "the" Duke of Blasko to leave me alone, even because we are related!

"No, thanks..."
"Cash, excluding inheritance tax and personal deposits at the central bank. You can keep everything else in Blasco's name."
"I want!!!"

title: Lucky Striker
description:
Lee Gi-Ho is trying to earn his tuition through the popular VR game Circuit, but things just aren't going his way. However, right when he decides to throw in the towel, he gets a lucky break that changes everything!

Fortune leads him ever deeper into the game’s lore, and before he knows it, Gi-Ho finds himself stocked up with powerful items chasing an elusive group of mysterious warriors. 

But to unlock his true powers, Giho must learn the secrets of this group before his luck runs out for good.

---

- [Webtoon Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vvOZs-a5I-s)

title: The Saintess and Her Secret Chambers
alt_titles: The Imprisoned Saintess and the Night of Confidentiality
The Imprisoned Saint Goes Wild at Night
The Imprisoned Saint and the Secret Night
description:
Saint Aristella, who sealed the goddess of lust in her body...

Ever since she was imprisoned in the temple of Yigmentar from which she could not escape, she sometimes felt her body heat up and her consciousness flies away.

The priests and knights of the temple, seduced by the power of her goddess within her, who is getting stronger day by day, fell in love with the saint...

“I hate relationships without love!”

If you want to receive the saint's favor, you have to win her heart?

And so, the men's war to win the love of the naive Aristella begins!

title: Almost Friends
alt_titles: The rabbit that refuses to be friends with the fox
description: One is a rabbit girl with a congenital defect, and the other is a fox girl that’s super popular but has a lonely heart. Despite their differences, they are each other’s precious ‘The Other Me in This World’. When they meet, a story of mutual healing and mutual growth begins…

title: Outlaws
description: Two high school students, Lee Sang-Hyun and Bae Ji-Hyun, live their lives as normal high school students, while secretly hiding their true identities: Mages of Law. But on one eventful day, Bae Ji-Hyun reveals her true identity of being a Law Mage in an attempt to rescue Lee Sang-Hyun from a deadly attack from the Corruptors, but to her surprise, Lee Sang-Hyun has a secret to show of his own! Join Lee Sang-Hyun and Bae Ji-Hyun, as they make numerous sacrifices and attempts in order to fight and exterminate the Corruptors that are plaguing the world in which they live in.

title: It's Hard for Evil Lords to Raise Haughty Concubines
alt_titles: It's Hard for Evil Princes to Raise Little Princesses
It's Hard for Evil to Raise Concubines
Xie Jun Nan Yang Xiao Mo Fei
description: The pitiful failure was reborn, awakening the talents within her… but she pretends to be weak, while hiding her true strength?! The notorious reputation of the so-called failure began to spread far and wide, her name attracting countless challengers. Naturally, in the end… she'll conquer all who stand in her way! When meeting the evil demon lord, she even dares to call him a pervert?! If these two can join forces, just what kind of bewildering change can they bring upon the world?

title: Never Die Extra
description:
Extras die every day in various ways in the game [Demon King’s Palace 3].

He was an extra when he reincarnated into the game.

I’ll never die. Never.

“Let’s get started.”

Evan had come to a conclusion.

He tapped his cheeks as a way of signaling to himself that he had made up his mind.

He would become a character who never dies.

title: The Father and the Daughter
description: A princess, neglected by her father, the emperor, decides to take the throne after his sudden death. But when he unexpectedly returns alive, their already strained relationship turns into a battle of wits and wills.

title: Xuan Ji Ci
description:
This is surely a story you've never thought of! The cartoon’s main character is called Yuan Xin. She’s an otaku who likes to immerse herself in a fantasy world. She, who likes to look at hot guys–after embarrassing herself in front of them in the school yard, decides to retaliate. Unexpectedly, during the crucial moment, an accident happened, and she crossed over to the game world!  
  
This comic has converted to strip comic!

title: Super Keyboard Man
description:
A super keyboard, comeback life of a technology nerd.
Money! Girls! I want it all!
Because I have a magical keyboard!!
I am the Super Keyboard Man!!!

title: Hotel Temptation
description: In her past life, Liu Zihan was a cowardly girl who was bullied. After her father's death, she was deceived by relatives and deprived of all her property. After her rebirth, she became the queen of mercenaries and turned into a female soldier from a weak woman. But in an accident, she traversed back to that weak and helpless time, but at the moment she already has good skills and knows the true side of everyone. So she decided to take revenge!

title: True Beauty
description:
From Webtoon: A high school girl who rises to pretty girl fame in her school after she masters the art of make-up via YouTube.  
From Naver: Everyone has a secret. Then what kind of secret does a goddess have?

title: Taebaek: The Tutorial Man
description: Beginner skills Lv.999! The adventure of a Tutorial NPC who has an ego!

title: Fuchou Airen
description: Yan Shuangshuang watched her former lover die before her eyes. An angel appeared, giving her a chance to live again. However, after her rebirth, everything went wrong.

title: Blood Time
description: The clumsy mistake maker, Yeon-Woo, one day passes through a dark alley and comes face to face with a person named Ha-Yang. To her surprise, the young woman appears to be a vampire, who asks for Yeon's blood in exchange. Will Yeon let the scary Ha-Yang taste a drop of her blood?

title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker
description: In Eastern History, humans and spirits exist in this world. Fox spirits have long acted as matchmakers, holding a prestigious position among spirits. In this story, the lives of a fox spirit and a man who have both rejected the idea of true love become intertwined, and their exciting adventure begins.

title: You Look Better Crying
alt_titles: Ni Ku Qi Lai Zhen Hao Kan
You Look So Beautiful When You Cry
description: Crybaby Xiao Yu together with the expressionless bad girl Xiao Xiao. Two different personalities seeking comfort in each other.

title: Poor Father and Daughter
description:
It's about a poor family of two: father and rebellious daughter.  
In order to make money the single father does a lot of odd jobs and at the school the daughter is incompatible with her classmates.

title: Powerful Juvenile King
alt_titles: Lin Yang and the Miracle Ring
description: My name is Lin Yang, a college student from a poor family. Accidentally, I got a ring. It changes my body into something with unique physical attractions for girls. However, that is not the only thing it brings to me…

title: Checkmate
description:
When he was just a student, Soohyun, ranked second, felt envious of the perfect Eunsung. Although he tried catching Eunsung, his soul aflame with passion, it wasn’t enough, and he lost all his motivation upon graduation.  
  
As time passed, Soohyun forgot everything. However, when he saw Eunsung collapse for the first time, he felt extreme pleasure. With his obsession for Eunsung rekindling, he has a desire to see him fall even further in front of him…

title: Lost in the Cloud
description: Skylar has a secret hobby - taking photos of his crush, Chan-il. But when Cirrus stumbles upon Skylar's cloud storage with its impressive collection of Chan-il's photos, things escalate pretty quickly. At first confident his secret is safe with Cirrus, Skylar continuously finds himself in compromising situations, making him question Cirrus' true motives

title: Seasons of Lovesome
description:
"It may be hazy blue, but that's alright"

Taking place a year after the epilogue of Seasons of Blossom, this story focuses on the new opening of “Cafe Blossom and NEMONE Atelier” as well as Bomi’s new classmate “Pureum” as they explore a new found youth. 

Campus romance, after school romance, office romance, it has it all.  

The heartwarming series is back with another youthful story!

title: Won't There Be a Problem If The Hero Is Such a Horrible Person?
alt_titles: Can the Brave be So Mean?
description: This is a miserable world ruled by the Demon King. However, the God of Creation gave the enslaved humanity a sliver of hope. A Holy Saint will be born every hundred years. The one who has the Holy Maiden's first kiss will become the Hero and lead humanity to topple the Demon King. During the Hero Trial that happens once every a hundred years, a strong but unruly man appeared. Disrespecting the trial and not lending a hand to the helpless villagers when the village was attacked by monsters! He keeps talking about getting the Holy Maiden and saving the world but is this kind of person the Hero humanity has been waiting for!?

title: Turning the Mad Dog Into a Genteel Lord
alt_titles: Turning a Crazy Dog Into a Young Master
description: Diarin, a priestess without any noteworthy family background or connections, always gets the toughest assignments. So when her boss tells her to help Ceres, a war hero, reintegrate into society, she decides to stop being a pushover and get as much as she can out of it, including a juicy promotion. But upon reaching Ceres' manor, she’s greeted by a growling hound instead of a human. Tasked with the impossible job of turning the mad dog into a proper gentleman, she dedicates herself to caring for him. But his unexpected obsession with her was never part of her plan.

title: Sweet Plunder
description: A poor girl entered an elite academy, and accidentally became the target for the rich people's "love hunt". The academy's elegant men become animals like a wolf, lion, bear, and snake in the anonymous chatroom, while treating the girl's heart as a game of gamble… The girl that suddenly discovers the dark truth of the game decides to bare her teeth and break the hearts of these people that attempted to play her, while also trying to uncover the game's mastermind… The revenge of the prey starts now!

title: Crazy Like a Fox
description:
When the emperor declared that his children must battle to become the last remaining heir, the only way Princess Lisbelle could survive was by becoming a mad woman. Feigning insanity kept her out of danger for years, but with only three children remaining, Lisbelle now finds herself a target. In a moment of danger, she discovers powers gifted to her by the goddess Hellare and suddenly finds herself in the company of a charming magician. But whether he’s friend or foe has yet to be determined…

---
"On the Moonlight Garden-! White evening primroses are in full bloom -!"

A strange succession ceremony has all princes and princesses fight each other as only the strongest member of the royal family may succeed the throne. After being poisoned to death, she returned five years into the past and decided to played the part of a crazy b*tch in order to survive. Yet somehow looking like the weakest was still not enough. The crazy princess, with no power or backing, was about to die yet again, but a suspicious wizard suddenly appeared before her.

"What should I do to get your kiss?"

"A deal. If you help me, I'll kiss you."

"Good. I have no intention of letting you die in the hands of anyone besides me."

I feel like I entered the tiger's den while trying to escape the wolves… Is it really okay if I make this deal? A fiery battle and romance between a woman walking towards life with all her might, and a man who lives for death.

---

title: The Playgirl and The Prince
description:
In Izina, a country in the outskirts of a large continent, lives Princess Maeve. A rare sight to see, Princess Maeve, is a Playgirl. She sleeps with almost every man she sees. But while out to look for her next prey, her eyes falls on Prince Carlyn of Guorango. Next thing you know, she proceeds to sleep with him too! But to her surprise, the "Prince" is actually a "Princess"!! What will happen after this?
