title: Guide to a Male God Chasing His Wife
alt_titles: Nan Shen Zhui Qi Zhi Nan
description:
The Modern-day Chapter of "The Distinguished Cute Master (Meng Shi Zai Shang)"! The miserable little white lotus was rescued by the male god. The male god cares for the little white lotus and raises her into a black hearted lotus who'll beat down any enemies!   
Lotus: "You're planning on doing something to me, aren't you? Are you looking at my body?!" (Huggingblankettightly.jpg)  
Male God: "Fool, I have been searching for you for a long time. Now, I just want to spoil you."

title: I Awoke as a God After Auto Battling For a Million Years
alt_titles: After Millions of Years, I Woke Up to Be a God!
Idle Player Returns as a God
Wangyou: Gua Ji Bai Wan Nian, Wo Xing Lai Cheng Shen
Wǎngyóu: Guà Jī Bǎi Wàn Nián, Wǒ Xǐng Lái Chéng Shén
description: An otherworldly invasion begins as countless monsters pour through rifts, engulfing human cities and plunging humanity into a doomsday crisis! From this point, humanity enters an era of universal job transfers, with nations vying to train powerful professionals and compete for top rankings in the otherworldly conquest! When the number one ruler of the Dragon Kingdom, who has slumbered for millions of years, awakens with millions of years' worth of idle resources, the bosses of the otherworld tremble. Top-tier professionals from countries around the globe kneel in awe...

title: The Terminally Ill Young Master of the Baek Clan
alt_titles: Baek Clan's Terminally Ill Young Master
description: Baek Yigang is a son of the Baek Clan, one of the seven great clans of Zhongyuan. Afflicted with the Taiyin Qi Blockage, he is cursed with a shortened lifespan and the inability to collect internal energy. He had been peacefully spending the rest of his days indoors when he was ambushed by a group of masked people. During the ambush, he lost his servant who was like a sister to him. Chased by the attackers, Baek Yigang escaped through a secret underground path. When he came across a blocked path, he decided he’d at least die fighting and picked up a rusted sword that was stuck in the ground…

title: If I Kissed You
description:
Soft cute gentle teacher x fake gentle and actually cold student. Age gap.  
Ms. Luo's self-awareness and acceptance process.  
Author Weibo: <https://weibo.com/u/2140322502?from=myfollow_all&is_all=1&sudaref=weibo.com>

title: Meeting My Ex-Girlfriend
description: What are the chances of running into an ex-lover at the recycling station? A newly written story of two women reunited as apartment neighbors.

title: Tricked into Becoming the Heroine's Stepmother
alt_titles: Éminence Grise Female Lead Is Trying to Make Me Her Stepmom
The Villain is Trying to Make Me a Stepmom
description:
I possessed the role of Civilian 1 in the 'tragic novel' I wrote with my friends as a joke. However, I was soon discovered by the female lead's father, known for endlessly doting on his daughter. The problem is... "Then, what'll happen to my daughter in this 'tragic novel'?" "...What? Ten male leads?" The father of the heroine, Duke Henstone, declared revolution in order to change his daughter's miserable fate. The thing is, if I were to run away now, I'd leave many lives in danger. "I will protect the female lead!" And that's how I began a new chapter of my life, living with the daughter-obsessed duke. But, why is the female lead acting so strange? Why do you keep hooking me up with your dad?

*Note: An éminence grise or grey eminence is a powerful decision-maker or adviser who operates "behind the scenes", or in a non-public or unofficial capacity. This phrase originally referred to François Leclerc du Tremblay, the right-hand man of Cardinal Richelieu.

---

title: Moonlight Howling
description: Yoon - the veterinarian working at the veterinary hospital - is paying close attention to Eun Woo. Yoon removed his mask to help him when he was sick and for the first time seeing Eunwoo's handsome face, Yoon was mesmerized. He said that there was nowhere to go, so Yoon dragged him to his home, and from there began to share the story of the two of them. The closer Yoon is with Eun Woo, the more curious he becomes …

title: Great Doctor Ling Ran
alt_titles: The Making Of A Miraculous Doctor
description:
Ling Ran, whose goal is to become the world's greatest doctor, suddenly obtained the golden finger system! And this is a system with a high degree of medical expertise! With the help of the system, what medical height can the intern Ling Ran reach?  
This manhua adapted the Webnovel called " great doctor ling ran"  
  
[Official English Novel](https://www.webnovel.com/book/great-doctor-ling-ran_11912235406605505)

title: The Flower of Vampires
description:
A breathtaking vampire romance depicting adventure and love in search of the legendary 'vampire flower'. The vampire Louveri sets out in his quest with the human contractor, Seo-Young, appearing in the human world after 500 years.  
  
Author-Artist: Season 1 - Bul-sa | Season 2 - Canaria/Dongmul(동물)  
Based on the [Original Webnovel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.nhn?productNo=1240893) by Hayasi (SHIN Ji-Eun)  


---

[Official Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/FANTASY/xuezuzhihua/list?title_no=1377)

title: The Regressed Genius Player's Mythical-Rank Weapon Creation
alt_titles: The Regressed Genius Player's Legendary Weapon Creation
description:
With the death of Earth’s potential Constellation, the Crimson Eye is now bent on consuming the world. 

Simun Kim--an alchemist out of necessity, due to an inability to use magic--successfully transmuted the Philosopher’s Stone to stop this cosmic threat. But he still failed. As death closes in, the Philosopher’s Stone rewinds time, waking Simun in the past with one last chance to rewrite the end of the world.

title: Born as the Second Daughter
description:
Selene was fortunate to be born to her beloved mother not just once, but twice. And now that her single mother has died in her second life, Selene must face the world as an orphan... or so she thought. 

Before she knows it, she's swept up by a handsome stranger who turns out to be her father and the nation's emperor! Not only that, but she discovers she has three older brothers who absolutely adore her. 

Going from the slums to the imperial palace overnight isn't easy, however, and Selene must navigate her family dynamics, the rules of the palace, and the unbearable loneliness of missing her mother. Moreover, Selene begins to realize that there's a hidden reason why she remembers her past life so well. 

Will Selene be able to find closure from her past and finally mend the hole that her mother's death left in her heart?

title: Lv. 99 Princess of Black Flame
description: When portals called “gates” opened in 1997, humanity was thrown into chaos as monsters ravaged the planet. Countless lives were lost, including Eunha Cha’s mother. Left to fend for herself, Eunha one day mysteriously awakens a new power. Drafted into the military to fight alongside other Hunters, she sets out on what was supposed to be a routine mission inside a C-rank gate. But when she becomes trapped inside, she’s forced to fight relentlessly against waves of monsters as the gate resets endlessly... until a voice calls out to her.

title: Neolithic Girl
description: Once, there lived a fearless girl who could defeat even the strongest of beasts with her bare hands. She was the strongest person living. Thousands of years later, the same girl from the stone age has lived to learn what romance is. Will her strength scare everyone away, or will it let her fall in love?

title: The Duke's Family Is Not My Problem
alt_titles: Don't Expect Me to Take Responsibility
I May Have Saved You, but I Take No Responsibility for It
I Saved You by Chance, but I Am Not Responsible
I Saved You, but I'm Not Responsible
description:
I was the one abandoned, yet I seem to have grown up the most mentally stable! 

I was ordered to serve my fake counterpart as her maid, so I decided to go undercover. But something's off with my former family. Whatever, it's not my problem! So, I just focused on my task... 

"Are you really not going to live with us?"

The eldest, who used to show obsessive control over the fake, started acting strangely toward me. 
"I never thought I’d feel such camaraderie and trust with the opposite sex. You’re strangely too comfortable." 

The second brother, who was on the brink of falling into darkness, managed to get back on track thanks to me. 
"I didn’t come here to help them film their regret-filled family drama." 

I tried to ignore everything and quickly moved on to my next mission… but why do I keep running into people whose lives are completely messed up? 

Why is everyone in perfect need of saving?

title: Summon The Demon, For I Am The Abyss
alt_titles: Summon The Demon, For I Am The Abyss
Devil Summoner, I Am the Abyss Lord
Zhaohuan Emo, Wo Ji Shi Shenyuan
description: Lin Tianhao, who has transmigrated to another world, attends the Job Change Ceremony and ends up taking on a “sewer-tier” job — Summoner. Just as everyone is mocking him, believing his future is doomed, he suddenly awakens a system and gains the skill [Demonic Sacrifice]! Who says the Summoner class is trash? I have the strongest SSS-rank talent!

title: I Came Back as a Martial Genius
alt_titles: Return of the Martial Arts Genius
description:
Demons came pouring from a portal that appeared out of nowhere and caused the Cataclysm. But all hope is not lost thanks to the Awakeners, people who can fight these demons. 

Lee Jun, a D-rank Awakener, is one of them. He fought demons heroically, but as someone who inherited nothing from his family, he could only go so far. 

As Jun Lee’s life slowly whittled away, a system message appeared, informing him that a special martial arts route had opened...

title: My Contracted Wife is Cold to Me
description: Shi Xia Ben is the envy of the president 's wife, but did not expect that behind the scenes is a contract marriage. The three-year deadline is approaching, but the president of Ao Jiao has proposed "let's really do a fake show". What if my husband does not act according to the contract?

title: Flower Wizard
description:
Exorcist Cheon Ji Yul's job revolves around protecting the natural order of the universe.  
  
So how does he end up becoming the bodyguard for a naive high school girl?!  
  
Possessing strange magic and special powers that monsters desire, the unwilling Cheon Ji Yul must now protect the girl from danger.  
  
What does fate have in store for them?

title: Introduction to Survival
description:
‘Remember’. 'One, two, three, four, five, six, seven'

‘I must remember until the end… until the end…’

The day when my wife Julia was killed by those scoundrels, my entire life was consumed by seething anger. That's right. I must eliminate those scoundrels.

'The day I exact my revenge, bury me beside her.'

Until then, I must endure and wager my life on this battle for survival.

title: The Slumbering Ranker
alt_titles: Even if I Sleep, I Rank
description:
“We’re only taking a break for about 30 seconds? I’m not imagining things, right?”
 “…Yes.” 

After 15 hours of hunting, Hyunsung asked to rest for a while, and after 30 seconds, he had to get up again and started hunting.
Actually, Hyunsung has a special skill.

[Thananos’ narcolepsy skill is activated.]
[You’re being forced into a sleep state.]

After sleeping for a while and waking up, I got an item? 
Pay close attention to the story of the God-Rank Class, the descendant of Thananos, the unstoppable Hyunsung.

title: The Regent King Is Too Ferocious
alt_titles: Rebirth Of The Tyrant’s Pet: Regent Prince Is Too Fierce
description: I died of a young age in my previous life, but unknowingly I went back in time to the past where dynasties still existed. However, this was not even a blessing. The me from that life died, killed by her own husband, the emperor. And now, I am reborn into a little girl, who is the sister of the emperor?!

title: Märchen: The Embodiment of Tales
description:
Märchen is a young man who was saved from the brink of death by a martial arts master by infusing her Ki into him. However, things take a turn when Märchen has no interest in fighting and aims to live a peaceful life.
His "Master" then decides to make use of his ability to become stronger simply by reading tales and absorbing the techniques used in them. She introduces a huge library, filled with all kinds of books that record different forms of martial arts and techniques, to him.
Märchen picks up a book and begins to read...

title: Night Flight!
description: Amadeonte Elvin, the legendary swordsman of the Elcano Kingdom and the first woman to join the Royal Guard, and Cyonel Gavadien Meon, the prince who is entangled in a struggle for his succession to the throne and is hated by his own father. Two really different people who share one common goal: to escape the country. Will they be allies or enemies?

title: Martial Evolution: Start by Awakening the King of Monsters
description: A youth named Yi He is reborn into the world of powerful Martial arts and awakens the King of Monsters with the strongest bloodline!

title: Romance of the Stars
description: When Lu Yinbing won the Golden Jade award for her performance in “Breaking Snow,” the popular young actress Xia Yitong was defeated. She collapsed on the spot, sobbing uncontrollably in front of the cameras. The two fanbases instantly started a war on Weibo. The movie queen’s fans accused the other of paying the media, while the young actress' fans defended her from every accusation. No one knew that Queen Lu and the young actress had been…

title: My Boyfriend Got Me Falling in Love
alt_titles: This Boy Got Me Falling Hard
My Boyfriend Got Me Fell in Love
description: The entertainment world's big shot Feng Yue pairs up with up-and-coming actor Xiang Shu Jian; will they have a sleazy love story? No, this is between a beautiful boss and a new, hot internet celebrity! Please give me a love like this!

title: Blood and Steel
description: The story begins with an eradication of Qingcheng by a group of martial art fanatic from Wudong, whose master and disciples only has one belief: to become the strongest. In order to maintain supremacy, it takes over all the other martial arts group and kill those refuse to yield themselves to it. Yan Heng, a young swordsman in Qingcheng, was saved by 'Wudang Hunter' Jing Lie, who also lost his fellows because of Wudong. Being the only remnant of their groups, the two allied and start their journey of revenge.

title: Nine Sun God King
description:
The fallen emperor Qin Yun, the inheritance of Jiuyang, awakened the world of martial arts, learned the skills of the world. Since then, he has been on the Xiuwu Avenue. A variety of martial arts strong, in order to seek his refining, willing to serve as his younger brother.   
  
  
Pr:||O imperador caído Qin Yun, a herança de Jiuyang, despertou o mundo das artes marciais, aprendeu as habilidades do mundo. Desde então, ele está na avenida Xiuwu. Uma variedade de fortes artes marciais, a fim de buscar seu refinamento, disposto a servir como seu irmão mais novo.||

title: Thrust & Conquer
alt_titles: Save the World by Hitting It
description: Taeryang wakes up in a world where men are treated as commodities. Could the power of his "thrust" be enough to save him?

title: Stairs
description:
Become the strongest, at the World's End.  
  
At the end of the world there will be ' Stairs', and at the end there will be everything.  
Go beyond the limits and be born as the strongest person at the end of the world!

title: Ending Maker (Oneshot)
description:
Two heroes of the game Legend of Heroes 2 that were rotten water*.  
  
Kang Jin-ho in the first place and Hong Yoo Hee in the second place.  
  
One day, I opened my eyes and reincarnated as a character in the game…  
  
“Hey…you too?”  
  
“Hey…me too!”  
  
The ending of Legend of Heroes 2 is the destruction of the human world.  
  
But if there’s two of us and we’re not alone.  
  
If it is also the #1 and #2 in the server rankings.  
  
The path of rotten water begins for a perfect happy ending!  

---
- Rotten water is Korean slang for someone who has played a certain game for a long time and mastered everything. Think of them as oldbies, veterans, or game pros.

title: Solo Leveling (Book Version)
description:
Known as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, E-rank hunter Jinwoo Sung’s contribution to raids amounts to trying not to get killed. Unfortunately, between his mother’s hospital bills, his sister’s tuition, and his own lack of job prospects, he has no choice but to continue to put his life on the line. So when an opportunity arises for a bigger payout, he takes it…only to come face-to-face with a being whose power outranks anything he’s ever seen! With the party leader missing an arm and the only healer a quivering mess, can Jinwoo some­how find them a way out?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Get Back
description:
The accident that occurred seven years ago at the orphanage changed the lives of these two girls forever. In a world where talent and ability are everything, what will be their destiny now?  
  
Семь лет назад судьба этих девочек изменилась.  
Каждый день стал адом!

title: I Dream of Health, Wealth, and a Long Life (Promo)
alt_titles: The Goal Is to Become a Gold Spoon so I Need to Be Completely Invulnerable (Promo)
My Goal Is to Live a Long, Healthy Life as a Golden Spoon (Promo)
description:
“I was born with a gold spoon in my mouth but I’m being murdered miserably? I’ll survive thoroughly and live a long life!”  
  
I’ve been reincarnated as the younger sister of my favorite’s novel character who is destined to be poisoned by her step-mother at the age of seventeen. My brother is on an adventure with the heroine so I have to survive by myself. Should we start with survival plans? First, be sure to behave myself around my step-mother and step-sister. Secondly, become close with children of influential families. Third, is… umh… getting married?   
  
To escape the fate of a miserable death, I, Adriana, begin to approach the Prince of the Empire, the suspicious Master, and the suspicious Demon!  
  


---

title: I Couldn't Care Less About the Original, I'm Just Trying to Survive
alt_titles: I Don't Know About the Original, I'm Busy Making a Living
I Don't Know the Original, I'm Too Busy Trying to Make a Living
description:
One month after getting married, the lord and husband went out to hunt monsters and returned as a corpse.  Penelope, still in shock, realizes that she’s reincarnated into a novel.

But before she can even accept the fact she was reincarnated, issues of the estate start flooding in!

“The price of turnips has dropped again.”
“The people of the estate will need at least three months’ worth of emergency supplies to get through the winter.”
“Firewood…”
“Water…”

Wait a minute… I don’t know anything about managing an estate!

“I think we should hire a magician to work in the estate.”
“I’ll only work for 100,000 gold.”

Just when she thought there was no way out, she gets help from the head of the magic tower… but something about this man seems suspicious.

“Want to touch it?”
“Touch what?”
“My hair. You’ve been staring at it since last time, you wanted to touch it, didn’t you?”

The head of the magic tower, the kind-hearted, dog-loving second male lead, seems a bit off this time.

Maybe I should just run away from the estate.

title: Who Can Define Popularity?
alt_titles: There's Something Wrong With My Popularity
description:
The ugly and shy Che Qiu Yuan was rejected after he had confessed to the school diva. He was even crowned with the nickname, “Gorilla.” His self-esteem was crushed. Therefore, he decided to turn over a new leaf, “start a new life,” and transform into a dazzling prince charming. From then on, he thought he was invincible. However, one day, he was overshadowed by a narcissistic classmate.  


---

**Links**  
- [Official Chinese (Simp.) Translation](https://manga.bilibili.com/m/detail/mc28062)

title: I, the Urban Legend Creator!
description: The protagonist Yuan Zhenji crossed into the parallel world of Jiang Shi, and found that this world was full of various horrors and that ordinary humans were as fragile as paper before them. He used a book called the "Urban Legend Records" to create urban legends that affect reality, punish criminals, house horrors, absorb their abilities, and "use magic to defeat magic," becoming a watchdog who fights against horrors. With his allies, he'll counter the impending horror that seeks to extinguish the world.

title: Glen (글렌)
description:
Joseph lived an ordinary life and it all took a turn when he realized he was being stalked. First, his school, then his locker, his phone and eventually his home- every aspect of his life was infiltrated by his stalker. Joseph is at his wits' end when Glen, a stranger, steps into his life at just the right moment and offers him a helping hand.  


---

title: Reloaded into the Other World
alt_titles: Returning to the Otherworld Once More
Transmigrating to the Otherworld Once More
description:
When the King’s Heart burns down, a being that transcends the fate of this world will arrive on this land!

The boy from Earth, Sung Sihan, brought down a tyrant and saved the world.

However, his happy ending was cut short when everything was taken away from him, and he was banished back to Earth.

After 10 years of gritting his teeth, he prepares for his return…

The hero who has already saved the world once re-enters Terranora!

title: Perfect Classroom
description:
Two siblings who have brought several secrets along with themselves transfer to a new school. With these two at the center of attention, the classroom hierarchy gradually begins to change.  
  
This work has received the 2015 Global Rookie Project Award.  
  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Infinite Devouring: From Zero to Hero
description: Yang Chen, who keeps failing his performance assessments in an immortal cultivation academy, accidentally discovers that he has the Ancient Dragon Soul. In a world where such souls are rare, he quickly becomes an almighty Heaven Master and is ready to venture into the unknown world with his newfound talent.

title: Sweet Bite
description:
The noble prince falls in love with a humble commoner! A confinement of possession begins, like the game of cat and mouse… But you can't stop love, a soft bite, is my property.

---

Official English: [WebComics](http://www.webcomicsapp.com/comic/5f2bd8e88c252b2eb429683a), [MangaToon](https://mangatoon.mobi/en/detail/599375), [Pocket Comics](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)  
Official: [Japanese](https://www.comico.jp/articleList.nhn?titleNo=29866), [Vietnamese](https://www.comico.vn/title/124)

title: Of Machines and Beasts
alt_titles: Peach And The Book of The Last Days
description: In the future world, civilization has crumbled due to an experiment gone awry, most of the world has descended into tribes and factions, the people have also been divided into two types: Cyborgs, a combination of the human body and mechanical parts, the other type are Beast Spirits, a combination of human and animal DNA. Hei Tong Shi is a cyborg, who wanders between cyborgs and Beast Spirits, he fights to uncover the mysteries of the world and for himself.

title: Otaku's Offspring
description:
Ever wondered about the daily lives of good-looking kids whose parents are Otaku?  
  
Yangwei, a kind and tall boy, is oblivious to the Otaku culture. On the other hand, Xiaoqi, the girl who sits next to him at school, grew up knowing it all due to her parents' influence. With Yangwei's and Xiaoqi's parent(s) being geeks, the two see each other in common and discover what's latent to them.

title: Dangerous New Hire
description: After 3 years of work, there is finally a new employee! But, it turns out he's the chairman's grandson?!

title: Battle Frenzy
description: In the silent and lonely darkness, two moons shown in the sky of a world with limitless possibilities. a mysterious, weird, delighted clown, several federal unions of cities formed three powerful empires, where interracial unrest and disturbance of monsters are a norm, this, is the time when heroes are made. Humans struggle to regain the control of planet earth while armed with the highest level of ambition. At this time of importance, second year high schooler Senior, Student Wang, he uses the Fate Roulette to upheave the world, watch out people, here comes the Senior!

title: Starting as the Black Dragon Boss, I Am Invincible
alt_titles: Kaiju Jianren Heilong boss, Wo Wudile
description: Useless Professional Binds with the Strongest Part-Time System, Transforms into a Black Dragon BOSS Crushing Everything!

title: Fill Me Up, Mr. Assistant!
description:
During the day he’s a administrative university assistant but by night, Shin Dowoon works as a demon hunter.   
Before him appears the promiscuous incubus in the form of a human student named Lee Hayoon. Hayoon offers a contract in return for letting Dowoon capture him. But because of the devils tie up play, Dowoon has no sympathy.  
Will this rough play be enough to satisfy the demon?

title: Insector
description: Humans are no longer at the top of the food chain. The creatures known as “Insectors” hide amongst us, using their supernatural insectile powers to prey upon humans. Miseong, a seemingly ordinary high school student, is also secretly an Insector. But unlike others of his kin, he directs his powers not at humans, but at Insectors instead. Will he maintain control over his abilities and use them for the good of mankind, or will he succumb to the monster within him?

title: The Tale of the Skeleton Messenger
alt_titles: The Tale of the Skeleton Messenger
description:
120 years after the Emperor's death, the Emperor's messenger and a Former member of the hero's party, Benrira, awakens. 

Having lost her beloved student to the corrupt fatherland, she decides to deliver the Emperor's final message.

"I am the messenger who delivers the Emperor's words. Heed the will of the First Emperor!"

title: The Garden of Plantus
description:
"I like you!"
Beyond the world we live in lies a place called the Garden, inhabited by otherworldly divine beings known as Plantus. 
An ordinary human named Lee Lumi happens to encounter Aleph, an incomplete Plantus who has arrived in this world. 
Having read "The Little Prince," Aleph claims she came in search of "a one-of-a-kind friend." Reluctantly, Lumi agrees to be her friend. 
But soon after, a figure who looks exactly like Aleph appears, calling Lumi a "gardener" and acting as though they've known each other for a long time. 
Meanwhile, a suspicious professor seems to know far too much about Aleph and the Plantus. 
As Lumi digs deeper, she begins to notice eerie similarities between the Plantus and the stories on SPR Institute, a paranormal website supposedly dedicated to protecting humanity.

title: Blood Sacrifice
description: Ozae is a blood-drinking monster known as a Bat. Knowing his secret, Seoho offers him a deal. Initially wanting nothing but his blood, at some point the beautiful Ozae finds himself wanting all of Sheoho. While Seoho also soon falls for the beautiful man. How will their dangerous and dizzying dance end?

title: The Legendary Return
description:
Due to the situation like the second IMF, the security company Jang Taesan worked for goes bankrupt, and he becomes an unemployed man wandering around Noryangjin-dong. He loses his life saving an elementary school student who was almost hit by a car. But thanks to his good deed, he goes 14 years back in time and is welcomed to a new life.

However the joy of being revived is short-lived. The thought of having to take the college entrance exam again makes me dizzy... But I remember all of the CSAT problems that I encountered while studying and the stock market graph I saw while working as a stockbroker...?! The last life was ruined, but the this next life will become a success!

title: The Eunuch's Rebirth: A Journey Back to Manhood
alt_titles: The Eunuch's Rebirth: A Journey Back to Manhood
The Second Eunuch Regains His Manhood
description:
Eunuch Lee Cheolsu is a secret power figure who controls the affairs of the empire at will. He possesses absolute power, wealth, and even strong martial arts skills… but what does that mean? If he can’t do *that*!

Through a reincarnation technique, Cheolsu returns to the time before he became a eunuch. He has one goal in mind: to become an alpha male and enjoy life with the most beautiful women!

title: Sorcerer Maiden
description: An accidental encounter during his childhood left the newly coronated emperor unable to forget the sorcerer he met, A’Luo. When they meet again, can the youthful emperor capture A’Luo’s heart? A beautiful fantasy romance is unrolling.

title: Wanting to Touch You
description: Xing Zi hates guys, because whenever she bumps into them she hiccups! However one day she bumped into a guy with a bad reputation, but she didn't even hiccup?!

title: Ruler of Infinite Realms
description: Ye Cheng, an ancient god, travels from the present, modern era to the past and becomes the owner of Effervescent Red Courtyard in Nanzhou. On his journey to Beidi, he promises the Snow Shadow tribe priestess his help, but...

title: My Childhood Friend Became an Obsessive Husband
alt_titles: My Childhood Friend Became an Obsessive Male Lead
A Childhood Friend Became an Obsessive Husband
description:
Isabelle is an orphan living in a temple with lots of knowledge about the love between men and women thanks to red covered novels that the saints had sneaked in.

But then, she found out that a priest secretly sold her to be a one-night stand for the duke who kills his lovers due to the shame of his inability to perform…

There’s only one way to get out of this, and it is to be a married woman.

At that moment, Isabelle recalled her childhood friend, Riggs, who said he wasn’t interested in dating.

“So, Riggs, marry me.”

“…What?”

“Nobles would refuse unless it’s a pure woman.”

“…Why do you hate the Duke of Cardiago so much?”

“Everything else is fine. Being a tyrant? If you’ve lived your life to the fullest, that could happen. But there can be no problems at night.”

Riggs was so frustrated that it seemed like he was going crazy.

A few days later, the reclusive Duke of Cardiago came to the temple.

Of course, the most surprising thing to Isabelle was the true identity of her childhood friend.

“Isabelle, you wanted to get married. You can’t say no because you proposed first. I’m the closest man to your ideal type anyway.”

“My ideal type?”

“Don’t I know your ideal type? You like guys who are tall, handsome, smell of soap at night, and sleep in simple clothes. Also, on the first night, the bed should break.”

“…”

“That’s everything, and I can do it all for you. So marry me.”

She once knew everything about her childhood friend, but that changed the moment they got married.

“Riggs, slow down…”

“I think I’m slow enough.”

“You weren’t always this impatient.”

Isabelle said pleadingly, but Riggs replied with a smirk.

“I was a childhood friend then, but now I’m your husband.”

---
Isabelle has always dreamed of meeting her true love and living happily ever after. Unfortunately, she discovers that she was just sold to the monstrous Duke Cardiego, who's infamous for killing his bride candidates. Her only way out is to quickly marry someone else, and as it turns out, her BFF, Lix, is the perfect choice! Although she tells him she will just stay a friend, Lix begins to show her that he doesn't feel the same way. Will their friendship be able to last through this matrimony?

title: Azur Lane - Start Building! (Doujinshi)
description:
A fan made manga by Xiujia\_yihuizi based on the mobile game Azur Lane that is about anthropomorphised WWII ships.  
A comedic slice of life manga about shipgirls.  
  
You can support Xiujia\_yihuizi on:  
Weibo: <https://www.weibo.com/u/3746428153?is_hot=1>  
Pixiv: <https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=19469841>

title: Mr. Baek
description:
Federal Informant ‘Baek Yisu’ and a criminal gang’s boss, ‘Baek Dogyeong’ are twin brothers.

With the same faces the two twin brothers have lived different lives until now. Yisu, who’s been betrayed by the gang, throws away his identity to become his brother. This federal agent is soon to become the gang’s boss…!

title: Destined Pair? I Disagree!
description: She was the queen of a nation and loved by God, but she turned down god's love and gave freedom to the people. On the day of her speech, she got betrayed and assassinated, and then was cursed after her reincarnation and must find true love before her birthday. Will she be able to find true love before it's too late?

title: The Admiral's Monstrous Wife
description:
Lydia Planang is called a monster because of her scales. She was treated like a minor and forced to marry by the order of the emperor. Her fiancé is a wild and fierce sailor. He is the admiral of Chillia, who is rumored to be very sadistic. But when he first met her, he was incredibly nice to her…?

"My husband just grabbed his wife's hand and he was already screaming."

Lydia learns little by little about Chillia's secret in the admiral's intense love. Dragons, giant octopuses, sea snakes, fairies and mermaids… A destined love after marriage on the splendid ocean!

**

"I know a plant that can help my husband increase his stamina."

Alexander leaned over and whispered in her ear, "If you weren't satisfied last night, I'll try to find it."

"…Oh no!" Last night! Lydia literally blushed as she recalled her secrets that she couldn’t tell anyone.

---
They call her a monster... but to this admiral, she's a sacred descendant of the sea! Rudia Flang has been mistreated her whole life, so when the emperor arranges her marriage to Alexander Cilia, war hero and the youngest admiral in history, she cowers in fear at the thought of marrying a violent seaman. As this ocean voyage treks on, she's met with benevolence from the Sercilian Island people who, unbeknownst to her, find the scales glistening on her body far from the marking of a monster...

---

* [English](https://tapas.io/series/the-admirals-monstrous-wife/info)

title: The No.1 Chef in Martial Art World
alt_titles: The First Chef in Martial Art World
description: Liu Xian, the world's number one Chinese chef, has traveled to the martial arts world by accident. There is no concept of cooking in this world, and everyone eats pills for food. Liu Xian, who is a master of culinary skills, is about to flex his muscles. However, what awaits him is the imprisoned play of gluttonous beautiful girls one after another! The blessing of Qi people? No, because this chef has gynophobia!

title: Dream Sign
description: For some reason, ordinary college student Han Gyeom has gained the ability to have lucid dreams. In these dreams, Han Gyeom has relations with his unrequited love, Leejoon. When this happens, the content of the dreams is actually shared with Leejoon. This causes him a lot of confusion regarding his own identity, when he happens to meet Gyeom at the bar where the latter works. Leejoon finds out that they both go to the same university, and becomes curious about the connection between this man and the dreams. So he suggests that they enter a relationship, however…"

title: The Heavenly Demon Will Give You a Massage
alt_titles: The Heavenly Demon Is Giving a Massage
description: Heaven-bound Heavenly Demon, once known as Kang Taehan, Returns to his original life after 60 years! "Ah, in such a blessed era, to be in this shape!" "Your body is screaming to be saved, haven't you heard?" The project to physically and mentally rejuvenate everyone, The journey of the Heavenly Demon Kang Taehan begins!! Weary office workers tired from alcohol and overtime, Athletes whose bodies are ruined and performance declined, Heads of families crushed by the weight of life, Modern people who have accumulated fat to withstand life’s burdens. All you modern people who are weary of their life, come and get a massage!

title: Twilight Poem
description: A hidden love story of a ghost princess who never loved anyone. General Jahyeon of Heeran Nation marries Soru, a ‘princess who sees ghosts’ by the king’s order. Jahyeon is cold to Soru, but he has the power to ward off ghosts, hence Soru wants to stay by his side. Soru is willing to sacrifice everything for Jahyeon, who is her only safe haven. Jahyeon is getting more and more concerned about Soru, but…

title: Accidental Warrior
description:
"I'm a witch!" 

After ending the difficult life of Cheon Eun-ha due to an accident and bad luck, Bris was reborn as a witch in a fairy tale. Even from his friend Sion, he hides the fact that he is a witch and lives alone a little far from the village. Then one day, her fairy appears in front of her and she calls herself her dragon lord. 

"Yes? Fairy Ariel? Maybe the protagonist of that fantasy fairy tale? It's unfair that the place of reincarnation is in a fantasy fairy tale I read by chance, but I have to become a hero to defeat the demon king! How can a witch do that?" 

And Bris finds out the truth about another witch... Is the villain in this fairy tale really the villain?

---
After a life full of hardship and heartache, Chon-Eun Ha died in the hospital all alone. However, she woke up suddenly in a lush forest, reincarnated as a witch an a wonderous fantasy world full of magicians, knights and other creatures. A world so wonderous, in fact, that suddenly she finds a fairy has moved into her house. "My brave warrior! I've been waiting for you! I'm sorry I must have startled you!" What is this fairy doing in my house?! "My name is Ariel!" No way, ***the*** heavenly Ariel from the *Tale of Ariel*?!

---
Eun-Ha Cheon was just an ordinary teenage girl until she woke up one day and discovered that she was not Eun-Ha Cheon anymore, but a witch named Blythe in a magical world. Fearful of prejudice and desirous of a quiet life, she hides the fact that she’s a witch, but this becomes tricky with the arrival of a beautiful fairy who won’t stop calling her a warrior. She doesn’t want to be a warrior or anyone’s hero. All she wants is an ordinary life… But as she learns more about her identity and her world, will she ultimately get what she wants?

title: Bloodline
description: Yeren, who dreams of being a vampire hunter, is unwittingly caught in the crossfire between a vampire girl and the Holy lands. As a temporary blood servant, he doesn't know what to do when the hatred and strife between them have been ongoing for thousands of years… This is a story about Lilo·Ai, the last vampire.

title: Panty Note
description:
The most beautiful thing on earth is a woman’s panty.  
If the person who uses the Panty Note sees a woman’s panty, they will be able to have sex with that woman.

title: Lord Xueying
description: In the Tranquil Sun province of the empire, there exists an unremarkable lordship known as Xue Ying Territory! This is the home of the Dong Bo clan, the clan of our hero Xue Ying! His father, a commoner turned noble; his mother, a noble who abandoned her clan for love, and his brother, an innocent toddler. But peace cannot last forever, Xue Ying’s peaceful life is shattered, and the only way to reclaim it is through power!

title: Sea of June
description:
Busan, 1936. Yeon Jeong lives her life without fitting in anywhere, until she meets a mermaid by fate. The mermaid tells her that she has come to pick her up as promised, and asks her to follow her to the place where eternal happiness lies.  
  
"Can I be happy there at last, living as myself?

title: A Toast to Your Eyes
description:
Scarlett, who has lost her lover six times to her friend, had always believed and forgiven her friend's words that are pitiful yet beautiful.  
  
"It was for you, Scarlett. Haven't you always said that any man who can get taken away easily isn't yours?"  
  
But as soon as the veil falls off, Scarlett finally decides to take revenge on her friend.  
And soon, in front of her friend , she kisses her friend's fiancé deeply.  
  
"I'm the one who is sorry for not seeing your evil intentions, but you shouldn't have thought that I'd stay a idiot forever."  
  
All of these are revenge from me.   
Quiet and promiscuous.  
  
Note: This is an one-shot, promotional manhwa for the novel of the same name.

title: Kindergarten for Divine Beasts
description: Minu Seo, a struggling nobody, never thought he'd inherit anything, especially not from the mother who abandoned him. However, what he received was beyond anything he could have imagined... A kindergarten for divine beasts! Will Minu be able to look after these magical children as their new teacher?

title: I Scared the Divine Lord as I Handed Over the Ancient Immortal Pill
alt_titles: Kaiju Shang Jiao Taigu Xian Yao, Wo Xia Huai Sheng Zhu
description: Bai Yifan has an ancient ring that allows him to travel freely between the Earth and the fantasy world, and he has discovered that "plants and animals" on the Earth will evolve into treasures when they are taken to the fantasy world. An apple evolves into an immortal fruit, an egg will hatch into a phoenix or an earth dog has the bloodline of a dragon. One could even use tobacco to manipulate the enemy to their advantage.

title: What's Our Hero Doing?
alt_titles: What the Hell Is My Hero Even Doing?
description: Hans wakes up as a minor character in Vantablack Ring, a game he's cleared countless times. To survive the monster attack, he decides to stick close to the hero, Kadith, only to see him immediately killed in battle. Shocked, Hans sets out to find the other heroes... but soon learns that the same fate awaits every one of them and that he seems to be absorbing their abilities. With his plans to lay low gone awry, will Hans have to become the hero and save this world himself?

title: Dominating the Immortal Cultivation Realm
alt_titles: A Mouthful of My Loli Master's Milk Makes Me Unparalleled
A Mouthful of My Beautiful Master's Milk Is Unequalled in the Whole World
A Mouthful of My Loli Master's Milk Is Unequalled in the Whole World
Luó Lì Shīfu Nǎi Wǒ Yīkǒu Tiānxià Wúdí
Loli Shifu Nai Wo Yi Kou Tian Xia Wu Di
description: Traveling through another world with a system, I thought I could be unparalleled, but I didn't know that if I wanted to upgrade this damn system, I would need to be beaten up constantly. Just when I was about to go crazy under the beatings of countless people, a loli appeared and domineeringly said that she wanted to accept me as a disciple. Hmph, facing the temptation of the loli, I agreed. Haha, after all, she will grow up one day. It's just I didn't know that she would grow up so fast...

title: The Villainess Captured the Grand Duke
description:
When I transmigrated into a novel, I did what anyone would do—propose to my favorite character, Grand Duke Reigrein. I mean, he’s the perfect man, so who wouldn’t want to marry him? As Schueur, I was supposed to be the villainess, but I’d rather save my honey! His Highness’s special ability consumes his emotions every time he uses it, so my goal is to awaken feelings in him. So far, I’ve only caused him irritation and annoyance, but one day I’ll make him notice me!

---
In this novel, my favorite character died. After being rejected by the female lead and losing his emotions, he could no longer use his abilities, and as he became weak, the North collapsed. Even his body was never to be found, but the novel only depicted the happy ending of the protagonists.

And I possessed the body of the villainess "Schuer" from that novel.

"Rather, I'll make him regain his emotions before he meets the female lead."

Thus, I left for the North.

"Grand Duke, can you hold my hand just once? Or maybe a signature. I'll keep it as a heirloom."

"If you want my signature, you too should sign and stamp here, my Lady."

"What's this?"

"A marriage certificate."

Huh?

"You can just act you usually do. It seems like your behavior is somewhat getting on my nerves."

...Did I win the jackpot?

title: On Your Knees, Your Highness!
alt_titles: Get on Your Knees, Grand Duke!
description:
Everyone dreams of knocking out their insufferable boss, but what if that boss is a war hero, a duke, and constantly breathing down your neck? For Chloe, enduring Curtis's relentless inspections was a daily struggle... Until a royal marriage decree offers her an unexpected way out.

---
Everyone has had the urge to punch their infuriating boss, but actually going through with it is hard. Especially when that boss is a war hero and a grand duke, no less. Chloe could only grit her teeth as she watched Curtis constantly conduct service inspections… but then, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presented itself. The king ordered Curtis to marry a noblewoman from another country, and he put forward his lieutenant, Chloe, as his lover. Now, the gun was in her hands… “First, get on your knees, Your Grace.”

title: Neoege Hago Sip-eun Mal
alt_titles: I Have Something to Tell You
What I Want to Tell You
description: After losing everything in an instant, a glint of hope amidst the deep despair presents her with a new life.

title: Anyone Beats the Original (Promo)
alt_titles: Anyone in the Original Will Beat You
description:
She was in possession of an “Extra 1”, who married the criminal and died in a violent manner. I don’t think I need to get married. I proposed to another man, ran away from home, and did all sorts of other things.  
  
“So marry me, Evangeline Clauda.”  
  
Five years of possession's life, three weeks before entering the original! In the end, she was proposed to the criminal.  
Am I… is this really a doomed ending?  
  
The more I twist the original, the closer I get to the original?! Will she be able to safely protect her life and love and face happiness?

title: She Is a Beauty
description: A heroic sturdy female general, woke up as a weak woman. The emperor however wanted this to happen, but also he wanted her to be on the battlefield, defending the homeland. However, she is no longer strong, how can she be able to fight?

title: Eternal Love
description: When Wen Yifan returned to her hometown for work, she met the rumoured “First-Class Handsome Guy” in a bar, but he turned out to be Sang Yan, whom she hurt and rejected in high school! In a twist of fate, the two people who could never get along kept bumping into each other. They even rented the same unit by chance and became housemates! Unspoken feelings refusing to see the light of day, strong emotions stirring beneath it all… Let’s see how Sang Yan, the “Peak Ideal Boyfriend” interprets and expresses deep affections and sweet love!

title: Qiao'er Is Naughty
description:
Nan Qiao'er, the ever-popular, top-searched celebrity of the Celestial Realm… transformed into a cheeky little imp during a live stream of her ascension in front of thousands! And she's even picked up by the scary Demon Lord… to serve as a meat shield!? Thank goodness mini-Qiao'er still retains her angelic looks. Now all she has to do to latch firmly onto the Demon Lord, and make puppy-dog eyes to plead for her life…

**AXED due to artist tracing/plagiarism**

title: Greatest Sword Immortal
description: Fang Haotian is a young boy who is deeply in love with a girl called Ningyu, but her parents are opposed to their relationship. Ningyu is arranged for marriage to another man. Can he become strong enough to take back his beloved Ningyu from this man?

title: Past Lives of the Thunder God
description:
He was the hero who brought down the Heretic Cult that drove the Murim world to ruin.  
The protagonist was killed due to the betrayal of the seven emperors becasue he was too strong and they didn't want him to be a hero.  
He was reborn as Baek Gong, a crippled person who was in despair.  
  
It's only been 30 years since my last life.  
  
"So my enemies are still alive?"  
  
This is his Revenge and his final journey!

title: The Little Lady Behind the Villain
alt_titles: She Is the Youngest Daughter of the Villainous Duke
The Youngest Daughter of the Villainous Duke
The Real Youngest Daughter of the Villainous Duke
description:
After passing out drunk on a cold night, I awake as a nameless young orphan girl. But she's not just any girl, she's a character from a novel I wrote in high school! Abused and sold at auction as a slave, I'm suddenly rescued by my father, Duke Henry Wensgrey, the story's original villain. Far from the wicked character I created, he's now a total fool for his daughter. But our relationship isn't the only thing that's changed, and I soon discover that this world isn't anything like what I wrote!

---
I possessed a character in a novel I had never finished writing when I was in high school. And then now I have the body of a supporting character instead of the main character. It was a seven-year-old orphan girl with no name… Having to suffer the abuse of others, until I got really tired and ran away from that place. But I was captured and sold as a slave. I thought my life was over… But the person who saved me was the novel's most prominent villain, Henriette.

He treats the emperor like a puppet. A person who has a reputation for being extremely cruel in the original and has a hobby of cutting the throat of aristocrats. …Is he my biological father? But other than that terrible reputation, living with him wasn’t bad either.

"Okay, my daughter. You can do whatever you want. If you want something, everyone in the family will do what you want."

Wait… I didn't write a novel like that in the first place?

title: Fog Land
description: Fogland, a mysterious international prison, traps Dante Kang a science teacher sent to reform prisoners during a sudden riot, leaving him with only one way to escape: by becoming a leader.

title: Rules for Dating Trash
description: After a messy breakup with a trashy ex forces Ihyeon Seon to take a three-year-long break from college, the last thing she wants to do upon her not-so-inconspicuous return is to dive straight into another relationship. But then comes Chanu Nam, a notorious bad boy who finds himself having a vested interest in Ihyeon. And suddenly, what was supposed to be a low-key senior year is looking like it's going to be anything but. The harder Ihyeon pushes Chanu away, the stronger he keeps pulling her back. But something’s gotta give – so who’s giving in first?

title: I Am the Strongest Lord in Another World
description:
Richard, a transmigrator, became a pioneering aristocrat in another world. At the time, the natives were invading the country from the front and a noble with ill intentions was plotting behind the scenes. Richard only had a few things to rely on and one of them was called... The Lord System.

Creating frontiers to build castles, finding dwarves to buy equipment and much more! Bearmen, minotaurs, goblins... all kinds of enemies were invading one after another! The road to becoming the mightiest lord begins!

title: I Thought My Husband Was Supposed to Die?
alt_titles: I Thought You Were a Time-Limited Husband?
description:
Alice was a chef living in Korea when an explosion transported her into a novel. Having worked so hard in her previous life only to die young, Alice wants to live this new life in peace. There’s only one problem: her mother-in-law is trying to frame her for the murder of her husband. Using her knowledge of the novel, can Alice subvert the original plot into something that might allow her to live in peace, or is she doomed to live as the caretaker of a comatose husband until her death?
___
"The deadline is six months, within which you must kill your husband."

On the first night of their marriage, I possessed the body of 'Alice,' a villainous supporting character who was ordered by her mother-in-law to kill her husband.

I thought I was married off to a duke who's a living  corpse for the sake of money, but lo and behold, this duke has a great body and is handsome as well. Instead of killing him, I looked for a way to survive by using divine power instead of poison.

"Mother, I will become a priestess for the duke!
As a priestess, I shall pray for the duke's well-being for the rest of my life!"

On the day I was about to leave the duke's mansion, my husband who had been unconscious suddenly woke up.

"You're the one who brought me out of the darkness, so take responsibility."

He wakes up and demands I take responsibility after saving him?

title: The Missing Gate
description: College student Zhao Zhe and classmate Liu Qingyan participated in the concert of the idol group MMC48, but they accidentally discovered the true identity of the new idol and landed into trouble. When Zhao Zhe almost lost his life, a mysterious girl named Chen Mo suddenly appeared to save him. For revenge, Zhao Zhe followed Chen Mo and joined the mysterious forces that supported her. Follow Zhao Zhe as he embarks on a new journey and travels around the world in order to compete and defeat his foes.

title: Tang Shanzang - Westward Journey Record Irresponsible Revision
alt_titles: Tang Shanzang - Westward Journey Record Irresponsible Revision
Tang Hill Burial - Journey to the West Irresponsible Anything Goes Edition
description: Journey to the West, but with female Wukong and muscular yet klutzy monk.

title: Ghost Hammer (Pre-Serialization)
description:
The Hellish Romantic Adventure of Apprentice Angel Yu Dante. 

Pre-Serialization work.
#Fantasy #Action #Worldbuilding #SuperpowerBattleSeries #ShonenRoyalRoad

title: There Are Always Teachers Who Want To Ask Out Parents
alt_titles: Zong You Laoshi Yao Qing Jiazhang
description:
That night, Qi Yan flirted with a mature woman at the bar and took her to bed, not knowing that she was the mother of a student in her class. And then at a parents' meeting, their eyes met.

"Teacher Qi, what a coincidence." 

But the closer she got, the more attracted she felt. Upon learning that she was single, Qi Yan began a determined but gentle pursuit. The path to pursuing is long and imprecise. When will her heart be touched?

title: Ultimate Legend - Kang Hae Hyo
description: Delinquency has become a major problem among the youth, especially the high school population. Taking the matter into their own hands, the government has created a special school just for these troubled youths. Kang Hae Hyo, a seemingly normal high school student who is bullied frequently, somehow ends up in the school! He's not sure he belongs there, but something him, and his past, may be discovered at this school…

title: Id: The Greatest Fusion Fantasy
description:
We find Chunwha in a world beyond his own… There he will struggle to find his own purpose among the many inhabitants of the new world including elves, dwarves, and even mages! As we watch him grow in strength and spirit, the manhwaga creates fascinating characters out of his companions and adversaries and moves past the simple concept of the antagonist vs the protagonist.   
  
To find out what fate has in store for our hero, follow Id in a fantastic adventure, exploring a world where anything is possible!

title: A Dance of Swords in the Night
alt_titles: A Dance of Swords in the Night
Sword Fanatic Wanders Through the Night
description:
The Mystic Lunar Dance Troupe took in Jin Sohan as an orphan, and he spent his childhood with them. But one day, one of the four great demons, the Venom Demon, discovered that he was special and kidnapped him. After all kinds of tests, he decided to raise him as his disciple. Ten years later, Jin Sohan tried to look for traces of the Mystic Lunar Dance Troupe, but the Sword Dance Troupe had already been destroyed at the hands of the Unorthodox Faction that’s now ruling over his hometown.

---
Kidnapped as a child to be trained in the art of poison, Sohan Jin returns to his hometown in search of the group of New Moon Sword Dancers who raised him. However, upon his return, Sohan discovers the sword dancers have been defeated by a nefarious sect that now rules the area, with some members having been abducted. What would have been a heartwarming reunion transforms into a quest for revenge as Sohan begins his search for the remaining sword dancers, and he’s willing to poison anyone who gets in his way.

---

title: Hungry City
description:
What has a vampire who just woke up from a long sleep encountered… A zombie?!  
  
- [Original Webtoon (kakao)](https://page.kakao.com/home/53153957)

title: The All-devouring Whale
description: It all started with a whale, whose cultivation was all about swallowing things. This was a fantasy world crowded with spiritual monsters. Fan Lingxiao, the chief of Sky Vagabond, grew a little catfish into an all-devouring whale and beame a world-famous spirit master. However, the whale somehow failed in a combat, and turned into a cruel zombie whale which swallowed Fan Lingxiao. When he woke up, everything had change…

title: The Demon Faction's Return
description: In an effort to escape the power struggle within the Heavenly Demon Sect, the protagonist Myeong-un retreats to a life of seclusion. However, simply avoiding ambition for the throne is not enough to avert tragedy. Myeong-un flees from the sect leader Myeong-gak, who seeks fratricide, before meeting his demise. At the moment of his death, as his consciousness fades, he hears a voice. "Do you regret it? Do you wish to fight again?"" To his surprise, Myeong-un, believed to be dead, opens his eyes once more....

title: Obsidian Bride
description:
A miserable life where even dreams of love were out of reach. 
The night I tried to end my life from the exhaustion of my joyless marriage, a special invitation arrived unexpectedly.

[ You are an existence that gleams like the jewels.
The Jewel Box, where existences who shine like you gather... 
Would you like to enter the Jewel Box? YES? or NO? ]

[ The Empire's Jewel Box ] is a luxurious party attended by only the most outstanding people. A place where they can meet a marriage partner solely based on "true love" while concealing their face and status.
"If you were granted the opportunity to become a shining Jewel, like those who were specially selected..."

My choice from that night changed everything.

title: My Magician Senior
alt_titles: A Mage, but Also a Scientist
description: This is a world where science and magic coexist. Here, some people pursue powerful magic, while others learn eternal truths. The protagonist, Blair, a mathematician who came from a different world, with left-handed magic and right-handed science, opens the door to a new world! Academic Dean? Supreme Witch? Senior Killer Brother? As an adult, I want it all!

title: Omega Complex
description:
Yoonwoo and Taegyeom have been best friends since childhood, but Yoonwoo is hiding a secret that could tear them apart–he's an omega… and he's in love with Taegyeom. 

When a traumatic event leads Taegyeom to despise all omegas, Yoonwoo is forced to keep his identity a secret. After struggling for years to avoid Taegyeom, they both end up at the same college, and Yoonwoo's carefully guarded secret is in danger of being exposed…

title: Post-apocalyptic Dispatch Company
alt_titles: Chéngwéi Wǒ de Yuángōng Ba! Zhèlǐ Shì Lǎobǎn Yǐwài Quán Yuán Sàngshī de Mòshì Pàiqiǎn Gōngsī!
description: A failed entrepreneurship! A ten million debt! A betrayal! A girlfriend that ran away! He even landed in a pile of trash/rubbish/garbage when he tried to jump off a building! The unlucky Cao Xiaomeng woke up to find himself surrounded by zombies everywhere! The system activates upon the moment of death! Become a post-apocalyptic entrepreneur! The post-apocalyptic dispatch company that hires cute zombie secretaries and mutant beast employees to serve you!

title: Dungeon Porter
description:
A world where only those with innate talent can become adventurers who conquer dungeons.
The world defined "Nagi" as a porter who cannot become an adventurer.

But if you clear a dungeon, doesn't that make you an adventurer?

Combat skills: 0! Survival abilities: Max level!
The dungeon conquest story of the all-purpose porter, Nagi, defying fate!

title: Scoring the Sacred Body of the Ancients from the Get-go
alt_titles: Start by signing in and obtaining the Ancient Divine Body
description:
Jun Xiaoyao was transported to a mystical world and became the divine child of a Clan of the Ancients. He came to possess an invincible background, unparalleled talents and even a check-in system, enabling him to acquire an Accomplished Sacred Body of the Ancients at the very beginning of his new life.

He acquired the Divine Elephant Overpowering Force, a six-star reward, checking in at the Old Tablet of Taiyue.

He acquired the Bones of Supremacy, a seven-star reward, checking in at his Ten Years Old Banquet.

He acquired the Cauldron of Maternal Qi of All Beings, an eight-star reward, checking in at the Bronze Mystical Hall.

He acquired the Grand Method of Freedom Melding, a ten-star reward, checking in at the Borderless Ocean.

He sat on the clouds countless years later, with his sword pointing at the heavens, saying, “I alone shall rule over the heavens and the earth. I shall become the pinnacle at the very end of the mystic path!”

title: L.O.R.D: Legend of Ravaging Dynasties
description: The Odin Mainland is separated into four countries, in each, lives a group of soul masters protecting their countries with their soul powers. The seven most powerful of them are known as Noble Lords. The story begins in the water origin, the Aslan Empire. Qi Ling has been a busboy in an inn ever since he was young and subconsciously tamed a legendary soul beast, Ice Fang in a battle between soul masters. Yin Chen came on the orders of the Silver Priests to take in him as his disciple. With his help, Qi Ling heads to the Grave of the Souls to seek his soul weapon. As he couldn’t sit still like how his lord instructed him, he enters the Grave of the Souls with Tianshu Youhua and Guishen Lianquan. After his risky adventure in the Grave of the Souls, he was scolded by his lord. At the very same time, another conspiracy that has long been in the works within the Aslan Empire is gradually revealing itself.

title: The Ghost Doctor
description:
Who needs studying when you’ve got the ghost of a 1950’s doctor by your side?!
High schooler Mujin escapes the ER with a mystical scalpel, and now he and Aclé, a ghost doctor, are stuck together. With Aclé’s intellect and Mujin’s bravado, the two make the best of their situation, acing exams and saving lives! But their escapades are catching unwanted attention. Everyone from the mafia to esteemed doctors want in on Mujin’s talents, but no one knows Aclé exists! And with Death looming around every corner, how long can they keep up this charade?
