title: Holy Alice Returns
description:
'Alice'  
  
'That person's destiny is to become a sacrifice', they said.  
The reason why they're being sacrificed is to cleanse the Emperor's sins.  
  
"You were chosen as the 56th Alice."  
  
Thus the thread of fate that has stopped, began to move again.  


---

title: Marry You? Yes, I Will!
description:
“Do you want to easily make a huge amount of money in one go? Marry me.”   
  
Yuseong ended up marrying Jinhyuk when the bride didn’t show up on the day of Jinhyuk’s wedding. There was too much money involved for him to say no…  
  
Somehow they ended up getting married! And one bed at that! What’s in store for Yuseong?

title: The Peerless Strong Man Only Wants to Return Home and Farm
alt_titles: Jue Shi Qiang Zhe Zhi Xiang Hui Jia Zhong Tian
The Peerless Strong Man Only Wants to Return Home and Farm
The Unmatched Powerhouse Just Wants to Farm
description: When Chen Fan transmigrated to the world of martial arts, not only was he abandoned by the system, he was also a cripple without martial spirit. He had no choice but to be the most inferior mortal. But unbeknownst to him, his home was full of divine things; the bath water is a spiritual spring, the person ploughing his land is a dragon prince, the person watering the vegetable fields is the first saint, the person who washes his clothes is an imperial empress. Unknowingly, Chen Fan had gathered many of the continent’s top powerhouses around him and became a landlord who controlled the world.

title: The Duke's Hidden Baby: BOGO!
alt_titles: Pregnant Wife And The Little Ones
description:
He has the absolute power. He kills without hesitation and is a cold, fickle man. Yet he becomes obsessed with her and dotes on her nonstop.  
  
The first time they met, he asked, “Was it you, six years ago?”  
  
The second time they met, he’s holding onto the DNA test, “You still dare to say he’s not my son?”  
  
The n time they met, “Mr. Duke, do you have an end to this?”  
The guy smiled with a deep charm, “The second child have yet to be born. Of course, there’s no end to this.”

title: Spirit of Peach Blossom
description: A beautiful peach blossom spirit had developed a liking to a little girl, promising to protect her at all times. The two soon began their journey through hardships, along with the feelings they have towards one another. This is a story of love, friendship, and spirits.

title: Monster Kingdom
description:
A mysterious and unknown game journey.  
In the virtual game, experience the brilliance and darkness of human nature. When the player's game journey reaches the end, what is waiting for them …

title: Travel to AD 3000
description:
This story is about a girl from the year 2011 who time-traveled to the year 3011, where androids that are indistinguishable from humans and humans with special powers have appeared. Some want world domination, and some just want their freedom. Caught within this conflict, the girl struggles to be with the one she loves.  
 - - -
**WARNING:** contains spoilers for the first couple of chapters  
<<Chuan Yue Xi Yuan 3000 Hou>> is about a young woman named Ye Bingyao (the female protagonist) who lives in the year 2011 AD. On a school outing, her friend Wei Xiaojie discovers a cave from which a strange green light shines forth. Wanting to explore it, but unable to find someone to accompany them, Ye Bingyao and Wei Xiaojie decide to explore it alone. At the end of the cave, something suddenly begins to turn, and Ye Bingyao loses consciousness with the sound of her friend's yell in her ear. Upon awakening, she finds herself in an unfamiliar place. She realizes that she has crossed through time…and that she's naked! What's more, there's a handsome, expressionless man standing before her, holding her at gunpoint. The man (Wei Si Ji) takes her for an android spy from Mars, and orders her to be restrained. Held down by a machine, Ye Bingyao loses consciousness once more. As she awakens again, the man stands over her, preparing to dissect her and prove that she's an android! At this moment, a handsome doctor (Dr. Li) appears to examine her and tells Wei Si Ji not to act hastily. Well, it seems her life has been saved…for now…

title: Kim Ohjin's Adventures With Strange Animals
alt_titles: Kim O-jin and the Strange Animals
Kim Oh-jin and The Strange Beasts
description:
Veterinarian Kim Ohjin was unexpectedly summoned by a dragon. After successfully treating the dragon’s pet, he returns home… only to find himself in another world.

"Animals in another world are still animals, right?" I was a vet barely scraping by in the real world, but now, in this strange new world, I’m a renowned doctor?

With my old clinic on the verge of closing, I’m setting my sights on a new opportunity—my second clinic, and hopefully, a big success!

title: Can the Grand Duke and the Marquis Be Friends?
alt_titles: Daegonggwa Hujak Saie Chinguga Eodi Isseo?
There's No Friendship Between the Grand Duke and the Marquis
description:
Obet Alphons gets on the wrong side of the Grand Duke's son and gets tangled up in a game of cat and mouse!

"My own future is in ruins, you jerk!"

Obet attends an imperial event dressed as a boy for a telescope. She tries to enjoy her meal when she meets a rude boy who mistakes her for a beggar. Obet doesn't hold it in and teaches him a lesson, thinking she'll never see him again. As fate would have it, the next day, she finds "that jerk from yesterday" in her drawing room! The boy figures out that Obet is a girl. She wants to run away, whatever it takes. But the relentless boy is hot on her tail, threatening the future of the Alphons. Just what does he want? Will Obet be able to separate herself from this persistent and powerful punk?

---
Obet gets on the bad side of the Grand Duke's son and falls into a chaotic, youthful romance!

"My future is in ruins, you jerk…!"

Obet attends an imperial family event dressed as a boy, for a telescope. She tries to enjoy her meal when she meets a rude jerk who asks if she’s a beggar. Obet doesn’t hold it in and teaches him a lesson, thinking she’ll never see him again…

"But why is that boy sitting in our living room?!"

The boy finds out that Obet is a girl. She wants to run away. But he keeps chasing after her. What does he want? Will Obet be able to separate herself from this persistent leech?

---
Obet has no idea what she signed up for when she attends the prince's oath ceremony disguised as her sick twin brother. Before she can make a good impression on the prince, a snooty young lord pokes fun at her, and the two of them spend the day bickering with each other. As it turns out, the lord is none other than Hinn, the son of the grand duke. To make matters worse, he instantly recognizes Obet when he visits her estate! Once he threatens to reveal what she did and bring shame to her family, she has no choice but to be nice to him. It's easy enough to avoid him at first, but this becomes harder when they start attending the same academy. Will Obet be able to keep Hinn from exposing her secret, despite the fact that he seems to be on a mission to annoy her 24/7?

---

title: My Evil Husband is Obsessed With the Wrong Person
alt_titles: Dear Villainous Husband, the One to Be Obsessed With Is Over There
The Person Who Is Obsessed With the Villain Husband Is Over There
Villainous Husband, the One You're Obsessed With Is Over There
Mr. Villain Husband, the One You Should Be Obsessing With Is Over There
description: Getting reincarnated into the world of a novel is never easy, but possessing a doomed bride on her way down the aisle to marry a murderous emperor is just unfair! Now, the newly reincarnated Angelica has no choice but to learn to survive the whims of her new husband, Emperor Ranielo… Well, at least until he falls for his fated love interest and she can slip away unnoticed. But as the days pass, Ranielo’s interest in her only grows. Can this tyrant be tamed, or will Angelica find that some destinies can’t be unwritten?

title: I Am the Village Chief of a Primitive Society
alt_titles: Becoming the Village Chief of a Primitive Society
description: Novelist Su Bai crosses over to the otherworldly primitive society and becomes the ruler of the tribe, relying on the daily assistance system as well as the knowledge of modern society to explore this novel world while leading the tribe out of poverty and evolution and gradually towards a developed civilization! Beast-eared woman! Farming! The main character will have his own frontier land!

title: I'm the Final Boss Villainess He Must Kill
alt_titles: Geuga Jungnyeoya Hal Choejong Angnyeoga Jeoramnida
I'm the Final Villainess He Has to Kill
I Am the Final Villainess He's Required to Kill
I Am the Last Villainess He Has to Kill
description: Hongyeon Kim has spent her afterlife generally being bored. So when a new program is introduced to entertain the dead, Hongyeon jumps at the chance to be transported into her favorite novel. However, when she finds herself in the body of the villainess, the demon princess Bella, she attempts a spell to speed up time to the end of the novel. Instead, she finds herself ten years in the past. Now, she must wait fifteen years to escape all while living with demons and raising the main character!

title: Yes, My Lich!
description: Concerning a silly lich and its silly subordinates who accidentally “transmigrate” into a modern tale. Lord Reichtwein used to be a devastating underworld boss. However, now, he is merely a… pitiful moocher.

title: The New Hire Is the Demon Lord
alt_titles: The New Hire Is the Demon Lord
description: Dullahan, the demon lord who once terrorized the world, finally revives in modern-day Korea, eager to take revenge against the hero who defeated her centuries ago. But all she can find is his descendant, Yongrae Kim: a hapless, incompetent office worker with no prospects and no joy in life. Ending his life now would only be doing him a favor, so Dullahan decides to improve his life first… but Yongrae's two-timing girlfriend and his many strict superiors at work stand in the way. Can Dullahan crush the office hierarchy and awaken Yongrae's dormant hero abilities to make her revenge more satisfying?

title: My Wife Is a Heavenly Big Shot
alt_titles: Wo De Qizi Shi Dacheng Qi Da Lao
Wǒ De Qīzi Shì Dàchéng Qí Dà Lǎo
description: The opening scene mentions a wife who has reached her power ceiling, who still wants a bicycle, and demands to eat only soft rice?! But when Xiao Yifeng said I was really your husband, I was nearly strangled to death by this future wife… something’s not right, I must have taken the wrong script!

title: Chicken Soup Queen
description: At the age of 20, she graduated from a top school in the United States with double major. At 23, she bought a new villa for her parents. She, Wei Yujin, had risen from the mud to the peak of fame in the 21st century, and she's going to do the same in ancient China.

title: The Deer and the Cauldron
alt_titles: The Duke of the Mount Deer
description:
He's a lazy, impish, vulgar, and irreverent playboy. From Lichun Brothel to the Forbidden City, the little imp Wei Xiaobao survives through the dangers. He doesn't know martial arts, yet the martial world and the imperial court become playthings in his hands. As it has once been said: There's danger in every step, and a beauty to bring home in every stage.  
  
Chinese:  
 ||偷懒耍滑、粗话连篇；玩世不恭，风流成性。从丽春院到紫禁城，小滑头韦小宝一路惊险闯关，不会武功的他却能把江湖和朝堂玩弄于股掌之间。正所谓：步步涉险强运渡，关关抱得美人归。||

title: The Planet Walks Alone
description: Struggling between school and his parent's constant fighting, a boy strives to go to university in order to leave his home. One day, he receives a strange message predicting that he will be killed by himself in 100 days…

title: Return of the Reborn God Emperor
description:
In his previous life, Lin Xiao accidentally obtained the Divine Judgment Technique, and awakened the ancient ancestor body, an unparalleled overlord body.  
  
After all kinds of hardships, he eventually became an immortal and conquered the gods and demons. after getting back stabbed by a traitor, he’s reborn and returned to his teenage, a seventeen years old self, with the knowledge of an immortal, in this life, lin xiao will settle all the grudges and make those people pay who bullied him in his previous version of this life.

title: I Just Want to Be Killed
alt_titles: Wǒ Zhǐ Xiǎng Bèi Gèwèi Dǎsǐ
Wo Zhi Xiang Bei Gewei Dasi
I Just Want to Be Beaten to Death by Everyone
I Only Want Everybody to Beat Me to Death
I Just Want to Be Beaten by Everyone
description:
Yu Le got sent to another world after dying from overworking and got a golden item that every male MC gets — system. But Yu Le did not meet the requirement which means that he have to say goodbye to the system temporarily. To reactivate the system again, he will have to live this life with zero motivation. So, wanting to activate the system as soon as possible, to get the ability to live forever, Yu Le has decided to court for death. But why is he not dying even when he’s trying so hard to, instead, he’s becoming stronger?!

---

title: Prince Charming Has His Eyes on Me
description: Su Aixin, a female student in her senior year of college accidentally picks up a charmed bracelet. From then on, she has the ability of changing personalities. Different personalities have different strengths and knowledge, bringing a huge change to her life…

title: I Am the Master in This Life
alt_titles: Helena: Master of the Guardian Stone
I'm the Master of This Life
description:
The guardian stone of the family appeared to me. To me, the illegitimate child, not my half-sister who is my enemy. Since then, my treatment changed. It really felt like I was part of the family. However, as I died, I realized that it was all an illusion at the hands of my fiancé. That everything he did for me was a scheme by my half-sister to take the guardian stone.

[Don't you want to take revenge on those who thoroughly deceived and killed you?]

I decided to accept the devilishly sweet offer. This time, I will definitely get the guardian stone and become the head of the household. I will give you back as much or more than what I suffered. Until then, I will believe no one. But-

“From now on, no matter what happens, you must never stop and run.”

The image of him trying to save me, his eyes running in despair, couldn't be erased from my mind. The fiancé I loved was looking at me as I died, but why were you running to me with those eyes. You, who I thought was my sister's person... I want to know where your sincerity lies.

---
Helena Croisen, bastard child of the family, thought she would finally be acknowledged when the power of the guardian stone manifested in her. Little did she know, a conspiracy was going on behind her back — one that would end with her beloved fiancé stabbing her in the heart. As Helena draws her final breath, a mysterious voice speaks to her. “Do you wish for vengeance?” Next thing she knows, she’s gone back two years in time! Will Helena be able to avoid the same tragic fate this time around?

---

title: Song of the Sky Pacers
description:
(In a made-up dynasty) During the Chen dynasty, Consort Jing gave birth to a pair of fraternal twins under the rays of sunlight. The prince was born with a cinnabar mole between his eyebrows, while the princess was born with six fingers.

Fortune and misfortune appeared at the same time, causing the twins to experience entirely different fates as they were forced to leave their family. The heavenly tribulation is approaching, will the two twins who were separated from birth ever get to be reunited? What methods would they use to fight against their destinies?

---

**Note:** This is the **page style** version of [Song of the Sky Pacers](https://mangadex.org/title/7226ef70-592f-42b5-a3ff-8b91af15d97f)

title: My Phone Doesn't Seem to Be Okay
description: A yuri series about a girl and her cell phone.

title: Unnie! I’ll tag you
description: Kang Chae-rin is a social media addict. She works hard, but she rarely gains followers. Chae-rin, who wanted to quickly live the life of an influencer, gets to know Yeon-woo, a returning student, and also an influencer. She approaches Yeon-woo thinking that if she gets attached to her, she will gain follower too!

title: Leveling Up by Hoarding
alt_titles: I Level Up By Absorbing Everything
description: Soul aura awakens, fierce beasts roam the earth. Chi Mo transmigrated and awakens the technique of collecting. Collecting High level talent of time, can let time go faster or slower! Collecting great golden sun phoenix bloodline can let the body transform into the sun and scorch the earth! Collecting the talent of swordsmanship, can make one understands the concept of the sword and slice through everything!

title: Paladin Dad
description:
Zuo Yi, a transmigrator, fought and struggled in the world of Sadya for three hundred years. During his fight with the Abyssal Lord, Saur, he was sent back to the blue planet.

To his immense shock, he had somehow gained an adorable four-year-old daughter! Zuo Yi, who has long been tired of the life of a knight, gradually interacts with the blue planet's various forces and ultimately resolves the global crisis—all for the sake of building an ideal world for his precious child.

title: When Did I Become Invincible?
description: He always thought he was a mortal, but he didn’t know that his yard was full of divine weapons and the chickens he raised were more like phoenixes! It wasn’t until after five years of living in a mortal village when the system finally allowed him to come into contact with cultivators. It was then that he discovered that no matter how strong someone was, the moment they saw him, they would be so scared that their legs gets numb and call him senior. Some even kneeled down and worshipped him…

title: Without the Male Lead, My Grades Are Doomed
alt_titles: Without the Male Lead, My Grades Are Doomed
My Grades Will Fall Without the Male Lead
description: High school student Han Jiseo is perfectly happy to be reborn as an extra character in a manhwa. Her side character always scores second place in the entire school, after all! The male lead, Ju Yiwon, is welcome to first place; Jiseo's happy so long as she can get into university. But one day, Ju Yiwon doesn't come to school... and Jiseo scores zero on a test. "Don't tell me... my grades depend on the male lead?!" If Jiseo wants to make it to university, Ju Yiwon needs to be present. Thus begins Jiseo's ultimate mission: make sure the male lead attends school! (Summary adapted by me from Kakaopage.)

title: Wagging the Tail
description: Korean Wolf Kang Doha is quite popular in school. One day, he bumps into the fox, Yeojoon, who's been spending his days in school as a loner. Doha finds him irritating, but he couldn't stop seeking him out. Is this… perhaps… love? (Random Fujoshis Scans)

title: How to Snag an Alpha
description:
Yoon Wooyoung, the youngest son of a wealthy family. Money, education, appearance, everything's perfect. His only complex is, he is a recessive omega.  
However, after the one-night encounter with Cha Kyungjoo, a dominant alpha, there's a strange change in Wooyoung's body.  
  
The bravest recessive omega in the world, Yoon Wooyoung, met an alpha that he'll never miss!

title: Natsukashii
description:
The firefly by the water shines into the night, lonely but heartwarming.
Four teenagers meet, each with their secrets.
Trust and betrayal make an exciting youth in a colorful kaleidoscope.
“Meeting you was the best thing to happen to me.”

title: The Naive Mr. Lu
alt_titles: Pure and Innocent Young Master Lu
description:
Disguised as a man, Lu Dingning picks up a bunch of girls, with her gentleman index on max and her prince charming smile leveled up! Women are constantly surrounding her and men are getting mercilessly bent in her presence.   
Life motto: As long as the hoe is dancing well, there's not a single boyfriend she can't steal!  
Zong Jize, king of the city, treats her as his brother but ends up pushing her onto the bed.   
Lu Yining says furiously, “Master Zong, I treated you as my brother but instead you sick bastard just wanted to sleep with me!”

title: Wicked Young Master's Forceful Love: Training the Runaway Wife
alt_titles: Ba Qing Eshao: Tiaojiao Xiao Tao Qi Di
description: "Don't touch our mom!" Two children, a boy and a girl, block the demon boss outside. The woman he has his eyes on was not only claimed by someone else first but also has two kids! "Heart robber, get out here!" Facing the crazy roars of the king is the very pure and innocent yet sexy mother… X years ago, she was violated against her will, is that her fault? C'mon you perverted and possessive madman, she's a victim too! Huh? Why does this boy look like my own son? Could it be…

title: Transmigrating as a Secretly Illegitimate Millionaire heiress, I Try to Curry Favor with the Real Heiress to Survive
alt_titles: 穿成假千金后，我靠討好真千金苟活
Transmigrating as a Secretly Illegitimate Millionaire heiress, I Try to Curry Favor with the Real Heiress to Survive
description: Transmigrated as a fake millionaire heiress, Ye FengLai has to rely on currying favor with the real heiress to survive, only to be given the "villain card" by the real heiress. What can she do? No problem! Step 1: Pretend to have amnesia and become a cute girl; Step 2: Start groveling. The plan is a huge success! She saved her own life, got the money, but... why is the real heiress's gaze towards her getting weirder and weirder?! A sweet, innocent girl who thinks she's groveling but is actually flirting without realizing it X A cold, aloof, and self-assured kitten skilled at conquest.

title: Boss of the Emperor's Harem
alt_titles: I'm the Chief of the Harem
Wo Zai Hou Gong Dang Da Lao
description:
Have you ever heard of a fertility fairy? That’s what Yun Mian is! Her mission upon descending from the immortal realm is to help the imperial concubines of Xiao Guo’s emperor bear an imperial successor.  
  
What? His Majesty is infertile?! And it’s something that even the imperial physicians and divine doctors can’t cure? Yun Mian’s under enormous pressure now!  
  
“Yun Mian, we are dizzy. Give us your divine qi.” In order to fulfill her duties, Yun Mian throws caution to the wind!  
  
“Yun Mian, our stomach hurts. Give us more of your divine qi.” After the ninety-ninth time she gave him her divine qi, the impossible happens! Just as Yun Mian is about to inform the imperial concubines, the devilish emperor captures her in his arms!  
  
“Yun Mian, since you’ve cured us of our affliction… we shall grant you the imperial successor!”  
  
What? She didn’t want to take on THAT duty personally! She immediately flees, but the devilish emperor’s words follow her…  
  
“Yun Mian, until you’ve fulfilled your duties, you’re not allowed to leave!”  
  


---

title: Cannon Fodder’s Record of Counterattacks
alt_titles: Quick Transmigration Cannon Fodder’s Record of Counterattacks
description:
*An adaptation of Hen Shi Jiao Qing's novel: Quick Transmigration Cannon Fodder’s Record of Counterattacks*

Ning Shu had dropped dead. But fortunately, she became a task-taker in charge of counterattacking for pitiful cannon fodder. Thus, Ning Shu played various kinds of life roles in various worlds, encountering many people who caused trouble for no reason. Transmigrated protagonist, reborn protagonist. Ning Shu had no choice but to painfully collect moral integrity in various worlds.

title: Resigning as the Villainess
alt_titles: Even the Villainess Can Be Annoying
I'm Tired of Being a Villain Too
I'm Too Lazy to Be the Villain
description:
Versace family! A house that produced many swordsmen and possessed a powerful force. Such a family perished. Due to the poisoning of the Crown Princess and the involvement of a foolish woman named Olivia de Versace. She was a woman who was pointed out as a rare ugly or evil woman because of her tall and heavy body.

I thought it was absurd when I possessed a novel character who is often referred to as a villainess. If you're going to pretend to be a female lead, or something. Or the male protagonist. Anyway, shouldn't it be a small supporting role? Even if it weren't, I shouldn't have gotten the passer-by's appearance like this.

title: The Villainess Is Everyone's Favorite
alt_titles: I'm a Villain, but I'm Favored
description:
"Damn this world, let it burn!"

A single exasperated cry while succumbing to overwork. But instead of dying, I woke up inside the game I’d been playing. As compensation for the hellish life I endured, I gained a unique ability to view information about people and objects. Determined to use this skill to lead a peaceful, carefree life, my resolve was interrupted by an unexpected *system message*:

[To a player who has suffered immensely and wishes for the world's downfall, the system grants the chance to fulfill that desire.]

<MAIN QUEST>
Destroy the world.

What?! I didn’t mean it literally! Fine. If this is how it’s going to be, I’m not backing down. Let’s see who gives up first!

title: Absolute Peerless Doctor
description: Tang Xiaobao was a notorious rogue in high school. After a fight with his rival, he was expelled from the school, and his girlfriend also left him. By pure accident, however, Tang Xiaobao acquired a magic watch which elevated him to a gifted doctor. With extensive medical knowledge transmitted from the watch, Tang Xiaobao started a new journey as a physician...

title: The Duke's 99th Bride
description:
Grace lost her mother and became an orphan, she lived on the streets and was waiting for the day of her death, but she was taken in by an angelic girl, Penelope Erdonia. One day, a marriage proposal came for Penelope from the Duke of Pelton, who was none other than the head of the most powerful family at the time. However, there is a rumour that all the women who went to the Pelton estate to marry him either disappear or return with a strange mind. In order to protect the innocent Penelope, Grace decides to marry the Duke instead.

---
When the daughter of the Erdona barony is forced to marry the infamous Duke Noel Felton, her loyal servant Grace McClean saves the day… by posing as the duke’s 99th bride-to-be! She’s doing her best to impress her fiancé by making him treats, rescuing a child, and even befriending the imperial princess! All seems well, until one day, Grace stumbles upon the duke’s journal and learns about his master plan... Will Grace survive her marriage? And what does the duke have in store for the empire?

---

title: Saving a Mercenary Unit from Bankruptcy
alt_titles: Pouring Money Into the Underdog Mercenaries
description:
Lee Ji-hyun, was lost in a snowstorm and rescued. But it was not Korea, no matter how you looked at it! The most elite military group, the Nio Mercenaries, led by the strongest warrior Valdemar, saved Ji-hyun?! Ji-hyun decides to sell them her abilities to survive. "Don't you need one management mentor?" Indeed, Ji-hyun can find a way to save the Nio mercenaries and return home safely?

---
Jihyeon, a business consultant from Korea, ends up stranded in another world. She is rescued by the members of the Nio Mercenary Corps, only to find out that the unit is on the verge of bankruptcy. A passionate professional, Jihyeon cannot ignore their dismal financial state. To help the corps, and in hopes of returning home, she volunteers to serve as the corps’s financial officer. Turning around a struggling mercenary corps is no easy feat, but Jihyeon and the corps members stick together through thick and thin. Her chance of going back home, however, remains elusive.

---

title: Love in Murder
alt_titles: Ai Shi Yi Chang Jing Xin Dong Po De Mou Sha
description: After finding out that my boyfriend was cheating on me with my little sister, I announced our break-up in a fit of rage. But never could I have imagined that the two of them would commit double suicide. Even the police believes that this was just an accident… But I felt that things weren't that simple. Since my university days, anyone who had a conflict with me would all perish in unnatural deaths…

title: Knockin' on the Dungeon Door
alt_titles: Too Much Dangerous Outside the House
description:
One day, my house got connected to a dungeon. It’s dangerous outside because of the monsters, but in order to survive, I have to clear the dungeon within the time limit!

“I don’t want to die. I want to survive.”

Kim HyunBok has to try and clear the dungeon by himself now that all the other explorers have died. Having awakened his powers, he starts taming monsters. With the skeletons Kris, Kai, and Kessle who have regained their memories, our protagonist’s life-risking adventure to clear the dungeon starts now!

---

- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc31491)

- [Official Japanese Translation](https://piccoma.com/web/product/91332)

title: Undercover! Chaebol High School
description: Da-kyung, who was an active member of a corporate criminal organization, belatedly learns of the death of her boss, whom she cared for like a father. Times later without knowing why her boss's death, she gets a clue, a college of rich people with most of the children of important people in Korea. Da-Kyung will go back to being a student to try to find out what happened, she is a well-trained assassin, but dealing with bullying and the stress of school life may not be as easy as it seems...

title: Becoming Overpowered by Solo Eating
description:
Ex reigned supreme over the game Lin Online.
However, he was betrayed by his trusted subordinates and left the game.

Two years later, he came across the VMMORPG <Fate>.
He vowed to take revenge on the guild “Kaimus” who had betrayed him.

[You have obtained the hidden class Heavenly Gourmet!]
[<Heavenly Palate> has discovered the hidden flavor within Rye Bread!]
[Your strength has increased by 2 points!]

"Wait, I can increase my stats just by eating?"

title: Working at the Witch's Mansion
alt_titles: I Work at a Witch's Mansion
description:
"What did I get myself into?!”
Elena works at a theater troupe as a cleaner with big dreams of making it on stage. But when the troupe is disbanded overnight, she’s forced to find a new job. Luckily, she stumbles upon an old mansion where she’s hired as a maid. But there’s something strange about the madam of the house... 

Elena used to be a theatre worker with the hopes of going onstage someday. Suddenly, the theatre is forced to close. She finds a new job in a mansion... but the owner of the mansion is a witch?!
  
NOTE: THIS IS NOT YURI

title: Make It Real
description: A feud? A dating rumor? What's the drama between the hottest member of DOT, Yoon-chan, and the leader of the group, Kang Sol?

title: A Good Day to Be a Dog
description:
A push and pull romance between a woman who is trying to solve a curse that turns her into a dog every midnight and a man who is afraid of dogs!

---
Hana has made every effort to avoid an inevitable family curse... of turning into a dog after her first kiss. Worst of all, the only way for her to break the curse is to get a second kiss. How will that work when Hana's first kiss is with a guy who is deathly afraid of dogs?!

---

title: Strange Love Rivals Increased!
description: After I isekai'd as the female villain of an otome game, I just wanted to avoid the death ending and live a peaceful life. But why are the male lead and female lead fighting over me?

title: How to Gracefully Divorce a Dragon
alt_titles: How to Divorce a Dragon Beautifully
description:
Twenty-year-old Jeong Seyun, a rabbit descendant, knows that dragons are considered the chaebols of the beast world. But she'd rather have a relationship based on love than an arranged marriage with a dragon. And as fate would have it, as soon as she enters college, she falls in love with fox descendant Kim Hangyeol at first sight! She musters up the courage to confess, but... to the wrong person?!
Will Seyun's dream of a romance come true? (Summary adapted from Kakaopage.)

title: Cultivation Through Science
description:
After traveling to the world of Xianxia, ​​Qin Yun became a peak master of a sect, with the "Super Master System".  
  
Qin Yun always said, "Learn mathematics, physics, and chemistry, and you can travel the world without any fear".  
  
Now, the master is an exam madman, and in Qin Yun's view, Immortal Cultivation is also a subject.  
  
It is like a nine-year compulsory education, and only through scientific cultivation can there be a way out…

---

Releases of this series stopped with chapter #22 on June 2021.

title: I Am Mom (Pre-Serialization)
description:
A monster mother who tries to protect her daughter in a world full of monsters and viruses. 'Blessing' is a human daughter who
believes and follows her mother. The story of a mother and daughter begins.

title: Shall We Have Dinner Tonight?
alt_titles: Will You Have Dinner With Me?
Would You Like to Have Dinner?
description: Do-hee Woo and Hae-Gyung Kim are both young and single, each with a history of broken relationships in their past. They meet one day while trying to dine alone at the same restaurant and they soon become friends who eat together every week. But with each meal, their friendship grows deeper as they help each other heal from the heartbreak they have suffered and soon they must redefine what they mean to each other.

title: Dasadanan
description: Kang Chan and Seyeon have been close friends since they were young after being introduced by their parents. After entering high school, Seyeon suddenly received a confession from Kang Chan and became aware of Kang Chan since then. Meanwhile, Naeun is displeased with their relationship. The trivial and noisy story of their love triangle and those around them…

title: Phoenix Descends From Above
alt_titles: Phoenix Descends From Above: First Female Monarch Under the Heavens
description: Jun Aofeng, the top female cultivator, was reborn into the body of the betrayed and murdered daughter of the Feng family. Her identity stolen by her maid, she will show them what a real lady can do. She'll have revenge on all those who betrayed her, while breaking a few kneecaps in the process! Just as she finally earned everyone's respect, she ran into the prince who is just as strong as her. What will happen when they butt heads?

title: The Poisonous Healer
description:
In a world where monster hunters are hailed as heroes, Cheon Haesun has been treated like an outcast because of his abnormal looks. As if that wasn't bad enough, a pack of monsters attacks his neighborhood on the day he discovers he's dying from an unknown illness!

With his sister's sacrifice, Haesun survives and somehow awakens to become a Poisoner, a rare hunter with toxic healing abilities.

But will his poisonous powers cure Haesun's illness and guarantee a normal life he's always dreamed of?

title: Escape the Original Male Lead!
alt_titles: I Accidentally Seduced the Male Lead's Younger Brother
description:
She possessed the mistress of the male lead in an R19 novel. In the original novel, the male lead was trash who abandoned her after getting her pregnant, saying that he belatedly realized that he loved the heroine. Fortunately, it was still before the original work started. She decided to scrap that shit herself.

"No, I don't want to," she flatly rejected Killian's offer to have an affair with him.

When he asked her why, she smiled brightly and answered, "Young Master is not my taste. If I must say, your younger brother is much preferable.”

"What? You prefer my younger brother?"

*Yeah. Not you, but your brother.*

Unlike the original, she firmly set up an iron wall, took care of Lexion, the younger brother who was abused by his elder brother, and protected the original female lead who had low-esteem from that shitty male lead.

And now that she'd already done what she had to do, she's off to go.

But a few years later–

Lexion, who had pushed out his older brother and taken the ducal title, came back to her as a beast with a decadent beauty. On top of that, he was even holding the engagement document that she had signed as a joke during their childhood.

"I've never forgotten you for a moment. Please marry me, Noona."

*No, wasn't that just for playing house?*

Every time she refuses his marriage proposal, he gently hugs her around the waist, and asks in a cold voice, "Did your taste change while I was away?"

Lexion's eyes were full of life as he asked.

It was as if when he found out who her type was, he'd kill them right away.

---

title: Wished You Were Dead
alt_titles: There Were Times When I Wished You Were Dead
description:
The Emperor of Croisen hated Empress Yvonne. Enough that he’d wish for her to disappear three times a day.

I don’t like the face of someone who looks just like the Duke of Delois, my enemy, but no matter how much I insulted her, her indifferent and aloof character stayed the same, which made me feel even more terrible.

I didn’t care whether or not she disappears or dies. I was fine with anything as long as I didn’t see her face.

The wish came true.
When he no longer wished for it to happen.

title: This Wasn't in My Adoption Plan!
alt_titles: This Wasn't in My Adoption Plan!
I Found a Family That Wasn't in My Adoption Plan
description: I spent a decade cleaning up after Duke Havenik Brauno’s mess only to be murdered by him? Reincarnated as Aerin Brauno, an illegitimate child of the Brauno family, she’s horrified to find her adoptive father is none other than the man who killed her. This time, Aerin refuses to let him control her fate. Armed with the knowledge from her past life, she’s determined to escape his grasp and find a new path. Can she rewrite her destiny, outsmart the deadly Duke, and maybe even save the Brauno family?

title: Introverted Us
description: Do you ever wonder what the most popular boy at school is really like? As it turns out, he might be just as awkward and shy as any of us. That’s what wallflower Jayu Nam begins to discover after a chance encounter with Jahyeok Yeo, a boy in her class who seems to excel at everything in life. Well, almost. Underneath Jahyeok’s persona is a secret super-introvert who would rather just stay home, except his charming good looks keep forcing him into social situations. Together, Jayu and Jahyeok begin to learn a little something about friendship and maybe more…

title: The Reborn
description: A century ago, in a continent far, far away, an ancient kingdom, Laham, was destroyed. In the war, Zeluo died and his body was reduced to ashes and bones. However, one day, Zeluo awoke from a mysterious magic. The rebirth caused him to lose all his memories and emotions. The hallucinations and voices in his mind urged him nonstop to return to his homeland, Laham. In order to retrieve his original self and his determination to return home made him embark on a long and treacherous journey without any hesitation…

title: Her Lies
description: Zhao Fugui, a high school girl who can see everybody's score in life, puts herself at the frontline every day to find the perfect boyfriend. However, she never imagined that someone by her side already held a perfect score, and that she's deeply in love with her...

title: My Lord, Pay Attention to Your Reputation!
description: A foolish and stubborn little servant girl has to serve this Lord day and night. This lord is not only crafty, unruly, and handsome, but the most most important thing is that he’s super lazy! He plays with his little servant girl all day long, but he cannot resist. What will they do?

title: I'm the One Who Died, but the Hero Went Crazy
alt_titles: I'm the One Who Died, but the Hero Went Crazy
I'm Dead, but the Hero Went Crazy
The Hero Went Crazy Even Though I'm the One Who Died
description:
As the hero's comrade, I died after blocking him from the evil dragon's breath. Well, it's fine. The Hero Elkinas was the only friend I trusted to have my back. I'll go out with a bang, I guess, so the hero can marry a pretty woman and live the rest of his life.

…Is what I thought would happen, but after 80 years passed, I came back to life in a completely different body. And…

“It’s regrettable, Arlene. Elkinas went insane. Completely insane.”

That was the first thing I heard.

What else could I do? I should help him. To help my close friend who seems to have not been able to accept my death, I decided to stay by his side while hiding my identity. This way Elkinas could completely accept the past and become happy, since this is the very reason why I died for him. But… I think he recognized me.

"You're… Arlene, aren't you?"

I touched my face. I definitely don't look like Arlene. Shouldn't there be no way he could know who I was?

"I won't ever let you go… Ever," Elkinas said with shining eyes.

---
Happy to die for the sake of her friends, Aryn the sorcerer succumbs to the poisonous breath of the evil dragon Kuntern. 80 years later, through the divine powers of The World Tree and her former adventuring companion Zephyr, Aryn finds herself reborn. Upon her awakening, she learns that her childhood best friend, Elkinas Pontiac, went insane after her death. Once the leader of their expedition, El is now a tyrant ruler, raising a child hatched from Kuntern’s egg. Will Aryn be able to save him?

title: The Millennium Alchemist
description:
A child was abandoned in a forest infested with monsters and ghosts. Woon Sowol was adopted by the five masters and learned the best magical techniques. Although the five masters are godly beings, now their inner balance is on the verge of being broken down. Woon Sowol takes revenge on behalf of his masters, and goes to the world to become a god. In the end, will Sowol be able to get out of the forest of beasts?

---

title: The Quiet Game
alt_titles: I Only Realized After Losing Her
description:
Ellie was a girl who couldn’t talk or even write. By chance, she begins listening to three people’s secrets. The three start to develop an interest in Ellie, who listened to their words. However, a couple of days later, Ellie disappears without a trace. 

With Ellie 's disappearance, he who confessed that he has a crush on a man, he who enjoys games involving riddles, he who has a secret fetish, The three men start searching for her, yet no one comes to figure out where she went, since they only talked about their own stories and had no clue about hers. Voiceless Ellie. 

That was my name. 

(After the tables have turned) I began to speak again and by the favor of someone truly dear to me, I became a ”Countess". The commoner Ellie who once couldn’t talk, can now speak as “Lady Phever”. And when the time came to reunite with the three men, “……Ellie?” The Ellie you know from the past is now gone. “You’ve got the wrong person.” Perfectly spoken words left my mouth.

title: Tiger Lily
description:
"I'll see you soon, my changgwi."   
Meet Baek Yoon, who got picked to be a changgwi, and Jay, who devours human spirits with the curse of a tiger.

title: Sadistic Beauty
description: The lives of two men are thrown into chaos when the sexy Chun Duna returns to town. On one end is student Woo Haesol whose timid nature reveals a man just begging to be dominated. On the other is Professor Byun Minho, a male chauvinist who bitterly views Duna as his mortal enemy. Tempers flare as pain turns into pleasure under the watchful eye of a sadistic beauty.

title: Doctor's Time Travel to Joseon
description:
"Is this really Joseon?! But I still have lives to save!"

Baek Kang-hyuk, South Korea’s top genius surgeon, finds himself transported to the Joseon era after touching a mysterious painting. And of all times… right before the outbreak of the Imjin War!

title: The Heavenly Demon Destroys the Lich King's Murim
description:
An unknown voice disturbed me while I was levitating during my cultivation to reach the transcendent demonic state.

My concentration had been broken, and I fell into an unconscious, overloaded state. When I awoke a month later, the Lich King had already taken control of the Murim.

After the battle that ended with the destruction of the Heavenly Demon Cult, I awoke a hundred and forty years later in a Murim where magic and martial arts coexisted.

---

title: The Cute Wife of the Cold Chairman
alt_titles: The Icy Chairman's Cute Little Wife
description: A punk girl turns into a great goddess to beat up scumbags and oppress fake angels. She angers all of the surrounding rotten women to death. After being reborn, I, Chi Yan, have to marry this brainless playboy with X disease? I found a handsome man to play my boyfriend, but he ended up trying to flirt with me every day! An icy chairman announced: My Yan'Er is the cutest in the world. I won't hold her back!

title: Saurus
description: Dinosaurs are back! This is a story of those who want to protect the collapsed human civilization.

title: Our Guild's Idol
description: Ajin Bae suddenly dives into Dear Dane, the world’s top MMORPG, using her brother’s account—who just happens to be the master of its number one guild. Tasked with keeping her identity secret, she tries to protect his legacy, but things spiral when she’s mistaken for a creep hitting on Bloomie, a popular female player who’s secretly a male idol. Trying to clear things up, Ajin sends a video with her voice in it. But that just gets Bloomie thinking: Wait… I know this girl!

title: Miss Gu and Miss Qu
description:
There are two women in the entertainment industry who share a name. One of them is Qu Xizhi, and the other is Gu Xizhi. Gu Xizhi already harbored hatred for Qu Xizhi because she "stole" her role as well as her ex-boyfriend, but somehow, the well connected Qu Xizhi won't stop pestering her to be friends!

When a tsundere straight girl falls into the trap by the perfect woman, she gradually gets her heart captured by her lifelong rival...

title: Vanilla Soda Sky
description: Taeha Oh loves to write smutty BL stories online. Why? 'Cause it's fun. Though he insists he's definitely not gay himself. But will things change after a surprise reunion sparks something inside of him…?

title: The Tale of Samjang
description:
Monk Sanzang from the "Journey to the west" has time slipped to the present-day Korea.   
  
She has lived her lifetime constantly fighting yokai but her most dangerous opponent turns out to be just one guy?!  
  
On the orders of Buddha, Monk Sanzang and her companions pilgramaged the Western regions in search of his teachings.  
Unlike Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing, who hoped to become gods in recognition of their contribution, rather than being tied down to the life of Buddhism, Sanzang wanted to remain in the human world and enjoy a new life as an ordinary human.  
  
But as she was being dragged to Heaven by orders from the Buddha, she notices a strange tunnel leading to the human world in which she escapes into…  
  
And the place where she fell is the Republic of Korea's Jeju Island!  
And she meets a guy named Lee Hyun?!  
  
The time-slipped Monk Sanzang a.k.a Hyeonjeong and the tsundere Lee Hyun's turbulent romance!

title: The Villain's Beloved Daughter
description:
My name is Rosaria von Valencia, but I didn't always have this name. According to a book I read, I'm supposed to be murdered in place of the saint, Cordelia, just because I look like her. I decided to run away to avoid ever meeting my future killer, Duke Valencia, but ended up running into him as he was on the brink of death. After I saved him in the hopes of being spared, he adopted me as his daughter! Now that my new dad's spoiling me with love, does this mean I'll get to live until the end?

---

title: Gwang-an
description:
Eun-Woo quietly worked as a court lady and hoped to become a Jimil Sanggung, a servant exclusive to the royal family. After 15 years of court life, she finally receives the favor of the Crown Prince. After getting drunk, the Prince visited Eun-Woo just once. But he keeps thinking of her...

This is a story about Lee Hyun, a lonely but outstanding Crown Prince, and Court Lady Eun-Woo, who wanted to live a simple life.

---
Eun Woo’s never been one for attention. She’s kept her head low in the palace ever since she first arrived, and all she’s focused on is doing a good job. Her peaceful life is broken, however, when the prince calls her to his bedroom. Lee Hyun is known for never having the same maid in his chambers twice, but Eun Woo keeps lingering on his mind. A story about a lonely prince and a lovely maid—will love make the prince’s wild eyes lose their sharp edge?

---

title: Visible Only to You
description:
May my comfort reach you!  
  
A fantasy romance to heal your heart.

title: Lost In Reverie
description:
The battle for the scholarship raged like wildfire. At the entrance of the school director’s office, Lin Yujing and Shen Wan came face to face.

After exhausting their tears, the two people stared at each other blankly for three seconds before turning around in unison and leaving.

Shen Wan got onto his private helicopter while Lin Yujing climbed into her Rolls-Royce.

–This is a story of two rich people trying their best to look poor in front of the other.

title: Freezing (Official Colored)
description:
Beings from a different dimension have started a war with mankind. To counter this threat, an academy called "Genetics" that trains female warriors called "Pandora," who can wield special weaponry and armor, was formed. Kazuya Aoi decided to enroll in this school because of a promise with his sister, an outstanding alumnus who died in battle. There he meets second year Satellizer L. Bridgette, nicknamed "The Untouchable Queen" due to her solitary demeanor but also top of her class whose battle simulation streak is undefeated, until he came… and slowly changed her.  
  
Colourized / Webtoon version

title: I’m A Super Rich Man, So It’s Reasonable For Me To Be A Scumbag
alt_titles: I’m A Super Rich Man, So It’s Reasonable For Me To Be A Scumbag
I'm a Rich Tycoon, So Being a Scumbag Makes Perfect Sense!
description: Jiang Cheng woke up and was reborn! He was also bound to the Godly Rich System. Every second the world runs, he can get money! As the system continues to upgrade, Jiang Cheng's wealth has skyrocketed. All the cool school beauties and queen bosses are around him. Jiang Cheng laughed up to the sky. In his previous life, he was trapped by the things that he couldn't get when he was young for so long. Now that he is reborn, who cares about those broken rules! Let's drink and enjoy it first.

title: Becoming a God, Starting as a Water Monkey
description: The protagonist, Liang, transmigrates to a world called the Great Wilderness. He was In a desperate situation, he accidentally awakens a system called the “Ze Bloodline System,” and everything changes from that moment! By infusing himself with the bloodlines of ancient divine beasts, the protagonist is able to gain immense power while gradually refining his own godly talents. Come! Fuse with the Ze Spirit bloodline!!! System: “Awakened bloodline—Water Monkey.” Protagonist: “???”

title: Never Understand
description: Yuri, one of the school's most handsome guys, and Jaerim, one of the school's ugliest, collide!...or don't they...Can't understand what's going on between these two! It's Out of Control!!

title: Ranju's Race to Romance
alt_titles: Fly Like A Butterfly, Sting Like A Bee
description: Ranju's sinful(?) gaze is always focused on the kind and popular angelic-like beauty in school, Jiha. When Ranju overhears that Jiha will be going on a date, she becomes determined to seduce her before it happens!

title: My Vampire System: A Dragon's Revenge
alt_titles: Evil Dragon Is Reincarnated! Revenge Begins at the Age of Five!
The Evil Dragon Has Been Reborn, His Revenge Started When He Was 5
È Lóng Zhuǎnshēng, Fùchóu Cóng Wǔ Suì Kāishǐ!
description: I was once the legendary red dragon who stood at the top of the world. For thousands of years, my brethren have been murdered by humans and the desire for revenge slowly turned into my only mission in this world! However, I failed. On the day of the decisive battle against human beings, I died with hatred in my heart... if there is an afterlife, I will definitely avenge my kind. If there is an afterlife, I will make these filthy humans pay with their blood! If there is an afterlife—hmm? I was reincarnated as a weak human baby?!!

title: I Swear I Really Like You
alt_titles: I Swear I Really Like You
description: What am I to you? Boyfriend? A boy toy? A hostage? A witness? Why did you save my life and just walk away? Why would you transfer to my school and tell everyone we go way back? On a different note, why do you always have a gun? And why do those foreigners keep chasing after me? Will I survive being next to you?

title: The Evil Girl Karuna Has Shrunk
alt_titles: The Villainess Karuna Has Become a Child
The Villainess Caruna Has Become a Child
description:
In order to make Clayen, the daughter of Count Macarena, the prince's fiancée, Karuna, who has lived her life pretending to be Clayen, committed all sorts of bad things. The day she finally became the prince’s fiancée, a sharp dagger sent by the Count pierced Karuna in her stomach. 

Ah, what a cold feeling. I prepared for this day. The promise that you can turn your life back! But why didn’t I go back to the past, and why is it the next day? Why did my surroundings stay the same, yet I'm the only one who returned to being a child? And why are you doing this to me? Duke Bikeld, who even sent an assassin to me as we tried to poison each other? We couldn’t manage to kill each other, weren’t we the best of friends? 

“I have finally found you, my mate.” 

Shouldn’t you be saying, “Die, my friend”?

---

title: The Ten Thousand Clans Invasion: Guardian of the Rear
alt_titles: Wan Zu Ru Qin: Quanmin Canzhan, Wo Liushou Houfang
Invasion of All Races: All the People Join the War, I Stay Behind
description: Invasion of the Ten Thousand Clans, universal superpowers, the era beyond time has arrived! In this age, all citizens are drafted to resist the foreign races and defend against external humiliation. Nan Ziying, at the tender age of adulthood, chooses to stay behind at the recruitment center, serving as logistical support. Many soldiers are disappointed, the youth scorn him, and white-haired elders take up arms and leave, leaving him behind with only women, children, and the elderly to guard the rear. Later, Nan Ziying awakens five great abilities and silently prepares. In this era where countless clans reign supreme and the times are filled with tragic heroism, ‘I am the calamity of these ten thousand clans!'

title: The Urban Flower's Vacation
description: The king of the Western underground world, "Tian Zi", vanished out of the blue, subsequently reappearing as the fiancé of the beautiful president! A mysterious mask gives Jiang Shaoyou boundless power, but with a catch - Every time it is used, Jiang Shaoyou will have to pick a flower; ie. a woman will fall in love with him! In order to complete his teacher's mission and investigate the dark hand behind the curtains, Jiang Shaoyou begins a life as a bodyguard without shame or restraint!

title: Build Up
description:
Maru Kang was just an ordinary kid with ordinary interests, until one day his father forces him to watch a soccer game on TV, sparking an obsession with the sport. Filled with determination, he sets a new goal for himself -- to become an amazing soccer player! The only problem is, he has already been proclaimed the “King of the Losers” at his high school. Can Maru overcome the obstacles in his path and transform into a talented and successful soccer player?

---

title: The Truth Mask
description:
Student Wu Mian accidentally obtained a mask. Once you wear it, everyone will agree with whatever you say or do. Even then, he has no courage to confess to a girl that he secretly loves. Until an incident completely changes his whole life…

---
