- [Alternative Official English - INKR](https://comics.inkr.com/title/237-the-truth-mask?utm=mgd)
- [Alternative Official English - WebComics](https://www.webcomicsapp.com/comic/The-Truth-Mask/5e82e8108c252b78b752b5b7)

title: There's a Rat in Our House
alt_titles: There Is a Mouse in My House
There's a Mouse in my House
description: Amidst the freezing winter, a solitary being huddled on the snow-covered pavement, bearing the burden of deep loneliness and faded scars. It had forsaken itself, fragile and vulnerable. The reason for welcoming this nameless creature into the home was straightforward. "What... does this mean?" "You helped me, and I wish to return the favor." In the complete darkness where no trace of light could penetrate, only two warm bodies occupied the space

title: CELL
description: Wi Sangwoo is kind of a twat, and then hits rock-bottom after his wealthy, sheltered life crumbles around him. Now he's trying to climb the social ladder by hanging out with the rich kids again… with a little help of some garden variety superpower.

title: Margrave’s Bastard Son was The Emperor
description:
He became the Emperor when he was just a boy and was beheaded before reaching adulthood. It was a tragedy brought about by his fate as the first noble wizard.

“Ian, don’t be born in your next life.”

He thought everything was over, listening to the traitor’s heartless words. He knew, but…

“You are a symbol of peace. Where else would you find such honor as a lowly one?”

He became the Margrave’s bastard son, whose family went extinct 100 years ago.
A lowly, unsophisticated one, destined to be sold as a hostage to the barbarians across the border.

title: Live or Not
description:
What happens when a tired old couple is given a second chance to escape their married life and start over? Through a twist of fate and a magical coin, Chastity and Valor are thrust back to their teenage years- to an age before they were wed. Will they take this opportunity to part ways for good or rekindle a love they never had?  
  
[Spotton Official English has been discontinued.](http://www.spottoon.com/book/77/WE)

title: I Have 999 Abilities
alt_titles: I Can Snatch 999 Types of Abilities
description:
In a world where superpowers are commonplace, Yang Xifa swore bloody revenge on those who harmed his dear sister. He will use his ability to take away other's powers to build himself up from an innocent bystander to become the leader of a powerful organization. Combining his strength and smarts to defeat the evil-doers, he will collect 999 abilities and become the most powerful hero in the world!

(Source: Anilist (Bilibili, translated))

title: A Dream Escape
description:
'Sonidor', a dream artisan who enters into other people's dreams through physical contact and grants wishes that could not be fulfilled in reality. One day, the emperor suddenly arrives at the house and asks to wake up the crown prince who has fallen into eternal sleep. "I want you to wake him up."

Sonidor enters the dream of 'Marmel', the crown prince who is praised by everyone for his gentle nature and beautiful appearance, but somehow Marmel's dream is gloomy and desolate. “You were just going to kill me?!” 

According to the taste of the prince who hates people, Sonidor turns into various animals and finds the reason why Marmel fell asleep one by one, and Marmel gradually opens his heart to Sonidor... "Your Highness, do you believe me?" Will Sonidor be able to wake Marmel from his eternal sleep?

title: The Villainess' Wise Retirement Plan
alt_titles: A Clever Retirement Plan of the Villainess
description:
I've transmigrated into a game I used to enjoy playing, "The Demon King's Consort," as the villainess who dies after harassing the female lead!
Worse still— I have a terminal condition! As a human mana stone, the more I use magic, the more it drains my life force...

What kind of life is this...? 

No matter. I can simply just choose not to use magic, right?
I'll preserve and protect my mana (= life force), gather a slush fund, and run away with my big sister to a warm and peaceful southern country...!

Or so I thought...

"Take it, Lillian. It's your doll."
My Father threw the male lead at my feet. The obsessive male lead that was destined to become a psychotic, possessive king in the future...!

title: The End of This Fairytale Is One Hell of a Drama (Pre-serialization)
alt_titles: The End of This Fairy Tale Is a Soap Opera
description:
Promotional oneshot for the novel.  


---

In the fairy tale, the lady and the prince greet the ending that lives happily ever after. The life of the extra Linet is not over yet, at the end of the fairy tale, she is left alone to make a pledge.

title: Shadow's Resurgence
description: Saal Cooper was the perfect "shadow" of the Cooper family. He was loyal, powerful, and... expendable. Spellbound to be Eren Cooper's human shield, Saal took all the wounds and pain meant for his master, making him an invincible hero. When the family discards him like a broken tool, Saal discovers the horrifying truth behind his lifelong agony. Betrayed and left to die, he reverses the spell with his final breath, reclaiming his stolen power. But death grants him an unexpected gift when he is reborn as his three-year-old self. This time, Saal is determined not to live in the shadows.

title: Spirit Fingers!
description:
​An ordinary girl… joins an extraordinary drawing club?!  
A story of finding one's true colors

title: The Earth Lord's School Life
description:
The Earth's Most Powerful Being is always longing for a fight that would excite him.

Driven mad by his love for battle, he possesses the body of a high school student and once again experiences the thrill of combat.

Meanwhile, the Earth's Guardian, sealed away by other gods, seeks to grow stronger in his new body and challenge them.

Will he overcome the gods with his new body and continue to enjoy the thrill of battle?

title: Breaking Through the Clouds 2: Devouring the Sea
description:
From [NovelUpdates](https://www.novelupdates.com/series/swallowing-the-seas/):  
  
Jinhai City Public Security Bureau newcomer Wu Yu is meek and mild, a man of few words, and completely unconcerned about the trials and tribulations placed before him by his strict boss. All he wants is to simply get by at his job, be paid on time, and play the role of a background actor.  
  
Nobody knew that this young man had a massive bounty placed on his head by a drug lord, as well as the youthful heroic spirit of a dragon-slayer from the abyss.

title: The Hand That Once Fed
alt_titles: Bitten by the Dog I Abandoned
description:
Evelyn Winter is the daughter of the House of Winter. She cruelly chases away the dog that only followed her, Gillas Black.

“Didn’t you say you loved me?”
"Love? Did you believe that word? You don’t know your place, you idiot.”
“You will regret this moment.”

Evelyn has no regrets, she marries Rowen, Delilah's heir and has a daughter, Sherry. But their happiness is short-lived when Rowen dies in a train accident and she is left a widow. To make matters worse, his family's financial situation deteriorates. And the boy I used to pet is missing. The dog I abandoned came back as a war hero.

title: My Heart Is Not a Stone
alt_titles: My Heart Is Not a Stone
description: In order to start a rebellion, Jiujin infiltrated the Western Region’s marriage convoy on its way through the central plains. But her cover was blown on the very first day. Fortunately for her, it appears that the princess she was escorting might also be a fake! Pursued by forces on all sides they must rely on each other to survive. Through close encounters and shared dangers, feelings gradually begin to blossom.

title: Otherworld Squad
description: One day, a fantasy phenomenon began to occur in my ordinary life. An elf is hiding in my room?

title: The 9th Class Swordmaster: Blade of Truth
alt_titles: The Ninth-Rank Sword Master: Conquering the Sword Forms
9th Class Sword Master: The Guardian of the Sword
description:
In the year 237 of the Imperial Era, the ‘Divine War’ concludes – a war fought to protect humanity from ‘corruption.’ At the end of this battle, the Sword Saint, Kyril McGyver, faces betrayal from his closest friend and Emperor, Oliver.

In the end, after killing the Emperor, Kyril decides to correct all the wrongs by returning to the past.

Now, with a power he could not acquire in his past life – the power of the sword and magic – he stands at the apex of both paths, ready to change the future.

title: The Dragon Next Door
description:
Meet my neighbor - a typical fantasy novelist, more than a little scatterbrained, likes to gossip, borrows things without asking, and plays MMORPGs. Oh, and by the way, he's a dragon in disguise.   
  
Named Dragon Kim.  
  
…Yeah…

title: I Became the Youngest Prince in the Novel
description:
The novel Chronicles of the Hero of Frosimar is a story about the failures of the protagonist not the successes.

“This is terrible.”

The First Emperor, who conquered the whole world, closed his eyes with a brief appreciation (after reading the novel).

But the moment he opened his eyes again, there were only a few lines about him in the Chronicles of the Hero of Frosimar.

This was because he became an imprisoned prince who met death with his first appearance (in the novel).

title: What Do You Do When You Suddenly Become an Immortal?
alt_titles: What to Do When Suddenly Becoming the Immortal
description:
When your soul goes into others, others are also going into you. On this day, Lin Fan and the Saintess transmigrated at the same time, and later found out that they could transmigrate infinitely! Constantly going back and forth between the two time and space, the two's chaotic journey through the immortal cultivation began. "Excuse me, your name is..."

Note: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) meets Xianxia

title: Seeking the Flying Sword Path
description: In this world exists demon spirits, river deities, and cultivators who seek for eternal youth. Through their mystic eye, cultivators can sense these supernatural beings. They cultivate their flying swords to slay enemies from thousands of miles away. With abilities attained through refinement, the second young master of the Qin manor, "Qin Yun" is one of those cultivators.

title: Kissing Lilies
description: Seohyun s'est récemment mise en couple avec Gyeol. En racontant ses rendez-vous amoureux à ses amies, elle se rend compte qu'elle n'a jamais embrassé sa petite copine. Seohyun va alors mettre en place des plans pour avoir son premier baiser avec Gyeol.

title: Baby Dragon
description: 'Aileen de Sheia' who was reborn as a dragon, had the memory of a 19 year old bullied school girl, Na Hui-joo. I'm happy to feel the strong power that no one has experienced. I also felt the love and kindness of the people around me for the first time. As some make their every effort to have her, some also make their every effort to get rid of her.

title: Breaking News
description:
An ordinary college student, Lee Ye-Seul, starts a part-time job at a broadcasting station cafe to meet and spy on Kim Min Jun, the youngest main news announcer in South Korea. Contrary to her expectations, Min Jun is a very cold person…  
  
"Do you know how long I've liked you? Why are you being so cold towards me?"

title: Saving the Doomed Idols with My Touch
description: I can save even the most doomed restaurant with my touch!Im Hyeonseong, a famous chef who has even shown up in a TV show as the CEO of a food industry.He built his wealth and fame from the ground up, but meets an unjust death because of his stepmother and step-sibling.At that moment, a system window appeared in front of him.They will give him a chance to take his revenge if he succeeds in making ‘Climax’, the doomed idol group, successful by controlling Cheon Ise’s body.Will I be able to save the doom restau– I mean the doom idols with my touch? We will now begin the special quest, ‘Idol, Cheon Ise’!

title: Rebirth of the Butterfly Girl
description:
Na Bibi and her only friend Dahee, both bullied by their classmates, have been enduring a painful middle school life. But after turning 17, Na Bibi gained the ability to transform like a butterfly and be reborn infinitely with a different appearance.   
  
With a brand-new pretty look, she is now ready to start afresh as a high school student. But her transformation stirs tensions with Dahee who disappears on her. Struggling with her identity, Na Bibi enters high school. She coincidentally ends up in the same class as Bang Yeonwoo, a student from the same middle school.

title: S Flower
description:
It’s Ye-eun’s 32nd birthday, but she’s not feeling too great. After her lingerie line went out of business, she's been forced to move back to her hometown, a place she thought she’d left for good. Luckily, her best friend knows just the thing to cheer her up: a big, shiny, limited edition dildo. Ye-eun “breaks it in” that night, but wakes up the next morning sans dildo. All she's left with are fragments of a hot night of S&M and the muffled moans of a stranger… Who could the mystery man be?  
  
This comic contains BDSM content that some readers may find uncomfortable.

title: I Became the Tyrant's Dishonest Adviser
description:
[Coming 2023]

“Your Majesty’s happiness is my happiness. How can I help you?”

Working as a Call Center agent

Overnight, I became the “servant” of the tyrant male lead in a romantic fantasy novel.

If you don’t give him the answer he wants within 3 seconds, he’ll execute you.

As the only henchman of the tyrant emperor, who changes his women every day, indulging in pleasure…

She has no intention of dying as the original. So, until the tyrant meets the female lead, she has to watch out for herself and run away.

Therefore, she started doing business to earn money for her escape

Saved a few ships to escape across the sea

She searched for the woman who could capture the attention of the tyrant and devoted herself to the education of his concubine.

Whatever the case, the remaining time until the fall of the empire is in one year.

I have to run away quickly.……

Surung—

The cold blade was pulled against my neck.

“Where are you going in such a hurry, Duchess Baloa?”

The tyrant has cut off my escape route.

title: Hero Shi Feels Lonely
description: Shi Zhou Wu is Ren Tian Faction’s elder brother. He has been devoted to martial arts and been oblivious to worldly affairs since he was a child. He is serious, he doesn’t smile and is often feared by people around him. One time, at a martial arts conference, he was surrounded by way too many chivalrous couples, this seriously stimulated his spirit causing a sense of invincible loneliness to haunt him. Therefore, he decided to find his own happy fated marriage…

title: Starting as a Master of Female Disciples' Leisure Skills
description: Xiu Xian died and, upon waking up, found himself transmigrated into the body of a cowardly illegitimate son from a cultivation family. Without spiritual roots, he couldn’t cultivate, and the head of the family despised him. Almost anyone in the household could easily humiliate him. However, he acquired a "Female Disciples' Leisure System." As long as his female disciples cultivated various leisure skills like cooking, painting, blacksmithing, weaving, and construction, Xiu Xian would gain experience points. As the disciples improved their skills, they could even develop all sorts of incredible cultivation techniques—like eating food to restore health bars...

title: Little Twin Matchmakers
alt_titles: My Daddy's Public Image Is Collapsing!
Wo Die Di Ren She Beng Le
description:
Adapted from the novel of the same name by Mumuchen.

"Waaaait… you look familiar! You look… just like ME!" 

Two practically identical boys have joined forces and hatched a plot—for love! Their mission: get their parents together. Shi Chuxia is a plucky photographer, always working for that scoop. Mr. Lu is super famous and just the right target to get Shi Chuxia the big bucks, as long as she can nab that one lucky shot. As their kids push these two singles together, sparks fly, but will it lead to a once-in-a-lifetime love? Or a massive burnout?

title: Lethal Romance
description:
A woman who is like a martial arts manhwa character "Yubi". A man who is like a shoujo manhwa character "Shinwoo".  
The two who are used to living in their own genres won't easily fall for each other!  
Will they be able to achieve a happy ending according to the standard of manhwa?!

title: Hellper 2 <KillBeros>
description: Indeed it is, indeed it does. A street action comic featuring the life of Jang Gwangnam leading up to the creation of the Killberos Tribe.

title: The Academy Is Doomed
description: The academy where Amon was assigned as a new teacher has gone bankrupt! The principal is addicted to gambling, the teachers are no-goods, and the students are lethargic! How will Amon tread forth as he stands at the crossroads of escape and success? A comedic fantasy series that will make your sides hurt from laughing!

title: Monstrous Heart
description:
Su Yuan, a poor student, in order to not place any additional burdens on his family, accidentally got himself enrolled into a college named, Ogus University. But soon he discovered that this institution was actually established for the protection of monsters (demons); and the physically weaker humans, in order to protect their lives, had to form partnerships—called PAL—with those monsters. Furthermore, as a result of his unique scent, many are drawn towards him in hopes of becoming his PAL; and at same time, he is also subjected to various attacks. That was, at least, until the day he rescued a fox covered in blood from head to toe, only to then discover…  


---

title: Acquainted: Encounter Spin-Off
description:
What appeared to be a one-time encounter in Spain blossoms into romance when by-the-book CEO Jung Wooseok and free-thinking architect Han Yujin meet again in Korea. The two are drawn to each other, but there’s a catch: Yujin’s the winner of a high-profile architecture competition held by Wooseok’s company. When word gets out that these two are acquainted, will their love be able to survive the public’s scrutiny... and their families’ even harsher criticism? 


---

  
[Official Indonesian Translation](https://kakaopage.co.id/content/Girlfriend-Spin-off-Drama-Encounter/3342?tab=episode)

title: The Mighty Teacher Is a Roleplayer
alt_titles: The Fake Master Who Accidentally Became the Strongest
description: Waking up in a fantasy novel where the universe bans her from using magic is just the first of many trials for Chris Dotten, a new professor at the prestigious Bedallua Academy of Magic. Bombarded with quests that each threaten to penalize her with death if she fails, Chris must survive her tenure as the teacher of the novel’s protagonist using whatever means necessary. However, with no magical solution at hand, her sole strategy is to roleplay as the teacher who is so powerful that using magic is unnecessary. Will Chris and her act survive until graduation day?

title: Heavenly Demon Wants to Be A Chef
alt_titles: Heavenly Demon Wants to Be A Chef
description:
Due to a gate-related accident, Woojin regains the memories of his past life... a life as the Heavenly Demon, ruler of China! 

However, as the Heavenly Demon, there was a dream he never managed to achieve. Now, in this life, he'll do whatever it costs to fulfill his lifelong dream of becoming a chef! 

This is the legendary(?) story of Cheon Woojin, the former Heavenly Demon, chasing his dreams!

title: A Song of Prosperity
description:
An intelligent and domineering woman encounters a carefree, flamboyant prince at a brothel. Initially, she thinks of it as nothing more than a chance meeting, but little did she know their fates would end up being so deeply intertwined…  
  
"If you hold no love for me, then I will give up my love for you as well."  
  
A romance story about love and loss set in ancient times.

title: Ex vs. Stalker
description:
Kidnapped by her ex-boyfriend, only the stalker is in the know!  
  
The fitting model Ju Yeon, who had just emerged as a star on social media, wakes up to find herself tied up in a dark school. Her kidnapper, a man named Nam Woo, is her ex-boyfriend. Ju Yeon had just reached a turning point in her life. But while she was being threatened by her ex-boyfriend at that moment, Ju Yeon's stalker, Park Su, was watching the two while keeping his mouth shut inside the shadows!

title: The Savior's Bucket List
description: Yonghak ultimately failed to save the world despite repeated regressions. At the next regression, he decides to quit being a savior. But suddenly, disciples show up, one by one... Will the world be kept safe?! Will the savior be able to fulfill his bucket list of wishes for rest?!

title: My Brothers, the Protagonists
description:
Until recently, I had three wishes that I could only hope to come true.

 

‘Please let my missing oldest brother come back.’
‘Please let my Second Brother awaken so he could stop working as a rift porter.’
‘And my youngest brother…As long as he can open his eyes…’

 

There’s nothing I wanted but happiness… was what I thought…!

 

“Keuhk…I’ll only play for 10 years so I can keep the darkness inside me, so work a little harder, youngest!”
My oldest brother spoke as though he were still in his adolescence.

 

“Since hyung is playing for 10 years, I’ll also play for 10 years, too!”
My second brother who returned as an awakener from the future (as he claims to be) said.

 

“You foolish pig, I’ll give you an opportunity to serve this noble soul.”
My Third brother… let’s just move on since it makes my head ache just by thinking about him.

 

“You unemployed parasites! Why can’t you all go out and find jobs?!”

 

Can the future of Lee Bobae, a girl with nothing more to wish for, be full of happiness?

title: Counterattack: Diva System
description: Chu You has always been responsible and hard-working in order to fulfill her goal of becoming a famous movie director, but unexpectedly, she was betrayed by a scum man and woman! Not only was she falsely accused, she was also robbed of her hard-earned savings! In despair, she committed suicide with hatred, but after her rebirth, she's contracted with the Diva system?! Once a scumbag, always a scumbag! Now, what you made me experience before, I'll give it back to you in double!

title: Night of the Soulless Heathens
alt_titles: The Shadowed Legacy of the Soulless Messenger
description:
Azadin, a member of the cursed Messenger Clan, is born with the worst of curses. Lacking magical prowess, he becomes the lowest-ranking messenger, wandering the continent collecting gold coins in hopes of breaking his curse. 

But when his twin uncovers a great conspiracy, how will he face the impending doom?

title: Blessing in Disguise
description: Siwoo has a first love from the past that comes to mind whenever the rainy season comes.

title: Moracmorac Crown Prince
description: A fantasy romance story about a handsome crown prince and his companions that are visiting a hot spring village and a girl with mysterious powers.

title: I've Become a True Villainess
alt_titles: The Case of the Legal Villain
The Circumstances of a True Villain
description:
I have to survive, no matter what! I've died and been reincarnated as the villain of a romance novel! In order to avoid the hideous fate that awaits me, I've righted her wrongs and even gotten engaged. I should be home free, but strange things have started happening ever since the heroine appeared. Why won't her fiancé leave me alone?

Note: The English will release on 30th Nov 2022, and the Korean release will release sometime after.

title: Skeleton Evolution: Starting From Being Summoned By the Sorceress
alt_titles: Skeleton Evolution: It Starts With Being Summon by a Goddess
Kulou Jinhua: Cong Bei Nvshen Zhaohuan Kaishi
Kūlóu Jìnhuà: Cóng Bèi Nǚshén Zhàohuàn Kāishǐ
description:
Jiang Cheng, a man who unexpectedly finds himself reincarnated into a fantastical game world as a lowly skeleton, summoned by a group of beautiful female players using dark necromancy. To his dismay, this skeleton is no ordinary minion; it's the epitome of cannon fodder, barely worth a second glance! But fortune smiles upon him, for he possesses an extraordinary ability—the Infinite Evolution System!

With this newfound power, Jiang Cheng embarks on a remarkable journey, evolving from a mere skeleton into a god-tier undead warrior. Now, armed with unrivaled strength and cunning intellect, he unleashes havoc upon the game world, sending players and NPCs alike into fits of desperation and sorrow.

Follow Jiang Cheng as he rises from the depths of obscurity to become the fearsome legend—the God-tier Skeleton, feared by all, and unmatched in the realms of virtual adventure. Get ready for an epic tale of action, strategy, and unexpected alliances in a world where the line between reality and the virtual becomes blurred. Brace yourself as the laughter of victory and the tears of defeat echo throughout this extraordinary adventure!

title: Returned Warrior's Swordsmanship Broadcast
description:
"After returning from hell, the first thing I did was pick up my sword again."

Meet the Returning Warrior's swordsmanship broadcast in comic form!

[Original Novel](https://novelpia.com/novel/148845)

title: Red Spirit
description: Around the 17th century, Wu San Gui overthrown the Mu Wang Palace with the help of a mysterious person, allowing them to do whatever they please to in Yun Nan, the Mu Wang Palace who had hidden in seclusion was massacred, and a simple youth named Jing Xiu Ming became the only survivor after being saved by the disciple of the Yunyou divine doctor named Ling Le Sui, but was infected with an illness that causes people to go berserk. In order to find the killer who killed his entire village and cure his illness, Jing Xiu Ming and Yunyou divine doctor's disciple set off for a journey.

title: The Little Saint and the Grand Duke of the North
alt_titles: The Saint Became the Daughter of the Northern Duke
The Saintess Became the Northern Grand Duke's Daughter
The Saintess Became the Daughter of the Northern Duke
The Saint Became the Northern Grand Duke's Daughter
description: Born Again to Escape, and to Heal a Broken Heart Liriette, blessed with divine power that could heal others through her blood, had spent her short life as nothing more than a tool for a cruel High Priest. Her end came quietly, used and discarded. But one day, she opened her eyes… and she was 10 years old again. "This time, I will never let the horrors of my past repeat themselves." Determined to escape the clutches of the High Priest, Liriette sought refuge in the farthest corner of the empire, with none other than Duke Windsorice, the ruler of the cold and mysterious North. "I can heal your eyes. Please, let me stay by your side." At first, it was simply a desperate attempt to escape her dreadful fate. Yet, as time passed, her hopes and dreams began to grow beyond mere survival. "Would you… become my daughter?" With trembling hands and a soft voice, Liriette asked, "What would you gain from me as your daughter?" The Duke's lips curled into the faintest smile. "A kind and beautiful daughter." Follow the heartwarming journey of a lonely girl who finds her home and happiness as the beloved daughter of the empire’s coldest Duke. Watch as the once-unfeeling ruler becomes the ultimate doting father, melting the icy North with his newfound love.

title: Don't Come Near My 10M Boundary
description: Nam Joo Won is a high school teacher with a phobia of students. On the first day of classes, Joo Won runs to the faculty bathroom to find shelter from his students but encounters the class delinquent, Lee Tae Gyum. Why won't this kid leave him alone?

title: Perfect Surgeon
description:
When he was a child, his father was said to have died from a car accident. But what actually caused his death was ‘Medical Negligence’.
Ever since that, his dream was to become a ‘Perfect Doctor’ that would never deny or mistreat a patient.

However, reality was harsh.
His mother was inflicted with an incurable disease, which required a lot of money. He quit his university hospital internship and became a sell-out dermatologist.

While he had stopped in his tracks due to the harshness of reality, a state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence, ‘A.I. – Ronnie’, came to him.
And thus, his journey to become a perfect doctor started once again.

---

- [Webtoon PV](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dqr0lp4pDiY)

title: Scandal
description:
What if your husband was the protagonist in the scandal of the most popular actress of the time?  
Ji-woo quits her job as a reporter, after their newlywed life is destroyed by her husband's affair, and leaves for the United States. However her ex-husband comes up with an offer that cannot be rejected…

title: Demon Apartment
description:
Gu Bai, carrying his painting board behind him, has moved into an amazing apartment.   
He noticed that the neighbor to his left is a headline queen, and on his right is the infamous acting king. On the upper floor, there is a supermodel living on the left side and a gold medal lawyer on the right side. And across his room, is a powerful big shot who is constantly featured in finance magazines.  
The ordinary Gu Bai will soon begin an unusual day.

title: Dokgo
description: After Kang Hu’s death from bullying, the family was torn into pieces. His younger brother suppresses his resentment and heads back to school. The story begins exactly one year after Kang Hu’s death when his brother seeks to destroy the delinquent circle

title: Looking for a Father
description: Hyun-Su Jung (29) was scammed by Jung-Mi Kim and is now in debt of $900,000. He is being chased by loan sharks and ended up kidnapping Jung-Mi Kim's daughter, Ha-Yeon Lee (17). But when Hyun-Su Jung calls to demand ransom, Jung-Mi Kim tells him she doesn't care about what happens to her daughter and hangs up. What will happen to the kidnapper and his victim?

title: I Don't Wanna Work!
description:
Rotieh Panderion has been entrusted with an important task: She must create "Nectar," an immortality-granting elixir. In return, she will be granted a position among the world's deities. After toiling away for a hundred lifetimes, she's had enough hard work and decides to go on strike! But her latest reincarnation is a poor, illegitimate princess accused of attempted murder. Now, Rotieh must clear her name and restore her lost wealth, but that's easier said than done when she doesn't wanna work!

---
Born as a genius among geniuses in Herbal Medicine, I've undergone countless reincarnations, all at the request of the Gods! I can't stop until I create the perfect Divine Elixir...

Isn’t this a scam? In the end, in this current life, I declared a strike.

I’m not going to do it! No, I won’t work!!!

"I'm counting on you."
"Me? Are you serious?!"
Surprisingly, my strained family relationships seem to be improving.

"Thank you so much!"
I'm receiving expressions of gratitude from all over the place. And to top it off…

"A long-lost disciple came to see you."
My first, and also my last, disciple appeared in front of me.

Why didn’t he die?

title: Top Corner
description:
A maths genius' kickoff!  

---

- [Official Spanish <Es> Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/es/sports/top-corner/list?title_no=2102)
  
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/action/top-corner/list?title_no=1753)

title: Rebirth of the Strongest Sword God
alt_titles: Reincarnation of the Strongest Sword God
description: The top player of the popular MMO, “Divine Realm”, Shi Feng, was betrayed by his club. He drank in sadness, but then woke up realizing he had gone back 10 years, to the time when Divine Realm had just released. Using the ten years of experience he had, he started all over to climb back to the top. This time, he intends to surpass himself and reach greater heights.

title: Efforts Never Betray
description: Jae-kyung, who grew up under a perfectionist father, must keep first place in the entire school.

title: Fire Dragon King
description: Seo Moon Moo-hui, who had no choice but to look at the world with a different eye from his childhood, unfolds a new world from the tip of his brush, who unexpectedly went out to Kang-ho!

title: Escape from Another World
description:
Kim Seojoon, a freshman college student leading a normal daily life, awoke one day to find himself transported into a fantasy world straight out of a webtoon or web novel or something like that. 

As he began to get excited about potentially having the role of a male lead character, a shocking event unfolded before his eyes—a murder of an imperial family. Consequently, Kim Seojoon found himself imprisoned in the world's prison, 'Gehenna'.

Will he be able to navigate the treacherous paths of this unfamiliar world?

title: Clairvoyant Doctor
description: Tang Qian dropped out of college to work in order to find a cure for his father’s illness. One day when he was standing up for the owner of an antique shop, he bumped into a cinnabar furnace. From that day onward, he had gained a special ability whereby an elder sage’s voice could be heard speaking to him in his mind, telling him a patient’s diagnosis and course of treatment upon seeing the patient. He verified that the sage’s prescriptions were truly effective and could even save patients on the verge of death. His actions of saving people were caught on by the hospital and people were sent to investigate him. Nevertheless, Tang Qian wanted to treat his father’s illness with his newfound ability. However, the ingredients for his father’s prescription could not be found in this world. Alas, he could only continue working for his father’s medical bills. He bought that very cinnabar furnace that he bumped into because it could have something to do with his special powers. He also believed that he had not fully manifested his powers yet. One night, he gained another clairvoyant ability...

title: Different Kings
description: Reiki is a resurrection, the entire world is covered by a strong aura, and creatures of the earth are affected by this. Humans experienced an account that they had stronger powers, and other creatures besides humans also evolved rapidly under the influence of Aura. Some powerful and mysterious races have appeared in silence. The legend says that the power remained: the family in another world, coincidentally, the soul of another world royal prince entered the body of a young common human, Huang Shang, and began the story of bloody and funny hegemony…

title: To My Husband's Mistress
description:
I, Leticia Violet, was devoted to my husband, but I lost everything. Just as she is about to lose her life, a man appears in her life. He promises to help me achieve the perfect revenge...

"When you say you'll help me get my revenge... please honor your word."

To those who brought me to my death, I will give back all that I have received.

---
When Letitia Winchester faces death at the hands of her husband’s mistress, fate intervenes. She’s fished out of the river by Prince Sion, the first “Sol” born in a holy empire in 300 years. Using his divine powers, he changes Letitia’s appearance and gives her the new identity of Countess Anarose Victoire. Armed with divine powers and a thirst for revenge, the two form an unlikely alliance. Prince Sion seeks justice for a fallen friend, while Letitia plots retribution against those who wronged her.

Together, they embark on a journey of vengeance and redemption.

title: Your Ancestor Is Online
description:
When Zhang Tianling a typical Chinese Otaku plays a game late at night like any usual Otaku with a hikikomori tendency does, he accidentally migrated to a different world and became the founder of the sect in the game he played with all the max stats and skills.   
  
Everything seems perfect, right? OP character and skills? What could go wrong?   
  
But what he didn’t expect… this sect is now poor and destitute, and only the sect master and one disciple are left.   
  
Where are all the people? Even the mountain gate is rented? Wait, the landlord is coming here to collect a debt?! Fortunately, the system I have is still working. Sect Simulator huh? This could work!

title: The Great Deity
description:
This is a story of an exceptional boy, Lu Xiao Yi who wasn’t destined to follow the path of a cultivator. After resigning to his ill-destined fate, a couple of mysterious dices appeared suddenly, and he gained mysterious abilities. Entrusted to rekindle the fallen deities’ mission, the young boy’s life hence begun to change!  
  
[Official Korean Translation](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=52785045)

title: High School Girl at the Convenience Store
alt_titles: A High School Girl & A Convenience Store
description:
A yuri manhwa about a tough high school girl and a shy convenience store worker. Even if it's just running errands, just being able to catch a glimpse of her makes it all worthwhile.

---
**Links:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=3698011)

title: The Masquerade
description: 『Sometimes, your future gets decided by just one moment.』    The whole kingdom of Jesús fell into a state of shock after hearing the news of Queen Mary Trizia’s Suicide.    While everyone praised Mary Trizia for being an excellent queen, whilst her older twin brother, Rafael Evans, was most suspicious of her death.    ‘It can only be you. No one else can save me other than you.’     These words and the image of his sister screaming those words while approaching him bare-footed remained in his head. Rafael ventures out in search after his relatives for the first time in his life, to attend Mary’s funeral.    But in the place where they found Mary’s body, Rafael finds a note…    “Lift up your face.”  Wanting to find the killer of Mary, Rafael disguises himself as the new queen consort, Anne-Mary La Shore and meets the king ‘Ivry.’    That moment marked the start of an unprecedented fate.  The unexpected end of his sister who wasn’t like her younger self, and who he believed would find happiness…    What was the ‘hell’ that his sister dropped into?  And what will change after Rafael and Ivry meet?

title: Revenge of Young Master Peng
description:
Habuk Peng Family’s best strength, Peng Jihyuk heads to the Nakho Region to save his family that fell into destruction due to the attack of the Demon Sect, but everything was a trap. At the moment of death, he felt the wrath of being the only one left from his beloved family.

‘Again…if you give me a chance…!”

Peng Jihyuk, who thought he was dead, woke up in the body of Young Master Sa, of the Peng Family.

---

- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/BOY/pengjiasigongzi/list?title_no=2059)

title: He Is So Flirty
alt_titles: In this case, it is love
description:
On the kind Qin Qing's first day of transfer, she accidentally got involved in the middle of someone picking a fight. Qin Qing used a strategy to save her senior who's been ganged upon, not knowing that he's Wen Yufeng, the infamous school bully! From that moment forward, Qin Qing's peaceful high school life was gone forever…  
  


---

title: Martial Streamer
description:
TaeMin was a student taking a gap year, when he ended up electrocuting himself while trying to become a Youtuber.

However, he ends up being reincarnated as Zhao Ga-hui in a world of martial arts, with livestreaming abilities to boot!

With the special ability to access Youtube when he closes his eyes, he starts streaming his daily life in ancient China, with the goal of becoming the ultimate merchant and martial artist!

title: Our Little Empress
description:
The child of a prophecy is born to save the world.
"I need to get married to save people...? I'll do the marriage!"
The emperor is a young and innocent boy. But...
"I can't give you my daughter! She will not be becoming empress."
My father interfered with my marriage!
"Is my sister just a toy to you?"
And my brother too!
Will I be able to save the world?

---
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://kakaopage.co.id/content/Baby-Empress/3516)
- [Official Japanese Translation](https://piccoma.com/web/product/76902)

title: Hi, My Lady
description:
The lady of the Walters house, Cecilia Walters, loses her engagement ring, the cornerstone of her profitable relationship with Hans G. Manz.  
Maid Mia Bridget is blackmailed by Cecilia into helping her find the ring, all whilst keeping knowledge of the loss under wraps to prevent raising a fuss. To do so, they work to enact Cecelia's "second secret plan" before Viscount Manz comes to visit the following week.  
  
Note: no official summary.

title: Heavenly Roommates
description:
'Myoryeong' is a fairy who dreams of the Jade Emperor, the ruler of Heaven and Earth. As the humans began to construct apartments, the Spirit of the Mountains, 'Hanho', had suddenly found himself jobless. And to top it off is 'Minwoo,' a lively neighbor as well as a flirt, and 'Nara' an otaku with no social skills. Here comes a fantasy sitcom drama that's about to unfold between these four members!

---

**Links:**
[Alternative English Translation (Tappytoon)](https://www.tappytoon.com/en/book/heavenly-roommates)

title: Trapped in a Crazy World as an Extra
description:
The Chronicles of the Seven-Colored World  a series that ran for over 800 episodes and earned its fair share of curses from readers. A batshit crazy world full of absurd plot twists, endlessly evolving monsters, and heroines who try to kill the protagonist at every turn.

"And I got reincarnated into this mess?"

I’ve ended up as a nobody named Rudian — a total background character.

But with a freaky eyeball monster I happened to pick up, Adi, and a demonic sword called Diablo by my side, I’ve decided to take over this insane world.

Time to dive into some true chaotic gameplay!

title: Gods of All People: I Sacrificed Hundreds of Millions of Living Beings To Become a God
alt_titles: Spirit Sacrifice: The Path to Godhood
Everyone Is a King: I Sacrifice Countless Lives to Become a King
description:
Han Wu transmigrated to a world where everyone can become a god. He obtained the ability to sacrifice life.
At the beginning, he had a trash clan, so he sacrificed to change his fate against the heavens.
With no power, no status, and no money, he sacrificed his way to the top.
As long as he has enough followers, he can become infinitely stronger through sacrifice, becoming the main god, the god of gods!

title: Keep Holding On
description: 8 years is a long time to have a crush. Doubly so if that crush is your own best friend. Han-gyeol is tired of his own heartsickness for his childhood friend Sooho, and he thinks that maybe it's about time for him to let go of these feelings. He's contemplating moving on, but there's something inside of him that can't help but cling to this crush. Will there be a reward waiting for Han-gyeol if he keeps holding on, or will it only end in heartbreak?

title: For a Fairytale Ending
alt_titles: Male Lead, I'll Respect Your Taste
Male Lead, I'll Respect Your Preference
I Respect the Male Lead's Taste
description:
Possessed as the daughter of male lead´s stepmother in an impoverished BL novel. To the time when the young male lead was neglected in abuse.

If the lead succeeds in escaping like the original, *he* will come to kill me, but what should I do? In order to live, I took care of the male lead and treated him, and he shyly said.

“I feel like there is someone I like.”

His cheeks turned rosy like peaches. But *he* couldn't easily say who *he* liked. Of course, how can you say that easily!

"Its okay! No matter who you like, your taste matters!”

So, my child, do whatever you want! I will respect your taste!

===

“…Edwin?”

Now, he shed tears as he grabbed me as I was about to leave. Then he threatens me with eyes that shimmer with obsession.

“If you want to leave me, kill me and leave, Alice.”

…How are you supposed to kill the strongest person in the world? He suddenly turned black and won't let me go.
___
Young Alice Estevan has a secret. She was actually reborn in *The Tyrant's Silver Flower*, a hardcore, tragic BL where she'll be killed for abusing the male leads! Luckily, she still has time to avoid that fate by liberating Edwin, one of the male leads, from the tower he's trapped in. And though she succeeds in getting the key to free the boy, there's just one problem: he hates her guts! With the threat of death looming ever so closer, will Alice win Edwin over and earn her happy ending?

title: Devil’s Advent
description: In this world, there is a legend that has existed for many years: One day, the demon king will appear in the world, and under his command, seven terrifying demons will unleash darkness and despair upon the world.

title: Bloody Sweet
description: When the daughter of a shaman gets "strung up" with a centuries-old vampire, is it love or something more sinister that binds them? From Narae Lee, artist of the hit OEL manga ’Maximum Ride,’ comes the story of two misfits and their quirky, fantastical romp to find one another.

title: The Tyrant's Tranquilizer
description:
Amelie Bourbon was a witch and a woman killed by the tyrant.

Just because I criticized a novel doesn't mean you have to make me into the supporting character Amelie, who died from the start, becoming the trauma and trigger of the heroine.

I'm scared. I don't want to die. I don't want to be harassed.

Let's run away!

But just when Amelie visited her family to inform them of her departure, the Emperor (the tyrant) arrived. In order to escape, I transformed into a bird by magic.

But the Emperor took me with him!!!

What's going to happen to me?!

---
Amelie Bourbon is a witch, destined to die at the hands of her lover, the ruthless tyrant Serwin Hennessia. So when ordinary office worker Lee Suyeon is reborn as Amelie, she vows to change the ill-fated story. The problem is the “calamity” sealed inside Serwin’s body, which threatens to ruin him and the entire world, can only be calmed when he is near Amelie. As she grows closer to Serwin, Amelie must hone her magic to subdue his violent impulses, but can she defeat calamity once and for all?

---

title: I've Got a Million Skill Points!
description:
Who said that if you are selected by the system, you will have to work hard for the system? For Su Chen, it is impossible to work part-time, and it is impossible to work for the system in this lifetime.   
  
Tasks issued by the system? No answer!   
Dare the system threaten? Beat him!   
The system knelt down and pleaded: "Host father, please have mercy on me, take a task."   
  
Su Chen impatiently said: "You wait until I spend a million skill points!"

title: Royal Agent
description: Chen Huan was once the first agent of China. In order to find out a 13-year car accident, he gave up the invitation of the organization and resolutely returned to Nanhai City to investigate clearly.

title: Surviving As a Fish
description: On the verge of death from the betrayal of his trusted colleague, 'Lee Yoo Shin' sees a ray of light moments before dying. "Do you want to start a new life again?" When he came to his senses, there was a vast reservoir in front of him and his body had turned into a fish. Will he be able to overcome all the hardships and return to his family's arms?

title: Domestication of Divine Beasts at the Beginning
alt_titles: Invasion of the Myriad Races: Starting by Taming a Legendary Beast
Monster Invasion: Guardian of the Rear Битва тысячи рас: Я укрощу всех чудови
description: All races have invaded Earth. Su Bai’s pet turtle evolved into the Black Tortoise , and his cat into the White Tiger . The Vermilion Bird and Azure Dragon , ancient sacred beasts, soon followed. However, these divine beasts have enormous appetites, which led Su Bai to become a notorious businessman that gives everyone headaches.“Brother, this is Black Tortoise blood, only selling for a mere ten billion. Hey, why are you cursing at me just because you’re not buying?”“The champion of the Hundred Schools competition wins ten billion? Help me up, I can still fight!”“The main city of all races has countless riches? As a human, I must protect my Dragon Country. I will lead the charge!

title: I Raised My Husband Wrong
description:
The Bloody, Murderous Ghoul, the Mad Dog of the Battlefield…
The countless nicknames of Libertisha, who was driven into war from a young age.

After the war ended, she received an offer to marry a duke, and her partner was...

"Who the hell are you? Get lost."

Little did she know it would be a child!

They were eventually wed after many trials and tribulations. However, during a mission she became trapped in an unknown space. Once she finally made it out, ten years had passed outside.

But now...

"Stay with me, Leti."

Where did my little kitten-like husband go? Now my all-grown-up husband is obsessed with me?!

title: Catherine's Key to a Happy Life
alt_titles: Rejected Lady Enjoying a Modest Life
The Abandoned Bachelorette Enjoys Her Simple Life
A Delightful Simple Life of a Single, After Leaving Home
description:
Catherine did not want much.

Even if she did not have luxurious clothes and shoes, she was alright with her hideously frayed bedroom curtains and her shoes that were so worn at the soles it was different in height.

It had been two years since she started enduring it for the sake of her late mother.

She no longer felt the need to do that.

"Alright, I'll leave."

Catherine was tired of everything.

***

"Are you the Pope's watchdog? You've done well coming all the way here."

The man who intruded her home was drenched from head to toe.
She could see mud squished beneath his black leather boots.

Unbelievable.
To think he would drag in not grass, but mud, while she was cleaning the floors!

"You've got quite the disguise. Even I was almost fooled into thinking that you're just an ordinary city woman---"
"Wipe it."

She pushed the rag she held onto the man.

"Why are you looking at me so foolishly? I told you to wipe the floor. And it's not proper to show your sword when it's our first time meeting each other. Is it not enough that you intruded that you would want to be reported for attempted murder?"

title: Long as We Have Loved
alt_titles: As Long As We Loved Each Other
description:
A one-shot about a girl accepting her identity amidst constant homophobia. 

[Author Weibo](https://www.weibo.com/u/2673967277?is_all=1)

title: Pharaoh's Concubine
alt_titles: The Song of Sand and Seas
Sand and Song of the Seas
description: She is a girl that everyone loves but she cannot speak of the love she has for her brother because her brother already loves someone else. In despair, she gets dragged into Ancient Egypt by a snake shaped bracelet that is engraved with a three thousand year old love oath. There, she meets the Pharoah's heir, a party boy….

title: Straight "Princess" in the Royal Palace
alt_titles: The Male Consort in a Game
description: "I'm straight, so why would I be entangled in this mess with three male suitors?!" Because of an obnoxious ad for a game, the main character, Lu Xing, accidentally enters the world of an otome game. In order to return, he must gain the affection of three male characters?! The aloof lord, the mysterious assassin, the gentle royal guard – who will be his final pick? The survival of a straight man begins now…

title: Can't Fall in Love!
description: Jeong-hyun often acts before thinking, leaving her unemployed after fighting with the store manager for her part-time job. However, she signs up as a talent manager when introduced by her older brother. There, she falls in love with an actress, Hee-ra! “It was like…love at first sight!” but it turns out that Hee-ra acts quite differently from her expectations. Though she shouldn’t be swept away in the moment, looking at Hee-ra’s face makes her go through all sorts of emotions. Will Jeong-hyun finally be able to control her outbursts?

title: I Need Someone to Stop My Older Brothers
alt_titles: Nuga Uri Oppadeul Jom Mallyeo Juseyo
description:
I only went to calm the disturbance in front of my house, but the one I encountered was the Demon King that I punished, and unfortunately, I was falsely accused of being the demon king and died in the hand of the subjugation team.

‘I’ll kick your ass, Pamel Asinov! I’ll make you shed tears from both of your eyes!’

Among them, the worst one was the hero, Pamel Asinov, who drove me to death as a Demon King!

But when I pleaded to take revenge, I opened my eyes, 500 years later! Pamel’s been dead for a long time, and the ‘brothers’ who came one day…

“Purple eyes. It’s not a color that anyone can have.”
“But I was like this from the beginning.”
“Yes, you were. Because you are the granddaughter of Archduke Asinov.”
“…the granddaughter of Archduke Asinov?”

Of all people, I’m the daughter of ‘that’ Asinov? It’s nice to live a peaceful life, but I was born an enemy’s blood!

‘All the brothers in this house have a habit of hugging people.’

This shitty family. I have to hate them, but why do I keep getting attached to them?

title: Absolute Control
description: The former general of the nation who is now a wanted man accidentally falls into a trap set by a hunter long ago. Wait! Isn't the hunter the little angel who always stayed with him before? The angel has turned into a cruel man and uses his means to convert the former strongest Alpha to an Omega with a sweet pheromone a day after they meet again. Xia Yusheng: "Qi Wangzhi, I swear I will kill you!"

title: The Baby Fairy Is a Villain
alt_titles: The Baby Fairy Is a Villainess
description: The daughter of a mad fairy, known for her cruel nature, transforms into a baby to infiltrate a noble family and uncover those who experimented on her mother. However, the eccentric men of the family grow overly attached to her, complicating her plans. As she struggles to escape, she discovers she can’t return to her adult form, and her enemies close in.

title: Evangeline After the Ending
description:
I thought he died from overwork in Korea, but when I opened my eyes, I found that I was a supporting character in a novel I wrote. As Evangeline who was executed for harassing the female lead.

While running and running alone to avoid the ending of the original, she said, “I copied the author’s novel when I was creating the world. Instead, if there is anything you want, I will give it to you.”

---
After the last episode "Servant Yesterday, Crown Princess Today," the author thought she was done with the story. But when she awakens as the villainess, Evangeline, she realizes the ending was just the beginning! To avoid the gruesome end she originally wrote for Evangeline, she resolves to win the male lead's favor and be accepted into his household. But as the plot begins to take strange turns that make Evangeline the new heroine, it becomes clear this story was written by someone else...

title: The Shameless Thief of Argus
alt_titles: I'm Going to Steal Again Today
description:
Life is all about taking the easy way for Seokwoo, who feels zero guilt over robbing thousands of players as Luke in the VR game, Argus. 

Just when he's leveled up to a master criminal, however, he gets caught and is sentenced to life in prison! Luckily, Luke discovers the will of the vanquished Night King in his cell, which lets him start the game over in exchange for getting revenge on the king's enemies. 

Though his level and stats have been reset, it's only a matter of time before Argus' infamous thief steals his way back to the top!

title: Picking up a School Beauty to Be My Wife
description: One of the China's first secret soldier, Luo Feng returns to the city, becoming the most successful student in Zijing middle school! there are so many school beauties, which one of them can get into his eyes?

title: I Got Married to a Goblin
alt_titles: I Got Married With a Goblin
description: Eunsoo is a famous patissier who runs a dessert cafe along a busy street. One day, he decides to go back to his family’s vacation house due to being stressed by strange dreams which hinders him from creating a new menu for his cafe. But his life is about to be turned upside down, since that place is where he promised to marry a goblin when he was still a child!

title: Skyfire Avenue
description:
Skyfire Avenue is a street that is 2048 meters long. There are 168 stores here, and each of the store owners is an extremely powerful adept.   
  
The Avenue does not permit any vehicles or any robots to pass through it, much less mecha. Even the patrolling police must move about on foot.   
  
This is because this is a street for pedestrians, a lane for nobles, hidden away within this high technology world. Lan Jue, the greatest of the mercenaries, code-named ‘Zeus’, has secluded himself here in Skyfire Avenue after the death of his wife.   
  
The name of his shop is “Zeus’ Jewelry Store”, and here in Skyfire Avenue, he has been given the title, Jewel Master.

title: Reborn as the Enemy Prince
alt_titles: How to Live as the Enemy Prince
How to live as a prince of an enemy kingdom
description:
Imagine being kin to your sworn enemy.

Killed in battle while defending his country, Bern wakes up in the body of the enemy prince, Kalian, and vows to avenge his people. But between taming an abusive half-brother and surviving his mother's deadly web of intrigue, sweet revenge seems to slip further beyond his grasp at every turn.

---
I could hear the hum of life in my ears. It was hard to breathe… I raised my gaze and stared into the distance. However, my blurred vision could not see anything. The light began to fade. That was my last memory.

When I opened my eyes once again, it was ten years before that last memory took place. And of all the things I could have become, it was from the enemy country that drove Secretia to ruin – I had become Kyris' third prince, Calian.

…..

Bern was the proud Crown Prince of Secretia who fought and died in the war against Kyris. But he woke up ten years into the past – as the timid Third Prince of Kyris, Calian.

title: Glotoneria
description:
In 17th century Europe, in the depths of a forest, lived a monster boy named Isaac who would devour all who entered his forest. Yet, he saved a girl named Livana solely because her flame-like hair resembled his mother's. In the process of this, memories of his mother are stirred up.   
  
Meanwhile, Livana's family is continuously embroiled in a series of unfortunate events, and Livana herself is rejected by everyone due to her hair color. But Ethan has always adored her, and her brother seems to have unusual feelings for her. How will these people's feelings intertwine…?

title: Master of All Skills
alt_titles: Skill Collector: The Ultimate Skill Thief
description:
[Unique Trait **Skill Master (EX)** has been activated.] 

"Whoa… your skill’s insane!"

[Skill has been copied.]

With the power to copy any ability he witnesses, Yoo Ju-yeon embarks on a legendary journey to the top — outsmarting rivals, outshining heroes, and collecting every skill in existence!

title: Maid in a Dream
description: Ah-ju lives two lives, a university student and an exclusive maid for the emperor. When she sleeps in one world, she wakes up in another. One day, the emperor asks her, "Help me with my love!"

title: She Who Is the Most Special to Me
description: Ru YunYun's new roommate is the former rock star, Hao Yue, whom she is enamored by. But why does Yue want to be the roommate of YunYun? It doesn't look like Yue is interested in being just a roommate…

title: The Divine Ring Descends: The Strongest Otherworld
alt_titles: Divine Ring Descends: The Strongest in Another World
Become the Strongest Hero Through the Cheat System
The Divine Ring Descends: The Strongest Otherworld
description: When darkness invades the city, zillions of human warriors come into being, but Aiden isn't one of them. One day, he comes across a mysterious ring and is sent into the Orc Realm where humans are forbidden, by a treaty. He magically survives his execution, lifts the Orc Tribe's sacred hammer, and becomes the tribe leader. Just then, he is transported back to his original reality.

title: The Duke's Only Daughter (Promo)
description:
I reincarnated as the lowest-ranked support character in a game. Being born as the great duke's daughter wouldn't have been so bad, if… my fate hadn't been to be murdered by him on my 9th birthday! Seriously, what kind of destiny is that?!   
  
Fine then! If I can't avoid my fate, then I'll have to conquer it!  
"Time to become friend with the main character and knock out the Demon King!"  
Follow the heroine as she embarks on a great adventure to overcome her terrible fate and defeat the Demon King while she's at it!  
  
*This is a promotional webtoon for the novel of the same name.*

title: A Butterfly Metamorphoses Three Times
description:
By a turn of events, Jin Naye ended up kissing her co-worker’s boyfriend, not to mention she keeps hearing a maleficent voice which nobody else can hear…  
  
At home, she’s a pitiful daughter who didn’t even get married yet, and at work she’s a weak-willed pushover. Day by day, Naye is forced to live a life full of torment. In order to defy her mother’s wish to meet a marriage prospect on her own birthday, she attends a party and gets herself some drinks - actions which are unlike her. There, she ended up having her first kiss, but with her co-worker’s boyfriend?! From that day onward, Naye’s life started to change bit by bit…

title: Why I Quit Being The Demon King
alt_titles: Why I Quit Being the Demon King
description:
Demiurgos DCLXVI, or Deus, is the 666th resurrection of the Demon King, fated to battle a warrior of the Pure Blood clan every 100 years to liberate his fellow demons from hell. But instead of waiting, Deus escapes 20 years early to forge a new identity among the humans.

---

title: I Don't Want to Be Like This Too
alt_titles: I Don't Want to Do This
Trẫm cũng không muốn vậy đâu
description:
I was a cruel empress who had the world in my hands, forcing commoner men to become my concubines, finally got what I deserved. The people I once knew became my enemies, and somehow ended up in the "enemies" hands?  
  
French : ||Vous prenez votre histoire classique, un monarque dominateur, qui fait tout pour séduire sa servante…sauf que la c'est la reine qui est dominatrice et qui ne recule devant rien pour séduire son servant, qui lui ne cherche qu'à fuir.  
Une comédie déjantée qui renverse les codes dans la Chine impériale.||

title: Life, Once Again!
description:
"Would you like to live once again?" 

It was a peaceful and normal life an average person would live. Getting a job, meeting ‘the one’ and getting married, then living life with your own loving family. I was living that life. 

Then I got an offer to start life again.

 The excitement of starting life once again quickly faded away. Faced with the fading memories of my past life, growing fainter and fainter as each day passed by; the fear of not being able to meet my wife and daughter overwhelmed me. To make matters worse, the opportunity to become an actor, a dream that I had given up before, was tempting… 

"If I live this life differently from my previous one, there’s a chance that I might not be able to meet my wife and daughter!"

Stuck between family and the dream I had given up, what will be my choice?

---

[Official Novel](https://page.kakao.com/content/51569746)

title: I Became a Renowned Family's Sword Prodigy
description:
Baek Woojin is the youngest son of a renowned swordsman family who has neither talent in swordsmanship nor an impressive Aura.
Although he was dishonored by his own family and killed, he reincarnates as the owner of a Magic Sword.

His only goal is the destruction of his own family.

title: Boy-Friend's Rule
description: Jiun's first romance ends when her crush, Jae-i, confesses that he likes someone else. To make matters worse, Jae-i mistakenly believes that Jiun's crush is his scary-looking best friend, Seohyeon, and tries to help her win him over. Now, Jiun must deal with a bigger problem than her unrequited crush, the boy-friend she had never imagined getting close to.

title: Tang Yin in Another Realm II: The Rise of Feng Nation
alt_titles: Tang Yin Di  Dunia Yang Berbeda II
Tomin in The Alien World II
description:
The assassin Tang Yin, who had transmigrated to another world, relied on his decisive and determined heart to sit on the throne as the king of Feng Nation, but two days after he became king, he was met with an assassination attempt. The mysterious Ling Wu Academy, the superpower nation Zhen Nation, and the Hao Tian Empire appeared one after another. In the midst of many crisis and obstacles, how did Tang Yin let the Feng Nation, and dominate the world!  
  
  
- [Official Indonesia (Mangatoon)](https://mangatoon.mobi/id/detail/420554)

title: Vanguard
description:
From the live action series with the same name, Vanguard, has been renewed. It features a girl named Lei Xiaoyu that has caught the attention of a mysterious assassination organization! The tsundere Wu Yue of the Vanguard was assigned to be Xiaoyu’s protector. A love story full of youth, campus life, and action?! As the plot was revealed layer upon layer, the brutal truth gradually appeared…  
  
**Information**  
Marked as "completed" on the website itself.

title: The Great Conqueror
description:
A passionate otaku for a fighting game passed through into the world governed by the beast tribes, filled with hope.  
  
The peak of martial ability?  
Extreme beauties?  
This brother was miserable! Such an event would force even civilised people to turn crazy!  
  
The pious scoundrel Zou began his unrestrained and destructive journey through the Among De Beast God Continent.  
  
Rules? There are no rules!  
Principles? His actions define the principles!  
Occupations? Occupations are as unimportant as fleeting clouds; this brother sought omnipotence!  
  
A different world but the same passions. A story of an unimportant person becoming the great conqueror—step by step—as a human would: filled with touching emotions, explosive anger, and hot-bloodedness forever!

title: Sword and Magic: The Walking Hero
description: The battle between the Devil's god and the Dragonian warrior ends with a warrior's victory, and 10,000 years later, a new warrior opens his eyes to save the world.

title: CHR-47
description:
When he woke up, the world completely changed. The end of the world arrived.  
The rich, famous and high ranks in the previous world lost their status. In this violent world, a canned food can be exchanged for a former world-renowned female celebrity.

title: How to Kill a God
description: The Age of Faith, The Last Myth

title: The Cook's Hidden Blessing
description: Rookie hospital cook Jungdong always wished he could do more for the patients who ate his food. But he never imagined the Roman goddess Ceres would answer his prayers, or that she'd name him her priest on earth! Now, Jungdong's noble new mission is to bless people with his cooking and gather enough good karma to restore Ceres's powers. As he works miracles with his dishes, he's more inspired than ever in his journey to become a world-reknowned chef. What's troubling, though, is that the goddess won't tell him why she needs all the power she can get. Meanwhile, a mysterious enemy inches ever closer to the duo... will Jungdong's cooking and Ceres' divine powers be enough to brave the storm that lies ahead? Based on the hit novel.

title: Looking for My One-Night Villainess
alt_titles: Looking for The Villainess Who Took My First Night
Looking for the Villainess Whom I Spent My First Time With
description:
Since becoming the villainess 'Liberata' in the novel 'Leoni's Turbulent Life,' I have faced execution on the gallows twenty times!
Tired of the repetitive regression, I just got drunk with a mind of "Whatever happens, happens."
But why is the Grand Duke lying next to me?

"Don't worry, I won't let you die."
But...
"If you don't put everything back in its place in your 20th life, this world will be destroyed."
The fortune-teller leaves an ominous prophecy that can't be understood.

title: Their Phantom
description: A shady undercover police officer x an innocent university student. In an accident, university student Song Xiao An is kidnapped and brought deep into the mountains, ripping her away from her peaceful and happy life. There, an undercover police officer named Zhou Si Han secretly takes care of her, and Xiao An thinks she can escape through her. However, she discovers that the policewoman is hiding a dark secret...

title: Your Majesty Is So Handsome (Promo)
description:
I woke up in this new world as Diana Gundal, the youngest daughter of a feudal lord. But hey, that’s great news! That means I can live my life pampered from head to toe right?  
  
Wrong! Everyday I’m living like a maid to help out with the household. What’s even worse is that I neither inherited the old Diana’s memories nor her knowledge of the language. I’m basically starting from scratch… I thought I would live the rest of my life like this until the Emperor came to visit our small village.  
  
BOOM! Oh lord, he is so handsome! I’m now so thankful I’m living under the same sky as him. I will work hard to get closer to him as his new number one fan!  
  


---

title: The Druid Genius Is Too Strong
Return of the Calamity-Class Death Knight
description:
Damien Haksen was once a gifted warrior with a bright future, but everything changed when a powerful Archlich twisted him into a Death Knight. Controlled by dark magic, he murdered his own family and helped destroy a kingdom. He broke free at the very end — too late to undo the damage. 

But fate gave him one more chance.

Now back in the past, Damien is determined to protect the people he once lost and destroy the dark mages who turned his life into a nightmare. This time, he’ll fight not for glory, but for love, redemption, and the future of his family.

title: Anti-Gods Dragon System
description: Tian Ling, a persecuted young man from his clan classmate, decided to get rid of him in a tragic way that led to death. At the moment of death his blood awakened the remains of a dragon millions of years ago known as the dragon system, he revived it in order to achieve their revenge in destroying the gods and become the supreme master … in a training journey to seek to destroy the heavens!

title: The Immoral Duke Needs to Be Homeschooled
alt_titles: Immoral Duke's Family Needs to Be Homeschooled
The Duke's Notorious Household Needs Proper Education
description:
You three kids, I’ll teach you.

Recently, there have been several changes in my life.

The first is that I became the governess of Lord Bertha’s siblings, and the second is that I remembered my past life. 

Why did I recall my past life now? Could this be inside the novel I read in my past life? 

If I remember correctly, I, “Estella,” the governess, will soon die. All to protect the half-siblings from that immoral man, “Diego”! 

“You seem like a more capable person than I thought.” 
“You’d better look for a job at another estate because you’ll go crazy if you stay here.” 

But “Diego,” the man who I thought was a heartless psychopath, turns out to be surprisingly kind…? 

Alright, I’m going to organize a dramatic reconciliation between Diego and his half-siblings!! How could you possibly kill these adorable kids when they’re hugging you?!

title: I Encountered A False Spiritual Revival
description: Everyone in the world is mentally ill, except me! (Confirmed!)

title: Villain to the Rescue
alt_titles: I Am Going to Be a Bastard
I Want to Be a Scoundrel
I'm Going to Be a Great Villain
I Want to Be a Big Baddie
description:
A proper villain must be ruthless and evil, a bringer of death! Having tormented the protagonist to his heart's content, he makes a brilliant exit. Once he's finished his work, he goes out with a bang.
Wang Yi was determined to be that kind of villain. Unfortunately… His male lead can read minds. (:з)∠*)
“You mongrel!” Mr. Wang chuckled as he looked down on the novel’s male lead.
Suddenly, a thought bubble filled with cute emojis (⁄ ⁄ ⁄ω⁄ ⁄ ⁄) and the words “You’re so cute…” appeared in front of Qin.
Qin: ?

title: I Was Raised by the Boss
alt_titles: I Was Beaten up by the Boss
description: The MC accidentally entered a hidden boss lair when he was younger, and in the midst of corpses, he was found by the hidden boss and got adopted by him. The boss sees the MC as a toy at first, but as time goes by, looking at the interaction between the cruel boss and the young boy…they somehow seemed like a family?

title: Martial Arts Alone
description: A place where you casually use blood or ma in your name, I lived in Murim for 7 years. I was miserable, and I did a lot of dirty things. But I had to do anything to survive. That's 'Nangin' Finally, I crossed the line and experienced death in a desire to become stronger. But when I opened my eyes, it was modern. The world has changed and we are connected to the fantasy world of Pangea?! And as a returner with the only class? Let's scratch the lottery tickets!

title: God-Level Fisherman
description: Who says that breeding cannot make a fortune? Fish farming, shrimp farming, salvaging a sunken ship, and the bubble star supermodel. This is the story of fisherman Xiao Peng who became the richest man in the world with a small fish farm.

title: New life: Savior From Another World
description: It was a peaceful life for humanity. Protected by the order of valiant knights they could be sure the randomly appearing gates to other worlds will be closed, and if any monsters slip through, they will be immediately caught. But on that day everything went wrong. The portal gates wouldn’t seal up. The guest from another world wouldn’t obey. The young knight was suspected to be self-proclaimed, which led to his imprisonment in a monster detention prison. His seemingly imminent death led to a new beginning. That day is carved into humanity history as future-changing. The day when the portal gates were forced open.

title: The Hidden Saintess
description:
Many years ago, there lived a knight who loved a saint. However, wanting to not hurt the saint who wasn't allowed to have personal feelings, he made sure to keep a safe distance from her. Eventually, the saint died in his arms and the devastated knight swore, with bitter anguish, 'If you get a chance at another life, I'll make sure that you will no longer live as a saint.' After long 300 years, the saint was reborn. Will their wishes finally come true in this life?
