title: Lucifer-ui Gyeonghowon
description: The contest over who gets to claim Lucifer's powers, between the bodyguard who gained them, and Lucifer who lost them.

title: Shaman After School
description:
“Without human faith, we cannot exist.”  
  
Shin Seonnyeo was born with shaman power, but she refused to be a shaman.  
One day, two deities came and asked her to become a shaman.  
The deities offer to grant her a wish if they can regain their old power.  
Can Seonnyeo spend a peaceful life after school?

title: I Raided the Demon God's Treasure Trove
description:
The peace of the world collapses after a war between the gods and demons, leading to the downfall of humanity — except for one person. 

Sewoon, the sole survivor, is determined to rewrite the ending of this tragic tale. While searching for Kronos' hourglass to reverse time, he discovers the treasure trove of the Demon of Greed, filled with items that can aid him in achieving his goal. 

With these demonic treasures at his disposal, can Sewoon stop the war and secure lasting peace in the world?

title: The Tiger who Swallowed the Moon
alt_titles: A Tiger that Swallowed the Moon
description: Kwak Taebum, national shooting team’s Olympic gold medalist who’s living a relatively smooth sailing life suddenly got involved in a hit-and-run accident. The person whom he calls "Daddy-Long-Legs" unexpectedly reappears in this life and death situation after he vanished during Taebum’s childhood. But the true identity of the so-called daddy-long-legs… is a vampire?!

title: Absurdity
description:
Really, I just wanted to take a peek around the human world, and maybe also ‘find my soulmate’ along the way. So why are things so difficult QAQ…

*(The main couple consists of two very cute girls.)*

title: Esteemed Female Masters All Want to Possess Me
description: Xiao Nan died tragically and then isekai-ed to the 21st Continent. Although reborn as useless trash, he awakened the reverse system, and his strength would increase as long as he was hurt. What he didn’t know was that he had a hidden identity-as the chosen son of heaven who was prophesized to revitalize the Sword sect. The elders of all factions in the sect therefore hid their identities and approached Xiao Nan to try to recruit him into their own ranks. Since then, Xiao Nan began to enjoy being nurtured by beautiful female masters, whilst discovering features of the system to become stronger + start a harem

title: Global Killing: Awakening SSS-Level Talent at the Beginning!
alt_titles: Quanqiu Shalu: Kaiju Juexing SSS Ji Tianfu!
Global Mayhem: Awakening SSS-Class Talent at the Start!
Quánqiú Shālù: Kāijú Juéxǐng SSS Jí Tiānfù!
description: Violent start, SSS level talent awakening! Tens of billions of people from all over the world, at the same time, descended on the heavens to kill the world. Hundreds of countries such as the Lighthouse Kingdom, the Dragon Kingdom, and the Sakurajima Kingdom are competing! Di Si Qin Feng woke up the SSS level talent at the beginning - Endless Extraction! He can extract everything! Including extracting demons! Turn on Infinite Kill Mode!

title: Kim Star Observation Diary
description:
Ten years as a manager. My level is chief, but suddenly, I was picked up by Korea’s top star Kim Dan and work like a new recruit?! The man famous for his bad personality, and now he is trying to tame me? You’re just making me do a lot of weird jobs that even doesn’t make sense! Why don’t you just wait and see? I’m not that easy! A contractual relationship between a top star and a manager, it’s starting now!

title: Wo Zhen Mei Xiang Chongsheng A
alt_titles: Wǒ Zhēn Méi Xiǎng Chóngshēng A
I Really Don’t Want to Be Reborn
I Really Don't Want to Remake
description:
Little had I known, I Chen Hansheng; the former elite of society and a Diamond Bachelor, was reborn. When I woke up, I was a senior graduate in high school? 
Later, Chen Hansheng was walking near the crosswalk, he seemed hesitant. A precious girl; Shen Youchu and two other girls; Bai Yueguang and Xiao Rongyu, who will he pick? All of them? One of them? Two of them? Read to find out. 

Side Note:  Diamond Bachelor is a slang word that means someone who’s insanely rich and single.

title: The Magic Soup
description:
Romeade, a wannabe knight, sets off to the Ice Castle so as to fulfill his mother’s will. It is rumored that a certain Sorcerer of Ice, beautiful yet cruel, resides in the castle. He is taken(kidnapped?!) to Larmanilla’s Ice Castle by a bear with fur as white as snow… but the cruel sorcerer demands that the boy makes soup. Roped into cooking for the sorcerer, Romeade ends up signing a contract to become the slave— ahem, the cook of the castle! Set in a beautiful and fantastical world of ice, the story of a cold-blooded Sorcerer of Ice and a warm-hearted Cook is about to begin.

title: Tale of Felluah
description:
Orthez Acryl is the Duke of Tesa's eldest daughter. She is a beautiful young lady who managed to capture the heart of the kingdom's crown prince. However, rather than become the crown princess she requested marriage to an Earl of a faraway land called Fellua…  
  
Two people who never met each other agreed to marry the other… what motivates this two behind their decision…?

title: The Star Next Door (Pre-Serialization)
description: Lim Soojung, a devoted fan, is devastated when her beloved male idol is linked to a dating scandal. To her surprise, the rumored girlfriend, Kim Sara, shows up in her life! Their hilarious encounter begins.

title: Who Are You!
description: Behavior and manners that always seem to change. Who are you?

title: My Farm by the Palace
alt_titles: Marronnier Farm Next to the Imperial Palace
Marronnier Farm Near by the Imperial Palace
description: When Hazel Mayfield is sent to live with the Martins as a child, she falls in love with rural life and vows to have a farm of her own one day. Eleven years later, she receives an unexpected windfall as her grandfather hands her the deed to a plot of land in the middle of the capital. Ecstatic, Hazel sets out to realize her longtime dream of becoming a farmer. There’s only one problem: Her new farm is right next to the imperial palace! And it seems the emperor himself has his eye on her land…

title: After Listening to What Inside My Mind the Female Leads Want to Flung Into My Harem
alt_titles: Fanpai: Bei Tou Ting Xinsheng Hou, Nv Zhu Xiang Dang Wo Hougong!?
The Villain: After Eavesdropping on My Thoughts, the Heroine Wants to Be in My Harem!?
description:
Traveling to the world of novels, Tang Yu gets the villain role system. As long as the mission is successfully completed, he can get rich rewards and return to the real world.

In this regard, Tang Yu can only accept it.
But in the face of the extremely mindless heroine and plot setting, he couldn't help but complain, but he didn't expect the heroines to hear his heart.

Bai Yixue gritted her teeth: "This bastard, he actually said that I am a cold ice mountain that no one wants, hehe, I must freeze him to death today!"

Lin Qingying squeezed her fists: "This damn bastard actually said that I'm big-booded, brainless, and violent? So I won't be gentle!!"

"....."

Seeing the heroine whose personality gradually collapsed, Li Qingze became numb.

"Hey! I'm the villain, it's fine if you don't follow the plot, and what do you mean with throwing yourself at me!"

title: Shen Ze
description: From an early age, Xu Shenze would often get caught up in the same strange dream. Over time, the dark shadow that the dream cast over his life grew, until, one day, the shadow became real, and suddenly Xu Shenze's life as he knew it was completely torn to shreds. His parents suddenly meet a gruesome end, and all sorts of other strange and disturbing events kept on happening to him. Alone and afraid, when he hears about a supposed "dream town", he decides to go there to look for answers. In the town that is called both the "Holy Land" and "Purgatory" by its residents, what sort of terrible truths are waiting for Xu Shenze?

title: The Strongest Warlord Goes to School
description:
Seok Hyun-woo is frequently bullied by the troublemakers at his school, who love to take advantage of Hyun-woo’s poor circumstances. Hyun-woo toughs it out though and continues to endure this frustrating situation. This all changes though, when on one (un)fortunate night, Hyun-woo is beaten and embarrassed by the bullies, with his spirit being pulled from his body shortly afterward. Coinciding with this odd occurrence, a bizarre abnormality takes place somewhere else in the vast universe… Due to that bizarre abnormality, the spirit of Hyun Woo-seok, a powerful warlord from an alien planet, is forced into Hyun-woo's body. Woo-seok, now a powerful warlord in a moody highschooler’s body, swiftly and easily overpowers the bullies… In his head, however, the bewildered Woo-seok has just one question: Where the hell am I?! The bullies, unaware of what’s happened to Hyun-woo, begin planning their vengeance. They do this, even though they were the ones picking on him in the first place… Seriously? It’s time for this alien warlord to dish out some payback on these sneering pricks!  
  
- [Original Webtoon (kakao)](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=51744668)  
- [Original Webtoon (RidiBooks)](https://ridibooks.com/books/3092005875)  
- [Original Webtoon (Naver)](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=3641181)

title: Life of a Lily
description: An unexpected reunion of a proper girl and a delinquent girl. A love story was developed between the two.

title: Fighting Ward
description:
A high school student, Kang Sun-woo, single-handedly defeats a group of illegal loan sharks who came to his house. At the hospital, where he goes for treatment, he is invited by a mysterious man to participate in a suspicious fighting tournament with a huge cash prize.

The prize is crucial for the survival of his family. Sun-woo must survive the fight ward !

title: Wan Mu
description: A girl who was adopted by two mothers met her soulmate- another girl, when she was 16 years old. After dating for ten years, the 'soulmate' decided to marry a man at the age of 28 because she did not want to live an "abnormal life". Only after leaving her to marry a man, did she finally understand the true meaning of love during those countless days and nights. However, can they still go back to the way things were?

title: Rotten
description:
Jaeshin sees dead people, and Officer Han can sniff out evil. Literally. Their search for a missing friend leads them and professional stuntwoman Yuhyeon into a tangled web of vile cover-ups and twisted violence. Can they handle the overpowering stench of evil?

---

- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/SUSPENSE/echou/list?title_no=1701)

- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/thriller/stench/list?title_no=1744)

- [Official Spanish <Es> Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/es/horror/rotten/list?title_no=2769)

- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/horror/the-smell-of-evil/list?title_no=2110)

title: Hold My Master
description: Being reborn after a cruel death, Bai Ye seeks revenge, and incidentally becomes the master of the Nuwa stone. Bai Ye does everything he can to receive the trust of his apprentice…

title: Love or Hate
description:
Haesu and Juwon met through their parents when they got remarried and have been in an illicit relationship ever since. The repeated break ups and meetings have numbed them, the process of arguing and sleeping together remaining a constant. All this changes when Taekyung gets involved.  
  
  
Haesoo et Joowon, dont le remariage de leurs parents signifiait qu'ils ne devaient jamais être dans une relation amoureuse.   
À travers des séparations et des rencontres répétées, des bagarres et leur relation insensée et insensée au lit, des bouleversements  
 ont commencé à se produire lorsque Taekyung apparais entre eux deux.  
. (Fujoshixgirl's love Fansub ) Traduis disponible sur notre blog !

title: Ni Yu: God Is a Girl
description: Since ancient times whoever inherits the divine power would inherit the world. But who would have thought that one day the Divinity Clan would be wiped out and the divine powers passed on to a girl? Thus, a female emperor ascended the throne to rule and protect the world. Surrounded by people who always spoke flattering words, yet harbored ill intent, and constantly faced with the skepticism the people who were supposed to be close to her - how can a woman stand such hardship? How will this female Emperor deal with this unjust and patriarchal society?

title: Adeline's Darkest Night
description:
Adeline was murdered by the man she loved but returned back to the day of her wedding with him. Now begins her twilight, so her death shall not be repeated.

---
Murdered by the man she loved.

Adeline Rotyn gave everything to her husband, Duke Venzak. That is, until he kills her one dark and stormy night. Instead of dying, she finds herself transported years into the past. Determined to make the most of her second chance at life, she vows to become stronger and escape her horrid fate.

---
**Original Novel:** [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54859115), [RidiBooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/2378028270)

**Original Webtoon:** [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%95%84%EB%8D%B8%EB%A6%B0%EC%9D%98-%EA%B9%8A%EC%9D%80-%EB%B0%A4/3223), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60476901)

title: Mu You Zhi
description: Right after she awakens, a former wage slave becomes the villainess side character with a suspicious black reputation, a rebellious and neglectful younger brother, and a cruel and ruthless male lead! Hey! Even if the one you love is the beautiful heroine, you don't have to treat me like a tool?! Good thing I still have a handsome master who always consoles me from time to time… Back to the topic~ Observe how the wage slave protagonist crosses into another world and survives through the hurdles.

title: The Countdown of My Death Is Spamming My Status Window
alt_titles: Deadlines Are Raining in the Status Window
Time Is Running out on the Status Window
description:
*The Repentance Before Death* is a webnovel widely hated for its awful quality. This never kept Yul-jeong Kwon from loving the series... until the author decided to kill off her favorite character. Ready to fight for her fave, Yul-jeong borrowed a backhoe to wreck the writer’s house. Unfortunately, she met with an accident and, when she opened her eyes, found herself in the world of her favorite webnovel as Mitchelle Nephthys, one of its most notorious villains.

---
A masterpiece of over 3,000 volumes, I was incarnated into *Dawn of Repentance*. Moreover, as the successor to the duke’s family, facing a grim fate, I became my cherished character, “Mitchell Nephtis.” But upon opening the status window, the countdown to death was D-3. With the thought that I couldn’t die like this, I somehow managed to survive, and each time I changed the development, experience points were granted?! If that’s the case, I’ll change the original storyline drastically to reap the benefits. Leaving the deceased “Michell Nephtys” aside, I lived as the nanny’s daughter, “Evan Laeff,” doing as told, but missions kept pouring in on the status window, and failure meant death. Now that it’s like this, whether the storyline changes or not doesn’t matter. I will definitely survive and prevail!

title: Doomsday Sword God
description:
If mercy and kindness can’t save the world, then this time, I choose to kill—

Eternal Slayer! Heavenly Lightning Slash! Sword of Annihilation! As long as you learn the most common sword skills, they can be upgraded to SSS rank?! Divine talent + forbidden skills! I’m the last spark of hope in this apocalypse!

title: King of the Arena
description: First-year Gilsu Lee transfers schools to run from the bullying and violence. And the new place seems almost perfect. Everyone in his class is friendly and kind, and no one is bullying anybody. Violence? No, we don’t do anything like that in this school. That’s what the “Arena” is for. Don’t forget, Gilsu. What happens in the ring stays in the ring!

title: An Abyss
description:
"I… thought you were dead…"  
  
Kinard has lived for revenge after the incident that took place ten years ago.  
Despite his longtime friend Raman's worries for him, he and Yesing hid their identities under the alias, "chaff", and strived for revenge. In doing so, he runs into Alvin, who was certain that he was fated to die.  
While protecting Alvin under his name, Kinard notices how much Alvin had changed since childhood, and a new feeling other different than remorse begins to sprout, as Kinard's revenge filled heart slowly dissipates…

title: What Should I Do With My Brother?
description: The top master in Cultivation world is a damn single and has been single for thousands years. Not mention of girlfriend, not even a sister. That is the reason why he saves his enemy's sister. Step 1: Save her and bring her up Step 2: Teach her cultivation skills to protect herself and insist to tell her bedtime stories to creat himself a great image Step 3: Send her jewels that most women like to dress her up That is what a perfect brother should do. Sister, "What the hell does this pervert who pulls me up every night to tell me ghost-like stories want to do?"

title: The Ugly Wife of the Shady Duke
description: Reincarnated as the neglected wife of a duke who secretly loves the novel's heroine, she plans to divorce him to survive. Yet, he desperately begs her not to leave, confusing her as the story unfolds differently than she remembered.

title: Beloved Golden Light Gratia
alt_titles: Golden Light Gratia, The Child Loved By God
description:
Gratia, a girl considered useless and despised by her family, has a revealing dream where a mysterious man predicts a great future for her. She soon discovers that she is the lost daughter of the influential Luciffero family. In a surprising event, after being attacked, a golden light erupts from Gratia, forcing everyone around her to close their eyes.

When the light dissipates, young Gratia disappears and in her place an adult version of herself appears, with distinct features of Luciffero. With an imposing stature and undeniable beauty, she comes across Nea, her mother, and realizes that the transformation expected for the future happened that day.

This was the moment when ten-year-old Gratia and twenty-year-old Gratia switched bodies for the first time.

title: The Fake Lady of House Silkisia
alt_titles: Fakes Don't Want to Be Real
description:
Psyche Silkisia lived her whole life as a fill-in for the missing daughter of House Silkisia. Despite her attempts to be accepted by the family, they accuse her of murder and force Psyche to commit suicide. Devastated by this, Psyche swallows the poison she's given and miraculously finds herself in the past. Determined to live for her own sake this time, Psyche hurries to escape. But when her family suddenly refuses to let her go, she realizes that perhaps she isn't the only one who's changed...

---
I lived my whole life as a substitute for the lost princess. But the moment the real princess came back, “Let’s be thankful that it ends like this.”

I was sorrowfully abandoned. …No, the ending would have been the same even if the real princess had not returned.

“I think my usefulness is up to here, so I’ll leave now.”

“If you come back, I’ll acknowledge you as a real daughter.”

“I don’t need it.”

I wouldn’t be loved by anyone, but it didn’t matter. I decided to live my own life completely.

“It goes up high enough for everyone to look up to.”

“I’ll make it like that for you.”

“Don’t leave me. Do you get it?"

Whispering that he loves me, and even asking me if I knew it.

title: The Artistic Genius of Music Is the Reincarnation of Paganini
alt_titles: High School Musical Genius Is Paganini Reincarnated
description: The Rebirth of Paganini, Joo-won Moon. He was once a gifted violinist, but due to an injury, he gradually distanced himself from music and lived the life of a regular high school student. “I don’t pursue music.” However, perhaps the irony of fate… Joo-won Moon accidentally transferred to the music class of an arts high school, he picked up the violin… Will Joo-won Moon be able to overcome his psychological trauma? And is there a chance for him to be reborn as a true violinist?

title: Protect My Star
description:
Lu Yan was an unknown trainee who acts cute in public but is headstrong and straightforward behind the scenes. One day, he caught the attention of a popular fandom influencer who drew fanart of him that made him popular overnight. But Lu Yan wasn't ready to accept the way he became popular…  
  
Indonesia:  
Lu Yan adalah seorang trainee yang tidak dikenal dan bertindak lucu di depan umum, tetapi keras kepala dan terus terang di belakang layar. Suatu hari ia di perhatikan oleh seseorang yang populer di dunia fandom. Dia membuat fanart dari dia dan dia menjadi populer dalam semalam. Tapi, dia tidak siap untuk menerima bagaimana dia menjadi populer.

title: Disobey the Duke if You Dare
description:
You must never see the duke’s face.
After her second husband's death, Lily is forced into a third marriage by her father. Her new husband is rumored to be a monstrous warmonger, but to Lily's surprise, the Duke turns out to be a kind man and husband. There's just one catch... she must never see his face.

title: Hidden Surface Town
alt_titles: Restraining order of ant 2: Hidden Surface Town
yi zu xianzhi ling II yin mian zhen
description:
The wheel of fate began moving due to a fated meeting in a small town, where everyone is free from restraining orders and lives in “peace”……  
  
Returning to her hometown from abroad, 19-year-old Wei Sheng Bai is living a normal rural life of a high school student. With her hearing problem now fixed, she is now able to appreciate her neighborhood atmosphere as it has now flourished into a lively hometown. One night, she watches the handsome stage performer Bu Luo Xu, playing the role of a beast with many eyes. Bai remembers a similar creature she befriended in the forest during her childhood, and coincidentally has the same name. Bai thinks they are all just trivial things. Or are they?

title: King of the Night Market
description: The World-class agent opened a shop in the night market?! Apart from common folks, my old enemies, friends and even their daughters drop by for a meal!? I, Li Cheung, welcome everyone, but if ya’ll gonna pull a scheme, then don’t blame me for being uncourteous.

title: The Sweetest Man
description: I found out that my friend is a vampire. Would you believe me? My friend for 15 years, Kim Hyung Woo, got drunk and was brought to my house. Then he started blabbering ridiculous things like, he’s a vampire, and since he just bit me, I might become a vampire, too…

title: The Invincible Deadbeat
description: Shin Min-cheol had been recruited to the world called ‘Anhelles’. He was one who had lived 200 years fighting to survival and destroying the enemies, in the end the ruler of the continent Zero, was lead to the victory of war. And finally, Min-cheol, who has finally returned to Earth leaving the peace of Anhelles behind, wants to live his long-awaited life as a ‘rich unemployed man’, but another conspiracy begins to approach him? If they are after me, they have to find me first. All I have to do is go and fight it off!

title: Youngest Son of the NamGung Clan
description:
This is the story of NamGung DeSo, the youngest son of the NamGung Clan!

After losing his dantian in the competition for the position of vice-patriarch, he then faces an unexpected death out of nowhere and regresses into the past…

The youngest son of the strongest clan?
Such a title is way too bothersome.
Let someone else become the strongest person or whatever!

Can the former trash of the clan make the most out of his second chance at life?

title: I Can't Keep up With My Stallion Duke
alt_titles: I'm Depressed Because My Second Husband Is Desperate
I Am Depressed While My Second Husband Is Desperate
The Second Husband Is Desperate and Depressed
description:
Not a single soul in Olivia Florence's life, including her own husband, provided the warmth that she craved, and she lived her life alone, growing strong. Waking up two decades earlier right after her regretful arranged marriage to the Duke, Lord James Parnell, she plans to live a different life.

She hatches a plan to annul her marriage remarry the Duke, Ian Tyrone, infamous for being *impotent* for never showing any interest in the ladies. Maybe his disinterest in women would allow Olivia to comfortably live as his wife, unburdened by childbirth and free of any other pressures in life.

But wait, the Duke who seemingly "couldn't get it up" turns out to be a complete stud at in the bedroom. What has Olivia gotten herself into?

---
Olivia, celebrating her second chance at life, decides to get away from her first husband, who has high libido. So she proposed marriage to Duke Tyrone, who is known for his incompetence, but when I got married, this man was a skillful man and totally not defective.

"This is fraud! This marriage is a fraud!"

Olivia, who is now depressed because of her desperate second husband putting moves on her, will she be happy in her second life?

---

title: The Accidental Heiress
description: Riella, who runs a small flower shop, suddenly inherits all of the fortunes of Duke Hoson, the mighty jeweler because of her special ability. However, there was another original heir who was meant to receive the tremendous legacy. The king's younger brother and jeweler, Grand Duke Haun, appears in front of Riella, who is confused about the sudden new inheritor. “Everything with Hoson's name was going to be mine. So I'm getting it back. Everything, including you.”

title: The Supreme Urban Heavenly Master
description:
Summary: The common people only know of ‘Lu Ban‘s Book*,’ but they most certainly don’t know about ‘Gong Shu’s Book’ that they are one and the same/that they can be traced to the same origin. The greatest heavenly master steps foot into the mortal world. He embraces a beautiful woman in his arms and mind, what’s more stirs up some trouble in a big city thousands of miles away. Adapted from the novel, ‘The Millenial Heavenly Master,’ with new chapters released every Wednesday and Saturday.   
  
*T/N: Lu Ban and Gong Shu are the same person, a Chinese structural engineer and inventor during the Spring and Autumn period of the Zhou Dynasty. Lu Ban’s original name was Gongshu Ban.   
  
<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lu_Ban>

title: World of Immortals
description:
The World of Immortals, it is the world every mortals long for. For many, it is an eternal glory to cause a spatial distortion and enter the World of Immortals. But the vicissitude of time is simply merciless, the legends regarding immortality had long been forgotten.  
  
However, a miracle shall rise once more! An immortal was about to split the space with martial arts and cut all ties with the mortal world. The protagonist, Xiao Chen, was caught up in it and accidentally brought to the World of Immortals. What will they find in the vast world beyond the rift?

title: The Genius Assassin Who Takes It All
alt_titles: The Genius Assassin Who Eats Everything
Honja Da Hae Meongneun Cheonjae Amsalja
description:
Waking up as the main villain of his own novel was not part of the original plan. Now a lowly level 10 assassin, Ganghu Shin must use all of his prior knowledge as the author to navigate the fantasy world he created himself, and somehow alter the ending in order to return to the real world. 

Can he change the outcome and defeat the "real" villain to prevent his own demise and save this world from impending doom?

title: The Prince's First Love
description: The flawless Prince Nazaire changes schools in hopes of wooing a bride… only to encounter the tyrant Cassius Li! At first, the two cannot stand one another, as they constantly infuriate each other. Yet between ball dances, rescues, and secret rendezvous, Nazaire and Cassius begin seeing each other for who they truly are. But love between a prince and a commoner could never happen, and if Nazaire hopes to ascend the throne, he will have to give up Cassius. Torn between love and duty, can the prince and tyrant reach their happily ever after?

title: Mystic Prince
description: An immortal emperor rules the Kingdom of Yeol, a divine country blessed by gods with awesome powers. After a thousand years of peaceful rule, the time has come for a new emperor to be chosen. This is determined by a series of trials, in which twenty princes with special powers who have trained since birth must compete. As all princes of varying personalities and agendas gather to partake in the trials, intrigue and possibly even bloodshed seem all but certain. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the other princes, the Fourth Prince Jeok-yeon Ryu hides a secret he must guard with his life.

title: Bride of the Water God
description: When Soah's impoverished, desperate village decides to sacrifice her to the Water God Habaek to end a long drought, they believe that drowning one beautiful girl will save their entire community and bring much-needed rain. Not only is Soah surprised to be rescued by the Water God - instead of killed - she never imagined she'd be a welcomed guest in Habaek's magical kingdom, where an exciting new life awaits her! Most surprising, however, is the Water God himself… and how very different he is from the monster Soah imagined.

title: Yuri Box
description:
Dreams that didn't become reality, memories you want to become dreams, and realities that no longer mean anything to the one involved…  
Be it dreams, memories, or stories…this shop is a place that collects, stores, and sells them.

title: Become Her Bride
description: Dokyung, the successor of Hanshin Group, had to live as a man and an idiot, hiding her identity through the scheme of her stepmother, Chairman Park. In order to pay her father's debt, Saebom must become Dokyung's bride. In this way, two women got married under complicated conditions.

title: Rehabilitation Classroom
description: In South Korea, where the juvenile law has been abolished and rehabilitation centers for juvenile offenders have been established, Min-su, who has been wrongfully accused of murder and sent to a rehabilitation center, realizes that it is a hell from which he can never escape through normal means. Min-su's older brother, Yu-seong, infiltrates the rehabilitation center as a guard to save his brother in crisis... A desperate struggle for survival and escape unfolds as the two brothers fight against false justice!

title: All I Want Is You
description: His grandfather's will says he must marry Eunyul, who left him five years ago, and live together for more than a year to inherit control of a company. Although the wound of betrayal is still there, he is forced to start an awkward cohabitation with Eun-yul, who is raising a 5-year-old child alone.

title: My Mad Fake Marriage to Maddie
alt_titles: My Mad Fake Marriage to Maddie
Don't Worry, We Both Agreed to This Fraudulent Marriage
Don't Worry, It's a Consensual Fraud Marriage
description:
As the legitimate heir to the imperial throne, Yullikian kuhn Rondenez is desperate to find a way to keep his usurping uncle from killing him next.
Frequenting the slums to make it seem like he's become a gambler, he crosses paths with Maddie, a notorious pickpocket who is willing to do anything for the right price, even kill.
That's when he comes up with a crazy plan.
Yullikian proposes to Maddie to get his uncle off his back, **but will this fake marriage lead to mad love or just madness?**

(Source: Tapas)

title: The Suspicious Boy Is One of the World's Top Ten Masters
description:
In the aftermath of Madorim's decline following the World War, a captivating tale unfolds as the maternal grandson, son of Lord Daesannim's daughter, returns to the city. Despite initial feelings of abandonment, he emerges as a figure of unexpected beauty in a martial arts world marked by rugged aesthetics.

Unveiling his true identity as the King of the Mu-myeon Mountain, a teenage expert who conquered the Dragon King of the Yellow River, the series promises a gripping narrative. Driven by his mother's last words and a determination to restore Madorim to its former glory, Jin Murip, this unparalleled teenage expert, arrives in Madorim.

title: Dangerous Heartbeat
description: "If you don't want your fake identity exposed to the world, then complete my seven little demands, Qi ChaoYue." [Dominant Sadistic Queen True Heiress X Submissive Masochistic Tsundere Fake Heiress] Despite how much she hates these outrageous demands, her body seems to be falling deeper into this world...

title: My Villainous Family Won't Let Me Be
alt_titles: My Villainous Family Won't Let Me Be
My Villainous Family Is Against My Independence
The Villainous Family Is Against Independence
description:
Elodie, the illegitimate daughter of a family of murderous villains with no sense of family, suddenly discovers her past life!

She realizes that she has been reincarnated in a novel she read in a previous life. When the real heroine shows up three years later, she realizes she's been abandoned by her villainous family and is destined to be killed. She was doing okay until her sister showed up, and she thought, "Let's be independent from this family!"

"Independence, what kind of bullshit is that?"

"Who dared to put such ideas into your head?"

"Sister, you don't think you're going to run away by any chance, do you?"

My family is against independence? I want to live, let me be independent!
___
A distant echo from a life long-forgotten; shattered shards of an ominous future. When her late mother’s heirloom pendant is broken, Elodie Perdia regains the memories of Ga-eul Yun, a girl from our world who realizes she’s landed in the body of a villainess from a fantasy novel. In the story, Elodie serves as the dark foil to the virtuous heroine and is destined for an early grave – a dark fate that can perhaps be avoided with Ga-eul’s knowledge of future events!

title: The Palace Beast
description:
The princess, knew she possessed exceptional abilities but understood she would never be queen and wished to live a peaceful life alongside her maid.

However, a neighboring kingdom coveted their current kingdom and secretly plotted against them. The prince, perceiving the princess as a threat, took action against her maid, causing the maid to disappear.

Living in a palace filled with deception and manipulation, the moment they harmed the maid who genuinely cared for her, the princess transformed into an extraordinary serpent. She surpassed her own limitations in order to protect her cherished companion, yearning to become a dragon capable of defending her loved one with unmatched power.

"The princess will unite the three kingdoms."

In a realm established through the gods' benevolence and the dragon's goodwill, where abilities tainted by human greed and was cursed by the dragon exist, a war that was prophesied is on the brink of starting.

As the prophecy approaches its fulfillment, Can she really become queen?

title: Honkai Impact 3rd - 2nd Herrscher
description:
Alternate fan translation of volume 0.2 of [Honkai Impact 3rd](https://mangadex.org/title/b82bc828-0f22-43d9-835d-d5ff1cb0d680/honkai-impact-3rd).  
  
"On February 1st, 2000. The entire man research staff of Shicksals Babylon facility in Siberia disappeared overnight. While Theresa investigates this mystery under orders from Otto, Walter and Einstein make preparation for *her* appearence. The stage is set for the second Honkai Impact."

title: Killing Time
description: "Save me, sister!” My sister who died three years ago called me, and now I have to use a cell phone that is connected to the past to save my dead sister!

title: Classmate Relationship?
description: By chance, Fang Tang came across Ah Shu, someone he noticed long ago. The two became classmates and intimate friends. A refreshing and pure love school life manhua.

title: Rather Than Being an Award Winning Actress, It's Better to Study at Qing Hua
alt_titles: Dang Ying Hou Buru Nian Qinghua
17 Again: Smart is the New Sexy
description:
Award-winning darkhorse Dong Fang Fei Fei, also known as the beauty who specially attracts scumbags was sent back to the high school when she was 17-year-old after being reincarnated. In order to avoid the fate of being killed again, she must gain admission to Qing Hua University.
Dong Fang Fei Fei roared: "You want an illiterate like me to get into Qing Hua University?!"

title: Strongest Cultivation App
description: A sound of a strike of lightning! The apps in the phone start to change? If you have any money you can but as many sacred talisman, and there’s nothing you can’t do! The ordinary Han Wu used the world’s buying system into the cultivation path in the city! Change your whole life!

title: How to Live as a Tyrant's Spoiled Brat
description:
On the day the empire fell to rebellion and invasion from another world, Valen met his end alongside his sister, the Emperor.  

But when he opened his eyes again, he found himself 40 years in the past.  

This time, he vowed to do whatever it took to prevent the world's destruction and protect the Emperor.  

And his solution?  

To live an even wilder life than before.  

"If I was a scoundrel in my past life, then this time... I'll be the ultimate menace!"

title: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide
alt_titles: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide
A Collection of Top Strategies That Only I See
description:
15 days until the apocalypse happens. 

That's what Hoyeong Lee, a 29-year-old office worker, learns when he takes the mysterious medicine he got for saving a goblin from a bear trap. As it turns out, it allows him to level up more easily and provides him with a strategy guide! 

Everyone in the world is forced into groups to conquer the mysterious Apocalypse Tower, and Hoyeong has to find a way to work with his teammates so that everyone makes it to the top alive. 

Will his ability give him an advantage, or will it end up spelling out his doom?

title: Beast 9
description: Eraser, the mysterious enemy that invaded Earth 13 years ago!! Before their overwhelming power, the entire Earth neared the verge of collapse. But at the last moment there suddenly appeared Earth's lone savior, The Beast: an ultimate weapon uniquely equipped to counter the Eraser's power!! The Beast is part of the MAGIC Brigade, whose commander-in-chief is also the founder of our Le Prince Academy… Ladies and gentlemen, I present to you, Mr. Vincent!

title: Cate Land
description:
How can you become a chef without a sense of taste? No problem! With a cheating knife in hand, the world is yours! Cate lottery system that comes with its own beautiful teacher and spirit planting space! “Coach, I want to become a chef!” From then on, Fu Yan Ze earnestly began walking on the path to becoming a Culinary God (Harem God)!  
  
Russian:||  
Хочешь быть поваром, но заставляют жениться? Убегай? Куда? В другой мир! Там ты найдёшь себя! Эта история про талантливого шеф-повара, который нашёл себя в другом мире!||

title: Four Dangerous Brothers to My Rescue!
alt_titles: Four Dangerous Brothers to My Rescue!
description:
Lestia, who grew up in the slums with her drunken uncle and managed to make ends meet by selling flowers. One night when her uncle, who was threatened by some thugs because of his debt, tried to sell her off.

"Hey, get your hands off her."

A group of beautiful boys appeared out of nowhere. They defeated the thugs at once and said incredible things to Lestia.

"It's nice to finally meet you, my sister."

Surprisingly, she was the daughter of the Duke of Verchester, a family which has produced wizards for generations. But it waas hard to believe those words without any proof.

"Come on, Lestia. Let's go home."

But did she want to hold on to any hope? She grabbed the boys' hands, a little impulsively.

---
Warmhearted Lestia has resigned herself to a life of misery under the thumb of her abusive uncle. However, right when things seem to take a turn for the worst, a mysterious boy claiming to be one of her four long-lost brothers appears in the nick of time to save her. After being whisked into a life of luxury, Lestia has her doubts about taking on the Verchester name. But after the discovery of her latent magical powers, Lestia starts to accept two strange truths: She is a true Verchester, and she has a destiny to fulfill.

---
