title: Holding Room
description:
Han Jae-hwa is a writer who is attracts attention due to his delicate looks and excellent writings. After a few days of being stalked, he decides to hire a bodyguard, Seong Tae-kyung.  
  
As the stalking continue to escalate, Tae-kyung proposes an idea…!

title: The End Days of Light
description:
Aliens? Magicians? What does this mean for a world where espers are fundamental to the pillars of society?  
As a mysterious maiden falls from the sky, the only thing that is certain is that she is moe as fuck.

title: Surviving as the Prince's Fiancée
alt_titles: The Prince's Fiancėe Descended From Heaven
description:
On her way back home late one night, office worker Sophie stumbles into another world where she's a princess?! Well that's what Alan, prince of the Lapis Kingdom, says. To return to her world she must fulfill the prophecy and help Alan become king. Sophie agrees but...amidst a war for the crown, can she survive?

(Source: Tapas)

title: Full-Time Sword Cultivator
description: In an era where reality and a game had become one, ***Lin Jichen***, the greatest mage in **Eternia**, was stabbed in the back and killed by the people he trusted the most—his lover and the man he considered his brother. Yet destiny had other plans for him. He regressed to the day before Eternia’s launch and gave up the staff for a sword! Join him on a journey to rewrite the future with the blade of a sword!

title: Call Me by My Name
description: When I entered the same university as my crush to be with him, I met a sunbae who has the same name as that of my dog?!

title: Do You Know a Fairy?
description: Due to his unique ability of seeing guardian fairies, Eun-Oh is deemed to be a loner. One day, the new transfer student Jae Hwi approached him without hesitation! "I feel good whenever I'm with you." After being told such words, Eun-Oh started to have a change of heart…

title: Please Use Dating To Save the World
description:
It’s unclear when it began, but the inner world started invading reality. Its goal is to amplify and control the dark side of humanity in the real world, so it has parasitized eight troubled girls with exceptional beauty and traits.

 

As the girls gain supernatural powers, they are gradually corrupted by desire. Their target, whether by coincidence or not, is the handsome and talented Wu Se!

 

Wu Se must protect himself while surrounded by the girls’ supernatural powers and find the opportunity to fight back.

title: Marriage B: Wed to the Enemy
description: Goyoh Rubiet did everything in her power to avoid an arranged marriage with the power-hungry Marquess Anthe Betelgeuse. Instead, Goyoh's sister is forced to marry him, but it's not long before Goyoh learns that her sister has been murdered by the marquess. Soon after, as she's struggling with guilt, Goyoh wakes up as a past version of herself. This time around, Goyoh is determined to accept her arranged marriage to save her sister. But is there any way she can avoid meeting the same grisly fate?

title: Ex-Love Review
description: "Giju is usually the most rational person around, but when it comes to love, she becomes completely foolish. During an argument with her boyfriend, the one she thought would be different this time, she accidentally falls down the stairs. When she regains her consciousness in the hospital, some strange review windows appears before her eyes. “What is this? Reviews written by his ex-girlfriends… rating my boyfriend?” Could these review windows be the salvation Giju needs for her love life?

title: Hello, Summer
description:
He climbed onto a tree to avoid the teacher and saw a strange girl on top of the tree full of white beautiful petals.   
  
The summer sun shined as bright as the white flowers on the strange Han Yeoreum (summer).  
  
He endlessly searches for the storage room filled with memories of her.

title: I Shall Kill That Sweet Devil
alt_titles: I'll Wrench the Neck of That Sweet Son of a Bitch
I'm Going to Twist His Neck
I'll Twist the Neck of a Sweet Dog
I Will Twist the Neck of a Friendly Little Bastard
description:
Chloe Garnache is an alluring trap for the emperor. 

After living a life full of abuse at the hands of her family, Chloe is finally freed from her torture by the grand duke, Kairos Ludwig. 

However, her days of getting taken advantage of are far from over. The only reason Kairos took her in is because of her beauty, which he plans to use in order to lure and kill the emperor. Chloe willingly follows Kairos’ orders, having fallen for his kind and gentle gestures. Unfortunately, her feelings are never returned, and she is met with a pitiful death once her task is fulfilled. 

But just when things seem to be over, Chloe awakens to find herself back before her life came spiraling down. And this time, she won’t be swayed by the sweet words of the devilish grand duke…

title: I Will Protect My Tyrant Dad!
description:
Reborn as a small-town child in a fantasy novel, Sien discovers her father is the exiled heir of a villainous duchy. Fearing their return to the ruthless family, she strives to protect him.  

But wait—her dad was once a tyrant?  

A heartwarming tale of a secretly powerful dad and his scheming daughter trying to preserve his innocence unfolds in this delightful mix of humor and healing misunderstandings.

title: Deuraegongwa Saijoajineun Manhwa
description: A story about getting closer with a dragon

title: You Go! Brave Little Yellow Croaker! Fall In Love!
description: An otaku girl isekais into a shounen bishoujo game?! No! But I'm straight! (Even if it makes my heart flutter picking up girls) The game slowly gets out of hand after a server outage, with settings in total mayhem. Do yo finally need my help to save the world? To save the world, I have to pick up chicks? That's so damn cheap! The love story of an otaku and 2d waifus~ Filling the world with love! ...But tbh, standing up to use the toilet is still really weird.

title: Nine Heavenly Star Art
description: Cultivate the Nine Heavenly Star Art and create your own legendary myth! This is the cartoon-adaptation of popular author Mad Snail's "Nine Heavenly Star Art". This is a world where humans, demons and mysterious beasts coexist. Humans cultivate mysterious qi. Demons cultivate corporeal bodies. Mysterious beasts cultivate soul perception. A legend says that in the middle of an endless rainforest, there are extremely powerful existences; they are called demon kings. Some demon kings have a tyrannical corporeal body, some are experts in illusions. Some demon kings are proficient in magic, some can even move mountains. Some demon kings are able to sense things thousands of miles away. These demon kings rarely appear in the human world. Even if they emerge in the human world, they would reincarnate in human form; assimilating with mankind while seeking to breakthrough realms…….

title: The Queen of Healing Doctors
description: She was transferred to a new body and has the strongest medical skills in the family. The old Mu Rong'er was once a lady who could be bullied by everyone. As a beautiful lady, she was bullied? A silly sister, sick mother and a cruel domestic slave … the unlucky girl was born again, and this time she will change all of this!

title: Love Train
description: On the first day of school, six students felt their hearts flutter all at the very same moment in time! This is the story of each of them pursuing and being pursued out of their earnest wishes for love.

title: Dreamland Adventure
description: Howard(Chen Xu), the lowly office employee, is stuck at the bottom of the corporate ladder until a chance encounter with the mimic dream system changes his life! Now he can access all the adventure he ever wanted: having adventures, fighting monsters and living with his gorgeous but fierce boss! The mission, as always, is to be attractive but independent, bold but sensitive.

title: Conquer My Heart
description:
“Dawn” entered the hall with her calm movements and stood in the middle. Her face showed no emotions, like a doll, but she was captivating and elegant, strikingly like an ice queen. Exer smiled lightly, spread her legs, and said, ‘As Lord, I will embrace you tonight.’ A fateful encounter for the first time. A woman falls in love at first sight. And a man fights the world for this woman. ‘If this world cannot accept her as a wife, then I will change this world.’ A love story between Dawn, the Eastern girl who endured a tough childhood while fleeing from war and became a slave, and Exer, the handsome man who was known as the strongest warrior in the kingdom.

---
Arrogant Duke Ixor Malkuth is used to getting absolutely everything he wants... until he meets the beautiful Daon, a slave who refuses to give in to his demands. As the conquerer of Daon's territory, Ixor tries to treat her like his mistress, but when she runs away, he decides to charm her into loving him. Yet with every attempt to seduce her, Ixor finds himself slowly falling for her instead. Will the prideful duke succeed in stealing Daon's affection, or will he find his own heart conquered?

title: Programmed To Love You
alt_titles: Shè dìng yāoqiú wǒ ài nǐ
description:
The torment you inflict upon me— I'll endure it willingly.

Is my burning desire to grow closer to Master every day simply just a pre-programmed setting?! Was I intentionally created with a face resembling someone Master once loved? Is this all a conspiracy, or just a ticking time-bomb? But! Wu Qing doesn't understand such complicated things! I just want to make Master happy! Even in a plague-ridden, post-apocalyptic world, I just want to get closer to Master!

A Clueless, Loyal Android x A Sickly, Cold-Hearted Researcher

title: Two Ways for Lovers
description:
She thought she was being chased after by two men, one selfishly cold-hearted and another beautifully doting.  
  
Intertwined with their love, who will become her lover? The decision is difficult… a child would pick one, but an adult would want both…  
  
Under the protection of her “two” lovers, will she be able to overturn her fate as a marriage replacement and suppress the slegs…?

title: The Resourceful Little Consort
alt_titles: Baby Concubine Wants to Live Quietly
The Baby Concubine Wants to Live Quietly
description:
I possessed a supporting character in a reverse harem novel. A young concubine who, in the end, was driven to death for treason after begging for attention from the regnant empress who was the female lead, and doing wicked things to the male leads who were the concubines. Despite everything, the fortunate thing was that I possessed her right after entering the Imperial Palace. Even if everyone in the Imperial Palace were wary of me, they didn’t hate me yet.

‘Let’s not be impudent, and be obedient.’

I obstinately didn’t need nor have the mindset of trying to be loved by the Empress. Although the male leads who were the concubines were giving me glances, I could just lie flat. Since it wasn’t even a very difficult thing, I really did so. It was definitely like that, but–

“Come to my bedchamber tonight. I’ll read you a fairy tale book!”

“P-please don’t cry. I’ll give you this.”

Just why is everyone’s attitude endlessly gentle? I couldn’t understand. And it was baffling.

‘…I don’t need it though?’

I wasn’t really a young kid lacking affection. And that gaze in which they looked at me as if I were the loveliest in the world was extremely uncomfortable. Just where would I use a fairy tale book that’s full of jewels and silk, and the magic pearl which is the Imperial family’s heirloom? Since it’s already been done, I just wish for everyone to get out of my palace.

---
In the nation of Seora, Yehwa Aryun is the Empress Regnant, and her court is full of consorts with special powers. The newest member of the imperial court is 8-year-old Sanya Yeoran. And although she has no powers, Sanya actually has the mind of an adult who knows exactly what will happen in this fantasy world, because she already read about it in her past life. Thanks to that, she comes up with a plan to avoid her tragic execution: stay away from Yehwa and her jealous consorts at all costs!

title: Taming the Corrupted
description:
I succeeded in taking the man who would, in the future, become the best in swordsmanship, one step ahead of the Prince and enlisted him as my younger brother. I treat my younger brother, who is not blood related to me, more kindly than anyone else, and I fed and raised him well. He will be my younger brother who will protect me from the damn fiancé who killed me in my previous life, and will be the replacement to go to war on my father’s behalf.

"I have never thought of you as a family from the moment I first saw you. My dear sister."

His eyes, filled with possessive desires, shone. It was a beast that I brought as my younger brother.

title: The Emperor's Puppy (Pre-serialization)
description:
Hari, who died in an unexpected car accident, had come to her senses after being reincarnated into a completely different world. Was she the daughter of the emperor? Hari, who opened her eyes with a throbbing heart, was in shock. I’m a dog? A dog that can talk, too? And it gets worse! I was the hunting dog of a cruel emperor who exterminated his own relatives to ascend to the throne.  
  
Now that it’s done, I have to find a way to live. The only thing this little doggy could do with her body was…  
  
“I’ll pay you back if you raise me, Your Majesty!”  
  
“Alright, I’ll take you.”  
  
“That’s a great choice, Your Majesty. You’ll never regret it!”  
  
Goodbye to my self-esteem— A dog’s way to utmost power… that’s the route I’ll take! My second life will be as the Emperor’s adviser and potential successor.  
  
Until the day of death!  
  
(DISCLAIMER: This is a promo chapter.)

title: Heir of Mythical Heroes
description:
Despite coming first in his exams at Raider Academy, Han Jungmin lacked the talent to fulfill his dream of becoming a dungeon raider. 

Crestfallen, he takes a break from school and writes a novel about dungeon raiders instead. But once Jungmin finishes, his story becomes a reality with new dungeons and monsters swarming in his home. Luckily for him, he has been granted a unique class and skills no one has ever heard of. 

Will Jungmin finally become the raider he's always longed to be?

title: I Am A Killer Maid
description:
This is the story of a mangaka, a killer maid, and body swapping ramen, with a side of gratuitous violence and explosions.  
  
* [Original Webcomic](http://ac.qq.com/Comic/comicInfo/id/535282)

title: Lee Bom, Be Mine
description: A cute office romance love story which makes your heart flutter.

title: I'm Not a Villain
alt_titles: I'm Truly Not the Villainous Big Shot
description: The human world is shrouded in fear of the unknown. In order to survive, a few awakened people rose up to fight. Yilin, an unlucky man who couldn’t become a hero in time, was tragically assassinated when he killed the boss. Unexpectedly, he was born again and gained the ability of a villain leader. He was originally an ordinary man but he became the lifelong enemy of countless gods and demons. Hey, you guys, it’s too late to kneel down now…

title: Lock You up
description:
Ordinary high school student Lu Qing Yu and the elegant university teaching assistant, Cheng Jing. Their encounters was definitely not by chance or just a coincidence. Due to their previous generation's old grudges and grievances had made them unable to live tranquilly and peacefully. He, who took great pains and had ransacked his brain over trying to make the star fall from the sky, but was enthralled and mesmerized by the star instead; The other him who was ignorant, trusted him wholeheartedly and faithfully, staying completely oblivious to the fact that this was all just a trap meticulously and carefully designed especially for him…  
  
Français :  
Un étudiant dans une école ordinaire : Lu Qing Yu. Et un professeur assistant dans une université réputée : Cheng Jing. Leur rencontre n'était définitivement pas un coup de chance ou une coïncidence. A cause de vieilles querelles entre leurs 2 familles, leurs vies ne seront pas un long fleuve tranquille…

title: Blind Passion
description:
From the day she was born, Soonok's greedy father had only one plan for his daughter - to make her the next queen of the Joseon Dynasty, even if that meant marrying her off to the unsavory King. As royal factions scheme in the shadows for the throne, Soonok and her childhood friend Hyang weave through a palace of greed, deceit, and lust hoping to survive together the troubles that await them. Will Soonok and Hyang's love remain true? Or will the palace's blood-stained secrets tear them apart?  
  
[R15 version](https://www.tappytoon.com/series/reignofdesire/1)

title: Dark Blood Age
alt_titles: World of Darkness - The century of blood
description:
A mysterious natural phenomenon caused the Earth to be plunged into darkness. The world turned into endless bloody chaos and mankind is on the brink of extinction…  
  
Chu Yun Sheng, an ordinary white-collar worker, discovered his family heirloom, a book, shining a bizarre light by accident. Out of curiosity, he tried to study the book.  
  
After long research, he still only understood a few symbols written in the ancient book. However, he was shocked when he figured out what messages the ancient book tried to tell him: the sun will disappear, and humanity is doomed…  
  
He tried to spread the message, but no one believed him; his family and friends even tried to take him to see the psychiatrist. Eventually, he gave up telling anyone but prepared for the apocalypse in secret.  
  
Until one day — the sun really disappeared…

title: Once again, The Noble Consort Yields Herself to the Enemy
alt_titles: Today the Imperial Concubine Is Also Using Herself to Raise the Enemy
Guìfēi jīntiān yě yào yǐ shēn sì dí
description:
[Airhead x Brooding Ice Queen]. 
“I exchanged bodies with my mortal foe, only to discover that she’s with child?!”
Faced with no choice but to carry the baby on behalf of Noble Lady Ning, Noble Consort Qiao seethes with rage every day. More absurd still, this devious, conniving Noble Lady has the audacity to harbor feelings for me?!

title: Reign
description: First, only in glorious moments should you speak the name of Gunlimdan. Second the task is chosen in discretion by the High Senior. Third, the goal of all of Gunlimdan is reigning Danju. With that, the goal of Yong Yeon, who had just joined Gunlimdan, was set. Take reign of Danju!

title: Tears by Day, Love by Night
description:
The first time, I wasn't considered a priority. Then, it didn't feel right to date men. The third time, I went on a blind date, to discover that I was dating a married man.  
  
Eunsoo's relationships always ended badly.  
  
But it's different this time. Just as he was about to be beaten up, Eunsoo is comforted by Hajoon, who appeared like a knight.   
  
But why would you… You're even comforting me in my dreams?!

title: Frenzy Leveling Up System
description: Despite being the young lord of Merak Palace, Yi Tianyun is considered a weakling and an outcast by all those around him. The only person who cares about him is the master of the palace and his aunt, Shi Xueyun. After another day of training without much progress, Tianyun receives a special dragon blood elixir from Xueyun to replenish his health. But upon consuming it, he’s thrown into the “Frenzy Leveling Up System,” which allows him to finally gain the boost in power he’s always wanted. Now armed with a trove of incredible skills and items, is there any opponent who stands a chance against him?

title: Apocalypse Descends, I Reincarnated As A Tyrant
alt_titles: Apocalypse Reset: Rise of the Tyrant
description: Luo Hao was betrayed by espers in a monster-infested apocalypse. Just as he was filled with regret, he found himself returned to the time before the end of the world—and awakened an Evolution System with limitless potential! This time, Luo Hao swore to take revenge on those who betrayed him, and to build an indestructible fortress amidst the apocalypse. However, espers began awakening ahead of time, and it seemed someone was manipulating events from the shadows. Everything was spiraling out of control. Strangest of all was Luo Hao’s Evolution System—it seemed to be pushing him down an irreversible path…

title: Queen, You Mustn't! (Promo)
description:
There hasn't been a queen like this before!

The strongest monarch in Babel's history called the God of War, God's Daughter, Aroha Fenril Astrofortus! After her return from concluding a seven-year war, she finds that those bastard nobles have prepared a bothersome trap…

'Your Majesty, you must choose a husband and continue the royal family's bloodline!'

She wants to throw all of that away, but in consideration for the royal bloodline, she does have to get married. On top of that, she's receiving a crazy amount of proposals from those that are vying for Babel's second highest position.

The husband candidates chosen by the Grand Chamberlain on special orders! The genius that is Babel Academy's youngest professor in all history, an optimistic national guard, Babel’s General and the Queen’s reliable comrade, and the young hero of Babel's political world, the most beautiful man.

…Who will Aroha choose?

Prologue webtoon: AWIN
Cover illustration: BUN

title: Holy Chef, Crazy Empress
description: The top killer of the 21st century crossed time and space into the Cold Palace as a useless Empress. To have a good life in the harem, you need to be good in the Royal Kitchen and excellent in the Emperor's bed. There is a super handsome and evil-minded husband and a cute baby genius - not to forget the superb Royal Kitchen system for lotteries. Conquer this dapper man with a pot and a spoon, dominate the harem and embark on the pinnacle of life!

title: Lu Bu's Life Simulator
description: “Take the prettiest women, ride the fastest war horse, wield the strongest weapon, one rider blocking the GuanDong 18 roads*. One man standing against ten thousand, they bow to this hero of turbulent times. People say if Lu Bu doesn’t die, there will be no opportunity to cause chaos. I laugh at all the hypocrites in the world; there are no other heroes besides Feng Xian. Entering the life story of more than a thousand reincarnations, experiencing the many vicissitudes of life, tempered into steel. Can the current Lu Bu Feng Xian withstand the inevitable end at Bai Men Lou?”

title: Moonstruck: The Red Night's Lovers
description:
If you love someone, what kind of things might you do? 
The desire to destroy even while in love, the dilemma of wanting to ruin a love that grows deeper. 
This is a deeply probing collection of high-stimulation romance short stories exploring how dangerous the emotion of love can sometimes be.

title: Blade of the Phantom Master
alt_titles: Phantom Master: Dark Hero from Ruined Empire
description:
"What is about to happen is mere coincidence. Never dream for such miracle to reoccur." After the ancient kingdom ‘Jyushin’ has perished, the only surviving secret royal inspector Munsu travels about the world, judging the evil.  
  
Link:  
[Movie](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=5182) (anime)

title: Rookie but One-in-a-Million Actor
alt_titles: He's an Actor With 10+ Million Views
A Rookie, Also an Actor With 10+ Million Viewers
description: Mooyoung spent his childhood under his stepfather’s oppressive rule, a life that felt like living in hell. A mysterious voice in the living hell showed him the way to survive. “Live someone else’s life instead of yours.” That’s how his acting journey began… Was it a survival instinct? Even when he did well, he excelled too much. Through acting, Mooyoung gained a new life. This is the story of Mooyoung, the overwhelming acting genius, embarking on a challenge in the entertainment industry!

title: I Am Reborn as the Sword God
description:
I achieved my cozy life of a seventh-grade civil servant by through a lot of hardships and nights of blacking out, so I was looking forward to the weekends where I could relax and have fun, but that night…

Is this Baek Rijin, the main character of the novel ?

When I returned to my senses, I discovered I was in the novel I was reading. Did a seventh-grade civil servant like me became the spoiled young master of the great Jaegal family?! A side character, who has received excessive investments and love since he was young, and now going through a stormy period of his life… The spoiled young master of the Jaegal Family, whom the Blood Demon Cult would annihilate ten years later!

---
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/15020)

title: Cannot Help It
description: In a joint essay class held in the summer as an extra class, Jung Yi-tae, an ordinary beta high school student, meets the Dominant Alpha, Geum Dan, a junior and a celebrity at the school. But after accidentally seeing Yi-tae’s ass, the Alpha begins to make strange suggestions…..

title: My Sweet Enemy, Thy Name Is Husband
alt_titles: Forced Into Wedlock With An Affectionate Enemy
Political Marriage With a Friendly Enemy
description:
My husband, my nemesis. Till death do us part.

Canach Riadon — a slave who rose to become the emperor and the man I wed in my first life. Yet our ill-fated marriage left my family murdered and my homeland destroyed at his hands. Now given a second chance, I vow to succeed in this political marriage and save all I love... Or will his love save me first?

title: Reincarnated as an Unruly Heir
alt_titles: I Reincarnated as the Crazed Heir
description:
Once a rising martial arts master, Jagak Yang is known as the Ten Strike Finisher due to his ability to defeat any opponent within ten moves. Jagak is also the son of the leader of the Great Martial Alliance, an organization of virtuous martial arts sects. His future leadership over the martial arts world seems all but assured -- that is, until he is assassinated by jealous rivals! Jagak is reincarnated into the body of Cheonso Ma, the playboy second-in-command of the evil Shining Light Cult. Can Jagak remain true to his principles despite his new life on the dark side?

---

**Links:**
- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/fantasy/reincarnated-as-an-unruly-heir/list?title_no=3308)
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/BOY/chongshengbuliangshaojiaozhu/list?title_no=1850)
- [Official Japanese Translation](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0001695)

title: My Incomplete First Love
alt_titles: Bu Wan Quan Chu Lian Guan Xi
description: An Zizi's car accident attracted both angels and demons, all fighting to claim her soul. Luckily, she was rescued by chance by a passing classmate, Yu Qiuren. The angels and demons didn't give up, and began to disturb An Zizi's daily life. But she never would've thought that the angels' Cupid arrows were slowly binding her to Yu Qiuren…

title: Between Summer & Fall
description: A teen who is worried about growth, love, and of friendship.

title: Living with the Emperor
description:
Heartache, competition, and the behind the scenes battles of the imperial harem; an ancient story based upon revenge.  
  
French : Être en compagnie de l'empereur équivaut à vivre avec un tigre.  
Un jour, Ling Su'er a sauvé le prince héritier qui s'était évanoui à la suite d'une blessure grave en pleine forêt.   
Comme elle avait besoin l'aide du prince héritier sur une autre question, Ling Su'er était prête à le protéger des autres princes.   
Mais tout n'est pas si paisible. Entre les combats dans le harem, la vengeance et les luttes pour le trône, Ling Su'er peut-elle rester innocente ?   
Victime de traitrise et de préjudice, Ling Su'er regrettera-t-elle d'avoir sauvé le prince héritier ?

title: Need a Girl
alt_titles: I Want to Make a Girlfriend!
description: Three boys are desperately struggling to "make" a girlfriend in their sad adolescent lives. They then realize that their classmate, Ghang Han-Gyul has been secretly going out with a beauty for 100 days (a 100 day celebration of a relationship is seen as very significant). This triggers the friendship between the manly, serious Han-Gyul and the three dateless losers.

title: How to Take Off a Wedding Dress
description:
"Find out who that woman is."  
The wedding planner, Jisue Lee caught the eye of the CEO of Hotel I, Woo Suk Yeon, with her resoluteness.   
"Jisue Lee, do you want to work for me?"

title: Chang An Demon Song
description:
The story happened at the dawn of the Tang dynasty. Nobody knew the peaceful and prosperous capital Chang An had a really experienced demon fox, Duan Mu Ming De for its biggest brothel's owner. The shounen onmyouji Bai Yu Mu, the best onmyouji among the younger generation of his onmyouji family, masterful at slaying demons and being vengeful, was forced to reside in this demon nest. There, he got acquainted with a seductive fox, a cold and distant wolf, a tsundere gold crow, a Virgo hedgehog and a two-faced weasel…at the same time, a larger conspiracy is brewing in the dark, in the capital that never sleeps, in which fires are lit every night. Meanwhile within the prosperous Chang An, the Rebellion of Anshi threatens to erupt..

---
**Original Webcomic:** [Manhuatai](https://www.manhuatai.com/changanyaoge/), [U17](http://www.u17.com/comic/88307.html)

[Official Vietnamese Translation / Tiếng Việt](https://pops.vn/comics/truong-an-yeu-ca-60110745a0c3120034d088b7)

title: Tales of Greed
description: Every person has something they desire, whether it’s beauty, wealth, or power. Depending on what you’re willing to risk, you could have anything your heart desires. You could be beautiful with the swipe of an app or become anyone with the press of a button -- but it all comes with a price. How far would you be willing to go to get what you wish for?

title: A Manhwa About Dating a Disabled Girl
Don't Give Your Heart to That Book
alt_titles: Don't Concern Yourself With That Book
description:
I was reborn as Ashley Rosé, the daughter of the 8th wife of the Emperor of Estria. I thought I was going to live a long and happy life in luxury, but soon I realized that I was an extra in the book 'Light of Rusbella' I had once read. While cleaning, I discovered a magic diary that seemed to fortell the future, and learned that nothing but ruin awaited me because Ashley Rosé was destined to die by the hands of the Crown Prince, Castor the Tyrant!

“What does the empire mean to you?” the Crown Prince asked, smiling oh so very beautifully. And then he killed me.

But after my death, I woke up once again in the past, only to be killed over and over again. As I continued to relive my deaths, I slowly lost my smile and changed. Let’s just try to survive first.

“What can I do for my elder brother?”
“Well,” Pale sky-blue hair fluttered softly in the wind. He smiled weakly, before parting his dry lips, “Call my name.”
“…” My head quickly snapped up.
“Call me… Amoru.”
His fingertips skimmed along the inside of my wrist.

title: Honey Bunny
description: A story about how a girl's lonely life was changed after taking in a stray bunny…who transforms into a man?? Read about the bunny's human escapades, his search for his lost friend, and how the girl and bunny's relationship progresses in this touching, yet comedic story!

title: The First Order
description: The world has ended and advanced technology is a relic of the past. In spite of his illness, Xiaosu hunts everyday, fighting to support himself and his brother Liuyan. But one day, Xiaosu is granted access to a palace. It presents quests that, when completed, grant Xiaosu greater strength and skills. As he grows stronger and sees more of his wasteland world, Xiaosu wonders: can the powerful and the powerless ever be equals?

title: Melody: The Crazy Flower Blooms
alt_titles: Princess Blooms as a Crazy Flower
Princess Blooms Into a Crazy Flower
description:
An outcast from the imperial family due to her freewheeling attitude and refusal to get married, Princess Melody Corbella wants nothing more than to live life on her own terms and protect the people of the empire. Using her secret powers to sneak out of the palace to influence affairs from behind the scenes, she ends up drawing the attention of the handsome imperial guard, Caisar Bethel. Though she avoided romance until now, could love finally bloom for this crazy flower?
___
“I, Melody Corbella, wish to marry him!” The rest of the table reacted in a cold enough manner for the Princess to feel ashamed, having raised her right arm vigorously with sparkles in her eyes.

And then, Prince Deimos broke the silence to open his mouth, “We must not send a nutcase like her, Your Majesty!!”

It was finally the moment where all of her crazy deeds in the past came to fruition; because the only way she could escape being sent off for Royal Marriage was to throw away the image of a Princess that everyone expected.

She chose to cut her hair short and be reborn as the Crazy Flower in the Royal Palace.

title: Until the Tragic Male Lead Walks Again
alt_titles: Until the Tragic Male Lead Walks Again
A Flowery Road for the Tragedy's Male Lead
A Flowery Path for the Devastated Male Lead
description:
I got reincarnated in a tragedy novel. Just before my favourite character turns into the villain! If this goes on like this, my favourite character will turn into the villain and die. I can’t just let my favourite character die like that, I’ll try my best to save him. But how? By getting married!

---
Countless marriage proposal rejections are nothing for Lamille Claude, a newly reincarnated character in the dark fantasy novel *The Broken Sword*. Her mission is to prevent the male lead, Roel Arnen, from succumbing to all his misery and becoming the story’s villain. To do so, she’ll need to bring him under her protection as her husband until he regains the ability to use his legs and reclaims his former glory. But it isn’t easy considering Roel’s reluctance to accept Lamille’s confessions of love. Will Lamille be able to win Roel’s heart in time to save him from his tragic fate?

title: Monster Child
description:
Not only is Charlotte becoming stronger, but Charlieis also changing…Each of them are missing something the other has… But will they be able to help each other out?  
  
[right]

title: Summer Bloom At The Corner of The Street
alt_titles: Sunflower House of the Street Corner
description: 18-year old He You is about to enter her first year of university. However, shortly after arriving in the new town she was scorned by a strange boy. While she was lost, she was attracted by the scent of flowers and ended up at a florist shop at the corner of the street. She was invited into the shop by a beautiful and enthusiastic woman who hoped she would be a part-timer there. Turns out, the owner’s son was the boy who scorned her. The shop even had the plant that He You saw as a child – a flower which possessed intriguing powers. Could this indifferent boy standing before her be the “magical” boy who helped her when she was little?

title: The Duke Needs His Coffee
alt_titles: I Didn’t Mean to Make Him Obsessed
I Didn't Lull You to Sleep Only for You to Be Obsessed
I Didn't Lull You to Sleep Only for You to Become Obsessed with Me
description:
The protagonist finds herself possessing the body of April, a side character destined to be used by the villain and eventually killed by the male lead. Ignoring the original plot, she resolves to live a quiet life running a café in the countryside.

However, her plans begin to unravel when she discovers that the boy she’s been caring for is actually the nephew the male lead has been desperately searching for.

April ends up becoming the male lead’s personal barista, brewing magical coffee for him every night, and eventually running a café in the capital. She tells herself it’s only until the female lead appears, but as she slowly opens up to the male lead, she finds herself becoming more and more entangled in a life by his side.

title: Rebirth of the Cute Tiger: Great General Wants to Hug
alt_titles: Princess Tigress Reborn: Hug Me General!
description: Following the owner to the battlegrounds, dying on the battlefield, Bai Ying changed from a war tiger into a sickly beauty, and even got married to her master. She transformed from the former ferocious tiger into an adorable one. "Come here, aren't you crawling to my body every day? What are you running for!" In front of all the court councilors, the great general waved towards Bai Ying. "It was obviously you who did not allow me to crawl towards your body…" Bai Ying on one hand mumbled to herself, on the other hand obediently crawled to sit onto the general's thigh. The room filled with the court councilor's looked at each other in dismay, they were getting served dog food by the great general.

title: High School Taoist
alt_titles: High School Life of an Exorcist
description:
A Chinese Taoist monk, He Xun, has his soul reincarnated into the body of a Japanese high school boy. He Xun, now Tanaka Mamoru, uses his cultivation powers to ward off demons.  
  
Among his encounters, a Demon Fox known as Miyazawa Momoko, suffers a humiliating defeat at his hand. Determined to get back at him, Miyazawa transforms into a school girl, and attends classes with Tanaka in an attempt to seduce him.

title: Becoming a Cthulhuian Overlord
description: Qi Su dies and reincarnates as a high school student, reborn with the power to see ghosts and spirits around him. Is he the only one who sees them? In order to survive from man-eating spirits, Qi Su accidentally comes across phantom relics which help him to disguise himself as a ghost, so he can begin exploring the mysterious world of Cthulhu.

title: The Cursed Princess Fell in Love with a Witch?
alt_titles: The Cursed Princess Fell in Love With a Witch
description: The cursed princess has to flee from her castle and into the woods where she meets… a witch?

title: Chief of the Novice Village
description:
I was a perfectly fine necromancer, so how have I ended up becoming the chief of novice village? But, since it's all set in stone, I'll just build a village that has a harem filled with beautiful young girls! Do you have a problem with that? I didn't think so! Let's begin the parallel world's novice village (harem) from scratch...

---
Tai Paer, who's profession, a necromancer, is considered to be one that make it difficult to live a normal life. As he was going to be burned alive by the townsfolk, he's miraculously saved by the system, which is searching for people that fit the job requirement of a Village Chief. Tai Paer starts his new life as the village chief of the novice village and progresses towards building his own harem.

title: Heaven Defying God of War
alt_titles: God of War Against the Sky
description:
Hundred years ago, a generation of God of War Ye Qingyun was born, crushing the sons of various great figures, making the enemy frightened by the wind, but unexpectedly betrayed by his lover Luo Ling, brother wolf thirteen, and falling into the Devil Abyss! A hundred years later, all walks of life entered the golden age, and wicked characters emerged wildly! Ye Qingyun was reborn as a waste disciple of the Ye Family, a small family in the Eight Desolate Continent! Fate is reversed and fate is changed!

In this life, I will not only crush the genius, but also kill all those who bear me! A ruthless sword, a dragon slaying knife, kill everything, unify the gods, dominate all things!

title: Words & Kisses
description:
I wasn't interested in dating… until I met her.  
Just as I was about to get into another ambiguous, half-hearted relationship, I met her. Hyunjin Go, I couldn't take my eyes off her. I had been treading a dull path, and she knocked me right off. Then I felt it- a little piece of my heart, breaking off and slipping away. "She's so pretty…"

title: To You Who Swallowed a Star
alt_titles: To You, Who Kept the Star
To You Who Swallowed the Star
description: The reason why we shine even in the dark reality is that we have different stars. Our growth that shines like a star, and romance

title: Dog Act
description:
When CEO Jung Taeon mentioned he would stay for a month at Yeonghwadang, Sahee didn’t think much of it. He was merely a valued guest who would never get involved with someone as insignificant as her. However, the rude and endlessly arrogant man had a different perspective.

“Yeon Sahee, why don’t we sleep together?”

Sahee felt a mix of discomfort and unease, but his unpredictable demeanor continues to unsettle her..

title: [Master and Servant GL Anthology] Novel-Addicting Knight-nim!
alt_titles: [Master and Servant GL Anthology] Novel-Addicting Knight-nim!
description:
Rosalyn, the Empire’s Strongest Knight… and a Closet Smut Addict?!
At 34, Rosalyn is a legend—hailed as the empire’s greatest knight with goddess-like beauty, unmatched swordsmanship, tactical brilliance, and commanding charisma. But perhaps she was too perfect? Despite her glory, she’s still a virgin… and deeply lonely.
To fill the void, Rosalyn secretly indulges in one guilty pleasure: steamy romance novels—aka smut.
But when she’s suddenly ordered to crush a growing barbarian uprising on the eastern front, her life takes an unexpected turn. Ambushed by a cunning trap, Rosalyn ends up captured by the enemy.
Wait… is this seriously happening?
“Stripped by barbarians… humiliated… could this be—my first time?!”
Just as her imagination runs wild, he appears—Atilla, the fearsome chieftain of the barbarians.
What happens when a smut-obsessed knight meets her fantasy in the flesh?

title: Hongyue Start
description: The moment the red moon appeared in the sky, everyone went crazy. Except for me!

title: The Masters Have Subscribed
description: “Cheong-un, parry the attack! Move faster or the obstacle course will kill you!” The progenitors of the great Wudang sect and the mighty Shaolin encounter post-ascension issues when they find themselves reduced to servants in the godly realm. Their only hope and escape from their divine chores lie in the hands of less-than-average Cheong-un, who can hardly beat his peers in the sect. Can the masters raise an average boy into a master of martial arts and finally relieve themselves of their menial chores?

title: Steel-Eating Player
description: Steel Emperor Hyeonuk Lee, the last savior of humanity, has died. The place he returned to in order to change the future is... the military?!! Why here of all places?! Corporal Hyeonuk Lee's steel eating show begins as he rapidly grows to get revenge!

title: Who Said I'm the Boss
alt_titles: Who Said I Was a Big Shot!
description:
Li Qiyue, only wanted to get married, but with the special ability to refine his daily necessities into magic weapons, he ended up beginning his career as a refiner instead… But wait, why is the protection bureaus main job beating people up? Why did his girlfriend dump him to save the world? And most importantly who said he was the boss?  
(this might be a bad description, but Chinese isn't my first language don't judge plz)

title: Dream of a Girl
description:
A girl wakes up in a foreign world after an accident and is suspected to be the 'dragon priestess.'  
  
**Original Version**  
Season 1: 37 Chapters (Complete) + Epilogue + Afterword  
  
**Remake Version**  
Season 1: 36 Chapters (Complete)  
Season 2: 67 Chapters (Complete)

title: Love Is Not Real
description: After being betrayed by his girlfriend in college, Kihyun spends his days in a lethargic state. One day, the man that his ex-girlfriend cheated on him with, Youngwon comes as a new employee in his company. Kihyun ignores the past because he doesn't want to think about it but then he hears some unexpected things from Youngwon.

title: Moonlight Sculptor (4-Koma)
description: A 4-panel manwha adaptation of the Moonlight Sculptor webtoon, which is based on the popular light novel.

title: Surrender To Love
alt_titles: Feelings Arises When Your Hands Are Tied
description: Officer Cen Jing tracks the ellusive thief, the Queen of Hearts, and lays out a trap for her with other members of the police force. The Queen of Hearts manages to escape, however, Officer Cen is able to track her to her work place: a night club. That's where Cen Jing discovers that the thief is also a dancer, the popular Ji Shuangrong. What other twists and turns await them...

title: How to Break up in a Romance Simulation
alt_titles: Ways to Break up With the Male Lead
How to Safely Break up With the Male Leads
How to Break up With That Man
description: Lee Young-Ah, a layoff expert at global company Rigveda, immerses herself in a love simulation game with her favorite character! But all the male lead targets are in a relationship with her, and her favorite character is far from being a fling. Unintentionally, Young-Ah comes up with an idea. Making use of the ability of a lay-off expert to break up with the male leads. Will Young-ah be able to make a safe separation and get her hands on her favorite character, Ren Brecht?

title: Prefectural Circle of Friends (Remastered)
description: Zheng Qian, an ordinary college student, accidentally found a second-hand copycat phone. When he opened the phone and found that WeChat could connect with the local government circle of friends, he felt that the world was exceptionally beautiful.

title: My Influencer Boyfriend
description:
Nan-ge is a popular youtuber about to reach 300,000 subs. But there’s a problem plaguing him… his subscriber count is stalling at 299,000! At his wit’s end, he takes up a friend’s suggestion and tries collaborating with another popular influencer - Prince Mengtai. On-screen, Mengtai's pretty face and cute personality has captured the hearts of young girls everywhere. But in reality, Mengtai's personality is - !?  


---

[Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/guiyuy)  
[Bookwalker Taiwan](https://www.bookwalker.com.tw/product/93501)  
[Official Website](https://www.tongli.com.tw/WebPages/book/TC0407001A/TC0407001A.htm)

title: I Ran Away and Got Married
description:
“You’re mine.”

When Raphia met her demise after having been used and thrown away by her benefactor, Yuri, she went back nine years in the past.

‘I’m not going to relive that hell!’

Running away from her benefactor, she went to Kasein Soleia, Yuri’s archnemesis, and signed a new sponsorship contract with him.

“I shall kill every single person you despise, Milord.”

“The necessary role happens to be open, and you might just be the right person for it.”

Young Duke. This is a sponsorship contract, right? But why . . . why are we getting married?

===

“Throughout the time I won’t be by your side . . . I will think of nothing but your small, cute head.”

That low voice sent shivers down her spine.

“I can’t believe you’re leaving. I’ll just . . .”

Kasein looked at her sharply as if he was daring her to continue making up excuses.

“You have to answer well, brat. Depending on what you say, all the wagon and shoe craftsmen of the Empire might lose their livelihood.”

Despite his harsh words, Kasein’s touch was gentle. He couldn’t take his eyes off of Raphia, who strangely grew more beautiful by the day.

---

title: Lord Demon King Always Teases Me
alt_titles: Mo Wang Da Ren Zong Liao Wo
Mó Wáng Dà Rén Zǒng Liāo Wǒ
description: He Mian, a college student who has social anxiety, cleared his favorite game for the 100th time. Gareth, the devil of the game, accidentally transmigrated into the modern world where He Mian was. He Mian is determined to let the devil return to the game as soon as possible. In order to get rid of Gareth's pranks and entanglement, the two must collect magical artifacts from the game which has been spread across the world when Gareth was traversing.

title: Don't Forget These Feelings
alt_titles: Don't Forget That I Like You
description: "Handsome people are the best!" Jiho caught Jungmin's eye- a returning student at the freshmen welcoming party… Be it for women or men, Jungmin is actually a major Ul-ppa* (*Korean slang for someone who is weak for beautiful and handsome people) and he finds Jiho extremely attractive. That was the extent of their first meeting, but for some reason, their strings of fate kept getting tangled with each other?!

title: Soul Cartel
description: When Shihoon was a child, his exorcist parents vanished in a fight with underworld spirits. After Shihoon has a chance encounter with the devil Mephisto, he somehow ends up contracted as the next judge for the legendary fight between archdevil Mephisto and the human, Faust. Along with his exorcist older sister, Shihoon enters the underworld to fulfill his contract and search for clues of his parents' disappearance.

title: Reborn as a Swordmaster
alt_titles: The Return of the Prodigious Swordmaster
description:
Yuma the eunuch devotedly served Empress Hela Rosé, but his life and the empire fall apart when she goes insane. Determined to discover what led to this, Yuma eats magic berries to go 40 years into the past and nurtures his skills as a swordmaster, which he couldn't do as a eunuch. 

Armed with memories and new abilities, he tries to prevent the horrors of the previous timeline. But will such big changes lead to his desired outcome, or will Yuma learn that the past isn't meant to be tampered with?

title: Eunsoo's Good Day
description: Mom suddenly wants to remarry, but the man she's dating… he has twin sons?    Do the brothers know about my confused feelings when they tell me they like me?    Since we’ll be a family soon, we should try to get along, but…    This is way past being close. Don't you think we're being too open with each other?

title: The Reset Life of a Game Addict
description:
Jinho Lee has just completed the ultimate challenge in the game Reset Life, where he had to experience all 99 possible endings to reach the final victory. After six years of intense gameplay, he feels a sense of achievement—but also an overwhelming emptiness. With nothing left to conquer in the game, Jinho finds himself at a loss, unsure of what to do next.

However, this feeling of burnout becomes the catalyst for an even greater transformation. Suddenly, Jinho’s life is reset in ways he never imagined—he becomes the top scorer in the nation, a model, a chef, and even a celebrity. What once seemed like distant dreams are now his new reality. But with this newfound success comes the question: is this truly the life he wanted?

title: Love Is a Cherry Color
description: He knows her secret. She knows his secret too. He is the coolest guy in school. She is the curve wrecker of class. They make a deal in exchange to keep each other's secret. They should be strangers after that promise. But he offers to help her confess to her crush at the same time. Is that true? Is he just teasing her? Or...?

title: Bewitched Brothers
description: It's been written in the laws of the universe that witches are unable to change their fates, and yet always change the fates of others. however, with the help of a mysterious potion and a limited relationship, Seo Moran, a descendant of a witch, manages to bewitch two brothers and change her fate.

title: The Dominator of the Underworld
alt_titles: Chengwei Yincao Difu De Zhipei Zhe
Chéngwéi Yīncáo Dìfǔ De Zhīpèi Zhě
Becoming the Ruler of the Underworld
description: Your sins of past, present, and future, who can you blame but yourself? In the Court of the Underworld, never have a sinner gone unpunished! And now, you are here~

title: Her Ladyship Objects to This Marriage!
alt_titles: The Princess Doesn't Want to Marry Her Ideal Type
description:
Lady Kyriel, the strong-willed commandant of the Alteion Empire, does not want to get married. However, when she finds herself in an arranged union, she is surprised to find that it is with a cordial but mysterious sorcerer named Idwin. He somehow checks all her boxes-the boxes she made sure were impossible to check. Kyriel's unbreakable vow and Idwin's inescapable fate take them on a journey to their higher purpose-one that involves the past and future of empires and churches.

---
"My youngest daughter."

"Yes, Father."

<Condition 1. They must have silver hair that resembles moonlight and have elegant blue green eyes. Condition 2. A gentle and kind personality is a given but they must also have a side to them where sometimes they posses a bored and dangerous atmosphere as if everything is annoying. Condition 3. He must have a talent he is so good at that he could be considered the best in the empire for it. Condition 4. It's no fun if I can see everything, so he has some secrets.>

"This Father swears. That at any cost I'll find your particular, complicated, and confusing ideal type!"

"Yes, Father."

The third Duchess Kiriel Empoleon of the empire's greatest knight family Empoleon, while responding without interest, thought, 'As if a person like that would exist when in the first place I made up that ideal type because I don't want to get married."

But Kiriel overlooked two things. The first, her romantic father, if it's about his children, his spirit blazes with passion, and the second, in Condition 3, she didn't write exactly what kind of talent he must posses.

"My youngest! This Father of yours! Finally in 10 years! Your ideal type! I found them of course!"

At that, "Almost 300 years ago in the holy war! Although he's a sorcerer, who were the enemy of knights!"

"I'm going to go lose my mind."

"Huh?"

"Nothing."

The mess that I made, I have to clean it up,.

"Relel, relellellou."

"It's read Edwin Solite Reli-ge-use."

"Relige... Anyways, why are you in here?!"

First, I need to chase out that person with the hard name. 

The story of a woman who asked for a fake ideal type, and a man who is pretending to be that fake ideal type.

title: Geu Fantasy Segyeeseo Saneun Beop
alt_titles: How to Survive in a Fantasy World
description: A story about the citizens who have forgotten about the pain of the war that happened one hundred years ago when the hero defeated the evil king.

title: Little Lady Mint
description: Mint, the most miserable girl in the orphanage. Everyday she received all kinds of abuse and she suffered through it, but one day a gentleman appeared in the orphanage and said, "I'll take this child." The man who became the supporter of Mint, is a great aristocrat of Elkedonia… 'Is it okay for me to stay here?' Mint who was an orphan girl turned to a little princess...

title: You’re Under My Skin!
description: Nuri hasn’t changed much since she was in elementary school. She still has a temper, she still lives in the same house, and she’s still tragically short. Her childhood friend Homil, however, has changed a lot. Several years after he moved away, Homil returns as Nuri’s neighbor and high school classmate. Now, he’s not quite the same boy Nuri used to know. Sure, he’s still an idiot and a good friend, but something feels different, and Nuri is all too aware of it in a more-than-friendly way. She might not be growing any taller, but maybe some weird feelings about Homil are growing inside of her…

title: Terror vs Revival
description: The terror man and the revival man finally meet. "Destruction is the beginning of resurrection". The whole world is in danger with the birth of a new evil. Min Jung-woo has the ability to see misfortune and Seok-hwan has the ability to come back to life. The two heroes made different choices…Who will be the final victor?

title: Vampire Sphere
description:
The story about 3 sisters and their involvement in the world of vampires & hunters…  
  
"9 years ago, 3 seeds were planted, and now they turn into 3 roses.  
Behind the girls have been chosen, their wings of destiny open.  
Bloodlines and hunters, roses and demons, love is like a symphony playing a melancholy tune."

title: The Most Talented Woman in the World
alt_titles: The Most Educated Woman in the World
description: God knows who once said that "To be a scholar is to be at the top of society", making the entire Feng Dynasty give up on martial arts to focus on education and they even opened the imperial exams to women! As the least literate of her time, the martial artist's daughter, Cheng Manyi, decided to pretend to be an educated lady to fulfill her father's wish for her to marry a scholar—— As a result, many famous scholarly families came to ask for her hand in marriage and now, her husband expects her to succeed the exams and bring honor to his household!

title: How to Prey on Your Master
description:
Dame Elle, the deputy commander of the Order of November, has her heart broken when she discovers her fiancé is in love with someone else. After a night of heavy drinking to wash away the pain, she wakes up the next morning in the bed of Sir Theodore, more widely known as the kingdom’s mad dog! Adding more to the confusion, Theodore keeps calling Elle his “master” and has been appointed as the deputy commander’s aide without her knowledge. But despite his wolfish reputation, Theodore acts oddly tame when it comes to the dame he serves. Just what intentions could this knight be hiding behind his sharp-toothed grin?

---
Elle Louise Therese was the most outstanding knight of the Raun Empire. At a party, she witnessed the affair of her fiancé and called off their engagement. El, who's in deep sorrow due to the shock, lost consciousness and collapsed. And the next morning, Elle faced an unexpected person. It's Theodore, who's famous for his crazy dog nickname! But somehow, Theodore was too polite in front of her?!

---

title: The Daily Lives of Ghosts
description: In the center of Samdochundong, a town famous of its ghost stories, the common tenants’ daily life gag.

title: Villainous Demon Son-in-Law
description: Ordinary student Yayoi, because a thousand years ago, he was kind to Xiangliu, he had a marriage affair with the daughter of Xiangliu family. Reluctantly, the Xiangliu family had to let him enter the demon den and become a son-in-law. From then on, the group of demons often accompanied him. At the pinnacle of life, he was even involved in the "longevity" storm. Everyone wanted to live forever. Everyone wanted to ascend. The biggest secret was hidden in him as a mortal. Relying on the soaring secret, Yayoi stepped on the demon clan and leaned on the town demon division with her back, and became a big villain who demon cried out.

title: This Star
description: Fei Yu Bei Tang, who was the heir of the Yanye royal family, was born and lost in the civil strife. Bei Tang had many near-death experiences and separations from loved ones, and after many times became numb to saying farewell. When Bei Tang felt as if all hope was dashed to pieces, the enemy country refugees adopted Bei Tang. The last descendants of the royal families reformed themselves, and intertwined with one another in the net woven by the bloody feud between the two countries and the redemption of familial love. To protect the beloved one, Bei Tang regained hope and embarked the way to redemption.

title: Inattentional Blindness
description: To unravel the curse of the Three God’s Grandma, Seah’s high school life will be full of ups and downs!

title: The Boss Is Too Much!!!
description: Taeho, a top, has a wet dream about being on bottom! To get rid of the restless state this put him in, he decides that he needs a relationship. Following his friend into a club, he meets a guy with a nice body, just like in that dream. "But… why am I beneath him again?!"

title: Drunken Truth
description:
Gitaek always dreamed of being in a relationship with someone who’s his ideal preference: caring, thoughtful and has a good body. After being absent for a while, he goes to his club’s meeting room and finds a new student—Jungwoo—who fits this preference and ends up confessing to Jungwoo while he’s drunk. Jungwoo is touched and a little flustered by the first confession he has ever received but, while getting to know each other, Jungwoo finds out that Gitaek’s drinking habit is confessing…  
  
Can the two have a happy ending after an unintended push and pull?

title: There's Nothing Else to Eat but You
description: 200 years ago. The great Demon King Leo, who was trying to destroy the world, was sealed away by the hand of a mighty hero. Soon, the world was restored and peace came. 200 years peacefully passed by. "I waited 200 years to get my revenge on you. Now, please die and let me absorb you and regain my full power." Broke free from his seal, Leo found Fresia. A girl with an uncanny resemblance of the Hero 200 years ago. "200 years? But I'm only 20 years old." Okay, so basically speaking, one thing lead to another and somehow he ended up as her full-time housekeeper?!

title: Vampire Heart
description:
Dokyung who happened to run into Hajin, whose clothes and lips were covered with blood, ran away in surprise, but gets caught. In this moment of danger, a cat appears and thanks to that, Dokyung runs away from Hajin and frees himself safely.   
  
In the next day, Dokyung, who was still upset over the things that happened the day before, runs into Hajin by chance again. In the end, as he got caught by Hajin again, he reveals his name and even his class number, Dokyung returns to his own dormitory while shaking in nervousness….  
  
But what's this? His dorm roommate was changed to Hajin?!

title: The World's Best Kunlun Tavern
description:
From MangaUdates:

Finally, Byeokwu has mastered it—the Sacred Art of Grand Clarity, one of the most precious arts of the Gonryun Clan. But nothing he learned in seclusion could’ve prepared him to understand the state of things one hundred years later. Leaving his clan behind, Byeokwu starts a new life as a chef at the Gonryun Tavern, determined to help the owner turn a profit. And if his noodles are good enough to tempt the Divine Demon of the Bloody Heaven into changing his ways? Surely, there are worse things.

title: Sugar Daddy
description:
How pure and selfless it is to love someone… a calculative person will never know. Or perhaps, seizing territory, scheming and lying is all because of how much I love you.  
  
Français :  
Aimer quelqu'un, c'est si pur et si oublieux, les personnes qui se servent des gens  
ne pourront jamais ressentir ça. Calcul, tromperie tout ça parce que je t'aime beaucoup plus.

title: How to Raise a Demon King's Child
description: This is a story of a "jack of all trades millionaire who hates a baby to death" & a "only good at babysitting woman" happen to meet each other and raise a baby together… But wait, it turns out that the baby is actually a demon's child that will destroy the world?!

title: I Hold the Heart of a Tyrant
description:
The Crown Prince’s only friend, me, Euseniel Heartland.

One day, our family was expelled from the capital for having had a bad influence on the Crown Prince. But after 14 years, we finally reunite, However,  he has changed drastically.

When asked why he changed, the Crown Prince answers that it is because he wanted to be the ideal man for me. But no, this is not the friend I used to know anymore, And it's not only his appearance what has changed, I'm sure there something else on the inside that's not the same as before. What could it be?

title: Into the Net!
description: Lu Yi Fan, a dedicated basketball player, has successfully graduated from his delinquent-filled middle school and entered high school believing that he has escaped from the terrors of delinquents. But who would have known that the basketball team in his new school was composed of juvenile delinquents?

title: Sister, Stop Messing With Me!
description: Wang Zhexing is someone who graduated from university recently. On his way to work, he was ambushed by numerous girls of unknown identity one after another. The assailants though, did not demand money from him. Apparently, their objective was to do something ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) with him. Just when he could no longer hold off their "attacks" of throwing themselves at him, a girl named Mulian appeared. According to her, she came in order to stop other woman from robbing him of his virginity…… And that everything began from a single Task4Reward phone APP called "Handsome Reward".

title: Friendly Rivalry
description:
Seulgi was no.1 in her old suburban school. Now, having transferred to the prestigious Chaehwa Girls’ High in Seoul, she must engage in fierce, friendly competition with her rich and talented rival Jay.
(Source: YLab)

---

title: Dokgo 2
description: The sequel to Dokgo! After getting revenge for his older brother, a new story begins for Kang Hyuk.

title: I Suspect He Might Like Me
alt_titles: I Think He Might Like Me
description: I think he might like me, but is it overthinking or is it actually the truth…?

title: Marry Me, α
description: Due to a huge debt, SeoWon (a Recessive Alpha) is a scholarship student in college by day, and serves guests as a barman by night. When he sees HeeYeon - a college student from his year (and a Dominant Alpha) - at the bar, SeoWon freaks out. And to top it all off, SeoWon is even more freaked out when HeeYeon says he’ll give him a large sum of money if he sleeps with him?!

title: Ayeshah's Secret
description:
A tragic young girl whose mother died giving birth to her…   
  
A wicked stepmother and three brothers with whom she shares no blood ties…  
  
Murderous intent born from avarice and twisted emotions.  
  
Secrets woven with betrayal, terror, deceit, love, death and vengeance… All buried deep within Ayeshah's Forest, shrouded in darkness.

title: The Husky and His White Cat Shizun
alt_titles: Er Ha He Ta De Bai Mao Shi Zun
Dumb Husky and His White Cat Shizun
description: The emperor of the cultivation world, Mo Weiyu, had deceived elders and slaughtered ancestors, committing every crime and sin known to humanity. After taking his own life, he was reborn into the year where he first became a disciple. The body of youth contained the soul of an old man. After returning to life, truths that had been hidden beneath the surface during his previous life were unearthed one after another. Among those revelations, the one that left him most stunned was that the shizun who he had hated to the bone during his previous life had actually always been secretly protecting him from the shadows...The heart of one can change, and even ghosts and demons can repent, but his sins weigh heavy. Can he ever wash clean the blood on his hands?

title: Transmoe Sword Fantasy
description: Hello everyone, My Name is A (Last name is A) Xiuluo... I am a swordsman, and my duty is to kill monstrous creatures. My special ability is... I can turn enemies I've defeated into girls.

title: Martial Arts of Demonic Humans
description: One day, a girl appeared out of nowhere claiming to be an exorcist and turning Liu Yanhui’s regular school life upside down. Ever since his troubles began to continuously plague him, his parents were critically injured by demons and even his childhood rival became an exorcist's target. Eventually, the city he has been living in is at risk due to his presence there… How will a young man with a demonic parasite growing in him survive this world?

title: The Legendary Otaku Hermit
description: The senior apprentice who practices the Emotionless Tao, Mo Huang, feels bored because he's too strong, so he went to the secular world to experience more, but unexpectedly he became an absolute otaku!?

title: Duke Richard's Haven
alt_titles: Time to Dedicate for Your Death
description:
She died when she was forty years old, what she saw when she opened her eyes was a small hand. Illian Heinrich, an old mercenary, had gone back ten years and became a twelve-year-old child, Haven Winter.

"Because you are not Illian Heinrich."

Julius had built a solid door. That door was only for Illian Heinrich, not for Haven Winter.

"What the hell is Illian Heinrich to you?"

Illian didn't understand him. What is it to him that a forty-year-old woman who used to work as a mercenary, often called lowly, is waiting for him? Illian Heinrich in this. Maybe he's acting like he can't live without Illian. Julius slowly turned and looked at Illian. His dry eyes sank as if they couldn't contain anything.

With those eyes on the subject, Julius said, "My everything."

title: Criminal Interview
description:
Jonathan helps his brother interview a serial killer, but little does he know that said killer has a special interest in him…  
  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: I Took Over the Demonic Ancestor
alt_titles: Wo Duo Shele Modao Zu Shiye
Wǒ Duó Shěle Módào Zǔ Shīyé
I Have Possessed the Patriarch of the Demonic Path
I Have Become The Demonic Ancestor
description: The young man accidentally took over the world’s most demonic ancestor, but unexpectedly lost all his power due to the thousand-year limit. Faced with the sect split and the siege of the righteous sect, if you want to reverse the situation, you must complete the tasks issued by the absolute domain system, and those tasks are all good deeds!?

title: Childhood Friend Channel!
description:
<幼なじみチャンネル>

幼なじみをV-Tuberにするラブコメディ。

title: This Life's Universal Superstar
alt_titles: In This Life, the Greatest Star in the Universe
I'm Going to Be a Big Star
description: Hard-pressed to find good luck in this universe, Sun Woojoo gives up on his dream of becoming an idol in favor of living a normal life. That is, until he finds himself waking up from a car accident on his exam day! But as luck would have it, Woojoo can now copy any move exactly as he sees it, and his two left feet that kept him from debuting are now moving to the beat! With this newfound skill, will Woojoo be able to turn things around and become the star that shines the brightest on stage?

title: Here Comes the Queen
alt_titles: She Is Coming, Please Get Down!
description:
The infamous actress fell into the sea and came back like a different person. She was originally weak and vulnerable, but now she's most feared killer. Transforming from an unskillful actress to a movie queen, she receives respect from everyone.

Unspoken rules? You'd better ask how much money your company owns? Movie queen? I was only acting for fun. I didn't know I would win all the awards. Fighting scumbags? That's what I'm really good at. Don't be too weak.
I enjoy the screaming coming out of your throat. I come back in the name of the God of Death!

title: Peerless Saint Emperor
description: In a low-level continent called The Spirit Continent (or Phantom Continent), Zheng Tian was the heir to Huyan Jueluo family, with exceptional talent, and had always been arrogant. Until one day, the Heavenly Palace Azure Dragon Sacred Beast sent out a message that there was a artifact, a magic weapon, and the nine star skill in the Spirit continent. As a result, the major powers of the world entered the Spirit continent and sent their respective young disciples to search for the treasures. As the disciples of the super sects interfered with the local powers and supported them as puppets, Zheng Tian's location, the Huyan Jueluo family, was tragically destroyed. Zheng Tian took his sister, Yue Xin, and fled all the way….

title: Becoming a Family With the Duke and His Dear Son
alt_titles: The Male Lead's Father Refuses to Break off Our Engagement
The Male Lead's Dad Refuses to Breakup
description: After her transmigration into the body of a villainess, Ibellia Barnein made it her first goal to call off the contractual marriage that would lead to her untimely death. Try as she might to avoid the cold duke and his son, however, they appear in front of Ibellia time and time again. Can she break her role as the evil stepmother? Or are the novel's events doomed to pass despite her best efforts?

title: LESSA 2 - The Crimson Knight
description: A year has passed since the Demans took over the island. The humans await a savior. A tale of a crimson knight that appears before them.

title: The Reborn Witch Raises a Templar
alt_titles: Zhuǎnshēng Mónǚ Yǎng Chéngle Shèng Diàn Qíshì
The Reincarnated Witch Became a Templar
description: One day, she finds herself reborn as Nilce Glory, the main character in a revenge novel and the strongest witch around—a title she earned by single-handedly taking down the Church. Despite being determined to leave all her grudges behind and face the miserable life she's supposed to have, she ends up saving Jarvil, the templar who's fated to kill her later on in the novel.  What was a brief moment of softheartedness has now become a major lifelong headache. And why is the usually cold-hearted Jarvil from the novel acting so clingy now?

title: Heaven's Souls
description: The world has plunged into a new threat. Alien creatures are wreaking havoc and there is only one team who can stop them. This is the story of valiant heroines fighting against these alien foes. Want to know more?Stay tuned, get ready, and watch them battle on!

title: Quadruple Courtship
description:
A story about the heroine of the story, Li, who suddenly becomes popular, and the quadruplet brothers who are pursuing her at the same time.

title: Energy Hunters
description: Gu Xinghe is a high school student with few words. After a mysterious bloody red rain, he suddenly found he became the target of a group of monstrous creatures, "the Death Disciples." Whatsmore, his beloved friend Lu Yang fell into a coma on his birthday from the monsters' attack, while Xinghe was saved by a girl with tremendous power. To save his friend, Xinghe joined the "Energy Hunters" academy that the girl attends, and start training to fight the "Death Disciples" and other dark powers.

title: Looking for a New Husband
alt_titles: I'm Looking for a New Husband
description:
Riat, caught up in her husband's treason, faces death.

After repeatedly returning to the past at the cost of half her lifespan, she finally breaks the cycle by offering her husband’s head to the emperor.

With only 1 year and 3 months left to live, her one wish is—

"I’m going to fall in love."

At last, an announcement spreads across the entire empire: a competition to find Riat’s new husband, with a grand prize of 1 billion gold.

Candidates begin to flood in, but suspicious figures also start gathering around her…

title: Two-Faced Princess
alt_titles: The Other Face of the Princess
description:
“Your Majesty, please call off my engagement with Her Highness, Princess Apolonia. I fell in love with Adriene Rhys.”

Six engagements, six breakups. The princess' fiancés always have an affair with her maids!

“I don’t want to marry a prince, I want to live with you, Father.”

“How useless. Leave!”

Apolonia, a princess who is known to be weak and stupid. However, she has a hidden side to her...

“Because the throne is not easily obtained, my father spent 10 years trying to kill my mother and the Emperor.”

Apolonia grinned, while her red eyes shone brightly. Usurping the throne. Her goal was clear and she never shook.

'I want to live with my father... To be precise, I want to live where my father sits. Just wait, Father. Your daughter is on her way... to get back everything that was stolen from her.'

---
Princess Apollonia may seem weak and dim-witted, but the truth is, she’s not as clueless as she seems. She must keep up her act of ignorance to foil her cruel father’s political schemes and weave her way out of his arranged marriages. Her ultimate objective is to avenge the deaths of her mother and grandfather and shape her own destiny! With a few secret powers, a handful of trustworthy allies, and some schemes of her own... will Princess Apollonia successfully reclaim her throne as the rightful heir?

title: The Best Worker
description: Li Qing, a small maintenance worker, was trying to live a honest life and doing a honest job. but he was inexplicably involved in a big family’s struggle. Whatsmore he had a terrifying secret of his own…

title: I Am Not Your Enemy
description: Mi Yo-Chu, the second daughter of the general, was betrayed and killed by the Ding Palace's prince, Su Bu-Xiao, and her personal maid in her previous life and gets a chance to be reborn. "This time, I will protect those dear to me and not repeat the same mistakes twice." Despite that, she gets into the same scenario as when she fell for Su Bu-Xiao in her past life. Though this time, the so-called sophisticated young master seems to have changed, like he got a lot… dumber? He also clung to Mi Yo-Chu like crazy. That's because…the person currently inside of Su Bu-Xiao's body is a reincarnator from the 21st century! and currently he's trying to trigger the first event for meeting his capture target: the player gets in danger and is saved by the capture target, disregarding her own life. And so, he tangled a snake around his neck.

title: Arknights: Angelina - Sketches of this Messenger's Journey
alt_titles: Arknights - Angelina - Sketches of THIS Messenger's Journey

title: Lies Like Lies
description:
Let's play "True or False".  
  
We're partners. That's true. Partners are more connected with each other than with anyone else in this world, we trust each other our lives. That is true, too. There's no secrets between us… That is a lie.   
  
I have terrible nightmares from my childhood and a heavy burden of guilt. And how about you? When you touch me with this icy look, with these icy fingers… What kind of lie do you hide from me?

description: Two schools girls meet on a Summer Night.

title: Egret: The Great Sage
description:
A master elementalist, Egret lived his entire life in the company of elemental spirits, having felt shunned by human society for his immense power. After his death, he is reborn as the young prince Judas, a social outcast bullied for his quietness and small frame. With his trusty spirits by his side, Egret enters the elite academy Ruvar-H, where he must make friends and turn Judas’ reputation around. But with danger from his past life following him, can this great sage make it in the real world?

title: There's No Way My Delinquent is This Cute
description:
He’s the school’s top delinquent. Just like the devil, that boy would always torment me and giving me nothing but trouble. That was until one day when I cursed inside my heart in irritation, that delinquent soon got into a car accident and passed away. 

I felt guilt over his death ever since that day. However, one fateful night, I woke up from a nightmare and what greeted me was a pair of glaring eyes that undeniably belongs to that devil delinquent?! Wait a minute, how come he’s in the size of a doll?!   

"Hey. The one who cursed me was you, right?" Even if you say that to me, you're not even scary at all. In fact, you’ve become cute instead.  
The delinquent and the girl who seeks to reverse this situation. This is their sweet, war-like, fantasy romance.

title: Plug in
description:
Han Taejun is a famous bully in the school, but he is popular because of his height and good looks.  
He has a crush on 'Jisook', a girl he encountered on a school trip.  
Lovesick, he scavenged all over the school chasing her trail, but he couldn't find her.  
Somehow he is annoyed by Jiwoon, who is in the same class, because he looks very similar to "that girl."  
But… she's the same person as him!  


---
