- [Alternative English (HoneyToon)](https://honeytoon.com/comic/my-sister-is-a-big-star)

title: When I Woke Up, I Became A Bagel Girl!
alt_titles: Eoneu Nal Jameseo Kkaeeoboni Bagelyeoga Doeeo Isseotda
description:
A Korean NEET who lives day to day playing games turned into a girl all of sudden! What will he do?  
  
Bagel is Korean slang for a girl with a baby face and a glamorous (sexy) body. Many Korean idols are popular for this reason.

title: Big Life
description:
life of pain and misery  
until came a miracle no would believe   
this is a story about how the poor, unpopular author's life flipped upside down for the better.

title: Together With Woo Rae
description: Rae rejects an invitation to go to a semester-end party from the most popular student on campus, Sungwoon, But what happens when Rae's new part-time job is at a strange bunny boy costume bar… and his customer is a drunk Sungwoon?!

title: Dr. Frost
description: Genius psychologist works as psychologist.

title: Nine Lives Man
description: Chang Sheng's adaption of "Nine Lives Man" is here for the 30th anniversary! The story follows Meng Jiu Ge (Nine Lives Meng) as what seems like a chance encounter with a homeless man leads him to understand that his life is only one of many He will live as he tries to understand the destruction of the city and those mysterious masked people that visited him.

title: Black Knight
description:
While most people avoid the suffocating pollution covering the world… Deliverymen press on, so the citizens can get the packages they desperately need. They are known… as the Delivery Knights!
___
Devastating air pollution and severe social divide between residents and refugees. A corrupt, unforgiving and violent social order. This is the world Sawol was born into. After watching the police massacre her mother and adopted family simply because they were refugees, Sawol holds a deep seeded rage and fear of the police. Sawol believes that becoming a delivery agent is the only means to liberate herself, but can she beat the odds stacked up against her to become one?

title: Would You Like to Sign the Contract?
description: "This is for the Chairman. Is there a problem with that?" These words came back like a dagger, and that day, I died. And I came back to life. From Yoon Suk, who was the director of the best real estate investment company in South Korea, to Kim Dong-kyu, who was a loner, as well as a loser. Momentary frustration, I rose again for revenge. Wait for me. I'll make sure to make them pay for what they did to me. Today, I plan as Yoon Suk and execute as Kim Dong-kyu. For the sake of our revenge.

title: Ultimate Path Martial Arts
description:
Yue Bing is brought back to 2008, time to learn martial arts from an ancient master, open a martial arts dojo, and get disciples!   
Brazilian jiu jitsu, Russian Sambo, American boxing, Japanese judo, anyone who wants to spar is free to come and issue a challenge.  
Who says Chinese kungfu is dead, the master is still yet to come, Chinese Kungfu Forever!!!

title: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die
alt_titles: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die
description:
In pursuit of a natural death, Silvia reluctantly agrees to a strategic marriage. To deceive the gods, she must convincingly play the role of a married couple.

"Shall we turn off the lights then?"
"Why would we...?"
"Don't we have to consummate our marriage on the first night?"
"Why is that necessary?"

Isn't my husband too conservative?

Silvia, who yearns for a chance to die, and Randal, who struggles with conflicting emotions, embark on an unexpected healing romance.

title: Siren's Song
description:
One snowy evening out on the terrace, Luan hears Yul singing and is immediately captivated by his voice. Luan is surprised to see his own honest reaction, while Yul is surprised by the simple fact that he was heard by another human being. To what lengths will Luan go to claim Yul for himself…?  
  
An enchanting new story by "Jazz for Two" creator Clarju.

title: Here Comes the Fiancée!
description: His fiancee lost her parents so she will be living with the Hyuns, but Sang-Won is a middle schooler and the fiancee is a 24-year-old adult!? Sang-Won tries to deny that his fiancee is 9 years older than him, but seeing that she does not act her age, he then feels comfortable around her. The fiancee seems kind and innocent on the outside, but on the inside…

title: The Reluctant Demon Cult Leader
alt_titles: The Demonic Cult Leader Is Too Reluctant
description:
The leader of the demonic cult is a formidable entity that everyone is afraid of. 

However, while the demonic cult members expect him to exude great violence, the new Demonic Cult Leader, Do Yu-gang, wishes to live a simple and peaceful life. 

Will his modest wish be granted in the end?

title: 10 Years in Friend Zone
description: Geralmente, quando uma pessoa é rejeitada depois de admitir seus sentimentos para alguém, a rejeitada tentará seguir em frente. Eles certamente não permanecem amigos ... A menos que você seja Shiho e Yul. Os dois nasceram no mesmo dia e há dez anos frequentam as mesmas escolas. Eles também estão jogando um joguinho onde Shiho confessa seus sentimentos por Yul, e Yul diz a ele para se esforçar mais. O resultado? Shiho se tornou um aluno perfeito, e todas as garotas da escola gostam dele. Mas agora os dois começaram o ensino médio juntos e parece que o pequeno "jogo" que eles jogaram pode ter mais jogadores. As regras estão mudando rapidamente - é tarde demais para algo mais acontecer entre Shiho e Yul?

title: Absolute Territory
description: A female college student's secret which she cannot reveal… That is, wearing a high school uniform and taking a picture! Chemistry unfolds between the female college senior wearing a high school uniform and a male nurse resulting in an explosive romance!

title: Don't Provoke a Reborned Bamboo Horse
alt_titles: Don't Provoke the Reborn Bamboo Horse
description:
Qiao Yu, the man I humbly guarded for more than 10 years, unexpectedly cheated in front of me!   
This is not the worst part. While I was fleeing from the difficult situation, I had an accident with the elevator. I fell into darkness together with the elevator. When I woke up again, I'm back to where I first meet him!   
Qiao Yu, if I'm unable to avoid meeting you once again, I'll make sure to protect my heart and never to fall in love with you again! Remember!   
It's not wise to provoke your bamboo horse.  
  
Español  
Yu Qiao, el hombre al que he estado protegiendo humildemente durante más de diez años, ¡me engañó delante de mí! Eso no fue lo peor de todo. Mientras huía desesperadamente, tuve un accidente en el ascensor. Caí en la oscuridad junto con el ascensor. ¡Al despertar de nuevo, había regresado al momentos antes de conocerlo! Yu Qiao, si realmente no puedo evitar encontrarme contigo de nuevo, me aseguraré de proteger mi corazón y de no enamorarme otra vez de ti. ¡Nunca más tendré nada que ver contigo! ¡Recuerda! ¡No hay que meterse con tu caballo de bambú!  
  


---

title: Tower of God: Urek Mazino
description:
Before he became a legend, before the Tower trembled at his name—

Urek Mazino was just another Regular, climbing the Tower for a purpose greater than power: To chase after the enigmatic being, Phantaminum.

This is the untold story of Urek’s early days— his trials, battles, and relentless spirit as a chosen Regular. Witness the rise of the man who would one day shake the very foundations of the Tower itself. The legend of Urek Mazino begins here.

title: Umbrella Girl Dreams
description: All things created in this world have their own purpose. For some, their true purpose can only be served in death. A person's treasured possession can have a soul and take the form of a human, but what if they were to be abandoned? A masterless Object Spirit can only wander the earth until eventually they too turn to dust in the wind…

title: Number One Beast Master
description: A global anomaly has occurred, and monsters have invaded. Monster trainers now bear the burden of saving human civilization. After Xiao Xingyu crosses over, he awakens the “God-tier Monster Training System”. By opening the Eye of the Demonic God, he can see through all hidden evolution paths of monsters, activate their hidden bloodlines, and unlock infinite evolution… A husky can evolve into the Hellhound! A fairy can mutate into the Twelve-Winged Blazing Angel! Hatching a dragon egg can summon the Nine-Spirited Candle Dragon!”

title: Imperial Master
description: Wu Xunmei and Xuan Jihua were the leaders of two enemy clans. They were brought together by fate and became lovers. However, they were both bound by the hatred of their clans and Wu Xunmei was forced to kill Xuan Jihua. Unexpectedly, Xuan Jihua was reborn. In this lifetime, can the two’s love bloom?

title: Autumn Wind and Rain
alt_titles: Qiu Yu Luo Feng: Shanzhai Dage Chengzhang Ji
description:
Zhang Luofeng is just trying to live a peaceful life - all he wants is to fit in at school and make friends! He even has a crush on Yin Qiuqiu, the beautiful but cold Student Council member. The only problem? He’s the young master of the Sui Feng Clan!   
A tale about the ups and downs of high school life, Autumn Winds is about fighting back against bullies, the thorny path of adolescent love, and, finally, the importance of letting go. Real men stand against the current and bravely fight for their dreams.

title: The Crescent Scholar
description: In his childhood, the only son of three generations of only sons, Yoo Weol, narrowly escaped a burning mountain with the help of the wolf spirit. Afterwards, to level the combination of yin and yang caused by change in his demeanor, his name was changed to Yoo Myeong, and his family would each time set up a ceremony of gratitude. Yoo Myeong who has fear of going up the mountain from memories of the incident, rashly went down the mountain, lost his way and met a big wolf. But oddly enough, Yoo Myeong's body became hot…

title: God Doesn't Play Dice
description: In the era of livestreaming and donations, Golden Gacha cards have been integrated into daily life. How did Xiao Hui, the unluckiest man, finally strike gold and beat down the rich to escape poverty? Wait, instead of riches what’s waiting for him is ♂change♀?!

title: Bride of the Snake
description: E Rae, who gathers wicked desires from snakes for revenge. For her, Suk Wol tries to find humans who are cursed by snakes. One day he goes down to the village to search for snakes like any other day, but then hears of a rumour about Lee Jin Sa so he disguises himself as a doctor to enter that man's house. And in there, he finds evidence of a snake with a different aura…

title: Crazy, A Three-Year-Old Sect Master?!
alt_titles: Fengle Ba, San Sui Zhang Men Ren?!
Fēngle Ba, Sān Suì Zhǎng Mén Rén?!
description: The Sword God Jian ZiQi, proved his way of the sword, cultivated the heavens and practiced his 9 heavenly series and ascended to a golden immortal, but in the secret realm he was ambushed by hundreds of golden immortals, and eventually died. Before he died, Jian ZiQi was able to reincarnate, and was reborn as the 3 year old everlasting sect master!

title: Qishi Huanxiang Ye
description:
Lin is just an ordinary high school student. But on the day she transfers to a new school, she gets a video game, which sends her to the world of King Arthur. There, she meets a mysterious wizard, who tells her that her mission is to find and gather the Knights of the Round Table.  
  
Lin n'est qu'une lycéenne ordinaire. Mais le jour de son transfert dans une nouvelle école, elle obtient un jeu vidéo qui l'envoie dans le monde du roi Arthur. Là-bas, elle rencontre un mystérieux magicien qui lui révèle que sa mission est de trouver et ramener les chevaliers de la table ronde.

title: Second Course
description:
The romance between two men letting go of their unrequited love?!  
  
Tae Hyunwook is the young team leader in charge of the Violent Crimes Unit, after graduating from the National Police Academy. He believed that someday he’d marry Hee-sun, his female friend for whom he bears a long-time one-sided love.  
  
“Hyunwook, I’m getting married.”  
  
At the announcement of Hee-sun’s marriage, Hyunwook tries hard to look calm and congratulate her. Besides, to help her prepare for the wedding, he even stupidly meets her in a restaurant called ‘Secondo Piatto’ in an attempt to put on a prideful act… Seo Wonyoung is the owner and chef there. He’s an old friend of Minseok, Hee-sun’s soon-to-be husband.  
  
But the detective’s intuition tells him that there’s something odd in the way Wonyoung looks at Minseok…? He's proven right on the wedding day, when he sees Wonyoung on his knees crying out for Minseok in the empty restaurant…!  
  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Artist’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/dong_m)

title: The Last Straw
description:
It was the summer I turned seventeen, three months before I broke off relations with my family. The missing eldest daughter of the Renity family, my 'older sister', had returned. Everyone in the mansion loved her, but they didn't care about me. However... a self-proclaimed low-level spirit keeps telling me unexpected things: the woman who's apparently my 'sister' keeps trying to protect me, and the Archduke is losing out from the mutual transaction with our family. Furthermore, I don't think my childhood friend and I are just friends anymore.

---
You can have everything else, but not him!

When Anita's long-lost older sister Arabella finally turns up after 19 years, their parents are overjoyed and begin to shower her with the love and attention Anita never received. But when they try to take away her best friend and fiancé, Axion, Anita finally puts her foot down. She's had enough.

title: Manipulate My Heart
description: The work tells the story of a woman who escaped the control of Ibera, a mysterious and powerful woman who can manipulate people's emotions. She thought she could live a normal life, but she discovered that her life was full of problems and dangers. Her girlfriend cheated on her, her job was stressful, her parents are trying to force her to get married, and all of this drove her to despair. And, to make matters worse, Ibera reappeared, determined to get her back. She will have to face her conflicting feelings for her as she tries to escape her grasp and discover her secrets.

title: Trouble
description:
The God who rules over the vast world of 'Rodowan' one day announces a new Divine Law.  
  
All reproduction is immediately prohibited.  
  
Those who are banned from conceiving rebel for the sake of humankind and their children, but the power of God and their followers is overwhelming and oppressive.  
  
God brands children born after the Divine Law as children of traitors, killing them or turning them into slaves.  
  
In this chaotic world, those who wish to punish this sick tyranny begin their desperate fight.

title: Thundercloud Rainstorm
description:
Midnight Mess Scan Summary:   
Jeonghan meets his cousin Iljo, who he almost forgot existed, at his uncle's funeral. Feeling sympathy for the impoverished Iljo, Jeonghan impulsively suggests to live together, which he soon regrets.   
  
"What are you doing?"   
"……."   
"What do you have to say for yourself."   
  
He asked because he discovered Iljo secretly tying to kiss him while he was asleep. Jeonghan attempts to kick out Iljo, but, in the end, fails to do so. Instead, he asks how Iljo can get rid of his unrequited feelings.   
  
"Just kiss me once."   
"If I do that, will that help you like me less?"   
  
On the pretext of sympathy, Jeonghan slowly gave his heart to Iljo. Before he knows it, he finds himself to be sexually involved and possessive over him…  
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
  
  
At Iljo’s father's funeral, Jeonghan meets his cousin Lee Iljo, who he had forgotten even existed. Sympathizing for his cousin’s impoverished situation, he impulsively asks him to move into his home not knowing he was going to regret his decision.   
   
"What do you think you're doing?"  
“…..”  
“Have you any excuse?”   
  
He asked upon discovering llcho secretly trying to kiss him while he was asleep. Jeonghan attempts to drive Iljo out but eventually fails to do so and asks Ilcho how he can rid those unrequited feelings that are still lingering.   
  
“Just kiss me once.”  
  
“Will that help you like me less?”  
  
Out of sympathy, Jeonghan gave his heart out to Lee Iljo only to become sexually involved and possessive over him.  
  
En Español por Meraki   
||  
  
Jeonghan se encuentra con su primo Lee Iljo, de quien casi había olvidado su existencia, en el funeral de su tío. Sintiendo simpatía por el pobre Iljo, Jeonghan le sugiere impulsivamente que vivan juntos, de lo cual se arrepiente pronto.   
“¿Qué estás haciendo?”  
”……”  
”¿Qué tienes que decir en tu defensa?”  
Preguntó porque descubrió a Iljo intentando besarlo en secreto mientras dormía. Jeonghan intenta echar a Iljo, pero, al final, no lo logra. En cambio, le pregunta a Iljo cómo puede deshacerse de sus sentimientos no correspondidos.   
“Solo bésame una vez.”   
“Si hago eso, ¿ayudará a que te guste menos?”  
Con el pretexto de la simpatía, Jeonghan le entrega su corazón a Iljo lentamente. Antes de saberlo, ya se encuentra sexualmente involucrado y siendo posesivo con el...||

title: Saving the Villain Who Was Abandoned by the Female Lead (Promo)
alt_titles: Methods to Save the Villain Who Was Abandoned by the Heroine
description:
***Promo for the web novel.***

I tried to save the sub-male lead, who was poisoned by the female lead, but an accident happened! He said he would repay the favor, but he randomly sent me to the most notorious villain, the Family of Assassins?! That family that consists of the oldest brother, a knight in the Imperial Army preparing for a revolt, the second brother, a reverend with a large bounty on his head, and a father who is the greatest villain of all time… Will I be safe in this villainous family throughout my three year contract?

*Promo Artist: Hunya
Cover Artist: cocorip*

title: Rebirth of the Great God
alt_titles: Reborn to Be a Great God
Rebirth of the Great God Cultivator
Rebirth I Am the Great God
description:
The Nine-heavens Crystal brought Lin Haotian back to life. In this life, he is Lin Que, a son of a declined family. One of his father's friend took him in and wanted to marry his daughter to him. However, his wife and daughter clearly hate his decision and make his life hard. Lin Haotian, now called Lin Que, decides to leave and regain his cultivation again. Although he is far weaker than before, he is incredibly strong in the eyes of ordinary people. They regard him as "Mr. Immortal." So what his life will be in the earthly world? Can he figure out the mystery of the Nine-heavens Crystal? Please do not call me "Mr. Immortal." I'm just an ordinary cultivator.

---
The God of Heaven, also known as "Lin Hao Tian." He is an immortal genius. He was killed jointly for threatening the status of many fairy lords. At the end of the day, he worked hard to break free from the shackles of time and was born again as a boy. This life will certainly be rewritten and returned to the top of the universe.

---
**Original Web Comic:** [AC.QQ](https://ac.qq.com/Comic/ComicInfo/id/649375), [BiliBili Manhua](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc29473), [Dongman Manhua](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/BOY/chongshengzhiwoshidatianshen/list?title_no=1866), [IQIYI](https://www.iqiyi.com/manhua/detail_2f117qexlth.html), [KuaiKan Manhua](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/8910), [Mkzhan](https://www.mkzhan.com/216094/), [U17](https://www.u17.com/comic/199776.html), [Zymk](https://www.zymk.cn/5052/)

**Official Translations:**
* English: [BiliBili Comics](https://www.bilibilicomics.com/detail/mc1670), [INKR](https://inkr.com/title/1010)

title: Syndrome
description:
Seo Jeong-in, the second son of a wealthy judge's family, fails to get into the university his father wants, unlike his older brother. Consequently, he ends up in a dormitory at a rural cram school catering to upper-class students. Having been aware of his sexual identity from an early age, Jeong-in has been enjoying a free-spirited and indulgent gay lifestyle. However, things turn for the worse when his dorm roommate, Seunghyun, captures footage of Jeong-in in a sticky situation with his friend Han Minwoo using a hidden camera installed in their room...
(Source: Lezhin)

title: Foam of the Sea
description:
"Never forgive me."
Margret, who was brutally murdered by her lover, is reborn 7 years later as 'Meg'. Will 'Meg', who doesn't know anything about the world, be able to acclimate well into her new life...? A story uncovering the truth behind her death and the growing love between the characters!

title: Choose Your Heroes Carefully
description:
Stuck in a game with a lousy hero? Me too!
Minjoon, a normal office worker, wakes up inside the game he was reviewing for his friend. It's not his fault the trailer was so boring it put him to sleep! Bewildered, Minjoon is tasked with summoning a hero to guide. The hero certainly looks strong, but he seems to be less useful than expected.

title: Sword Legend
alt_titles: A Thousand Faces, A Thousand Blades
description: The death criminals whom lived in the jail country, Palom are entering the “MAD GAME” in the progress. This is a battle for your freedom. What is the meaning of freedom ? Those that spill scum blood like a butcher massacring people, is there the flavor of freedom ? I swore before , I will use the legend sword in hand, breaking apart the shackles of this world !!

title: The Illidan Girl
description:
A voice that captivates the heart of young boy.

Based on a short story by an anonymous user posted on 31st December 2016.

title: The Rogue Producer Survives as an Idol
alt_titles: The Trashy PD Has To Survive as an Idol
Surviving as a Crazy Idol PD
description: Seo Hoyoon, the genius producer of a popular idol survival show, is infamous for his sharp tongue and coldheartedness. Cursed by a trainee for it, he wakes up as a member of a flop idol group called "The Dawn." To avoid being stuck in this parallel world forever, Hoyoon must make his group top-tier... but with the competitive industry and challenging tasks, it won't be easy. With his wits, know-how, and a little help from those around him, will this producer-turned-idol make it big?

title: Nameless Lantern
description:
The state of Joseon is defeated by the invaders of the royal family.  
  
Two girls are born with a power that both the emperor and his traitors can use.  
Will this light illuminate the chaos of the times that have come? Or will it be the reason an entire country burns out?  
… A new story begins!

title: Doomsday Summoning Frenzy
description: As The sky turned blood red, demons of the other world began to invade the earth. Wen Yu who died miserably is reborn back to the first day of the post-apocalyptic world. He switches to a special profession, Soul Master and begins his journey to change his fate in his second chance at life.

title: Hive
description:
Gigantic oxygen-doped bees are attempting to dominate the human race by reversing the food chain. Lee is a mid-level manager at a large company who only has one thing on his mind: to save his family from the bug-apocalypse.

---
Original work is split into 2 separate titles - [Season 1-2](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=609480) and [Season 3](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=675331).

title: Rebirth of King Zhou: Not Being the Ultimate Villain
alt_titles: Reborn in the Investiture Game as the Strongest Freelancer
Rebirth of King Zhou: Don't Be a Villain
Rebirth of the Gods Game: The Strongest Rogue
Rebirth: King Zhou Doesn't Become a Great Villain
description: Liu Nian enters a game called ‘Glory Continent’ and discovers after his death that he is the reincarnation of King Zhou. Enchanting beast-eared girls, cold and beautiful mature women, sweet and adorable lolis… a harem of beauties for him to choose from. In this life, he decides not to be the ultimate villain. He wants all the stunning beauties and to overturn the heavens in the new round of the Ultimate Venerate/God Battle, aiming to become the top deity!

title: The Devil's Cure
description: This story narrates how a trashy Divine-less Sect and a group of unreliable disciples under the leadership of an unreliable master bring the development of the sect to greater heights.

title: Eternal First God
description:
Even in his dreams, Li Tianming can’t stop himself from laughing! Why? Because his family pets are all the Primordial Chaos Beasts of myth!   
  
That teeny weeny little chick over there is actually the eternal Infernal Phoenix that eats suns! His black cat is the Genesis Chaos Thunderfiend that refines worlds with its lightning. The cockroach, well, it’s the Myriad Worlds Deathless Beast that possesses trillions of undying clones…   
  
Followed by his menagerie of pets, Li Tianming begins his ascension to become the number one beastmaster of the ages. He journeys across the many worlds, only one thing remaining constant. No one is ever ready for the likes of his pets! After all, who's ever prepared to fight a chicken and its fellows…

title: Master of the Martial Arts Library
alt_titles: Lord of the Martial Arts Library
description: Ha So-chan, the bastard of the Ha family, lived a life full of despair. Even though he dedicated his life to training, the only thing he received was laughter and a destroyed dantian. Then came the miracle: ‘Congratulations on becoming the master of the martial arts library.’ “The world will remember my name.” Thus, begins the story of the greatest teacher and the greatest swordsman, who is destined to conquer all.

title: It Was All You
description: In the near future, bioengineering doctoral and clone examiner, Yuri, lives day by day in pain due to her husband's affair. Then one day, she starts testing the latest love clone 'Victor', which is destined to be discarded a month later. While she gets comforted by Victor, she realizes the terrible things her husband has done…! In the end, Yuri plans a brutal revenge… What is her fate?

title: Righteous Evil
description: Amidst a world of Tao and evil demons, good and bad, an ancient poltergeist and a young priest of guardian seals accidentally break a seal whilst going on an adventure to find the way of imprints, constantly challenging the line between good and evil.

title: The Plan for Being Gods
alt_titles: The Plan to Assemble the Gods
description: Before the deification after the War of the Shang and the Zhou, Jiang Ziya fell asleep accidentally. One thousand years had passed when he woke up. To complete the deification, Jiang Ziya started looking for god-to-be in the modern world to once again fight with the enemies from a thousand years ago. The enemies were ready, but the modern gods were busy enjoying their lives and refused to be deities…

title: Ten Thousand Live Broadcast Big Local Tyrant
alt_titles: Ten Thousand Live Broadcast Big Local Tyrant
One Thousand Live Broadcast Big Local Tyrant
description: Wang Tian, ​​who works in the martial arts hall, found a bug when he registered on a live broadcast platform after being expelled. Using the rewards in the live broadcast room, he opened the treasure chest to get cheats and swept those who once looked down on him! Martial arts, food, art, wealth! Wang Tian has everything!

title: My Spiritual Girlfriends
alt_titles: My Affair With a Ghostly Girlfriend
Wo De Ling Jie Nü You Men
description: One night when the black wind rushed to a high fever, the high school student Ye Lan gained an unspeakable super power. The strange and beautiful demon loli, the arrogant sister of Heavenly Demon, the innocent and lovely beauty sword fairy… Ye Lan can’t afford to be able to avoid and can’t avoid it, so he has to wander between the dangers that come in droves and start a mysterious adventure.

title: Who Invited You?
alt_titles: Why Did You Come To My Home
description:
Official Summary:  
The unfamiliar guy who appeared in front of Seo Jaehee, the office worker with a busy life. Remove prejudices against him!  
  
From MangaUpdates:  
Jade is told that her childhood friend from China is going to stay at her house. Yet, the grown man who arrives at her door is no longer the sweet boy from her distant memories, rather far from it. As she struggles to re-adjust to their new life together, will she rediscover her childhood crush or simply kick him to the curb?

title: Standard Heroes
description: Let the standard adventure story of extremely normal(?) people begin!

title: Control
description:
There's something strange, in the neighborhood.  
Who you gonna call? Uhm. Some strange cute hypnotist girl.  
And you have no clue who she is, and you didn't call her.  
  


---

title: My Warmonger Husband
alt_titles: I Stole the Child of My War-Mad Husband
description: What if your whole life was predetermined? When Noelle Ainelle is reborn as an evil marchioness, she learns she is fated to die alongside her 5-year-old daughter at her husband’s hands. But with a new attitude and a will to live, Noelle resolves to salvage her marriage for their daughter’s sake. Too bad her husband, Rupert Ainelle, is a war-loving marquess who knows nothing but violence. With the clock ticking before the unthinkable, can this villainess make peace with her warmonger husband?

title: Houkai Gakuen 4-Koma
description: 4-koma based on the mobile game Guns Girl Z (Houkai Gakuen / Houkai Gakuen 2).

title: Date a Ranker
description:
All Myeong Seong-a wants to do is spend her life playing video games. 

Unfortunately, after defeating a streamer in an online game and taking his money, she realizes that he is actually a boy in her class named Kang Hanjun, who also happens to be a terrifying delinquent! 

Determined to keep her identity a secret, she decides to request a class transfer, only to run into An Tae-ui, another classmate who looks exactly like her game character! 

Can she spend time with Tae-ui while keeping Hanjun from discovering who she really is?

title: FOG (E-Sports)
description:
Two years ago, Yu Sui had his teammate sold out, and had himself criticized by the public. He didn't care about any of it. The only thing he cared about was the kid on his team, Shi Luo. After coming back to China, the two meet again. Yu Sui is starting a new team – will Shi Luo give himself once more to the one who hurt him before? Can there be a new path for their relationship?  
  
"I met you when we were young, and then I lost and found you again. My regrets vanished long ago."

title: Above the Undead Master
description:
After rebirth, the world has changed. The blood race has become the master of the world, and humans have completely accepted this life and are proud to be blood dependents, as the saying goes: humans who have not been sucked by the blood race are not good humans.

Wang Zhe wanted to repair the regrets left in his previous life and make a better life, but unexpectedly, he was involved in all kinds of events competing for the quota of blood family members. At the critical moment of life and death, a mysterious force in Wang Zhe's body revived. The blood families, real masters and real kings came!

title: Santa Industries
description:
Being poor has become a sin.

The once righteous International police has now sided with the wealthy. The world has now changed into a place where money is everything.

A girl from a slum, who has spent her entire life hiding her power, faced a tragedy because of the atrocities of a devilish building owner. With nothing but a burning desire for revenge, the girl who no longer wanted to be a slave to this filthy world anymore, makes her way to the Central City checkpoint.

And there, she meets a “Santa”, a mysterious courier of presents…

Despair, sorrow, and the wishes of those who had died, the revenge play of a hero who clenched her every desire and dreams tightly within her fist.

title: Cierra
description:
Cierra Elburke and Claude LeSpencer, both sharing backgrounds of illegitimacy, find refuge from the scorn of their family and society in each other’s arms. But when Cierra is forced to marry someone other than her beloved, she begs for another chance at life with a happier ending. Through the power of the “key” to the throne that is gifted by Claude, Cierra is given a chance to start over. Yet this time, she chooses to leave everything behind, including Claude, with hope for a better life. Has she made the right choice, or will this second chance prove more disastrous than her original fate?

---
The price for a love which should not be was paid with terrible ruin. Sierra prays that she has lost everything she treasured. 'Please, let me make a different choice this time.' Time rewound like that, and Sierra was once again faced with a choice. The time she returned to was the one night she spent with the one she loved. In her womb, there was a child she had coldly erased in the past before her return. She couldn't be with him because the relationship with him in the past was full of despair. But the child who was the fruit of their love, she wanted to save this time. 'I want to leave only one trace that he left behind.' So, eight years after Sierra disappeared from the capital. The love she had to leave has returned once again.

title: Tiger x Crane
alt_titles: Tiger x Crane - Record of the Demon Master
description: Amongst demons, dark arts, and rare mystical treasures, a chance meeting between a boy named Tiger and Xiao Xuang, a powerful exorcist, marks the beginning of a great friendship. So begins the adventures of Tiger and company in a fantasy world where demons are tamed and tradition is protected.

title: Fake Slackers
description: After classes were divided, not only were the two infamously and widely known "problem youths" placed into the same class, they became deskmates. They were obviously exam prodigies but they pretended to be slackers, their entire beings immersed in this skit. They had to compete for last place during exams; playing games every day on the surface but studying seriously behind others' backs. Come and gossip about the two guys in our class who always have to compete for last place: the one who always plays tricks in solitude (He Zhao) x the one who would rather destroy humanity than concede (Xie Yu).

title: Hang Ah, the Moon's Child
description:
Hang Ah was an incarnation of the moon.  
She was the guardian of the palace since its founding, and her protection resulted in a thousand years of prosperity. But, after a thousand years, she disappeared. All kinds of disasters happened as if it was waiting for this moment of vulnerability. At the same time, a child considered as ‘The Second Hang Ah’ appeared. She wanted to go away believing all of this was a lie.  
  
“The Hang Ah I know had beautiful hair resembling the moonlight… Just like you.”  
‘I’m… Hang Ah? I can’t believe it…’

title: All My Abilities Are Forbidden Spells
alt_titles: Quanmin Zhuan Zhi Wode Jineng Quan Shi Jin Zhou Qianyue
Job Transfer For All: My Skills Are All Forbidden Spells
description:
Lin Han finds himself transmigrated into a world that merges reality and games. This world is rife with dungeons, forbidden zones, and hidden realms, not to mention rampaging monsters! 

When the time for the Class Change comes, Lin Han doesn’t receive the Warrior Class that he has always dreamt of. 

Instead, he receives the class Life Cleric. Just as he’s despairing over his misfortune…

[Ding! You’ve awakened the “Myriad Augmentation System”!] 

With every attribute augmented ten thousand times, all of Lin Han’s basic skills have turned into Forbidden Spells! 

Watch Lin Han as he dominates the battlefield with his Forbidden Spells and becomes known as a close-combat Healer!
- - -
Crossing to the other world with his soul, Lin Han arrived in an era where games and reality merged. There are countless dungeons, forbidden lands, and hidden realms where mighty monsters reign supreme!

On the day of his class profession, Lin Han missed the opportunity to become a warrior, the class of his dreams! Unexpectedly, he awakened the unique hidden profession – Life Sacrificer – at a critical moment!

[Ding! Ten Thousandfold Amplification System Awakening!]

Lin Han’s attributes increased by ten thousand times, and his basic skills all reached forbidden curses!

In the name of a close-combat healer, during the moment of unlimited forbidden curse devastation!

title: Just the Male Lead's Friend
alt_titles: I Became the Male Lead's Female Friend
description:
She became the failed-in-love, jealous inducer, female friend of the male lead. In addition, the character even has an unrequited love for the male lead. She would be ruined. As long as this was the case, she decided to just become friends! It was nice to have the first meeting with such a young male lead…

"Hello, Miss Bouser."

"Uwa!!"

*You were mistaken for a girl and you cried?*

Fortunately, she managed to resolve the misunderstanding and become close friends. However, the male lead in his childhood is more shy and soft-hearted than she had thought. Eventually, she became attached to the male lead and decided to become a real friend. However, due to the disturbance of the male lead's father and the war which broke out, they had to be separated for a long time. She thought she could barely meet him again and stay the same as before but…

"Your eyes must have dropped a lot since I didn't see you. Princess Averine!"

*What's wrong with him now?! It's not just that. Rather than getting along, he keeps getting into trouble when he has a chance, and most of all, he even bothers my love life!! Aren't we just friends?!*

---
Dahlia Averin would've been just fine living as a pretty, loaded extra... were it not for the fact that she's destined to fall for Rudrik, the male lead, and be used to better his love life! Determined not to go down that path, Dahlia swears to just remain a friend and stay out of his romantic relationships. But upon discovering that Rudruk is not quite like she had imagined, she finds herself caring for him more. Will Dahlia's resolve stay strong, or will they end up as more than just friends?

---
**Original Webtoon:** [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%82%A8%EC%A3%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%97%AC%EC%9E%90%EC%82%AC%EB%9E%8C%EC%B9%9C%EA%B5%AC%EA%B0%80-%EB%90%98%EC%97%88%EB%8B%A4/3360), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61313362)

title: Rewritten Love Story
description:
'Lee Jeya' who gets into an accident with his ex-girlfriend from college, 'Han Seori.' When he wakes up, he finds himself 10 years in the past and his and Seori's bodies are switched! Jeya wants to rewrite their failed love story along with Seori during this time. 

"Jeya, you want to go out with me again? Then try seducing me."

But will Jeya be able to seduce Seori when he is  in Seori's body himself?!

title: 44th Period: Survival Class
description: Mysterious black circles have started appearing all over the world, and whoever falls in doesn't come back out. Then one day, a black circle swallows an entire school and everyone in it, turning it into a twisted maze of nightmares. Will Doyun and his classmates find a way out?

title: Pick Me, My Queen
description:
Aurora Fenryr Astrophotas, the Goddess of War, returns from the seven-year war to face the aftermath of her father’s mysterious illness and subsequent death as well as the four men vying for her hand in marriage. Her best friend’s lover, her loyal fan’s fiancé, a professor with a secret, and her ex-fiancé come before her, but will she find a husband in time? She yearns to return to the battlefield, but instead, she must evade bedchamber intruders, power-hungry nobles, the haunting illness, and most importantly… her own heart.

---
There hasn't been a queen like this before! The strongest monarch in Babel's history is called the God of War, God's Daughter, Aroha Fenril Astrofortus! After her return from concluding a seven-year war, she finds that those bastard nobles have prepared a bothersome trap… 'Your Majesty, you must choose a husband and continue the royal family's bloodline!' She wants to throw all of that away, but in consideration of the royal bloodline, she does have to get married. On top of that, she's receiving a crazy amount of proposals from those that are vying for Babel's second-highest position. The husband candidates are chosen by the Grand Chamberlain on special orders! The genius that is Babel Academy's youngest professor in all history, an optimistic national guard, Babel’s General and the Queen’s reliable comrade, and the young hero of Babel's political world, the most beautiful man. …Who will Aroha choose?

title: The Cannon Fodder Princess Wants to Last
alt_titles: Princess Cannon Fodder Wants to Last
The Cannon Fodder Wants to Go to the End
The Transmigraed Cannon Fodder Overthrows the Male Protagonist
description:
On the way to escape the marriage, the heroine fell into the lake due to a miscalculation of a math problem, and passed through to the former princess Mu Yunkai who was being hunted down.   
  
As long as you earn good connections with the men, you can draw prizes and redeem various superpowers. Once the percentage of your connection is full, you can return to the original world and live again!   
  
I thought this as a journey full of happiness with beautiful men, but why do all of them want… to kill her?

title: I Will Not Be the Supporting Character Forever
alt_titles: There Is No Eternal Supporting Character
description:
“Why a supporting character instead of the main character?! And out of all supporting characters, why must I be this girl…”

When she came to, she was in the middle of the novel, *Empress Rosalynne*, as the supporting priest character, Elena. Moreover, the story starts right after Elena messed up a holy ritual and she was treated awfully by everyone around her…

“There’s only one way to get out of this! I have to become the tutor of the Emperor’s little brother, Duke Levi!”

Elena thought she could watch over the protagonist of the story, Rosalynne, as the events of the story unfolded at the imperial court, but something was wrong.

“Equality between commoners and me, a noble? You better watch yourself!”

The protagonist she had admired so much was a villainess who discriminated against others based on their social status.

“I won’t be able to stand it if everything ends up the way she wants!”

And so, Elena resolves to change how the story unfolds. Can she rise from her role as a supporting character and claim the position of protagonist?!

---
Elena wakes up as a disgraced side character in a novel. To survive, she must hide her commoner status. When the protagonist, Rosaline, discovers her secret, she forces Elena to do her work instead. Amidst the male lead's advances, Elena finds herself drawn to an apprentice knight she met by chance.

title: Dependency X
description: A perverted Alpha seme and a contributing Omega uke. The dailies of a young love, a display of affection that kills many normal people, "My reliance on you, is like the earth revolving around the sun, the planet revolving around the sun, and the universe revolving around the stars "

title: Dragon King Awakening
description: During a time of war, I pretended to be a girl in order to recieve a better life. In the end however, I was simply tricked into being a sacrifice to appease the local river god! Though who would have thought that as I lost all hope that I'd live after being thrown into the river, that I would inherit the powers of the water god! The rise of the dark forces, the return of the ancient demon gods, see how Yang Shou is able to use his newfound power to save the world!

title: Even If I Say I'm Not a Villain Now
alt_titles: Come on Now, Even If I'm Not a Villain
description: After being killed by her own father, I woke up... 500 years later?! To make things worse, I’ve been reborn into the body of a so-called villainess—a woman hated by her family and fiancé for her fragile health and sharp temper. All I wanted was to live quietly and figure out why I was reincarnated. But now, my once-cold family and fiancé are suddenly desperate for my attention, and my slave boy from 500 years ago has returned... perfectly alive. As if that wasn’t enough, immortal weapons from ancient times are starting to gather around me. "You shouldn’t have fed the stray dog." I never gave anyone a single bite, so why is this happening?!

title: Frostbite
description:
In 1984, my mom left with a suitcase.

It was very cold that day. I remember that snot got all over my hands, and blood seeped out from frozen cracks in my skin. I had frostbite.

title: The Chronicles of Qing Xi
description:
Despite being a lowly palace eunuch, Bi Xie possesses the brilliance of a strategist who is able to assist the Emperor in reclaiming feudal lands, expelling the Huns, and bringing peace to the nation. He soon garnered the loyal support of various ambitious and talented men by his side.  
  
However, his motives are hidden deep underneath his impeccable façade as he is harboring a deep family grudge against the imperial family…

title: The Regressed Doctor Just Wanted to Live Quietly
alt_titles: The Regressed Doctor Just Wanted to Live Quietly
description: In the operating room, Dr. Jinhyeok Lee is flawless—unyielding, brilliant, and untouchable. But outside, he’s a ghost to his family and loved ones. He misses everything, even his mother’s final moments. By the time he understands what he’s lost, it’s too late… until it isn’t. He wakes up 27 years in the past. Now armed with a lifetime of memories, Jinhyeok vows to live differently. But peace won’t come easy. Old rivals, new battles, and countless lives await. Scrubs on. Lights up. Scalpel ready. And this time, Primum non nocere.

title: Peerless Scripture of Chaos
alt_titles: I have a Chaos Sutra, 我有一部混沌经
description:
Mo Qi was born unable to cultivate, so he had decided to work as a chef in a cuisine restaurant. He had stumbled upon a 'cookbook', which he had mistakingly used to cook food however, this was no ordinary cookbook - it was the peerless scripture of chaos. Things start to take a turn when Mo Qin realises his body is getting sturdier, and he is starting to get stronger!  
  
  
This was written by me, as the original description wasn't the greatest.   
- Asura

title: King of Manifestations
description:
Li Luo is Nan Feng Academy's best student, outshining his peers. However, he was born without a Manifestation, causing him to fall behind his classmates. When Li Luo decides to use the solution his parents left behind to solve his problem, he fell into the adversity of "five years of service to the country, otherwise, he would die".

Between heaven and earth, there are Manifestations. And I, Li Luo, will become the King of Manifestations!

title: Our School Teacher Kim
description: At our school, there's a new teacher, Suzy, and the perfect role-model of a teacher, Sunwoo. This is the story of two very different teachers with the last name Kim.

title: How Did I Become the Princess?
description:
Once upon a time, ​​I was a weary, nameless warrior with neither family nor money. Some might say this was just my lot in life, but not me. When I am given the chance to return to the past, I take it, hoping to return to simpler times. However, after turning back time, I am shocked to learn that I am actually Princess Nanael, the long lost daughter of the emperor of Ovyulia. With my new name and new home, I’m dead-set on not losing my family ever again.

---
“Please turn back time.”

The warrior made a wish. Who cares about a mission, I just want to be a normal girl. But, where is the average life I wished for...?

“I’m sure this child is the princess I had lost 12 years ago.”

Did I come back as an imperial princess? From a poor warrior who had no name, I became Nanaelle, the princess who had everything.

For a moment, I was flustered by how differently things were going from what I had thought, but then I decided to protect the things she never had before... 

“These are all mine. This time, I’ll never let anyone take them away from me.”

Nanaelle who became a princess starting today! What kind of life is waiting for her?

---

title: Tale of the Yellow Dragon
description: With the screech of rubber and a crunch of metal, Dojin departs the mortal world, leaving behind his beloved sister and niece. He awakens in the kingdom of Yooguk, where the people call him “emperor” and serve a god named Yellow Dragon. Dojin soon discovers that Yellow Dragon called him to Yooguk for a purpose: to share his “life force” and protect the kingdom. As Dojin slips deeper into Yellow Dragon’s cold embrace, how far will he go in order to get back home? (Source: Lezhin)

title: The Investor Who Sees The Future
description:
After experiencing an accident in the military, Kang Jinhu gained the ability to foresee the future. 

He decides to use this ability to invest in various companies and make money, aiming to become the world's number one investor. 

How far do the limits of his foresight extend? Beyond investments, it touches economics, politics, corporations, and even global affairs. From now on, he’s reshaping the world of finance!

title: Fever Flower
description:
Two-faced actress Min Seohee, when will be the end of her vicious celebrity career?

Popular movie actress Min Seohee, with a pretty face and excellent acting skills, that are enough to win the public's love.
Her shocking secret is that she is a lesbian with numerous love affairs! From fellow entertainers to staff members and even managers. Her agency, unable to tolerate Seohee having a relationship with another woman every night, assigns 'Miso', the standard of ordinary life, as her manager.

On the other hand, Seohee has only known of one person who did not fall for her, and that is 'Donggyeong', a junior in the theater club during her pre-debut days and who now works as a film director. Reunited at a high school classmate's funeral, Donggyeong is still dry with Seohee. Seohee, whose self-esteem is broken, takes the lead role in the film director's independent film in order to seduce the woman she meets again...

---

- [Original Webtoon <Bomtoon>](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/Fever_F/?p_id=YumGumYum)

title: Plundering The Heavens
description: Some people say that he is a black sheep in the cultivation world, one with no sense of righteousness and honor, and one who disrupts the order of Taoism! Some people say that he is the biggest scum in Nanzhan Prefecture, colluding with demonic cultivators, swindling and committing all kinds of crimes! To all the slanders, Fang Xing said, “that’s right, I’m that legendary black sheep. Is there a problem?

title: Bodyguard in Disguise
alt_titles: Zhè Ge Bǎo Biāo Yǒu Diǎn Méng
Fall In Love With A Gangster
description: Yue Yao, AKA Bai Fei, is disguised as a man and hiding among the largest underground family in the city — the Ling Family — to become the Young Master's right-hand person. Using her identity as a 'brother,' she became acquainted with the carefree Young Master Ling Ye, until a particular assignment arrives where Ah Fei, who is dressed as a woman, couldn't resist her own inner desires and kissed Ling Ye while drunk…

title: 0.0000001% Demon Lord
description:
The 72 Demon Kings, who received the order to destroy the earth, each went through a trial by the Great Demon King Astrea. Those who passed the trial earned the title of Demon King, and each Demon King was granted special powers by the Great Demon King.

So far, each Demon King had been granted extraordinary abilities. When Karos became a Demon King, he received a power from the Great Demon King, but… 

“Great Demon King, no matter how much I think about it, there is a problem with my power.”
“Problem?”

Among the Demon Kings with extraordinary abilities… Karos received the [Gacha] ability. 

“Gacha as the power of a Demon King? How am I supposed to rule the world with Gacha?!'”

title: Resentment
description:
The hostess Lingyue was murdered by her best friend and her husband… In order to hide the crime, she was thrown into the wilderness. There, she was possessed by spirits and filled with hatred, she started on her path to avenge her death…  
  
This is a manhua that will stimulate your senses and touch your heart deeply. Here, the author will reveal the depths of everyone's hearts, and the resentment within…

title: Burn
description: Fledgling photographer assistant Xiao Zhou, is captivated by model Lan Shan at a bar, Lan Shan upon realising her stealing a photograph of her isn't angry, but is instead impressed by the aura/energy of the photograph. The two who meet for the first time are deeply captivated by each other naturally feel a connection, their fates intersecting.

title: Kibotos Eujeil Mutu Daehoe
alt_titles: Blue Archive - Kivotos' First Martial Arts Tournament (Sensei 🍇 Battle)
description: The strongest students duke it out in Kivotos' First Martial Arts Tournament in order to claim the greatest prize of all: Sensei's virginity.

title: Library of Heaven's Path
description:
Traversing into another world, Zhang Xuan finds himself becoming an honorable teacher.

Along with his transcension, a mysterious library appears in his mind.

As long as it is something he has seen, regardless of whether it is a human or an object, a book on its weaknesses will be automatically compiled in the library.

Thus, he becomes formidable.

“Emperor Zhuoyang, why do you detest wearing your underwear so much? As an emperor, can’t you pay a little more attention to your image?”

“Fairy Linglong, you can always look for me if you find yourself unable to sleep at night. I am skilled in lullabies!”

“And you, Demon Lord Qiankun! Can you cut down on the garlic? Are you trying to kill me with that stench?”

This is an incredible story about teachers and students, grooming and guiding the greatest experts in the world!

title: Dirty Dress
description: In her childhood, Min Ju was naturally talented, receiving praise for her abilities. However, her confidence takes a hit when she meets young Han Seol. Feeling a twinge of jealousy and a sense of inferiority towards Han Seol's talent, Min Ju tries to keep her distance, but Han Seol continues to approach her...

title: Feng Shen Ji III
alt_titles: The Legend and the Hero III
description: The conclusion of the Feng Shen Ji series.

title: Lucky Paradise
description: Jung In-Ho just can't catch a break. In a rush to make it to class before he missed a pop quiz, he crashed head-first into a passerby and groped his chest. It turns out that passerby is a sunbae in his university's physical education department.

title: Maid in Heaven
description:
"An orphan, Sherl Watson, leaves her job in London to work at the Taylor Mansion.  
Rumors and a cloud of mystery surrounds the mansion as strange occurrences keep popping up.  
Will Sherl and the other maids be able to get out alive or were they all doomed to begin with?"

---

- [Original Webtoon <Mr.Blue>](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000047697)
