- [Original Webtoon <kakao>](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=54230020)

title: The Supreme Almighty Master
description: "The most versatile student in history! An adventure changed my life. From then on, I got a full score in the exam, I will hit the score, basketball genius, swimmer, beautiful harem… omnipotent, how lonely~~ ~"

title: The Delivery Man From Murim
description: Stranded in a new world, Smiley Kang covertly lives the life of a delivery man. Until now, humanity has fended off demonic beasts and their portal “gates.” There are the Awakened, citizens imbued with supernatural abilities, and there are those more scheming, fighting to monopolize and claim demonic resources. But as the number of gates starts to rise, the world is at risk once again. Can humanity survive another onslaught of demonic beasts? The answer lies with the mysterious delivery man…

title: Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything
description:
Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him.

When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By entering the game early at a high price, spending money like crazy, and acquiring a god-level talent known as [Evolve Everything], he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

Prepare for an epic tale of betrayal, rebirth, and the relentless pursuit of vengeance in “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything.” Follow his journey as he navigates treacherous alliances, overcomes formidable challenges, and evolves to become the ultimate force.

title: Rosalyn Vogart
description:
"Do you not think the husband is so beautiful his in-laws will bring him into sudden wealth?" 

Due to the luxurious spendings of the royal and noble families, the church and state of the Calabria Kingdom had collapsed. In order to obtain honor, the only thing they cannot obtain, being bourgeois, the Bogarte merchants try to marry off the black sheep of the family, their second daughter Rosalyn to the most beautiful person of the Calabria royal family, Crown Prince Robien... Honor bought with money, the fall of the royal family prevented with marriage... Can the two who ended up getting married embrace each other's vulnerabilities and get closer together?

title: Restart
description: An unknown virus broke out worldwide, degenerating humanity. Andy Biya had unfortunately died from the sudden disaster, but he unexpectedly awakened a power of reincarnation, and even met Eno Edison, a proud and aloof person who exuded a dangerous aura. Following the fateful experience of birth and death with Ino, the both of them gradually learn the secrets of each other and the world…

title: Surviving in the Emperor's Bed
alt_titles: How to Survive Sleeping With the Emperor
description:
'It’s been a couple of months since I became empress, and I’m avoiding sleeping with the emperor.’

The powerful empire led by inheritors of the golden dragon's bloodline, ‘Duhaleut.’
The emperor that reins over that empire, 'Karmond.'
And the one who rose to the seat of empress after marrying him, Princess 'Rovelia.'
Since she became empress, she’s expected to help continue the powerful imperial bloodline.

And to do this, she needs to sleep with the emperor, but...
For the sake of her 'true goal,' she ends up in a situation where she has to decline sleeping with Karmond...!

Indeed, she has to survive sleeping with the emperor. Will she be able to safely achieve her goal?

title: My Covenant with the Monster Lord
alt_titles: Yāo Zūn Fēiyào Duì Wǒ Fùzé
Yao Zun Feiyao Dui Wo Fuze
Yāo Zūn Fēi Yào Duì Wǒ Fù Zé
The Demon Lord Wants to Take Responsibility of Me!
description:
Yu Yin transmigrated twice, once again he has returned to his original world of cultivation, but the moment he gets back he gets scammed by a demon lord he doesn't recognize? Not only was he scammed, he even bit him and forced him into an engagement?! Yu Yin was very shocked, but the demon lord won't let him go.

Bei Xiao: We already have a very close relationship, why don't you let me tease you?

Yu Yin: …You don't have to do that.

---
**Original Web Manhua:** [BiliBili Manhua](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc30102), [KuaiKan Manhua](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/5701/)

**Official English Translations:** [INKR](https://inkr.com/title/697), [Mangatoon](http://h5.mangatoon.mobi/contents/detail/858143), [Renta!](https://www.ebookrenta.com/renta/sc/frm/item/142352/), [WebComics](https://www.webcomicsapp.com/comic/60828c658c252b2c1b421fad)

title: Twisting Tendrils
description:
In order to prevent the villainous princess from bringing doom upon this world, Jiang Xu—who transmigrated into her imperial sister-in-law—does her very best to nurture Her Highness into a virtuous and well-behaved ruler, despite her own frail health. However, as time passes, the proud and alluring princess unexpectedly pins her down onto the bed.

"If you can accept my brother, why not me? Won’t you spare me a glance, Imperial Sister-in-law?"

Jiang Xu: …If you think I’ve lived too long and want to anger me to death, just say so!

title: Girl in the Birdcage
description: Yeonkwang Arts High School makes a clear distinction between the talented and the mediocre. The talented receive full benefits of the Gifted and Talented program—funding, training, opportunities to participate in exclusive art contests—while the mediocre are left to fend for themselves in the hopes that they, too, can one day make it into the prestigious program. Talent equals power in this competitive school, but when Chung-eun, a G/T student, falls for Yumi, a non-G/T student, the tables are turned. While Chung-eun is blinded by Yumi’s charms, Yumi’s got a hidden agenda.

title: Dungeon Architect
description:
Kang Chiwoo lost his life in an accident and got reincarnated as the son of a great demon lord in another world.

Unlike his previous life as a map designer, he is now a loser named Kella.

However, in a world where magic exists and having realized the dormant power of Kella, Chiwoo sets out to achieve his goal of creating his dream map that he couldn't make in his past life...

Will Kella be able to create his own map while fending off his brothers who constantly try to kill him, the countless threats upon his life, and the pressure of those around him who want him to succeed the throne?

title: The Sunshine Powerhouse
description:
Choi Kang is really a soft-hearted guy, despite his completely opposite looks. He is determined to make friends at school, but Haessal wrongfully gets the impression that he's a bully. Kang's online friend "Bada-nim" consoles him, as he tries to clear up the misunderstanding. Will he succeed? And what will happen to him and Haessal?  
[Official Chinese Translation](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/2091/)

title: Apocalyptic Thief
description: A storm of the universe brought species mutations. The poison, undead, giants and monsters in the city roared as they waved their weapons. As the beasts in the woods fought over territorial rights, humans, too, awakened an ability known as star power… Zhou Zheng, without star power, traversed to this apocalyptic world. Using the abilities of the thief character in the game, he destroys the darkness and fog, seeking supreme power!

title: Ciel~The Last Autumn Story
description:
With the author's characteristic humour and creativity, this work describes one girl’s fantasy adventure.

Yvienne Magnolia lives in a small village and her beauty turns the villagers' heads, yet she would never have imagined the grand future destined for her.

When a count tries to kidnap her, Yvienne is forced to leave her family, and flee to the Lowood Institution for wizardry and witchcraft.

In the school, she meets interesting people, like January Lightsphere who comes from a noble but peculiar family, and Lariatte, an heir to an orthodox fighter family, who might yet become her closest friend.

---
[Korean Manhwa at Yes24](http://www.yes24.com/Product/Goods/4585512)

title: Duty after School
description: Strange things are appearing from the sky, and the world is slowly dying. In Korea, there aren't enough military men to fight these enemies off, and high-school and college students have no choice but to join the military and help the others survive - at the risk of their own lives.

title: Love Can't Be the Same
description: I finally met the childhood sweetheart whom I hadn't seen for many years and became his secretary, but he turned out to be a real arrogant president.

title: Ghost Emperor
description: The comic tells the story of an atheistic teenager Jiang Chengfeng who, by accident, acquired a magical power. With this power, he can easily resolve the most terrifying and fearful events in the world. This time, the mission is to rescue a missing boy, and the location is the horrifying Kun Kunyan! See how he passes through all the way! Fighting evil spirits! Don't pretend to be a ghost! Otherwise, they will all burst!

title: Finally Living Together With My Anti-Fan
description: Popular idol Juna is forced to leave the group due to a homosexual scandal. Half a year later, he enters campus as "Han JunRan", a university student. However, by a twist of fate, his roommate turns out to be his number one anti-fan!? Living together with his anti-fan will turn out to be a complicated experience…

title: Travelling Through the Universe's Flower
description: I'm a renowned genius in the History Department of my college, but I can't believe that I've travelled back in time into the body of a princess whose country was defeated in war! Was my being a genius in history all for nothing?! And not only am I stuck in the past, I'm having an arranged marriage with the Westerners as well! Moreover, I'm being married off to a country that runs of magic and has severe gender inequality issues. But don't you dare underestimate me! You're looking down on me, a princess of a defeated country? Well, I'll show you who's the real expert here!

title: I Became a First-Class Guide Thanks to My Childhood Friends
description: [The twin brothers love me too much. What should I do?] D-class guide Qiao Yang, because of a drunken accident, discovered that he could use the two A-class sentinels, his childhood friends Zheng Jia and Zheng Yan, to enhance his own class. In order to retain this rare S-class status, he chose to conceal his exploitation of them. However, during the repeated interaction with the two, he gradually becomes aware of their feelings towards him...

title: To Whom It No Longer Concerns
alt_titles: To Those of You for Whom Even Regret Is a Luxury
For Those of You for Whom Regret Is a Luxury
description: Exploited by her brother, betrayed by her sister, and killed by her husband. So ended the tragic story of Ariana Lopez--until, at the moment of her death, she suddenly finds herself back in the past. Now that she has a chance to do it all over again, she enlists the help of Duke Dante Heigenberg, the most feared and desired man in the entire empire, to take revenge against her family and reclaim what’s rightfully hers. But strangely, the duke seems to want Ariana more than just for her extraordinary musical talent...

title: The Good Student
description: After losing his memories in an accident, Eun Jo transfers to a new school, convinced he's a model student—quiet, kind, and hardworking. But when he sees his classmate Bom being bullied, something in him snaps. His instincts take over—and so do his fists. As Eun rises against the school’s cruel hierarchy, he starts to wonder: Who was he before? And why does Bom feel so familiar? Packed with school drama, mystery, and unexpected fists, this is the story of a “good student” who may not be so good after all.

title: My Husband Who Hates Me Has Lost His Memories
alt_titles: My Husband Hates Me, but He Lost His Memories
description: In a politically arranged marriage devoid of love, Lily is wed to Theodore, the head of a rival family. Theodore loathes the union, but little does he know that Lily despises her own family as much as he does. Living a quiet life, she counts the days until their inevitable divorce. Then fate intervenes—a sudden accident erases Theodore’s memories of her, transforming his coldness into unexpected affection. Can Lily trust this dramatic shift, or must she guard her heart to avoid future heartbreak?

title: Offering My Neck to You
alt_titles: I Offer My Neck to You
description: Fang Luoan, a half-werewolf, was five years old when his father was killed. He was then adopted by vampire Fang Yanchen. Today, twelve years later, as Fang Luoan is about to reach adulthood, his werewolf attributes are beginning to emerge. His uncontrollable emotions and the abnormal power he has have caused a ton of terrible troubles. But what he never expected is that Fang Yanchen, whom he has been living with, is the foe that killed his father…

title: Dad Asked Me to Choose One of Ten Goddesses to Marry
alt_titles: Lǎo Bà Ràng Wǒ Cóng Shí Gè Nǚshén Zhòngxuǎn Yīgè Jiéhūn
description:
Dad asked me to choose one of ten goddesses to marry: As the leader of the “Dead Night” team with the most outstanding record in China’s Secret Army – “Dead Doctor” Feng Lin was asked by his father to choose one of the ten goddesses who had already engaged in marriage.
Feng Lin, who had no intention of doing so, had to come one by one to break off the marriage.
During the process, Liu Nian, the traitor of “Dead Night”, appeared. In order to get revenge…

title: Transformed Into A Piece Of Land
description: The darkness eclipses, humans began to transform into unique monsters(Darksiders), but I got transformed into a piece of land! I live together with the other humans that managed to survived, planting crops and building walls to resist the monsters and the darkness of human nature, preserving the last spark of humanity’s fate during this apocalypse.

title: Genius Hitter Hits Fastball
description:
Even he, Kang Geon-woo, a genius major leaguer who gained wealth, fame, and everything, could not continue a happy married life with his wife. He, who felt regretful about his wife's absence, returned to the past with the power of a mysterious ring.

As a high school student in the midst of a fresh romance, will he be able to find love this time?

title: Knock Me Out
description:
Eddie es una superestrella de lo más egocéntrico, y JaeYeong, su guardaespaldas es completamente opuesto. El mundo del cantante tendrá una sacudida gracias a quien lo resguarda y un extraño acosador no le hará el trabajo fácil a Yeong.  
  
Dysania Scans: Suddenly stuck being a bodyguard for a famous international singer, Jaeyong’s life takes a sudden turn when packages filled with bloodied items from a stalker named B start showing up.

title: Mayabi
description: The last Mayabi War begins in Ayuta, where the gods' seal was released.

title: Make the Best of It: Advance or Fall Behind
description: In order to avenge her sister, a demon snuck into the land of the celestials all alone. In an unexpected turn of events, she was rescued by her nemesis' fiancee! Originally, she wanted to get close to her nemesis through his fiancee, but she soon discovered that his fiancee was hiding a secret that could change everything.

title: I Became the Villain’s Lost Daughter
description:
I possessed an extra who didn’t even have a name in the novel.

Her features are black hair and purple eyes that means that she is cursed.

And I’m the lost daughter of the villain in the novel?!

title: Hold on, Crown Prince!
description:
Hold on, Crown Prince! Why are you doing this to me?! 

With a charming face and a not-quite-so attitude, not a day passes in the life of a beautiful boy Ray without some trouble. Seeing Ray get repeatedly fired from various jobs due to his fiery temper, Edward lets him in on a must-have item(!) for noble ladies that is sure to bring in a big sum of money. While searching through the forest for the material for the item, Ray is injured, though lightly, by an arrow out of nowhere. He runs away refusing any treatment. The arrow's owner is none other than Crown Prince Lucas of Luvecia. Having saved Ray from his troubles time and again, Lucas makes an offer Ray can't refuse--the terms of which dictate that his life will be spared, should he grant Lucas his wishes.

title: The Sichuan Cuisine Chef and His Valiant Babes of Another World
alt_titles: Sichuan Chushi Yu Yishijie De Yongzhe Shaonü Men
Sichuan Chef and Brave Girl in Another World
description: After transmigrating into a world of magic, Qin Chuan who was a Sichuan Cuisine Chef discovers his food is key to boosting combativity. With demons rampaging the land, it’s about time to put an end to the misery and suffering.Who’s to say a chef can’t save the world? But why are the heroes super hot babes?

title: Beast Familiar for All: Beginning Awakening of Mythical Talents
alt_titles: Quanmin Yu Shou: Kaiju Juexing Shenhua Ji Tiamanfu
Quánmín Yù Shòu: Kāijú Juéxǐng Shénhuà Jí Tiānfù,
description: A soldier reincarnated into another world would he be able to reach the top or would he be left behind as others move forward or would his arrogance cause his destruction.

title: Red Dot
description:
Do-hee hates people's inconsiderate stares.
She even cut her hair because she hated it, but the attention never ceases.
One day, a fatigued and frustrated Do-hee received a link.
A familiar room, similar body type, and a red mole above her belly button
What catches the eye more than the naked body in the video.
What is this...roommate...Cha Bo-bin!?

title: Sunshine & Bright Stars
description: Realistic and nuanced slice of school life. A cute, positive, and enthusiastic junior bumps into a girl who does hip-hop, and is emotionally shy and slow despite looking cool. The sweet, tangled-up, heartwarming, and GL story of chasing love.

title: The Internet Are Character Pairing Fans of the Movie God and Me
alt_titles: I’m Being Shipped With the King of Film!
Quan Wang Dou Shi Wo He Yingdi CP Fen
The Internet Are CP Fans of the Movie God and Me
description: (Note: CP = Character Pairing) Whaaa?! The demon spirit management just arranged a husband for me again?! This time, the guy's a movie god! OMG~ I'm only a recently matured small fox. Arranging such an old demon to me, what am I to do~

title: Regenerate Top Players
description: "Bai Qi", an unknown game anchor, is about to reach the pinnacle of his life when he accidentally dies while streaming a game called "Soul Throne". Unexpectedly, he is reborn into the world of this high-difficulty action game. With his "T0-Level" game skills from his previous life and the blessing of the system's "100 Full-Achieved Max-Level Accounts", can Bai Qi ascend to the throne once again and become the one and only king of that world?

title: Subscribers Only
description:
Choi Hanseok, who was the most popular guy around, has become a lifeless & boring person after a certain incident 3 years ago. A friend decides to stage an intervention to save Hanseok from the person he's become. The intervention? Videos shot by the the trendiest camboy Mill Tea.   
  
But what happens when Hanseok realizes who Mill Tea is? And then they inevitably meet?

title: Shura Sword Sovereign
description: Ten thousand years ago, the ancestor of the blade killed the Sword Emperor in Wuwang Mountain and ordered the sword cultivators to be killed all over the world. Thousands of years later, the young Chu Mu was born, crushing the soul of the blade and forging the soul of the sword, With one stroke of his sword, he pierced through the sky, leaving a mark for eternity.

title: I Am the Descendant of the Divine Dragon!
alt_titles: The Descendant of the Divine Dragon
description: In the highly competitive world of the Xuan Realm Continent, where warriors strive to refine their bodies, cultivate their martial abilities, harness the essence of the heavens and earth, and push beyond mortal limitations, our protagonist, Lu Hao, faces unjust persecution from his own clan since childhood. However, fate smiles upon him as he awakens the dormant bloodline of the Divine Dragon within him. With an unyielding resolve, Lu Hao embarks on an extraordinary journey, overcoming countless obstacles to ascend to the zenith of power. Along the way, he unravels the enigmatic secrets of his past life.

title: The Flower That Swallowed the Beast
alt_titles: The Flower That Swallowed the Beast
A Beast Swallowed by a Flower
The Flower That Was Swallowed by the Beast
description:
“A wolf only keeps one female by its side, Lisi.”

Iris was called the flower of the Whitlow Duchy, but in reality, she lived a life no better than a weed. The man named Caverant Green, who deliberately approached her to live a comfortable life again, was an extremely hot and beast-like man. Every time she make eye contact with the leader of the beastmen, a dangerous atmosphere blooms between them…

---
A bargain for her life, to escape a tragic future. When Iris Whittle is murdered by her sadistic husband, she is sent back in time to when she was 20 years old. As the unwanted daughter of a duke, Iris realizes she can leverage her status and foresight to secure a better life this time around. Thus, Iris makes a daring marriage proposal to the fearsome Count Keibrandt Green, the most eligible bachelor of Gavizar Empire, whose gruff and stern demeanor hides the fangs of a wolf.

title: Can't Say No
alt_titles: I Can't Say No to Him
description: As one knows, talking too much can cause problems. This happened to Guan Cheng when he misspoke during Latin Dance and accidentally caught the attention of Yu Yunfei, who slowly intrudes on his life. “Wait, this man, where have I seen him before?" What will this dense and straightforward man do when he meets an overly attractive male?

title: Betrayal of Dignity
description:
Would you sacrifice your honor to marry a Duke?

In order to save her family from ruin, Chloe Verdier must find a groom for her sister, Alice. 

She soon runs into the handsome but arrogant Duke Thisse who makes a proposal that could save them.

When Alice flees with a mysterious man, Chloe must seek out the Duke in the biggest gamble of her life.

title: Without A Daoist Partner, I Will Die
alt_titles: Meiyou Dao Lv Jiu Hui Si
Méiyǒu Dào Lǚ Jiù Huì Sǐ
Death Right Away for Not Having a Taoist Companion
Come On, I Need A Couple!
description:
Shock! His older sister regarded his ancestral grave as a furnace tripod? His strange disease miraculously disappeared and he officially embarked on the road of cultivation. Huh? You must do it again within 30 days? Or you’ll die?


---

**Links:**
- [Alternative raw (BiliBili)](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc31504?utm_source=mgd&utm_medium=uploader)

title: Chess and Rawin
description: Chess, a werewolf with a large build, but a timid and shy demeanor; and Rawin, a vampire who seems cold-hearted but is actually passionate… When they first met, these two are excessively(?) attracted to each other, and have ended up having sex on the same day. But, from past to present, the relationship between werewolves and vampires has been ill-fated. How will Chess and Rawin’s unusual love story end?

title: Starry Empty Wish
description: Seo Yeonji who was rejected by her childhood friend, fell asleep that night while cursing him. The next morning she woke up and acquired a weird ability to see information about the people around her.

title: A Fruitless Betrothal
description: Dai Yi is a female geography teacher who has just transferred to high school. She has a crush on her colleague, the popular female teacher, Zhang Guo, and she was about to grow closer with her crush. However, Zhang Guo unexpectedly announced that she was engaged。

title: Ultimate Tutorial Warrior
alt_titles: Warrior Kim Builds up His Traits
description:
Junsu is an ordinary college student who spends an extraordinary amount of time trying to beat a pay-to-win hero collector game called Arcane Seoul. 

All his hours of painstaking gameplay finally pays off when he lands Cheonma, one of the ultimate SS-ranked characters in the game, seconds before a truck runs him over. Now, he finds himself as Jeonsa Kim, a basic tutorial-stage character who can learn any skill. 

Can he use his gaming knowledge to survive the godforsaken, magic-driven, and monster-ridden alternate world of Arcane Seoul?

title: The Exceptional Farmgirl
description:
Following an accident, Su Xinyu, a 35-yeard old surgeon transmigrated to a baby's body in ancient times, becoming the seventh daughter of Tao Liuping.
She hence became the infant Xiangzhi'er, but kept her adult's mind secret as she grew, seeking a way to survive in the patriarchy. It was fortunate that her mother was a strong woman, who knew the ways of the world and thought differently. She promised to raise her daughters well and protect them from bullying, not to mention that Xiangzhi's sisters all earned their keep, and were as tough as they were smart. Xiangzhi herself became good friends with the young boy Rock, brought to her by a mysterious old man — and yet, she failed to notice that her little quirks that surpass ordinary children were noticed by an old woman from the village who held hidden depths...

title: Little Red Baby Bird
alt_titles: The Beloved New Daughter-in-law Of The Wolf Mansion
The Beloved New Baby of the Wolf Manor
description: After her first molt reveals red feathers symbolic of a curse, Lindsey Raniero of the Eagle Clan is shunned by her family and dies alone. She awakens in the past, only 7 years old. Wishing to escape her fate, Lindsey takes her bird form to run away and makes a deal with the rival Wolf Clan: She will wed their ailing heir and heal him with her clan's power in exchange for their protection. But surrounded by wolves and with her family now on her tail, can this little bird live to spread her wings?

title: All My Female Disciples Want to Kill Me
alt_titles: Nv Tudi Ge Ge Xiang Sha Wo
Nǚ Túdì Gè Gè Xiǎng Shā Wǒ
All of My Female Apprentices Want to Kill Me
All the Female Apprentices Want to Kill Me
description: Possessing the memories from the 21st century, I transmigrated inside a big shot, “Su Bei”, and brought my own “Apprenticeship Up to [10000] Times Feedback” system. The disciples are not only as beautiful as flowers, but they are also blessed with a revolutionary destiny. This is the chosen one who can become the main protagonist in any novel. But these disciples hate to be unable to peel my skin and tear my bones. What the hell did the past Su Bei do against these apprentices!!

title: How Small and Innocent
description: The daily life of Cui Haomin, who lacks facial expressions but has plenty of points when it comes to love. This is the story of childhood sweethearts, and the male lead is the younger brother from No Words.

title: Find the Waves
description: Kang Pado is a boy who accompanies his father on their countryside farm; raising cattle, fruits, and vegetables for a living. At the same time, he is studying at the not-so-nearby high school which, travelled by land, is 10km away. However, Pado’s father unwittingly mentions to him a shortcut using the river, shortening the distance to only 3km. Being an obedient kid, he takes his father’s advice and swims every day back and forth to the school whenever he has classes. However, circumstances occur when, due to a lack of students in their high school, the administration shuts it down, leaving Kang Pado no choice but to go to Seoul, where his sister lives. There he will continue his high school studies and deal with what Seoul High School Life has to offer!

title: The Grown Dog Bullies Its Owner
description:
"You there, be mine!"

School grass Xia Zhixing, unwilling to reveal his identity as a streamer, borrows the face of the mysterious top student Lin Lang.

Unexpectedly, the student that resembled a cute little puppy had actually desired him for a long time...

"Senior, the reward I want is you."

title: Over Steam
description: In the aftermath of a great war between humanity and creatures known as the Talaiv, the storms of war are brewing again.

title: Gunslayer Legend
description: In the year 2035, the technological civilization of mankind reached an unprecedented height. However, it was also followed by energy exhaustion. Soldiers from various countries plundered all the resources greedily. Ulysses performance will determine whether he can become an agent fighting for world peace!

title: The Secrets of the Lovely Duchess
alt_titles: The Secrets of the Lovely Duchess
description:
After seven years trapped in the Devil Grand Duke’s dungeon, Luculia is finally free, but her savior is not the prince she imagined. 

Davierre Montefeltro, a temperamental duke, unexpectedly takes her in. As Luculia adjusts to life outside the dungeon, mysteries swirl around Duke Davierre’s intentions. 

Can Luculia find happiness at last, or is this new life just another dungeon?

title: My Harem Depends on Drawing Cards
description: A Genius, who has now have to learns his lesson through a different worlds and now he is waste with no talent in this new world? Only using cards from his system, he now have to open a road of harem in his new life!

title: A Will Eternal
description:
One will to create oceans. One will to summon the mulberry fields.  
  
One will to slaughter countless devils. One will to eradicate innumerable immortals.  
  
Only my will… is eternal.  
  
A Will Eternal tells the tale of Bai Xiaochun, an endearing but exasperating young man who is driven primarily by his fear of death and desire to live forever, but who deeply values friendship and family.

---

**Links:**
- [Alternative Raw (ac.qq)](https://ac.qq.com/Comic/ComicInfo/id/649851)

title: Ao Jiao Wangye Zhongtian Fei
description:
She was a chef who was a fresh graduate from the famous X-university and a rising star.  
But she who wanted to shine brightly, died and crossed over.  
Even more, she was very unlucky to have ended up in a desert hungry and tired.

title: Trash Belongs in the Trash Can!
alt_titles: Throw the Trash in the Trash can!
Put the Trash to Where It Belongs!
description:
'Woobin', who uses his good looks to seduce rich women and has lived like trash. 

He ends up falling in love with 'Suzy', a chaebol heir who was only supposed to be a target of his seduction.

He experiences the sweetness of love for the first time, 

But it lasts only for a while because what's hidden behind Suzy's angel-like appearance begins to slowly choke Woobin. 

A romance story of two trash-like humans who can't even be recycled!

title: Black Chains
description: The Emperor’s consort committed suicide. Hassolan, who devoted 14 years to Emperor Akelans, hung herself but woke up 14 years in the past. No matter what, she keeps returning to that day. The once cold Emperor now fiercely refuses to let her go, saying, “You are my mate. If you don’t want it, I won’t be Emperor.”

title: My Brother and His Gift
description: After losing his parents in a tragic car crash, college student Lee Sihyuk is left alone to raise his baby brother, Siha. In order to do so, Sihyuk decides to follow in his father's footsteps and become a translator. While working to apply for the job, he suddenly finds himself knowledgeable about things he's never learned and starts to gain recognition as a translation prodigy! But even with his mysterious new ability, can Sihyuk really balance work and school, all while raising a 3-year-old?

title: The Villainess's Dazzling Debut
alt_titles: The Villainess Makes a Splendid Debut
description: Although she was born as a noble princess, her life was abandoned by her fiancé and betrayed by her family. “I don’t need to live kindly, I will live more splendidly than anyone else. Even if that's called a wicked woman.” After her return, the prelude to her vengeance was to kneel before her cheating fiancé. But before long, “Princess! There is so much gold, they say, that the Royal Bank's warehouses are running low!” “Princess! Every country is clamoring to serve the princess!” “Princess! Oh my God, the Emperor of the Empire has come to visit!” The world kneels before Erdella.

title: Hanlim Gym
description: Tired of being picked on, Yeongha, the new transfer student, decides to fight back… and discovers he can pack a punch. He soon becomes the top of the food chain, savoring his new title as the toughest guy at school. But he meets his match when Suho Kang, the Champion of the PVP games, single-handedly takes down him and his crew. To earn back his honor, Yeongha decides to join the PVP games. Will he finally get the satisfaction of beating Suho up? Or will he gain something more?

title: Mirror of Innocence
description: Jiang Xiaoman, a university student and online writer, inherits a mysterious job from her father. Working as the archdemon Qin Lan's assistant, she begins to tackle strange cases with Qin Lan. As the two clashing personalities band together to solve each bizarre yet heart-rending case, they develop special feelings towards each other.

title: I Can Extract Attributes
description: I, Gu Shaoyang, have the ability to extract fused attributes. Extracting the enlightened roots and bones of countless geniuses, I am the top demon, the supreme heavenly pride. By fusing countless lower grade yuan stones and inferior pills, I can rub out extremely high grade yuan stones and god grade spirit pills. Now I just want to ask: when will I be invincible?!!!

title: Sunyu of the Shadowless
description: Some children are raised in the hands of Kwak No, After establishing a Disciple-Master relationship, the children dream of their own dreams by practicing martial arts and walking in that path to become masters. In order to make a living, Kwak No always had to leave his seat, and Seon-yu, the eldest of the children, has to take care of the Children, and He’ll be the Great Master.

title: Restless
description:
Gyojin mistrusts all alphas and he despises the society that makes life difficult for Omegas. He manages to find a job, but his superior is none other than Hyeono, his former classmate from middle school who was bullied because of a misunderstanding that involved him. They settled the misunderstandings, but Gyojin is now bothered because Hyeono started courting him. While trying his best to reject Hyeono, Gyojin’s senior from college, the source of his trauma of Alphas, re-appeared in his life. And this sunbae also turned out to be one of his superiors…

dans sa vie. Et ce Sunbae s'est aussi avérée être l'un de ses supérieures… (Fujoshixgirl's love Fansub ) Traduis disponible sur notre blog ! ||

title: Dog's Love Way
description:
The sweet office romance unfolds in a world that has been animalized ♡  
  
Daeun, who works as usual, hears the rumor that an employee from another company will come, and that they will carry out a project together. The employee who attracted the attention of people in the company with his handsome looks, was none other than Daeun's long-time unrequited love, Junhyuk. Can Daeun capture Jun-hyuk now that they met again?

title: Rewriting My Third Life
alt_titles: I'll Take Those You Play the Field With
description: After being abused and killed by her family in two separate lifetimes, Blesse Lavian expects nothing from them in her third life. This time, despite knowing the horrible end that awaits House Lavian, Blesse decides to keep quiet and flee when the time is right. But the more time she spends with her cold-looking father and half-sister, the more she realizes that the Lavians aren't so bad after all. Will Blesse take a chance and rewrite her third life, or will she end up betrayed once again?

title: Bloody Romance
description: The first love that I experienced was a delicious red.

title: Became The Lucky 666 Princess Destiny
alt_titles: Wo Zhuansheng Jiu Chao Shen, Hai Bian Cheng Xingyun 666 De Tianming Gongzhu
I Was Reincarnated Into a Super God, but Also Become a Lucky 666 Princess of Destiny
Wǒ Zhuǎnshēng Jiù Chāo Shén, Hái Biàn Chéng Xìngyùn 666 De Tiānmìng Gōngzhǔ
description: In the beta test of a video game, the Super God player is forced to turn into a beautiful woman. The beautiful woman also happens to be the Lucky 666 Princess of Destiny. Don't get in my way of becoming a super god!

title: Mercury Express
description:
If you can afford the fee, I can transport anything.  
  
Ling Yu, a delivery man with strange abilities, is caught up in all kinds of trouble after accepting jobs that no one else would dare to take.

title: Egg of the Elf (Official Colored)
description: Humans and elves coexisted on the continent. Due to the Demon King’s curse, females will no longer... be born???In order to save the humans, the elves added a new law to the land. This law allowed humans to continue to reproduce, and that law is...

title: My Japanese Sisters
alt_titles: My little sister comes from a neighboring country
description: 老爸突然再婚，外表凶恶的高中生霍天麟突然多了两个来自日本的妹妹！然而这两个天降系妹妹却有着惊人的秘密！霍天麟将如何与她们相处？她们又将如何看待霍天麟？

title: By Myself
description: The spread of a virus of the national disaster proportion has shut down Seoul! Haebin, who lost all of his classmates in an incident a year before, left home in order to avoid being alone again. What is the unexpected truth awaiting him that keeps him from regaining his normal daily life?!

title: My Hubby Is Too Cute!
alt_titles: I'm in Trouble Because My Husband Is So Cute
description:
‘I was sad just for being reincarnated with a dirt spoon, and now you’re telling me I also have to marry because of a debt?’

Not just that, but the person who will be my husband is the Heir Apparent of Duke Hessenweitz, the monster from all those horrifying rumors!

“A monster doesn’t deserve good treatment.”

However, in the castle of the duke, I saw my young husband being abused for being a monster. I felt pity for my young husband and since he was more like a younger brother to me, I tried to be a little nicer to him…

“You are my miracle and my salvation.”

Only… I didn’t expect this kind of reaction at all? And not just that…

“If I had a daughter who resembles my wife, she would be like you!”

No, why are you doing this to me? Even the father-in-law who had a bad temper? Can I survive in this duke’s castle safely?

---
Upon marrying into the powerful Hessenweitz duchy, Ellie Blanchett arrives at her new home and quickly learns that behind the prestige lies a deeply dysfunctional family. Her husband Zachary, heir to the duchy, is considered a monster by his own father, who scorns him for his supernatural powers. But as Ellie discovers, her husband is not only kind, but cute too! Stuck in the middle of this father-son drama, can Ellie help Zachary accept his powers and stand up to his dad once and for all?

title: The End is a Game to Me
alt_titles: The End Of World Is A Game
description:
Go Cheon-su, is an unemployed Game Streamer. With only 1 viewer.

One day, he is picked as a Player and is thrown into a real-world survival game.

The game clear condition is to not die. The 24*7 Survival Stream begins.

title: All I Want is My Dream Home
alt_titles: My Dream is Just to Own a Home!
description:
Isabel lived and died as a doormat. 

After waking up in the past, she gets to work on dumping her terrible boyfriend and escaping her abusive household. However, financial and legal limits stop her from gaining total independence on her own. There is one potential solution: a policy that provides housing for newlyweds! 

This means Isabel has to find a man to marry. Enter Sir Dylan, the perfect catch. For reasons unknown, he volunteers to become her fake husband, and they earn Ishael’s dream house. 

But can they turn it into a real home together?

title: Ping
description: In the modern age, there remains martial arts clans from long ago, all vying for power. Amidst a fight, the son of a security man meets a mysterious girl who kisses him out of the blue…

title: It Turns out That I Have Been Invincible for a Long Time
alt_titles: I've Been Invincible for a Long Time
description: Over a five-year journey around the world, Ye Changqing first believed he could be like other cool novel protagonist systems with a plug-in, but even the most common immortal cultivator cannot be. Living close to a sect in a small town was his only option, so he started a business. His small store eventually turned into the holy land of all the righteous individuals, and the dog he raised up turned out to be the feared demon king. From that moment on, everyone acknowledged Ye Changqing as a Supreme Master.

title: Polar Night
description:
Heavy snow, strong winds, extreme cold, and an Antarctic winter with half of the year being night.  
An unidentified 'something' appeared in front of researchers isolated in the worst conditions on Earth.

title: Turning into a Tentacle Monster, Made Me Crazier
alt_titles: Turning into a Tentacle Monster, Made Me Crazier
After Turning into C-Type Tentacle Monsters, They Became Even Crazier
description: For unknown reasons, Xiao Zheng would transform into a tentacle monster when he became excited. Even if he longed for love, he would disguise himself as being cold. But suddenly he was summoned by Bai Anan, who was usually serious but secretly loved drawing. He signed an agreement and became Bai Anan’s “familiar”. He was threatened to help her – to draw the Manhua that would top the list!

title: Late Winter
description: A sudden cold current swept the earth. The burning hot summer has turned into extreme winter cold. The whole world looks like it is the end of the world. Even worse, scary and deadly creatures hide beneath the thick snow… they are the Snowmen…

title: Mad Maid with Odd Powers
description: The maid cafe's shop owner is always away throughout the year, but the two maids keep the shop orderly, neat, and tidy. Suddenly, supernatural attacks disrupted the peace in the shop, and the maids got into fights with them. Together with the male protagonist, Mo Qi and his hidden ability, they undo the manipulation and protect citizens. However, it seems like the shop owner has some sort of connection with these supernatural events, which leads to a big secret…

title: Mermaid's Dresses
description: In order to break her marriage contract, the revolting mermaid girl goes ashore to the city, to find her “fiancee” that manages a western-clothes shop, but accidentally releases the seal, on a piece of female clothing, of a monster……. For the sake of subduing the monster, the arrogant mermaid girl and the attractive two-faced brother start a fantastic new life~

title: It's Just a Dream...Right?!
description:
Jungoh was just expecting to take on a part-time job as an assistant. What he didn’t expect was working inside people’s dreams with a cute, but grumpy shaman named Ibeom. And he certainly didn’t expect Ibeom to be cursed by a nightmare seedling, with uncontrollable sexual arousal that can only be tamed by acting out his desires! Ibeom may not be too sure about Jungoh, but with his prickly personality, he has no one to turn to for help. But luckily for him, Jungoh is always in a giving mood...

title: The Lady Is the Future Tyrant
alt_titles: The Lady Is the Future Tyrant
My Wife Is Actually the Future Tyrannical Empress
description: Zhao JinYu did not expect that after his rebirth, the one he will marry would actually be the future tyrannical empress who usurped the throne. In order to prevent his wife from going astray in this life, he worked hard and made great efforts. But his wife seems to be different from her previous life, how come she doesn’t care about the affairs of the court at all and only sticks to him every day? But that’s not bad because he plan to have several children with her sooner, so that she will get busy with the children every day, so that she’ll have no time to plot for rebellion. Just as planned!

title: Strange Store
description: This is a ghost online shop that betrays desire. As long as the customer needs it, the black business card will arrive as promised and will be delivered with exclusive items with magical effects. However, no one knows how much it costs to use these items. The legend of “Strange Store” has already started circulating in the city. “The next business card… will it appear next to you?”

title: My Favorite Idol
description:
The bodies of the top idol and a school outcast are switched?! A school outcast who is always bullied everyday, Hong Jooa. A top idol who is loved by the whole nation, Go Yohan. Jooa, who envies the life of her beloved idol, and Yohan, who envies the simple and free life of an ordinary person. While they yearned for each other’s lives, their bodies were switched one day!? A spectacular body-switch romance, My Favorite Idol!
Blackout-Phantom

alt_titles: Shā sǐ Hǎibào de 100 Zhǒng Fāngfǎ

title: The Strongest Fate System
description:
The Venerable Immortal Zhutian has been undermined and returned with a mysterious system!   
  
Absorb every luck and control the fate of everything, I am the only one who decided!   
  
Rebirth into a Chinese student named Qin Yunhui, see how he uses the system to achieve everything he ever wanted in this realm of men!   
  
Modern earth meets ancient immortal story. "When I return to the heavenly realm, I will get back everything I deserve!"

title: 6 Worlds of Cultivation
description:
Left alone in front of the monastery during a troublesome time, Yub SeJun was thought to be a normal, abandoned baby. However, he had the power to change the world in the way he wanted. In the world, everyone followed the classical cultivation; however, SeJun follows his morals and creates a novel cultivation method. Can he become the new hero who will bring the world out of chaos?

[Alternative Raw](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=rfrc)

title: BLISS: Divine Contract Civilization
description: Ten years ago, an earth-shattering war nearly destroyed the world. The survivors built a new world, yet it doesn't seem to have calmed down at all…

title: Harp and Poetry Under the Aurora
alt_titles: Harp and Poem Under the Aurora
description: In the north of the continent, there lies a snow-covered country dubbed the 'Snow Kingdom'. When a nomadic hunter girl first enters this land, she feels an unprecedented warmth, and even encounters a beautiful woman...

title: Brother's Sick Love
alt_titles: Hu Ru Yi Ye Bing Jiao
The Yandere Came During the Night
description: Yu Xiang unfortunately transmigrates into a merchant's daughter, who was mistakenly taken to the marquis manor at birth. She is immediately disabled, and carries the nickname of 'disaster star'. Helplessly, she can only cling to her older brother, the marquis, in hopes of surviving, and wait for the true master to return so she can give way. Years later, when the true master returns to the manor, Yu Xiang prepares to leave. however, she finds out her clinging technique is too good, that her marquis brother won't let her leave!

title: Between Seasons
description: Night after night, a mysterious woman runs through Yoongun’s dreams. So when he happens to catch a glimpse of her in the flesh, he devises an intricate plan to lure her into his arms, determined to bring his subconscious fantasies to life. In a twist of fate, Kyu-young is searching for a way to nurse her broken heart when Yoongun makes his timely entrance. Seizing the opportunity, Yoongun proposes a tempting solution to Kyu-young’s heartache. He suggests becoming her rebound, a tool for revenge against her unfaithful ex-fiancé. Seduced by this irresistible offer, Kyu-young’s life takes an unexpected turn. Will he be her unwitting destroyer or an unexpected savior?

title: S-Class Self-Employed Person
description: After seven long years in a fantasy world, I finally returned to the real world. Just when I thought I could enjoy some peace and quiet in normal life... Thanks to an Esper, my home vanished in an instant, leaving me with no choice but to scrape together what little money I had and start my own business. “Amazing! The highest-ranked S-class Guide has appeared!” “Huh...? Me?” I was just planning to live quietly as a café owner, but somehow, I ended up becoming an S-class Guide...?!

title: To Kill a Mirror
description: Yu Ha Na has a trauma related to murder. She then witnesses the new teacher's murder scene.

title: When Fate Finds Us
description:
*One kiss could save my life.*

As a prophetess, Noemi can see the futures of those she touches. Yet sadly, as the wife of a god, she sees only death in her own fateful future. But then, a sudden kiss with an unruly merchant brings a vision of life. Could he be Noemi's key to survival? Or will she be unable to escape her destiny?

title: Shinsu Jeil Sword
description:
Mu Sung, a young worker at a restaurant dreams of winning the heart of So Yeon, the youngest daughter of a renowned family. He decides to become Shinsu Jeil Blade, a term coined after a convicted swordsman who placed beauty above everything. By a chance of luck, Mu sung gains a handbook written by a legendary master and receives an unknown power~  
  
Here starts an unusual swordsman's journey in the murim world~ will he be able to fulfill his goal?

title: My Boss's Special Request
description:
Choi Jung-woo, President of G Cosmetics, an emerging brand in the cosmetics industry and her secretary, Shin Soohyun, an excellent worker with incomparable beauty. One day, a special order from the President came: "Shin Secretary, marry me." . The marriage conditions are so awesome, right?!! Follow those two people office romance! An unpredictable love story!

title: A World of Gold to You
description:
Once upon a time, the world had been divided into the Moon Kingdom, inhabited by humans, and the Sun Kingdom, inhabited by demons. Estelle, a knight of the Moon Kingdom, loses her family to an ambush from the demons and is sentenced to life in exile after becoming entangled with a mysterious demon child. To survive, she sets out to a mysterious tower in the north with her companions. A timid knight, a slave boy, and a shadow who was once the Demon King.

This is an alluring story about three people embarking on an adventure to find their true selves.

title: Ancient Animal Tales
description: What does it take for an animal to live and survive? What would it choose to die for? A T. rex, washed ashore and stranded on an island for over 20 years, waits for the day he can take his final breath. But just when that moment seems near, hope arrives. A collection of stories about the great creatures that have roamed the Earth before us.

title: Plaza Wars
description:
15 years ago, two gangs survived the competition at the Capitol plaza to overtake Seoul.  
  
Gi Jun cut off his own Achilles tendon and leaves his gang, realizing shortly after that his younger brother has become the other gang's leader.  
  
15 years later, after his brother's sudden death, Gi Jun is now searching for the truth aiming to uncover what has happened.

Alternative Official English

description: Magical girl Vanilla was dismissed when she was just 18-years old because the king is a lolicon?! Vanilla didn't want to be separated from her familiar, Black Mike, so he suggested that they run away together! Pursued by many, Vanilla gradually discovers her feelings for Black Mike during this chaotic situation.

title: This Wolf Won't Bite
alt_titles: I'm a Wolf, but I Won't Harm You
description:
Lucy Leopardi has no friends. But of course she doesn’t—she’s a lamb born into a family of lions! Lonely, insecure, and desperate for friendship, Lucy can’t wait to make her first friend. One fateful night on a ballroom balcony, she meets Roman, a charming, young dog with whom she makes an instant connection. But when his association with the infamous House of Baskerville comes to light, will their newfound friendship blossom, or will dishonesty bite into their budding relationship?

title: Please Eat Without Hesitation
description:
Hanna, a chef of a famous restaurant in London was a victim of terror bombings. When she woke up, she became Choi Songyi, the daughter of the Minister of War Affairs of the Joseon Kingdom.  
  
The Crown Prince of the Joseon kingdom, Lee Pyo has a extraordinary talent. His sense of smell and taste are very sensitive; he has never forgotten the taste and aroma of any food he's ever eaten.  
  
What will happen if both of them meet?

title: Illusion Hunter from Another World
alt_titles: The Delusional Hunter in Another World
description:
"I have a little secret. I'm from an alien planet far, far away.

However... fate had other plans. I found myself reincarnated into the body of someone who had literally starved to death! Will Gi-ryeo be able to find a way to adapt to this strange planet called Earth and keep his true identity hidden?"

title: Please Sponsor My Revenge
description:
After losing it all, Robelia Efferentia wants to give up on life until she learns the true cause of her misery: her uncle, Marlon. Filled with rage, she meets Jade Ferrado, a powerful duke who can help her enact revenge. Robelia asks him to become her sponsor, but he'll only do so if she agrees to marry him. She signs the papers, and with the duke's resources now at her disposal, Robelia is ready to wreak vengeance! However, she soon discovers that her uncle isn't the only one behind her woes...

---
"About your curse, I’ll try to solve it. But in return, please accept me as your blood relative."

From the information in the original, she knew the reason why her mother died. Robelia suddenly remembered her current situation, deprived of everything and pushed to the end. So she decided to take revenge.

She successfully escapes her uncle's control and quickly plans to take back what belongs to her. She reached out to Duke Ferrado, who was known to be fraught with danger, and made her proposal.

"I know a better way. I was thinking about creating a contract marriage, what do you think?"

He suddenly came up with a rather unexpected proposal. Robelia has shaken her uncle’s capital thanks to his support.

In front of her, the original heroine and the enemy's daughter appeared as love rivals to her.

"Well, sis, why did you change so quickly?"

Can Robelia get her revenge perfectly?

"When everything comes to an end, I want to be by your side"

And can she have a happy ending with the man she woos?

title: Invasion of the Immortal Emperor
description: The miserable and ugly man, reborn into a sect full of beautiful sisters! He thought he'd spend his whole life with them, but he was faced by countless mountains, bloody battles, rainy winds… The rubbish Tian Chen in the eyes of others, the abandoned son of a martial family, destined to be a good for nothing for a lifetime! in order to prove himself, and get back what he lost, and protect his loved ones, he embarked on a road full of hurdles, stars move and fight, everything is unified, a generation of the best immortal emperor finally arrives, he stands on the top of the continent, trying to become the most dazzling existence in tens of thousands of years!

title: Catching up to Luke Vischel
description:
Bastian Effenberg, the best duke in the world who had nothing to fear.
She declares that she will marry the kingdom's top monster hunter, Luke Bischel, who is the exact opposite of her! The marriage of two people who are opposites, can it really go smoothly?

---
With wealth, status, and incredibly good looks, the only thing Bastian Effenberg is missing is a decent personality. But who needs one of those when the queen is your cousin and the whole world bows at your feet? Of course, even a noble pain in everyone's side needs to be disciplined once in a while. And that's what Bastian's parents thought they were doing when they threatened to marry him off to Luke Vischel, the ferocious knight of everyone's nightmares. Luke may have been the only person Bastian ever feared, but that is precisely how she captured his heart. Now, Bastian is determined to conquer the woman who once sent chills up his spine, but is he any match for her? This pompous heir is certainly a force to be reckoned with, but if anyone can tame him, it's her.

title: Children of the Rune - Winterer
description:
"Child, you must survive!"

After the destruction of his House by his uncle, all that was left for a young boy, Boris, was the heirloom sword, Winterer. But little did he know that this treasure would become the cause of another crisis. As people seek Winterer, Boris’ heart grows colder and bleaker, much like the winter.

The adventures of Boris — to survive and to protect the sword of his House — begin now. What awaits him at the end of this journey? And what secrets does the winter sword Winterer hold?

title: The Constellation of Us
description: Asterism is both a bland and cruel story between a rebellious boy and an obedient student. Like how two shooting stars fly towards each other, converging and separating without even a single word, the two gradually find their place in each other's lives. The pair become each other's model, and this might just be the strongest display of their feelings.

title: Flawed Almighty
description: Do good or go to hell. The conditions of his new curse seem simple enough for once-hopeful hoodlum Jeonji Kim. Or so it seems when his perky guardian angel shows up on his doorstep one day and heals his limp. But will simply going through the motions of helping people be enough to appease a petty god with a grudge?

title: Succuba & Siren
description:
An entry for "Let's Meet at the Witches' Gathering."  
  
  
  
  
[Weibo](https://www.weibo.com/u/5372531272)

title: The Unintentional Villainess
alt_titles: The Reason I Have to Be a Villainess
The Reason I Have to Be a Villain
description: After being reborn in a novel, Renee Blair is determined to transform her reputation as "the villainess of the century," which will prevent her death at the hands of Sir Dywen the dragon slayer! But then she learns that the original Renee had been controlled by a pop-up game system of daily missions that forced her to either commit evil deeds or face painful penalties for declining. With this system continuing to affect her as well, can the new Renee outsmart the game and reset her evil legacy?

title: Raising the Second Male Lead’s Son
alt_titles: Raising the Second Male Lead’s Son
I Became the Mother of the Supporting Male Lead's Son
I Became the Mother of the Sub-Male Lead's Son
description: Our protagonist wakes up one day to find herself as Elia, the daughter of a bankrupt baron and a side character in a romance-fantasy novel. While on the run from debt collectors, she saves a child from an attacker -- only to be accused of being the kidnapper by the child’s guardian, Duke Kaiden. Taken to his mansion, she’s forced to live with them and be the child’s nanny. Can Elia clear up the misunderstanding and find her way out of this mess?

title: The Princess Back From Hell
description: After taking revenge on the ex-boyfriend who used to abuse her, she died and transmigrated as the heroine of the popular otome game "Rose Spiral". She found out that the targets who could be captured possessed evil intentions, approaching the female lead only to use her. The frozen heart of a reborn girl burns with hatred, and a revenge plan slowly unfolds. While attacking and taking revenge on the men, will she learn to love and be loved again?

title: Finding Camellia
description:
Her life was nothing but lies. Camellia was just 12 when she was taken away from her mother in the slums and forced to live as the son of an aristocratic family. But under the layers of secrets and lies, she never forgets. She continues to struggle to be her true self again, to reclaim the life of Camellia.

---
Camellia was a flower born of a street rat, her face more ethereal than any other. When she was a child, a wealthy noblewoman took her and forced her to become Camellius Bale, the second-born son of House Bale. From that day on, her life was no longer her own.

For years, Camellius has lived to protect the position of her older brother, Kieran, even though this does not benefit her at all. With nowhere to run, she obeys her stepmother's orders, burying herself deep beneath a facade of lies. As she begins to cross paths with Claude del Ihar, the heir to the grand dukedom, she continues to hope that someday she can reclaim what was once hers—the life of Camellia.

title: Adorable Spoiled Little Princess
description: This is a story about: a female lead who transforms into a child after losing her virginity, her identity switches between an adult and a kid. With the crown prince who has a dual personality too, there's equal parts love and bite.

title: He Flew Back From Hell as a Crow
description: A guy known as “the Raven” is supposedly left for dead by hired assassins from the “Predator Group.” But instead, he gained mutant powers such as speed, reflex and immortality just like a raven would. As he is given another chance to live, he wanted to hunt down every single assassin as a plot of revenge.

title: My Girlfriend Is A Bit Weird, but She Is Very Cute
description: My name is Ma Yun and I recently made a girlfriend. Although I always feel that she is a bit weird, she is really cute~

title: Return of the Scholar
description:
Against all odds, Ma Hyeon escapes the demonic realm he was trapped in and returns to his family. They’re shocked and overjoyed to find the son they thought dead is alive. They’re even more shocked to discover that his ordeals have transformed him into a martial arts master of incredible skill and power! 

But Ma Hyeon soon learns that surviving demons and monsters may not be as challenging as adjusting back to a normal life after a decade away, especially as a shadowy organization targets his family...

alt_titles: Demon Queen Just Wants to Make Peace
When I Opened My Eyes, I Had Become the Devil
When I Opened My Eyes, I Found Myself a Demon
description:
‘Lee Jinjoo’, who dreams of being a musical actor and works part time for her living expenses. After a car accident, she had opened her eyes and found herself in her favorite romance fantasy novel where she possessed the devil who’s the final boss in part 1. Jinjoo, who had been possessed by a devil who’s fate was to die by a warrior, tried all she can to change her fate as the devil… I’m go back to my original world no matter what! Will Jinjoo be able to change her fate as she wants to?

---

title: Celestial Jailer
description: Liu Lang was the number one guy in Nanshan City. He was killed then thrown into a ravine. Afterwards he woke up in a prison. He was ordered to watch over the deities who committed crimes in the heavenly prison.

title: My OTP Is So Sweet That I Want To Fall In Love
alt_titles: My CP Is So Sweet That I Want to Have a Love Affair
My OTP's So Cute I Wanna Fall In Love Too!
description: Zou Ming, a girl who creates fan works for her OTP and wants to fall in love, and Li Dongxu, a boy who looks honest but enjoys teasing others. Who says science and engineering majors don't understand romance? Who says love at first sight doesn't exist? An ignorant first love like a sweet and sour lemon is about to quietly bloom during the summer…

title: I Am A Humanoid Cultivation Pill
description:
A masterful pill was born at the top of the Peak of Not Returning. It is Yushu who is in the wind, is chic and suave, and has a broad mind..!

Yes, it's me! Beat and beat, eat.

title: Dating to Survive
description:
The exorcist fell in love with me, a ghost...?!

A survival love story of a ghost who resorted to a false confession to survive from the exorcist.

title: What's Your Name?
description: A stern student volunteer responsible for attendance and adherence to school rules is kissed on the forehead by a mysterious delinquent! Despite repeat violations, he has yet to learn the delinquent's name.

title: Burn my Calories
description: I'm so invincible that everyone calls me Big Daddy! How dare someone call me his Stepford wife? Me, I weigh half a ton! I can fight! I'm invincible! I root out the strong and support the weak! I'm the protector of all the boys in the school! However, one day, I got thinner and weaker... But I became handsome...

title: The Returning Hero's Restaurant
alt_titles: The Alley Restaurant of the Returned Soldier
Street Restaurant of a Returned Hero
description: Kyungho returns to Earth after 10 years of saving the Spirit Realm from the Demonic Realm. However, the Earth that he returned to is being attacked by the demonic realm just like how the spirit realm was attacked. Will Kyungho, who dreamed of living a normal life with his mother by operating a restaurant, be able to protect Earth?

title: Planet Nya Nya Nya~
description:
Jung Dayeon, a webtoon artist and a cat owner saves a young heir from a dog and the next day suddenly a butler appears at her house, what's more the butler has cat ears and a tail?!  
  
"I am Nyangjji from Planet Nya, a planet far from Earth. I have been ordered to be a servant here for one year."  
  
A hilarious human documentary about cat butlers that appeared out of nowhere.

title: Bewitching Demonic Beauty
description: Thousands of years of cultivation have made me into a youthful and glamorous red fox spirit with a bewitching face that makes all heads turn. Captivating the weak new king should be easy! Is there any man I cannot defeat? Eh? This isn't right! Stop, your majesty, don't touch my heart!

title: Love Data
description: This is a yuri love story between a human and an android.

title: Mistaken Lover
description:
Summary: What do you do when the person you are entrusted to protect happens to pique your interest as well? Zhen Hao, who was asked by his best friend to take care of his love interest ends up falling in love with him as well. Who will win the affection of this love interest?… An exciting love triangle awaits~

title: Updater
description:
The blacksmith NPC ‘Aiden.’

One day, his village gets deleted by the hands of the system moderator and as he and his little sister ‘Elise’ perished, he swore to himself.

I’ll destroy this system with my very hands.

It was then…!

“You have unlocked moderator perms, Moderator Lv. 1”

Aiden wakes up with a new power,

Marking the beginning of his journey as a moderator…!

What will become of Aiden?!

---
- [Official Japanese Translation](https://piccoma.com/web/product/69621)

title: The Indomitable Wanderer
description:
I am a wanderer martial artist. I don’t shy away from blood, but I’m ready to retire. Should I take one last job? or not?

For many long years, he has roamed as a wandering martial artist's, living as a hired blade to make ends meet.

But now, he finds himself utterly penniless, living in poverty with nothing to his name.

As a master of martial arts at the peak level, he makes a decision, to take on one final, high-stakes mission, earn a fortune, and put an end to his life as a wanderer.

The story follows his journey as he takes on this last assignment and the unexpected twists that unfold along the way.

title: Aged Beauty
description: The world's greatest doctor fell off the cliff and died, resulting for his daughter, Xu Youran, to seek refugee with Lord Rui. Unexpectedly, she was betrayed by her maid which resulted in the loss of her memory. Her maid took that opportunity to assume Youran's identity and attempted to marry into the Lord’s family. What no one expected was that the soul of the infamous doctor, Yue Qianqiu, reincarnated into Xu Youran's body. Now that she is reborn, how will she, with her once notorious reputation, live out this life?

title: Arctic King
alt_titles: Bing Feng Mo Ri: Jue Wu Sheng Huan Zhi Lu
Frozen Apocalypse: No Chance of Survival
Frozen Armageddon: There’s No Way Back
Frozen Doomsday: No Way to Survive
Bīng Fēng Mò Rì: Jué Wú Shēng Huán Zhī Lù
description: The stars shift, the blizzard persists, the icy apocalypse is imminent, food! Temperature! Violence! Dependence! In this dilemma, under the distortion of human nature, has desire given birth to monsters? How to break out of adversity and find a way to survive!

title: Why Ophelia Couldn't Leave
alt_titles: The Reason Why Ophelia Can't Leave the Duke
Why Ophelia Can't Leave the Duke's Family
The Reason Why Ophelia Can't Get Away From the Duke
The Reason Why Ophelia Can't Leave the Duke's House
description:
Ophelia became part of the Duke’s Family through her mom’s divorce.
However, her mother and stepfather died in a carriage accident. Late at night, at the end of the funeral, Ophelia was unable to escape from the duchy because of her stepbrother, Alexander.

The two slowly grew closer and became attracted to one another, but one day, an investigator comes in to say some shocking things...

---
- **Note:** The webtoon was released as R15, it's not R19 like the novel.

title: Dracorun
description:
Harry, who grew up dreaming of Dragon Rider while watching TV as a child, rescues the eggs of the dragon 'Sapo'hanging on the edge of the cliff and bring them home.  
'Ranno', a baby dragon hatched in the barn of Harry.  
Although the level is low, it's Harry's best friend.  
  
Theme - Dragons (animals was the closest thing)  
  
Season 1 has ended and it's currently on Haitus until season 2 begins.

title: Sigeup Yeonae
description:
‘Date me for 20,000 won an hour.’

Cha Do Hyun is a poor college student. One day, he got a ridiculous offer from Lee Sana, a younger student at the university. Should he accept the offer from this girl, who was looking for a good place to bury a body on campus? Everything about it is suspicious, but having just been fired from his part-time job, the offer is too sweet for Cha Do hyun to turn down!
“You are totally worth the money”
“Keep that thought to yourself!”

A woman with nothing but money, a man with everything but money, and their suspicious dating service.

title: The Director Who Buys Me Dinner
alt_titles: The President Who Always Treats Me to Meals
The President Who Always Treats Me Meals
description: We have to date. If we don't, we die. Dongbaek is one of the newest employees at Min Entertainment. His director, Yudam, is absolutely perfect in every way. Yet, Dongbaek thinks his director has lost his mind... What do you mean the director has lived three lives? What do you mean they have to date if they don't want to die? (Source: *Manta*)

title: My Amazing Wechat
alt_titles: Wo De Weixin Lian San Jie
My WeChat Links The Three Realms!
description:
Leo, a common middle school student, was accidently invited to a Wechat group full of miracle figures, such as Lord of Thunder, Mother of Lightning, Mighty Miracle God…since then his life became totally different with wonderful equipment he got from the wechat group.

[Additional Official English (Webcomics)](https://www.webcomicsapp.com/comic/WeChat-in-the-Third-Dimension/5d78c9808c252b612719af74)

title: WonderLab
description: Ordinary stories from the O-5681 branch of Lobotomy Corporation.

title: A Single Round at Romance Is Enough!
alt_titles: One Round of Unplay Is Sufficient
First Round in the Dating Simulator Is Enough!
description:
One day, I became the heroine of a love simulation game, Deborah. After seeing that I would be sent back to my world after achieving a Happy Ending, I finally managed to receive the confession of the male leads through many struggles.

[ Normal Ending achieved! ] ‘What? Normal ending? Didn’t the happy ending with the female lead and male lead end well?!’

The second round started again after failing to achieve a happy ending. ‘Oh, I don't know, tell them to stop this!’ It's none of their business to decide my life. I have to be happy! Unlike the first round, I’m going to do what I want to do... But aren’t the male leads acting a bit weird?!

---
Romance simulation video games are usually a mess-free way to date handsome men, but after Shiyeon Choi wakes up in one, she wants out! In her new gamified life, she quickly realizes how rude the male leads are. Thus, Shiyeon decides to "Bad End" all of her love interests, determined to give them a taste of their own medicine. But despite beating the game, she finds herself back at the beginning once again. In this round, she plans to live freely and blow off the MLs... but will she succeed, or is romance in the air after all?

title: Ooh La La
description:
The hilarious adventures of a newly couple.  
  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Start Raising Dragons From Today
description: In a world full of magic, Lynn, who got isekai-ed, obtained the cheat – the Dragon Ranch. Lynn relied on the power obtained by raising dragons, so I started to raise dragons diligently. Fire Dragon, Earth Dragon, Ice Dragon, Steel Dragon… Dark Dragon, Bright Dragon. many years later to enter the Holy Iris Academy to learn magic. He wanted to hide his strength and develop wretchedly, but he always encountered all kinds of difficulties and had to show his amazing ability. Accept as a direct disciple, become an unparalleled powerhouse, and find the truth of this world…

title: I Became the Duke’s Male Servant
alt_titles: I Became the Duke’s Male Servant
I Became the Duke's Servant in Disguise
I Became a Duke's Male Servant
description:
I woke up as a maid in a tragic romance—a woman who gave her heart and loyalty to the scheming Duke, only to be discarded and executed.

Roselia, now a servant in the Duke's household, is destined to become a pawn in his grand game, ultimately betrayed and exposed by the Crown Prince, the male lead, leading to her public execution.

To avoid catching the Duke’s attention, she takes a bold step—disguising herself as a man.

But wait... why is this happening?! Even in disguise, the Duke insists on keeping her close.

Somehow, instead of being a maid, she ends up serving as a manservant in the Duke's household.

"This wasn’t part of the plan!"

Caught in a web of danger, deceit, and unexpected roles, can Roselia change her doomed fate?

title: I Can Change the Timeline of Everything
alt_titles: I Can Change the Timeline of Everything
description: “What should I do if the elixir has expired? Don’t be afraid! Just reverse the elixir’s time, I want all of your expired elixirs! What should I do if the cultivation method is too slow? Don’t be afraid! Just adjust the cultivation time forwards by hundreds of years, the cultivation method will be successfully mastered immediately. What if the growth of Spiritual Grass is too slow? Don’t be afraid! Just accelerate the growth time of the Spiritual Grass by tens of thousands of years, and the Spiritual Grass immediately becomes a Divine plant. Traveling to another world and discovering that you are a waste material? Don’t be afraid! I can change the timeline of everything!”

title: The Tyrant's Comfort Doll
description:
Legend has it that a man with black hair and red eyes will bring ruin to Den Helder's royal family. Because he was born with these features, Rayton is shunned by the palace as "the cursed one." When the vengeful prince stages a bloody *coup d'état* years later, the powerless youngest princess, Setz, also died by his sword. Little does Setz know that she's about to wake up in her body five years in the past-- but now that she has, it's her chance to get on Rayton's good side and turn her fate around. Cracking the prince's cold exterior is a challenge, but once she does, there seems to be no going back! As Rayton grows more and more attached to her, Setz is pulled deeper into the midst of the dark conspiracies brewing around the palace. Has the princess truly escaped death, or is she in more danger than ever before?
___
Her brother, who was the one who caused a *coup d'état*, had sliced her throat. After she returned to the time before she died, she decided that she would somehow tame him and survive! But… Did she tame him too well?

"Brother, why don't you get married?"

There was no reply from him instead, the glass that he held popped and cracked.

"Oh no, you're bleeding."

"Why should I get married?"

"Eh?"

"I already have you."

Why should I get married you say? You have to get a consort so I can leave this castle! Sezh laughed strangely.

"Sezh."

At that moment, she stumbled and Raytan pulled her body into his arms. His red eyes started to gleam suggestively while looking down at Sezh who was trapped in his arms.

"You know we are not real siblings."

---
Alt. Official English: [Tappytoon (R19)](https://www.tappytoon.com/en/book/the-tyrants-comfort-doll-m)

title: Lady Crystal Is A Man
description:
Crystal Rotary.

She was the youngest daughter of the Rotary family and a fragile girl who did not come out of the annexe due to her weakness.

Her true identity was male.

Only women were kept alive in the family, and men either become corpses or heirs.

Crystal’s only goal was to leave the Rotary family and live a normal life.

In order for him to survive, he grew up as a daughter. He held his breath like a dead person.

He was finally about to leave, what did they mean, get married?

Crystal, driven into a corner, proposed marriage to Grand Duke Pentrine, who was politically at odds with the Rotary family.

Crystal thought the Grank Duke would refuse, of course, but he got a reply instead. 

Crystal escaped to the Great Castle of Pentrin.

He was a cold northern master, a cruel man, and a man with an icy heart.

Crystal met the rumoured Ellian Pentrin.

And got married. What happened?

***

“You don’t have to be so nervous. I won’t do anything to you.”

On their first night as a couple, Crystal was told that the consummation was not going to happen.

‘What does this mean? Are you saying we’re going to break up?’

Ellian whispered at a distance where his breath could reach only him.

“I’m sorry, my Lady… Because I am a eunuch.”

Ellian Pentrin said in the sweetest voice in the world.

title: The Duke's Teddy Bear
description:
What if your soul could leave your body and possess people -- or even animals? Thanks to an incident in the past, that’s what happens to Marshall Lidiance every time she passes out or falls asleep. No one knows her little secret, but things become problematic for Marshall when she gets absorbed into a teddy bear owned by the icy-cold Duke Ludvillian! Will Marshall be able to figure out what caused the soul absorption while still keeping it a secret from everyone?

---
