title: Limbless Schira
description: Childhood friend turning into demons? And the reason is because of me? In order to save BaiYe who is corroded by a curse, YeYi went on a journey to purify the curse. Along the way, the truth of previous life unfolds…… This is a story that consist of conspiracy, monster hunting, friendship, romance and all the comedy elements of an magical adventure story!

title: A Monstrous First Day
alt_titles: A Gate Opened on My First Day as a Politician
description:
Secretary Han Seung-Moon ran for office with no hope of winning, but when his opponent's unexpected arrest makes him the victor, he winds up as the youngest assemblyman in South Korea.

As he's being sworn into office, he thinks his life couldn't get any better... but that all comes crashing when a monster falls through the roof of the National Assembly!

Now, with an eerie blue gate unleashing horrors onto the city, Seung-Moon and his party members must find a way to save Seoul from destruction.

title: The Warrior and the Deity
description:
Orr was cursed after drawing a legendary sword from the ground which made him lose all emotions. On his way to defeat the Demon King, he had to stay at a village to resolve the cases many people simply vanishing. In that place, he met Mayim, a mountain deity who seemed to be connected to the abductions?   
(Random Fujoshis Scans)

title: Million Times Attack Speed
alt_titles: Wǒ Yǒu Bǎi Wàn Bèi Gōng Sù
description: After being reincarnated into the Tianwu Continent, Ye Yun activated the Multiverse Devouring System and received the reward of a million times attack speed in the beginner's gift package. From then on, he became an invincible powerhouse! As the saying goes, in the world of martial arts, speed is paramount. Do you think I was just picking my nose and cleaning my ears? In fact, I just executed thirty-five thousand people with a single sword strike and eighty-seven thousand people with a single sword swing, while also unleashing various boxing techniques and secret arts.

title: Frankenstein Family
description:
A scientist couple has been arrested for conducting illegal studies, allegedly for performing genetic modification on five of their children. Youngest child, Dannis, is the only one who grew up as a normal human, and has become the only family member who has to tend to rest of the members and to try to find a medicine to turn them into normal humans again.

Dog human, plant gene, spider web gene, as well as mind reading, how will these family members who grew up in the laboratory survive in the outside world?!

This series was first digitally serialized in Suncomics by Taiwanese publisher Anime in August 2015, now it has been also serialized in Japan published in Comic@Bunch of Shinchosha since December 2017.

title: Before Death Do Us Part
description:
She would have to marry the son of another organization?!

Yang Hye-jin had completely cut ties with her family right after she entered college, in pursuit of peaceful a daily life. It has been nine years since she left her violent father and her ignorant brother, who resembled him. However, her family suddenly appears and unilaterally announces her marriage with an unwanted partner, Moo Kang. Can Hye-jin and Moo Kang swear their entire lives in this marriage, which consists of a contract between organizations, and where death is the only path should they do not accept it?

---
The Yang and Kim families were once rival gangs with construction company fronts that spilled blood over a smidgen of gold. But a new company has entered the picture, and now both their stakes are at risk. Reluctantly, they form an alliance… sealed with an arranged marriage between their children, Hyejin and Moogahng! However, Hyejin’s past traumas keep her heart guarded, and Moogahng shrouds himself in mystery. It doesn’t seem like any amount of blood, tears, or gold will make their marriage better. But can love make this troubled pair work?

title: Was Manager Seo Disposed of as an Industrial Accident?
description:
“Why do you care about those non-paying users?”

Seo Seo-hyeok, a game planner who gave up on the quality and only focused on the paid contents. But why did he die from overwork after working all night out of greed to make money? When he opened my eyes again, perhaps fortunately out of misfortune...
'This is the game I was making...!!'

As the devil-like planner who harassed gamers reaped what he sowed, his suffering with the transformation of the game begins!

title: Chronicles of a Doomed Prodigy
description: Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time slipping through his fingers, Yeonshin must find a way to defy his doomed destiny.

title: I Adopted the Male Lead
description:
When Karina wakes up inside a novel, she realizes she’s been given a chance to change the tragic lives of the male lead, Roland Bleuet, and his sister, Melisa. Karina saves up as much money as she can and makes a run for it with the children. But to her dismay, the money she has saved up isn’t enough to get the three of them to the capital. Instead, they head for Torres where Karina bumps into Duke Claude Torres, a “talent fanatic” who is obsessed with collecting talented individuals and an antagonist who will negatively impact Roland’s life in the future. Will Karina be able to protect Roland and Melisa from all dangers and give her adoptive children a better future?
___

title: Super God System
description: “As long as I  level up 10 more level, I will be able to unlock the gene  again, and then I will be able to destroy this planet!” Travelled to  the future, reborn in the body who is known as trash of the academy, in this future world where zombies and giant beasts co-exist, Lin Xiu accidentally obtained an upgrading system, surpassing the limit of the human body and devouring the starry sky!

title: Just One Smile is Very Alluring
alt_titles: A Slight Smile is Very Charming
Wei Wei Yi Xiao Hen Qing Cheng
description:
What is it that makes a man fall in love with a woman at first sight? Appearance? Aura? Wealth? NO, when campus prince and gaming expert, student Xiao Nai first saw Bei Wei Wei, what made him fall in love was not her extraordinary beauty, but her slim and slender fingers that were flying across the keyboard and her calm and composed manner!!! Embarrassing, no?  
  
At the same time, gaming expert Bei Wei Wei, at this time and place is on the computer, methodically commanding a guild war, and won a perfect and glorious victory despite being at a disadvantage, and was completely unaware that cupid is nearby.  
  
Soon after basketball player, swimmer, all-around excellent student, and game company president, Xiao Nai, uses both tactics on and off-line to take this beauty’s heart. Therefore this romance slowly bloomed.

title: The Right-Eyed World
alt_titles: The World Seen by the Right Eye
description:
"Human beings must be happy no matter what"  
A society where emotions are controlled by a chip. and hackers that can hack the chips to make the people hallucinate.   
The survival of Ah-Yeon, a white hacker who suffers from depression in a world where negative emotions are forbidden.  
  
[Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/koerfolio)  


---

[Official Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/CAMPUS/youyankandaodeshijie/list?title_no=1561)

title: 7th Strike
description:
In order to get the headlines, the entertainment reporter Li Shu Zhen, while secretly follows and takes picture of the "Baseball World's Most Popular Superstar" Liu Xian, unexpectedly photographed his "nude photo"? Later on he discovered that Liu Xian is his former alumnus, not to mention he's the junior of the baseball department. Falling into deep thoughts, whether the secret was made publicly into the headlines… At the same time, Liu Xian proposed a secret transaction with Li Shu and the transaction was actually…  
This time are you ready to catch the "strikes" of the nonstop heart beating series?

title: The Way My Nemesis Looks At Me Is Slowly Shifting
alt_titles: Sudi Kan Wo De Yanshen Zhujian Bianzhi
description:
In Yu Wan’s eyes, Ni Shang is a complete bitch who’s been deliberately opposing her since childhood. A lifelong nemesis! If her father hadn’t held her dancing dream hostage, she would never have stepped foot in Ni Shang’s company as an intern. 

Determined to get under Ni Shang’s skin, Yu Wan resorted to every tactic she could think of. She even went so far as to pretend she was a lesbian just to disgust her. But can someone please explain to Yu Wan why this little brat is suddenly looking at her more and more strangely, constantly touching, rubbing up against her, and shamelessly asking for hugs?

title: A Wisdom Tooth
description: The unspeakable secrets between a handsome dentist and his patient's classmate.

title: I Can Use the Card Drawing System to Summon Beautiful Girls
alt_titles: Wo Neng Yong Chou Ka Xitong Zhaohuan Mei Shaonv
description: “It’s a disaster! I’ve been taken over by a mysterious card-drawing system and found myself surrounded by adorable girls in a mobile game! What’s even more terrifying is that among them is the antagonist sister sent by the Demon King from another world to hunt me down. What should I do? Seeking urgent advice online!”

title: An Insincere Idol's Blank Slate
alt_titles: A Blank Slate Regression for the Idol That Lost His Original Mindset
description:
‘I want to do real music now instead of these fucking idol songs.’

Yoon Eden, an idol in his 8th year, was tired of working with his shitty agency so he worked on the side as a composer.
He succeeded in music composition and bought a house in Cheongdam-dong, but has become an arrogant celebrity.

[Your 30,000th fan is disappointed in you.]
[Starting a project to help idols regain their lost, original intentions!]

But what the hell? He was sent to his debut days when his group was at its lowest to find his original intentions-

[The conditions have been met.]
[You have disappointed 30 thousand fans, now make 30 million fans happy!]

There’s even a mission that's only possible to complete for 1st tier idols?!

“Fuck, my Cheongdam-dong house! My billion-dollar royalties! My Ferrari!”

[Profanity detected.] [Original Intent -2]

[When Original Intent falls to 0, you start over again!]

Even in these harsh conditions that threaten infinite regression, will the project help this idol find his lost, original intentions?

title: A Doomed Girl Group's Do-Over
alt_titles: I Became the Leader of a Girl Group Destined to Fail
I Became the Cursed Idol Leader
description:
Her tenth year since debut, the two-time consecutive year-end grand award winner: Baek Nokha, the undisputed representative female soloist of South Korea.

On what should have been her greatest day—a day where she was to receive another grand award—the unexpected news of her mother’s death turned it into her worst.

“Do you want to save your mom?"

A mysterious cottonball appears in front of the sorrowful Nokha. It says that if she accepts its proposal and fulfills it, it will bring her mom back to life.

“I don’t know what kind of proposal this is, but I accept.”

To return to that moment before everything changed, Nokha accepts the proposal. After making a contract with the cottonball, she opens her eyes in another person’s body.

Then…

[System]
[Congratulations!
You have become "Yoon Chung."]

[From now on, you are a member of a girl group destined to fail.]

[You must save Still Blue!]

Can Nokha, now member Yoon Chung, save the girl group from its destiny of failure?

title: Dear Summer Sky
description: Baek Gihu, who loves the sky more than people, takes pictures of the sky with his camera. One summer day, a girl named "Haneul"—her name means "Sky"—transfers to his class and sits in the seat next to him.

title: For My Own Good
alt_titles: I Will Save the World And Then Retire
I'll Retire After Saving the World
description:
The only way out is through.
In the midst of a disastrous monster attack fated to end the world, a strange device throws Heejae back in time 20 years where he meets the students of his foster father, Seokyoung. Now it's up to him to take them under his wing and stop the apocalypse so he can finally set off for a peaceful life.

title: The Villainess's Debut Novel
description:
Ma-go has started her 44th life this year. She is paying the price for the book she wrote 500 years ago, “Record of a Dreamlike Romance”. 

“Until all of your books are eliminated, you can never have eternal rest.” 

A single book had twisted the destinies of many. So the angry God of fate sent down the reaper, Ha-rib, on an errand… 

After living many cursed lives, only 5 copies of her book remain! With her curse coming to an end, she started preparing for her final rest, but… 

“I’m publishing that old book ‘Record of a Dreamlike Romance’ as an e-book.” 

An unexpected interview with Gyu-jin, the CEO of an online bookstore! If he does that, she might never be able to break this curse! 

Also, he has a crazy resemblance to her first love…?

A woman trying to repay the karma for writing a cursed book, and… The grim reaper watching over her VS her reincarnated first love! 

A never-ending 500-year old romance between three souls!

title: A Happy Ending for Villains
description:
I was reborn into a romance fiction novel. I am lowborn, but there are plenty of boys here, and I get to work for the nobles.

But there’s a tiny problem. This noble family happens to be a family of villains, and I’m supposed to lead these serpents and throw the empire into chaos. Apparently, I am the greatest villain in this novel!

The deaths, the chaos in the empire, and the matters of inheritance locked the duke’s children and me into a corner of the manor. But the novel never mentioned anything about being locked away. So here, I must survive and grow… for a villainous happily ever.

title: Prices Crash, I Rise
alt_titles: With My Price Deduction System, I Became Invincible
Dominating With the Price Collapse System
description: Yifan activates a system by chance with a pop-up telling him that everyone in this world will lose 1,000,000% in purchasing power except for him. The following day, the market crashes. Luxury cars only cost 1 yaro each and mansions 5 yaros each. With hundreds of thousands in his account, Yifan suddenly becomes a rich man with enough money to buy everything on Earth!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd - Valkyries' Dining Escapades
description:
This is a story about the Valkyries living in the dorm and their culinary adventures. Each valkyrie has a different specialty but they all share the same desire to convey their feelings to their loved ones through cooking.  

---

Valkyries are more than warriors. They are also exquisite chefs and connoisseurs of fine living. Study from these masters of the kitchen because their recipes actually churn out delicious gourmet food!

title: The Evil God Descends, I Own Great Hell
alt_titles: Evil God Descends, I Have a Great Calamitous Prison
description:
In the apocalypse, an evil god descends, devouring humans and threatening my homeland, China! Little do they know, I hold the control of the Demon-Suppressing Hell, where countless gods and ancient monsters from China have been secretly imprisoned for thousands of years! All for this moment... to annihilate the foreign gods and cleanse the human world!

— Of course, if you surrender, as the Warden, I might consider letting you evil gods into the Great Hell to work on sewing machines. Meals and accommodation are provided, of course.

title: Umbrellas
description: A comical story of anthropomorphic umbrellas.

title: Let's Get A Divorce, Husband!
description:
When Baek Hayul wakes up in a foreign world as Duchess Aila Rinehart, she knows she has to escape. Her husband, Duke Claude Rinehart, is the antagonist of the story, “Prince, My Prince,” who gets executed for plotting a revolt against the crown. Hayul has no intention of dying alongside her new husband and demands a divorce. But when Claude turns down her repeated requests to end their marriage, she has no choice but to propose a deal. She gives Claude one month to win her love and change her mind, something she is determined to resist with all her strength, but her time with Claude leaves her feeling suspicious, restless, and uncertain. Will Claude be able to win Hayul over, or will they ultimately part ways?

title: Red Shirt
description: The legend of the killer company, Cha Si-hyuk. He decides to retire after meeting the woman he loves, but the company has no intention of letting him go easily. Eventually, everything starts to be taken away from him, and Cha Si-hyuk takes up the sword again. Revenge begins, and the war with the huge organization ‘Neville’ becomes unavoidable… What will be left at the end of the sword of revenge?

title: How to Raise a Nine-Tailed Fox
alt_titles: I Raised the Nine-Tailed Fox Wrongly
I Raised a Nine-Tailed Fox Wrongly
I Raised a Ninetailed Fox Wrongly
description:
As captain of the holy knights, Celia excels at protecting the country from monsters. So, when a priestess tasks her with raising a baby nine-tailed fox, Celia is hesitant but does her best to help the creature. Despite the abuse he has endured from other humans, she manages to gain some of his trust and names him Rahn. They start getting along, but the crafty fox is always looking for a way to escape. Can Celia raise Rahn until he's an adult, or will this sly fox pull one over his holy knight?
___
One day, I met a spirit. And it wasn't just anyone, but a gumiho puppy. As I worried about the little one's fate, I met a priestess from the eastern continent, who told me to raise him until he reached maturity and then send him back home. Raising a little fox...

How could a cursed human welcome and care for a young life? It was strange and scary, but I couldn't refuse.

The fox, Ran, was just adorable. So, with much love and care, I raised him... But when he grew up, he became as seductive as I've heard of his kind, and he refused to be independent. All the training he had given seemed to have been in vain, with that lewd look.

"You can’t run away."
"Keep being good and help me, Scyllia. By my side."

Forever...

title: I Changed My Life By Signing In
alt_titles: By Registering, My Life Has Been Altered
My Life Changed In Another World
description: After the male protagonist crossed, he was mistakenly taken in by the Jade Female Sect, which was full of female disciples, and became a nursing home to watch the gate. Favoured by the god-level check-in system, he obtained a magical physique that had never been seen in ancient times: the Spring Heart Divine Body. It is necessary to constantly adjust the girls to obtain welfare stimuli and convert the excitement points into cultivation. The Jade Girl Sect is surrounded by strong enemies and is in danger. In order to protect his own En (NV) people, the male protagonist relies on the super god sign-in system, fights the same way, kills the demon Xiu, fights the alien race, and zhen eight.

title: Emperor-in-Law
description: An ordinary self-funded university student suddenly acquires a rich, mature wife and activates the ‘Life Decision System.’ Does this system provide options that will become reality upon choosing them? Little children make choices; I want everything! Find out how Lifan, the son-in-law of a wealthy family, counterattacks little by little with the system in hand to become this generation’s greatest son-in-law!

title: Monster Bar
description:
A quaint little bar awaits its destined clients… Meanwhile, the strange bartender with a glass of cocktail reveals the mysteries of your life by looking into your past reincarnations — containing stories of love and hate throughout the centuries.   
Come and explore the brotherly bond between a dragon bartender and demon hunter. A touching story that even dazzles the heavens with its world of monsters; a world where a dragon searches for traces of his demon hunter friend from his past life, longing to meet again. But how did the talented demon hunter and mysterious dragon meet?

title: Obedient Heritage
description: One morning out of the blue, I was given an enormous amount of wealth and a man as my inheritance by my father. Despite not meeting even knowing my father's name or face, this man who's my heritage will never disobey me….!

title: Engineer x Fence
description: Is it serious that I have lost my body and my heart, for that Beary Otaku? The sexiest man in this neighborhood, Johny Black, comes to tell you his sad story(?) of his unrequited love…

title: The Beauty of the Apricot Forest
alt_titles: The Beauty in the Apricot Forest
description: He thought it was just an accident that he got sent back a thousand years by a rogue lightning strike. Little did he know that someone had been waiting there for him for decades. His arrival brought a person back from the dead, and reunited them with what they had lost. Through a series of coincidences, he and the person who’d been waiting came to meet, know, and love one another. The strings of fate which drew them together, stemming from broken threads of a previous generation. The beauty remains even when the Apricot Forest blooms no more, the story of their love and tragedy, spoken of only by whispers in the wind.

title: Reincarnated Warrior
description: A legendary martial artist, after countless reincarnations, awakens in the body of Jinho Seok, the neglected bastard of a powerful merchant family. Once downtrodden and suicidal, Jinho transforms into an unstoppable force, stunning his family with unmatched martial arts skill. As his reputation soars, Jinho’s newfound strength sets him on a path to reshape his destiny and claim his place in a world that once cast him aside.

title: Rising with the Monsters
alt_titles: Calamity and I: The Dual Ascension
description: 100 years ago, a dimensional doorway was opened for reasons unknown, and the world has been plagued with disasters ever since. A group of extraordinary individuals who have been dubbed the heroes are sworn to save the world.

title: Campus Master
description: An unruly youth, son of the underworld godfather, enrolls in high school, sets off the bloody winds while still does not forget engaging to various gorgeously beautiful ladies. Teachers, models or big sis, all belong to him.

title: Peerless Martial Spirit
description: In the continent of Longmai, thousands of clans stand tall, countless sects exist, and cultivation is the way of life. The strong can do anything they want while the weaklings live like ants. Youngster Chen Feng has an incomplete dan region, causing him to be unable to cultivate, he withstood countless sneers directed at him. Until he obtained a mysterious dragon bloodline, breaking out of his cocoon and opening a new chapter to his life! Coquettish demonic fox spirits, cold female emperors, demon girls or princesses from a prestigious clan, all of them jump into my embrace. With the unparalleled inheritance, I will manifest the strongest martial spirit, obtain all the beauties and look down from the heavens.

title: Even If Despair Consumes You
description:
Staying alive is a new form of entertainment.
When Dokyung, disillusioned by the harshness of life, finally resolves to call it quits, a bored demon, Hwamyung, appears before her with a particular offer. Will Dokyung, having entered into a contract with the Demon of Disillusionment, be able to flip her disastrous life upside down?

title: Alcohol ?%
description:
Has 2 pairs: OL x high school student, store worker x tattoo artist  
  
  
[Author's twitter](https://twitter.com/DeerWhisky)

title: The Guy Inside Me
description:
Who would've thought that rivals, the academic tyrant, Xu Sheng, and the top student, Zhao Zhan, would exchange bodies a few times and then start to like each other secretly! After many clueless situations the two became closer to each other, after they experience some funny stories and incidents, they finally understand their feelings for each other.  
  
¿Quién hubiera pensado que los rivales, el tirano académico, Xu Sheng, y el mejor estudiante, Zhao Zhan, intercambiarían cuerpos unas cuantas veces y luego empezarían a gustarse en secreto? Después de muchas situaciones sin pistas los dos se acercaron más el uno al otro, después de experimentar algunas historias e incidentes divertidos, finalmente entienden sus sentimientos por el otro.

title: The End
description:
Flora was born to become the main character, and 'I' will always stand behind her. Being sacrificed or beaten with wretched words didn’t matter if it made Flora shine every time. Because I thought that a role was just a role.
But Flora, I have to kill you and end this play now.

title: An Extra, yet the Duke's Only Daughter
alt_titles: I'm an Extra, but I'm the Duke's Only Daughter
Extra but the Duke's Only Daughter
description:
Reincarnation Life Cast by Dice, aka "ReLife," is a mobile game that I transmigrated into. The objective is to help the main characters save the world from the evil demon king, with each character classified by how crucial they are to the plot. I awoke in the body of Alyssa G. Dravein, a side character who dies by her father's hand when she turns nine years old. But, my dad seems to love me so much--where did it all go wrong? Can I change my fate and live to see ten?
___
I squandered my salary to strengthen my game character, and became the lowest-ranking extra in the game. But… [◆Fate: On my 9th birthday, I will be horribly murdered by my father.] No, what is my fate?! It was unfair that I dimensionally shifted while playing a game, but now I will die by my father’s hand… I can’t just sit back and accept this crappy fate. Since it has come to this, I will overcome my fate myself!

title: Chetamja: The King’s Eyes
description: Become a Chetamja! Turn your rage into a weapon that defends the kingdom! When young Gwiyeong loses his family in a brutal Jurchen raid, he swears to hunt down every last one of them. His skill in battle soon catches the attention of King Sejong, who offers him a chance to join Chetamja—an elite force of secret agents serving as the king’s eyes and ears in the north. Now, alongside his comrades, Gwiyeong must carry the flame of vengeance and forge it into a blade of duty that will defend the kingdom of Joseon from the shadows.

title: Oblivious Mr.B
description:
The life of an ordinary beta is overtaken by an omega!  
Who is he that only Mr. B doesn't know?  
#Omegaverse #MoodUp #Actually\_I’m…

title: What’s Wrong With Liking Big Tails?
description: They say the big shot light slayer Erl has no interest in women, but only he knows that none of YOU are his type~

title: Lady Dragon
description:
A being that appears to be human, but is stronger than them, Shil. These mysterious beings scattered throughout the world, remain dormant unless Simeone bestows them with a name. After that, their only purpose is to protect that person. Julitan, a simple cook in a small fishing village, encounters a Shil and gives her a name that resembles her crimsom eyes. “Please, tell me my name”. She requests. “Kanellian, the contract holder of noble souls, swears to become the servant of Knight Julitan as her master.” However, Julitan soon realizes that his ordinary abilities cannot handle Kanellian’s extraordinary powers. In the end, he embarks on a long journey to find a new contract holder capable of matching her formidable abilities…

title: The Demon Lord and the Hero
alt_titles: The Demon Lord and the Hero

title: Surviving as an Obsessive Servant
description:
In this world of a BL novel, I’ve died three times of the same rare disease as the sickly protagonist.
I couldn't accept dying such a pathetic death.
Thus, I took special measures.

'Let's try feeding a spoonful of the well-prepared medicine to the sickly protagonist!'
Young Master, I won’t miss a single drop of medicine, not even a breath!

I disguised myself as a servant to serve the sickly young master.
Even the spirit power from his breath would heal me, so what could be better than this!
But serving said individual was not easy…

“Get out! I said get out!! I’ve had enough of this!!! …Wait. What are you doing on your knees right now?”
“Young Master, if you’re going to throw it away, please throw it into my mouth.”

I said to him, who then withdrew his arm from throwing the medicine bottle in embarrassment.

"I wouldn’t mind if you just spray it onto my face instead…"

For a moment, his pupils dilated wildly.

***

I’m a do-if-you-must kind of girl.
While I was at it, I took good care of Young Master, who was my lifesaver.
As well as serving him, I hugged him, carried him, and brought him everywhere as his legs.

I wonder if he recognized my true value as the heir of a prestigious dukedom.
Young Master would occasionally gaze at me with intent, but he no longer tried to drive me away.

Now that I've recovered and repaid his kindness, it was time to figure out how I should leave…
But Young Master started acting strange.

“You said you like me so much, so why are you trying to run away?”
“...”
“You said you’d die without me.”

Before I knew it, he began to have the look of a hungry predator.

title: Travel to Tang Dynasty
alt_titles: To Be Reborn at Dynasty Tang
description: One representative of the king's special forces, to protect the country's treasures, he was struck by thunder and sent to the early days of the Tang Dynasty. In this strange and ever changing era, he will fulfil all modern human dreams with a sincere heart: beautiful princesses, shui queens, loli, beautiful harem ladies!

title: Beethoven Reborn
description: Only music sustained me from the maddening pain. If only I could hear my music... with my own ears... Even as my soul was falling apart, I prayed to God... and prayed again. Ludwig van Beethoven is considered the greatest composer in human history. I closed my eyes like that. And 180 years later in Seoul. The saint of music, known as an immortal genius, has been reborn. <Beethoven Born Again> And then I began to hear the voice of an angel. "Dobin.. Dobin.." Only music sustained me from the maddening pain.

title: Your Highness, I'm Pregnant
description:
The cute and clever "eunuch" was discovered to be pregnant and unexpectedly became the Crown Prince's personal attendant? The Crown Prince is rumored to be erratic, two-faced and aloof… and yet he keeps indulging her despite her testing his bottom line again and again…Why would she disguise herself as a man after crossing over and insist on staying beside him…"It's my turn to face all these hardships for you in this world!"  
  
Based on the [Original Webnovel](https://www.xbiquge.cc/book/48292/) by HONG You Ling

title: It Was Just a Contractual Marriage
description:
The empress of a fallen nation was dragged to the enemy empire. Despite everything, the Treasure of Grandel was still gorgeous. However, in the end she was just a captive who was going to be hanged by the savages. Eliza wanted to avoid that outcome no matter what, even if she had to tell outrageous lies. There was only one option: the man known as Banella's guard dog, the enemy empire's commander, and a lowly and vicious warrior—Lezet Christian. Eliza had to convince this cold and obstinate man who stood before her.

In a trembling voice, she said, "I'll give you a child."

title: Mr. Liar
description: Coquettish Lawyer x Tsundere Detective! Officer Shen, the human-lie-detector detective, finds it difficult to resist the smooth-talking lawyer, his nemesis who spits out lies like flowing electric current. "You used to be my closest friend, yet you ruined my reputation. Now you actually dare to come back and lick me?!” The elite police officer, after demoted to the Useless Department, meets his Mr. Liar again. Can the past misunderstandings between them be resolved? Can they go back to how they were in the past?

title: Not a Peep!
description:
“If you press this button, you can enter the world of your own special drama. 
(It will be revealed when you finish the story. If you don’t finish the story, you’ll never know.)

This was posted on my SNS timeline.
It seemed fun, but it was a problem since I had to study for exams.
I quickly pressed it to share with my friend and then fell asleep.

…….I should have just fallen into a deep sleep.

“Cheep.”

What.

“Squawk!”

What the hell! Where am I?

title: Memory Lost
description: Once a proud woman, but because of a chain of major events, was taken away by the killer group and lost her memory from then on. In order to find her, he traveled through mountains of water and from the player he once was, he became a cold and quiet police officer. Fate had allowed them to meet again. When they regain their memories, will they be happy or will sink into the abyss once again?

title: Silkflower Fantasy Dream
description: D List actress Bai Muzhi just received her chance to shine but she ends up getting tortured to death by film director Ye Ze. Afterwards, she's reborn…as Ye Ze's secret wife, Yun Xiaoran?! She never thought that revenge would involve so many…men!

title: Blade Note
description: Do you believe in god ? A survivor of the question picks a possessed blade to give the answer.

title: Tempted by Our Echoed Heart
description:
On the first snowfall of that year, Shan Xianchun, who had been roped in to help as a photographer for a cosplay shoot, unexpectedly captures a picture of a girl in a long, green dress through her lens. The girl’s gaze—staring at her—full of complexity and affection, seems to be locked on her, leaving Shan Xianchun as though her heart had been gently pricked.
Many years later, when she crosses paths again with the girl who once captivated her so, what kind of sparks will fly between them?

title: Administrator Kang Jin Lee
description: Is he crazy? Or just the typical attention seeker? Lee Kwang-Jin, who doesn't understand the difference in people, and his Master Kwak No who's the one helping him to understand the differences of people. A warm human story of a student and his Master.

title: Adonis Next Door
description:
Su Shuang Shuang comes home one day to find that someone has moved into the apartment next to hers. When curiosity gets the best of her and she goes in to meet her neighbour, a handsome guys comes out of the shower? And he calls the police?  
  
[Official English WebComics](http://m.webcomicsapp.com/comic/5c86037fd5626e789d67b03d)

title: The Flower Boy
description: College student, Han Soyi, has been unable to move on from the lingering affection she has for her ex-boyfriend. She tries to sort out her complicated feelings by concentrating on her studies, and receives a flower pot from a local elder to use for a class at school. But little does she know, the pot she receives happens to be a cursed pot, where a man's soul lies trapped…

title: I Have the Heart of a Dragon
description: Sharon, is a warrior who defeated a vicious dragon a thousand years ago. One day, an unidentified man appears in front of Aru, who grew up longing for Sharon. "What? Are you that terrifying dragon? Besides, I'm that hero?!" A cute and sad romance fantasy of a dragon and a hero who reunited after a thousand years!

title: There Can’t Be Girls In My Guild!
alt_titles: There's No Way There Are Any Girls in My Guild
description: In reality, Li Yu, who is an introverted otaku, is a senior player of MMORPG "Star Trails ol". The elite guild where he belongs is nicknamed the "Geek Group" because the characters in the game are all male. Li Yu, who has been worrying about this, only accidentally learned a long time later that he is actually the only boy in the group. All the other members are actually beautiful girls with their own cute attributes, and they all have a deep connection with him

title: Xiaobai's Dream Daddy
alt_titles: Xiao Bai's Father Is a Wonderful Person
description: Because of a conspiracy, she got pregnant and gave birth to a cute little darling. A few years later, she met her “sweetheart” again. Only, the cold, unfeeling man from the legends didn’t seem as bad as she had imagined?

title: The Tyrant's Only Perfumer
alt_titles: I Became the Tyrant's Only Perfumer
I Became the Sole Perfumer of a Tyrant
description:
A young woman sick with an incurable illness closes her eyes for the last time, only to wake up as Ariel Winston, an antagonist of the novel she had loved reading before her death. Knowing that death lies before her if she continues down the path the real Ariel has been going towards, she quickly breaks up with Duke Cedric Evans, who is not only the protagonist of the novel but a man who is cursed with a condition that causes him to become bloodthirsty when he does not smell a specific scent constantly. However, Cedric, who had been forced to date Ariel due to her status as his personal perfumer, suddenly seems reluctant to distance himself from her. Just what is wrong with this man, and how will this change the events of the novel? Will Ariel be able to live the life she wants?

---

title: Bittersweet Con Panna
description:
I'm not clingy... I'm just in love!
Graduate student Songah thinks her girlfriend Yoosung is the cutest girl in the world. It doesn't matter if she's actually more sophisticated than adorable; Yoosung is number one in her heart! So how is she supposed to react when some hot childhood friend suddenly enters the mix?!

title: The Lord Has Hidden Intentions
description: I treated you like a brother, but you treated me like a love rival! You stole every girlfriend I ever had! I just wanted to get married and have a baby, why is that so difficult?! A black-hearted white lotus vs. straight guy. A wild omegaverse fantasy,  that's both sweet and seductive~~

title: Light of Arad: Forerunner
description:
Summoned to purify the corruption spreading across Arad...?

Jinseong, a player who dedicated his life to "Dungeon & Fighter," is summoned to Arad by the transcendent Nemer and given the mission of becoming the Claw Master.

“You shall become the Claw Master and guide the blade through rightful trials.”

"I'll become the Claw Master or whatever it takes. I will survive in this Arad!"

Will DFO veteran Jinseong successfully complete his mission and return to the real world? The story of the Dark Knight Jinseong's quest to prevent the destruction of Arad begins!

title: The S-Rank Spiritualist's Taming Journal
alt_titles: The Diary of a S-Class Spirit Master
description: In a world of hunters, monsters, and dungeons, Ina is just an ordinary Korean woman--and she wouldn’t have it any other way. Ina was a spiritualist in her previous life, but now she can finally enjoy a peaceful world... or so she thought. One day, after touching a mysterious egg found in a dungeon, Ina reawakens her S-rank spiritualist ability! With her new spirit companions, a couple of troublemakers named Iz and Rika, will Ina ever fulfill her dream of living a quiet life?

title: The Detective Agency for Regretful Male Leads Is Now Open for Business!
alt_titles: Huhoe Namjureul Wihan Heungsinso Jeolchan Yeongeop Jung!
Thriving Agency for Regretful Male Leads in Full Operation!
description:
A detective who'll find your leading lady for 500 won has appeared!

Out of all the countless web novel protagonists, I wasn't a romance-fantasy noble lady, a cool hunter, or a holy saintess. Of all things, to think I've been reincarnated as a 'private investigator'… And on top of that, my clients are all regretful male leads?

"Hurry up and find my woman."

"All of a sudden?"

Still, now that I've started, I have no choice but to see it through. Just how many 'runaway lead' stories do you think I've read?! The runaway female lead always gets caught soon enough. They come back one way or another! The cool guy, the hero, the beastly man— I'll make sure all the regretful male leads get their happy ending.

title: Dragon and Phoenix Flip
description: Fang Minzhu, a small agent in the entertainment industry, was introduced to the most popular idol girl star Liang Youxi as a life agent. But Liang Youxi asked for a male agent. Minzhu, who is in desperate need of work, gritted her teeth and pretended to be a boy who applied for the job, but Liang Youxi was very mysterious; "I choose a boy because this can make you stay away from my private life with integrity." It is strange of the female star to say that. In a certain accident, Minzhu found out Liang Youxi's secret. It turns out that Liang Youxi is…

title: Double Click
description:
What happens when you lose the one thing that you were the best in the world at? Jiho Seong was once a top-ranked player in the online action game, One Sword. When the game eventually shuts down due to a lack of players, he loses all interest in competitive gaming. That is, until he finds out that his school has an e-sports club and discovers a popular team-based game called Sword Rush, which seems to be an exact copy of One Sword. With new teammates now by his side, Jiho takes another shot at rising to the top of the game!

---

- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/drama/double-click/list?title_no=3501)

title: I'll Do That Marriage (Promo)
description:
Promo for the novel:

Lilian McKellion, the girl who wanted to avoid a bad end, willingly went to the insomniac emperor in place of her sister, Laelin. She is tasked to help the sleepless emperor, who was cursed by a witch, by using her ability to induce sleep whenever she touches another person's body with her lips. Can Lilianne survive being with the emperor, ‘Kael Rue Kaldorf?'

title: The Reader and Protagonist Definitely Have to Be in True Love
description:
An internet troll who wanted attention, the reader criticized his favorite web novel, saying: “The protagonist is dumb and the author is s*upid.”  
  
Author: “… Got it.”  
  
Unfortunately for him, the author actually listened to his (troll) feedback. The formerly lighthearted tale of a cute harem master suddenly became super dark and edgy. The reader could only helplessly look on as the protagonist was abused and betrayed, finally embarking on the road to becoming completely evil. Everything was a mess!  
  
After that the reader transmigrated into a strange world. How come the person in front of him looks like the protagonist (evil undead version)? Just what is going on?!

title: The Waste Female Demon God
description:
Bai youling, one of the three demon cultivators were betrayed by her only disciple, who was also her husband-to-be.
Reborn in a commoner’s body, she will once again rise to the top!

title: 1st Kiss
alt_titles: Nǐ De Rénshēng Shì Wǒ Lái Chíle
Ni De Rensheng Shi Wo Lai Chile
1st Kiss – I Don't Want to Consider You as Sister Anymore
I Don't Want to Treat You as Sister Anymore
description: He is her younger brother, although the two have no blood relationship but she always considers him to be her biological brother … can only be brother that’s all. of course he doesn’t want to be like that, but he is also afraid that he will create distance with her more and more far away. If their first meeting in life was not like that, would they have another result? The girl he loves is right in front of his eyes but is like a wind and can’t hold … Can only as younger brother? How must he do to let her know that he can also become a guardian for her whole life?

title: The Wretched
alt_titles: I Am the Bane of Others' Existence
description:
Ji YouChuan was investigating the mysterious organization Blaze in order to take revenge for his parents. 36 demons were released during one of the confrontation with Blaze and he signed a contract with the strongest demon, Chelsea.

He joined the “Wrath of Heaven” team for the sake of investigating Blaze even more deeply and to retrieve the 36 demons, but after getting betrayed by his teammates, the sacrifice of his friend, wandering the wastelands and various other incidents, Ji YouChuan and Chelsea will uncover the thousand-years conspiracy behind the Red Rain catastrophe!

title: God of War Mad Concubine: The Path to Obtaining the World
description: A special ghost, Sheng Qianyu woke up and did not expect to wake up and become a lady of the Prime Minister’s Mansion! She was supposed to be married into the princely palace, but she was betrayed by her fiancé and her sister. The wedding night was stained with blood. With the identity of the three daughters of the honor king and the third daughter of the royal family, She was involved in the investigation To find the truth of a murder in the palace. With he outstanding skills of a agents, Sheng Qianyu not only resolved many crises, but also won the favor of the six princes. Strong cooperation, step by step tricks, turn your hands over the clouds in the power! But what is waiting for them is more serious conspiracy…

title: The Northern Grand Duke’s Hamster
description:
After getting into an accident, I reincarnated into a novel I’d started reading but ultimately gave up on.

“Squeak!” (What the?!)

…Specifically, I reincarnated as a hamster that didn’t appear even once in the story!

[Current Miracle Value: 1%]
[Try raising your Miracle Value. We’ll save you from death!]

I, who had become a tiny hamster, was given a quest to cause “miracles” in this world. Only then could I return to my original body.

“What about saving Kyle? That’s a type of miracle.”

[Target decision complete: Save Kyle Jane Meinhardt.]
[Selecting quest…]

However, when I made up my mind to save Kyle (the reason I stopped reading the novel) from his upcoming death…

“Why are you trying to dance with me when there are a lot of people over there?!”
“Why? Because you are my only pet among all those people.”

I managed to use my Miracle Values to temporarily become a human, which is good, but…

Is it just my imagination, or is life as a human harder than life as a rodent?

“If I tie you up, will you not disappear?”
“...Confinement is a crime, you know?”

Will I be able to save Kyle and bring about a happy ending in his world?

title: Doberman
description:
Eden City, the second Las Vegas and a place where all pleasures of this world converge. Sarin comes to Eden City, trying to find the biological father of her niece, Hayan, using the diary of her twin sister, Irin, who died in a car accident. Along the way, Sarin encounters Owen, the king of Eden City.

Though frightened by Owen’s forceful attitude and the strange gaze that seems to desire her, Sarin chooses to stay by his side for the sake of her niece, Hayan. As she gets closer to Owen, she starts to uncover the darkness that looms over Eden City. Despite this, staying by Owen’s side becomes more natural for Sarin.

However, Sarin is also hiding a secret of her own…

title: The Outcast is a Fighter
alt_titles: The Outcast Is Too Good at Martial Arts
description:
Cha Mugyeol, a high-school student, is consistently bullied by a group of delinquents at school. Elsewhere, Mugyeol, a mixed martial artist, has been set up to be left paralyzed and meets his demise. Two different lives are at their ends, but somehow, they both end up living on in the same body. 

Will they succeed in finding justice, and climb their way back up to achieve their dreams?

title: Prepaid Dragon King Tanks Everything!
description:
“You ate me, so at least give me some kind of compensation, yeah?!”

Dragon King: “Fine! I’ll give you a prepaid cultivation technique—comprehend it first, then catch up with the training later!”

Me: “You think that’s enough?! I had to smell your nasty dragon breath—mental damage times two, buddy!”

Dragon King: “What do you want from me?!”

Me: “From now on, we’re like immortals sharing a single health bar. All the damage? You take it!”

Dragon King: “Damn it! You lunatic! Why does my ten-thousand-war-chariots-level HP bar feel so short now?! Guess it’s time to get a job…”

title: Emperor With an Inconceivable Heart
alt_titles: Conqueror of Modern Martial Arts, Kang Haejin
description:
Haejin, a young boy with an unyielding spirit, even in the face of relentless school bullies due to his frailty. His determination to grow stronger knows no bounds, but his body refuses to comply. Yet, Haejin’s tenacity prevails.

One fateful day, he crosses paths with a homeless General, and a random act of kindness unveils hidden potential within Haejin. The enigmatic General utters the cryptic phrase, “Martial Arts does exist!”

Join us on a journey as Haejin, a prodigious talent in the realm of Martial Arts, sets out to conquer the modern Martial Arts world. His story is a testament to unwavering dedication and the mysterious power that lies within.

title: Day by Day
description: A childhood friendship ruined by a confession?!

title: Lover Next Door
description:
Let’s go, babe.”  
“Excuse me??? I was just making my way through!!  
  
SiHyuk, who was able to get a studio with good conditions, suffers from insomnia due to frequent lover’s quarrel between the couple next door.  
  
Then one day, he runs into the couple who happened to be having a dispute out in the hallway.  
  
SiHyuk gets involved with one of the two, JaeHee, and ends up becoming his pretend lover.  
  
With JaeHee’s ex, SoWool, being obsessive with JaeHee and acting like a stalker, what kind of fate awaits for SiHyuk and JaeHee who got into a pretentious relationship to shake SoWool off…?

title: City of Darkness
description: Everyone in his Triad gang looked up to him. He was the boss's favorite pupil, but then in a single night, after he had won so many territorial fights for his gang, he lost everything! Why?

title: I Upgrade by Rewarding Apprentices
alt_titles: I Rely on Rewarding Apprentices to Upgrade
Wo Kao Da Shang Tudi Shengji
description: The master is driving the crane west, what should I do if the enemy comes to the door? ! Awaken the apprenticeship rebate system, the more you give to your apprentice, the more you get back to your master! Hahaha, good disciples, hurry up, as a teacher, you never hide your secrets!

title: Uniform and Parasol
description:
A girl of strong character in a school uniform, and a solitary figure under a dainty parasol. Across age and class, two lonely hearts thread together.

---
Part of the "青春18×2：重返最初的悸動" anthology

title: From Morning to Night
description:
'We'll give you an apple tree in exchange for borrowing your child for 48 days.' A traditional fantasy depicting Manet going on an adventure to search for their missing younger sibling Nox, who disappeared along with the strange letter.

---

The official release for this webtoon, “From Morning to Night” has included background music. It's worth listening: [link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ChEOqCzOFQ8).

title: Hongdo
description: Humans, foxes, goblins, ghosts, and sorcerers all live together in this world.

title: Three B(r)others
description:
The school's three most popular guys are actually someone's exasperating brothers—and someone who loathes attention at that! Haejoo craves a life of mundanity and obscurity, but she's plagued by her three jaw-droppingly handsome brothers who stand out even when they're doing nothing more exciting than breathing. At school, she goes to great lengths to hide the fact that they're related, but what happens when she finally gets busted? Will Haejoo be able to achieve the quiet life she seeks despite being stuck in a school with her three older brothers?

---
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/comedy/annoying-brothers/list?title_no=3498)

title: None of These Witches Are Serious
alt_titles: None of These Witches Are Serious
None of These Witches Are Decent
Zhexie Nüwu Mei Yige Zhengjing de
description: Ron accidentally travels to another world, but before he can even enjoy the thrill of his journey, he's framed and guillotined. On his deathbed, the system sends a cheat to avert the crisis. He also picks up a super cute and clingy witch along the way. A beautiful duchess from the empire suddenly appears, offering her territory, and a tsundere dragon maid takes care of her. Guided by the system, Ron is about to embark on a joyful journey into another world. But no one ever tells him that the same system has killed all ninety-nine other travelers before him! Whose conspiracy is all this?

title: Upgrading the Frivolous Emperor
description:
Stabbed from the start, upgrading with his own wits, self-proclaimed "No.1 Playboy" Wen Zhao Sheng was forced to become the emperor. After being unluckily assassinated, he was reborn miraculously. Now, he plans to use some "dirty tricks" to make an unexpected comeback! This man sure is more cunning than a fox! Playboy emperor x Heartless assassin  
  
[Official Korean Translation](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/renounce_the_emperor)

title: Baby Dragon Tames the Crazy Guys
alt_titles: The Baby Dragon Tames The Crazy People
description:
The Emperor of the Empire of Atlantis, Thalassa, in the depths of the sea. Contrary to her belief that days of abundance and happiness would continue,
she was betrayed by her lover and friend, and sealed away for a thousand years.

And when she opened her eyes again...

"I, who was once the great Emperor of the glorious empire, have become a baby as small as a baby crab!"

Atlantis had already perished, and Thalassa was reborn as the baby princess and dragon heiress of the kingdom established by the traitors!

What's more? The dragon heiress has to marry the crown prince to break the curse?

"You scoundrels!"

Not only did she have to uncover the secrets of Atlantis's demise,
but she found herself destined to marry the crown prince against her will.

"I have no choice. I'll just stay with them until the curse on the crown prince is lifted!"

Nam Yoomin, a full time department store worker, begins to feel skeptical about her own life. She decides to quit her job due to a conflict with her manager. However, when she enters the manager's office. She comes face to face with the manager who has now turned into a monster. Yoo Min immediately runs away from the manager, but encounters another monster and faces danger once again. Outside the department store, a world experiencing doom had already begun unfolding.

title: Poisonous Witch Doctor
description:
The witch’s descent, David Sun, has decided to join the modern society after learning all the witchery and vermin from his master. He doesn’t have any goals other than his family’s well-being and earn some extra money by saving people from illness. He did not expect trouble to come to find him. While facing all the temptation and evil, watch how a fatty hides from others’ sight and promotes witchery…

title: Emperor’s Domination
description:
The rise of revered cultivators has been witnessed for countless years.
However, the eyes of the world fail to notice that, behind every cultivator, there seems to be a mysterious… Yin crow.
After the Yin crow guided a legion of young cultivators to the peak of cultivation and established a sect, he chose to leave and abandon it.
Thousands of years have passed since his departure, and circumstances have changed. The once brilliant sect was left in shambles and vulnerable to imminent danger.
Aware of the impending downfall, the Yin crow returned as a young boy in order to fulfill his agreement to guard and restore the sect to its former glory.


---

**Links:**
- [Alternative Raw (AC QQ)](https://ac.qq.com/Comic/comicInfo/id/651972)
- [Alternative Raw (BiliBili)](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc31570)

title: 685 DAYS
description: "I'm sorry…" The second year of high school enters the new semester after the time when Juyeon and Mihyang, who became awkward with the rejected confession, avoided each other due to misunderstandings and worries. The two meet again, and with a fluttering heart, a slightly different special story begins. From the thrilling confession to the day when the first snow falls for the two, <685 days>

title: The Script-Eating Actor
description:
"Jaehee, why do you always carry two copies of the script?"
"Well, I might lose one."

That’s a lie.
One is for carrying around on set and showing to others.
The other one is for—

[The drama Youth Train is available for absorption.]
[Would you like to absorb it?]

I use it for eating.
I devour the script and make it completely my own.

The story of Jaehui, an actor who can absorb a script 100%.

title: Unholy Night
description:
[From Kidari Studio's Penis Navidad Collection]  
  
On Christmas Day, 14 years ago, Joonyoung and Eunhyuk became step brothers after their parents remarried. However, their parents soon passed away in a car accident and Eunhyuk became the only person Joonyoung could depend on. To Joonyoung, Eunhyuk was the perfect guardian as well as savior. But upon a certain incident, Eunhyuk's existence took on a different meaning to Joonyoung. That incident had Joonyoung leaving Eunhyuk's side as if he was running away, and now that 6 years have passed, he ends up reuniting with Eunhyuk at a hotel. As Eunhyuk, who had desperately looked for Joonyoung, finds and warmly hugs his little brother, his eyes show nothing but iciness unlike the warmth of his embrace…

title: Magic Scholar
description:
Certan was the prince of the demon world who wrecked havoc a long time ago. His father, the king of the demon world, had his soul sealed in an octagonal tablet and he sent to the human world…

By accident, he got stuck with a boy named Go Jinyoung…

‘Let’s conquer the martial world with magic!’

The popular martial arts novel, Magic Scholar, returns as a webtoon!

title: Unity of Heaven
description:
Unity of Heaven and Earth is an action-packed manga set in a fictional modern society. It features the characters from Journey to the West, but all completely different. Introducing the master-turned-loli San Zang; the dragon-turned-horse-turned-beautiful woman White Dragon Horse; the pig-turned-Adonis Pigsy and Sun Wu Kong, who has been reincarnated as a human. All of your preconceptions from Journey to the West will be turned upside down!

---
**Original manhua:** [u17](https://u17.com/comic/74952.html)

title: My Love is a Gangster?!
description:
Ever optimistic genki girl Chun-Ah-Young just started working as a florist… but the manager of her shop is one seriously suspicious looking guy. What's worse, his friend that actually owns the place and occasionally comes to visit, appears to be even scarier than he is!  
  
Just who are these people and what do they really do for a living?

title: Raising A Bat
description: High school senior Min-kyum has been left to his own defenses after his parents kicked him out of their lives. His new house is in a shabby neighborhood, the site of several mysterious assaults that have left victims with bite marks on their necks and blood loss symptoms. After moving in, Min-kyum heads out for a meal…then somehow wakes up at home with strange marks on his neck. He tries to shrug it off, but his deskmate at the new school looks suspiciously pale and familiar…

title: The Strong Man From The Mental Hospital
description: This is a world where evil creatures are gradually rampaging. However, the evil creatures are strong, they all disappear after this mental hospital, and even without dignity, they are reduced to ingredients and pets. This is the green mountain mental hospital, where talents are abundant and strong people are surrounded. In this regard, the seriously ill Lin Fan, who is carrying the system, said: I am definitely not a mental patient, I am a normal person who likes to cultivate. Usually is to touch the socket, climbing high voltage box, thunder days standing on the rooftop to the heavens dance a stick method.

title: Azur Lane - Azur Lane for Dummies (Doujinshi)
description:
A long strip comic series based on Azur Lane series made by Toucailao. This series offers the sight of KAN-SEN dealing with various problems they face in their daily life. From a minuscule thing like the mechanic to a huge problem like intergalactic war. Expect references, wacky interactions, comedy, fourth wall breaks, and insanity. Especially, insanity.  
 
Toucailao's weibo:  
<https://m.weibo.cn/u/2125874520>

title: Endeavor’s Cross
description: Climbing to the top of Heaven’s castle will prove a herculean task, for the one who can reach the summit shall be granted control of the world.

title: Frozen Hearts
description: Hiding her identity as a Snow Maiden demon, Seolha has carved out a life in disguise among humans. However, her life changes forever when she catches the interest of the Northern Prince, a man known for hunting down and killing demons, and agrees to become his bride. Will those two be able to overcome their differences and live happily ever after?

title: Two People
description: My life has been sold to two different people. Now I have to live as a different person in the day and night.

title: It Was a Mistake, Grand Duke!
alt_titles: Grand Duke, It Was a Mistake!
description:
I somehow kidnapped the Grand Duke I had a one-sided love for!

To hide this fact we had to pretend being in a relationship, but the Grand Duke is behaving strangely:

"Vivian, may I kiss you?"

Huh? Are we kissing as soon as we started dating?

"We'll kiss, then take take a step further and get married."

Is this relationship going to be alright?

---
Vivian Louis is the twenty-one-year-old daughter of a Count, a sweet and seemingly harmless girl who has only one guilty pleasure in life: thirsting after her crush, the breathtakingly handsome Grand Duke Lennox Elphidion Glenn! For her, it was love at first sight at the tender age of fourteen. That’s when she began obsessing over him, creating endless works of fan art and fan fiction. Then one day, an accident with her best friend’s magical crystal ball makes the unthinkable come true. The grand duke is kidnapped and tied up in her bed, and he’s telling her that she’s the kidnapper! Scrambling for a way out of this scandalous bind, the two agree to act like a couple. They even sign a one-year contract, but Lennox seems to want more than a fake relationship. Unbeknownst to Vivian, a full-blown romance is on its way. Could it be that her wildest fan fantasies will truly come to life?

---

title: Another Happy Ending with My Jerk Friend
description:
Waking up from a car accident, Bai Tong realizes that he has been unexpectedly reborn as a 4-year-old. After getting his heart and body played with, in his previous life, he vowed to keep away from playboys in this current lifetime! However… who actually is this playboy? Hazy memories from his previous life, unusual pheromones, and suspects that constantly target him… Can Bai Tong unravel the truth behind his previous life?  
  
*Note: Omegaverse.*  
  
Al despertar de un accidente de coche, Bai Tong se da cuenta de que ha renacido inesperadamente como un niño de 4 años. Después de que hayan jugado con su corazón y su cuerpo, en su vida anterior, se comprometió a mantenerse alejado de los playboys en esta vida actual. Sin embargo… ¿quién es realmente este playboy? Recuerdos confusos de su vida anterior, feromonas inusuales, y sospechosos que constantemente lo atacan… ¿Puede Bai Tong desentrañar la verdad detrás de su vida anterior?

title: Our Secret Alliance
description: I suddenly became a couple with my childhood friend one day?! Two model students 'Yoon Sae' and 'Kim Jaeha' have created an alliance in order to reassure their controlling parents and live freely. To avoid getting caught, they start a fake relationship!

title: Fools
description: Eungi has been in college without being engaged with others. One day by encounter, he finds the secret of underclassman Jeongwoo. Why are you so nervous to forget? A love story that’s both easy and difficult.

title: Zero's World
description: How much are you worth? Do you have something you couldn’t prove to others - no matter how much you’ve struggled or the lengths you’ve gone through for it? There are those who are worth nothing, only 0s. And this…is the story of those zeros.

title: Trans Horizon
description:
Shin Jaemin who lacks self-confidence and is much more timid than his peers, spends his middle school days being bullied by his classmates. If there’s any hope, it’s the new and fresh Idol group 'ROSE'. On the day of high school’s entrance, the freshman representative shows up in front of an exhausted Jaemin, who spent the previous day watching Rose’s performance videos.   
That representative is 'Yu Do-Yeong', one of his favorite Rose members. And they'll involve Jae-min in very 'special' fate.

title: Sweet Candy
description: Li Xiao Guo is a new nurse at Jiayu Hospital. Her life takes a drastic turn for the worse when a string of unfortunate incidents strike. Her parents get scammed out of their life savings, her family goes more and more into debt, her phone gets stolen, and Xiao Guo's job is at risk. Desperate for a way out, Xiao Guo tries to sell her blood for quick cash. At the same time, a special patient is admitted to the hospital and Xiao Guo's world is turned upside down. It soon becomes clear that Xiao Guo and this new patient are tied together by more than just coincidence…

title: A-Lan Doesn't Know How to Love
alt_titles: A-Lan Doesn't Know How to Fall in Love
description: How do you date someone who doesn't know how to fall in love?

title: Fork & Knife
description:
A world of constant war because we don't understand each other's differences.
A world where it is normal to hate and harm other species.
In this hellish world where blood is splashed and people kill and kill each other, how can a boy named Rito survive?
A medieval dark fantasy of humans and xenomorphs.

title: The Gods Come and Go
description: College student Sean Hanks has been cheated by his first ever girlfriend. Shocked, he accidentally slips down a cliff and falls down directly on a container that seals a powerful being. Now that the entity inside the container has been released, what fate awaits Sean?

title: It All Starts With a Group of Primitive People
alt_titles: Starting With a Group of Primitive Men
description: Chen Liyi, who was shopping with a rich woman, accidentally traversed to the Stone Age, leading primitive people to fight beasts, build civilization, and become the emperor of this land. The system is in hand, the inheritance of technology can be obtained at will, Not only that, even the primitive people can also play with guns!

title: Forced to Become Villainous Son-in-Law: Frost Queen
alt_titles: Forced to Become Villainous Son-in-Law: Frost Queen
description: The useless son-in-law returned to the underworld just to find out that his right-man hand has already ascended to the throne. With monsters going rampage, doubts and suspicions, and constant humiliation from other tribes, she finally unleashed her full potential. Carrying two pairs of ice wings on her back and dual-wielding frost spears – The Frost Queen has returned.

title: The Villainess's Princely Predicament
alt_titles: I Am a Villainess but I Picked up the Male Lead
I'm a Villainess, but I Picked up the Male Lead
description:
I possessed the most powerful villainess in a novel, Countess Edina. To be exact, she is the villainess who attempted to assassinate the male lead, took his 'heart,' and sold it to a neighbouring country. Naturally, I tried everything to avoid the male lead until I got his heart back but for some reason I keep running into him half-dead in the streets! I tried to look away and just leave him there, but his condition was simply too terrible.

"Just this time, and only this time! I'll help you and pretend I don't know anything!"

However, since this keeps happening, I think it would be better to just leave the male lead there next time. I'd rather just be nice to him for once, pay my debt, and get over everything!

"No, I don't need your kindness."

But… I think the male lead despises me too much… Can I survive all this? 

===

"I still remember those days when you would poison me and send assassins after me."

"Oh… haha…"

"Yet, once again, I still love the Countess."

"Wait… what?"

The male lead, who saw me as an enemy just a year ago, is now confessing to me, the villainess.

"Doesn't this make me seem like I'm crazy?"

I was frozen and couldn’t say anything, but it was I who felt crazy.

"But that's okay. Because I am a crazy bastard," he whispered softly to me in a deep voice.

It wasn't that I disliked how he'd changed… Ha. This is all too much. He's exactly my type - What should I do?

---

title: I Opened The Gates Of Hell
description: Yie Fan became YAMA, the king of hell, he has to do missions to upgrade “hell”, make hell a better place, and as his destiny, his fate, he will do whatever it takes to become the best king and rebuild hell

title: Ultimate Devouring System
description: After transmigrating, Ye Xuan obtained a devouring system, not only can he devour items, he can also exchange blood vessels, martial arts, magic weapons, elixirs and treasures…holy! This is easy as f-! “Dont bother me, do you believe i can’t devour your magic weapon?”

title: Pendant of the Elemental
description: The only son of the living legend, the Duke of Landert, who suffered countless hardships during his childhood, enrolls in the Karingston academy.

title: A Free Ride Everyday
description: Cheng Huan, the female lead, unexpectedly runs into Liao Jia, her senior from high school who works at the same company, on her way home. Taking the opportunity to hitch a ride from him, the number of times they start to meet each other begin to increase wildly. For some reason, Cheng Huan is always able to get a ride from her senior. Unconsciously, they start to realize each other's feelings, with every ride together becoming yet another opportunity for them to grow even closer.

title: Dawn of the Predecessor
description: In an era where myth and reality meet, gods and heroes from ancient myths such as Greece, Rome, Judea, Egypt, etc. are recreated in the 21st century real world. The protagonist Yoo Geon is gaining new senses and powers through a process called ‘awakening’. As his new senses open, Geon sees what others can’t see and realizes that the world is changing. Geon grows up experiencing curiosity about the world, awareness of the unjust reality, adolescence, and love. However, he also faces the threats and dangers that the new world brings.

title: All for My Dearest Juliet
description:
Enoch Latraki loves his wife, Juliet, even though she doesn’t love him back. But one day, she suddenly changes, becoming gentle and kind. Enoch is determined to find out why his wife has become so affectionate.

---
Due to her terminal illness, Princess Juliet has spent her entire life inside the Rozenta Kingdom's palace without any peers to talk to. So she's delighted to meet a kind young servant named Lete who provides her with much-needed company. However, their pleasant strolls end abruptly when Juliet is suddenly told to marry the archduke of Herventel, Enoch Letrachi. What comes as a greater shock is that Lete is actually Enoch, and that he has refused to see Juliet until she signs the marriage papers! Can Juliet find happiness when her trust in her husband-to-be has already been shattered?

title: Qin Si
description: Little Immortal Hua Yu (lit. cherry blossom fairy) who lives in the Ninth Kingdom's Cloud River, gave up immortality to fall to the mortal realm in search of that beloved person. Getting to know that beloved person again, starting off as strangers, losing oneself in the rivers and lakes until, finally, that moment when that sound was heard. Will that iceberg face be able to sense the feelings in the maiden's heart?

title: A Trace of the Wonder
description:
S Tier Hunter Sa Hyun--a member of HN, one of the world's top guilds--came to see Jeong Yi-Seon.

"I came to scout you, Mr. Jeong."
"Like hell you are, if you're approaching me like that."
"I don't think you know what exactly 'hell' is, but......"

Sa-hyun let out a laugh, looking just as if he were in a painting.

"Let's make a contract, shall we?"
"I'm not interested in any 'contract,' so please stop following me. You're getting..."
"I'll take care of them for you."
"What?"

Still full of laughter, he stared right at him. He was definitely smiling, but his icy eyes still sent a shiver down Yi-Seon's spine. Sa Hyun approached the stiff Yi-seon, one step at a time. Leaning down, he whispered. Whispered in a kind, friendly voice.

"Those corpses that haunt you... I'll take care of them."

title: Lost At The End Of The World
description: It tells the story of the survivors of the storm caused by unknown creatures who plan to end the human race.

title: Blood Demon Reincarnation
alt_titles: Rebirth of the Blood Demon: The Cursed Tanker's Trial
description:
Kang San is a bottom-tier anker with neither talent, ability, or skill. Misfortune follows him until a divine messenger appears before him one day. 

"You wee the Blood Demon in your past life." 

To atone for his past life’s sins, he must endure harsh trials. But in return, he will receive immense rewards. 

Can a weak F-rank tanker drenched in blood change his fate?

title: The Year We Turned 29
description:
Three 29 year old friends with the same name, "Woori."  
You know how you expect things to straighten out when you hit the big 3-0?  
The trinity: Work, Love, and Exams. All things that the three Wooris are currently struggling with.  
Welcome to a *realistic* romantic comedy.

title: Fairy, Wait a Moment! Please Listen to My Argument
alt_titles: Immortal Lady, Wait! Please Listen to My Cunning Defense
Xianzi Qieman! Qing Ting Wo Jiaobian.
description: My fellow Taoist is truly useless... Don't come over here.

title: She's Too Much For Me
description: The dangerous, delinquent high-school girl I met 4 years ago is now working night shifts at my Convenience Store! The mad story between a 30's aged Manager and 20's aged College girl!

title: Last Paradise
description: This is a story about Myunghan, who has just entered high school, Sihoo, his childhood friend, Seungchan, who suddenly appears between the two, and the strange triangle that develops between the three of them.

title: I Am a Small Kitten
alt_titles: Wo Zhishi Yi Zhi Xiao Maomi
description: Somewhere within a family of three, lived four cute pets: three balls of purrs and a little puppy. Not a moment goes by without something interesting happening with these four adorable pets each and every day…

title: Gunman
alt_titles: Embodiment of the Assassin in the Murim World
description:
The No.1 Hitman, Kim Gun, finds himself plunged into the world of martial arts due to a mysterious accident. To return to his original world, he must complete a mission called 'Martial Arts Conquest.'

With a total of 2 guns, Kim Gun's adventure to subdue the unfamiliar martial arts world begins.

title: Winter Wolf
description:
Is it safe to fall in love with you?
After losing her family to the revolt, noblewoman Lysithea hires Taron, a strapping young broker, to help her flee the kingdom. But when a heavy snowstorm strands the bickering pair in an eerie abandoned mansion, Lysithea has no choice but to rely on her new partner. What dangerous romance awaits them?

---

title: Colorless Girl
description: Com um novo ano eletivo, Eunwoo termina se sentando perto da Jinah uma garota sombria e pouco sociável, em uma tentativa de se aproximar da sua colega acaba em uma situação muito mais complexa do que poderia imaginar. Uma história sobre os desafios das emoções da juventude, uma obra de estreia de Lame!

title: Gravekeeper and the Silver Fox
description: A silver fox abandoned from its pack, A gravekeeper who sent away his parents early, and the love story that sparks between the two.

title: Chronicles of the Cursed Sword
alt_titles: The Record of Destroying the Sword
description:
Rey Yan was an orphan with no home, no skills, and no purpose. But when he comes upon the PaSa sword, a cursed blade made from the bones of the demon king, he suddenly finds himself with the power to be a great hero. The sword's creator is the evil Shiyan, the royal vizier who needs the sword to assist him in releasing his ancestor, the demon king.  
  
Note: Because of differences between magazine and tank chapter numbering, the chapter numbers don't match up, but there's nothing missing.

title: The Book of Lagier
description:
What happens when a good-for-nothing human prince signs a contract with an all-powerful Demon King? Well, the prince dies instantly, and the Demon King is forced to take his place. But wait, there’s another catch! 

As the new Prince Lagier, the Demon King is obligated to fulfill the prince’s last wishes or never return to his former body. Join the Demon King and his demon friends as he gets in shape, battles the Angels, and races against time to complete his missions before it's too late.

---
