title: Judge and Executioner
description:
Shin, a serial murderer, has shaken the entire nation of South Korea to its core.

Jihu Seo, who lost his father to Shin’s evil deeds, meets another victim: Duseok Kim, a former detective who also had his family murdered by Shin. Duseok vows to turn Jihu into a human weapon to exact revenge on Shin - in prison, with his bare hands.

“Korea has not implemented the death penalty since 1997. With no one else upholding justice, what other choice is there?”

title: Evangeline's Sword
description:
"I want to bring it back… Our original form, our original Michael..."

Evangeline and Michael grew up together on the island since childhood. However, her friend Michael left the island to become a knight and lost contact with him. When was it wrong? Five years later, she and Michael met again and he had become a cursed magician who burned the continent.

"Me… I can't remember anything, Eve."

"What do you mean?"

"I… I've been cursed by a demonic dragon."

The evil dragon's curse turned the boy with an angel's name into a slaughter-crazy demon. The boy's most precious person, Evangeline, made a decision.

"I will choose you this time. Mika."

The story of Michael, who became a magician under the curse of a demonic dragon, and Evangeline, who tries to save Michael.

---
How far are you willing to go for love? Not a day goes by that Eve doesn't wish to reunite with her childhood friend, Mikha. But three years later, when she learns that Mikha has become a cursed sorcerer who leaves only death in his wake, Eve must embark on a journey to save not only the man she loves but also the world as she knows it.

---
***Note:** The webtoon was released as R15; its not R19 like the novel.*

title: His Mystery Girl
description:
The glamorous daughter of the city’s richest family falls from grace- quite literally, as she falls off a building and dies! However, her story is just beginning.

description: The not-so-normal daily life of twin siblings.

title: Yandere Miko-chan
description: An untitled series about yandere Miko Iino, posted by an anonymous user on DC Inside.

title: Li Zi and Nian Nian
description:
In the big city, where young people’s social circles are painfully small, how does one find love? Tang Li, a real estate agent who has just started working in Hangzhou, unknowingly falls for Niannian, a part-time employee at a late-night noodle shop, and begins frequenting the place. 

Helping each other out, becoming roommates, and slowly falling in love, the two eventually find their way to each other.

title: Stop Bothering Me, Emperor!
description:
Song Xiao only wanted to be a man of virtue, but somehow ended up being forced into a marriage with his Highness, plotted by the cunning emperor himself. However, just as the generation of great businesses began to flourish, the emperor died… When Song Xiao opened his eyes again, he finds himself in a college entrance exam… but why does his seatmate look so familiar?!  
His Highness: ▼\_▼ Let me copy your homework.  
Song Xiao: …

title: 61 Days with You
description: “Let’s break up, but just give me 61 days, okay?” — this relationship that cannot be continued, two hearts that still throb, nine long-awaited destinations and 61 days with you. This time, no one knows if this break-up trip will end as a regretful make-up or something left to luck. A very sweet, sincere and romantic love, the reality of confusion and struggle; will we still have a future? A masterpiece on a cure for metropolitan affections, a bittersweet story is now online.

title: Enoch: The Shining Tree
description: "You shall live and suffer for eternity, trapped within your armor, prisoners of time." Enoch's life is turned upside down when his entire family is slaughtered overnight by the cursed knights. The knights wander, sentenced by the witch's curse to a fate of endless empty slaughters. Enoch trampled under their trail of blood, burns for a vengeance that outlasts, outdoes eternity. Who will be whose fate? Who is the one that orchestrates their conflicting fates?

title: Dragon Raja III: Back Moon Tide
alt_titles: Dragon Raja III: Back Moon Tide
description:
When a mysterious heartbeat is detected under the seas of Japan, Luminous, Caesar Gattuso and Johann Chu, (also known as the Ace Team of Cassell College) get sent on a mission to Tokyo, where they must cooperate with Cassell's Japanese branch, led by the conflicted Chisei Gen.   
After an unexpected turn of events, the trio will find itself in the middle of a hybrid mafia war.  
  
Adapted from the original novel which has also been turned into a game.

title: ONCE
description:
Mo Li's appearance is Bai Jiu's salvation, and the hope and light in Bai Jiu's eyes are treasures that Mo Li is willing to do her best to protect. ...Can we give each other another chance?

[Original Webcomic](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/10925/)

title: Stockpiling Ten Thousand Tons of Pork During the Apocalypse
alt_titles: Kongjian Xi Lao Liu, Moshi Xian Dun Yi Wan Dun Zhurou
Kōngjiān Xì Lǎo Liù, Mòshì Xiān Dùn Yī Wàn Dùn Zhūròu
description: “Mr. Chen, the one hundred portions of roasted duck that you ordered is here.” “Mr. Chen, the ten thousand pounds of pork that you ordered is here.” Chen Luo, also known as the Void Sovereign, hid like a coward with his outstanding powers until all the survivors died before him. Having found no meaning in life, he decided to bury himself. It wasn’t that he couldn’t survive, he just didn’t want to live anymore. After waking up, Chen Luo is shocked to find out that he has been reincarnated to one month before the apocalypse, and that the subspace he created in his past life with his powers was also retained.

title: Drama Writer Who Reads Spoilers
alt_titles: The Screen-Writer with a spoiler Cheat
description:
6th year drama assistant writer Jang Yeon-jae. He desperately wanted and tried, but ahead of his debut, his teacher the main writer Kim Tae-jin stole his script.

"Sir! How could you do this! That's my script!”
“Yeon-jae. It is true that I was a little influenced by your ideas. But that is definitely my work.”

After leaving the assistant writer job out of anger, he looked for a way to knock Kim Tae-jin down, but there seemed to be no hope. But at that moment...

A miracle happened.

[You can purchase 200 characters of the script with a rating of 0.1%.]
[When broadcasting with this script, the expected average rating is 15.2%.]

[Do you want to buy?]
[Yes / No]

'On-air shooter' required!
Assistant writer Jang Yeon-jae's high-rating drama,
(Drama Writer Who Reads Spoilers)

title: The Killer Lives Next Door
description:
A killer who can completely conceal all traces of his existence has been hired to deal with the target while keeping a low profile.  
  
However, the place where the killer infiltrated was an apartment in Korea that was has poor soundproofing level. Everyone can hear everything that is happening in the apartment.  
  
It is in this place that the killer is to monitor the target until given further instructions. All he wants to do is to complete his mission in peace. However, things just won't go his way.

title: She's Not Our Daughter!
description:
Sierra's peaceful village life is disrupted when her ex-boyfriend, Duke Cassius Ideos, shows up and mistakes the child she's raising as his daughter. The thing is, the girl is her niece, not her kid! When he refuses to listen to any explanation, her only option is to follow him to his duchy and await the results of a paternity test. All Sierra has to do is keep to herself for three months, but will things remain that simple when she begins to suspect that the duke still has feelings for her?
___
Six years ago, Sierra broke up with her ex-boyfriend, Cassius, without a word. Now he's back as a duke, claiming he regrets abandoning her. But wait, wasn’t she the one who ended things? To make matters worse, he starts getting strange ideas after meeting Hanael, her 5-year-old niece whom she's been raising in place of her sister. "I had no idea, Sierra. I never knew you were raising our child all alone…" Hanael, who had been hiding, suddenly yells at Cassius instead of being shy. "Please, stop denying it... our relationship, and our child." "You're a bad man! You abandoned us!" No, Hanael, he didn't abandon you. And I'm not your mother!

title: You Too
description:
Two childhood friends meet again as roommates at university.  
  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Author’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/RR_frame)

title: The Tainted Half
description:
Two brothers. One concubine.
Seolha’s face was disfigured by her mother, who sought to deny the emperor his prize: the most beautiful concubine in the world. Now forced to endure a lifetime of abuse, Seolha can only pin her hopes on Muon, the emperor’s twin brother. But is he really someone she can trust?

title: Wolf in the House
description: After ending an on-again, off-again relationship of 10 years, Minsuk decides to foster a Siberian husky named Bexan to mark the start of his new single life. He can’t wait to cuddle with his new furry roommate, take him on walks, and play fetch. But Bexan is no ordinary dog…and when night falls, Minsuk is in for a surprise.

title: Three Kingdoms
description:
In an era when heroes flocked to defeat others and to conquer the world, one brave warrior - Yeopo - goes back in time due to a moment of mistake. As he is on the verge of death he thinks, Give me one more chance, and I'll conquer the world! When he opens his eyes, Yeopo is back in his old feisty 20s. Yeopo travelled back in time. His turbulent spirit unfolds as he once again sets to conquer the world!

description: She is the top killer of the killer employment center. Her auntie threw her to a strange man. When she wanted to ask who was the child's father, Auntie's feet ran away… Six years later, the baby was caught by the black empire. In desperation, she was disguised as a man pretending to be a driver lurking into the black empire boss side to do undercover…

title: Kangtawoo
description:
Hyeon Kang, a self-centered high school kid, has to bear the burdening fate of being the master of 'KANGTAWOO', the only robot that can stand against 'Spelta Empire', which seeks to conquer Earth. A giant robot action in Busan!

title: Zombie Revelation: 82-08
description:
A mysterious virus breaks out on board the Boat 82-08 out at sea. The people who find out about it first only want to use it as a weapon but quickly lose control over the virus.

Will the trio survive long enough to rejoin their friend Jinu? Or will it be Jinu who doesn’t make it out to meet his friends?

title: I Dominate the Apocalypse by Cultivating Immortality
description: Craft celestial-grade treasures from apocalyptic scraps, and roam the wastelands of the end times using immortal cultivation techniques. With a soul traversing two realms, truth and illusion blur… In the realm of the void, a frenzied path of cultivation begins!

title: Local Supplier of Alien Goods
description: The exclusive update every Monday and Friday was originally a local tyrant, the second generation ancestor, who was driven out of the house by the villain due to his father’s disappearance. However, it is this supermarket that connects other worlds and makes the male protagonist a business tycoon in both worlds! The chewing gum is exchanged for the god pill, the boy returns to the yuan, the orders of the big guys are soft! Perfume to change the marrow liquid, to strengthen the body, see the uneven road, solve it with one punch! It’s okay if you want the unicorn beast of the Eastern Fairy World as a mount. As long as the money is in place, cash on delivery is no problem. What do you want the colorful heart clothes of the Nine Heavens Profound Girl? There are many ways to make money, and the little brother is full~ As long as you have money, I can get you what you want to buy. I am Liu Lei, the only supplier in the world, and I speak for myself!

The Monster Lady and the Holy Knight
description: Veronica lost everything—her home, her family, and even her humanity. Her monstrous red eyes see only horror until Leon, a renegade holy knight, presses a kiss to her lips. Could he be her only hope for salvation?

title: The Strongest Sect of All Times
alt_titles: Wo De Zang Men Yi Dian Qiang
Wǒ De Zōng Mén Yì Diǎn Qiáng

My Sect Is 100 Million Points Stronger
description: Wang Feng finds himself transmigrated to the Xian Lan Continent. With the help of a  powerful system, he summons mighty individuals to crush all opposition, leading his Immortal Sect to unparalleled glory.

title: Oh! My Assistant
description:
Naive comic artist Seonho, who draws R-19 series, hires beauty(?)-and-brains Muyoung with outstanding skills to be his assistant. However, working with Muyoung who is too task-oriented and has a prickly temperament, turns out to be a little difficult. Seonho asks Muyoung to pose for him one day to help with a sexy scene, but when he sees how erotic Muyoung's pose is, Seonho's "junior"… that hasn't stood in 2 years, got up. It's hard! It got hard! It finally got hard!   
  
This is an unpredictable, comical and chest-tickling BL story brought to you by Milla and Yalgae!

title: Lime Odyssey - The Chronicles of ORTA
alt_titles: Lime Odyssey: The Chronicles of ORTA
description: Made into a free to play RPG, Lime Odyssey - The Chronicles of ORTA follows the journey of an ordinary high school student who is thrown into the fantasy world of Orta.

title: Before I Knew It, I Had Stolen the Dark Lord's Heart
alt_titles: Before I Knew It, I Had Stolen the Dark Lord's Heart
My Lord Was Already Into Me When I Noticed
By the Time I Woke up, the Dark Lord Had Wound Down
By the Time I Came to My Senses, the Dark Lord Had Wrapped Around Me
description:
Seeing the relationship between Duke Willow, the Sword of the North, and her father who's his guardian knight, Celine has been looking forward to meeting her lord, Damian. However, the Damian she encountered was a skinny, frail boy with a bright smile that belied his Northern Majesty. To fulfil her duty as a guardian knight, she decided to take her lord's side, no matter what kind of person he was. But there's something fishy about this frail boy...

---
Ten-year-old Celine Mars dreams of becoming a great knight escort just like her father. She’s set to serve under Damien Willow, the heir of a powerful Duke. There’s only one problem—he’s a total weakling, or so she thinks. Celine vows to train the poor, defenseless Damien to stand up for himself, completely unaware of his real strength. Meanwhile, Damien instantly takes a liking to Celine, finding her cluelessness and pure intentions both amusing and endearing. When will Celine finally realize she’s got the wrong idea about Damien?

title: Nowhere Boy
description:
"Welcome to Survival, 'I Am Unhappy,' the exciting game show to find the world's unhappiest person! The grand prize… is a wish granted by God!"  
  
When the victor of the game show wishes for the end of the world, God accepts this wish with a set condition: the world's end would proceed over the course of 100 days, and during that time, he is allowed to 'change his mind' only once.  
  
Oh Duk Hee, a quirky comic artist who specializes in unhappiness, is chosen by God to make the unhappiest person on Earth happy again. With the pressure of mankind's destruction riding on her shoulders, will she be able to change his mind before it's too late?  
  
The competition to choose the world's unhappiest human?! The hybrid school fantasy action story by Jung Pil Won!

title: Dafeng's Night Squad
description:
In this world, there is: Confucianism; Taoism; Buddhism, Demons, and Magicians. Xu Qi’an, a graduate from the police academy, suddenly finds himself waking up in prison, to be exiled to the border three days later …

His initial goal was to protect himself in this world with no laws, and to be able to live a leisurely life as a rich man..

Many years later, Xu Qi’an looks back on the past, and the long-dead enemies and friends, as well as the numerous bones he has left behind.

As the Yangtze River flows eastward, the waves wash away the heroes; right and wrong, success or failure will all turn into nothing but history. However, just like the sun’s rays gleaming over the towering mountains, after the sunset, a new sun will rise.

title: Diagonal
description:
Two idiots sitting diagonal from each other. A GL oneshot. Scanlated with author permission.

title: My Dangerous Guardian
description:
High-school girl Han Sowon suddenly gets caught up in the night by a handsome genderuwo. In the morning he met genderuwo who last night in human form named Yoo Hyun. Han Sowon was confused because he had a strange power and could hypnotize the people around him.  
  
Her parents were hypnotized and told them to sleep together. Because they had no choice and Han Sowon was also hooked, they slept together until early morning.  
  
Yoo Hyun calls himself the god of protection for a reason. What is it that Yoo Hyun wants to protect that you need to lull together?

title: The Gangster Daughter of the Henchman Duke's Family
alt_titles: The Gangster Baby of the Duke's Family
description:
My name is Leonora Hachania. Although I’m the daughter of a villain extra whose name in itself means ‘insignificant’, my desire for power is unimaginable. I can’t just let the Hachania family be as insignificant as it is in the original novel! 

“Woll to the left, wight now!” 
“Yes, ma’am!” 
“Woll to the wight, wight now!” 
“Yes, ma’am!” 

With the sunglasses I made by painting on them with ink, I raised my voice fiercely. 

“Sowldier Enoch, we don’t cwy!” The tender-hearted third child who had met my eyes was startled and sniffled with his runny nose. 

“W-we don’t cry!” I’ve succeeded. 
“Were you originally this weak? How annoying.” 
“Ugh! S-Save me!” 
“Hyung, they look like they’re really suffering, should we kill them quickly? It would be better for them.” 

My brothers who couldn’t even hold a candle to the male lead and were extras have become the greatest villain brothers in the world! 

Although it was a bit difficult since my villain father was so clumsy, “Rini, just what kind of evil deed are you planning this time…”
“Keke, it’s nothing. As expected of my daughter, you’re planning something evil. Very nice.”

I’ve redesigned him to be a villain with a dual personality. Keke, mwahaha! Nice, I’ve increased our assets using the information from the original novel and made the family into a significant one! Now, I just need to escape this terminally ill body and enjoy the proper life of a villainess- 

“I know that Your Ladyship is a caring person, so it would be too greedy to wish for your kindness to be mine alone.” 

I think the human weapon that I revived for the family has broken.

“But if I get rid of all the people you are kind to…” The red flame blazing in his hand burned the map of the world. “Won’t I be the only you can be kind to?” He says that as if he’s about to hunt down the entire world.

title: I've Probably Made a Mistake in Getting Married
alt_titles: I Think My Marriage Was a Mistake
I Guess I Got Married Wrong
description:
I've reincarnated in the world of fiction, where characters are decapitated at the hands of villains.

I read the famous gothic novels to cure my timidity and build my courage! Before the real story can begin, I have to get away from the dreaded capital society. So I married a poor baron in the countryside...

"Don't make me pay your bills. Do you understand?"

This man, who shows up at the wedding covered in blood, must be the dreaded villain who kills everyone! Did I, in an attempt to avoid being a villain, marry a man who would be a villain? I'm definitely screwed. I must have married the wrong person!

title: Pick Up Love
description:
Meet Leo, a stray cat who accidentally picks up an abandoned dog, Milky.  
To avoid a bad reputation from the other stray cats, Leo teaches Milky how to survive in the streets…  
But can he keep his cool through Milky's adorable demeanor?

title: The Last Step on the Way
description:
“I wanted to tell you it’s okay now.”  
  
Joo Giran was torn apart by guilt after his grandmother passed away. He had a one-night stand with Baek Sunkyung after meeting him at a club but…  
  
“I wish it was just the two of us forever.”  
  
They meet again as sunbae & hoobae in the same major at the start of the semester celebration. Giran is strangely attracted to and forms an odd camaraderie with Sunkyung, who strides toward him unabated. Sunkyung stays by his side through thick and thin, as if Giran was his final destination.

title: Cohabitation
description: A boy and a girl, living together… They are both best friends and best enemies ! This is a simple comics about love in the city…

title: Queen of Flower
description: Kim Sohye's life changed after being chosen as the empress. Unfortunately, Shoye's life after marriage is not exactly happy. The king who previously had a concubine doesn't love her and always insulted her. The concubine turned out to have evil intentions to the king. But, slowly but surely the king begins to feel the empress's sincere heart. The feeling of their love began to grow like a flower in bloom. How does their story continue? Will the empress be strong and fight the king's concubines?

title: The Moon at Daybreak
description: Pu Reum Han led a normal high school life, that is until, he dreams of a lady, looking for his help to find her missing baby. But what if that baby is inside him?

title: The Girl of the Black Lotus
alt_titles: The Guide to Capturing a Black Lotus
Become the Girl of Black Lotus
description: Ling Miaomiao transmigated into a novel. She became the cannon fodder girl No.3 and she still has to finish those extremely cliché missions?! It's already enough that she has to spoil the relationship between the original male and female lead, but she also needs to 'conquer' the vicious and merciless Black Lotus, Mu Sheng?! How hard can this be? Genius Miaomiao will conquer you now~ Wait a minute, the plotline’s direction doesn't seem right, why is the Black Lotus paying close attention to Ling Miaomiao? Could it be that Miaomiao's spring day has arrived?

title: The Villainess Wants to Turn Over a New Leaf
alt_titles: Max-Level Green Tea Transmigrates Into Little Pitiful One
Man Ji Lvcha Chuan Cheng Xiao Kelian
Mǎn Jí Lǜchá Chuān Chéng Xiǎo Kělián
Villainess Wants to Turn Over a New Leaf
description:
Lin Feilu is an oscar-winning actress. Acting cute, slandering, feigning innocence, or playing the white lotus. Regardless, she wasn't a good person. She then died on her 27th birthday. She vowed, if there was a next life, she would be a good person. In the end, she transmigrated into a five-year-old princess of the great Lin Dynasty. Her imperial mother was not favored, her older brother was mentally challenged, and her life was constantly in danger, with having little to eat and trying to stay warm.

Lin Feilu: …You all forced me!

title: The Hunter Next Door
alt_titles: The Hunter Lives in a Rented Apartment
description: The rift brought an end to the world humanity once knew. Monsters claimed the lives of countless people, and those with supernatural powers known as hunters became humanity’s last hope. For Jiho Lee, becoming a hunter wasn’t a choice, but a result of losing everything. Now, in the aftermath, she begins forming new ties and gradually rebuilding a life on her own terms.

title: Our Classmate Sookgyung
description: The tale of Sookgyung, a ghost no one pays attention to, who's been sitting in school for the last twenty-seven years.

title: Force Field Girl
description: A boy who is bullied gets saved by his…Force Field Girl!

title: You're My Flame
alt_titles: I Raised Him Modestly, But He Came Back Obsessed With Me
I Raised A Boy Kindly But He Returned As An Obsessive Man
description:
After being reborn as a desolate fire witch and villain destined to die a tragic death, Chersinia creates a plan to avoid her fate by gambling at a casino to become a wealthy recluse. 

The only problem? She somehow ends up with a slave boy named Ben instead of the money she needs! 

But much to her surprise, she starts to warm up to Ben, who provides the perfect joy and comfort in her lonely life. Little does she know that Ben has a dark secret that will change her life forever...

title: After School Exorcism
description:
**From [Inept Scans](https://mangadex.org/group/6421/inept-scans)**  
In the nation’s capital, there is a female demon! The city is a huge university campus built by all the world’s nations. In this city that symbolises peace, there are countless demons and ghosts possessing students from all over the world. Every evening strange events overlap and cause havoc throughout the city. A mysterious girl, Ji An, walks between the light and the shadow. She has all kinds of wonderful adventures with demons and humans alike.

title: Lost in the Wrong World
description: The story of an intelligent teenager leading a group of students to survive amidst the chaos of the supernatural after their field trip goes awry.

title: My Daughter Is the Demon King When I Was Reincarnated
description: Ji-hyeok, a public defender, was living a hard life looking at his daughter, who was not worth it. Ji-hyeok, who lost his life along with his daughter in a car accident, asks God. “Because I don’t need it!! I just need to see my daughter again!!” After such a persistent request, he arrives in a new world with the power of observation and persuasion, and Ji-hyeok finds out that he is the devil’s butler and lawyer. And he finally comes face to face with the Demon King…. “So Eun-ah…” Surprisingly, the Demon King was in the form of his daughter. The Demon King’s Castle, which was destroyed by the luxury and pleasure of the previous Demon King! Attack of the warriors! The protests of monsters are pouring in every day! Only Ji-hyeok can protect her daughter!

title: Guang Xiang
description: A story about two youthful boys–one named Yu Xiao Guang, the other named Lin Xiang–who have to deal with the problems forced upon them by both society and their families. How will they console each other during the tough teenage years? What will be the true nature of their friendship? And what does the future hold for them?

title: Tenth Time's the Charm
description: A shy returning student who loves caring for flowers, Hyunwoo has a condition that makes him pass out in the presence of excessive stimuli. For example, he nearly fainted at a bar recently because of some freshman who’d doused himself in cologne. Thankfully, he got some fresh air in time, as well as a glimpse of that same freshman making out with another guy. Hyunwoo doesn’t think much of it, but a few days later, he’s overwhelmed by the same dizzying yet irresistible scent. But this time, he’s not at a bar—he’s at a flower-themed cafe, to interview for a job he desperately wants and needs. What will Hyunwoo find in this garden of memories?

title: Business Performance
description:
Jung Rin is the former leader of the so-called failed group 'Pantetosan'. 3 years after his contract ended, he lived as an ordinary unemployed man, rather than an idol. One day, Pantetosan's once youngest member, currently a rising actor in his 20s, Yeon Seoho, met Rin.  
  
"You wrote this, right?"  
  
Seoho pushed a book towards Rin, and proposed to him with an elegant expression.  
  
"If you wrote this, do you have any thoughts in making this into a movie?"  
"What……?"  
  
Rin kept rejecting but it was difficult to resist Seoho's stubborness.  
He then made a proposal to Seonho…  
  
"From now on, 5 times…."  
"5 times?"  
"I want…you to go out with me on a date."  
  
"I know well that you can act well, it won't do if I can't check it by myself,"  


---

**Links**:  
- [Original Webtoon (kakao)](https://page.kakao.com/home/54717652)  
  
——————–  
Jung Rin es el exlíder del fallido grupo llamado 'Pantetosan'. Tres años después de terminar su contrato, vive como un desempleado común y corriente, en lugar de como un ídolo. Un día, el miembro más joven de Pantetosan, actualmente un actor en ascenso en sus 20´s, Yeon Seoho, se reúne con Rin.  
“Tú escribiste esto, ¿verdad?”  
Seoho empujó un libro hacia Rin y le propuso algo con una expresión elegante.  
“Si tu escribiste esto, ¿no tienes intención alguna de convertirlo en película?”  
“¿Qué………?”  
Rin siguió rechazándolo, pero era difícil resistirse a la terquedad de Seoho.  
Entonces le hizo una propuesta a Seoho …  
"De ahora en adelante, 5 veces …"  
"¿5 veces?"  
"Quiero … que salgas conmigo en una cita."  
"Sé que puedes actuar bien, pero no servirá si no puedo comprobarlo yo mismo".

title: Unnie's Taste
description: Bang Ha-jeong's unrequited love! Who is the one who makes the Ha-jeong's heart skip a beat everyday? To a mysterious unnie and a tutor with a different taste.

title: Deathwalker Chronicles: From Murloc to Glory
alt_titles: Walking with Death: Start From Murloc Dungeons
Journeying Together With Death: Beginning From Murloc Dungeon City
description: After unlocking the hidden class “**Deathwalker**,” becoming a legendary adventurer should be straightforward… right?

title: A Man of Virtue
description: What’s it like spending your whole life coming in second place? Ask Nam Jinwoo: he’s been living in the shadow of his rival, Ma Sangtae, his whole life. Now the two are even working in the same office. But passion is strange is a strange beast… It can start as envy or hate and turn into something, well, erotic. Before he knows it, Jinwoo’s head is filled with the most vivid, dirty, and erotic fantasies featuring none other than Sangtae. Unable to control the fantasies, the only way to stop them might be the last thing he wants to do…

title: Hamster
description: A series of short oneshots from the author’s weibo about the misadventures of a sly house cat and an earnest hamster.

title: My Father, the Possessive Demi-God
alt_titles: One Day, My Dad Showed up
description: Young Claire lives with her mother and her twin sister in a humble country home. Feeling mature for her age, Claire is tired of being different from everyone she's ever met. However, when her father suddenly appears, she realizes that she wasn't the only "strange" one in the family. As she slowly learns about her family's past, she understands more about herself and her destiny.

title: Devouring Eternity
description: Lin Chen was betrayed and his martial arts were crippled however, he had unexpectedly made a fateful encounter with the sacred engulfing star map, which led to the awakening of the Holy Vein constitution, and reaching the pinnacle of cultivation!

title: Hand Over the Money!
description:
As someone who lived a normal life after being forcibly discharged from the special forces, one day Ju Hyuk receives sudden and strange missions through his glasses.
While carrying out the missions hoping for the best… His money starts multiplying like crazy…?!!
After getting the taste of money, Ju Hyuk begins to participate in the money survival game in earnest and becomes a regular that overwhelms all the other participants thanks to his overwhelming physique!!

title: 9000 Years Old Empress
alt_titles: Gian thần mị quốc: Tà Vương, đừng quá hư
description:
The invincible commander of the Ye Jiajun was killed by a traitor and died in the battlefield. The Heavens are merciful; I was reborn, but I did not expect to be a eunuch?! Then, I almost got killed by the crippled prince on the spot?! Can someone tell me why does this prince hug me whenever he can? And even want to kiss me?!  
  
One is a servant who gets thrown away, and the other is a prince who gets treated coldly, being looked down by everyone. After their fateful meeting, they begin working together to purge corruption and bring prosperity to their imperial reign.

title: The Minus Touch
description: A boy, Zeo, lives in a time when nobles dictate and command indestructible warrior robots as they like. Commoners get mercilessly killed like flies and it's up to Zeo to end this.

title: In Secret
description: The life of a K-pop star is a hard one, especially if you’re Choi Yuwon. Not only does he have to keep up with the grueling lifestyle of an idol, but he also needs to keep a vigilant eye on the troublemaker of INSECRET, Park Dojin. Dojin acts how he pleases, and Yuwon is the only person in the group who can keep him out of trouble. This arrangement seems to work just fine for the both of them, until one day, Dojin makes a fateful mistake…

title: Rookie Chef with the Magic Touch
alt_titles: Youngest Chef From the 3rd Rate Hotel
description: Kang Sunghoon, the youngest member of a 4 star hotel kitchen in Korea, has the ability to memorise different kinds of ingredients. However, as the youngest, he's still unable to escape dishwashing duty.

title: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast
description:
When an average twenty-something wakes up in the battered body of a nameless extra from a romance novel, all she wants is to go home. But first, she’ll have to see the story through as Rona, the maid of Grand Duke Ileon, the novel’s hero who was blinded by poison. She just has to make sure the heroine restores his sight with a special flower so they can have their happy ending -- easy enough, right? With a plot gone awry, Rona’s dangerous past, and the grand duke’s affections, can Rona stick to the story?
___
*Unexpectedly, I grabbed the collar of the blind beast.*

Grand Duke Eléon Clevent fell into the abyss from the Empire’s Greatest Knight. Rona succeeded in making Eléon, who is obsessed with anger and frustration, into a human being again. Soon after, Rona found her family and left his side… When the Grand Duke’s eyes were healed, he was desperately searching for her through the entire empire.

“Young Lady, have we met somewhere?”

“It’s my first time meeting you, Your Highness.”

title: The Count's Secret Maid
description:
For Paula, not a single day passed by without a reminder of her ugliness. But it was her hideous face that spared her from being sold to a brothel or dying tragically like her sisters. 

So when Paula's father sells her off to work at an esteemed nobleman's mansion, she realizes that peasant girls are a disposable resource. However, she finds the young Count Belunita tucked away in an annex, shamefully hidden from the curious eyes of the public.

And as Paula struggles to appeal to her tyrannical master's whims, she must also embrace her role as his secret maid.

title: The Skin Painter
description: On Earth, spirits roam. As thousands of years pass, many curious and peculiar species are birthed. Some spirits satisfy their own desires by devouring weak human beings. With this, a group of humans possessing special powers came into being: exorcists, wizards… Within them, include those miraculous beings who defy natural laws. With one pen, they are able to redraw one's features… We call them: Skin Painters. The manhua tells the story of the master (The Skin Painter) and his disciple as they travel the world.

title: Affection Level ↟ Max ══ What Happens Next ══
alt_titles: Make the Level up to Max
description: After maxing out the affection level of all the collectible characters in the MMORPG Shangyang, Liu Yuan transmigrated into this fantasy land. This resulted in the birth of the biggest con in Shangyang's history, and also the coming of the unprecedented "Love Sage."

title: Trace
description:
The story set in the contemporary South Korea. Some 30 years ago, unidentified creatures appeared out of nowhere and have attacked people. They have caused massive destruction wherever they go. The monsters are called "Trouble", and get the world have fallen into chaos. Along with the first appearance of the "Troubles", some number of humans were born with or acquired supernatural abilities. These mutants called "Trace" are the only ones who can fight off the "Trouble". The "Trace" are also considered freaks and generally shunned by the community because some of them misused the powers for their own interest.  
  
The plot revolves around two main characters. Sah Gang-kwon, a high school student born as a "Trace" who attempts to hide his ability. The other is Kim Yun-Seong, who acquired his "Trace" abilities during his early 30s. Soon after the acquision, his wife and daughter were taken away from him for experimental purposes.

title: Surge Towards You
description: Cheong-ho is a national swim team member who has been struggling with poor records. As an alpha, his physical condition could be improved greatly through sex with an omega, but he has a fear of omega pheromones. His hopes of being a top swimmer seem to be sinking, but that all changes when he meets Yi-rim, an omega whose pheromones don’t give off any scent. Yi-rim is only too happy to help Cheong-ho out, and thus the two of them start a purely physical relationship. It’s almost like they’re a match made in heaven. But…why is it so hard for them to close the distance between each other?

title: First Love, Lasting Hate
description: Eunha, whose dream is to become a teacher, has finally become a university student. However, she discovers that her childhood friend and first love, Ha Seungmin, is also in her class. Seungmin used to be a bully in middle and high school and had almost cut ties with Eunha. But now, he seems to be getting closer to her.

title: Zombie Fight
description:
As life gets harder, Ian pushes his emotions away and resists. His father's violence and debts increase. Thee misfortunes continued and his body became increasingly numb, he accidentally walks in on an illegal fight and receives an offer.

"If you get in the game, I will give you all the money on this floor."

His survival period begins, where he must survive in an illegal fighting arena.

title: How a Ride-hailing Driver Comes to Dominate the World?
alt_titles: What's wrong with me, an online car-hailing driver, who has a little money?
Wo Yige Wang Yue Che Siji Youdian Qian Zenmeliao?
Wǒ Yīgè Wǎng Yuē Chē Sījī Yǒudiǎn Qián Zěnmeliǎo?
description: In a comical turn of events, Yang Chen quits his job after a heated argument with his boss, only to receive a breakup notice from his girlfriend of six years, Zhao Feifei. Left with no other choice, Yang Chen decides to become a ride-hailing driver. After an annoying passenger complained about him, Yang Chen unexpectedly gains access to the “**Prize Bad Review System**”. With generous rewards from the system after getting bad reviews and his great ambition, Yang Chen worked hard and finally established his dominance in the world.

title: By a Deity's Side
description: Xiao Bai recently moved to a new city with her family due to her father's job offer, despite her being so shy and timid. One day, Xiao Bai and her family were visiting the temple where she noticed a statue of a lucky cat. She decided to make a wish, and suddenly she found herself concerned with a black haired cat god…

title: Old Era Dragon Tamer
alt_titles: Dragon Rider of the Olden Days
Dragon Master of the Olden Days
description:
A masterpiece of the Beast-Taming!

In a wasteland where mutant beasts run rampant, human survival space is rapidly shrinking. Su Huan, a genius teenager, accidentally obtains the Old Era Dragon Manuscript that combines Old Era knowledge and magic, thus embarking on a path to the fantasy world.
Hatch pet-taming eggs to activate advanced bloodlines that surpass those attainable by ordinary people, and enlighten their skills to create unprecedented top-tier combat power. There is also the "Dragon Transformation Secret Technique" that allows the tamed beasts by his side to transcend their mortal forms and become colossal dragons!

title: Fox Love Story
description: Gumiho Yeon, who despises humans, accidentally avoids an accident with the help of human Dong-i. In essence, a nine-tailed fox is a being that has to repay the favor it receives. Yeon visits Dong-i without skipping a day for Bo-eun, and Dong-i is only burdened with such a kite. The two, who seemed never to be able to get closer, know each other's wounds and shortcomings, fill them in, and develop good feelings... The two are different in their environment, race, and way of loving. Can a nine-tailed fox and human love have a happy ending?

title: Egregor
description: Poa lives in a small provincial village, and dreams that one day he can become a great blacksmith. But, once mercenaries invaded his village and massacred all inhabitants, including his family. That moment radically changed his life …

title: Summer Solstice Point
description: “I’ve never kissed anyone before… so help me out. Please?” Seoha’s divorce is still fresh in her mind when 20-year-old Jihoo begins working at her café. Jihoo’s unassuming beauty immediately draws her in, and his desire for Seoha burns too bright for her not to notice. Seoha decides it wouldn’t hurt to shake him up a bit… but Jihoo’s not the only one stepping into unfamiliar territory this summer.

title: Kiss the Abyss
description:
As a rookie game designer, Wang Zixin never imagined that his life would depend entirely on a video game character, and that escaping death meant crossing into the game and raising Abyss, the game's protagonist by himself.   
"Not only do i have to go into the game, now i have to raise a child????? What even is this situation…"

title: The Sea Painted by the Moonlight
description:
Naranda is a country where mermaids are said to have lived in the sea once upon a time.
Yeonji joins the Naranda Historical Research Institute as an intern to prove it.
She has been dreaming of a mermaid since she was a child.
At the institute, she meets her team leader, Hae-rang, who looks like the mermaid from her dreams.
She tries her best to impress Hae-rang, but she's not impressed with her...

The mystery of her past life, sinking to the bottom of the sea with the kingdom of Naranda begins to unfold!

title: Regnal Trigger
description: In the Trebian Empire’s mines, Aren and Toa led a life of harsh labor for 10 years. It was Aren’s dream to escape the mines together with his younger twin sister, Toa. However, it did not come into fruition. Toa ended her life through suicide. Losing the motivation to live without his sister, Aren commits to ending his own life. However, a mysterious figure nicknamed ‘Deed’ appears before him. Deed claims there is a method to revive Toa if Aren makes a contract with Deed…?

title: The Main Characters That Only I Know
description:
“If I were given another chance…” 

10 years after the apocalypse began on Earth, while he faced imminent death, Yoohyun was filled with regret. Just then, a bright light descended upon him. When he opened his eyes, he was greeted by an unfamiliar scene… Not only had he reincarnated as a non-human race called “Teller,” but he had also traveled back in time by 10 years! 

“Now that it has come to this, I’ll live my best life this time!” 

Unlike his previous life, where he was solely focused on survival, he is now determined to lead a successful life. In this new life he has gained, will Yoohyun truly be able to become the protagonist?

title: My First Love From the Future
alt_titles: Mối Tình Đầu Đến Từ Tương Lai
description:
Soo-ah is about to marry a sweet man named Hamin. In front of her is Lee Gyeom, whom she has been crushing on for 19 years.
Six years ago, Lee Gyeom left for abroad without saying a word, and for 19 years he refused to confess,
He proposes to Soo-ah, who is three months away from getting married...

“If you marry him, you will die.”
Surprised by the situation, Soo-ah keeps him at arm's length, but he begins to intrude into her life.
“Why are you doing this now?

Once, I loved him so much, but he hated me so much.
Now, the man who promises to marry me and loves me only for me, Hamin.
And the woman who is loved by both of them, Sua.

The strange fate of three men and three women over 49 regressions.

title: The Villainess Is Bothered by Male Leads
alt_titles: The Villainess Is Bothered by Male Leads
The Villainess Is Annoyed by the Male Leads Again Today
description: All she wanted was an easy life as a noble woman. Instead, Laura Jay found herself involved with a series of drama and a number of courters. She didn't sign up for all the excitement. "Just leave me alone!"

title: Please Love Me
description:
I already confessed to him, but he still treats me like a child…  
(Random Fujoshis Scans)

title: Weekly Boys' Romance
alt_titles: The Weekly Love Story of Young Men
description:
Five boys, living under the same roof, yet indifferent to one another, are given an ultimatum: "No girl problems, or you're out". With each of them harboring their own unconventional romance, can they succeed in protecting their clumsy, innocent love and rebuild their friendship?  
  
  
A love/hate drama filled story about 5 highschoolers who live in the same house.

title: Despite Being Summoned as a Demon, I Still Need to Practice Chinese Medicine
alt_titles: Bèi Zhàohuàn Chéngwéi Yījí Mówù De Wǒ, Yīrán Hái Yào Zuò Zhōngyī
Bei Zhaohuan Chengwei Yiji Mowu De Wo, Yiran Hai Yao Zuo Zhongyi
That Time I Was Summoned as a First-Level Monster
I Was Summoned as a First Class Monster, yet Practice [TCM] as Before
description: The 30-year deadline was up. Huang He, who could have easily inherited 10 billion yuan, married someone rich and beautiful, and walked to the peak of his life, ended up transmigrating into the game and became a level 1 little zombie… In his despair, Huang He learned that as long as he died, he would be able to transmigrate back to his original world. Thus, he began his path of seeking death. But little did he know that wanting to die was not that simple…

title: Sages Who Slaughter The Heartless
description: An inexperienced protagonist and a big-chested maiden, seeking revenge…

title: A Concubine's Daughter and Her Tactics
alt_titles: The Strategy of the Concubine's Daughter
description:
During the Great Yan dynasty (756-763), The Eleventh Miss Luo was forced to marry her brother-in-law as a second wife.   
  
She thought it was an arranged marriage, but for the benefit of the family, she unexpectedly became the true favorite of this man's heart.   
  
Even though she is a concubine’s daughter, why should she be bullied? Let's see how the little concubine’s daughter finally became the mistress of the house!

title: Sorry I Couldn't Protect You!
description: Is this fate? Chess, a close friend of Benjamin, appears before him looking for a roommate. Will this meeting rekindle the friendship they once had? Or will this turn out into something better? Watch out as their story unfolds . . .

title: I Cloned My Newlywed Wife
description: Underground human cloning services are becoming more and more common in society. After my wife, who I’d just married, died in a plane crash… I had to ask myself— should I clone her?

title: I'm Just a Side Character, but I Became the Guardian of the Marquess Family's Heir
alt_titles: Even Though I Was Just a Mob Character, I Ended up Becoming the Guardian of the Heir to the Marquis' Family
From a Background Character to the Guardian of the Marquess's Heir
The Extra Guardian Missed the Right Time to Leave
The Extra Guardian Missed the Timing to Leave
description:
I was supposed to have died in an accident… but when I opened my eyes, I found myself inside the pages of my favorite novel!
And the worst part? I wasn’t reborn as the heroine or even the villainess… but as a completely insignificant side character.

According to the original story, the noble couple I work for will soon disappear, and all the servants will be dismissed afterward.
I knew exactly how it was going to play out, so I told myself:
“I’ll just live quietly, freely, and comfortably in my own way.”

But things didn’t go as planned…

Suddenly, and completely against the original plot, I find myself in charge of the marquess’s children, who were left behind after the tragic accident.
I’ve become their guardian, even though I was never meant to play this role!

Even when I tried to walk away, I couldn’t ignore their innocent eyes and their need for comfort…
So I chose to take on the responsibility, leading them on a journey filled with surprises and challenges.

title: unTouchable
description: Sia Lee is a modern-day vampire who absorbs energy from humans by touching them instead of drinking their blood. She has been desperate to touch Jiho since the day he moved in next door—but he's a germofobem. Will Sia best his mysophobia and touch Jiho?

title: The Gamer: Fantasia
description:
Han Jihan, a college student who has lived a normal life. I thought I was dead in a car accident.

---

- [Official Japanese Translation](https://piccoma.com/web/product/80356)
