- [Original Webtoon <Naver>](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6101520)

title: Face With Love, Affection, and Time
alt_titles: Towards Feelings of Love, Towards the Passing of Time
description: "You were originally the heartless one. The one who wanted to leave was you, and now you say you love me?!" Liang Zijin pulled Luo Xiangdong's shirt: "Since you came I won't miss it a second time." Luo Xiangdong turned the situation around, and kissed Liang Zijin: "Lian Zijin, you can't run away from me in this life."

title: The Devil's Temptation
description: Hyun was supposed to spend his Christmas snuggling with his cat on his comfy couch watching TV. This year, however, he decides to attend his company holiday party to make his existence known to his office crush — the devilishly handsome Alek — but instead, downs too many drinks, makes a fool of himself, and blacks out. The morning after, he wakes up to a Christmas nightmare: lying next to him butt naked is his despicable colleague, Ivan Mariani. Hyun has always hated everything about Ivan. So why does Ivan suddenly look different…smell wonderful…and radiate irresistible sexual energy?

title: Golden Mage
description:
Junseong Kim had a hard life living secretly as a pro gamer to pay off his late parents’ debts before dying in a tragic accident. But his luck changes when he is reincarnated into another world as a boy named Elemis. 

Awakening to a doting mother and great magical power, Junseong, now El, journeys to become the most powerful mage in this brave new world! Soon, he and his mother are caught up in the schemes of deadly intrigue, and it’ll take both his mage power and gamer wits to come out on top!

title: Appetite
description: Dohoon can’t find a reason to live. He hoped to get a fresh start at his new high school, but things are no different—the bullies make fun of his limp and no one wants to be his friend. Then one night, he runs into a classmate, Aji… Having seen something he shouldn’t, the two make a deal: Aji will protect him for the time being, but when he turns 20, Dohoon will have to pay up.

title: Save a Female Assassin
description: The ordinary courier Daniel saved a wounded girl killer who was in a coma on his way home. Facing this unpredictable and ungrateful killer, can Daniel keep himself alive? When destiny makes them come together, the door to a dangerous yet exciting world of killers has opened.

title: Intercept
description: A new love is coming to Yoon Seo, who is tired of love!

title: Seasons' Cafe
description:
On Jeju Island is a café called ‘Seasons’ Café’. While working at the cafe, a questionable series of events comes to Yoon Yeonghyun.  
  
Even though he’s too jaded to care about the café, a miracle happened and a savior appeared. Although, there’s just one problem… It’s the exact guy who Yeonghyun dumped and ran off on in the past…!  
  
Between both the lack of customers and the breakup, will Yeonghyun be able to manage work and love?

title: My Silent Girl
description: Hu Yimeng looks handsome but actually likes cute things, Zhang Luoyu is a holy girl on the surface, but she speaks with a strong northeast accent, and she is not a cute girl at all but a decathlon fierce girl! A handsome female cosplayer and a Sanwu beautiful girl painter, the contrast between the two is hilarious and anxious daily love story.

title: Dingji Fanpai Dashi Xiong
alt_titles: Rebirth of the Top Villain History's Strongest Martial Brother
description: For the first time, Yan Zhaoge has the equipment of a full-level boss. The second crossing, before the development of the martial arts civilization, was like a person who was used to playing the hell mode and was suddenly thrown into the simple mode. Don't be too cool! But is this plot wrong? I am not the protagonist? But the villain Gao Fushuai who is competing with the protagonist?

title: Princess, Please Stay Away From Me!
alt_titles: Gongzhu Dianxia Qing Li Wo Yuanyidian A
Your Majesty, Please Keep Away From Me
description: Women? It’s fine to play with them for a bit, but as for those sacred vows professing eternal love? Heh, I’m sorry. I won’t believe a single word! Especially if they’re coming from the mouth of a beautiful girl… That’s what I used to think. However, after I transmigrated one day and was bedded by a certain loli princess, I… seem to have changed.

title: Transfer Student Storm Bringer
description:
Ju Ingong (which literally translates to *main character*) has been terrifying all his schoolmates in every school he has been so far. He has one extremely scary face type and whoever lays his eyes on him thinks he is a BAMF (bad ass). Although… is he really?  


---

title: The Snake Demon Wants to Flee
alt_titles: The Snake Demon Is About to Escape
description: An extreme two-sided war of romance between a flirtatious snake demon that claims to fuck the gods VS a righteous but cold Daoist who only knows how to fight! Due to an unexpected mishap, the Snake Demon King could only bond with the (weird) righteous genius. This story about how the Snake Demon King tries to undo the bonding while trying to figure out how to take back his throne, but loses his body and mind in the process.

title: With All Kins, Have No Pity
description: Zhou Yun knows that servant Yin Jun, is the Zhou family's most loyal dog. Then, after his death and upon opening his eyes, he found out that not only was he the captive of the step-son who took his position as son of the first wife, he was actually reborn into the body of a good-for-nothing son! A loyal dog becomes mad???

title: The Obsessive Male Leads Want to Eat Me Alive (Promo)
description:
I possessed someone in a depraved adult BL novel and met the young obsessive male lead (Top). After being bullied by the bottom for years, he turns to a darker path in his adulthood and becomes the crown prince, indulging in imprisonment, obsession and all sorts of heinous adult past-times. Hmm… Then if the bottom never bullied the top, it would have a happy ending, right?

—

For the bottom’s happy future, I met the young obsessive male lead top… and he was super cute?!
‘Oh, my heart. He’s like a furry baby predator.’
My baby, I shall protect you!
I fed, raised and even introduced the insecure obsessive male lead top to the bottom.
‘Big Sis, I don’t like that bastard. He’s disgusting.’
Of course the bottom was hesitant at the beginning, but the two ended up a little closer. I left with peace of mind. I hoped that my favourite character would lead a happy lives with each other, but, despite my intentions-
A few years later, I heard that an obsessive male lead was sweeping through the battlefield looking for me.

—

With a height reaching almost 190cm, shoulders as wide as a wild beast and black hair with the scent of blood, Sislin held my waist with a look in his eyes akin to that of a freshly captured beast. 
‘Annette is tiny.’
Red eyes tinged with madness turned towards me.
‘But I’m not.’

—

Heinrich undid my ribbon with his bright red lips. Swish - I could hear the thin cloth rub against each other as it came undone.
‘You promised not to leave me behind.’
Purple irises with a hauntingly beautiful smile.
‘What kind of punishment should I give… to a naughty child that breaks her promises?’

—

He was a stranger, the man who ‘proposed’ to me with countless slaves caged up behind him.
‘It’s a present. You wished to raise a smart pet, after all.’
All I did was raise some boys for a happy ending, but these obsessive male leads want to eat me alive.
Why?
What happened…?

title: Demon King's Rules x Witch's Covenant
description: Warning! An association of valiant individuals formed by the villainous demon lord and the rebellious witches has surfaced! Through casual methods of operation, they will turn the definition of justice upside down! By committing crimes across dimensions, they will ultimately snatch the halo of the main characters away from the hands of pesky humans!

title: God-Level Takeout Man
description:
(Adapted from the novel: “God-Level Takeout Bro”, also known as “The Almighty Urban Takeout King”)  
  
How did a famous TV anchor end up in a car accident? Who was the mysterious singer with the heavenly voice that appeared on KTV? What trauma was it that caused an innocent young woman to suddenly pull out a gun and shoot someone? Who is the person wearing a golden robe behind all these incidents? Read on to find out what really happened!

title: The Duke's Daughter Is Going on Strike
alt_titles: The Princess Is Going on Strike From Now on
The Princess Is Going on Strike
description:
Aeryl Frey Brixia had lived all her life hiding behind a mask.

She was shunned by everyone including the father she craved affection from because of the ugly mark on her face that branded her a monster.

At the end of her miserable life, she was falsely accused of selling military weapons to the enemy nation and sentenced to execution…

The blade of the guillotine dropped and everything went black.

The next time she opened her eyes, she was in her room again as a young girl.

This time, she was determined things will be different. She will no longer be a puppet. She will no longer be manipulated.

And the first thing for her to do is to cooperate with the two officers leading the investigation against her father

title: I'm a Scarecrow
description:
'Can you buff me?'

Monaka, who looks like a top-tier experienced player at a glance, offers to form a party with White Jack, who's a returning player of “Lunatic Online”, but…

'Don't step on that.'

'Ack!' 

'Take a potion.' 

'Hack! Haack!' 

'I'm sorry… I couldn't click on the potion.'

Get to know the noob, White Jack, Monaka's character, and the other guild members.

'We're getting married, so change genders, Hyung. You lost earlier at rock-paper-scissors.'

The chaotic life of Lunatic's Netkama*!

(This game is set in the virtual game “Lunatic”, which is based on the online game “La Tale”.)

(Please be aware: Due to the nature of this series, this work purposely uses incorrect spellings for a sense of realism.)

*TL/N: Scarecrow can also mean 'puppet/figurehead'.
*Netkama is a term for when a male uses a female character online and hides their true identity. The original author, Kimma, also wrote the novel, “Netkama Punch!!!”.

title: Red String
description: The story of a boy and girl whose lives were one day entwined by red string. Literally.

title: The Genius Murim Fitness Trainer
description: Ganghyeok is ruined. His gym business is failing and there's no way he can pay off his debts. But one night, while reading his favorite author's latest webnovel, he gets sucked into a world of martial arts fantasy and wakes up as a child monk in the Shaolin temple. There, he must apply his knowledge of modern fitness to survive their strict training, juggle the friends and enemies he makes along the way, and find a way to get back home.

title: The Beast Within
description:
Ray and her older brother Hayes are driven out of their home as their household falls apart. Hoping to find shelter, they arrive at an ominous castle covered in bloody red roses located in the middle of nowhere. This is where Ray meets the castle's mysterious host Clodan—a dark, beasty man possessing dangerous charm and even more deadly secrets. Within the enclosed walls of a remote castle, there is no reason or logic left as Clodan desires innocent Ray.

---
***Note:** This series is being published in English and Japanese prior to its release in its original language, Korean.*

---
**Official Translations:**
* English: [R19](https://www.pocketcomics.com/comic/9321?languageCode=en), [R15](https://www.pocketcomics.com/comic/9028?languageCode=en)
* [Japanese / 日本語](https://comico.jp/comic/9028)

title: Ma'am You Have Been Uncovered
alt_titles: Ma'am, Your Mask Has Fallen Off Again
description:
Mother always said to Qinran: "Your stepfather is from a famous family, your eldest brother is a genius, and your sister is a top student in her high school. You, a country bumpkin, don't embarrass them."

Everyone with status in the capital received a warning from Mr. Juan of the Cheng family: "Mr. Juan's wife is from the countryside and doesn't understand our current situation, and she has a bad temper. In short, everyone should be extra patient."

Until one day, when Master Juan was investigating a certain big boss, his men fell into a confused silence while looking at one of the waistcoats of his sister-in-law who claimed to know nothing…

title: Your Letter
description: In return of helping out a bullied girl, Yi Sori becomes a target herself. Feeling hurt and alone, she moves back to her father's house. She seems to be having trouble fitting in with her new classmates but then she finds anonymous letters that help her cheer up as it guides her through the school, sharing the writer's own nostalgia.

title: Demonic Master of Mount Kunlun
description:
The True Heavenly Demon served as the young leader of the Demonic Cult for 100 years because his father, the Cult leader, lived a long life.
However, after inheriting the Cult Leader’s position, which he did not desire, he died after just one year.
But when he woke up, he was now a baby!
He was abandoned on the roadside, but he was picked up by a Taoist from Kunlun, a sect belonging to the justice faction.
That’s when he became Jung Gwang, the youngest pupil of Jung Jabae.
As he died of natural causes, he didn’t have any grudge.
He was more curious about a life with warm relationships among people instead of a bloody one.
He couldn’t enjoy his previous life because he was busy cleaning up his father’s mess, so shouldn’t he live for himself this time?
But he’s now a child. After entering Kunlun, he must at least make sure he won’t have any regret before the final moment.
Under his influence, Kunlun is gradually changing.
Taoism? That’s none of my business.
Demonic way? I’m a little sick of it.
The story of a turbulent life in Murim of the reborn True Heavenly Demon.

title: 500cc
description: 'Sang-eun' is greeted by a pretty sunbae, 'Jian', who she meets in her first university class! When Jian leaves momentarily during their freshmen welcome meeting, Sang-eun follows... But while comforting the upset Jian, she ended up confessing?!

title: Peace Restaurant
description: Chef Sua, with her unrivaled culinary skills, doesn't just rule over Peace Restaurant, Seoul's most peculiar eatery -- she weaves harmony between cosmic enemies now seated as tablemates. The tension in her restaurant simmers not from culinary rivalry but from the precarious peace among patrons from warring dimensions. Will Sua's culinary diplomacy be enough to maintain this balance, or is her restaurant destined to become the epicenter of an ultimate showdown?

title: Hammer Gramps
description:
‘Why do my dreams have to match this family’s wallet?’ Magician wannabe named ‘Tan’.
After mining for 50 years, he finally succeeded in gathering up money for Magic School’s tuition fee.

70 year old grandpa joins Magic School!

But… rather than being just a magician, my body has become stronger?

title: BABY
description: December 1, 2043 AD. The mysterious lifeform BABY invades Earth and takes control of a number of human hosts, parasitising them. The possessed bodies metamorphise into monsters called ‘Organos,’ which slaughter a great mass of humanity in a series of bloody massacres, bringing mankind to the brink of extinction. Thereafter, December 1 comes to be known as ‘Extinction Day.’ While battling an Organo, Elettra, the protagonist of the story, finds that her left hand has been infected by BABY. However, aside from a throbbing pain in her hand, nothing about the rest of her body changes. Elettra begins to search for other survivors, hoping to solve the mystery of BABY…

title: Only I Shall Be Immortal
description:
In the Heavens or on Earth, only I shall be immortal! In the vast Divine Lands, at the western border, upon the recommendation of his best friend, he began walking on a path he had never thought possible.  
  
 The Cloudlink Sect, as the ‘Final Path’ of the 7 main sects of the Divine Lands, on their sacred disciple acceptance ceremony that happens once every 5 years, took in a single 5th generation disciple who had a beggar-like bearing.   
  
With the gates of cultivation opened wide for him, will this bright and mischievous child be able to mature into a powerful Immortal that rules the world? Please find out in - Only I Shall Be Immortal

title: Good Night, Liang Xiao
description:
“I fell in love with you at first sight. I’ve been in love with you for such a long time! Finance dogs doing overtime together fell in love overnight!   
Liang Xiao “ Senior, you are the one who is destined to be loved by me."

title: Day 100 of My Sister's Disappearance
alt_titles: Mèimei Xiāoshī de dì Yībǎi Tiān
description: I killed my younger sister and managed to get away with it. But on the 100th day after her death, something strange happened…

title: Rom-Comixxx!
description:
It’s called Erotic Comic Department so it may cause some misunderstandings, but the misunderstandings are right!!  
Sangyeol, the club president who loves erotic comics, and Sunjeong, who loves every type of comic except for erotic comics.  
And to protect the existence of the club, they work together in making an erotic romantic-comedy school comic!

title: Cherry Boy, That Girl
description: What happens when you take a good, long look and realize that your boyfriend is prettier that you? And what happens when you go to a high school with so few girls that you're considered a goddess? But then again, your pretty boyfriend is also attending the same school…

title: The Overpowered Cop
description: Specialized in excessive suppression, police officer Shin Hae-soo gains the ability to go back 60 minutes in time. On the day his father passed away, he instinctively knew. This was a murder disguised as a suicide. Determined to catch his father's killer, Hae-soo becomes a detective. Then, one day, following a mysterious accident, he suddenly gains a supernatural ability! As he solves criminal cases and tracks down the organization, a massive shadow begins to emerge bit by bit!

title: Death to the White Ferret!
alt_titles: Death to the White Ferret Weasel Sheep!
description:
"I waited a thousand years. As a weasel."

Leonie, the princess that destroyed a country, is given eternal punishment. Not as a human... but as a weasel! One day, after a thousand years of hiding in the forest, a boy who understands the words of a weasel appears! He even confessed to it being his first love! But Leonie, whose love cells had dried up... 

"After a thousand years, I can finally die!" 

I only intend to use this innocent boy! Chanjae, a hopeless devotee who fell in love with princess Leonie, a mage who became a weasel, as well as a figure he longed to meet from a history book he had read.

title: My Virtual God is a Teenage Girl
alt_titles: My Virtual God is a Teenage Girl
description: I just thought life was unlucky, but it turned out that a high school girl was manipulating my life and bullying me

title: My MMO Wife Is a Cultivator
description: All it took was one meet-up, a simple meet-up with his MMO wife and suddenly he was dragged into the world of urban cultivation. Thus he believed that he would begin his journey as a cultivator in this urban world and live a life of overbearing dominance. However...why is life as a cultivator so hard and so impoverished? How come everyone's still playing the MMO even though they're piss poor? Wait a minute...playing the MMO is part of cultivation too?!

title: I'll Change the Fate of Being Executed
alt_titles: I'll Change My Fate to Be Executed
description:
This was my first night as a crown princess. A dagger in my hand, stained with my husband's blood. The heated blood of a man who has always treated me harshly. I pledged never to be his wife if I were born again. After being executed for treason and conspiracy of the Crown Prince. Another opportunity has thus been provided. I'm attempting to reverse everything. Even if I have to be a crazy spirit!

"Wait, what the-? Why are people complimenting me?!"

"I will make you my princess if you refuse to be my wicked bride."

What's the matter with the crown prince, who used to be harsh to me?

---
As the winner of Crown Prince Karzhan's fiancée competition, Veniti Lysie should be happy, but everything changes on their wedding night when she's framed for his murder and executed. After returning to the past, she decides to lose the contest so she can live, but she keeps advancing! She bumps into Karzhan as they're both running away from their duties and learns that there's more to their past than she thought. Can Veniti save herself, or will she be unable to escape her execution?

title: Born Perfect
description: Standing next to my crush was this perfect guy. I was passing by when he made an offer… is this guy serious?

title: Where the Clouds Stop
description: Time is a strange thing. The person she killed the day before yesterday had already begun to rot. But when she came home the next day, they were standing in her house, smiling at her. What is happening? The doctor told her if she took the medicine she would wake up! Where am I? What is this? Who are you?

title: Hot and Cold
description: It was a summer when even breathing was hard due to the heat. The air conditioner in An Kyungsoo's room was long broken. As a replacement, his landlord sent him a humanoid air conditioner that is all the rage overseas, taking form in a handsome male model. As soon as it is turned on, it became so cool that he cuddled it, but he can't help feeling a bit weird. As he was cuddling this temporary replacement of his AC, he pressed a button located "somewhere" and it opened it's eyes. Turns out that not only did his humanoid have a handsome face, he also has a kind personality and a gentle voice… This totally perfect AC's over friendliness gradually included skinship, as well as relieving his sex drive that has been long stifled by the heat..

title: The Fresh Start of Elegant Beauty
description:
Millennia-old Chinese clothing culture intertwines the fantastical lives of two girls.

One day, Bai Tang, a freshman in university, accidentally "picked up" a girl named Zhu Lian, a quirky girl dressed in Tang dynasty attire who valiantly claimed to be from over one thousand years ago... From that moment on, Bai Tang's ordinary life takes a wild turn.

title: Fate Makes No Mistakes
description: Eunjae’s been losing sleep from some decidedly disturbing dreams: some kind of otherworldly being keeps having its way with him in the middle of the night. His days are filled with strange coincidences and hours of his day just seem to disappear… Then one night, a man in a strange mask saves him from being hit by a bus. Turns out the strange man isn’t a man at all, but a goblin. It isn’t long before Eunjae’s forced to accept that according to the world of the afterlife, he’s dead. And there’s only one being now that can protect his body and soul from slipping away: San, the goblin.

title: Prejudice
description: The star of a male idol group who has a cold demeanor, who also has no control in restraining himself. And an idol with a harmless and childlike cutesy personality on cameras and is able to stay in character, but is an complete opposite off-stage… They're sworn enemies that hate each other and somehow ends up having to act like a couple with each other as fan service?! Yup, Looks sweet!

title: Jipchak Namjuga Nareul Juingongeuro Mandeureotda
alt_titles: The Obsessive Male Lead Made Me the Female Lead
Obsessed Male Lead Made Me the Main Character
description:
Welcome to *The Adversary of the Evil Dragon*!
I am a guide for travelers who have come into the novel.
You have become 'Tiarozeti Isol'
To return to your original world, you must complete the novel.

"You have to be happy… I will miss you."

Somehow, I fell in love with the male protagonist, Lexion Spero, and ended the story by dying for him, but strangely, when I opened my eyes, I was still in the novel...?

"The new main character is Tiarozeti Isol."
However, this time, not only have I become the main character-

"-Titi, choose me, not this damn fate."
Unlike the previous life, Lexion's obsession for her begins!

---
After Tiarosetti learns from her Guide that sacrificing herself to save the male lead, Lexion Spero, and following the plot is the only way to return to her world, she desperately carries out her role. But confusion strikes when she wakes up where her story starts, and Lexion saves her before he should. The Guide states she's now the main character, and Lexion isn't the male lead! Can Tiarosetti find her way home, or will Lexion's inconsistent behavior shackle her to his world forever?

title: Is the Demon King a Healer?
description:
"If you are a healer, just heal at the back."

This is the mindset of everyone in this world. Healers have been most unappreciated among combatants. But the strongest man, the 'demon king,' who is the target of everyone, was a healer?

*Note: There is a chance that "Is the Demon King a Healer?" will back as an official series in future.*

title: Hundred Years Game
description:
“Your game ends here.”  
  
Every 100 years, in a competition that will grant them more than one wish, there is only one final winner.  
  
The young boy Han Si-Joon jumps into a fierce battle while risking everything to save his family.

title: I Am a Living Beast in the World of Cultivating Immortals
alt_titles: I Am a Living Beast in the World of Cultivating Immortals
description: In order to speedrun the game and win the mysterious grand prize, I used every possible trick in the game and ended up offending the entire world! What? The mysterious grand prize is actually transporting me into the game world? Seriously!

title: Sealed Lips
description: She was exploited, mistreated by her stepmother and stepsister. They were scum, insane, crazy. She became a tool for her sister's success. After dying from a painful death, she was reborn. In her previous life, she had a fiancee that she admired and loved for a long time, but he was cold and felt disgust toward her, which brought her pain and made her hopeless. But now, facing him again, she said while smiling: « Let break off the engagement, I don’t want this marriage anymore! » However this man wants to stay in a relationship with her— « Shang Zhen, you were already my person the day you were born. You want to break up? That’s too late »

title: Why Did Men Stop Wearing High Heels?
description: Kim Manseok is your average, everday guy but with one particular hobby: his love for high-end high heels. He owns his own personal blog and is known as a woman online but one day, his identity is exposed! Will he be able to continue his life as an ordinary salary man?

title: Monarch of Death
description:
"What can I do with a body that only has bones?"

Karnak had become the king of death using the forbidden secrets of "necromancy," but he began to reminisce the pleasures of the flesh, in sorrow of his bony body...

"I'll turn back time itself!"

After a long period of research, he succeeded in using the time regression spell and regressed to the past with his right hand, Baros.

"Uh... young master, I think the past has been changed."

This is the death king's project to straighten out his twisted(?) life!

title: Surviving a Fantasy Adventure Comic
description:
When the author of Hero Lee’s favorite comic, Adventure King, starts killing off major characters and wraps it up with a huge letdown of an ending, he sells every book in disappointment. 

Right then, Hero receives a strange text from the author himself that all characters must endeavor to survive, and those who don't do not deserve a place in the story. After being asked if he would like to try it for himself, Hero wakes up inside the comic as Background Villain #3. 

Will he be able to survive the story and see it to the end?

title: Mystery
description:
'Mystery' is what Garam thinks of the creature he accidentally awakened from a deep, long sleep. Her beauty is bewitching and it catches his attention ever since their first meeting. Enthralled by her, he ultimately falls in love with Mystery.  
"Will you be my muse?"

title: Little Prince
description: Short story about a prince who met the captured son of the enemy's general.

title: Bye bye
description:
On a rainy night, Seoyoo stood on the Mapo Bridge to end himself. A minor without a driving license, Seonghyeon is surprised by Seoyoo and gets into an accident. Seonghyeon paid 3 million won to Seoyoo to lie about it to his older brother. But Seonghoon doesn’t believe Seoyoo and Seonghyeon’s words and, while he’s trying to unravel the truth, Seonghoon falls for Seoyoo’s charms. Seoyoo, who has low self-esteem, believes that someone like Seonghoon wouldn’t fall for someone like him.

“It’s more stupid to think that you’ll receive a proposal from a sex partner…”

“I… I really don’t know where to go though. I guess I am crushing on you.”

Will Seoyoo and Seonghoon find happiness?

---
- [Original Webtoon R15 <RidiBooks>](https://ridibooks.com/books/3093000401)

title: High School Return of a Gangster
alt_titles: High School Return of a Gangster
A Gangster Became a High Schooler
I Am a Gangster Who Became a High School Student
description: A gangster dies saving a bullied teen — and wakes up in the boy’s body. Living the school life he always dreamed of, he vows revenge for the boy’s suffering. But when the boy's long-time crush begins to suspect he’s not who he says he is, things start to spiral...

title: Zhiran Chenghun
description:
A young girl plays truth or dare with her friends one evening and gets challenged to ask the first male that walks into the bar to give her his belt.  
This evening was meant to be her bachelorette party after making a deal with her adoptive mother. The deal they made was that if she agrees to an arranged marriage, she will get to continue her studies. In order to keep her education going, she sacrifices herself, but little did she know the identity of her fiancé…

title: Cinderella Chef
description:
I will conquer your stomach first and then conquer your mouth with my excellent cooking skills.
I can always handle both evil husband and nasty mother-in-law.
As for those ill-disposed sisters-in-law, just let them be jealous!

I’m not going to play with you~

title: Teenage Swordsman
description: ‘Quest Hero’ is a VR online game that has received attention worldwide. One day, one of their named users, ‘Harang’, was pulled into another world by an unknown sword-like object. No matter how hard he tried, he wasn’t able to log out and was even attacked… Not only did he feel ‘real’ pain, he also meet the ‘real’ Yuta instead of the npc Yuta. Would Harang be able to complete the ‘7th Quest and return back to the real world safely?! The journey of the ‘Adolescent Warrior’ who fell into an unknown world!

title: A Painter Behind the Curtain
description: Ian is a painter with a natural-born talent, but his love for painting is soon lost after being forced to work for the cruel and greedy Bardi family. No one knows that he's the genius behind the beautiful works of art that the famous family claims as their own. That is until one day, when the wealthy merchant Raymond comes for a portrait and his interest in Ian is piqued… Can Raymond help him to see the beauty in the world again? Or will Ian's true talent forever remain unseen?

title: Magician Rebirth
alt_titles: 重生魔术师, Magician Rebirth, Rebirth Magician, Reborn magician
description: Ai Xiaoming, who was framed to death, was reborn in the year 2008. When he was reborn, he planned to perfect his life and find his enemies …

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury - Nideaneng's Suletta x Miorine Shorts
Dial Again
description: Noah whose body became immortal, starts a job as bodyguard in underground society. Meeting such a strange man inside (that underground society?), he steps into the unknown world. A new BL drawn by Nanohana Boys’ author, Bbyon, who gained popularity at Comico!

title: Your God Sent Me You
description:
She believed he was a heartless husband and treated him badly. 

Until he was hunted down as a traitor in order to protect her.

‘My dear wife. Please stay safe.’ 
Her heart was torn to pieces as she knelt before his severed arm. But this time, she could see that his body was clearly intact. 

“Your highness? Why are you crying all of a sudden?” 

She had returned after losing hope, to the first night of their wedding three years ago. 
“You must be nervous about your first night. Don’t worry. I didn’t plan to spend the night with the princess anyway.” 

“Why? Aren't I your wife? Forget it, let’s undress and head to bed.” 

“…Your highness?” She tugged at his arm with force. 

'This time, I will certainly protect you. Even if I die trying, I would rather die with you. Not as Nirszeg’s princess, but your wife, Agnes Arpad,' she pledged with determination.

---
After her husband, Duke Arphad, and his knight sacrifice themselves for her, Princess Agnes flees King Sebastian's murderous conquest, only to be captured and suddenly sent three years back in time to her wedding night! Faced with reliving the past, Agnes is determined to save herself and the duke from the king's clutches. With nothing but a daring new scheme and a fierce resolve, can this formerly pampered princess rise up to become the Arphad family's royal savior?

title: Nightmare Building
description: Returning home after having his collegue slip something in his drink, he had a weird dream about having sex with a stranger. Hasung has made a new business contract and finds out it's the same guy from his dream… He ends up confused when he keeps having sex dreams and confronts Ren asking about who he is. Ren ends up being an incubus named "Nightmare."

title: Poisoning the World
alt_titles: Du Bu Tian Xia: Te Gong Shen Yi Xiao Shou Fei
Queen of Poison: The Legend of a Super Agent, Doctor, and Princess
description: She is an ace agent, the queen of medicine and poison. Sweet and adorable she looks; resolute and cunning she actually is. She is half an angel and half a devil. When she travels through time and stays in an orphan girl’s body, will she rewrite the history? “I quit the marriage with this coward girl. To my surprise, she is so shrewd and eloquent! How ignorant I am!” Some lord regrets. “She is such a hottie!” Some prince sighs. “

title: From Acting Genius to Top Idol!
alt_titles: From Acting Genius to Top Idol!
description: “The brilliant actor, famous Baekhyun, before he dies, encounters a miracle and travels back in time! But there’s nothing free about time travel. His lifespan ends at thirty, and he has only ten years left. To return as an actor and stay alive, he must become an ‘idol’! Experience the journey of the talented performance star as he rises to the top ranks of idols, an exciting story awaits!”

title: Golden Waltz
description:
Ice Dancing: A figure skating event that can be explained by its name, dancing on the ice. Because ice dancing involves two people matching their breathing to dance together, their partner is very important.That's why they call meeting the best partner a so-called "miracle." Yoon Hong Joo is uncertain if she would be able to recognize it if it did occur to her. At present, she has her hands full dealing with a partner who is moody and slacks off, that is, until the mysterious Kim Hye Sung comes to her assistance.

___  
- [Alternate Raws (Kakaopage)](https://page.kakao.com/home/53083564)

title: Shine and Sweet
description:
Suen, 19 ans, universitaire, est en couple depuis 1 an avec Shen Luo, designer, quand elle découvre de manière inattendue un secret incroyable, il a de super pouvoirs…une comédie douce et pétillante.  
  
—  
  
After dating for one year, my boyfriend suddenly confessed that he had a special ability! Not only does he use it anytime I ask, he can also be summoned at will!  
  
A cute yet forgetful girl and a handsome boyfriend with an ability—what kind of sweet and troublesome love story will unfold?

title: I Don't Need a Proposal
alt_titles: I Didn't Save You to Get Proposed to
description: As usual, I was going home from work. But suddenly I had an accident. Before I left, I heard someone’s voice in my head. [I’m Elsia Artise, please save him, please, you can do it!!] That was the last thing I was aware of before fainting. After opening my eyes, I found myself in a different place… This place was in a novel that I read before that accident happened! I already possess the body of Elsia, who will die as soon as the novel begins. There’s only one thing I can do to survive. It was following Elsia’s request and distorting the original! First, it was to save Ixion, her unrequited love, who was assassinated and killed. “Prince, I am here to warn you of the assassination that will take place today.” I succeeded in saving him by using information from the original, I just want to live a comfortable life that has nothing to do with the original. Until I received a letter… “I owe you a lot of favors. I hope you will come to the capital immediately because I want to repay this favor with a marriage.” Ixion’s marriage proposal, which I thought was the end of our relationship. “Prince, I didn’t save you so you could propose to me?” Can Elsia peacefully refuse his marriage proposal and return to her comfortable life?

title: His Royal Highness is Hungry
description: My name is Qiu Kui, and I time-traveled! From the wonderful modern world to a poor, ancient village where there's no internet, and even electricity! Worst of all, my parents drowned themselves and my younger sister is physically challenged, and not forgetting the fact that our family is also in debt. I mean, seriously, how can I live under these circumstances! Thank goodness I time-traveled with a bag of groceries and daily necessities… But has anyone time-traveled with items like these? This is ridiculous!

title: Digimon Adventure
description:
Seven kids at summer camp are unexpectedly transported by 'digi-vices' to a colorful and enigmatic world. Lost and alone, they are befriended by small digital monsters, Digimons. The kids and their Digimon partners quickly become inseparable, and the strange creatures guide their human friends through the wondrous DigiWorld, protecting them from the hordes of evil Digimons. The group soon discovers that some of the giant Digimons they encounter are not evil Digimons but good Digimons gone bad. A dark power is corrupting even the most gentle of Digimons by embedding Black Gears into them, turning them into vicious monsters. Creating chaos and destruction wherever it goes, the evil power threatens all of DigiWorld.  
  
As they try to find their way back home, the seven kids are drawn further and further into the mystery. Through teamwork and trust, they help their newfound Digimon friends digivolve from 'monsters in training' to giant champions that must save the DigiWorld from the powerful evil intent on destroying it.

title: Level 999 Goblin
description:
The protagonist Kim Chulsoo works his ass off for a living as a manual laborer in real life and by grinding for and selling items in a game.

He finally gets the chance to switch to a hidden class, hoping for that one big shot in life…!

But the hidden class turns out to be... a Goblin Summoner?!

title: The Summoner: Apocalypse Rewinds
alt_titles: Lord of Summoning! When Anomalies Descend Upon The Human World
God of Summoning! When Mutation Descends Upon The Mortal World
Lord of Summoning When the World Changes
description:
As the apocalypse descended, game monsters bled into the reality, unleashing a bloody massacre that pushes Blue Star’s civilization to the edge of extinction.In humanity’s final moments, time rewinds for him—returning him to the day it all began.
Now, with a single burning purpose, he will hunt down the hidden mastermind behind the catastrophe, defend his homeland, and ensure the tragedy never repeats.
The apocalypse looms. The countdown has begun.
In this deadly race against time, he must seize control—and turn despair into his game of vengeance.

title: Such a Cute Spy
description:
North Korean spy Anna Rhee must seduce the South Korean math genius Donggu Park and return with him to North Korea!  

[Official Korean (Lezhin)](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/cute_spy)

Note: Life of Ruin is a pen name of [Lee Hyunmin](https://mangadex.org/author/45b9fad4-8bde-41bd-893f-5b4bf5a652b5)

title: Thumbs Up, Level Up
description:
My name is Um Jicheok.
An ordinary hunter assistant of the Republic of Korea.
I have been barely living, dealing with monster corpses.

But one day, after my grandpa appeared in my dream,

‘Receive thumbs ups and get awakened.’

Grandpa, is this why you gave me this name?
Thumbs up is the point!
Get thumbs up, buy skills and level up.

‘The unprecedented awakened’
The story of Um Jicheok, the strongest hunter who gets stronger through thumbs ups.

title: The Final Boss Became a Player
alt_titles: Final Boss Volunteers to Become a Player
Ultimate Boss, Volunteering to Join the Player Ranks
description: A recently launched game in its closed beta testing phase fell victim to a mysterious AI hack, transforming what was once a tranquil and delightful adventure into an inescapable pit of monsters. Influenced by this AI, the final boss gained sentience and swore to defend its own virtual realm, determined to reclaim the game's former glory!

title: The Emperor's Strategy
description:
Born into the royal family, every move by Chu Yuan needs to be cautious; constantly afraid that one moment of carelessness will cause him to lose everything. After ascending to the throne at 18, not half a year passes before civil strife erupts in Yun Nan. Though the intentions of the old guard at the royal court are not exactly the same, all are waiting to see how the new emperor will resolve this situation.  
   
Unexpectedly, before this incident comes to a head, the King of Xi Nan, Duan Bai Yue, had already personally commanded troops to battle a few thousand miles away. Not half a year has passed when peace has already been restored.  
  
With sparse moonlight shining into the royal palace, Chu Yuan stamped a wax seal on a secret letter, and had it sent urgently to Yun Nan 800 miles away – this time, what will we be asked for in exchange?  
  
Brush marks can be seen on the back of the paper, almost as if it can be seen how angry the young emperor is when he wrote this line.  
 Duan Bai Yue spread out a piece of paper slowly, and replied deliberately with one word.  
   
You.  
  
[synopsis taken from translator's site: <https://pucari.dreamwidth.org/>]

title: Yours to Claim
description: Nothing crazy ever happens to Jooin. He’s just your average college student, keeping his head down and flying under the radar. Yahwi, on the other hand, is drop dead gorgeous, super popular…but also kinda mean. So why has the campus heartthrob taken an interest in a total nobody? There must be an ulterior motive…but it’s hard to care when faced with those killer looks. Will Jooin become a slave to his desires? Or perhaps he’ll become the master himself…

title: Lion Heart
description: Tattoo artist Woosol angrily goes on a vacation after he finds his (now ex-)boyfriend of 5 years cheating on him. His destination is a tropical destination with stunning beaches and palm trees but he finds something more interesting in his time there.

title: Two&Too
description: Ah, the young and in love. Read to see where Shen Nantang's lighthearted university endeavors take him!

title: I Took Away the Tyrant’s Virginity
alt_titles: I Took Away the Tyrant’s Virginity
I Took Away the Tyrant's First Time
I Took Away the Tyrant's Chastity
description:
“After all, a man must have big breasts… … .”

The man's chest visible through the sunlight is very handsome... … .
for a moment. Who are you naked next to me?

"Emperor… … your majesty?"

Unbelievable.
Unintentionally at a masquerade ball
It seems like he spent the night catching a tyrant.

“How dare you take away the emperor’s virginity and leave?”

No, last night was an agreement!

“If you knocked me down on the bed, you will be responsible.”

yes?
The look in your eyes that silently urges me to answer... … .

“I will take responsibility for the book, Your Majesty.”

I curled my tail.
___

- Official Raw: [Kakao Page (mature)](https://page.kakao.com/content/65232803)
- Official English: [Tapas (mature)](https://tapas.io/series/i-stole-the-tyrants-virginity-mature/info)
- Official Japanese: [Piccoma](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/155020), [Piccoma (mature)](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/175309)

title: Excuse Me, But The World Will Be Gone For A While
description:
If the Earth is destroyed, who do you think would have caused it among us?  
This is the 18 year old male and female unfortunate survival game.  
That day, the world looked at us and told us to die.

title: Evergreen
description: One day, on his way to work, Seojin meets a wounded man who turns out to be the person hehad dreamed of that night. Mystified by the event, he takes him home. Who is the strange man who seems to be running away from someone? And who is the person named "Helio" that the man keeps mentioning?

title: Magic Scroll Merchant Zio
description:
In the fantastical medieval land of Irok, magic is wielded by magicians and those wealthy enough to afford to purchase it.  
The merchant, Zio Oh and his young assistant, Bono sell magic scrolls but their success (and safety) are not guaranteed…

title: Sunbae, Don't Put That Lipstick On
description:
The boyfriend of the senior you like is marrying another woman? Mr. Perfect's fluttering heart and an all-out romantic attack with the intent of revenge! The push and pull of an exciting romance between a straightforward, handsome, sexy, and serious junior at a cosmetics company and a mature woman who doesn't see younger guys as men.  
  
  
  
- [Official Indo Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/she-would-never-know/list?title_no=2426)

title: Almight Network
alt_titles: Wo De V Xin Shi Waigua
description: When Fang Lin bought a new smart phone, he found out the phone app gave him a special social network with the immortals. In a dog eat dog world, Lin is taking a stairway to heaven with this special social network.

title: What Happens When You Mess With the Original Novel
alt_titles: What Happens When You Tamper With the Original Work
The Consequences of Messing with the Original Work
description:
You know, sometimes you just gotta do what you gotta do to survive. Getting hit in the head with a liquor bottle? Yeah, no thanks. If booting my deadbeat dad to the curb is what it takes, then so be it. Who cares about being the 'good' daughter when your skull's not intact?

And honestly, this whole 'rebuilding the family and getting back home' plan? It started with a bit of divine intervention, or so they say about that land. Next thing I know, bam! I became Countess Validus, blessed by the gods and apparently a real estate mogul.

Then the "just trying to make my life easier" snowball started. A little business here, a tiny push towards the Magic Tower there (hey, free research!), pointing out a few flaws in some laws (someone had to!), maybe tossing a sponsorship bone or two (art can be an investment, right?), and... why not, a school? Knowledge is power, and all that jazz.

The thing is, I wasn't exactly expecting a fan club to spring up. My staff acts like I hung the moon. Then this one lord suddenly wants to be my shadow, apparently my word is gospel now, and someone even called me the hope of the nation! And the proposals? Don't even get me started. All I did was try to not get hit in the head again and maybe, just maybe, find a way back to my own couch. Why is everyone acting like I'm some kind of saint? It's beyond me.

title: Enoch
description: “Chimeras” are people that have been infused with animal DNA in order to give them superpowers and abilities, however society doesn’t favor them so they live in fear and rejection. Our main character, code name “01”, works as a mercenary who happens upon an old acquaintance. He’s then given a job to protect and transport Enoch, a girl who is sought out to be the perfect “material”, to the borders of Canada.

title: Try Crying Prettier
description:
Damie finds herself waking up after a one-night stand with the most notorious playboy in the capital, Acard Valerian. The night was an impulsive decision as she had her heart broken just the day before, when her first love, manipulated by her heinous step-brother, cruelly told her to “find someone else.”

Fed up with all of this, she decided to seduce the incredibly handsome man who had just arrived in the North, Acard Valerian, who is not only incredibly beautiful, but also an utterly lustfilled bastard.

“Your face is pretty when you cry.”
It seems he has chosen the wrong opponent and is now playing with fire.

title: Shell
description: TaeHee, who wants to become beautiful, and DoHa, the cosmetic surgeon. Can their outer shells make them happy?

title: The Savior's Time
description: Your younger sibling is dead. After the funeral, you find out that they had been meeting people in a secret group chat app. Everyone in the chat room is a suspect.

title: Countdown to Graduation
description: With graduation just around the corner, a straight boy was confessed to by his classmate. Faced with an unexpected confession, Wu Ying first refused. But the other party keeps persisting to be close to him “in this way”…

title: Charlotte’s Letter
description: Charlotte, a bookworm who dreams of becoming a writer, starts her new job as a maid for Lord Matthew and his sister Lady Anna, the last remaining members of the Parvens family. Her ability to write catches the attention of them both. Now, for Matthew, she is tasked to write letters pretending to be him, while for Anna, she must secretly report on Matthew's day-to-day affairs. Putting pen to paper has never been so difficult! What will become of Charlotte when the Parvens family's twisted deceptions come to light?

title: It's a Misunderstanding That I'm Dating the Villain
description:
In my 24th year of reincarnation, I was living a peaceful life as an insignificant knight commander barely mentioned in the original story. Content with my uneventful existence, I avoided meddling in the main plot.

But during an undercover investigation, I accidentally stumbled upon the villain in the act.

"Sir Clara, have you been waiting for this opportunity? Clever, very clever."
"No, no! I swear to the gods, I have no intention of exposing your identity!"
"Hah, and what reason do I have to trust you?"

That’s how the shadowy mastermind decided to keep me under his watchful eye.

"Here, take this. I bought it just for you."
"Why would I accept this...?"
"The flower matches the color of your hair. And now that I see it, it suits you perfectly."

Wait... why does everyone think the villain is pursuing me out of affection?
This was not part of the plan!

title: The Genius Blacksmith's Game
description:
Hyeonsu's life took a turn for the worse when a fire left him covered in burns, his father in the hospital, and their family smithy in a blaze. But just as he was losing hope, his friend had an idea: If he can't be a blacksmith in real life, why not try it in Ares, the AI-powered virtual reality game? 

With a bit of luck, he might make enough money there to pay for his father's hospital bills. 

With so many irons in the fire, can Hyeonsu rekindle the flame of his passion and rise from the ashes?

title: Goong
description:
Monarchy ended long ago in Korea, but there are still other countries with Kings, Queens, princes and princesses. What if Korea had continued monarchism? What if all the beautiful palaces which are now only historical relics were actually filled with people? What if the glamorous royal family still maintained the palace customs? Welcome to a world where Korea still has the royal family living their lives! But for Che-Kyung, a high-school girl, this is a tragedy, since she has to marry the prince who turns out to be a total jerk!  
  
The final volume (Vol. 28) of Goong is a collection of short stories that ranges from the past to the future of the main story.   
(comiXology)

title: If History Was a Group of Cats
alt_titles: If History Were a Bunch of Meows
If History is a Group of Meows
description: The comic is based on the 5,000 years of Chinese history and stars twelve adorable cats. Based on the Twenty-Four Histories and the mainstream views of historians, the cartoons are witty and humorous, while truly entertaining in their presentation of historical knowledge.

title: No Mercy from the Reborn Lady
alt_titles: There Is No Forgiveness From the Regressed Lady
There Is No Forgiveness for the Regressed Daughter
description:
Cassia Hall's life shatters when her brother's lover—her best friend—betrays her. In a twist of fate, she returns to the past and vows revenge, but keeping her brother from falling in love with the villainess proves difficult. As hope fades, an unexpected hero arrives: Grand Duke Cain, who was executed for treason in her past life. As she uncovers the truth about their intertwined fates, Cassia realizes he may be the key to altering her destiny.
___
Cassia, stripped of everything by her brother's lover and best friend, resolves to rewrite her twisted fate by traveling back in time. Her first objective: prevent her brother and the villainess from ever falling in love. Yet, she quickly discovers that altering human emotions, even with the ability to manipulate time, proves impossible.
In a moment of despair, a hero from the North emerges – Cain, the emperor's half-brother and a grand duke condemned to die for treason. Upon meeting him, Cassia instinctively understands: this man holds the key to reshaping her destiny, mirroring her own past struggles.
Now, Cassia must navigate the intricate threads of fate and love, with Cain at her side, to reclaim what was taken from her and forge a new path forward against all odds.

title: The Genius Actor Who Brings Misfortune
description: “You’ll get hurt if you’re close to him.” “I don’t know why he’s so unlucky.” “Yeonjae, I’m scared of you…” “Lee Yeonjae,” avoided by everyone as if just being near him beings misfortune. Even he thinks it’s weird. Why do bad things only happen around me? I wonder how it feels to live a life of being loved and not hurting those around me. But, was even wishing for that too much? —Bam!! After an accident, I woke up in a strange place facing a mysterious entity. “Strange. You should’ve died according to your fate, so why are you still alive?” One truth I learned after meeting that entity is, [I can avoid misfortune if I act like someone else.] To survive, I have to become an actor.

title: Back To School
description: Chiwoo’s got issues. Upon returning to school after the “incident” last year, he vows to keep to himself and stay out of trouble until graduation. Easier said than done: his bad boy reputation has made him the talk of the school, and Kyujin - class president and model student - won’t stop being friendly. Trouble arrives soon enough in the shape of Jihyun, a tattooed hunk from Chiwoo’s dark past. It’s gonna be a tough year…

title: HANA
description: Hana is a child who is only known by the public as a genetically modified mouse. This is the story of what happens after Hana escapes from the lab.

title: I Became the Tyrant's Doomed Wife
alt_titles: I Became the Tyrant's Time-Limited Wife
description: I found myself in the body of the empress married to a tyrant emperor—one doomed to be poisoned and die. The bigger problem? After my death, this tyrant loses his mind and ruins the entire empire! With only two years left to live, I worked tirelessly to rewrite my poisoned fate while keeping the emperor’s sanity in check.All seemed well… until: "Leah, why don’t you ask me if I’ve eaten breakfast anymore?""Because you’re healthy now."That afternoon, he collapsed after drinking his wine. With a smile. *Wait… did you intentionally poison yourself?!*

title: How to Survive as a Villain on the Verge of Death
description:
A villainess with 44 days left to live. 

I've possessed the princess Eve. I have a limited life span, but I cannot die in vain. I stopped committing evil deeds in order to survive, and I succeeded in making a deal with my fiancé who hated me. 

Why does the crisis never stop? 

On top of that, the mastermind (*contract fiancé) who was supposed to be my business partner has started to obsess over me, and the male lead suddenly wants to protect me, leaving the female lead behind? I just wanted to live… 

Where did this world go wrong? 

---
She wakes up as Princess Ivnes von Albion, a notorious villainess destined to be killed.

But dying a meaningless death? No way. She decides to stop her vicious behavior and even manages to strike a deal with the fiancé who once despised her.

So why does the danger keep coming?

Now the supposed “business-only” contract fiancé, who’s actually the hidden mastermind, starts obsessing over her. And the original male lead suddenly wants to protect her instead of the heroine?

All she wanted was to survive.. Where did this world start to go wrong?

title: Fei Xi Yan Xue
description:
Liang Xi comes to the capital to visit her father who is a high ranking Nobel for the first time!  
As if that wasn’t enough, she also has to deal with half step sister’s hatred and now somehow gets dragged into the turmoils of the inner palace?!  
Just what will become of Liang Xi?!

title: Every Step Is My Reflection
description:
After being sold to slave traders, Mirelys had no will to live on anymore…until her mana leaked out and caused an explosion in the building. An imagery of a mirror from her house shattered, that's when all her past life memories flooded into her. Mirelys Arjurine was a villainess in a book, and was also ruthlessly killed by the main protagonist, Duke Allen Chastein.   
  
The Emperor of Emeriyal arrived at the scene only to see a ragged girl with hollow eyes.   
  
"Papa, I want that thing." A boy with smooth, jet black hair pointed his finger at Mirelys.  
  
With no hesitation, the emperor agreed to his son's request and brought home a castaway. Will Mirelys ever attain a true family bond she never had in her life, or does she have different intentions…?

title: I Became the Successor of the Martial God
alt_titles: I Became the War God’s Successor
description: One day, I suddenly became the protagonist of a game. However, the more you look at this protagonist... the more you'll sigh. He's got the worst stats, the worst talent and zero connections. But still… You have acquired [Heavenly Martial Physique]. You have become the master of the [Martial God's Tome]. “So what? I’m the ultimate veteran player!” He's not just a veteran player— he’s a full-blown obsessive maniac. Thus begins the legendary playthrough of a hardcore veteran!

title: Trouble With The President
alt_titles: Fall in Love With my Trouble
description: After a failed one night stand, the bold woman secretly left, leaving behind a provocative message with a lipstick mark. The man, however, swore to find this woman. The next day, all the major media outlets released a 'Wanted' notification at the same time. Tong Tianai was on her phone when she saw the notification, which made her face turn completely red. "Qin Jinyang… the Qin Association President…" Because of that lipstick mark, she had become the Chief Executive.

title: I Reincarnated as a Parenting Story Extra
description:
I possessed a mere maid in a Northern Duke’s household — just a background character in a romance-fantasy novel. 

A lifetime job with stability, as long as I keep my head down and stay out of trouble? Sounds perfect! I planned to save up quietly and one day escape for a peaceful life. But then...

“You went to… a Korean cyber university?”
“How… how could Annie know that…?”

The heroine — reincarnated from modern Korea — found out I’m a transmigrator too!

Now I’m stuck to her like glue, constantly in her spotlight… and worse, her overprotective brother starts to take notice.

“You want to quit your job? Who said you could?”

The male lead of this childcare story—the one I thought would ignore me — has become obsessed!

Annie’s chaotic survival tale as an ordinary extra in a not-so-ordinary childcare drama begins!

title: Salt and Pepper
description: Min Hu Chu, a guy who lives to eat and So Geum Ji, a girl who eats to live. They’re both childhood friends but with complete different opinions on the purpose of food. Focusing on these two characters, introducing a story that includes recipes to make alone(?) and their campus life(!) The author of ‘Second Lead Complex’, Soi’s beginning of a new series!

title: TandB
description: The daily life of Tiana and Breathe, Set as girls in Korea

title: Sister, What Can Be Wrong?
alt_titles: Jiějiě néng yǒu shé me huài xīnsī
description: The wealthiest female CEO x The rising female director. What will their story unfold ? What's her secrets buried in the past? Who is the "substitute" that others keep talking about? Will they be able to solve all their misunderstandings ?

title: Eternal Covenant
description:
Since childhood, Ian Gloucester believed he was cursed to live as a destructive monster. He carried out his days in faithful servitude to the savior who plucked him from the depths of hell, Cardinal Brixton. But, one day, a mysterious man named Soleite Winkler, who shares the same "curse", tells him that this power is actually... magic. As a result, Ian begins to question everything he's ever known. The two reluctantly form an alliance to expose the corruption that lies within the Kingdom. Despite his loyalty to the strict and religious Cardinal, Ian is drawn to Sol and slowly begins to fall for him. For the first time in his life, he isn't alone. As Ian finally learns to embrace who he really is, will he also embrace the newfound lover who set him free? *(Source: Tappytoon)*

title: The Cold President's Little Cutie
alt_titles: Bóqíng Zǒngcái De Zhuānshǔ Xiǎo Nǎi Bāo
The Fickle President's Exclusive Cutie Pie
description:
My mom is the naive and sweet protagonist in a tragic romance novel. My mom is also the substitute lover who escaped from the overbearing President. And I? Well, I'm the five-year-old genius hacker.

Gu Chu, a brilliant hacker, finds herself reborn in a tragic romance novel as a five-year-old cutie. Her mother is the unfortunate heroine, her father is the blind-to-reality President, and they're surrounded by scheming relatives, a two-faced aunt, and various villainous women.

Determined to protect her mother, little Gu Chu stands tall and begins to fight back. What harm could a five-year-old possibly cause? She just wants to protect her mommy and maybe inherit her President daddy's billions along the way.

title: Sir, Don't Show Off
alt_titles: Young Master, Please Don't Show Off
description:
Lin Xiu, a playboy, was reborn in the body of someone in a different world. He could copy others' abilities when he touched them? That's cool! His road to intimate interactions with others started there... 
"**Wait! My sister-in-law, don't beat me! I didn't flirt with other girls. I was doing something serious!**"

title: Breaking News: I’m Married to the Grand Duke?!
alt_titles: [Breaking News] Marriage with the Grand Duke
description:
Revel Ivela became a journalist to expose corporate corruption, but in the end she reincarnated within a novel.

To make matters worse, she became a bankrupt-novelist who had lost everything due to her father's gambling! Revel Ivela begins her life as the "Reporter Bel" as she investigates the corrupt nobles until she is left with no choice...
"I approve of the union between the two of you."
After she had received a unilateral annulment notice from her fiance, that same day Revel impulsively spent the night with a stranger. The next day Revel remembers nothing of that night, yet she receives a marriage certificate sent by none other than the emperess herself.

title: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer
description: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer is a wuxia novel by Jin Yong (Louis Cha). It was first serialized in Hong Kong in the newspaper Ming Pao from 20 April 1967 to 12 October 1969. The Chinese title of the novel, Xiao Ao Jiang Hu, literally means to live a carefree life in a mundane world of strife. Alternate English translations of the title include Laughing in the Wind, The Peerless Gallant Errant, and The Proud and Gallant Wanderer. Another alternative title, State of Divinity, is used for some of the novel’s adaptations

title: Wood and Snow
description: A collection of art and short comics of Minami's OCs, Wood and Snow.

title: The One
description:
Cane Lele was born into the fashion industry. Her mother, Ye Fei Yi, was Taiwan's top model, and her father was also a model, until a tragic airplane crash left Lele without parents. Therefore, it is no surprise that Lele hates the industry, thinking it superficial and unnecessary.  
  
Raised by her maternal grandmother, Lele reaches seventeen before she is sucked in by her mother's sister, Ye Fei Hong, a fashion model agent (and former model), convinces the reluctant Lele to model. Lele had been adverse to the whole idea, until she sees a photo shoot of popular American model Angus Lanson, and she begins to see modeling as an art form.  
  
When Aunt Fei Hong's magazine editor invites Angus Lanson to a meeting of all the top fashion ambassadors, Lele is invited to meet him and is very curious. She does not know that Angus' twin elder brother, Eros Lanson, is secretly accompanying his brother. This obviously leads to confusion and is the start of a charming story of Lele's goals: fashion in NYC, becoming a top model, and love?

title: The Demon King Cheat System
description: One day, countless dungeons suddenly appeared in the world, and human beings ushered in the "dungeon era". The boss of the abyss-rank dungeon, Adesalai, was killed by human players using despicable means. Unwilling, he was reincarnated in a weak and useless player also accidentally opened the exclusive boss system, using the system to conquer the dungeon and become the special ability of the dungeon master, he started his own road of revenge.

title: My Older Sister Is the Main Character
alt_titles: My Elder Sister Is the Protagonist
My Big Sister Is the Main Character
My Sister Is the Main Character
My Sister Is the Protagonist Though
My Older Sister Is the Protagonist
description:
Reincarnated into a novel, she tries to protect her sister from being imprisoned by taking her place. However, the obsessive duke fixates on her instead, flirting and even threatening to confine her. Strangely, she finds herself drawn to him despite her protests.
___
When Helena was reborn into a novel, she was forced to grow up knowing that her sister was the main character and that a terrible life awaited her… unless Helena could stop it from happening. By learning how to take care of family matters, Helena took her sister, Callisto’s, place as the head of the house, allowing her to live her dream of being a knight. But she now finds herself hurtling towards both the terrible fate once meant for Callisto and the man who makes it come to pass.

title: Rebirth of Legendary Doctor
description: Because of the making a mistake in the capturing soul operation, doctor Xing Aofei was banged by a car and died, but he got a chance to be reborn because of the accident. Unfortunately, once again, Xing Aofei is destined to only be a doctor, and he is also included with the so-called Wrap You Up to the Human’s Pinnacle of Life System’s various pits? The road of Xing Aofei ’s rebirth, is destined to be a sad path……

title: Demoniac Two Heroes
alt_titles: The Twin Swords of the Sima Clan
description:
"The head of our family is foolish person," thought Cha Wun-Yeop, the servant of the respected sage.

A foolish master, who plays around by his mistress, Chang Sanmi and an upright man, Beom Seosoo, stand in stark contrast as the prince.

“Beom Seosoo, with his upright character, is the most formidable person I've ever known!”

Caught stealing, he faced severe scolding and disgrace, but Cha Wun-Yeop ends up aiding Beom Seosoo against Chang Sanmi's plot.

"But as the eldest son of the Kamseuk Clan, I can’t just stand by and watch."

"I will grow stronger than I am now and deal with of them all."

Determined to seek revenge on Chang Sanmi, Beom Seosoo sets out to gain strength, while Cha Wun-Yeop leaves the Seol family to follow his own path.

"Living life once, I’ll no longer be an orphan or a servant, but live as a transcendent being."

"Freely and with pride, I will roam this vast world."

Practicing his unique martial arts through mystical methods, Cha Wun-Yeop becomes a master, getting closer to the mastermind behind the plot at Seol Kam-Seuk's House.

One day, Cha Wun-Yeop and Beom Seosoo reunite. Cha Wun-Yeop is astonished to see if Beom Seosoo's martial arts.

“As the eldest son of a prestigious family, you use this kind of swordsmanship!”

The man who once criticized him was now walking the same path of martial arts as him!

title: The Thousand Faces Actor
description:
"What do you think people will end up calling him?"

Someone asked. But no one had an answer.

A transcendent being has appeared in the world.
And a new chapter in film history begins.

title: Secretly Cultivating by the Demon Cult Leader's Side
alt_titles: The Evil Cult Leader Hid Beside Me and Watched Me Practice Secretly
description: He Yun, who was sold to the Jiuyou Demon Palace as a child, survived safely thanks to being ‘diligent and obedient’—and a great cook. But on a calm, uneventful day, the Demon Sect Leader suddenly “ahem ahem” took him by force!

title: Infatuation Unwanted
alt_titles: Extra Doesn't Want to Be Overly Obsessed
Extra Doesn't Want Too Much Obsession
description:
Plonked right into the world of a novel she once read, Sophie simply wishes to live out the rest of her quiet life in the background. Who could ask for a better place than the sleepy village of Pellun? And it was wonderful, peaceful... until knights came in searching for Lady Amelia. The Amelia Cedric from the most powerful noble family in the Rohatin Empire?! Wait, it can't be... I'm just an extra!

title: Musketeer
description: The King’s royal guards, comprised of warriors who possess the top skills in all the nations. People call them the "Musketeers". If a Musketeer serves Korea’s king, they are revered and honored. From all the Musketeers, there were three at the very top that received praise from everyone. A Korean-style heroic action manhwa about the three Musketeers.

title: Princess Naihe Is Too Black-Bellied
description: Chu Qitong thought that he would stay in the palace all his life and play with those shady schemes, until he met Ning Zhuangyan. That girl in a red dress broke into her heart unquestionably like the scorching sun, letting her know that besides rights in this world, there is another thing called love. Chu Qitong: In the past, I did all my tricks to win the throne for Aze, but now I'm doing everything I can to exchange your peace for the rest of my life. Ning Zhuangyan: My sweetheart is a beautiful girl who can overwhelm the country and the city. She can't give me a phoenix crown and Xiapei, and she can't ride a tall horse to marry me, but that day at the Golden Luan Hall, she held my hand with all eyes on her. The moment I saw her, I knew she was better than thousands of good people in the world.

title: The Last Passage
description: Hell? Far from it. After all, isn't this what you wanted? After choosing to end his own life, Huiseo Yun awakens adrift on a wooden raft in a bleak, desolate ocean. Attacked by a monstrous creature that defies reality, he questions if it's a dream... but his instincts scream otherwise. Just when all seems lost, he is rescued by a mysterious woman who resembles a grim reaper. As he catches his breath, Huiseo asks: am I in hell?

title: The Saintess Returns as a Villain
alt_titles: The Saintess Returns as a Villainess
description: Beatrice has lived as a saint for 10 years to prevent the disaster of the empire and win the love of her family. One day, her place as a saint was taken away by a girl named Lina Cumbell with her black hair... “I will kill you, your family, and all your followers.” She is framed as a warlock and executed. Beatrice's second life began like that. “Even if this life becomes a villainess… Lina, I will avenge you!!” The new life of Riche, a true saint who decided to become a villain, is redrawn.

title: Coffin Jackson
description: Roman is no ordinary mortician. He works for a vicious gangster by getting rid of his victim's bodies. But betrayal, unexpected partnerships, and a shocking acquisition may bring Roman closer to death than ever before.

title: Crossing Code
description:
They call her Saintess, a mystical and beautiful holy figure that guides the nation. Suddenly one day, her body has switched with a flippant, crude womanizer! To conceal the emergency, she’s sent to hide at a college as a normal student. But how is that possible with a scheme to get rid of her and all these hearts aflutter at school?!
