title: Growing the Seed of Evil
description:
Astraea, the world's strongest swordsman,
One day, she realizes that she has reincarnated as a character from a novel.
Not just any character, but the one destined to be killed by the final boss, the evil god...

While hiking, she saves a child from some thugs and discovers that this child is destined to become the evil god in the future.

"Well, if that's the case, should I raise him well and completely reform him?"

She decides to take the child in and raise him, but...

"Astraea, where are you going? Are you going to meet that guy again?"

The child who she saved becomes an obsessive man who follows her around, monitoring her every move.
**Somehow... it feels like she might have raised him wrong.**

(Source: Kakao Page, edited)

title: Heartthrob
description: Being the new kid in school is never easy. Especially not for a wallflower like Eun-jae, who has spent most of his childhood in and out of hospitals because of his weak heart. Now, his only wish is to live and experience life as a normal high schooler. Unfortunately, the high school experience for him not only means attending classes and making friends, but also getting bullied for looking like an omega. But things aren’t all bad. Not when you consider his regular encounters with Jin-hyeon, the popular kid in school. As accidents and coincidences keep bringing them together, Eun-jae realizes he had met Jin-hyeon a long time ago… even if the latter doesn’t remember. And although a throbbing heart has always been a cause for concern, Eun-jae discovers a heart can throb for sweeter reasons too.

title: Me and My Professor
description: Yali Han must live with the handsome professor because of her financial problems. At first all was well, but one day an unexpected thing happened…

title: Marshal, Your Wife Ran Away Again!
alt_titles: Shǎo shuài nǐ lǎopó yòu pǎole
Shao Shuai Ni Laopo You Paole
Sergeant, Your Wife Ran Away Again
description: Gu Qiang Zhou returns to the town where her father lives only to avenge her mother. On the course of the story she meets a marshal with whom she has a complicated relationship.

title: The Reincarnated Armed Escort
description: Although an old porter has shown great determination and loyalty to his escort agency, he is never given the chance to become an armed escort due to his bad leg. But after sacrificing his life to keep a priceless treasure from a group of bandits, he is reborn as the 22-year-old Li Zhenglong who died 30 years ago! Now, in the body of the fourth young master of the Heavenly Dragon Escort Agency, will he finally realize his dream? Or will Li Zhenglong's terrible reputation ruin it all?

title: Secret Player
description:
The world fell into the grasp of an Artificial Intelligence system that changed reality into a game map consisting of monsters, items, and NPCs. Only the ‘Master Player’ is capable of turning this game-like world back to normal.

When Na Sanggi’s family was murdered by an unknown Player, a mysterious voice told him that he must become a ‘Player’ in order to bring his family back. Thus begins Na Sanggi registration as a Player to uncover the truth of the incident and save his family!

title: The Producer's Second Life
description: If you had the chance to start your career over again, what would you do differently? Junsu faces this question when he suddenly goes back in time to his first day at work as a rookie producer. After ten years of getting his ideas stolen by a scummy senior producer, Junsu gets a chance to change his professional fate. And better yet, he has all the skills and memories of the Junsu of ten years later. Will he be able to avoid his previous mishaps and make his dreams come true?

title: Daughter of a Superstar
alt_titles: I Became a Top Actor's Daughter
description: Rumin is an acting prodigy with a Newtube channel that often goes viral. As it happens, she is also the spitting image of her favorite A-list actor Hajin Jeong. A shocking turn of events reveals that Hajin is actually Rumin’s biological father. The cold-hearted actor reluctantly takes her in, but pointedly vows no affection. However, as Rumin’s raw talent shines, Hajin finds himself becoming an unlikely mentor. Having long fantasized about Hajin being her father, can Rumin finally make her dreams a reality? This series contains strong themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: Informal Romance
description: Informal! And their special love begins

title: One Day
description: This city is awfully big. Although we may not know each other, we may have brushed past each other on the road at some point. Perhaps we share a love of reading the same book and listening to the same song, or perhaps we’ll talk about love with an expiration date of one day. But on this day, we saw each other’s true selves, and that will forever be engraved on our lives.

title: Final Fantasy XIV - SAMNK (Doujinshi)
description:
SAMNK, known as 사몽흑 in Korean is a fan-made webcomic for Final Fantasy XIV–drawn and written by 므다닫 [@zkxmfhkej](https://twitter.com/zkxmfhkej/).  
  
The web comic features the slices of life in Final Fantasy XIV with Samurai and Monk as the main protagonist pair.

title: Deep
description:
Season One: Minwoo is a shy college student who becomes entangled in a whirlwind relationship with notorious bad guy Yujin. Minu believes in true love, but Yujin only believes in one-night stands. Yujin reveals his deepest secret to Minu in order to seduce him, but things take an unexpected twist when Yujin develops feelings for Minwoo. Will Minwoo and Yujin be able to overcome their differences and find true love?

Season Two: After imprinting with Minwoo, Yujin, who wishes to only be with Minwoo, ran into the biggest obstacle. “I don’t want this anymore.” It came as a sudden that Minwoo started to distance himself and reject Yujin. In the meantime, there seems to be a new sparkling romance for Minwoo…?
(Merman ALERT!!!!)

title: The Man From Hell
description:
The Demon Emperor Of the universe is reborn and has returned!
“I am a demon. I enslave gods and immortals! If you don’t succumb to me, I will make you by force!”

title: Records of the Southern Mist House
description:
In the mysterious female boss Lu Mansheng's spice shop, occurs many unquestionable fantastical stories of the vicissitudes of life.  
  
Dans le mystérieux magasin d'épices de Lu Mansheng, se déroulent de nombreuses histoires fantastiques et incontestables sur les vicissitudes de la vie.

title: I've Become the Devil's Master
alt_titles: I Became the Master of the Devil
description:
“Give me the strongest Norma.”

She became a villain who blackened the male lead in a devastated novel. Having already regressed nth times, she decided. She would save the male lead trapped in the bas**ent and escape. Finally, his identity was revealed and a happy ending was just around the corner. What do you mean abuse? She fed and dressed him herself, so she only had to run away.

“If you throw me away like this…”
Redian, who became the crown prince, held her hand tightly.
“I’m going to chase you to hell, master.”

The male lead seemed to be too immersed.

---
After countless reincarnations as doomed villainesses, Ms. Transmigrator gets her final chance to rewrite fate–as Ciani Felicité, the woman who drove the male lead to madness! Instead, she plans to rescue Redian, the male lead trapped in her family’s Subterranean Castle, nurture him, and then escape. But why is his intense gaze fixed on her? With so much attention, can she really navigate this reincarnation to a happy ending?

title: I Became the Childhood Friend of the Obsessive Second Male Lead
alt_titles: I Became a Childhood Friend of the Obsessive Sub Male Lead
description:
Rieta, staying with a military ducal family, decided to help Noel, the second male lead, by coaching him on winning the female lead’s heart. After years of guidance, Rieta was confident Noel would succeed. However, in a surprising twist, Noel complimented Rieta instead, misapplying her advice. Flustered, Rieta realized her friend had taken her words to heart, but not in the way she intended.

---
Born with memories of the novel *How to Survive as an Ordinary Lady*, Princess Rietta Lise is next in line for the throne of the Kingdom of Lise. But after being sold to the empire by her father, a king who lives in luxury and pleasure, she enters the ducal Mayer estate. Upon realizing that Noel, the duke’s second son, is the sub-male lead of the novel, she’ll try to repay the duchy’s favor by making him the real male protagonist!

title: Yue Chen Yin
description: She is the reincarnation of the Sea Dragon’s daughter, born with extraordinary wisdom and talent. Yet because she was born in troubled times, suffered tragedy and became an orphan. After ten years of grinding, she finally cultivated an exceptional set of martial arts. With XiaoHun sword in hand, she begins a journey to seek revenge, even disguising as a man to enter court. At first, revenge was her everything. Until she met those two equally exceptional men…

title: Saving My Class 8 Seniors
alt_titles: Zheng Jiu Wo De Gaoyi Ba Ban
description: After the high school entrance exam, rebellious Qingjun Cao and her friends, Jingjing Ceng and Qing Yan, were lucky enough to attend the same high school… and be in the same class. In it, she meets the gentle Jia Lu, the full of life Qiyang Si, and the cowardly Haiwen Tong. Each person is hurt in their own way: misunderstood, lonely, not acknowledged… this is her spring, as well as his. Luckily, I have you this time.

title: From Simp to Billionaire: The Rise of a Divine Tycoon
alt_titles: Budang Tian Gou Hou, Wo Chengle Yi Wan Shen Hao
I Became a Billionaire After I Stopped Being a Simp
After Improperly Licking Like a Dog, I Became a Billionaire
description: Once a typical simp, Lin Xin’s life takes a drastic turn when he’s dumped and inherits a divine financial system—starting him off with a whopping trillion yuan! But there’s a twist: he can only spend this fortune on women. Stuck with this bizarre stipulation, Lin Xin is forced to navigate an unconventional and thrilling path to wealth and power, transforming from a mere simp to a legendary tycoon.

title: My Multiple Personality Girlfriend
description: Appearing in front of Gu Bei, who had lost his memory, was the beautiful girl Su Mo who claimed to be his girlfriend. However, Su Mo had other personalities in her body. The problem for Gu Bei is that if he wants to date normally, it seems he has to conquer all the other personalities?

title: In the Bizarre Invasion, I Took Over the Body of the God of Death and Became the King
alt_titles: In the Bizarre Invasion, I Took Over the Body of the God of Death and Became the King
Weird Invasion, I Took over the Body of the Grim Reaper and Became the King
Strange Invasion, I Took Over the God of Death and Counterattacked to Become the King
description: Su Mu is reborn and re-enters the “Apocalypse” system, facing deadly situations where Death itself comes knocking and an array of demons and eerie creatures awaken to threaten the world. Against all odds, he turns the tables and becomes an unstoppable king, joining his teammates in a desperate fight to reverse their fate and ignite a nationwide awakening and evolution.

title: Punk Dunk Funk
description: Lee Sandeul, 23, is an excellent worker at a farm during a working holiday in Australia. He attends a charity party where under the influence of alcohol he happens to have a one night stand with the son of the president, Mo Lahn, 21. Ever since then Mo Lahn gets desperate to look for Lee Sandeul for which Sandeul even escapes back to Korea but can he escape Mo Lahn’s obsessive madness?!

title: Captain’s Duel
description:
Im Dajun, who was abandoned by his family and now lives as the leader of a runaway group, one day brings Yeonwoo home by chance. Yeonwoo then commits a violent rampage in Incheon. Standing in the way of Yeonwoo, who was trying to kill a chaebol chairman for revenge, is Yoon Gamin, a top student hopeful. Meanwhile, Nahwajin of the School Authority Protection Bureau watches the situation with interest...

The first crossover in the Blue String Universe! A massive showdown featuring the main characters from [True Education], [Study Group], and [How to Fight]. This is a record of an intense battle not covered in their own stories.

title: Dinghai Fusheng Records
description:
Amidst the Silence of All Magic in the Divine Land, Mara is about to descend.
In order to prevent the destruction of the Divine Land and save all the people, Chen Xing, the last exorcist, embarks on a journey to release the sealed spiritual qi of heaven and earth — only four years remain.
The road ahead is full of thorns. Watch this cute little koi Chen Xing and the moody and grumpy Protector Xiang Shu, together with numerous people with distinct personalities in their group, working together to turn the tide again and again!  

---

[Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/qianerbai)  


---

title: Best Fairy Doctor
description:
When I asked my master why he wants me to study medicine?   
He said "Because you can't find a wife normally these days, if you have these skills, you can get into touch contact with girls"   
I mean what a pervert, right? But I too am a pervert, as I usually peek at my Senior sister while she takes bath. But I am also a Gentlemen who treats girls with care, that's why they call me A Gentleman Pervert. In this way, I learned superb medical skills and came to city to find a wife…if possible a Harem?

title: Go Deok-chun's Food Truck
description: Junho inherits a food truck from his late uncle Deokchun and sets out on a journey across the country to make the name “Go Deokchun” famous through his cooking. Starting with Sehee, a chaebol heiress, Junho becomes entangled with women who have their own stories in each region. While all of them fall for him, Junho’s heart is captured only by cooking! This is a nationwide food truck romantic travel story featuring the charismatic Junho—”Let’s start business!

title: My Messy Marriage
alt_titles: Marriage Is Too Noisy for Me
description: "I'll do this marriage." Woo So-ran, a dedicated lawyer, is the only person who's aware of Baek Kang-ho's contract. She agreed to marry him instead of his runaway bride. “You'll regret it.” Well, I don't make decisions which I’ll regret in the first place. She entered the tiger's den with confidence. Even though her life has been quiet and boring so far, a messy and secret romance begins. Will I regret this marriage?

title: Zero Degree Lover
description:
A teenager who has already passed on, relies on the power of drugs to continue protecting the 10 years long love he holds for his lover, the consequences he faces is the inability to reincarnate.  
  
Knowing the truth what will his girlfriend decide to do?   
  
'When you reincarnate hurry and find me!'  
  
A love story of infatuation and bitterness, fully released!

title: My Beautiful World
description:
A girl who is afraid of people. And then approaches a small light. New Release of the author of Pinocchio.  
  
Every person in this world changes, it could be anything like their desires or personalities. What if behind a person smiles hides a dark malice or depression? How will someone react to it if that person have the ability to see their hidden facade? This is the story of a girl who can see the ever changing form of humanity as she dives into the mysterious realms of the unknown and real life.

title: Jintian Ni Louxianle Ma?!
description:
Mini is a "Scum Detector", and her latest job is from a rich girl who wants to test her boyfriend's loyalty. However, her boyfriend, Zhao Yueming, is a straightforward gentleman, and Mini's usual methods don't work on him. This is a bit tricky for Mini, who is used to dealing with scumbags regularly. This game of tug-of-war between the womanizer and the one who understands them best is about to begin. Who will fall into the trap of love first?!

[Official Japanese Translation](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0003618)
[Official Korean Translation](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12220642)

title: Jealousy Inducers
description: I want to have a romantic relationship. For them to achieve that, they ask help from those who trigger jealousy!

title: Love Me for a Lifetime
alt_titles: Qing Wo Yi Sheng Yi Shi Lian
description: Ah-Li is the apprentice of the Daoist Qiu Jue and they roam the country exorcising demons. It is not until they reach the capital that they hear of a suspicious ghost mansion owned by the seemingly richest man in the capital. Just what is going on in there? Ah-Li will not rest until she finds out (though her master really doesn't want to bother about it).

title: Tian Xing Yi Shi
description: In the world of demons where humans are simply an old folklore…

title: Domestic Wolf
description:
The witch "Lyla" who studies pleasure, buys a rare red-eyed black wolf while looking for familiars so that she could further her research.

Lyla brought the wolf home and fell asleep but then is attacked by a wolf who turned into a man! However, she is able to skilfully subdue the attack...

Join Lyla on her journey as she begins to establish the hierarchy for a bound, but still rebellious familiar!

title: Disciple of the Three Kings
description:
By chaos, the world began to be invaded.

One day, gates suddenly appeared in the world, unleashing monsters upon humanity. The situation brought humanity to the brink of extinction.

The martial world of Eun, the world of magic and knights Einhart, and the world of demons Gehenna became interconnected, and superhumans from these worlds swept away the monsters.

However, they were not righteous saviors.

Under the law of survival of the fittest, the newly emerged Players of Earth were oppressed.

Lee Ro-Woon sought to mediate between the Players and the superhumans from other worlds, aiming to bring peace to the world.

But due to the discomfort of the superhumans from other worlds with his actions and the betrayal of his comrades, Lee Ro-Woon lost everything and fell into ruin. At the moment he was about to give up everything, he became the vessel of chaos and was transported to a sealed world.

There, he encountered three supreme beings.

Lee Ro-Woon becomes the disciple of the Three Kings and rises to rule over everything!

title: Zhaohuan Wansui
description: The Soaring Dragon Continent is a world of summons, you can only become strong if you become a summoner! Yue Yang, an average high school boy, was suddenly transported into this world. When he woke up, he was greeted with a lot of worried faces and found out that he had assumed another person’s identity. Turns out he’s the good-for-nothing third son of the Yue Family, who had just recently drowned himself because of a failed engagement. Unlike the third son of the Yue Family who was useless in summoning, Yue Yang succeeded in making a contract with a summoning grimoire on his first try, even when the other guy failed for the past fifteen years. Others would have a headache making contracts with beasts afterwards, but countless beasts tried to gain favour with Yue Yang instead, acting like a good kid before him.

title: The Top Player Returns
alt_titles: Bei Qiangzhi Huigui De Dianfeng Wanjia
Bèi Qiángzhì Huíguī De Diānfēng Wánjiā
Top Rank Player Forced to Return
The Top Player Who Was Forced to Return
The Strongest Player That Was Forced To Return
description: Demons have invaded the real world, world destruction is imminent!! top player Wang Yan actually inherited the game character’s profession ？？？？ Starting from 0? Can the once peak player save the world and reconquer real life survival game with this ending world as its stage?

title: The way to appeal to the Devil
description: Li Fei, who had to come out to "work" because his mother was seriously ill, was somehow caught up with a super rich boss. Not only was he asked to help the boss with work, but also to accompany him to eat and play? Then, Li Fei discovers that the true identity of his boss is the Devil himself…

title: Help Me, Uncle!
description: With life twisted enough to drive him crazy, Sang Tae is forced to run away at night to get away from a loan shark chasing him. Not having eaten anything at all, he called for help. Did the urgency of his situation show? Finally, a rich man named Yeon Woo appears up and willingly helps SangTae and offers him a warm meal and a place to sleep. Thinking his world was not over yet, Sangtae felt relieved as Yeon Woo offers him to work for him.

title: Starts From Baby
alt_titles: Raising a Child and Falling in Love
description: Kim Jun, who strongly dislikes kids, is contacted by his unrequited love, Min Ji-Hwan. One day, Ji-Hwan asks him to move in together to raise his baby nephew. Jun accepts this suggestion in order to stay close to Ji-Hwan. Now, Jun has to adapt to his new role as a parent and overcome his past trauma to win Ji-Hwan's love.

title: Reveries of the Moonlight
description:
After losing everything to the Vampires, Segun meets the Vampire hunter Silvester to become a hunter for himself. "Welcome to the world of the psychedelic moon."  
  
- Prologue: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YBK3-BhghQM>

title: Touch the Empyrean
description: The Crown Prince of divinity, Chong Hua, had spend all his life living peacefully above the Empyrean until one day Yun Huang, a girl from the Taotie clan barged into his life. He, who had never actually felt the fickleness of mankind gained a great interest in the girl who came from an unknown world, but what comes to them is also dark and full of conspiracies…

title: Guiding Him Patiently
description: Fashion stylist Ji Xun, who travels through ancient times, expects to marry a rich and beautiful woman and reach the pinnacle of his life, but instead he is targeted by a man who stares him down! Is all this a bad debt in this life or an unresolved bond from his past life?

title: I Will Save the World by Eating
description: A 300-pound fat man suddenly gets a golden finger from the heavens and thinks he can change his life. In the end, because of this unfortunate golden finger, he has to rely on crazy meals every day to stay alive. Even if that's not enough, he also discovered that this golden finger made him the queen of the alien insect race. Even if it's a bug race why is it a queen! Do I really have to obey the system? Destroy the Earth?

title: Chronicles of the Lazy Sovereign
alt_titles: The Secret Records of the Supreme
description:
Wi Yeonho, the Radiant Martial Sovereign, is the great martial artist who ended the world's calamity.  

He was a nobleman, a paragon, and a peerless hero...  

"That man? He was a complete and utter scoundrel."

A truth too shocking for the world to know.   The real face of history's greatest hero is about to be exposed!

title: Raiding the Vampire Count
description: Claiming to be the gaming industry’s streamer "Rising Star" Xia Ri. Due to the decline in popularity, he played a popular Otome game recommended by his younger sister, but unexpectedly went into the game dimension. In order to return to the real world, he had to pass through all the obstacles.

title: Let's Do It After We Marry
description: "Marriage in my life is a definite NO!" says Moa, a misogamist. One day, she faces a situation with a naked Geonwoo, her superior who was rumored to be strict and cold. But oh my goodness...... Are you telling me that such a body belongs to a human?! His body was like an art statue, excellent and magnificent, to which Moa forgot her embarrassment and couldn't take her eyes off of it. After seeing Geonwoo's perfect naked figure, Moa experiences a terrible aftereffect, and that was seeing his body whatever she did wherever she was. Tormented by it, a drunk Moa ends up confessing to him one night. "Umm............ Team leader, do you want to try sleeping with me once?" A confession that would never have come out in her right state of mind. Right as her regret came flooding in, a more shocking response came out from him. "I'm sorry but I won't do it unless it's with a woman I'll marry."

title: Bless
alt_titles: The Devil Can't Survive after 90 Days!
description:
One day, Eden falls from the sky. All he remembers is his name and that if he doesn't find the treasure and defeat the 
Demon King within 90 days, he will cease to exist.
With his best friend Coupie, they work together to suppress magic and prevent Eden from disappearing!

title: Lifesaving Romance
description:
An obscure actress named Kim Eun-hong, who alternates between minor roles and extras.

On her way home drunk after being dumped by her boyfriend of nine years, Kim Eun-Hong became involved in an accident with Lee Kang-il, the CEO of LJ Pharmaceutical.

But then Kang-il suddenly asks me to act like his fiancée. You’re giving me a billion won just for getting engaged? Why me?
“I can’t live without Kim Eun-hong.”

I’m pretending to be his fake fiancée to avoid being thrown into jail…

Can Eun-hong be reborn as a veiled French girl with a gold spoon? And will she be able to keep her contract with Kang-il, who harbors a lot of secrets?

A man who dies if he’s not confident?! And Eun-hong’s life-threatening (?) romance act for him!

title: Master of Villains
description:
Mystic World - a virtual reality RPG game.

Beopgyu Lee, the developer of Mystic World, wakes up to find himself in a strange lab which he recognizes as one of the settings from his game. To make matters worse, he is in the body of Han Lee, a notorious villain character.

Find out how Beopgyu survives as Han in the game he create - not as the main character, but as the master of villains!

title: Sperman
description:
After years of frustration, Kim Gidoo is about to have his first time with the girl he loves.  
But then, he's kidnapped by a group of suspicious people, and learns that he's to become a hero thanks to his super-powered sperm…

title: Joseon Fox Scandal
description:
The traditional fairy tale we all know is actually a crime drama about the shapeshifters who fled from the sky!   
  
This story is about a fox sent down from the sky and Joseon’s greatest gisaeng swindler, Choran. Many skillful storytellers turn the gears of fairy tales around to talk about the evil gods and goblins who torment humankind, but let us now start a true story of love that will make even the sky tear.

title: School Foolishness
description: Wang Dabing accidentally picked up a cultivation system. From then on, a wicked cultivation school was born! Geniuses and geniuses were turned into waste material in front of him, and those who bullied him would naturally become a slag . The system comes up and shines! Alchemy draws the Fubu array refining machine learning test, as long as you complete the task, just sing along on the road of pretending to force! Super rewards allow you to hang on to everything. As for the system tasks, the class teacher who arrogantly acts wantonly, kisses the class flowers sought after by the school … System, are you serious?

title: Secret Order
description: A narrow dead end world, in a chaotic era. A piece of rock, is key to the fate of this country, with its shocking secret. Life is harsh, mentoring is tough. A trip to a creek… a heinous murder… are destined to… an ancient world, a heros's tears, the dusk at day's end… Looking back, I believe everything in the world is for the fortunate, and also for those fated to be.

title: Too Cute to Handle
alt_titles: You’re So Cute What Should I Do
description:
Forget "saving face," this is "saved by face!"
Roseny has been masquerading as a boy for years at the orphanage. But when the duke chooses her to be a playmate for his son, it isn't long before her secret is revealed. Instead of being sent back, her adorable complexion results in Roseny being adopted! What will this new future hold for her?

title: Crushing Jade and Casting Pearls
description:
When Ding Hanbai, the young master of the centuries-old jade-carving shop, first laid eyes on his timid shidi Ji Zhenzhu, he bullied him relentlessly, not expecting that Jiangnan could produce someone who would break down his defenses and melt his heart this way.   
They go from being unable to stand each other to admiring one another, but as the days pass, even this admiration begins to evolve…   
A step from brotherhood, a step to special affection, and one more step into a lifetime together.

title: Carnal Karma
description: 27-year-old virgin Eun Chae-yi becomes an overnight sensation when a Hollywood star kisses her at an airport in front of hundreds of fans and cameras. And if that isn’t enough, the next night, a handsome prince of a mysterious country woos her into an unforgettable one-night-stand. But when both these strangers insist that she is their lover from a past life, Chae-yi must figure out what are memories and what are dreams, what is fate and what is fraud.

title: The Savior is Ruined
description: The male protagonist who has cleared all types of different worlds comes to Earth, and he decides to give up his identity as a savior and starts to show off. It turns out that the seemingly peaceful earth is a world designed by the enemy. The helpless male protagonist has no choice but to start resisting under the agreement with the God King in order to have a peaceful life.

title: I Became a Leader in a Wretched Prison
alt_titles: I Became a Dead Character in a Prison for Waste (Promo)
I Became a Pro in a Tragedy Novel's Prison (Promo)
Became a Deceased Person in a Prison for Waste
description:
I reincarnated into a novel… but, hey… What am I supposed to do if I reincarnate in 10 years before the novel begins?

The location: prison. The problem is that even a jungle is better than this place!

After ten years finally passed, I became the top dog in this prison. 

*
“Hey Mint. Cut it out. Don’t go overboard.”

“I have no idea what you’re talking about.”

I became a good-for-nothing leader, but I’m fine with that. That’s a privilege a pro gets. 

“I’ll make you dead on paper, so do me one last favour.”
“I have no idea what you’re on about.”

A golden opportunity was bestowed upon me. 

“If you help me, I’ll release you from prison.”
“What do you want me to do, Master?”
“...”

The chief of the prison asked me, the psycho of the prison, for a favor.

“Make the new guy coming into the leader of this prison.”

It may be called a prison, but in reality, it’s a lawless place. If I can make one man into the leader, I can finally be released.

“But to do that, you need to enter a male prison.”
“...Huh? How can I attach something that’s not there and get in?”

But oh god? The new guy is the male lead of the original novel.

title: Circle Trap
description: 'Noel', who searched and attacked the traitors of the organization, found a man called Kang Jin who referred to himself as nothing but an ordinary homeless person! Even though there were also powerful threats, Kang Jin, the one who ended up fetching Noel's interest, claimed to be unrelated till the end, turning out to be imprisoned in Noel's own officetel… What are the secrets hidden by Kang Jin and Noel's true intentions?

title: Tales Of Herding Gods
description: Daxu ancestors abandoned by the gods-“It’s dark, don’t go out!” The old, weak, sick, and handicapped in Daxu Dilapidated Village picked up a baby from the riverside, named Qin Mu, and raised him with painstaking efforts. As night fell on this day, darkness enveloped the ruins, Qin Mu walked out of the house… “Be a villain in the spring breeze!” The blind man said to him. Qin Mu’s villain is on the rise!

title: About Death
description:
Series of stories where "god" talks to the people who are on the verge of life and death.

---
**Official Translations:** [Indonesian / Bahasa](https://www.webtoons.com/id/drama/about-death/list?title_no=501)

---
**Note:**
Each original chapter is accompanied with a BGM that adds to the ambience, so it’s recommended to click the original webtoon link while reading the adapted version. You can also find the artist's social media links on mangaupdates.

title: Chase the Dragon
description: Daniel Winter, the werewolf, is on the run. The very person he's running away from is his past lover, lan Summers, the dragon. Unconvinced by Daniel's disappearance right after his proposal, lan has made a vow to reclaim Danny's love once again, no matter what it takes.

title: Sweet Trap
description: Hwang Taeja was bored. Bored of night clubs, bars and women. Until he met a mysterious woman who didn’t even bat an eye at his charm. How will the playboy win that person’s affection when all he did that night they met was to embarrass himself?

title: A Dead Crow's Stare
description:
Jinu is a weak coward left in a world full of zombies, ruled by survival of the fittest. Then, there are those other survivors who would use him, or perhaps even protect him. In the midst of survivors fighting for the sake of survival, fun, and desire, what will Jinu's fate be?  
  
(Rose Squad Scans)

title: Empresses in the Palace
alt_titles: Empresses in the Palace: Story of the Flowers
description: A collection of short chapters of the consorts and concubines from the original work "Empresses in the Palace" - famous for its original novel and TV drama adaptation.

title: Gradual Love
description: 'Chan-geun' was born with the curse from his forefathers, baldness. Then he meets 'Yeong-shin' a hairdresser who hates baldness! Chan-geun's hard days of struggle to hide the cruel truth begins!

title: Memoirs of a Witch
description: Lily, a black witch who was brought to the castle during a witch hunt when she was young and is still used by the king for her power even as an adult. She lives each day enduring both fear and scorn. Then one day, she meets a new court jester. Unlike other jesters, she is disliked for his flattery, but the jester shows favor to the witch. Why does the jester show favor to the witch? Can the witch ever get her free life back?

title: My Darling Signed In
description: Jaehyun may be the composed upperclassman on campus, but he secretly plays the hottest elven diva online with a love of pricey costumes. He meets Eunsung, a handsome first-year with deep pockets guarding his own secrets, at a school event. They connect instantly, but what begins as a sweet challenge becomes a risky game of affection on- and offline!

title: My Daddy Is A Cultivator
alt_titles: Don't Mess With The Cultivation Babysitter
description:
The almighty Demon Cultivator Xie Tian gave birth to a child during the demon king selection and lost his place as the demon king! Now at the bottom of the pit, he decides to bring his son Duoduo and get his man back from the succession and marriage ceremony of the righteous sect! Who is the father?!   
  
Bai Jing: Since you're already, then you won't be going anywhere else. I want both the father and the child!  
Xie Tian: Marriage? Sure. But I'm on top!

title: Him+Him
description: Because of his violent lover, Joo In-hae, Donghae visits the hospital with wounds. Thanks to Suhyun, the doctor who offered him a meal, Donghae feels liberated after a long time…

title: If You Are Not Careful, Your Name Will Go Down in History
alt_titles: If You Are Not Careful, Your Name Will Go Down in History
description: Tu Ye, who traveled to ancient times, wanted to kill his country and return to modern times. However, due to a strange combination of circumstances, he got blessed by "fainting", and step by step pushed Daqian, who was about to be destroyed, onto the road to the first empire.

title: This Wasn't My Plan
description:
This is a R-12. Kim Ro-ah is the manager for the famous actor, Chen Sih-Yeon, who mistreats her. When fatigue hits due to overwork, Ro-ah gets into an accident and dies. In her dying moment filled with revenge, she swears if she could return to the past she would trample all over Sih-Yeon to prevent him from becoming famous. It turns out that she actually did return to the past, just in time before Sih-Yeon is about to make his debut. Ro-ah tries to sabotage Sih-Yeon’s career, however her plan is not turning out as smoothly as she expects it to be.

---

title: Thirteenth Night
description:
The Ran Empire, a country that carries 500 long years of history and the daughter of one of the four major families who aided the emperor at the time of its founding. The daughter who was abandoned as soon as she was born and was raised in the slums.

In front of Salk, who's on the verge of being sold as a concubine to a rotten old man, is a noble young lady. A lady who looks identical to Salk and is claiming to be her twin sister.

Hee-yeon, whose life is in danger, asks her twin sister, Salk, who she met for the first time after 19 years…

---
With its splendid history of five hundred years, Lan Empire has its own share of lights and shadows. Abandoned at birth, Lynx grows up in one of its slums although she is a daughter of the powerful House of Joo, one of four founding families of the empire from its birth. Just as Lynx is about to be sold off as a concubine to a senile old man, a noble lady appears in front of her. Heeyun Joo, the noble lady with a striking similarity to Lynx, claims to be her long lost older twin sister. With her life being extinguished steadily, Heeyun asks that Lynx, her twin younger sister reunited only after 19 years, pose as her.

---
Lynx Joo may be the daughter of one of the Empire's founding families, but being abandoned at birth, she is left to grow up in one of its slums. The future of a woman in the slums is bleak at best, so Lynx is ready for an out. She’s about to be sold off to a senile old man when she’s rescued by a noblewoman who looks just like herself. Claiming to be her older twin sister, Heeyun Joo asks her for a startling favor: to pose as her… or else.

title: Ice Lamp - The Chronicles of Kira
alt_titles: An Ice Lamp - Chronicles of Gira
description:
A girl passing as a boy, fourteen-year-old Kira is left to fend for herself alone in this world. During a crucial turning point in her life, she makes a pact with a mystical entity in return for a male voice; this grants her to step into a bigger world by becoming a servant to a grand noble. From a commoner to a page boy, to a knight that leads others to battle, Kira matures through enduring agony and education. However, she's a mere pawn, an expendable being in the chess match between powerful men without any control over her own destiny. With no one to count on, can our heroine be able to change the fate others have chosen for her?

---

title: Murim's Youngest Miracle Demon Doctor
description: In the world of Murim, there are two legendary titles: Shin-ui (神醫) – the Divine Doctor of the Orthodox Sect, and Ma-ui (魔醫) – the Demonic Doctor of the Unorthodox Sect. What if... ... these two opposing forces… got married? From this legendary union comes Dan Ak-seon, a child born with the unmatched medical genius of both parents. But just as he’s growing up, fate intervenes. A mysterious absolute master appears before him— an encounter that will pull young Ak-seon into the chaos of the martial world. Armed with both divine and demonic healing arts, his journey through the rivers and lakes of Murim begins now!

title: Temple of Dragon King
description:
This series is adapted from a novel on the zhulang site. 

Lin Qinghan’s grandfather (her father’s father) is facing an imminent danger. His relatives disregarded the stability of Lin conglomerate and used various despicable means to inherit properties owned by him. President Qinghan was framed in the process. However, her husband, Zhang Xuan, who owns the title of “Satan” among the Lords of Dragon King Temple, is resolving everything one by one.

title: Trainees
description: Cha Hyeseong watches his crush drift away into stardom. He tries to preserve their relationship by enrolling into a school that produces idols – the same one she attends. He's immediately assigned to debut in an idol group that focuses on acting, which brings more trouble than he asks for.

title: Survival Methods of the Cannon Fodder Daughter
alt_titles: The Survival Strategies of the Cannon Fodder Girl
description:
Ye Qiqi transmigrated and became the five years old disliked daughter of the tyrannical emperor.

To survive, she did everything she could to stay away from him. Yet, fate pushed her to the tyrannical emperor time after time.

She even became his treasure accidentally? But the palace fights and the battle over the position as successor had just begun...

title: Zen Martial Arts Academy
description: Zen is a type of inner power energy that is essential in Marital Art World and the amount of Zen everyone has is different. Mingyum is a person without Zen, who wishes to become East Asia Strongest Martial Artist. Due to his argument with his sister on what Major she wanted him to take at school and what he wanted, he left, wandering around only to end up in a bad neighborhood. He ended up saving a girl, but got himself beat up in the process because he had no Zen. Then he got saved by a foreign girl who suddenly appeared and announced she is his fiancée. What will happen next?

title: I Will Definitely Confess Today!
description:
Born from a korean father and a filipino mother, Dan Kim has always been bullied for his looks until the arrival of his little savior, Chaeeun Han. The two became close friends and as time passed, Dan slowly developed feelings for Chaeeun. Sadly, the two parted ways in middle school and has not been in contact for 2 years.  
  
Now in college, Dan is determined to tell Chaeeun how he feels but with a growing competition for Chaeeun's affection, will he be able to succeed?

title: Xie'e Lianjin Shushi Gao Buding Ziji De Shiyan Ti
alt_titles: Xié'è Liànjīn Shùshì Gǎo Bùdìng Zìjǐ De Shíyàn Tǐ
The Evil Alchemist Can't Handle His Own Experiment
The Evil Alchemist Can't Handle His Own Test Subject

title: Naked Matchmaking With My Childhood Friends
description: Boy drops from school return to village where he's parents wants him to marry either of two sisters of different family.

title: The Emperor Thinks I'm Dying
alt_titles: Problematic That the Emperor Thinks I'm Terminally Ill
I'm in Trouble Because the Emperor Thinks My Time Is Limited
description: As his strongest knight, Lindelle helped the emperor ascend the throne. But at his coronation, she coughs up blood–a side effect of her contract with the dragon Laroque, who promised to grant Lindelle any wish if she can find the dragon’s real body. Meanwhile, Laroque’s magic is destroying Lindelle’s body, and the only way to heal is to fulfill the contract. But the emperor’s word is law–and he says Lindelle can’t leave until he finds a cure!

title: Isn't This Inside the Game?
description: A guild master, once ranked number one, wakes up 500 years in the future after winning a major siege. The guild is gone, the world feels strange, and everything has fallen apart. Determined to rebuild the guild and adapt to this unfamiliar time, they embark on a journey to restore their legacy and conquer the challenges of the new era.

title: Yue Shi
description: On the night of lunar eclipse, demons cause the world to be in chaos, the child with red hair and scarlet eyes bearing Solomon’s power, shall descend—

title: Ave Maria
description:
To recruit a new pope and a saint, the leader of the isolated and consensual nation, "Dav Marha," who serves the only god, "Marha," a trust, is established, and the chosen candidates are to gather together to compete.  
  
The candidates learn about the truth of the candidacy in the course of the match…

title: I Hate Love
description:
The various, daily life of the female student who hates love, Han Yeonsil. A romcom you can relate to!

---

title: Killing Killer
description:
The main character, Siwoo Lee, lost his parents to a murderer ten years ago. Finally, he meets Jack, the killer who killed his parents, and beheads him. “It wasn’t me who killed your parents.”
After learning that the real culprit is a "contractor" belonging to a group of killers using superpowers, Si-woo Lee decides to hunt down the registrants with Jack’s help.

title: My Hammer Girl
description: A girl armed with a hammer that has fallen from the sky? This time the one who crossed over from another world is? A hammer straight to the head! The male protagonist is dead?!

title: Syrinx, the Villain Healer
description:
Syrinx Aden has long been eluding the pursuers who murdered her family. All she wants now is to lay low while working as a jeweler, but she keeps attracting unwanted patients due to her ability to heal people with gems. Unfortunately, her newest patient turns out to be Heimdal, a notorious villain with a split personality. Despite her efforts to stay away, she somehow runs into him at every turn. Will Syrinx be able to escape Heimdal before danger catches up with her, or is it already too late? 

---

2 years ago.
After treating a patient who collapsed in front of my house, patients piled up one after another.

Syrinx, who was reincarnated into a novel she had read in her previous life, and Heimdal Wespergo, the villain and final boss in the novel, who came to her house as a patient.

title: How to Survive in a Horror Game
description:
In the horror mystery game "Night of the Murderers,"
I inhabited the character destined to be the tenth victim,
the tutor 'Arviche Green'.

The prime suspect is her employer, Duke Rearmend Laycus!

"…A, a murderer."

"Miss Green, you seem convinced that I'm the criminal.
Is that right?"

She lost her life after her last conversation with Laycus.
The remaining life count is two hearts.

'If I use up all my hearts, I really don't know what will happen.
So I need to steer clear of the main plotline of this game as much as possible.'

Arviche's efforts to distance herself from Laycus, the prime suspect,
perversely catches his interest...

"Do you remember when I said you were interesting, Miss Green?
I must retract that statement."

It was a relief to hear that.
The interest of a murderer is nothing but horrifying.

"Perhaps saying you're interesting might not be enough."

[Laycus Rearmend's favorability has increased.]

'...Wait, what? This isn't what I intended.'
A misstep.

Now, she has woken up in the body of a young girl, only to find out that she was framed as a traitor and is now remembered as such in history. “Please die,” they said. Words from comrades she’d fought beside for a decade.

“I’m sorry, Rin. For the sake of the world, you must be the one to die.”

And as everything faded away, she felt it was truly the end.

‘…Huh?’ Rin opened her eyes again. Thirty years had passed, and she’d awakened as the illegitimate child of the Tusrina family—now known as the Apostle of the Gods!

===

“You are an exceptional talent. It would be a waste to let you wither away here. Would you come with me?”

Rin stared at the man holding out his hand. One of the four heroes celebrated by the world. The very one who’d betrayed her in her past life, now attempting to adopt her because she resembled his old comrade's swordsmanship.

*Are you insane? As if I'd ever let you adopt me!*

title: Mom, I'm Gay
description: Jin and Rin are best friends since childhood, and they each have a secret - that they are both gay. Jin lives in a familiar household, while Rin has an overprotective mother who even looks at what she reads. However life turns upside down when both of their households find our about their sexual orientation. How will they survive despite their parents knowing?

title: You Mao's Labyrinth
description: Famous female live-broadcaster You Mao was mysteriously kidnapped, but the kidnappers began to question the various suspicious points involving the incident, resulting in them killing each other out of doubt. By the time Yang Haoyu appeared, the scene was already full of dead and injured people, but everything is just the start of his revenge…

title: Rebirth Knight
description:
There are mysterious masked-men trying to conquer the earth!! And to defeat them, the state started a project team called 'Rebirth Knight'. Kang Chan, one of the strongest high schoolers, meets a girl named Chaewon and falls in love at first sight. However, Kang Chan hears from Chaewon that she is a member of the Rebirth Knight, and decides he wants to be a member too…  
  
Read from left to right.

title: Killer Crush
alt_titles: When the Killer Falls in Love
description: A killer only has to do three things. Go on missions. Kill people. Leave absolutely no trace behind. Joo Taeman has 14 years of experience under his belt and he’s never let his feelings get the better of him. Never. That is, until Taeman experiences butterflies in his stomach after seeing national sweetheart Kang Dahyeok in person. But as it turns out, Taeman’s not the only one smitten on the spot. Dahyeok’s been looking for someone who can help him escape his reputation as a hunky heartthrob to live his gritty noir dreams. This killer crush’s out to get someone, but who’ll be the first to succumb? (Source: *Lezhin*)

“We follow an unspoken agreement not to look at each other’s face. After all, he’s nothing more than a conversation partner for me to unwind with in the restroom… Once we leave these doors, we're nothing but strangers.”  
  
A BL about falling in love(?) in the company restroom.

title: One Sided Love
description: Qi An is living a double life working two jobs to pay for his sick father's medical care. By day he's a timid, bespectacled office worker, at night he transforms into Yi You, a gorgeous singer who is #1 at the Chaos gay bar. When You Du, an old flame from Qi An's past, pays an exuberant amount of money for an evening with "Yi You", the two men spend a passionate night together. The magic dissolves the next day, however, when Qi An goes into the office and finds out that You Du has become his new boss!

Sit, stay, fetch, be human! That’s what happened to the canine, Jonggu, thanks to a miracle. As a dog, Jonggu always listened to his master Euncheol, but as a human, he calls the shots… in bed! Now Jonggu’s the master bending Euncheol over for all kinds of lustful fun where all the treats are under the sheets! Euncheol may even have a shot at real love with Jonggu. Find out who the true master really is... where the sex is hot and just maybe, real love can be found in a dog-lick-dog world.

title: Come to the Orchard in the Spring
description:
Teaching assistant Han Bom from art department starts dating her longtime crush and fellow teaching assistant Nam Hae-Song from a neighboring department. But she gets approached by a promising art student Lee Yoon-Oh.  
  
For some reason, Nam Hae-Song starts to avoid Bom after they start dating while Lee Yoo-Oh waits for her everyday, tells her he loves her everyday, and hugs her tightly and tell her to come to him everyday.  
  
The person I love, the person who loves me, and my spring orchard of flowers, alcohol and candle lights.

title: Who Stole the Empress?
description:
"All my people are dead... I just wanted to try my best. I just wanted to be a kind Empress. Why..."

Her injuries made her look so worn out… After torturing her for days and killing everyone she ever loved, the Emperor abandoned the Empress in the snowy mountains. In this heavy snowfall, the former Empress Roselyn had resigned herself and was ready to accept death. Her family, her friends, all her hard work for the people of the empire... There was no reason left for her to continue living. So she laid down on this pure white blanket, her body almost frozen, and watched the white snow be dyed in black. At first, the cold was painful, but the pain quickly subsided and so she thought that freezing to death just might not be all that bad.

“Being persecuted to death, lying alone as if you're ruling this snowy field...”

That man.

“If you don't need your life anymore... then pardon me, I’ll take it.”

He's the enemy general, Tamon Krasis.

“You’re mine now, Empress.”

She was abandoned by them, but he stole her and took her away. Who kidnapped the Empress?

Determined to make sure she doesn’t suffer the same fate, Letizia rebels against her family and the confines of high society. When the mysterious man who showed her kindness in her past life is in danger, she intervenes and becomes embroiled in a plot she could have never imagined. Can Letizia save herself and those she loves when given a second chance at life?

title: Black Angel
description: A series of murders happen within the same neighbourhood - all with a common thread: a sweet corrupt whisper in the ear tempting the daily victims…

title: Life With My Loving In-Laws
description:
Lowell, the "ugly duckling" of the Viscounts of Linthea, is sold in marriage to the Dukes of Hikaruel, a vampire.

Rumors that her political partner, the Duke of Hikaruel, has burn scars all over his body and is crippled, etc., lead her to Hikaruel territory, where she is unable to hide her fears.
But what awaits Roel in the Duchy of Hikaruel is Prince Aslan, a beautiful dark-haired boy, and the kind people of the Duchy of Hikaruel...!

Having grown up in an abusive family, Lowell is bewildered by the Prince's different appearance and the warm atmosphere of the ducal family, but he also feels happy.

"Please, let me stay here forever...!"

Unhappy Lowell's life as the happiest bride in the world begins!

title: Sincerely
description:
Promo for the novel.  
  


---
I woke up one day inside the story of a novel as the maid of the disgraced Duke and side character, Alejandro Quillo Vel Laviti. Will Alejandro’s fate change with my appearance as a new ‘extra’ character? What is the truth behind his cursed mark?

title: Beware of Your Boyfriend
description: Da-In and Si-Hyun are in the same class, but they’ve never spoken to each other. One day, an unfamiliar guy appears and says he is the Lee Si-Hyun from the future, and that they’ll go out with each other. Da-In doesn’t believe him, but as his predictions come true, she starts to trust him. As Da-In shows interest in Si-Hyun, their classmates say they are flirting with each other. However, Si-Hyun has a twin who looks exactly like him. Just what is the identity of this unfamiliar guy…?

title: Forty Millenniums of Cultivation
description:
"If this galaxy is truly a ruthless and bloody forest, we Cultivators would burn our lives to ignite a small spark."

One day, the tiny spark would set this dark place ablaze and light up the whole world! This is a passionate tale about the journey of an ordinary teenager—from being deserted at the border to eventually becoming a legend that takes over the galaxy!

---
- [Alt Raw Bilibili](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc24464)

title: Zhong Qing
description:
[Idle Nomad version]
Low-grade guide Qin Yun thought his assignment on Planet G would be uneventful—until he met Cezar, an eccentric esper with too much power and even more curiosity to spare. Left with a temporary mark, Qin Yun was stuck with being dragged across the galaxy, and dodging danger all while enduring Cezar’s unpredictable whims. This is only temporary, right?

[1Braincell version]
Low-grade guide, Qin Yun, forcibly marked by divine-grade sentry tyrant Mersherie, aggressive maiden-heart seme x serious straightforward uke starting an unbashful unabashed companion life, conquering the whole universe while at it

title: My 36D Maid
description: Hou Rui woke up one day and realised that his ultimate dream had been fulfilled. From now on, every day he is woken up by breasts, and bathed and dressed by a beautiful woman. He is even accompanied by her when he goes to school!….. Ahhh, life is too comfortable and satisfying to be hated by people. Is "exquisite" a word?

title: One-Punch Man - The Fight of Gods (Doujinshi)
description:
A fanmade comic by Cminglap, depicting Saitama vs a Godlike entity.  
  
WARNING: SPOILERS FOR THE ONE PUNCH MAN WEBCOMIC!  
  
Author & Artist: <https://twitter.com/cminglap>

title: Alien Stage
description: These short stories tell us a bit more than it was told in the animation project "Alien Stage". Here are the stories about the main characters of "Alien Stage", about their life, past and future. You will reveal details about the characters and find out more things about them than while listening to the songs and watching the animations. The comic contains both funny and very heartwarming stories.

title: Beast Taming: Starting with the Classic of Mountains and Seas, Sweeping Across the Globe
description: Starting with the Classic of Mountains and Seas, Sweeping Across the Globe The era of Beast Masters has arrived globally, but the Great Xia is on the brink of collapse due to a break in ancient civilizations, with no one able to summon powerful beasts. The time-traveler Yang Yang starts by summoning the *Classic of Mountains and Seas*, using the legendary beasts from the mythic mountains and seas as his own! With terrifying talent and strength, Yang Yang leads the Great Xia to sweep across the world, crushing various nations. Everyone is shocked: he is not a Beast Master, but the “Beast Overlord” who stands above the heavens and earth! [Updated every Tuesday and Friday]

title: There Is No Fantasy for Alice
description: Alice doesn't wake up from her dream. Stuck in a chaotic world, she, along with the White Rabbit, cuts down fairy tale characters that rampage after drinking "magic potions" that imbue special powers such as shrinking or growing bigger. Meanwhile, she is being targeted by three leaders of the world.

title: REAL PLAY: BERSERKER
description: Due to the virtual reality creation item 'Real Play (Ripple)' rank 1 pro gamer 'Hyun-soo' leaves the gaming scene. Unlike his peers, he despises Ripple and is bullied for it, spending his days barely getting by working part time jobs. Thanks to his friend who pities him, he reluctantly begins to play Ripple. With his reaction times from his days as 1 frame, and the strength of a berserker, he becomes the focus of attention.

title: The Gangster Baby of the Duke's Family (Promo)
description:
My name is Leonora Hachania. Although I'm the daughter of a villain extra whose name in itself means 'insignificant', my desire for power is unimaginable. 

I can't just let the Hachania family be as insignificant as it is in the original novel! 

"Woll to the left, wight now!" 
"Yes, ma'am!" 
"Woll to the wight, wight now!" 
"Yes, ma'am!" 

With the sunglasses I made by painting on them with ink, I raised my voice fiercely.

"Sowldier Enoch, we don't cwy!" 

The tender-hearted third child who had met my eyes was startled and sniffled with his runny nose.

"W-we don't cry!" 

* * 

I've succeeded. 

"Were you originally this weak? How annoying."
"Ugh! S-Save me!"
"Hyung, they look like they're really suffering, should we kill them quickly? It would be better for them."

My brothers who couldn't even hold a candle to the male lead and were extras have become the greatest villain brothers in the world!

Although it was a bit difficult since my villain father was so clumsy,

"Rini, just what kind of evil deed are you planning this time..."

"Keke, it's nothing. As expected of my daughter, you're planning something evil. Very nice."

I've redesigned him to be a villain with a dual personality.

Keke, mwahaha!

Nice, I've increased our assets using the information from the original novel and made the family into a significant one!
Now, I just need to escape this terminally ill body and enjoy the proper life of a villainess-

"I know that Your Ladyship is a caring person, so it would be too greedy to wish for your kindness to be mine alone."

I think the human weapon that I revived for the family has broken.

"But if I get rid of all the people you are kind to..."

The red flame blazing in his hand burned the map of the world.

"Won't I be the only you can be kind to?"

He says that as if he's about to hunt down the entire world.

title: Home Plate's Villain
description: To meet his dead parents again, Hong Bin made a deal with the Baseball Fairy, who agreed to return him to the past if he achieved 3,000 career hits as a baseball player. And at the age of 40, Bin the baseball legend hits his last ball and goes back in time. After reuniting with his family, Bin decides to pursue his old dream of joining the major league. The only issue is that he's lost all his old skills as a pro! But will his past experiences be enough to help this legend fulfill his new goal?

title: The Scholar Warrior
description:
Cheon Muji-chee, the only son of the Hebei thousand swords family and the grandson of King Kwon. Cheon Seong, the lazy young master of the heavenly swordsman. He wants to become an imperial scholar, but the world pushes him to the top.

“My dream is to become a scholar….

How long do I have to be like this?”

title: A Sheep in Wolf Clothing
alt_titles: Pi Zhe Yang Pi de Lang
description: There exists a website where you just pay a few dollars and set a keyword, then you can easily enter the world of novels to personally run around and venture. After every time you enter, the experiences that occurred will automatically become parts of the novels. A new novelist, Lan Pi, saw such an introduction, mouse-clicked it, closed her eyes, and entered the VR world. The funny love between the gentle, black-hearted Sheep King and the funny, straightforward Wolf tomboy girl has just begun.

title: A Declaration of Revenge
description: A man named Lee Jung-yool appears out of nowhere in Han Gitae's detective agency, and Gitae suddenly finds himself under threats to cooperate with his plans…! What exactly is the massive conspiracy that involves the two of them? And what will become of these two?

title: Return for Revenge
description:
When she was hit by labor pain, what greeted her wasn't words of comfort but vile accusations of infidelity. Killed in defense of her unborn baby, she vowed to take revenge on them all… and God granted her a second chance. However, it seems that she's not the only one brought back. Who's that silver-haired guy in mask? Why does he seem to know her every move, yet still willingly provide unconditional help regardless?

---
When Empress Sawol was pregnant with the Emperor's child, she loses all of her loved ones and then is sentenced to death by the Emperor and her little sister, who became the imperial consort. After her death, she magically gets another chance to relive her life. Will Sawol do the right thing when faced with her past mistakes and save herself and her family? And will she be able to take on revenge against the malicious Emperor and her sister?

title: The Crown Prince Lost His Mind
alt_titles: Tai Zi De Liao Shi Xin Feng
description: The sick and weak Prince of the Da Qi dynasty was sealed, leaving only his shallow breathing. The prince, Huang Sang’s martial arts teacher Wu Nian opened the altar, in order to use the once weak prince to destroy the beloved son from the palace. However, he did not know before opening the seal of Wu Nian, that he was actually the most tyrannical prince recorded in history. The teacher went on his knee's and begged for Wu Nian's sanity to return. You are still my kind hearted prince! The teacher has made a grave mistake, releasing not the prince, but in his wake, a mad and heartless man.

title: Campus Flower Guard
description:
School flowers and sisters, beautiful and powerful sisters, pure beauty teachers, all cherish their embraces ... Ordinary high school students, by chance, get a magic pen, and life has changed since then The variety is colorful. 
- - -
This is a story about a high school boy named Ji Tian Wu. One day he finds a fountain pen in a bird's nest. Somehow it gets absorbed into his hand and a computer like voice begins analysing things around him and he learns that he earns points in some mysterious system. Each use consumes a certain amount, which apparently he needs to keep replenishing in order to use. So far he has learned that he can earn them by coming in contact with girls.

title: Invite A Wolf Into The House
description: One is the most prestigious CEO in the world of werewolves, the other is a homeless vampire who is good for nothing. They have every reason to become archenemies, yet to their surprise, a wolf cub pops up and ties their bond. Behold the romance between a werewolf and a vampire. What sparks will be kindled between the two, inspite of their drastically different statuses and personalities?

title: Don't Get Caught! xxx
description:
"Why are you coming out there!!!" 

I couldn't forget my school crush, Seo Jungwoo.
Eun Se-eun is serializing a BL webtoon based on Jungwoo and himself.
When my friend told me that Jungwoo already left my hometown, I return to find a peace of mind.

However, contrary to his friend's words, he encounters Jungwoo, who is now working at the post office in his hometown.

title: The Demon from the Bloodstained Dark Jade
description: Unpopular young star Mo Ji meets by chance a man, Shen Yi, who bears a remarkable resemblance to himself. At their first meeting in the largest Jiangnan clubhouse in Hongcheng, a misunderstanding occurs between the two. Shen Yi thinks this pretty-faced boy that looks like an internet celebrity, is wanting to take the opportunity to seduce him. Mo Ji thinks this old mister that stinks of money wishes to sign him via the casting couch. From this misunderstanding, love, hatred, affection and enmity is born.

title: S.I.D.
description:
As a little boy, Si Mun, the grandson of a famous shaman, gained the ability to see—and communicate with—ghosts. His grandmother gave him a talisman which rid him of this ability and erased his memories of any supernatural phenomena he had witnessed.   
  
Years later, Si Mun is working a hectic, yet ordinary job as a homicide detective in the Korean police force. His grandmother has since passed on, but the powers she sealed away appear to be reawakening…  
  
Polski:  
Jako mały chłopiec, Si Mun, wnuk słynnego szamana, zyskał zdolność widzenia i komunikowania się z duchami. Babcia podarowała mu talizman, który uwolnił go od tej zdolności i wymazał wspomnienia z wszelkich nadprzyrodzonych zjawisk, których był świadkiem. Wiele lat później Si Mun wykonuje szaleńczą, ale zwykłą pracę jako detektyw z wydziału zabójstw w koreańskiej policji. Od czasu kiedy jego babcia odeszła, moce które zapieczętowała, wydają się budzić …

title: Green Boy
alt_titles: Green Boy: Shouting Out to You
description:
Jae-in is an irrepressible girl who aims to be a champion, and Tae-jin is the innocent boy who loves her.  
This is the story of their challenges on the road to the championships, and an unlikely summer-time love.

title: Chasing Star Moon
description: After her parents divorced, Cong Cong has been living alone, one day she goes to meet her idol, falls down a flight of stairs and travels through time.

title: Distance Between Us
description: “I wanna graduate so I don't have to see him ever again...” Under the blue sky, Hyunwoo’s youth spins in a circle. Same class, next seat in the bus, and his bright smile. The smallest things take quite a strain on Hyunwoo’s heart, seeking for jealousy and dictatorship. Wanting to get closer, but still keeping the distance. Why is love so complicated? Today as well, the distance between Hyunwoo and Chanhee stays the same as ever.

title: Princess Wei Yang
description: A young lady of the prime minister family, enduring for 8 years. Finally, at one day she was bestowed empress, Phoenix of the country! But life is unpredictable. Her husband loved her stepsister, deposed her as Empress and even forced her son into death. In that Cold Palace, she was forced to drink poisonous wine. So in the next lifetime, she made a promise to never do good deeds and help others, to never step into the palace and to never become the Empress!

title: Sacrificed
description:
“You, who has always been useless all your life, can now be useful for once.”

Ludis, an illegitimate child of the Emperor, was always abused by her own father due to her lameness and uselessness. She was offered to an ancient god so as to save their Empire that was currently in crisis. In the midst of offering herself, a man approaches her.

---
An illegitimate daughter of Emperor Berthold Amaryllis of Visio, Ludis has spent her entire life being mistreated and pushed into the shadows. Now, with the Visio Empire standing on the precipice of destruction under the threat of Demonspawn hordes, her father finds a new use for her in becoming the sacrifice necessary to summmon an ancient god. But as the colossal golden eyes seem ready to consume her, she finds herself in the embrace of a mysterious man...

---

title: Santa Will Always Grant Your Wishes
description:
[From Kidari Studio's Penis Navidad Collection]  
  
Hojun the hotelier didn't believe in the tale of Santa Claus since his childhood. That fact remained the same even after he’s reached adulthood. But one day, on the day after Christmas, he met a strange man who asked him if he believes in Santa.  
  
[CAUTION: Served to you by BL Bakery while it's still piping hot!]

title: Have You Seen My Brother?
alt_titles: Xiōng Tái Kànjiàn Wǒ Dìle Ma
description: The martial arts master Chu Wenshan has lost his memories, but the only clue to finding out about himself is a threatening letter… Huh? My brother was kidnapped? Wait, who’s my brother? No, even if I don’t know, I have to rescue him. Excuse me my friend, have you seen my brother?

title: Their Color
description: Due to the magical essence leaking out of the new dimension that opened up within this world, all living creatures started to mutate into monsters. However, the remaining survivors of the human race were able to reduce the effects caused by the magical essence, and the world became divided into two factions. The “New World”, and the “Under World”. Because of this, the people left behind in the Under World became adapted to their surrounding environments, and evolved into a new species. These people became known as the “Under People”, and they seem to be far more superior and powerful than the human race…?

title: The Redemption of Earl Nottingham
description:
Is my cursed husband's fate up to me?

Madelyn's husband Ian was left broken after the war, and in turn, made her life a living hell. Fleeing her doomed marriage, she meets a tragic end. But when she opens her eyes, she finds herself at 17 again. 

The war has yet to start, and Madelyn can still change her fate. But what about Ian?

title: Code of Silence
description: Joaquin, the top killer of the Nielsen family was to murder a family of three, yet he came across a young boy named Davion who once saved his life, causing him to spare the young boy's life. Davion, oblivious to the truth beside his foster parents' death, wishes for Joaquin to train him in order to avenge his foster parents' deaths! With this, Joaquin became Davion's teacher. As a cruel killer encounters the innocent young boy, he seems to feel something change in this heart? When will the truth be revealed, and how will they be able to face it?

title: Genius Monster of the Century
description:
Ei Ruri, who was a famous child actor, grew up and couldn't return to being an actor because her body changed. But her aunt, a genius scientist, successfully developed a nanochip that allows people to become beautiful and "perfect". She wanted to test this, and the person she immediately thought of was Ei Ruri.  
  
A chance to get back your former beauty and honor! If it were you, would you take this chance?  
  
- [Official Japanese Translation](https://piccoma.com/web/product/22828)  
- [Official Thai Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/th/drama/shijienv/list?title_no=2042)

title: Gluttonous Widow
alt_titles: [Master and Servant GL Anthology] Gluttonous Widow
description: In a small village, a girl named Cheonghwa, as frail as she was beautiful, was sold to be the new wife of a rich, old man. He was not a good husband. Fearing she would gain weight, he kept her starved. With this, Cheonghwa found the gnawing hunger unbearable. Then one day, that husband suddenly passed away. Now, she could eat. She could eat to her heart's content. Both the food... and her handmaiden, Ohwol, standing right before her eyes.

title: Boss's Very Hot Summer
alt_titles: Leng Ku Zong Cai De Xia Tian
description: Accidentally destroying pictures worth several thousand, the newbie Gu Yi Ru falls into the hands of the callous chairman Qi Xing Chen––threatening her family, blackmailing with promising futures, and also unable to refuse those hugs...

title: The Male Lead Is Trying to Change the Female Lead
alt_titles: The Hero Is Trying to Change the Heroine
The Tragic Male Lead Is Changing the Female Lead?!
description:
I ended up possessing the body of an extra named Luberia, who is barely mentioned in the story. And right in the tragic novel *Emperor Caesar*, full of wars and disasters, where the protagonist sacrifices everything for the love of the hero and everyone ends up dying! I planned to live discreetly and hide my strength... 

But the male lead, Caesar, keeps looking for me and even proposes marriage, saying he wants to keep me around. Luberia doesn't want to meet the same tragic end as the protagonist, so she tries to avoid Caesar at all costs... But due to Caesar's intimidating appearance and assertiveness, before she knows it, she ends up engaged to him. 

Will Luberia manage not to fall in love with Caesar and survive until the end?

title: A Heart for the Emperor
alt_titles: Plant a Heart in the Emperor
Please Give a Heart to the Emperor
Please Plant a Heart in the Emperor
Give a Heart to the Emperor
description:
An avid reader suddenly finds herself in the body of a minor character with a tragic ending in the prologue of a novel . How will the new owner of the body take the reins of fate into her hand and change the storyline so that she remains unscathed? The new Charlion wishes to save herself and her family from their impending tragic end.

title: Zaizhan Yishi, Qichong Xinghe
description: Wu Xinghe, the youngest grandmaster in the history of ancient Chinese martial arts, was hunted down by the organization of Blood-Eating Rose and died. However, it is a spirit that is not ignorant, and the soul is reborn on the body of a low-level noble boy in a different world, once again opening the road to the peak of his pursuit of martial arts.

title: Vengeance of the Reawakened Sword God
description: A generation of traversers came to the city, originally preparing to live a life of obscurity, but one by one troublesome things broke in, making it difficult for him to keep a low profile! He can only be forced to pretend to slap his face and see how Chen Yuan plays in the city!

title: Kita, Guitar, Kizuita?
description:
Bokita
People have been calling Kita weird for not having a boyfriend. And have started gossiping about Kita and Bocchi. One day Bocchi brings this up during practice...

title: Off Stage
description:
Batoto Scans :  
Once again, PAZE (Korea's #1 idol group) is on stage to perform at the annual awards ceremony. Suddenly, during the performance, the lead dancer falls down on stage causing an ankle injury. Due to this injury, PAZE's entire schedule of activities, including the comeback tour in the first half of the year, have been cancelled!   
  
In an effort to keep fans satisfied for the duration of activity suspension, the agency decides on a two-man unit. It is composed of PAZE main rapper Jae-hyuk and group leader Hae-eun.   
  
Hae-eun hesitates under the sudden pressure but just how is Jae-hyuk not hesitating at all?! Instead, Jae-hyuk is acting as if he had been waiting for the formation of this duo! Hae-eun feels that his relationship with Jae-hyuk will change through this partnership. After their kickoff exclusive show begins a wonderful love story of two idols…

title: Diary of a Scumbag Girl’s Struggle to Survive
alt_titles: Diary of a Scumbag Girl’s Struggle to Survive
Survival Diary of a Bad Girl
description:
Everyone gets reincarnated as the heroine when they're dropped into another world, right?! So why am I a supporting character?! Worse still, I'm inside my own novel, one with a bad ending!

---

- **Vol. 2:** Ending A (ch. 117A-142A)
