**Note:** You can read ending B without reading ending A.

title: Dear Anonymous Sponsor (Promo)
description:
Judith, a war orphan of a defeated nation, concealed her identity and exiled to the federal state. She has an anonymous supporter, whom she never met or knew his name, age or how he looked. On one summer day, five years after she sent her letter to her anonymous supporter, once a month with gratitude, she received a letter from him.

“Miss Judith, how about spending this summer at Waltz's Curtis mansion?”

Waltz, the capital of Baja, from where the letter was sent, Judith’s heart bloomed with happiness by receiving a letter from her sponsor. She was amazed to see the skyscrapers, the kind which she saw in the newspapers, which she had never seen in her life.

“Miss Judith, don’t trust your sponsor too much.”

As soon as Judith got off the train, she got involved with an infamous gangster.

“I didn't know there were guests. That said, a lady too."

At the sponsor's mansion, which she had finally arrived, there was a suspicious someone that lived in the house instead of her sponsor.

“I don't share anything that comes into my hand once.”

And the real owner of the mansion who had returned after a while. In the hot summer, as the strange air current spreads around her and the three men, the number of questions gradually increases.

“Have you ever thought it was weird? About the things they erased from your memories.”

Of the three men who hide their secrets, a nobleman from a foreign country, a successful businessman in the military business, a boss of a low-quality gang, who really is her sponsor?

*This is a promo manhwa for the novel.*

title: Bowblade: The Descendants of Bowblade
alt_titles: Bowblade Swordsman: Descendants of the Bowblade
Archer Sword God: Descendants of the Archer
description: Eulji So Moon has aged well and is now a grandfather. He orders his mischievous grandson to go on a joyful trip to Zhongyuan! To save the fallen Namgung family clan and help them spread their wings once more, Eulji Ho’s journey starts now!!

title: Powerless
description:
It’s time! 

Introducing, in the “powerless” corner, the former undisputed MMA champion Gwangho Hwang, with a professional record of 49:1 and a reputation for all kinds of dirty tactics, returning fresh from a supposed ‘permanent’ suspension. 

And in the “powered” corner… well, folks, let’s just say it’s a murderer’s row of deadly opponents with an array of special abilities. Welcome to the octagon, the ultimate showdown between a league of enhanced super-fighters going up against Gwangho’s brawn and his manager Seyeon’s brains! 

The bell rings for Round 1. Touch gloves, and face the pain! Here… we… go!

title: The Devil in the Suit
alt_titles: 西装下的魔王：傲娇总裁不能撩
description: A second-rate novelist Shao Xin Yu who always can't write good novels, cross-dressed under the alias "Shao Xin Yu", and risks it all by sneaking into the legendary men idol company, the Rong Guang Group- with the plan of writing a popular novel based on CEO Wen Qi Jing. Wen Qi Jing is cold and arrogant. He has frightened away numerous personal assistants. Even so, the carefree and careless "young man", Shao Xin Yu, makes his heart beat fast when "he" appears in front of him.

title: Princess Agent
alt_titles: Tègōng Huáng Fēi Chǔ Qiáo Zhuàn
Tegong Huang Fei Chu Qiao Zhuan
Te Gong Huang Fei Chu Qiao Zhuan
description:
Chu Qiao was once agent 005 for the the military unit 11. After being framed and thrown into prison, she successfully escaped but then had sacrificed her life to protect the special agent unit from being bombed. When she woke up, Chu Qiao had traveled to the Xia Dynasty as an 8-year-old slave girl. Due to receiving help from Yan Xun during their escape, there fate was bound together, as Chu Qiao would then spend years helping him rebel and reconquer his land.  
However, as they walked further and further down the path to their dream, they grew further apart. One reason was because of the way they dealt with things, the other was because of a rather meddlesome Zhuge Yue, who never stopped loving Chu Qiao, despite having their loyalties lie on opposite ends.  
The old regime will crumble and wither away, letting the new Xia Dynasty be reborn from the ashes.

title: Forever Mine
description: He will follow every command I give him. He will follow me to the ends of the earth. He is Forever Mine.

title: My Oppa Is an Idol
description:
A chance encounter?! Through persistence Nam Dareum gets to work at her Oppa's company!  

---

title: The Adorable Princess of Doom
description:
Demon King Kaon breaks the taboo and tries to bring his dead lover back to life. However, magic creates new existences beyond expectations. A little girl who looks exactly like his dead lover. However, her soul is a Korean woman named 'Lee Eun'.

The Demon King tried to kill the child as it was a failure, but he thought it was something related to the will of his deceased lover, so he made her a princess. In that way, the only being who mixed the power of the greatest magician of mankind, 'Asela' and the Demon King Kaon, 'Luciana Lord Moon Blood Lane', was born.

But that is the position of the Demon King! Lee Eun suddenly fell into another world on the day she won first prize in the lottery!

"Send me back! I could have been happy in the modern world!"

But why is this apex place more appealing? What is the prophecy of doom?

In a world full of secrets. a new life unfolds where you will meet friends and family, friendship and love that did not exist in modern times, and even the pain of the past will be healed.

---
Eun Lee has had an eventful day. First, she won the lottery. Then, she was summoned to a mystical realm by the Demon King, Kaon Mahana Lord Moon Blood Rain, and was newly named Rue, princess of the demon realm. Eun demands to be returned to her original world so she can collect her winnings, but Kaon wonders if she has something to do with his late lover’s will. Eun surprises herself by adjusting to her new and unfamiliar life, but will she ever truly let go of her past and find happiness here? 

---

title: This Human Became the Bizarro Lord
alt_titles: Shēnwéi Rénlèi De Wǒ Què Chéngwéi Guàiyì Zhī Zhǔ
Shenwei Renlei De Wo Que Chengwei Guaiyi Zhi Zhu
Shēn Wéi Rén Lèi De Wǒ Què Chéng Wéi Guài Yì Zhī Zhǔ
Shen Wei Ren Lei De Wo Que Cheng Wei Guai Yi Zhi Zhu
I'm a Human, but, I Became the King of Monsters
description: Since childhood, the protagonist could often see terrible “bizarre” creatures that no one else would see throughout lifetimes. Yet, he was never afraid. Instead, he was drawn to those bizarros and grew an attachment to them. Then one day in high school, he happened to meet a bizarro monitor and receive an invite to manage a prison that houses countless bizarros, as well as track down the ones who went lost in the world…..

title: High-end Player of Mystery
description: When he opened his eyes one day, Yuyu found that he had entered a strange game world filled with monsters, and if you die, your death is broadcast live. To survive, you must beat the game. Fortunately, Yuyu meets the game’s cold-mannered god, Yunze. Caring more about his life than his image, Yuyu clings to Yunze for help.

title: Elegy of the Heavens
description: The Gods created the Heavens, Hell, and the Human world, and the Gods also created Angels, but what if the Gods are wrong? You once said that as long as I live, we can meet again…I will wait forever, even in the depths of Hell, waiting for our love that is not blessed by the Gods

title: To My Star
description: A story of growth of 20-year-old youth turns into real adults.

title: What the Evil Dragon Lives For
alt_titles: What the Evil Dragon Lives For
What Does That Evil Dragon Live For?
description:
Elaine becomes a human sacrifice to the evil dragon Rabess, who is here to destroy the empire. But it seems that Rabess already knows her. And he offers to grant her three wishes... 
Elaine feels she should at least save the world, so she asks him not to destroy it.  Then she ends up returning 10 years in the past, to when she was 16 years old. 
However, Rabess seems to have a different plan in mind...

title: The Empress' Poor-quality Special Effects
description: Wu Sheyue is a cosmetics specialist/assassin. One day, her organization decided to kill her. Though she was stabbed, she survived, and travelled back to the past, into the body of a “mad” girl. There, she uses her wits and skills to become the Empress.

title: Stupid Cupid
description:
I confessed with a trembling heart, and what I got in return… were words of support?! There’s something seriously wrong!  
What?! You’re saying you thought I like men?!  
  
The most useless and cute attempt in the world of wanting to couple up with a cupid begins!

title: My Wish Is Two Separate Beds
description:
Julia, the Queen of Semele, has a dilemma—her childhood friend and husband, Endymion. Married through an arranged union, they’ve shared a bed for 12 years, growing up like siblings. But one day, everything changes.

“Do we really need to share a bed? You should break this habit, especially for your future concubine who’ll bear your child…”

“My child? With whom?”

Suddenly, their dynamic shifts. Endymion leans closer, locking eyes with Julia.

“My child… will be with you.”

His whisper sends shivers down her spine. Since that night, sharing a bed has become unbearably awkward.

“Can we please just use separate beds?”

title: Peony: Dreaming of the Dangerous Grand Duke
alt_titles: I Saw the Future With the Killer Grand Duke
description: Today, I am getting married for the second time to my husband, as the daughter of the imperial family he hates. Pretending to be good, pretending to be weak, pretending to be poor. I possessed Gabriella Nashert, a villainess who possesses the ‘three-piece combo’ that enrages the readers. In order to escape her scheduled death, she asked Ernst Esqes, the Northern Grand Duke, to marry her on a contract. The three years spent with her husband, away from where the original incident took place, were quite sweet. Even though it ended with my death. "If you and I meet in our next life, please marry me again." However, when I woke up again, I found out that I became the daughter of the family who’s responsible for my death?

title: Rewriting My Husband's Tragic Ending
alt_titles: I Became the Wife of a Tragedy's Main Lead
I Got Married in a Hardboiled Fiction
description:
Living alone as an abandoned princess of the Kingdom of Anzak, I discovered I was in fact in a trashy novel which appeared in my dreams one day. My half-sister was the novel's heroine, while the male lead was well-known to be cruel and heartless. I was just an extra who died before all the drama started. Sold as a scapegoat for the Halvenkia Empire's peace treaty, I was destined to die, unable to escape my fate.

"I'm the only man in Halvenkia who's still single. Don't you fancy me?"

But all of a sudden, the main character wants to marry me. Your first love, first kiss, and first fling are all with the heroine, but could I take them all for myself?

Alexia, struggling to alter the story in order to survive. Tervion, wanting to keep her all for himself. And Ophelia, the unknown heroine. The original story has now begun to flow in a completely different direction. This is romance fantasy which covers Alexia and Tervion's dreams and fantasies, as the only ones in each other's eyes.

---

As the bastard child of Anzak's king, Alexia knew she was destined for very little. "The Book of Wolves" foretold her destiny as a side character, from her impoverished childhood to her brutal death at the hands of the enemy prince, Tervion. But when Alexia is sent to assassinate him, the story changes. Now she's engaged to him as part of the peace treaty between their two countries. In the face of mortal danger and abandoned by a loveless father in enemy lands, Alexia must decide where her loyalties lie and whose life matters most.

---

title: Divine Bells
description:
Divine Bells - they choose their own masters and they determine the status, prestige, and influence of the countries their masters rule. The presence or lack of these Bells also has great consequence in the lives of each country's royalty. In particular, the personal and political futures of King Hong-Ryeong seem doomed without a Bell, but at equally great peril if he obtains one.  
  
But are the Divine Bells simple magical charms, deities of great powers, or something else altogether? And when the owner of three of the eight existing Divine Bells dies, leaving them to choose new owners, where will the resulting turmoil lead?

title: One Take
description: Former rising star, current no-name actor Jang Seungmin’s lucked out. Not only has he nabbed a role in a TV show, but he’s also getting to work with the biggest star in the country, Ha Hyunje. Charismatic, handsome, but also a little bit of a jerk, Hyunje has a magnetic presence that draws everyone in. Before Seungmin knows it, he’s become yet another Ha Hyunje fanboy. Seungmin’s satisfied with keeping a safe distance between himself and Hyunje, but…why is Hyunje so interested in Seungmin? More importantly, what does "the incident" that happened 7 years ago have to do with anything?

title: Lady Adelyn the Homebody
description:
I woke up in the body of Adeleide, the supportive female friend of the Female Lead in a novel my friend wrote. But the kind, shy Female Lead only seemed to care about herself, so I decided to stop going along with every one of her whims. She's an adult, she can't rely on me for every littke thing! And now the playboy second male lead, who is supposed to be cold, visits me all the time? Everyone's personalities seem so different, how is this story going to play out?! I just want to live a quiet homebody life!!

---
After waking up to find herself as the extraverted side character in the failed novel she co-wrote with a friend, introverted Adelyn is not looking to get involved in anything, including the characters' story. In fact, she plans to stay home and out of everything for as long as she can. But something about the story feels off and won't let her be! With the characters acting out of character and the plot taking twists and turns, will Adelyn be able to get back to her homebody life?

title: I Don't Want to Attack You!
description:
On the way home, a drunk Heather helps an elephant who is crying because his nose hurts. When a small, palm-sized elephant is turned into a nose cuff, the elephant claims to be the god of sexual desire and affection.

"In exchange, I will let you share passionate love with the most handsome man on the continent."

However, this was not a blessing from God, but a curse.

title: Witch Hunt
description: A boy transfers to a seemingly ordinary school. But on his first day, he witness a classmate using magical powers…

title: Beastly Things
description:
In a world where werewolves live among humans in secret, Han Ji-u, a detective agency owner and a powerful werewolf, crosses paths with Cheon Yuseung, a famous actor, when he "accidentally" hits her with his car. 

And when they run into each other again "by chance," one thing becomes clear to Ji-u: She must have him — whatever that may entail. 

Ji-u wants Yuseung’s rare ability to make werewolves stronger through touch. Yuseung, on the other hand, wants information on key figures in the werewolf world to eliminate them. 

Will they each get what they’re after? Or more importantly — will they fall in love?

title: TAL
description: They walk like ordinary people, they talk like ordinary people but in fact there is nothing ordinary about them since they can materialize an image they have on their mind… They call themselves Chachaoong which also means Shaman and they do not know how or when they came to this world. It is now a time for their current king to choose the future one and so he did by choosing Yu Jin an ordinary human…? Many of the Chachaoong can not tolerate a human ruling them and now the poor Yu Jin not knowing what suddenly hit him, is trying to avoid the Chachaoongs who are trying to kill him!

title: Slayerdramon Ant
alt_titles: I was Reincarnated as an ANT!
description: A high school student Zheng Lang reincarnated into an ant after the death. The world he lives now is another world, which is under the control of monsters. One day, he ran into some people who accidently intrude this world and they became friends later. A new and exciting journey is waiting for them…

title: Black Dog
description: One youngster, Hei XuYa, self-proclaiming to be history's strongest exorcist, uses his half-beast Black Dog blood to help people exorcise demons as a living. One secret academy isolated from the rest of the world, is a school that specializes in fostering professional exorcists. When Hei XuYa enters the BaCheng Dao Academy, a storm in the exorcising world will break out!

title: Scandal
description:
Sweet and sexy love stories with the theme "entertainment industry" from 7 charming creators. ♥ 7 people, 7 different colors… their love stories begin now!  
  
Vol1 - In A Flash by Mum  
Vol2 - Incompletion by Sagold  
Vol3 - Don't Piss Me Off by Jeong Seokchan  
Vol4 - Finally, Again by Yuan  
Vol5 - End of a Misunderstanding by Kemi  
Vol6 - Yoon Jiwoon Studio by Juns  
Vol7 - Benecia by Bbomeu

title: The Goddess of Abundance and Her Troublemaker Apostle
alt_titles: The Goddess of Abundance and Her Troublemaker Apostle
Goddess of Abundance and the Genius Rogue Apostle
description: Earth’s life force is depleted, and it’s dying. Humanity’s only hope lies with Dispatchers, heroes sent to otherworldly realms to retrieve energy for survival. Chansu Oh is one of them, but despite his legendary father, he has zero talent. However, things change when Chansu is sent to the Block-Style Territory Expansion World as the Apostle of a forgotten, weakened Goddess of Abundance. Armed with nothing but a modified harvesting skill and a desperate drive to find his parents, Chansu must reclaim his territory block by block. From wretched outcast to genius apostle, the hunt to restore his Goddess begins now!

title: 90 Days for the Delicacy
description: The only joy in Viss’ life, while working as a delivery man for the Chinese restaurant Miss Lan China, is when once every three days he gets violently involved with the mysterious handsome man Graven. One day, while musing why Graven would lust after his plain self, Viss, who went to a motel after getting a call from Graven, received the blood-stained body of a man as a gift. The reeking smell of blood caused him to faint, and when he woke up, Graven confessed something shocking to the confused Viss. “Do you remember…the kid you saw at the apple farm ten years ago?”

title: Waves Upon Waves
description:
there's an old legend in Sereong's family: their flute 'Manpa' will turn into a person if you care for it with enough love! But Sereong doesn't believe in this legend and plans to sell Manpa.... But it was then when Manpa turns into a human and tells Sereong he can grant her wish.

A romance between one who grants miracles and one who doesn't believe in miracles.

title: Anyone Can See It's a Beast
description:
Q: Can a wolf and a lion get married and have a rabbit as a kid?
A: Stop talking nonsense, wash your feet, and go to sleep.

... And just like that, I ended up in a situation where I really should just wash my feet and sleep. My dad's a lion, my mom's a wolf, and somehow, I'm a rabbit. Not just any rabbit, an extra who becomes the trigger for a war in the novel! At this rate, not only will everyone die, but both my mom's and dad's entire families will be wiped out.

'No way. I have to change my fate somehow.'

I clenched my fists and stood up determinedly, but then...

"Chloe, do you know what's for dinner tonight? That's right... rabbit meat!"

First things first, I need to make sure the wolves at home don't find out what I really am.

I thought all I had to do was hide the fact that I'm a rabbit. But a bigger problem showed up. Of all the countless special abilities among beastmen, I just had to get "being pitied." I thought this life was doomed too, but then...

"We’re not fighting. So... don't cry, okay? Please."

My parents, who even stopped a war because they were worried about me.

"Just say the word. If you want, I can kill everyone who's bullying you."

And even the original novel's male lead, who's gone a little overboard taking my side.

Honestly... stopping a war might be easier than I thought. Maybe this ability... is more useful than I realized?

title: I Am the Prince of This Land
description: Oliver, a hairdresser, has undertaken a journey to rescue a princess who possesses hair made of gold. It is said that the princess is far away in a tower that is surrounded by monsters. The journey proves to be challenging for Oliver who has only wielded a pair of scissors all of his life. Within the first few days, he is attacked by a beast. The beast attempts to… kiss him?! What is to happen next?!

title: Valkyrie Agency
description: Valhalla, the tower that lies at the center of humanity's defences from the Oculus, a race of enigmatic and feral creatures that slaughter humans. Descending from Valhalla, the warriors known as Valkyries are fighting and risking their lives to face the Oculus.

title: The Ex-Mercenary Prosecutor
alt_titles: The Former Mercenary's Life as a Prosecutor
The Prosecutor's Blade: A Former Mercenary's Revenge
The Life of a Former Mercenary Inspector
description:
Jeonghwan, once a legendary mercenary, returns under an identity no one expected— a prosecutor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his mother’s mysterious death, the tragedy that robbed him of his peace and future. To take his revenge, Jeonghwan must wield two weapons: violence for those who stand in his way, and the law for those who must be judged.
___
"The ones who took away my entire life, they will pay for it.”
To uncover the secret behind his mother’s death, legendary mercenary Lee Jeong-hwan returns as a prosecutor.
His revenge begins against those who took his mother’s life and trampled on his once-ordinary existence.
Threats that stand in his way will be dealt with by force, and those who deserve judgment will be dealt by the law.

title: My Guild is Full of Demons
description: Yan Yongqing, once an elite adventurer, faces betrayal by the Light Angel at the brink of victory, leading to his team's demise. Reborn with a Demon Lord System, he starts anew, rising from Level 1 to lead a terrifying army of demons! With top-tier demons like Satan and Lucifer at his command, it's time to turn the tables on the angels and claim his vengeance.

title: The Day the Flowers Bloom
description: Choi Na-Ra, an ordinary school girl, was saved by a mystery guy wearing glasses. She falls head over heels for him at first sight. Is this the beginning of a love triangle? Will there be a day when the flowers bloom for Na-Ra?

title: Restarting the Life of the Loser Princess
description:
Her Royal Highness the Princess became the Queen somehow...
Her Royal Highness the Princess was beheaded for no apparent reason...
Her Royal Highness the Princess was inexplicably reborn as a 6-year-old...
Her Royal Highness the Princess Level 999...
This time Her Royal Highness is going to kill everyone!
Who said that only heroes can restart their lives? ! 

Adapted From : 廢柴公主LV999 (Wasteful Princess Level 999)

title: The Dragon Cubs Arrive! Mommy Is a Dragon
alt_titles: The Dragon Cub Is Coming! Mommy Is Fierce and Spicy
description: Five years ago, she left an egg and said, "This is the son I gave birth to you. When he grows up, that will be my return date." A few months later, the son broke out of the shell, with two shiny eggs on his head. Xiao Longjiao, she hadn't returned at te date. She disappeared for five years, and he went crazy for five years, until the little dragon cub brought back a woman... But the little dragon cub said, "Dad, she saved me, and I want to commit myself to her!" Infighting.

title: Romantical Behind
description:
The new boy group sensation “Poison” is out to conquer the K-Pop scene with their buff bodies and sexy charm. With a successful debut and thousands of eager fans, everything seems to be going well…or is it? As the group’s prim and proper leader, Sihyun should be dreaming of chart domination. But instead, his dreams are filled with fantasies about his groupmate, the sullen and mysterious Seong-eun. As the two spend more and more time together, they get caught up in a whirlwind of muddled passion and sweaty tension, both on and off the stage. Will they manage to keep things together? And will those dreams be fulfilled?  
  
**Spanhish** : ||  
Apariencias espectaculares y cuerpos dignos de un idol ¡Poise On!  
Sihyun parece duro, pero este líder siempre se pone nervioso.  
Junto con Sung Eun, hay un secreto que no se le puede contar a nadie,   
“Sung… ¿Está bien que hagamos esto?”  
||  


---

**Links**:  
  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Author’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/popblink)

title: Psychomachia
description: When Ming Shu finished his training and returned to Dongye City's Bureau of Criminal Investigation, he found himself abruptly reunited with Xiao Yu'an—his old neighbor and childhood friend who disappeared from his life years ago without a word. Not only is Xiao Yu'an suddenly back in Ming Shu's life, he's been instated as Ming Shu's boss. What's more, they suddenly become roommates and start living together as well! At the same time, Ming Shu is faced with a string of baffling murder cases: an unemployed man suddenly goes berserk in a cafe, a band's most diligent member dies under bizarre circumstances, and a mysterious game room seems to host more than games…

title: Rebirth of the Divine Doctor
alt_titles: Miracle Doctor, Abandoned Daughter: The Sly Emperor’s Wild Beast-Tamer Empress
Shenyi Qi Nü: Gui Di De Yu Shou Kuang Fei
description:
The mentally disabled 13 year old daughter of the Ye family, one day re-births! She rules over the Omnipotent God’s Cauldron, she possesses a spirit cultivation space. She’s no longer the good-for-nothing, abandoned girl who everyone bullies whenever they see her! With her incomparable poisons, even miracle doctors have to move to the side.  
  
Spirit beasts beg for contracts, but too bad, even the God of Beasts have to call her Boss. Scum father, you dare to abandon your wife and daughter, she will surely make him destitute and homeless. People of the world, you dare to bully her, to insult her, she will definitely pay them back a hundredfold.  
  
Reborn again into the world, she returns as a sovereign, but who knew she would attract the nefarious-blood-thirsty-demon him. He’s definitely the sly emperor who doesn’t hesitate to kill and cut down anyone, but he transforms into a harmless foolishly cute prisoner prince of an enemy country……

title: The Archduke's Magical Business Partner
alt_titles: The Terminally-Ill Villain Supports My Broken Engagement
The Time-Limited Villain Supports My Broken Engagement
description:
Waking up in a novel is bad enough, but being the villainess Daphne Peregrine is even worse! Knowing the doomed character's fate, Daphne starts mending her strained relationship with her family, hoping they'll let her move to a peaceful land. Since she'll need money, Daphne asks the enigmatic Archduke Luciel Gresbel to go into the antidote-making business with her so she can use his noble connections. Will the original Daphne's past misdeeds ruin her plans, or can she dodge her untimely death?

---
After dying in a car accident, I possessed the villainess 'Daphne' in an R-rated dark romance novel.

"Of all people, why did I have to possess her? This life isn't going to be easy either..."

But this life is surprisingly sweet and enjoyable!

Thanks to the knowledge of herbs I gained in my past life to make a living, I developed a hit business item.

"My sister is a hero who saved us!"

"Weren't you calling me a witch before?"

"Th-that was in the past..."

I also gained adorable twin cousins.

Somehow, I ended up restoring strained family relationships, making my taciturn and awkward family members cry tears of joy.

And even...

"Why would you eat something unsavory when there's something delicious right in front of you?"

I even acquired a business partner who, despite being frail but full of charm, is determined to win me over with their good looks! (Of course, I didn't realize this innocent Grand Duke was the mastermind behind everything at the time.)

Could life get any better? A 200% happiness index, living the high life as a villainess!

title: The Villain's Daughter Plans to Run Away
description:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!
I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?

title: The Dilettante
description:
Stay until you're drunk on me. One day, top counterterrorism agent Hana Lee receives news of her twin brother's passing. Unable to accept the death of her only living relative, she sets out to uncover the truth. Along the way, she gets tangled up with the mysterious Eunseong Yoo and the cold-blooded mafia boss, Giulio Parenti.

Note: The English webtoon was released as R15, it's not R19 like the original novel. It is not confirmed if the Korean release will have a mature (R19) version. This series is the sequel to 페어 트레이드 (Fair Trade) which does not have a webtoon adaptation. The 2nd ML in this story is the ML in The Dilettante

title: Celeb Lady
description: The Ugly Duckling Becomes the Empire’s Top Celebrity! Juliet Karenina, the era’s hottest celebrity, wakes up in the body of noblewoman Louvetria Diorlos in another world. Faced with a clumsy body and a timid personality, Louvetria endures bullying from those around her: Twins who mock and ostracize her. Her unrequited love, Kedric, who scowls at her. Her step-grandmother, Molga, who torments her in secret. But with Juliet’s spirit inside her, Louvetria won’t tolerate it anymore. “I won’t stand for this, no matter who it is. “Louvetria’s bold transformation begins!

title: Stalker's Game
description: Why did the stalker choose Hyunsung? It began with gifts. First, candies, milk cartons, confectionaries piling outside his small apartment’s door. Then, the meals. Dinner cooked and waiting for him, perfectly timed for when he arrived late from his mundane office job. Soon he began to accept it, the feeling of being watched, like it even. But why him? Who is the stalker? Can Hyunsung really let this continue…trust him? Or is it all just a game…

title: Dear Brand
description: There are three genders in this world: ABO. Hitman Mo Jia Wen received a mission to assassinate the talented researcher, Shao Yuan Fan. However, in contact with Shao Yuan Fan, he found out that this person has an unknown past, and those past unexpectedly is related and linked to him in countless ways…

title: Adopted Boys
description: Yeo Ju, planned to confess to her childhood friend through a novel and even signed with a publishing company. Yeo Ju then is bound by money when she tries to leave the publishing company.

title: To Level up and Chew a Newbie
alt_titles: Raising a Newbie to Use Them
Raising a Newbie to Grind Them
description: 「Asta Chronicles」, where the seeds of MMORPG appeared like a comet in the dry game market. On the day when the notice of the ‘mythology’ difficulty raid update, which is the most recent update in a long time, was announced, the heart of Ji-Jeong (Seong Cha-hyun), the master of the famous guild ‘Haste’, who ranked first in all server guild rankings and recorded the most records for first clear, is excited. However, this time, of course, he logged on to the game with the intention of completing the first one, and on that very day, he heard the news that his partner healer would be enlisting!

title: Throne of the Dragon King
description: A transmigration out of the blue and he had reincarnated as the Eldest Crown Prince of the Eastern Dragon Palace, Ao Fan. He had to inherit the Eastern Dragon Palace and become the next Eastern Dragon King. At the time of the crisis, Ao Fan discovered the existence of the system and activated it which brings him lots of items and points! "Deities killing one another, fighting anyone I meet on the way. I'll defeat anyone who refuses to comply with me!" He swore to lead the Dragon Clan to rise again and contend for hegemony among the divine investitures!

title: Deadbeat Hero
description:
Na Gangnam has been a jobless deadbeat for years, leeching off his poor ol’ mom. But one day, he suddenly decides that he’s going to start being a good son starting the next day.

While sleeping, he wakes up from a loud noise and opens his window… but what’s this? Why is there a slime in front of his house?

He ended up being thrown into a fantasy world along with his entire house?! Gangnam’s journey back home, I mean, to his mother starts now.

title: Soaring Heavenly Dragon
description: After the loss of their family, the Ling Family’s descendants flee for shelter. Unexpectedly, they come across a young man while escaping. From then on, they commence the path of the unknown.

title: How to survive the rainy season
The Nest of Eternity
description: After the hoobae that I secretly loved died in an unfortunate accident, Sarang took the couple’s child, Yungwon, in and started raising her. Sarang is raising Yungwon with love and affection, accepting all of her. Yungwon, misunderstanding all the affection, commemorates her 20th birthday by stating that she will go out with Sarang.

title: Summer Breeze
description:
In an unfamiliar place I met a boy with a not so unfamiliar gaze. After the summer breeze passes, we will be…  
  
Han Gyung Chal's new summer special!

title: I Have a Set of Passive Skills
alt_titles: I Have a Body Full of Passive Skills
description:
“Is the strongest skill in the world a skill that needs to be actively used?”

“Wrong! It’s a passive skill!”

“What is a passive skill?”

“A passive skill is an instant-activated active skill, a killing move that no one will be prepared for, the ultimate trump card that only the dead can know!”

“Can you explain it in simpler terms?” 

“Breathing techniques, strength, perception…” 

“Heh, is that it?”

title: Blinding Flower
description: An S class leveled witch family has finally gotten a baby with extremely high amount of magic. But, why is it a boy? As your mother, I can only raise you like a girl and live like a girl.

title: Hello, Mr. Blue
description:
"She who is afraid of water, what kind of love song will she compose when she meets him who is wandering in the sea?" One day, Areum received a phone call saying that she had a younger brother who was adopted to France? That man is also a world-renowned diving expert! What exactly is going on?  
  
This is a story about a woman who is afraid of the water and a man that prefers being underwater by the same artist who drew "Honey Honey Wedding".

title: Zero: The Beginning of the Coffin
alt_titles: Zero: The Beginning of the Coffin
description: Having been born in a secret government laboratory that cultivated esper (telepathic) powers within humans, Shuuichi and two sisters, Sumire and Katsumi, are forced to endure a difficult life as test subjects until their escape. Years later, these siblings are still being sought after by unknown organizations that are after Shuuichi's powers as he is what they refer to as the “zero-sample” with the ability to cause “zero-shock.”

title: My System Is Serious
alt_titles: Seres's Resolve: The Battle for Humanity
description: I'll never stop fighting tooth and nail to safeguard humanity and all people under heaven. It's time to power up the system once more, ramping up its capabilities to meet this crucial challenge!

title: TACIT
description:
The world that fell due to pollutants that release the zombie virus and the people who adjusted to that place.
A village called 'Amina' that had great resources and was where professor 'Simon' lived.
However, the people of 'Amina' fall into despair after 'Simon' disappears.
And 'Ruby' who was born in 'Amina'.
Incidents that had been buried slowly start to reappear because of her...

---

title: The Girl and the Geek
description: Single with no regular job, Go Nanhee starts a new cleaning gig and meets Oh Deokhoo; literally the filthiest, NERDIEST guy she's ever seen! If that wasn't bad enough, his uber expensive action figure goes missing during her shift! Now she's stuck cleaning his messy apartment in order to pay him back. Can a man who's only ever seen a girl in games and a woman who only fawns over stars on TV… actually fall in love?

title: Star Dream Idol Project
alt_titles: Xing Meng Ou Xiang Ji Hua
description: The shining lights, the magnificent stage! Friendships created through singing, making a future through dancing, the girls embark on their journey towards their dreams! One who has lost status due to a scandal is hiding a plot behind her back. A pair of bosom friends, separated by fate. A girl who tries to exonerate her mother sets off on her journey for a talent competition. When the stage turns into an empty battlefield, she uses her voice to chase after her dreams.

title: I Took Over The System Players
description: College student, Xing Ye gained the ability to take over another person’s body with a success rate of 100%, but by chance took over the body of a necromancer. This necromancer turns out to be the owner of the system, and it’s all because of this system that he’s a corpse after dying. This system gives suicide missions with no regards of the host’s abilities, but Xing Ye finds this suicide system quite compatible with him now that he’s a corpse? “Hahaha, I’m already dead, what do I have to fear?”

title: Play House
description:
A man who has no luck in finding love goes to a renowned shaman after suffering countless breakups. The shaman says that the reason for his lack of luck is his best friend Dohyun. The two of them have to be connected by the string of fate for a month to restore Chang-ho’s luck. How will they survive living together?  
  
Chang-ho, cuya suerte amorosa ha sido aniquilada,  
va a encontrarse con una chamán después de divorciarse.  
La chamán dijo que la razón por la que el romance se esfumó fue porque …  
¡Doyoon, su mejor amigo, era el culpable!  
Los dos, deberán estar unidos por un lazo del destino durante un mes  
para restaurar el romance perdido.  
¿Cómo se desarrollarán las cosas?

title: I Was Forced by the System to Become a Villain
alt_titles: Zhengyi De Wo Bei Xitong Bi Cheng Da Fanpai
As a Righteous Person, I Was Forced by the System to Become a Villain
Zhèngyì De Wǒ Bèi Xìtǒng Bī Chéng Dà Fǎnpài
description:
Lin Bei, who traveled through time and became the second senior brother of Lingxi Peak of the Qingyun Sect, determined to be a good person, but ended up getting entangled in a system that specialized in cultivating supervillains.

Lin Bei had no choice but to go against his original intention and turn into a big bad guy to compete with the countless children of destiny on the Kyushu Continent for luck and save his life.

title: Cradle of Imae
description: Ryujin, a child born of fire. The day of his birth an exorcist from the capital warned “beware of flames”. As Ryujin grew older, he soon loses everything to a fire. Heeding the exorcists words, he travels to the capital. Lost on the path Ryujin encounters Imae, a strange first encounter. From then on they begin a close relationship.

title: Flight Highschool
description:
Flight Highschool is a series of webcomics created by Anyan. It features anthropomorphized modern military aircraft living daily lives in high school.  
  
Original naver page: <http://blog.naver.com/jk100687>

title: A Strange Joke
description:
This is the story of two people living out their campus romance, the returning transfer student Min who has a tough time with love and the department legend Joon who's scared of romance.  
  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Veiled Armor: Awakening
description: Hua Xiaoyao is an orphan. One day, he ran into Decra, who was carrying out a mission, and got dragged into Decra's fight with a Malady. In a moment of crisis, an extraordinary power burst forth from his left hand's middle finger and helped Decra defeat the Malady. It attracted the attention of Mr. Marlowe from the Golden Ibero Central Academy, who sent Hua Xiaoyao an invitation to take the academy's entrance exam. That's because Hua Xiaoyao may be related to the New Human Project more than ten years ago...

title: The Crazy Adventures of Mystical Doctor
alt_titles: Miss Wu, the god of the wife
description: After the modern female killer travelling crossed, she was reborn as a loser in this new world - Sima Youyue, the fifth young master in the generals' residence. As a result, she began the way of grass counterback, collecting all kinds of magical animals and artifacts, and started the adventures to meet with the actors…

title: Steady Affection
description:
“Why don’t we —— ?”   
  
Jung Dahoon laughed out loud at a joke his longtime friend Gu Junhee made. However, Junhee had a strange expression on his face.   
After that day, their relationship, which was nothing more than steady friends, began to drift in a different direction.   
Can they be more than just friends?   
  
A soft and endlessly sweet BL of one’s youth starts now~ ♡♡

title: Annoying Alice
description:
Alice is so annoying!  
All she does is cause trouble and make fun of me…  
but why can't I stop thinking about her?  
  
[lezhin raw](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/cute_jung)

title: God of Wine
description:
Mixing cocktails at a level beyond anyone else in the world, a sommelier, the one known as the liquor god Li Jie Dong. He died at the age of thirty in order to taste the recently excavated wine from the Han Dynasty.  

When he awoke, he found himself in the world of the Five Element Continents as Ji Dong the little beggar. In this place, there was a special occupation known as the Yin Yang Spiritual Masters who control the the 10 elements of the sexagenary cycle. These bizarre 10 elemental techniques could make anyone gasp in amazement. Each and every Yin Yang Spiritual Master has their own Ying Yang crown that is condensed by one’s own attribute.  

Due to the abundant love the people held for their wine and liquor, bartenders gradually gathered together to form a guild. This guild is named the Bartender Guild, and is respected by all.

---

**Note:** Starting with ch. 81, the manhua switches to the long strip format. MangaDex decided to follow Inkr's decision and just keep it split.
[**God of Wine: Season 2**](https://mangadex.org/title/2cd214f0-3dd8-4c75-b1b4-973c2c53b72b)

title: Hunter Academy’s Strongest Battle God (Promo)
description: Evaluated as having the lowest attribute type, F-Class, the five-year-old Shin Yu-Sung was abandoned by the famous Shin hunter family. That same year, Shin Yu-Sung was taken in by one of the top Hunters, the King of Fighters, at his orphanage. The King of Fighters, who had obtained the highest attribute type with his "physical strength" and not his attributes or other abilities, saw Shin Yu-Sung in a different light. Ninth Pulse “Your innate ninth pulse is overflowing in your body with mana! Extreme intellect! And an ethereal appearance! But you’ll die before becoming an adult…” And Yang Body Type “The energy of the Yang Body that can cure the Ninth Pulse is overflowing in your body!” In the King of Fighter’s eyes, Shin Yu-Sung only had an F-Class attribute, but is a monster born with the body and constitution that appeared once every millennium. Thus, having been abandoned by his family because of his talent, Shin Yu-Sung ironically became the King of Fighter’s pupil because of it. Twelve years passed and Shin Yu-Sung, who finished all the preparations, finally left the mountains where he had trained. Shin Yu-Sung’s strength isn’t an attribute that Hunters value but is simply his “physical strength.” A hunter, that's unlike any seen before, was born.

title: Zippy Ziggy
description:
Reputation is everything in a world of icons and popularity contests. So why not score some points here and there by being the nice guy? This is the way Kang Shin-gi legitimizes the fake personality he has everyone believing. Armed with his above average looks and a (completely false) angel-like personality, he has every girl in school head over heels, and all the guys looking to him for guidance. With the exception of having a screwed up cross-dressing devil for a dad, Shin-gi’s life is absolute perfection (*cough* of lies), until one day, Um Seung-hui transfers to his school.  
  
While being a complete martial artist freak, she also likes to fib just a little in front of those who know her… you know, like acting like she's just a scared little girl who'd play with kittens rather than break brick walls with her head! After all, how can anything go wrong when you're as cute as Seung-hui?  
  
Fate has brought these two masters of lies together, and the two must battle it out to see who will be crowned the undefeated heavy-weight champion of fakeness!

title: Borderline Bestial Corpse
description: During the holidays, protagonist Mo Bai, his older brother Mo Fan, and their childhood friend Luo Han were attacked by a bestial corpse that had suddenly broken into their house. When Mo Bai woke up, he discovered that he was a bestial corpse, while Mo Fan was rescued by hunters. In order to find his younger brother again, Mo Fan gradually became the strongest hunter in the organization, while the appearance of the S-Rank Mo Bai instilled fear into the people. When the brothers meet once again, they are completely different people, meaning conflict can happen at any time.

title: Bliss In Another World
alt_titles: Welcome to Paradise in Another World
description:
On his way towards the hospital, our protagonist Yang Ni was mugged and killed by someone who despised him. When he woke up, he had arrived in a place in between life and death called "Huang Quan." He learnt that by playing the games in Huang Quan, he could receive a chance to be resurrected and return back to the land of the living. Buckle up for a thrilling adventure with Yang Ni and the friends he makes along the way.  


---

title: I, Who Am Ignorant of This World, Became a Princess
alt_titles: I've Become a Princess Because I'm Ignorant of This World
description:
Jeong-min, who accidentally tore up her classmates’ novel, suddenly found herself in the world of the torn novel after she woke up.
For a bookworm like her, both her current situation and the new world she is in are completely incomprehensible.

Though she has no knowledge of the world she is in, her unique fiery personality will make up for it.

That’s why, no matter what obstacles come’s her way, she will give it her best!

title: King of Hell
description: Going to school during the day, at night, the incarnation of the ghost of the city ghost night ghost, the real identity turned out to be the youngest son of the king of hell, the command of the eleventh yin handsome - Luo Luo Prison! There is also a local girl who claims to be her

title: A Chronicle of Vile Ambitions
description:
A dark chronicle of intrigue and betrayal set in the royal palace of a crumbling kingdom. A chronicle that will make you laugh the second before dropping you into a pit of despair. A chronicle without pretence, a strike straight to the heart.  
  
Third Place Winner of the 11th Chinese Animation & Comic Competition's Golden Dragon Award (金龙奖) for Best Story.

In hiatus since 22 January 2022 with last chapter #60.

title: Inn of Deceiving Stars
description:
After signing a lucrative movie contract, popular actress Bai Ding Ding heads off into the mountains for filming. However, she never could have imagined that what awaited her would be a giant prank – "The Inn of Deceiving Stars (Qi Xing Inn)," a reality show centered around a historical-style inn specifically designed to deceive Ding Ding into thinking she's travelled to the ancient past.   
  
Having fallen for the ruse, Bai Ding Ding is forced to diligently manage the shady Seven Stars Inn (homophone for the program name, aka Qi Xing Inn) in order to survive. Will Ding Ding be able to see through the program's directors and their meticulous plans? What kind of "new life" will begin to play out within the mountainous wilderness?  
  
—  
*PLEASE NOTE* - comic is in wide strip form. Please read the appropriate version for your device.

title: Strange Detective
description: Wang You Cai, who has the abilities of a detective, originally planned to take a break after resigning as a cop; but to his dismay, his friend experienced an unexplainable tragic death. As a detective, he has decided to solve the mystery; while searching for answers, he met the female Mc Zhen Meng, who is part of a mysterious group; confidentially, they start to uncover the truth of many other obnoxious situations. Read to find out more!

title: Senior's Girl's Beating
alt_titles: Xue Zhang Di Xiao Nu Xin
description: A young girl who pretends to be a male god, a black-shouldered younger brother and a pretending to be a lady, is a hard-working model of campus life that strives to keep people from falling apart. In the mutual transformation and mutual supervision, they gradually began to face up to the true self, and love also came quietly. You can live the way you like.

title: Elegant Desire
description: What’s the chance of running into your first love again after twelve years? This is exactly what happens to Solhui after attending her frenemy’s bridal shower. What’s more? Her first love is having an affair with a married woman. But that’s not all. She meets him and the woman again when she starts a viola lesson with a new student.

title: I am a Unicorn
description: The legendary beautiful and mysterious, elegant and noble magical creature... The farm girl Jasmine accidentally met the unicorn Dai Wen in the forest. Although it is beautiful and noble, it seems to be a little less... ...? Under the glamour of TV series and 3C products, Dai Wen gradually became friends with the kind and capable Jasmine. One day, the news reported the news of the extinction of the unicorn, Dai Wen was shocked! For the survival of the race, Devin decided to set out to find other unicorns! Worried that the world-famous Dai Wen would be in danger, Jasmine decided to embark on a journey to find a unicorn with him. Can Dai Wen find the unicorn to succeed in continuing the race?

title: Universe and Sword
description:
A young boy who wants to become a hero, Universe, one day meets a real hero who he admires?  
The young boy who wants to become a hero, Universe, Instead meets The hero Sword, and thus their story begins.  
  
Un jeune garçon qui veut devenir un héros, Wuju, rencontre un jour le vrai héros qu'il admire?   
Le jeune garçon qui voulait devenir un héros, Wuju, devint à la place l'épée du héros.

title: Divorce Proposal
description:
To save her noble family from a massive 100 million debt, Ariana Astaroth marries the wealthy commoner Rowen Green, making him the new Count Astaroth in exchange. But after five years of marriage, he impregnates her best friend, and Ariana demands a divorce, stating that she'll pay him back. She goes to a guild run by a man named Rowen for help, who promises to help her escape the marriage. Can Ariana divorce her disloyal husband, or will the overwhelming debt crush her in the end?

---
One day, a friend who was like a sister to me confessed that she was pregnant with my husband's child.

"Congratulate me, Ariana."

A friend who brazenly demanded a blessing instead of feeling sorry.

"Don't talk nonsense. Do you think divorce is an option?"

A shameless husband who became a Count as a result of a marriage of convenience. Although I chose a strategic marriage to solve the family's debts, I had worked so hard for this marriage...

'Divorce is the only option without a second thought.'

The problem is the marriage contract with my husband. If I file for divorce first, the penalty is a whopping 500 billion won! The only thing I inherited from my father, who poured all his money into preventing the outflow of cultural assets, is a keen eye for beauty. It's a moment that requires an extraordinary divorce strategy!

"Just wait, Rowen. You'll fall in a way that your poor imagination couldn't even conceive."

title: Dragon with Luv
alt_titles: You Long Ze Ling - Xiao Chun
description: This is the story of a girl who traveled to a different world, taming the dragon who wished to devour her and making him her boyfriend.

title: Chaotic Sword God
description:
Jian Chen, the publicly recognized number one expert of the Jianghu. His skill with the sword went beyond perfection and was undefeatable in battle, After a battle with the exceptional expert Dugu Qiubai who had gone missing over a hundred years ago, Jian Chen succumbed to his injuries and died. 

After death, Jian Chen’s spirit was transmigrated into a completely foreign world. Following an extremely fast growth, his enemies piled up one after another before becoming gravely injured once more. 

On the gates of death, his spirit had mutated, and from that moment henceforth, he would tread on a completely different path of the art of the sword to become the sword god of his generation

title: No One on Titan
description: Beneath the freezing skies of Titan, Saturn’s sixth moon, a team of extraterrestrial researchers and their AI companion uncover something that shouldn’t exist: a strange black sphere that defies all known laws of physics, plunging the team into a whirlwind of confusion and fear, and forcing them to confront a force beyond their comprehension.

title: The Lovely Geum Bokhee
description:
Will this love come true some day? Exiting their awkward one-sided loves.  
  
- [Original Webtoon (kakao)](https://page.kakao.com/home/52945034)

title: 2D Partner
description: Down on her luck having graduated from a scammy university with no job prospects Xiao Jun doesn't have a lot of hope for the future but everything changes when a strange creature slinks out of her air conditioner. Could this be the start of a beautiful relationship?

title: Mushoku Tensei - Rudeus Future Diary: Eris (Doujinshi)
description:
講述在魯迪的未來日記中的艾莉絲
及後人神跟艾莉絲的故事
・商品類型: 同人誌
・作品名稱: 無職轉生

・創作題材: 無職轉生
・商品尺寸: A5
