Alright, let’s start with the succession ceremony. I’m sure everything will work out.

title: The Legend of Luoxiaohei
description: A cat spirit, while stealing the famed Heavenly Bright Pearl, was injured heavily by the spirit Diting and turned back into a cat. While wandering the streets, he was adopted by Luo Xiaobai, and became Luo Xiaohei. Their story begins now.

title: A Beautiful Tale of Flower Stories
alt_titles: A Beautiful Tale of Flower Stories
description:
Because of you, I can have hope for the future. I'm willing to pay any price for these true feelings.

Because of an unfulfilled desire, Yongen appears before Yingzi as a ghost. With Yongen having lost her memories, will Yingzi help her recall her incomplete wish?

For a wish, Mari breaks off a sambar deer's antler, which causes her body to change in strange ways. How will Hezhou help her best friend return the antler and make everything right?

Lanying is immediately drawn to Yansheng, who is fated to bear her family's curse. How will Lanying give it her all to help the person she loves escape her fate?

Mirong and ah-Mao were just online friends at first. After a trip to see different tiger gods, they come to learn more about each other. What will happen between them as they grow ever closer?

Four stories, four relationships. They might only have been a brief part of each other's lives, or they might have left a deep imprint in each other's hearts. But it's doubtless that their heartfelt emotions are worth treasuring.

title: Defend the Rose
description: Born into poverty, Boole fights to rise through the ranks of the personal guards for one sole purpose, and that is to be closer to the Saintess. However, in a series of events, he winds up being the royal family's pawn to to defeat the church. On one hand is the girl he has longed for since ages ago, but on the other is the omnipotent crown prince. Which will the young knight choose?

title: The Evolution of Species
description:
Yoon is a free agent, using his extraordinary strength and cunning for any job that comes his way—legal or otherwise. But when a crucial mistake plunges him headfirst into the world of a shadowy crime network known only as the “platform,” he enlists the help of a well-connected alpha named Kwon Shinwoo. Together, these reluctant allies will have to uncover the mysteries of the nefarious platform… and each other.

From the omegaverse world of “The Origin of Species.”

title: Ghostly Grave
description: A group of grave robbers are on the hunt for valuables inside a cave-like crypt. Little do they know that they're soon to find something or lot more unusual and a lot less forgiving than mere treasure.

title: Please Assist with This S-Class Mission
alt_titles: Please Assist with This S-Class Mission
description: After a decade stuck as an E-Class hunter, Hara is suddenly hit with an S-Class Awakening Quest: date the nation’s beloved news anchor, Seheon. There’s just one problem—he’s tied to an embarrassing event from her past she’d rather forget. Still, the promise of S-Class power is too tempting to ignore, so Hara proposes a contractual relationship to Seheon. What starts as a desperate deal for “Official S-Class Mission Assistance” quickly turns into a strange, unpredictable romance.

title: To My Rude Darling With Multiple Personalities
alt_titles: To My Rude Darling With Multiple Personalities
Dear My Rude Darling With Multiple Personalities
description: Life has never been easy for Monica Orphen. She spent her childhood at an orphanage before becoming a war nurse. During the war, she met a soldier named Sol, whose face she never forgot. Years later, by a stroke of luck, she runs into Sol again...except he says his name is Louis? But then the next time she runs into him he’s Garcia, then after that… Enrique? Monica isn’t sure what’s going on, but she isn’t going to give up until she finds out who this man really is!

title: Shadow Princess
description: After the fall of the Kingdom of Jarthewer, Princess Lisselotte and her maid, Hannah, escape to the Grand Duchy of Ralus, home of the princess’s fiancé, Vincent Ralus. Though Hannah has lost her memory after nearly drowning, she stays strong, enduring Lady Charlotte’s daily abuse in hopes of a better future. But everything changes when Vincent asks her to pose as Princess Lisselotte for the 10th-anniversary ceremony of the Jarthewer Republic. Returning means certain death both for her and the princess, but if they can pull off the deception, it may be their only chance at freedom. Stuck between the handsome but cold Vincent and his mischievous and buff guard, Diego, can Hannah succeed in her dangerous role?

title: My Crazy Dramatic Fairy Tale
alt_titles: The End of This Fairytale Is One Hell of a Drama
description: After the girl meets the prince, they live happily ever after, but don't you wonder what happens to the others? My name is Lynette Camellia, and after helping my sister meet her Romeo, I started a gossip column about the empire for fun. But instead of just writing about drama, I'm living it. Not only am I trying to escape an engagement to a man twice my age, but Prince Lucas wants to use me and my column to take down the evil crown prince! Who knew that a fairy tale could be so... dramatic?

title: Blue Valentine
description: PREVIOUSLY: The six girls of NMIXX set off on a journey to reach MIXXTOPIA, a world where everyone's individuality is cherished. Experiencing many difficulties along the way, they fall victim to the villain Monopole's trap and even have their ship set aflame. While repairing the burned ship the girls stay in FIELD, confronting the stubborn prejudices of society and gathering people willing to travel to MIXXTOPIA. The newly repaired MMU sets sail safely once again. In order to reach MIXXTOPIA, NMIXX heads forth into a vast black hole.

title: Rebirth of the Divine Demon
description: Feared as the Divine Demon, Cheon Jeong lived and died on the battlefield, knowing nothing but violence. When death finally claims him, it should have been the end. Instead, he awakens thirty years later in the body of Mujin Hwa, the powerless heir of a ruined clan. His overwhelming strength is gone, replaced by a frail body and enemies closing in from every side. To protect the siblings now in his care and reclaim a clan on the brink of collapse, the fallen legend must begin again and build a future from nothing.

title: I Brought the Mastermind in as a Maid
alt_titles: I Brought the Mastermind in as a Maid
I Hired a Villain as My Housekeeper
description:
I became the manager of a mansion where no one came to work because of the vicious rumors.
Having no talent for housework, I was haunted by a mysophobic ghost and posted a housekeeper job notice in the newspaper.
And I hired the only handsome man who came to me without asking or questioning…

“Thank you for hiring me. Here’s my resume.”

「Name – Dante van Dyke
*Major Career
Former) Commander of the Magic Special Forces
*Joining Aspirations and Future Plans
Planning to clean up the corrupt empire.」

Gasp, what is this!
He was the villain male lead who would later destroy the empire.
Why do you prepare that while doing other people’s housework. I put on a very harmless smile.

“Unfortunately, you have not passed due to your document…”
“Do you not like me?”

I was overwhelmed and frightened by the eerie eyes that sank lower and lower.

“I-it was actually a pressure interview. Pass.”
“What shall I do first, landlady? I’m good at housework, but I’m also good at other things.”

The man who suddenly changed into a friendly person gently showed a charming eye smile.

“I’d be happy to work the night as well.”
“What did you say?”
“I mean working overtime.”

He was very much desperate.
Even that’s not enough—the sword master, the devil, and the mage tower lord came together…

“I came here after seeing job postings for a cook, gardener, and butler. Let me do anything, Master.”

Ah, don’t plot treason in my house!

title: Fox Sisters
description: Scary Gumihos who haunt humans and eat their livers... are nothing like these two fox sisters. The eventful daily life of 'Ryuwol' and 'Ryuhwa'!

title: Age of Death
description: Mok, a son of a Yangban, becomes seriously ill and finds out that he's being protected by four divine spirits and is also gifted with special abilities. After he is cured, he is able to see the world of spirits and ghosts. Fortunately, his new friend Han helps him in his new life between the worlds of humans and spirits, because with these new abilities, new adventures await him… (From: MU)

title: Dog & Fish's Sonata
description: The Hou brothers left their original deep-sea dragon palace and finally arrived in a land city. Life here is indeed more exciting and lively than they imagined, every day is incredibly fulfilling, and they've made many new friends… Here you can see everything familiar from your life, and maybe one day you'll even encounter that beast around the corner.

title: I Am the Obsessive Emperor's Talented Pharmacist
alt_titles: I Am the Obsessive Emperor's Talented Pharmacist
I Am a Competent Pharmacist of the Obsessive Emperor
description: Hailey is an obscure palace pharmacist in the BL guideverse rofan novel "Ties of Obsession," which is what the reader vaguely recalls upon waking up in her body. Even without Hailey's memories, the new Hailey thwarts the evil head pharmacist's attempt on Emperor Damion's life and is rewarded with the position of his personal pharmacist. Although the contract Damion makes her sign is a lifelong one, it pays a crazy high salary, and her patient's handsome face is a nice perk. What Hailey doesn't foresee is Damion getting attached to her before meeting his gay lover from the original novel!

title: One Day
description:
Various short stories from an upcoming Chinese Manhua artist, Benjamin.  
  
Two stories are in black & white, while two other stories are evidence for Benjamin's profound sense for colored illustrations.  
  
The main character of the entitled story, male and contemptuous of how people from his parents generation live their life, spends a day when everything goes wrong. At the end of the story, he realizes that he himself is on the same path as the older generation.

title: The Defectives
description: Amikor Lu Bixing, a Nyolcadik Galaxis hipsztere beleszeretett egy B4 nevű gengszterbe, nem tudta, hogy a drágasága valójában Lin Jingheng admirális, az Ezüst Erőd parancsnoka. Ahogy jobban megismerték egymást, a világ drámaian megváltozott: csillagközi kalózok szállták meg a Csillagközi Uniót. Az Édennel kapcsolatos kellemetlen titkok napvilágra kerültek. Lu Bixing származása hihetetlenül rejtélyesnek bizonyult. De csak egymásra vágytak, függetlenül attól, hogy milyen különös volt a körülöttük lévő világ.

title: All Villains Are Idiots
description: Peter Mack, a natural born nerd, and a CIA agent who focuses mainly on internal missions. One day he is assigned to a mission which is believed to determine the outcome of World War iii. During the mission he meets Linus Sweeney, a handsome genius who broke his heart 8 years ago. Peter must suppress his past feelings so he can chase him around the world to secure a dangerous weapon in which Linus developed. The issue is every time Linus approaches him he whispers sweet words into his ear, which makes Peter's heart race…

title: My Husband Hides His Regression, so Do I
alt_titles: My Husband Hid the Fact That He Had Returned in Time—so I, Too, Chose to Keep My Secret
My Husband Hid His Regression From Me, so I Hid It From Him Too
description:
She only realised it after her contract husband died— that he had turned back time thousands of times just to save her.​

---
***Note:** This is a promotional oneshot for a novel of the same name.*

title: A glimpse into Jianghu
description: Zhou Jinchen, who lost his eyes in the tragic massacre of his family, sets out on a path of revenge after taming a wolf to serve as his guide dog...

title: Genius Cute Baby: Heaven-Defying Mother Is Hacking Again
description: On her wedding night, she was betrayed and harmed by a scoundrel, forcing her to survive in the lower realm. He has returned through reincarnation, devoted entirely to the affairs of the state, yet harboring deep, hidden personal motives. One is a Dragon Lady of the lower realm, the other is a reincarnated Phoenix Lord; both entered a partnership and a fake marriage solely to further their own agendas, finding nothing but mutual dislike in one another. However, why does the little phoenix still in the womb feel like pink bubbles of romance are starting to pop up between them?

title: Salt Society
description:
Jo Yeon-oh est un alpha hyper-dominant, héritier de la Fondation Haeseong et PDG de la galerie Naban. À ses côtés depuis l'enfance se trouve So Gi-hyeon, un bêta qui veille sur lui en secret depuis des années. Leur relation, qui semblait indestructible, commence à se fissurer lorsque Gi-hyeon se confie. À l'instant où Gi-hyeon révèle ses sentiments longtemps enfouis, Yeon-oh réagit par un haut-le-cœur humiliant.

« Tu as oublié que tu es un bêta. »

Un alpha qui éprouve un dégoût viscéral à l'idée de sortir avec un bêta. Face à ce rejet cruel et profond, Gi-hyeon tente d'enfouir ses sentiments, mais Yeon-oh refuse même cela. Animé par une obsession égoïste et un besoin de contrôle sur ce qu'il considère comme sien, Jo Yeon-oh ne permettra pas à Gi-hyeon de le quitter.

« Très bien. Sortons ensemble. Espèce d'égoïste. »

Au lieu de rompre les liens, une relation de mensonges s'installe. Pourtant, puisque c'est le choix de Yeon-oh, Gi-hyeon l'accepte sans protester.

« Si tu ne peux vraiment pas le supporter, je t'ai dit que je t'aiderais à trouver quelqu'un. Reste avec les omégas si tu peux. »

Même pendant leur relation, Yeon-oh suggère froidement à Gi-hyeon de coucher avec d'autres, une forme perverse de considération qui blesse profondément Gi-hyeon. Finalement, Gi-hyeon atteint ses limites. Et au terme de son long et désespéré amour non partagé, Gi-hyeon est confronté à une transformation physique qu'il croyait impossible.

Jo Yeon-oh, un homme prisonnier d'une possessivité maladive et d'un déni de sa propre attirance, et So Gi-hyeon, qui a ravalé ses blessures en silence jusqu'à ce qu'il choisisse finalement de fuir. Où mèneront finalement ces deux êtres si différents ?

title: Rosemary's Fairy Tales
description: Rosemary has been asleep for seven hundred years, and finally wakes up from her nightmare to find that the "prince" has divided her land and taken away the treasures of the kingdom, leaving only a cursed land that no longer has life. She vowed to take everything back, put on the crown of thorns, and crown herself king. From then on, the red-haired princess of Algers embarked on a journey and began a bloody feast of hunting the prince.

title: Taking a Summer's Bite
description: On a scorching summer day, two youths scarred by loss and pain find an unexpected refuge in each other. Yu Chan, burdened by the torment of hearing the thoughts of others, and Ha Jio, struggling with loneliness and the weight of a broken family fate, cross paths by chance. What begins as mere curiosity soon grows into a profound bond that compels them to confront their hidden wounds, unspoken fears, and untold stories. Amid a closed-off village and a world that refuses to understand them, they learn that every choice brings loss—but also the chance for true change. That summer, which they thought would be nothing but painful and scorching, becomes the brightest and most transformative season of their lives: the summer they discover hope and love.

title: Indestructible Demon Fist
description: Magic can help people achieve extraordinary things, but it can also bewitch hearts and bring destruction. Due to years of misuse of magic, the world is ravaged. To stop the collapse, humanity launched the "War of Sealing Magic," and after a long and fierce battle, finally defeated the Magic King, Gumur, ending the age of magic. However, the wounds left by magic are difficult to erase, so humanity established the "Demon Sealing Bureau," to both purge the remaining demons and repair this ravaged world...

title: Perfect Shooter
description:
While the Tianwang Team’s players and fans are still basking in the joy of winning the 2024 season championship of the D3 Second Health League and being promoted to the D2 Asia Health League, the team’s ace pitcher Marco Garcia unexpectedly falls into a psychological crisis of being “overlooked.”
Once plagued by severe self-doubt and a loss of confidence, Garcia must confront and overcome his inner psychological barriers.
Can he break through himself and reclaim his place as the true trump card in the hearts of both the Tianwang Team and its fans?

title: Bunker Days
description: As a child, Seo-woo rejected Won-hyeok, the boy who once led her into the darkness of a bunker. Years later, now a high school student living a life of bitter isolation, Seo-woo finds herself driven to the edge. In the middle of an attempt to end it all, she stumbles upon another abandoned bunker and steps inside to hide. But her sanctuary becomes a prison when she is trapped inside by none other than Won-hyeok—who returns drenched in fresh blood.

title: My Boy
description: Cowboy is a four-panel comic series drawn by Hong Kong cartoonist Wong Sima in the 1970s and early 1980s. The comic was originally serialized in the supplement of Ming Pao for many years and was later compiled and published as a book by Boyi Publishing Group Co., Ltd. The complete set of Cowboy consists of 41 volumes, telling the life fragments and interesting stories between the two fathers, Cowboy and "father", in the comic. It describes the appearance of a well-off family in Hong Kong at that time and also shows the innocence of Cowboy and his affection for his father. The prototypes of Cowboy and father cartoon are the author Wong Sima and his three sons.

title: Turning Point
description:
Baek Sarang, who was comfortable eating alone, meditating alone, and drinking alone.
Yu Pyeonghwa wants to get along with others even at a loss.
Love and peace, who have lived conflicting lives, meet each other and learn a new way of life.
A realistic romance that is more adult than you think and more childish than you think

title: The Heart-Pounding Operation
description: "Don't you think we're missing that heart-fluttering feeling?" From elementary school all the way to high school, Nam Do-yeon and Jeong A-rin have gone from childhood friends to lovers. For a couple who strives for a perfectly rational relationship, a plan to reclaim that one missing piece of excitement— Operation: Heartbeat begins!

title: The Genius Prismatic Mage
alt_titles: The Genius Magician Who Sees the Rainbow
description: In a world where you must steal or be stolen, kill or be killed, Ray, an orphan from the 50th sector, possesses the unique ability to see mana in the form of colors. However, despite the colorful sparks that fill the world around him, his existence has been numb detachment, completely devoid of emotions. But when a life-altering event shatters the cold, unfeeling life he once knew, Ray's journey might just unfold into a story richer in color than he could have ever imagined.

title: The Delinquent and the Gangster Heiress
description:
The rough and wild delinquent, Jang Tae-ho, gets dragged off to his grandma’s countryside house on the very first day of summer break, thanks to his parents’ brilliant plan (or maybe a scheme).
Waiting for him there is none other than the gangster heiress, Min Ju-a!

With a gun pointed straight at a stunned Tae-ho, Ju-a declares:
“I kidnapped you to make you my underling.”

And so begins the chaotic, action-packed summer break of the delinquent Jang Tae-ho and the gangster heiress Min Ju-a!

title: Bongchon Bride
description:
"He bought me for 50 sacks of rice."
Soongap is nearly beaten to death by his master when friendly giant Bongchun buys him and saves his life. Bongchun's blind mother is delighted, believing her son has finally brought home a bride. And the more Bongchun treats Soongap like his darling bride, the more things get heated...

title: To Hell With the Status Window
alt_titles: To Hell With the Status Window
description:
The strongest man of the Murim, “Asura,” got transported to another world.

Having reached the pinnacle through his martial capabilities alone, he smashes the status window and the tower with his own hands—rejecting participation as a player outright.

title: A Hero Who Knows His Stuff
alt_titles: The Return of the World Savior
The One Who Saved a World Before Will Be Best at Saving Another
description:
For 20 years, Hyeonseok fought monsters in another world before finally managing to save it and be sent back to Earth as a reward. 

Now a former deliveryman named Chanseok, he looks forward to enjoying modern conveniences, only to discover that Earth is very different from what he remembers. Monsters have started appearing from Erosion Points that pop up at random, and people with innate abilities become Hunters to defeat them. 

Reluctantly, Chanseok applies to become a Hunter himself, mostly for the money. He saved the world once before, so how hard can it be the second time?

title: Reincarnated Streamer
description:
Lee Soo-hyuk, the "Master of Thunder," was once hailed as the strongest player. However, during a Tower raid, he was betrayed and killed by a trusted friend.

In his final moments, he exhausted all his power to save his comrades. Yet, despite feeling death take him, he awoke to find himself reincarnated 20 years in the future.

In this new era, the truth has been buried, and the traitor, Kim Il-soo, reigns supreme as the top player. 

To exact his revenge —and for the sake of the allies who might still be waiting for him—Soo-hyuk must become strong again, and fast.

"Doing things the same way as before won't work."

Given a second chance at life, the former champion chooses a new path... Live Streaming! It doesn't matter if the world is full of streamers imitating the legendary Lee Soo-hyuk.

"Because I'm the real deal."

title: Yaksha
description:
Ten years ago, a coup took place within the Haegang Faction, and the protagonist, Kang Min, lost his big brother—someone who was like a father to him.

Burning with rage, Kang Min hunts down and punishes the traitors, but is arrested in the process and sentenced to life imprisonment.

Then, ten years later, the police—trying to keep the now out-of-control Haegang Faction in check—release Kang Min through a suspension of sentence.

And so begins the blood-soaked revenge of Kang Min, the Yacha of Hell!

title: Divorcing the Emperor
alt_titles: How Can There Be a Divorce When We Haven't Even Married, Your Majesty?
I'm Not Even Married, What Divorce, Your Majesty?
description: As a self-proclaimed expert on archdukes of the north, Krisha has one goal in life. To marry one. However, all her plans are immediately overturned when she finds out she's already married to the emperor. To make matters worse, he wants a divorce! If that happens, not only will she become a divorcee at age 21, but she'll be banished from the mainland for the next 10 years. Though she sets out to give the emperor a piece of her mind, little does she know he's not the only obstacle to her dream...

title: Bad Plan
description: Lee Joo-hyuk (the team leader) doesn’t understand why his subordinate Park Hwi-rim is only very cold and stiff with him whereas he has good interpersonal relationships with the rest of his colleagues….getting furious, Joo-hyuk decides to approach Hwi-rim with a wicked plan !!

title: Falling can't kill Uika Misumi
alt_titles: A Fall Like That Can’t Kill Uika Misumi

title: Winter Season
description:
Lee Hyun’s life that day was no different from any other, until Gu Seunghyeok, the man he had broken up with nine years ago, appeared.
“Did we ever start running a hole for hire business here?
I did not know you were selling a man’s ass for money too.”
Seunghyeok turns out to be the owner of Club Nexus, where Lee Hyun works.
The moment they come face to face, he spits out cruel words and looks at Lee Hyun with open disgust, as if he is staring at something filthy.
“Why are you looking at someone like that? It hurts.
I finally run into an old friend after all this time, and I am offering him a good opportunity.”
It feels like proof of the saying that misfortune always comes all at once.
After meeting Seunghyeok, disaster begins to sweep through Lee Hyun’s ordinary life, and the bond between them, seemingly ready to snap yet never fully breaking, lingers like a thin thread.
“If you need money, just say it straight.
Say you have gotten desperate enough to need money earned from beating people up.”
Back then, did you look at me the same way?
With eyes full of disgust?
What kind of face did you have, and what kind of gaze did you look at me with?
The past that refuses to let go tightens its grip around Lee Hyun.
“…It has been a long time, Gu Seunghyeok.”

title: How to Protect My Male Lead
alt_titles: How to Protect My Male Proganist

title: Primitive Man Kim Dong-Woo
description:
Lawyer Kim Dongwoo worked hard for all his life, yet he has achieved neither a family nor a career that brings true satisfaction. The lawsuits that fail to progress properly and a broken family have become overwhelming sources of stress for him.

Perhaps because of this, Dongwoo suddenly becomes a primitive boy living 25,000 years ago.

But it feels far too vivid and real to dismiss as just a dream.

The life of primitive boy Dongwoo unfolds with his primitive family and the great wilderness of nature.

How different is that life from the present one? Or perhaps, how similar?

title: Cookie Run: Science Basics
alt_titles: Cookie Run: Fun Fun Science Basics
description:
Collections of short, standalone short comics teaching basics of scientific concepts.  
  
The first 30 volumes contain 25 comics of about 6 pages each, the last 5 volumes contain 5 comics of about 30 pages each.

title: Philia Rose - The Prophecy of the Crown of Thorns
description:
Stop the rebellion of the Priest and Prince Paeryun!
Philia, a priestess who has the ability to read the other person's mind, is tasked by the High Priest to 'stop Leo Elion's rebellion.'

He was once a promising prince of the kingdom of Elion.
Leo, who has become a prince who dreams of rebellion, proves that the prophecy announcing the ruin is true.

You have to persuade him to stop the war so that the kingdom can be safe. This was the mission of salvation given to the young priestess one day
Will Philia be able to tame this wild beast of a  prince?

title: The Student Who Never Graduate
description:
The original title in English is grammatically incorrect without the s at the end of graduate. :)

My memory will forever remain in the year I took the college entrance exams." In the May of 2016, a high school senior at a small town's prestigious high school fell to her death and was ruled a suicide. Two years later, senior Yinzhe was welcomed into a new classroom on the top floor. Due to his unsatisfactory science grades in his junior year, he was forced to join the literature class. As the workload for supplemental courses slowly overwhelmed him, "hallucinations" started to occur... An unescapable nightmare-like high school life... Yet as now he looks back, he suddenly realized he could no longer feel the flow of time after the college entrance exams.

title: The Second Chance Convenience Store
description: There’s a convenience store that feels uncomfortable but somehow keeps drawing you in. One day, a new night-shift part-timer appears at the small convenience store -- his rugged looks fill everyone with unease, but soon he brings about a refreshing change to this small convenience store. He helps not only his coworkers but also customers, resolving their worries and troubles. Who is this mysterious night-shift part-timer?

title: Should We Switch?
description: Rayun, who is in a relationship with many men, and Sora, who is happy with only one husband. two completely different people. But one day, something changed?! ㅡSora, who suddenly has a younger sex-pa, and Rayun, who has a husband of Soon-aebo. What happened…”Shall we switch?””

title: Occult Courier Service
description:
The Occult Curio Shop is the strangest, most eccentric building in a remote ancient town that doesn’t exist on any map. It’s run by a witcher and witch sister duo, Nos and Elio. The customers who visit are all supernatural beings living in this haunted town, such as werewolves, witches, demons, vampires, ghosts, Benandanti, lizardfolk, and other magical creatures.

They take on exorcism jobs for human clients, then either reprocess the paranormal spoils they obtain or sell them directly to monsters. This kind of work makes Nos and Elio a fortune. But their obsession with traveling the world means they can never hold onto their money, and it constantly drags them into even more unexpected supernatural incidents.

title: Sense Zero
description: Because of his positive response to everything, Yoon Jiho is considered very insensitive. In fact, he doesn't realize that Seo Danwoo, his best friend, has been secretly harboring feelings for him for a long time. Can Danwoo's feelings be conveyed to Jiho, who is super insensitive? This is the most insensitive romantic comedy story of our time.

title: Sense Zero
description: Freshman Yoonchan created quite a spectacle during the welcome party for first years. Ah-in, who just got back to school after taking some time off, somehow got himself involved with this guy who's got absolutely no sense. Things happened and now, they're actually dating?! This kind of relationship that doesn't make any sense at all… will it be okay?

title: Love Chimes
description: The story of the tyrant emperor and the ingenious woman from use to mutual redemption, solving the mystery of both sides' life experiences and revenge...... Gao Leng Wang Gui and exotic beauty, clever divine doctor and black-skinned loyal dog, imperial princess and hot-blooded straight man......

title: Mommy, Your Dumplings Know They Are Wrong
alt_titles: Mommy, Your Dumplings Know They Are Wrong
description:
After an unexpected death, Sheng Mimi a modern woman wakes up in Shangjing of the Great Yu Dynasty, only to find herself reincarnated as the stepmother of two seemingly adorable (actually chaos-causing, demon-king-level) kids?!
Watch how Sheng Mimi whips these little troublemakers into shape easy~

title: Her Bag
description:
After accidentally breaking an item, Do-ah apologizes to the cafe owner, vowing to pay it back. But the owner has something else in mind.

She asks Do-Ah if she could become her dog.

title: Laws of the Inner Palace
description: [Rule-based supernatural tales x Harem] When Ruo Li enters the palace, the others warn her about the rules that govern its walls. Break them and face dire consequences. She finds this laughable, as if she hasn't been through worse.

title: Ace Ice Blade
description: Once the youngest ace rising star, he has fallen to become an unclaimed free-agent. The once-glorious ace team "Tianhong Ranger" now faces the crisis of disbanding. His encounter with a young and carefree genius newcomer rekindles in them the fighting spirit to climb back to the summit.

title: Trap
description: A man breaks up with his male longterm lover as he enters an arranged marriage. But will he be able to forget?

title: White Scandal
description:
Once a highly anticipated child actor, Ji Eun-Seol’s life took a sudden nosedive after getting blamed for her brother’s crime. Now living under the name Seol Eun-Seol, she is working as a road manager for a troublesome actor, because she couldn’t let go of her dreams of acting despite of her deep-seated wounds. While working as the manager, she is approached by Dan Yi-Hyeok, the central figure of the past incident.

“The scandal involving the grandson and the girl who tried to murder him. In short, a cover-up scandal. I want you to play the opposing role.”

"If I accept this proposal, what will you give me? You clearly promised to be on my side.”

“Money. I’ll give you 10 billion won.”

Thus, begins the pretend relationship between Eun-Seol and Yi-Hyeok, approaching the buried secrets of the past as time goes on…

title: Metro Hunter
description: Unidentified monsters have taken over the metro lines of Seoul, bringing chaos to the city. In the 20 years since the monsters emerged, a system of hunters has been built in order to deal with the monster dungeons that have formed all over the city. One such hunter, Kang Cheol -- the Metro Hunter -- is on a journey to find and slay a monster he calls the “Master of Fire.”

title: Perle
description: Jean Erhardt debuted in Joachim Empire as a successful capitalist infamous for buying his noble title. Despite his seemingly innocent intentions, Jean yearned to spark a revolution from within high society. But first, he must gain a powerful friend. A chance encounter with Maximilian, the hedonistic Crown Prince of Joachim, presented Jean with one such auspicious ally. This proved tricky as Maximilian knew of Jean’s past as an escort and the prince hungered for Jean’s return to decadence…

title: Oil on Canvas
description: After an embarrassing run-in with auctioneer Luca Orsini at a Carnevale party, art restorer Dojin finds himself entangled in an unexpected restoration project. As secrets unfold and hidden motives come to light, Dojin must navigate a web of deception, art, and an unspoken connection that keeps pulling him back...

title: I Like Your Pheromones
alt_titles: Wo Xihuan Ni De Xinxi Su
description:
As a good-looking Beta with a good family background, Duan Jiayan has lived a smooth sailing life for more than ten years, until he met Lu Xingci in high school.

Lu Xingci’s family situation is better than his, he is taller than him and plays basketball better than him. Needless to say, his grades are a whole tier above Duan Jiayan’s. Even his friends can’t help but occasionally praise Lu Xingci.

Most importantly, every girl that Duan Jiayan has set his sights on, all admitted that they have liked Lu Xingci for a few years already.

Since then, Duan Jiayan has never thought well of Lu Xingci, till the day he received his new medical report. He is a late-blooming Omega, and because he became an Omega this late, it came with dire consequences. Now Alphas will feel the need to beat up other people whenever they come near Duan Jiayan. He himself is now allergic to every Alpha’s pheromone, except Lu Xingci’s.

title: Cookie Run Kingdom
description:
Based on the hit mobile game, join GingerBrave as he ventures through Earthbread with his new friends!

(Note: While the setting is the same, the storyline is completely different from the game.)

title: SHADOW - Super Human Assistance Department Office Worker
alt_titles: SHADOW - Super Human Assistance Department Office Worker
description:
Have you ever thought about who cleans up the mess that the heroes made from the fighting? SHADOW (Super Human Assistance Department Office Worker) is now here to clean up the mess!  
  
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/fantasy/shadow/list?title_no=453)

title: Aura from Another Planet
description: Aura is a certified buff spell caster from Planet Leviathan that came to earth by a portal accident. She attends school on earth as a way of adapting, and never fails to find friends, old alien frenemies, and troubles with her buff spells.

title: Sidekicks
description:
Even if people are born with super powers, they must serve as sidekicks of superheroes in order to become superheroes themselves. Lamia a.k.a Dream Girl has the power to make people fall asleep. She is the sidekick of Darkslug, who is not a great hero compared to his reputation. One day, Dream Girl and Theo work together to get rid of villains and save the world.

---
Original work is separated into 2 titles - [Season 1](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=616238) and [Season 2-3](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=642653).
Official Webtoon entry covers only up to the end of Season 2.

title: Magical 12th Graders
description:
After the death of her older sister, Yeorum Han enters her final year of high school. But when a nap in class runs long, she wakes up to find her biology teacher and best friend in cosplay... fighting monsters?! Faced with death, Yeorum chooses the path of a magical girl, and resolves to find out the truth behind her sister's suicide.

---
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/FANTASY/magical-12th-graders/list?title_no=346)

- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/fantasy/magical-12th-graders/list?title_no=345)

- [Official Thai Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/th/fantasy/magical-12th-graders/list?title_no=540)

title: Gepetto
description:
After a decimating war against the androids they had built, humanity, though victorious, was forced to start living in shelters, isolated from the wastelands of the rest of the world, created by the damage the confrontation brought to the world. Dr Gepetto, one of the brightest android creators of his time, died and left behind an inheritance of untold proportions, the only clue as to how to get it being a blue haired android the old man had built and preserved for as long as possible even after his death. The android was reactivated, and she's attempting to escape the grasp of the new government. And a hunt for the inheritance begins.  
  
Note: The author has explicitly split the storyline into multiple seasons. These seasons are represented by the Vol.#.

title: Moon You
description:
Earth perished. I am alone on the moon.  
<Sound of the Heart> A fantasy chic gag that crosses the tidal universe!!

title: Denma The Quanx
description:
Denma is a Quanx, a special breed of humans who possess unique, superhuman powers. He used to be an infamous space villain, but he was tricked by a beautiful woman and found himself trapped in the body of a child - and he's been forced to work as a space courier ever since to get his real body back.  
  
Denma is a fantastic tale of myriad space adventures that Denma goes through, filled with spaceships, ESP, high technology as well as insidious conspiracies and heartbreaking romance, all coming together to present a wonderfully constructed futuristic society controlled by greed, lust, and desire

---
[Part 1 - 322 Episodes]
[Part 2 - 678 Episodes]
[Part 3 - 414 Episodes]

title: Happiness
description:
Saebom, a Sergeant of the Special Forces, and Ihyeon, a Detective Sergeant of Saeyang Police Station, are high school friends who enter into a marriage of convenience so that they can qualify to buy an apartment together, while a mysterious and seemingly contagious virus tears through their city of Saeyang. Saebom and Ihyeon move into their dream home only to find that the new virus that turns people violent and thirsty for blood has come knocking at their door.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Trump
description:
The story takes place in a world where using magical powers is natural. Hiasen, the son of the most wanted criminal in this world, gets involved in the mysterious events of the so called "Melly Day". Trying to help Melly's ghost to find a certain person, he joins the Yeohadan, the police of the Trump-world.  
But who is the person Melly is looking for? How did his father became a criminal? And what actually happened on the day his mother died?

title: Daoist Magician From Another World
description:
The first generation of Daoists was jealous of Zhang Daoling because he possessed a special treasure, the Supreme Ultimate Soul Stone. To capture this treasure, the immortals and gods devise a strategy to ambush and kill his beloved. In a fierce battle, Zhang Daoling detonates his primordial spirit and dies alongside the immortals and gods.
What’s going on, am I reincarnated in another world of swordsmanship and magic under the protection of Supreme Ultimate Soul Stone? I am the youngest son of the Blood Dragon family—— one of the Four Famous Generals of the Storm Kingdom.
How will the story of Zhang Daoling, who was once a Daoist, advance in this magical world?

title: The Lucky Star Shines Upon You
alt_titles: The Lucky Star Shines Upon You

title: Girl Wishing
description: Be careful what you wish for…

title: Collarbone Bodhisattva
description: A traveler comes across a memorial pillar. Why is it so dilapidated now?

title: Fantasy Enlistment Squad
description: The Jeokun Mountains, the immediate border between the Demon Tribe and the Alien Federation, are the final strategic stronghold where training and actual combat occur simultaneously. The Federation forces are constantly recruiting and selecting soldiers to find the ten Transcendents revealed in the Book of Prophecy and reclaim lost territory. However, more terrifying than the war with the Demon Tribe are the absurdities and harsh treatment of military life.

title: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir
description: Hwalin Yong, once the shattered heir of a fallen martial sect, is thrust back in time-- but he isn’t alone. A monstrous darkness lingers at the edges of his mind, constantly whispering, waiting to claim him. Can Hwalin resist its pull, or will he surrender to the shadow? As the battle within intensifies, he uncovers a dormant power that could reshape his destiny and the fate of his sect.

title: Half of Me
description: A car accident leaves both Taekin, a high school outcast, and Heechan, a business owner, in the hospital. But Heechan has no time to sit around and enjoy his hospital bed. If he doesn’t get up and make sure his clients get their products, his business will be in jeopardy! There’s just one problem. After the accident, he now inhabits the body of this high school kid every day from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Talk about an out of body experience! Heechan decides that the way to fix things is to go to Taekin’s high school in the boy’s body and sort things out himself! While looking for the source of their transformation, Heechan sees a familiar face from his own past. But who is going to believe this ridiculous scenario and help him out? Just how is Heechan going to get his body back?!

title: The Villainess Is Bothered by the Male Leads Again Today (Promo)
alt_titles: The Villainess Is Annoyed with the Male Characters Even Today
description:
"Now that we have no ill feelings towards each other, let's live our separate lives well and never see each other again."

It was the start of a possession that began with a typical regretful family drama. After cutting ties with a family that doesn't get along with each other, I thought a peaceful unemployed life was waiting for me.

However...

For some reason, men who had no interest in me before the possession started creeping in.

"I have something I like."
"What is it?"
"It's you, Lora."

The slave who I brought because I felt sorry for him getting beat up now confessed.

"Why doesn't Laura take care of herself? I'll take care of her from now on."

The condition of the butler, who is of mixed race, became strange.

"Lora, will you marry me?"

The Grand Duke, who used to threaten me, proposed.

"Haa, this sweet smell... you're the first one to drive me this crazy."

This crazy man seems even crazier.

...I wish they'd all just disappear.

title: COPYCAT
description: Those who have lost their humanity buy and sell the corpses of murder victims like works of art, and a serial killer called “Jahak” (Self-Harm) who commits these artistic murders has become the talk of the town. An artist, enraged by this situation, begins tracking down Jahak…

title: There’s No One
description:
« Chaque première fois que j’ai vécue, c’est toi qui me l’as apprise. »

Dans un monde ravagé par une maladie cannibale, Jay erre à la recherche de son père et finit par sauver un jeune garçon nommé Won. Tous deux voyagent ensemble pendant sept ans.

Won cache l’amour qu’il éprouve pour l’homme qui l’a élevé, mais après un certain incident, lui et Jay passent une nuit ensemble. Alors que leur relation commence à changer à partir de ce moment-là, une chaîne d’événements révèle la véritable identité de Won, et tous deux sont contraints de se séparer…

title: Dance of Fox and Serpent
description:
A frosty top-tier celebrity stylist vs. a deceptively innocent, low-tier internet star with rustic charm. 

One unexpected act of "red carpet revenge” catapults Chu Xia back into the spotlight, reborn with a brand-new identity. But the real game is only just beginning: a deadly match between “prey” and “predator.” 

Who will emerge as the true winner?

title: Escape Room
description: Overly rational. Sociopathic, even. Sean's unfeeling personality consistently drives people away from him. That is, until he wakes up after a night of heavy drinking in… an escape room? Now he must use his unique mind and join hands with other players to survive sadistic games of life and death. The only way out is to escape! [From Webtoon]

title: Playing the Perfect Fox-Eyed Villain
alt_titles: Performing as the Perfect Narrow Eyes Villain
description: Shihu Lee has logged 20,000 hours playing Let's Kill the Demon Lord! for the past 5 years. But when the game takes a turn he doesn't like, Shihu cancels his pre-order of the DLC in anger, only to find himself sucked into the game! Now in the body of Julian Kreipart Prason, the villain, he has to play the part perfectly to survive the many enemies around him while unable to use the moonlight blade, Julian's signature ability. Under the watchful eye of Eileen, the genius gold mage, and his family members who want him gone, can Julian make it?

title: I Became the First Prince: Legend of Sword's Song
alt_titles: I Became the Degenerate First Prince
I Became The Rogue First Prince
I Became the Rouge First Prince: Legend of Sword's Song
description:
Reborn as a sword, I lived for several hundred years, spending my entire existence looking after everyone.

Then, out of nowhere, I took over the body of a fifteen-year-old uncouth first prince.

"**Do you have any idea how many I've raised?**"

The great knight once called the **Undefeated**, the **Dragon Slayer** who brought down the **Mad Dragon**, the ***Mercenary King***, and more... I raised every single one of them.

The ***Magic Sword Gruhorn*** possessed the body of the uncouth first prince...And has begun to write a new legend.

title: You Can't Have My Blood
description: A sweet contract romance between a vampire and a human! Siyun accidentally meets Jinwoo, a famous vampire director of a well-known foundation, at a café. He offers him a matching partner proposal where he would provide him with his blood. "I’m already anemic and short on blood—why me of all people?!" As their affection deepens, what will become of them?

title: I Will Change My Husband First Through a Plundered Marriage
alt_titles: I Will Change My Husband First Through a Plundered Marriage
description: « Adieu, héroïne originale. » Trois fois le désespoir. Trois morts. À la fin de chaque cycle, la même femme m'a tout volé : mon mari, ma vie, mon avenir. J'ai finalement compris la vérité : c'est une transmigratrice, quelqu'un qui s'est réincarnée dans ce monde en connaissant l'histoire originale. Maintenant, pour ma quatrième régression, il est temps de récupérer tout ce qui m'a été volé. Pour cela, j'ai besoin d'un allié puissant. Pour combattre une folle, j'ai besoin d'un fou. « Enlevez-moi. » Prince héritier Arpad Istrid. Je lui ai proposé un enlèvement nuptial, lui demandant de m'enlever pour m'épouser. « En échange, j'empêcherai Votre Altesse de sombrer dans la folie. » Une offre qu'il ne peut absolument pas refuser. Avec un sourire triomphant, je l'ai regardé droit dans les yeux.

title: My Academic System Is Making Me Date?!
alt_titles: My Academic System Is Making Me Date?!
Even Though It’s a Top-Student System, Little Su’s Affection Level Is Steadily Increasing
description:
The stubborn, hyper-competitive top student Chu Xun, who has to be the best his whole life, just happens to run into Su Muqing, a genius girl who can read minds. He’s determined to become the number one student in the entire school!

It’s here! The Top Student System has arrived! Chu Xun’s learning ability is going up! Up! Up!

But… why do the system’s tasks feel so much like... dating?!

And so… Classmate Su’s affection level goes up~ up~ up~

title: Magic School Girl: Spare No Villains
description:
In a modern society full of all kinds of ‘villains’, God has descended to bring justice to this chaotic world.

The hero who will fulfill his justice is… Magic..

title: The Tough Life of a Journalist
alt_titles: The Tough Life of a Journalist
description:
In the interview room, they spoke of a warm world and justice, but in the end, a newspaper company is still a company, and a company is just that. Starting the day at 5G speed but ending it at 3G, Weekend work is a given, and being on-call is an option. The more incidents and accidents, the more work piles up, So I wish for world peace now more than ever. Yet when I see the numbers in my bank account, all I feel is sadness. This is the story of a realistic journalist living in a world full of inevitable things. Even so, the “clickbait journalist” and “corporate worker,” Who wander with hope, hoping to improve even just a little, Find themselves constantly torn between two worlds. The cat reporter, caught in the middle,
Heads to work again today, stumbling along the way.

title: When We Were Young
description: ※ [Stubborn but kind hearted Premier top x Double faced top scholar bottom] It easy to be enemy but hard to be friends. Shen Moqing and Lu Cangming fought for ten years. Yet, at the end, they realised the one who knew them well, is each other. ※

title: The Roommate Agreement
description: Lately, Yeji's life has been less up and more down. She's barely making ends meet with a dead end part-time job, school's been rough, and her roommate is the worst. Moving in with an old friend just meant that after a year, she had one less friend. Things quickly take a turn when her roommate/former-friend/"frenemy" announces she'll be moving out. Too bad Yeji's new roommate wasn't exactly what she was hoping for.

title: John Loves Tite
description:
Tite loves John. But does John love Tite?

Today, the people of Holy City were gossiping among themselves.
Tite Libero, the eldest daughter of the prestigious noble family Libero.
Rumor has it that the beautiful and bright Tite fell madly in love with the hope of humanity, Cardinal John.

title: Dear Anonymous Benefactor
description:
"Miss Judith, how about spending this summer at the Curtis estate in Wilz?"  
After five years of silence, her anonymous benefactor finally replied—with an invitation to meet.  
Judith, a war orphan and secret esper, had fled to the Federation after her homeland’s defeat. In her painful life, the only warmth came from a mysterious benefactor.  
She never knew their name or face, but their generous gifts filled the void in her heart. Though she never received a reply, writing a monthly letter of gratitude became her cherished routine. So when the invitation arrived, she eagerly set off for Wilz.  
There, in the dazzling and dangerous city, she met three men: a charming rogue with an enigmatic smile, a successful businessman who cared for her, and a gang leader who clashed with her at every turn.  
One of them was her benefactor—but who?

title: Double Down
description:
« Tu veux bien me sucer un peu ? »

Ji-han est découvert par Shin-woo, qui apprend qu’il a le béguin pour un homme. En échange de son silence, Shin-woo lui impose une demande d’ordre sexuel que Ji-han n’aurait jamais imaginée. Pour couronner le tout, lorsqu’un harceleur commence à s’en prendre à Shin-woo — une star populaire dont Ji-han est le garde du corps — ils se retrouvent à vivre sous le même toit…

Entre Kim Shin-woo, le cadet capricieux et insupportable qui n’en fait qu’à sa tête, et Ji-han, qui le supporte mal mais se laisse malgré tout entraîner malgré lui, la relation déjà bien compliquée des deux hommes ne cesse de s’emmêler. Comment leur histoire finira-t-elle par se démêler ?

title: Calm Down, Revenge Queen
description:
*An adaptation of Du Liao Liao's novel: Transmigrated Cannon Fodder, Please Calm Down!*

Abandoned, framed, tragic ending... A quick-transmigration female supporting lead has had enough! Why must a supporting character have to be a contrast to the main lead?! From this world onwards, she has decided to take fate into her own hands, no longer listening to the system's plans! Pushing aside all obstacles and difficulties, she fulfils her own dreams, whilst using all sorts of methods to get back at those who harmed her previously...

title: Please Don't Die!
description: Yoon Ha-jin lives a fragile life, precariously balanced between life and death. One ordinary day, everything changes when he encounters a mysterious, timid girl who claims to be his protector, and a Grim Reaper who has come for him.

title: The Stories of Those Around Me
description: Summer is happily in love; Mira is a beautiful and successful woman but doesn’t have a boyfriend; Jung-A lives with her boyfriend for 5 years. These 25-year-old girls are very close and believe in that they can keep thier friendship and love forever. However, everything changed after Mira’s blind date.

title: 456 Endfield!?
description: Fun facts you probably didn't know!

title: 335km
description: A girl whose wish is to see the ocean.  A boy who is afraid of the outside. A school trip that was canceled and a journey to fulfill her wish.

title: The Promise
description: An official comic oneshot for Arknight: Endfield centering around Perlica. Since Hypergyph, the parent company of Gryphline the publishing company is Chinese in origin, it is decided that assigning this comic as being Chinese in origin is the most reasonable choice.

title: Toymaker Tria's Tyrant Problem
description: As the ordinary owner of a toy workshop, Tria spent her days struggling to pay off a mountain of debt with the help of Shadie, her trusty shadow friend. Luckily for her, a mysterious, half-dead client shows up one day, offering a jaw-dropping amount of money to make an expensive toy. Despite being wary of the man and his circumstances, Tria accepts the commission. But it doesn't take long for her to realize that this dictatorial client is just one of the many tyrants that will plague her shop...

title: We're Not Brothers At All!
alt_titles: We Are Not Brothers At All
description:
Han Xiu, who originally planned to play games, suddenly learned that he had a convenience brother, so of course he couldn’t let it go

Sheffield lets his emotions take over him when he hears that his stepfather’s illegitimate son, Randol, wants to reunite with the family. On a whim, he decides to give his "big brother a little welcome "gift" - spending a passionate night with him.

title: Past Friendship
description:
He was my best friend in the world. 
And that was enough.

Taesung and Wooyoung became best friends by chance when they were young.

Their friendship seemed to continue, even as they went to high school, but Wooyoung feels the desire to be more than just friends with Taesung.

Meanwhile, Taesung has become wary of Suhwa, who had become close to Wooyoung in high school. And an incident between Taesung and Suhwa causes a falling out between him and Wooyoung.

The two of them end up going to the same university without repairing the relationship. 

In order to rid himself of his feelings for Taesung, Wooyoung decides to cut off all contact and enlist in the army.  But he still struggles with his feelings.

After his military service, with Suhwa’s help, Wooyoung moves into an officetel, where he coincidentally reunites with Taesung…

The unrequited love which had started fresh and pure, had become gradually more intense as time passed.
Kwon Wooyoung felt like he was dying to have Go Taesung.

title: The Princess After The Revolution
description:
"Now, at this place, I punish the last royal daughter of the dynasty and declare a republic.”

Princess Lumina died from the revolution. She is reincarnated in Korea with the memories of her previous life and becomes an ordinary office worker. Now that she has done everything she wants in her past life, she wants to live comfortably, but the ties from her previous life appear and interfere with her company life!

title: The Second Journey to the West
description: The unknown species from outer space, who call themselves “the Heavenly Beings” have invaded. Ogong is set free, ready for war. Battle after battle, Ogong is becoming more harmonized with his mecha, Monkey Overlord, and their fighting ability keeps on improving. Ogong feels his instinct, waking up the God of Destruction inside him, which was sealed after his last battle before being imprisoned. Monkey Overlord tries to dominate Ogong’s body, to fully transform as the God of Destruction! Can Ogong save the world from the Heavenly Beings, while keeping his rationality?

title: Love traps
description:
L’amour… ça s’attrape !
Le guide secret du chat dominateur pour capturer son chiot !

Chassé du dortoir du jour au lendemain à cause de travaux d’agrandissement, Lee Yewon (uke) se retrouve sans logement.

Il passe un temps à loger chez des amis, mais en tant que demi-humain, l’approche de sa période de rut le laisse dans une situation désespérée, sans endroit où rester.

C’est alors que Ji Seunghu (seme), son camarade de faculté et lui aussi demi-humain, l’invite à occuper la chambre libre chez lui.

Reconnaissant, Yewon lui prépare un repas et lui offre à boire pour le remercier de son hospitalité…

Le lendemain, ils se réveillent nus dans le même lit.

…Au lieu de rembourser la gentillesse du propriétaire, il a laissé son rut prendre le dessus et a provoqué un sacré incident ?!

title: Boredom Alert
description:
"So, he was a worn-out man. A man worn down by boredom at that."
Kwon Tae-Shin, a VIP customer at the high-end members-only club Zeus, would buy one-night stands with money, but he would never sleep with the same person again. One day, Lee Won-U, a low-ranking club employee and young father, is assigned to drive Tae-Shin's car, when Tae-Shin suddenly throws a fit and offers to buy Won-U one night.
"Have you ever slept with a man?"
Won-U, with his ordinary appearance, is surprised to find himself "chosen," but the large sum of money lures him into an impulsive offer.
"You're paying in advance, right?"
However, after a night filled with nothing but pain, Won-U regrets it and begins to avoid Kwon Tae-Shin. Nevertheless, Tae-Shin begins to obsess over Won-U... "I've thought about it carefully, and I think you might want to do it with you one more time."

title: Liar
description: [Yaoqi Village 2024 Spring - Super Short Comic Bronze Award] A high school student, Jiajia, was suddenly pushed down the stairs from behind when she was leaving the school. When she woke up in the emergency room and wanted to identify the culprit who pushed her, her homeroom teacher, Miss Zhang, stopped her at all costs. At this time, Jia Jia's consciousness began to waver, she wasn’t even sure if she had remembered wrong...

title: When the Rain Stops and the Stars Begin to Fall
alt_titles: When the Rain Stops and the Stars Begin to Fall
description: Uika Misumi x Sakiko Togawa

title: Sui Daily Slices: It's a Time for Family Reunion
alt_titles: Sui Daily Slices: It's a Time for Family Reunion
description: Lots of dishes, lots of people, and lots of time.

title: How to Make My Tyrant Husband Love Me
alt_titles: How to Make My Tyrant Husband Love Me
description: The notorious Empress Belita, famed for her myriad romantic entanglements! Just when Belita is on the verge of being killed by her tyrant husband while attempting to elope with a prince from a neighboring kingdom, "I" becomes Belita. "I"--now Belita--narrowly escapes death and vows to cease her unfaithful behavior to dispel the emperor's suspicions. Amidst a palace rife with numerous paramours, distrustful emperor, and the looming specter of war, can Belita survive?

title: The Tyrant’s Crush
description:
Yui wakes up in a novel as Marilyn, the beautiful protagonist who's chosen as the empress but almost dies at the hands of the cruel Emperor Rael. That's when the empire's guardian goddess, Antia, swoops in and saves Marilyn... only to send her back to the past so she can charm Rael and save the world from his tyranny!

Regardless of Antia's wishes, Marilyn wants nothing to do with the man who killed her in her previous life. Can she escape her fate in the original novel and find happiness away from the dangerous Rael?

title: Juhyun & Jinsol
description:
A girl meets another girl and falls in love. After a fearful eighteen, the two reunite again ten years later.

Total 51 Chapters
40 Chapters + 11 Side Stories

title: To Abyss
description:
Felice was born into a family of knights that had served the imperial palace and protected the wizarding Mureu family for generations. Yet thanks to his exceptional talent, he became the youngest ever Grand Court Mage.

After losing his position as a court mage to Felice, Aeris Mureu falls into deep inferiority and retreats into seclusion, eventually placing a curse upon himself through dark magic.

Asked to lift his childhood friend’s curse, Felice goes to seek out Aeris, only to learn that breaking the curse requires sexual acts.

“So even a Grand Mage cannot help having vulgar nipples after all.”

title: Winning Mentality
description:
After an unexpected accident ends his football career, Go Yoon-oh returns to coaching his former club, Wimbledon City FC, to win the championship. One day, “monster striker” Moon Tae-won joins the team, but he doesn't perform as well as expected, and displays a particularly harsh attitude towards Yoon-oh. Yoon-oh tries to help him adjust, and after hearing that Tae-won is not feeling well, he visits Tae-won’s home.... A sleep-deprived Tae-won tells Yoon-oh that he thinks kissing him will make him better at football.

“If you kiss me, I’ll win the next game with a multi-goal victory.”

title: wide open
description:
Hu Yeong, the star rookie of the pro basketball team HG Big Whales, was struggling day by day under the crushing weight of repaying his father’s loan shark debt. When everything felt unbearable, a man suddenly appeared.

“Are you trying to seduce me right now?”
“What you just did was seducing. What I’m doing is testing the waters.”

The brief rest Hu Yeong shared with the man was sweet, but in the harsh reality of his life, he chose to cut ties and disappear rather than hold on. He never imagined he would meet him again a year later—this time as a player for HG Big Whales, standing before the team’s owner, Eun Jun-wook. Hu Yeong thought he would be crushed in silence, but Jun-wook’s reaction was nothing like he expected.

“If there’s something you need, tell me. I’ll help with whatever I can. I want to be an addition to you, not a flaw.”

title: The Invincible of The East
description:
The Fourth Heavenly Demon who was also known as the Heavenly Enlightened Warrior, a match for ten thousand enemies, and the Sacred Saint of the Sun and Moon Cult, found himself in an unexpected predicament. During the unification of Jianghu, a mishap occurred with the Soul Splitting Grand Art, resulting in his soul being mistakenly transferred into the body of the 14-year-old son of Mount Hua's Shadowless Sword Warrior.

Tsk, what is this miserable body...

Doesn't matter. I am the Invincible of the East and all the martial arts in the world are in my head.

I will unify the Jianghu once again!

title: The Outlaws 0
description:
He sweeps them all away in a satisfying blow!
The rookie days of monster detective Ma Seok-do!
A covert operation begins to take down the worst and strongest crime syndicate.
The official prequel webtoon to The Outlaws film series.

title: Assassin's Creed: Forgotten Temple
description: Edward Kenway returns to take the leap of faith in an all-new adventure. The high-seas hunt is on for a long-lost treasure left by Those Who Came Before. But this time, The Templars aren’t the only ones after the prize. Join history’s most cunning pirate in an epic journey around the Chinese Sea.

title: Miss Vampire’s Bullying Game
description:
Irina, la antepasada del Clan de la Sangre, se disfrazó de loli oscura para vigilar a su comida de sangre -una cazarrecompensas maldita llamada Chelsea- y se hizo pasar por la prometida de Chelsea. Sólo para entrar accidentalmente en un pacto de esclavitud con ella. Al principio, Irina pensó que el estilo de la pintura era: "Chelsea arrodíllate, sé mi esclava de sangre ......". Quién sabía que el verdadero estilo de la pintura es: "Angelito, por favor, intimida a Chelsea sin piedad...".
Contexto

title: The Prenup
description: What’s a girl to do when she has sworn off love completely? Get married, of course! When Seunghui Wu is scarred after the end of a relationship eight years ago, she refuses to even consider dating. But when her father comes to her with a old contract he made, promising her to another man’s son, there’s not much she can do. Despite her circumstances, Seunghui is determined to get married on her own terms, which are all conveniently laid out... in a prenup!

title: Blaze
description: Girl blackmails supposedly younger genius teacher boy with a classic pic. Kinky things happens.

title: There Are No Bad Military Dogs
alt_titles: There Are No Bad Military Dogs
description:
Min Ah-hyun, qui a grandi en étant maltraitée comme cobaye dans un institut de recherche, s’engage dans l’armée, qui semble liée à son passé, afin de percer les secrets de cet institut. Là-bas, elle rencontre Shin Hae-jun, son supérieur direct. Il était un « chien militaire », obéissant aveuglément aux ordres venus d’en haut, même lorsqu’ils étaient contradictoires.

Avec l’apparition des zombies, le monde se rapproche de sa fin. Ah-hyun, qui a perdu sa jeune sœur dans le chaos, en veut à Hae-jun et le tient pour responsable. Pour éviter d’être de nouveau mêlée à lui, elle déserte et travaille comme mercenaire. Mais Hae-jun retrouve calmement Ah-hyun et lui propose de collaborer, lui offrant de l’aider à retrouver son frère… !

title: The Predator
description:
Sangjin seems like your typical average joe working part-time at a convenience store. That is until you find out he lives with a human-eating monster. To keep the monster's appetite satisfied, he feeds the monster humans whom he deems to be trash of the world. One day, a girl named Jiwon, who believes the monster to be a god, decides to move in with the two. With the police closing in on Sangjin as the main suspect in the recent disappearances, how long will he be able to get away with this?

---
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/SUSPENSE/bushidongwu/list?title_no=1845)

- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/thriller/thepredator/list?title_no=3425)

- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/thriller/the-predator/list?title_no=3224)

title: Escape Me If You Can
alt_titles: I Can't Escape, He Won't Let Me Go
description:
An absolute being worshipped by all, he was a slaughterer who trampled on my life. 

I, Daphne, was the daughter of the emperor’s favored concubine. I had a childhood more affluent than anyone else’s, but I incurred the emperor's wrath and, despite being a princess, was treated coldly, practically like a maid.

The one who showed me kindness was Crown Prince Askeladd, whom I hoped might one day become part of my family. Askeladd had always shone brightly. Everyone was fascinated by him, and everyone submitted to him. As an absolute being who reigned over all, he was no exception to me. 

He was my god. Yet... 

The cruel destroyer of my world I had always believed to be beautiful was none other than Askeladd. I tried to escape from the slaughterer who trampled on my life, but...

---

Note: This is a Japanese webcomic adaptation of the Korean web novel of the same name.

Web Novel: [Naver](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=8496962), [Kakao](https://page.kakao.com/content/63283222)

title: Run Like a Dog
description:
"Survive? I'm just a little Maltese!"

Ppiyong was living a cozy, carefree life in a warm home with her loving sister—until one day, her family and all the humans suddenly disappeared. She's never done anything on her own before—will she find a way to survive in a city overrun by zombie dogs and reunite with her sister?

title: Change (JinYuan) Ss2
description: Continuing from Part 1 of Change (JinYuan)

title: Just a Sunbae I Know
description: Junwoo wakes up in the morning and next to him, in his natural state (?) is his sunbae?!! It’s true that they’re dating, and it’s great to see how enthusiastic sunbae is, but!! Isn’t this mature style of dating (?) too much? Caught between pure love and sexual love, are we fine like this, sunbae?

title: I Don't Want the Obsession of a Twisted Archduke
description:
I reincarnated as the wife of a cursed archduke in my own twisted novel. As the author, I took responsibility and set things right by lifting the curse, which was the key to returning home. I thought my job was done, and just when I was finally trying to go back, the archduke asked me, "Did you really think I wouldn't know that you’re planning on returning to your fiance?"

He had completely misunderstood!

"Whether you like it or not, I'm still your husband. I'm never letting you go back to that bastard."

All I want is for him to please let me go home!

title: Winter Romance
description:
[Author Kim Gyeol's novel Winter Romance is now a webtoon adaptation!]

“Kwon Sihyun. I met him on a piercingly cold, frigid winter day.”

To Seokyung—who had no one to rely on, not family, not a teacher, not even the piano—a man suddenly appeared.
He was indifferent and cold about everything, yet on rare occasions, he smiled... and he could be gentle too.
...If it’s him, maybe someday, he could help me escape this dreadful place.

“I like you, teacher.”
“I don’t need anything else.”
“As long as I have you, that’s enough for me.”

And so, Seokyung didn’t want to let this chance slip away—
Even if it meant deceiving both herself and him.

title: Be Honest!
description:
'What 'filters' do we use when we talk to people?'

A timid college student who always hid her true feelings, disappears after collapsing on the street one day and then returns 1 year later.

It's later revealed that she now has a rare disease called 'Rayleigh Syndrome', that causes her to say whatever's on her mind.

A bumpy adolescence without a filter, and a coming of age story where words can both hurt and comfort.

title: I Became the Black Swan Mother of the White Swan Princess
description:
The transmigration that happened to others happened to me, too. I’m pretty sure I’m now a supporting character… but exactly which novel is this?

When I opened my eyes, I was a widow with stepdaughters my own age, and not only that, I turned into a black swan every night due to a dark curse! Holding back my tears, I decided to take charge of my fate…wait, why should I? Why So Serious?

A duchess during the day, a queen of the lake during the night – I have the best luck to be able to leisurely float around! Life should be lived unplanned! When I had just about decided to live my life like this, a white baby swan, one that was not in my no-plan life plan, came to me.

“Mommy, are you really my mommy?”

What, you were a person? And even the youngest sibling of the tyrant emperor?

“I’m not your mother! Can’t you tell by the different colors of our feathers?”

I’m a black swan, you’re a white swan! But why is she so crazy cute. Can our mother-daughter love endure the obsession and persecution of this child’s seven brothers, including the tyrant emperors?

title: The Villainess Is Done Trying
alt_titles: The Villainess Is Tired of Everything
description: What would you do when you've transmigrated as the most-hated villainess in the story? In the case of Marso, she tried hard to change the storyline by performing good deeds and taking care of the female lead. However, things are not going as she had hoped for--every character in the story still hates her! It seems no matter what she does she cannot seem to change her fate. Tired of trying, Marso declares that she'll stay home and do nothing--for the rest of her life.

title: My Pet Rat is an S-Class Awakener
alt_titles: My Rat Is an S-Class Awakener
description:
I got thrown into another dimension, wearing nothing but my pajamas. While everyone gets a Status Window and all these fancy powers, I’m stuck with only a system error. Oh, and my pet rat somehow came with me. Except… he’s not a rat. He’s a beastman, and not just any beastman, but a ridiculously powerful, S-rank Awakened beastman! And now he’s in love with me.
“What can I do to make you like me, Soyul? I’ll do anything! I’ll even crawl inside a cat’s mouth if you tell me to!”
“I’m pretty sure the cat will faint if an S-rank rat of all things did that.”

title: Brinny and the Empty Seat
description:
The story of a possessor from a book who, for the sake of its goal, won’t mind killing others.

Brinny, who’s living while adapting to her stepfather, thought that story had nothing to do with her. Up until she was swept into an incident with the sickly second prince, Lucian.

In the midst of the crisis, Brinny rescued Lucian by displaying her superhuman strength, and looking at the possessor ‘Ariadna’ tied up had reassured her that everything had been resolved.

But for whatever reason, her beloved older sister and the first prince died in a carriage accident, and then even Lucian, who later becomes her fiance, started to display some abnormal behavior.

The possessor wasn’t executed in the past.
Would ‘Ariadna’ still be alive?
In order to regain the empty seats of their lost loved ones, Brinny made a decision.

To fight against the possessor.

title: Treat Your Friends With Respect
alt_titles: Please Take Care Of Your Friend
description:
I reincarnated as the younger sister of the male lead in a BL novel.
She's a fragile sunfish whose life is in danger even from catching a cold.

So, I took advantage of a childhood friend who has healing abilities.
The problem is, that ability manifests through skinship.
Anyway, it was only a matter of time before this little guy fell in love with the male protagonist, so I didn't worry for long.
We held hands and I stole his first kiss...

But then,
Since when...

"Lavie, you're beautiful."
"Huh...?"
"You should look outside. I couldn't stop myself when I saw you."
"Akka, stop it."
"If you keep getting nervous like that, it makes me wanna do it more."

Why is the guy who should be with the male lead suddenly doing this to me?!

title: Sizzling Chop Chop
description:
Eat, eat, eat, eat, eat, eat, eat, eat, eat, eat… We will eat delicious food well ♡ (Ah, I'm glad I'm alive!!!)   
  
A delicious mouthful that will fill your everyday with happiness! <Sizzling Chop Chop>  
  
Pre-serialization on [Daum League](http://webtoon.daum.net/league/view/8942) (2014)

title: See You in My 19th Life - A Piece of Memories
alt_titles: See You in My 19th Life - A Piece of Memories
Let's Get Along in This Lifetime as Well
description: There’s a special bonus, in commemoration of the launch of the drama. Seoha is a boy who has gone into a lethargic state after his mom passed away, because of this, his friend Juwon decided to take him with her to the places where Seoha’s mother used to go. What will they get to see there and who will they be able to meet?

title: I Debuted as an Exorcist, Not an Idol
description: A girl competes in an idol survival show and builds a love-hate dynamic with a top star judge. Despite reaching the finals, she fails to debut. Soon after, she discovers that the star can see ghosts and is destined to die—because of her. To save both their futures, she disguises herself as a bodyguard and takes on the mission of exorcising spirits, learning everything from YouTube.

title: Intoxicated East Wind
description:
10 years of unrequited love, 10 years of yearning, 10 years of waiting.  
Was it all in vain?  
Yan Zhi pulled out of Zhao Fei Ying's arms and stood in front of him.  
He slowly striped his clothing.  
One centimeter after one centimeter, he slowly revealed his untouched snow white skin in front of Zhao Fei Ying.  
  
"I, Leng Yan Zhi, here by vow——- to stay by my brother for as long as I live, until he is bored and tired of my existence."

Is it possible for the deeply passionate Leng Yan Zhi to receive his his older disciple brother's love?  
  
Note: Does NOT contain incest

title: Mao Zhi Ming
description: The young girl Moli who was about to enter high school, was struck by lightning while running late and was sent to Continent of Mingzu. What is this, so it’s a Q version of a world?! What about the promised beautiful youth! Oh well, at least everyone is half beast~ I’ll reluctantly join in for the time being! The status of a magician or some other heavy responsibilities like that, I don’t want it. I just want to foolishly spend my sweet time being. Selfish!

title: Emblem Wars
description: Among the numerous emblems to exist, only one is said to be cursed with the fate of ruin—the Emblem of Asura. After a man who serves an unseen will reduces Vahn’s life to ashes and casts him into a timeless abyss, Vahn endures 999 long years of torment before awakening the true power of ruin. Reborn as vengeance incarnate, his retribution begins.

title: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life
alt_titles: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life
Return of the Back Alley Wizard
description: Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn’t the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future’s secrets in his hands. This time, he won’t serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master?

title: I Catch You
description:
“Thanks for being my last stroke of luck!”

September 2015—Kwon Min, a senior in the top 0.1 percent, accidentally uncovers the truth about Ja Yubin, the “transfer student” who keeps stealing twenty minutes of every mock exam in his dreams. Thirty minutes a day, the two of them chase a mystery trickier than any killer exam question: the puzzle of luck and fate. Even nineteen—an age that vanishes in the blink of an eye—holds moments so bright you want to grab them and never let go.

title: This Time, I Will Survive Until the End
alt_titles: This Time, I Will Survive Until the End
In This Life, I Will Survive Until The End
description: Adette Berse keeps getting reborn but never survives past 30, always after trying to get married. Determined to break the cycle, she vows to stay single and instead focuses on earning money for her family. In a society that frowns upon working women, she disguises herself as a man to invest in a business with Duke Mateilo. Intrigued by Adette's audacious maneuver, the duke eschews business talk for continuous meetings. With her future on the line, can Adette outwit him and survive until the end?

title: Woke Up as the CEO’s Dog
alt_titles: I Will Become Your Dog, Boss
I Will Be Your Dog, President
I Will Be the CEO's Dog
description:
"I envied dogs, but I never really wanted to be a dog!"
