Not only was she working overtime, her salary was low, and now it was getting cut?

On the way home from work after her worst day ever, Woomi meets a lost puppy and tries to find its owner right away... but the said owner was the CEO of the company she never wants to see outside? She's surprised to see that the CEO, who is famous for being cold and strict, is endlessly kind to his dog. That evening, she fell asleep envying it, thinking, 'My fate... I wish I was a puppy too.' And when she opened her eyes, all she saw were soft jelly feet and a firm manly chest?

"Woof??????"

What the heck is going on!!

title: Feasting Lord in Another world
alt_titles: The Isekai Lord Feeds People Well
The Isekai Lord Who Conquers with Cooking
description:
A revolution that begins in the small fishing village of Evergreen — a reincarnated nutritionist sets out to conquer the other world deliciously, one dish at a time!
“Welcome to Evergreen!”

title: 2024 Rookie Short Story Collection
description: A selection of Hell Camp short stories produced directly by legendary writers Lee Hyun-se and Lee Du-ho! Introducing the strongest rookies of 2024!

title: Card Shark
description:
The world's best poker players are called 'sharks', and the most ruthless among them is known simply as Czar. Kim Yoon and a gang of thugs roam from house to house, seeking this legendary figure - despite rumors that no one ever returns from his domain. One day, a man in a red hoodie warns Yoon, "Sir, you'll die if you keep this up.” Ignoring the warning, Yoon leaves to gather money for a new game. Suddenly, he hears the chilling sound of bones smashing and bodies crushing. As the noise fades, Yoon finally comes face to face with Czar…but when he offers Yoon a chance to play, Yoon sees it as a golden opportunity and believes his life is about to change. "I'll try it."

**[Official Novel (Ridibooks)](https://ridibooks.com/books/120033248)**

title: Kiss The Scumbag
description: Five years ago, Winston and Yujin fell deeply and irrevocably in love at first sight. But their passionate relationship shattered when Winston discovered the unthinkable truth: Yujin’s was having an affair with none other than his own father. Consumed by betrayal, Winston channeled the love he once cherished into resentment. Yet no matter how hard he tries, Winston cannot extinguish the pull he still feels. Now, reunited by fate and unresolved wounds, passion and scorn intertwine… But can either of them truly escape what they once meant to each other? (Source: *Lezhin*)

title: If This Maniac Is a Trial
alt_titles: If This Fool Is an Ordeal Too
description:
Sylvere, Tasha’s notorious maniac alchemist.
When a prophecy declares that he will awaken as a hero, Yvor Hussman, a priest of the Grand Temple, is sent to take him to the capital.
Without a priest, a hero is bound to lose control. At least, that's what they claim in the name of preserving peace.
But… could this man really be nothing more than just a maniac?!
“If this maniac is a trial, then I shall accept it...!”
Will Sylvere and Yvors reach the capital safely?

title: Kiss of Dawnlight
description:
「學姐……我想知道更多妳的事。」


一次回眸，讓姍姍的目光從此離不開光柔學姐。
一次快門，定格了眼前的畫面，也悄悄拉近了彼此的心。


光柔的美，令姍姍自慚形穢，卻又致命地吸引著她，
在情緒翻湧的瞬間，她私藏了光柔的唇膏……
懷揣著罪惡與自卑交織的秘密，
她在逐漸靠近的距離中，
窺見了光柔耀眼外表下，藏著讓人顫抖的傷。
唯美、悸動、令人心疼。
再近一點，就能交換真心嗎？

title: Become a Tomato!
description: "Shin Yi-seok, a transfer student from the countryside who is rumored to be scheming due to his rough appearance, witnesses the cunning secret of Jo Hae-joo, the first-class student in the school, whom he fell in love with at first sight... Questions about him gradually grow like a snowball. Shin Yi-seok's unrequited love for Jo Hae-ju, who is red on the outside and white on the inside, begins!"

title: False Moon
description: To pay off his debts, Lin Shuye would cross-dress as a woman. But one day, he accidentally got involved with the #1 hitman of a gang. Due to an unexpected circumstance, he became his partner in crime. Forced to flee and live together as an affectionate couple, they faltered back and forth between lies and desire.

title: Accidental Baby
description:
Do Yihyeon is known at work as a notorious workaholic, but in truth, he is a mutant omega suffering from face blindness.

Then one day, after getting heavily drunk, he has a one night stand with a man he does not recognise and ends up unexpectedly pregnant.

After the initial shock of the sudden pregnancy wears off, Yihyeon decides to keep the child. As he quietly struggles through morning sickness on his own, a superior he has never really interacted with before suddenly starts making advances on him…

*“I want us to become something more than coworkers, Ihyeon.”  
“You already are my superior.”  
“You have never met someone better looking than me anyway.”  
“Well, I am not so sure.”*

Between relentless flirting and an impenetrable emotional wall, who will come out on top?

title: Resurrection Boy
description: A boy with a Resurrection Heart. Not even hundreds of deaths could kill him. Now, Jio sets his sights on the research lab that suppressed him and his friends their entire lives.

title: If I'm with You
description:
Since they were kids, Dal had been taking care of Saebyeok who had a weak heart. Dal knew all about Saebyeok's irritability, yet he still kept on taking care of him which resulted in Saebyeok getting obsessed with Dal. But one day, Saebyeok's secret came to light and gave Dal a huge shock… Will these two people be able to protect each other's feelings?  
(from Random Fujoshis Scans)

title: I Doted on the Demonic Cult's Leader
description: Jeong Ha-yun, jeune diplômé d'université, se réveille un matin dans le corps de l'herboriste Cho-yun, du roman d'arts martiaux "Le retour du héros". Convaincu que les enfants méritent d'être protégés, il choisit de recueillir Joo Cheon-oh, le futur chef du culte démoniaque Seomun. Doté du pourvoir de déformer le cours de l'histoire originale, il était décidé à l'élever et l'envoyer convenablement dans la société. "Je veux leur arracher la tête. " Est-ce vraiment ce que signifie être un pratiquant d'art martial ?! Si vous vivez l'extinction, même un enfant rêvera inévitablement de vengeance ?! Les mots qui sortaient de la bouche d'un enfant de sept ans étaient plus que cruels, et en tant qu'adulte, Ha-yun devait empêcher ça... "Fait ce que tu veux. Soit tu créer l'art martial le plus fort du monde, soit tu te venges avec lui." Mais rien ne se passe. Le corps réparé par les arts martiaux refuse souvent d'écouter les mots de son professeur et les disciples lèvent les yeux au ciel lorsqu'il s'agit du travail de leur professeur. Avec le temps, le fantôme de vengeance a disparu, mais il développa une obsession pour Cho-yun et ne veut pas être séparé de lui.

title: Superhuman Streamer
description: Uhyeon Baek logs into Reverse Planet expecting a VR game, only to discover that the world is painfully real. A decade of grief and experiments turns him into a superhuman contract killer, and he finally executes the director behind his suffering. But when he returns to his original life, the ghosts of his fallen companions follow him. Haunted and restless, he goes back to Reverse Planet, only to realize he's entered the real game this time. Paired with superstar streamer Soyul Kang, his lethal efficiency goes viral... and puts him on the conspirator's radar.

title: The Shepherd Wizard
description:
Born on the edge of the world, Turan spent his life as a simple shepherd — hiding a power he was told could destroy everything he loved.

He knew nothing of the wars, the noble houses, or the ancient bloodlines that shaped the land beyond his hills.

And honestly, he's grown a little tired of it.

Watching the world from a distance, never quite knowing what lay past the horizon — until a random encounter cracks the door open, and curiosity does the rest.

With nothing tying him down, Turan steps into a world he has never seen — and slowly, through his eyes, its beauty, its cruelty, and its secrets begin to unfold.

title: The Mischievous Baby Is Throwing A Tantrum
alt_titles: The Mischievous Baby Is Throwing A Tantrum
The Naughty Baby Is Wreaking Havoc
description:
I was the strongest dragon in the world. But I was sealed by a warrior. I didn’t do anything wrong! I don’t want to die! I don’t want to!

What is this?

However, when I opened my eyes, I found myself becoming the youngest daughter of the warrior who sealed me. Well, it’s not so bad. If I raise myself well and destroy the warrior’s family, it will be my revenge against him! I’ll kill you, warrior. I’ll burn you to ashes, warrior!

I swore that…

“But our lady, it’s so pitiful; what should we do?”
“Our lovely lady…”
“She’s on a limited time…”

Humans.

What did you say? Am I on a limited schedule?

***

But it’s alright. I am a dragon. An indomitable and magnificent being. I need to recover my strength, capture some petty black mages, and replenish my magical power! I might as well save these insignificant humans, too.

“Our lady is making a move again, isn’t she?”
“Calling her evil was all lies. Our lady is a warrior now. A warrior.”
“Our lady! I’m your fan!”

Maybe I’m a dragon that humans find appetising?

And to add to that,

“Daphne! Teach me swordsmanship too! Me too!” The third eldest, Brother, who used to curse at me upon sight, is now wagging his tail and sticking to me.

“I, I…! I’ll follow your example and become strong!”
“Hey! I still don’t like you or anything, but take this as you go!” My second sibling, who was a recluse, and the first eldest, Oribe, who despised me and ran away from home, haven’t changed much.

“Don’t get hurt. You’re My precious daughter.” Even my father, the warrior who didn’t even blink when I died, suddenly cares for me!

I planned to destroy this family and achieve my revenge, so why are you all acting like this?

title: The Ten-Thousandth Rebirth
description: After living through ten thousand lives, Chen Luo has mastered everything from ancient languages to the art of the master thief. Now, back in the classroom of his youth, he’s no longer a helpless student—he’s a man with the ultimate cheat code: absolute knowledge of the future and everyone’s darkest secrets.

title: The Player Purge: When the World Becomes a Game
alt_titles: Player Elimination Plan! When Anomalies Descend Upon The Human World
description: The apocalypse prophecy has come true. A dark celestial body draws near, turning the entire Blue Star into a doomsday game. All of humanity has been reduced to NPCs—helpless prey for players from beyond the stars. As the world mutates and players run rampant, despair consumes mankind… Until Yun Qi awakens a hidden class, gaining the power to strike back against the players.

title: Divine Melody - The Untold Story
description:
Sequel to Divine Melody. Caisheng, the half demon fox god who can change gender at will, wanders the Earth looking for her lost lover's reincarnation, Wei Tzequi. Wei Tzequi, a former divine being, was banished from the heavens for breaking the rules, but Caisheng refuses to give up hope she will meet him again.  
  
But finding Wei Tzequi is only the start of Caisheng's troubles. Other beings, both demons and gods alike, want her for their own reasons. Some see Caisheng as the salvation for their own race, while others want to kill her for their own nefarious purposes. Even a fox-god from the heavens, Yuer, finds himself intensely curious with Caisheng, and decides he will take her back to the heavens in order to marry her. In order to survive, Caisheng must muster what allies she can so she can continue to wander - and find the one person she has spent so many years seaching for.

title: Divine Melody
description:
This is a tale full of wonderful Ancient Chinese legends. A group of beautiful female fox demons lived at the base of a mystical mountain. Among these foxes is the very special Caisheng, a little fox girl with the ability to change into a male fox demon when she matures and allow the continuation of her species. One day, she secretly went into a nearby human village and befriended a boy named Duoxi and a girl named Xiaoque, and when the little fox child is attacked by a dog, the two human children saved her! Now the two children are marked, and will remain so – even in their reincarnated lives – until Caisheng repays her debt to them…   
  
Two hundred years later, Caisheng not only becomes the most powerful fox demon but also has mastered the art of gender transformation. She begins her search for her saviors' reincarnations: the boy now known as Yunshi, and the girl as Ping'er. Not knowing Caisheng's true identity, Yunshi falls in love with the female Caisheng, and Ping'er with the male Caisheng! But Yunshi is a priest whose duty is to destroy all of the demons… what will he do when he discovers Caisheng's true nature? And whom will Caisheng choose in the end?   
  
(Clarifying note: Very low smut content)

title: Don't Touch My Ears
description: Ruan Ning is a sophomore at Hongcheng High School. She is the class president, the number one student in her grade, and the most popular girl at school. But she has a secret, she's a beast-person, and nobody can see her ears or tail, at least until a beautiful new transfer student comes along.

title: Emotion
description:
The delinquent Choi Young-hyeon and his personal toy, Lee Min-woo.

Min-woo had always obeyed Young-hyeon without protest, swayed by the delinquent’s ever-changing moods.

But one day—nine years after it all began back in middle school—Young-hyeon abruptly declared an end to their relationship. And in doing so, he overlooked one crucial fact.

That the “personal toy” wasn’t Min-woo at all—it was himself.

A truth he realizes only after waking up in a strange room... kidnapped.

title: I’m The Only One Who Doesn’t Know That Villainess Is Man
alt_titles: Am I the Only One Who Didn't Know the Villainess Was a Man?
I Didn’t Know the Villainess Was a Man
I'm the Only One Who Didn't Know the Villainess Was a Male
I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Know the Villainess Is a Man
description:
Fortunately , it’s still in my childhood day’s , not to severe yet. To prevent worsening of condition , I must stick close to treatment , the villainess Rachel.

“Never come near me again”

” I hate noisy and chaotic things ”

” We don’t need that , so just leave ”

…..well, it’s not easy to stick by sharp tongued villainess. Still I destroy the original work diligently to survive. But it seems we couldn’t completely avoid the original work , and we have to part away .

Ten years later . The caring villainess sends a handsome bodyguard , worried about my safety.

” You’ll make my face explode . Have you fallen for me ”

But this man somehow remind me of Rachel. But his personality seems different …. Maybe it’s just my imagination?

….Or so I thought .

” So are you going to have contact marriage , you’re holding the hand like this once you’re married .”

As I stutter in surprise , he closes the distance between us . I can fee his breath .

” You should also kiss.”

His face up close is clearly that of man’s .

Could you do this with someone else.

Wait a minute .

Wasn’t he supposed to be villian?!

title: Westwood Vibrato
description:
Whatever instrument, the genius instrument repairman Cornelia Bobo Warshaw will tune it to your desire. From Yoon In Wan, the author of 'Island', 'New Amhanguhsah' and Kim Sun Hee, the author of 'Three Kingdoms of Go' comes a new creation about music and drama.

---

**Note:** Westwood Vibrato is a manhwa written by Youn In Wan with art by Kim Sun Hee. Originally released in Japan in black and white, it was later released as a Korean Webcomic in full color.

title: Killer Seven
description:
On a small island, Seven, an assassin who can disguise himself as anything, carries out various assassinations at a low price, charging only 567 yuan for each mission.

---
**Note:**
- The Manhua was originally published on Tencent Comics but later taken down. However, You can continue the story that started in Chapter 9 through the anime/donghua of the same name.

title: The Cat Is Nipping Catnips
description: Pa Si happened to encounter Qing’s pheromone, which smelled similar to a catnip. This encounter made Pa Si, a lover of catnip, greedy for Qing’s pheromone. With his attention and attraction only focused on Qing, he tries to stimulate Qing’s pheromones by making him angry. The road to mutual understanding is long and it would take the two of them a long time with inevitable mistakes. Pa Si only regarded Qing as a Catnip, but he also wondered…what if Qing was the one destined to him?

title: Permission of Bite
description: Caelius , a high-ranking lord among vampire nobility, undergoes an unexpected transformation while investigating anomalies within their territory. During the crisis, they cross paths with a young werewolf named Rehgar, forming an inextricable bond. Though their races are sworn enemies, the two are forced to embark on a journey together to uncover the truth behind the hidden darkness festering within the vampire realm. Along the way, their connection evolves from a mere contractual relationship into that of inseparable soulmates.

title: My Possession Became a Ghost Story
alt_titles: After Transmigrating, I Became an Urban Legend
description:
I transmigrated into a romance fantasy novel.

The problem? I woke up inside a coffin… on the original owner’s funeral day.

Worse, I’ve read way too many romance fantasy novels to figure out which story this is. My family is cold and heartless, and the maids tremble whenever they see me… At this rate, I must have possessed the villainess.

Fine. With all my rofan experience, the first thing I need to do is escape the villainess route!

While searching for a way out, I discovered a strange symbol.

“What’s this?”

[How to Summon □□]

A summoning circle to call a spirit? A dragon?
Perfect. A villainess should at least have the power to protect herself.

“Meow.”

…But instead of a spirit or a dragon, why was I chosen by a three-eyed, leopard-spotted cheese cat?!

Well, whatever. It’s adorable, so I don’t mind.

⸻

There is a monster living in the Rohanson Count’s estate.

A monster wearing the skin of the late Lady Evangeline.

A heroine who believes the world is just a romance fantasy novel—
And the people around her, forced to experience horror stories because of her.

title: A Wicked Husband
description:
When Archduke Cesare returns from war, Eileen barely recognizes the man she once knew — he's cold, commanding, and burning with unspoken desire. But nothing shakes her more than his sudden proposal. 

As old feelings stir, Eileen must choose: take his hand, or flee before his fire consumes her.

title: Rescue System
description:
Kim Soohyuk, a veteran rescuer in Shinil-seo was crushed and killed during a rescue operation in a collapsing building.
Soohyuk, who thought he was dead, opened his eyes in an incident 10 years ago. [Save Everyone] He was able to save two people that he couldn't save in the past.
As a reward, he was also given new abilities and strength. "Great. From now on, I will save the lives of those I couldn't save in the past!"

title: Veteran of the Apocalypse
description:
When Seongho logs off Survival Life for the final time, the last thing he expects is for the video game to become reality. Worse still, the game is set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and deadly monsters. 

Having awakened as a hunter with the ability to open dimensional gates, Seongho rushes to build a hideout in another realm in order to survive as he works to level up his skills and abilities, preparing to save the world from impending doom. 

But with other hunters emerging and forming parties, there may be more to worry about than just monsters…

title: A Requiem for the Queen
description:
At night, Princess Millaria, who dreams of an unnamed queen, becomes intertwined with the body of a queen from a hundred years ago, as if by fate. And thus, she discovers the queen's diary.

"I entrust the kingdom to you. I humbly plead with you, bowing my head like this."

A dark cloud loomed before her, causing confusion!

"Who are you?"

Ferdinand, the Duke, somehow recognizes her true identity. But crisis soon becomes an opportunity!

"Cooperate with me. If you do, I will turn a blind eye to your identity."
"Alright. But there's one condition."
"What is it?"
"It's not enough for you to just turn a blind eye to my identity. I want to be treated as a flawless queen."

Millaria, who has chosen to live under the name of the queen, and Ferdinand, the Duke who knows her secret, play a duet solely for the well-being of Queen Gloria, who only desired the kingdom's peace—a requiem for the queen.

title: Unfortunately Inherited Grandpa's Wardrobe and Female Ghost
alt_titles: Unfortunately Inherited Grandpa's Wardrobe and Female Ghost
Grandpa's Wardrobe and the Ghost I Inherited
description:
Unlucky since childhood, Jiang Yao is scraping by in the big city, until life collapses all at once: he’s laid off, his rented room mysteriously burns down, and after paying the damages with his life savings, he’s left penniless.
With nowhere else to go, he returns to the ramshackle, dangerous house his grandfather left behind.

While cleaning, he’s driven off by the house’s guardian: a female ghost named Shen You.
In a frantic dash to escape, Jiang Yao opens the bedroom wardrobe, only to be pulled, along with the pursuing ghost, into the strange world hidden behind it.

Thus begins his wild, episodic “infinite-flow” adventure: one portal after another, one deadly trial after the next.

(Source: Bilibili, edited)

title: A Comic Artist’s Survival Guide
description: Snow, a failing comic artist whose comic is about to be discontinued, reincarnates into his own comic by chance. In his comic, the Pante Continent is on the verge of ruin due to the expansion of the Demon King’s army, resulting in Snow being in danger as well. Just as his life was about to end, Snow receives an opportunity to survive, with the condition that he takes over the author’s role and rewrites the entire comic’s storyline. If he fails to ” create” a more interesting story, then Snow and the comic world would be destroyed…

title: After Transmigrating, I Became an Urban Legend
alt_titles: After Transmigrating, I Became an Urban Legend
My Possession Became a Ghost Story
Fùshēn Zhīhòu Wǒ Chéng le Guàitán

title: Fragment of the Moon
description: Eugene, a doctor who was falsely accused and released from the hospital, now treats people illegally. He is targeted by Vladimir, the boss of a massive mafia organization, and is abused every night. Then one day, Vladimir is seriously injured, losing his memory. "Why did it have to be you? Coming to you in such a critical situation... Isn't that proof of our special bond?"

title: Kariel the Warrior
description:
In a world where warriors are chosen to wield a holy sword and defeat the Demon Lord every hundred years, Kariel is only a guide, bound to support others from the sidelines. He dreams of rising beyond his rank, but the Demon Lord of this era has already been slain. 

Despite this, the world begins to unravel instead of heal. Monsters grow unpredictable, a mysterious knight hunts champions, and secret organizations move in the shadows. 

Traveling with his childhood friend Reina, Kariel is drawn into a dangerous mystery that may determine the fate of the world.

title: Maison
description:
Once a slave, Lev is unexpectedly freed by a passing nobleman named Nox and brought into his household to start a new life of quiet stability.

But everything begins to shift the night Lev shares a bed with Arad, Nox’s close friend.

From that moment on, the balance between the three begins to twist, tangle, and unravel, turning the mansion into something far more complicated than a place of refuge.

title: The Villainous Duke's Daughter's Special Method of Growing Rice
description:
When you transmigrate into a novel as the villainess destined to die, there are different ways to survive: flirting with the male lead, learning to fight, or finding happiness elsewhere — but not Erica! 

She has decided to become a successful rice farmer just like in her past life! What follows is an epic (and rather surreal) quest to find the last rice seeds in the world, tame a giant rabbit magic beast, recruit magicians to water the fields, and — 

Wait, did she just turn the Holy Sword into a hoe?!

title: The Last Of The Devil's
description:
Note: The series has an ending, but was cut short. Should you choose to read it, read it at your own risk.   
  
Due to his father's disappearance, Rhine stepped into the vampires territory in search for his father. Little did he know that the cold and arrogant leader of vampires behaved abnormally to him after one night.   
Every single day he worried if he could make it out alive while finding his father, and the secret behind this vampire household, can he escape the vampire's control over him?

title: Suseon Reincarnation Book: Return of the Supreme
description:
The main character faces death while dealing with the ancestors who conspired with each other to get their hands on the sacred weapon, Sanhasajikdo.

Eun-i, the only sister left behind by Seo-hyeon, the owner of a small household with no speculation that goes unrecognized.

To protect his family, Seohyun concentrates on training Seoncheon's martial arts...

Sanhasajikdo and Ki-ryeong, which were thought to have disappeared, are restored and take a step towards the top again.

title: I Became the Dying Female Lead's Sister
alt_titles: I Became the Sister of the Time-Limited Heroine
I Became the Younger Sister of a Dying Woman
description: In a twist of fate, a girl wakes up as Lynzelle, twin to her favorite novel's dying female lead, Lykke. To secure Lykke's happiness, she volunteers to wed the fearsome prince, Hernan, in her sister's stead. But hold on... The scary prince turns out to be super cute, sparking unforeseen feelings! Everything seems perfect until Lynzelle's health mysteriously deteriorates more than Lykke's, and the story takes an unexpected turn. Is this cute twin tale hiding more secrets than meets the eye?

title: Time Roulette
description:
Poor law school student, Jeonghun Han, experiences a time slip via the time roulette machine he accidentally finds at his father's place. When he comes to his senses, he finds himself in the middle of a battlefield during the Joseon dynasty! But before Jeonghun can even process what’s happened, he’s approached by a messenger named Jun, who informs him that the only way he can go back to his time period is by completing the time roulette’s mission. Will Jeonghun be able to complete his mission and return to his time?

---

- [Original Webtoon <Webtoon kakao>](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%ED%83%80%EC%9E%84%EB%A3%B0%EB%A0%9B/2525)

title: Dark Invasion
description: During a rare total lunar eclipse, as the blood-red moon showed up in the sky, countless black particles erupted from its surface and rained down on Earth. Anyone struck by these particles transformed into monstrous, black creatures. Like ravenous zombies, they attacked the living, spreading the horrifying transformation like wildfire. Caught in the chaos, a college student named Xu Baijin bands together with a group of survivors, fighting for their lives against the relentless onslaught of monsters. As they struggle to survive, they begin to uncover a chilling truth: this apocalyptic event is no mere natural disaster, but a dark secret lurks beneath the surface, waiting to be revealed!

title: Taekwondo Kid
description: Ihn Kim is an explosive Taekwondo fighter who can throw brutal kicks, but his opponents don’t take him seriously because he’s held back by all the sparring rules. However, changes are coming in the Taekwondo world that just might give Ihn a fighting chance. Can Ihn beat the people who once mocked him and show everyone that his style of Taekwondo is no joke?

title: Love in Session
description:
Eighteen-year-old Chae Woori is just a normal high schooler who loves reality dating shows — until she unexpectedly lands a spot on "Love in Session" alongside her childhood crush, Hyeon Woojin. 

Frantic to win his heart, Woori throws herself at the opportunity. But her mission quickly becomes complicated: Woojin is mysteriously absent, one participant hates her, and she finds herself unexpectedly attracted to others on the show. As romantic tensions rise, Woori must navigate her feelings and the show’s drama. 

Can she untangle her heart and find true love amid the chaos?

title: The Secrets of the Willson Family
alt_titles: The Secrets of the Willson Family
description:
Multi-million dollars in inheritance, but where is the money? 

Anna Willson arrives at her late grandfather's country villa expecting a holiday. Instead, she finds secret messages left for her by her grandfather and a bunch of suspicious people. Can she follow her grandfather’s clues to uncover her family's secrets and secure her inheritance before anyone else?

title: Return of the Demonic Instructor
description: The world is destroyed by a demon invasion and Bigang Sa is forced to serve in the demon army for centuries. After a failed human uprising, Bigang transports himself back into his body, ten years before the arrival of the demons. Can he use his centuries of demon warrior training to create a new class of murim fighters powerful enough to ward off the coming invasion?

title: Swordsman Of Red Light
description: Sahwacheon is a powerful swordsman with unmatched skill in a fight. After rescuing a girl from kidnapping, Sahwacheon gets into trouble with feuds between families. An intensive story of a Swordsman on his dangerous journey to survive in the red light district!

title: When Enemies Become Lovers
description:
A misunderstanding during an audition for a talent show 5 years ago made Ho Su hate Won very much. But bad luck for Ho Su, it turns out that he actually has to ask Won for help in order to become famous. Can Won and Ho Su solve their problems?

___

- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://kakaopage.co.id/content/Musuh-Jadi-Cinta/3027)

- [Official French Translation](https://www.verytoon.com/serie/amour-amer)

title: Mr. Magic Man
description: Maseong is a celebrity magician with a profound secret: he can actually move things with his mind! When he runs into a mysterious young woman with amnesia claiming to know him from a past life, Maseong’s existence is upended. Cheondong seems to attract attention wherever she goes, including that of Maseong’s charismatic (but maybe evil) boss, Phillip, and Phillip’s lecherous half-brother, Pilyeong. Who is Cheondong, why does she know so much about Maseong, and will they be able to work through more than five centuries of baggage and just fall in love already?

title: The Spy Life in the Demonic Sect
alt_titles: The Spy Life in the Demonic Sect
A Spy's Survival in the Demonic Cult
description: Iseo Jang, the Murim Alliance’s prodigy spy, has spent 14 years deep undercover in the Demon Sect, earning the ruthless title of “Rabid Dog” for his work as their counterintelligence agent. But his newest mission is his most absurd yet: make the Sect’s laziest, most notorious delinquent -- Wu Ma -- the next Cheonma. To pull it off, Iseo ditches his post and applies to be Wu Ma’s official aide. In a world of betrayal, martial arts, and political games, can even a talent like Iseo turn a hopeless young master into an heir?

title: Strinova ~Tomorrow Will Finally Come~
alt_titles: Kǎlā bǐ qiū ~zhōng jiāng yíng lái de míngtiān ~
description: Opal has decided to form a new elite combat squad. Michele Lee, a rookie investigator from PUS, is ordered to participate in the squad's selection exam. Also taking part in the exam are an individual from Urbino and a member of the Scissor who is hiding their identity...

title: Refund High School
description: High-schooler Aru's dream of becoming an idol is cut short after dying in a car crash on her way to school. She finds herself being offered the option to be reincarnated into a fish... or attend Refund High School in the Underworld to change her fate. Will Aru be able to earn enough karma to reincarnate as the ideal version of herself?

title: Red Cage
description:
In the worst neighborhoods, the back of a taxi is called the cage. 5326 is the code, Re-Call Red, a revenge call to end all suffering. Need a bully curb-stomped? Call. Your husband cheat on you? Call. Has your business partner stolen all your money? Call and Deke will be there, waiting for you, for them. The Rainbow Taxi offers the full spectrum of special services.

Call now.

title: A World Without Domino
description: A long, long time ago, there was a legendary traveler—Domino. Wherever he went, prosperity followed. His story was passed down through generations, inspiring many young people to dream of becoming travelers themselves. One day, a girl awoke from a deep slumber—but she couldn’t remember who she was, where she came from, or where she was headed. Just then, a kind-hearted young traveler happened to pass by and offered her his help. And just like that… their journey began.

title: The Taming of the Hellcat
description:
She was forced to marry. Now, her husband wants a divorce. 

Leah retreats to a secluded villa to regroup — only to be saved from danger by a mysterious leopard. 

But the wild creature is no ordinary beast; he’s Januk, a shape-shifting imperial prince, and taming him might be the start of something wild.

title: A Flower Blooms on the Wall
alt_titles: A Flower Blooms on the Wall
description: “Of course I recognized you. You’re my first love.” Living a life of being stalked by her first love, Dam Do is visited by her brother’s friend Yun Oh. No longer the boy next door who used to follow her around like a puppy, Yun is now a man, and he acts strangely aloof around her. While Dam has found herself resenting her first love, Yun is secretly quite excited to be around his first love once again. As the two become reacquainted after their time apart, they may be in for a lesson on what love really is.

title: Success Story Of The Omnipotent Soldier
description:
Second Lieutenant Kang Seong-tae, who was commissioned as a bachelor's officer in 2008, will be transferred to a defected unit...

---

- [Original Webtoon <kakao>](https://page.kakao.com/home?seriesId=54395693)

title: Into the Sea
description: Once the closest of lovers, Ji Lingyue and Lan Wu, were forced apart by their identities as human and demon. Lan Wu, the mermaid princess, chose to leave Ji Lingyue, subjecting her to countless days and nights of agony. When they reunited at a cultivation gathering, Ji Lingyue swore never to let Lan Wu leave again.

title: 35cm
description:
In elementary school, Ban Hana was always the tallest in her class.
But while everyone else kept growing… she didn’t.
Now in high school, Hana finds herself face-to-face with a tall, broad-shouldered boy she barely recognizes — so tall she has to crane her neck just to meet his eyes.
And that boy?
It’s Han Gyeol — the same kid who used to be shorter than her.
The height difference hasn’t changed.
It’s still 35 centimeters.
But this time, everything else has.
A story about a 35-centimeter gap — and how their positions completely flipped

title: Love Deficiency
description: In Love Deficiency, people are in danger of turning invisible and dying if they're not in love! Thus the romance of a man and a woman begin because of the need to survive!

title: Please, Be My Baby
description: Kang Min-woo suffers from amnesia after a car accident. Three men approach him... Each of them claims, "I'm your real boyfriend!". Finding himself with three boyfriends in an instant, Min-woo begins a physical conversation to find the "real" one.

title: Dancing With Unwelcome Guests
description:
A new semester of 8th grade—Ji Haero ends up in the same class as her ex-boyfriend, the one who secretly dated her and then dumped her.

But wait, what now? It’s already painful enough being stuck with the guy who broke her heart,
and now he says he likes someone else in their class?

And of all people… that someone is Choi Jinyoung?!

There’s a secret between Ji Haero and Choi Jinyoung—one that absolutely no one can find out… Surrounded by nothing but unwelcome guests, can Haero survive the chaos of adolescence in one piece?

title: So As A Joke
description: A story took inspiration from the myth "As a joke"

title: Đang chữa lành
description: Bí quyết của cuộc sống là bắt đầu làm những điều điên rồ từ sớm.

title: Please Eat Little Bean!
description: "Please eat Little Bean!" is about a red bean whose biggest dream is to get eaten. Every day, its job is to be inside a variety of treats like red bean bingsu, matcha red bean cake, red bean boba milk tea, red bean buns, and more... just drifting along, waiting to be eaten. While "working", it meets many unique little friends, such as Boba Pearl, Wolf Berry, and more... The manhua's storyline is very interesting, its characters are charming and cute, the backgrounds are exceptionally beautiful, and the action flows are smooth. It shows the audience the bittersweet life of a little bean and the parallel world of foods~

title: PGR · Overlord Celica
alt_titles: Tiān Kōng Bà Zhǔ Sài Lì Kǎ
Tian Kong Ba Zhu Sai Li Ka
description: With the fall of the Hanging Gardens, the mighty Celica returned to the mortal realm. Her triumphant journey, crushing all in her path, began. ———— But is that truly the case? A side story completely different from the game's plot—the overlord Celica has finally arrived after a difficult struggle!

title: Closing Breaker
description:
The 31st generation descendant of the Yoo Sim Joo clan, Joo Cheongdo.
 The curse that he was given when he was young kills everyone he has given affection to and even threatens his own life. However, Cheongdo, who cannot give up his will to live, expects a final miracle from Yoo Chanran, who can solve any problem.
"How much is it? 
"Starts at 100,000 won per hour."

title: [Traditional Erotic Fairy Tales] It's Not My Thing !
description: Le bûcheron, parti travailler dans la montagne comme à l'accoutumée, lavait son pénis de bois au bord de l'eau où il allait se désaltérer, lorsqu'il le fit tomber accidentellement dedans. L'épaisse brouillard devant le bûcheron chagriné se répand, et le dieu de la montagne apparaît faisant une demande obscène tout en lui disant qu'il lui trouvera son objet...

title: My Dress-Up Darling 107.5
description: A Collection of fanmade manga content/drawings drawn and authored by 沈蛇皮/Shen She Pi/Shipi.

title: Fey Evolution Merchant
description:
A century after the Spirit Qi Awakening, the world enters a new era. Humans are able to absorb the world’s awakened spirit qi, allowing them to tread on a new path—spirit qi occupations!

Simultaneously, the plants and animals on the planet are also evolving toward their ancestry line or developing spiritual mutations.

Lin Yuan realizes that he can assist feys in evolving limitlessly and constantly purify their bloodlines. He starts off with a small fey evolution store on the Star Web and rises up from there.

Lin Yuan: “There is no problem that I cannot solve to deliver the goods. If there is a problem, it is because the goods are better than expectations!”

title: Would You Like to Hold My Hand?
description: Ex-lovers who are like poop teas that make the duvet full when you think about the past! If we could know the end of love with our lover, wouldn't we be able to filter the shit out of it and easily know the fateful person? That question will be answered.

title: Rumors are strictly prohibited
description:
A crack ship that trended for half a year — and now the real people finally meet! One’s a famous movie star. The other? A chill, low-key idol. Two people with zero overlap, no connection whatsoever... yet thanks to a random crackship post on a fan forum, they suddenly blew up online as a pair?! Our socially anxious little idol just wants to stay far, far away — but fate has other plans, and the two unexpectedly cross paths! What kind of sparks will fly between this “CP born on the internet”? 

(CP stands for "couple" (or character pairing) and not the other term)

title: Martial Fist (Extras)
description: Extra chapters published inbetween chapters 131 and 132.

title: [Master and Servant GL Anthology] First Love to You
alt_titles: [Master and Servant GL Anthology] First Love to You
description: The little witch Lulu, who dreams of fated love, runs away to the human world in search of it. Just when she’s starting to believe that running away only leads to suffering… She meets Hayeon by chance. With a bright smile, Hayeon looks at Lulu without judgment—never mocking her dreams. And when Hayeon says she’ll paint her an even more beautiful portrait… Lulu finds herself overwhelmed by a new desire: “I want to make her mine.” 10 years later Lulu returns to the human world to finally claim her true love, Hayeon. But Hayeon doesn’t recognize her at all…!? “Even if you don’t remember me, that’s okay. We can take our time building new memories—just the two of us.” “Become mine!”

title: My Niece/Aunt Seems to Like Me Too!?
alt_titles: My Niece/Aunt Seems to Like Me Too!?

title: The Parasitic Mage
description:
In the vast realm of a massively multiplayer online game, players fight, level up, and shape their own destinies. But while others chase glory with swords and spells, one man chooses a path no one dares to take— The path of the Parasite Mage. Unloved by the system. Mocked by players. Yet behind the scenes, this strange and overlooked class holds terrifying potential. By infesting bosses, draining enemies, and thriving off others’ strength, he plays a different kind of game—one that only a true tactician can master.

With strategy, patience, and a dash of madness, the Parasite Mage begins his ascent from ridicule to dominance, turning every enemy into fuel for his rise.

title: Jiǎzhuāng Shīyì Hòu Qíngdí Shuō Wǒ Shì Tā de Nán Péngyǒu
description:
Могут ли два конкурирующих альфы стать парой? Спросите Лин Юньфаня, который попадает под машину, спасаясь от ростовщиков, за рулём которой оказывает не кто иной, как его бывший соперник, Цзи Цанхай!
Их путь от друзей детства к непримиримым противникам принимает драматический оборот, когда Юньфань симулирует амнезию, чтобы избежать неловкого воссоединения. Но внезапно Цанхай заявляет, что они встречаются!
Пока Юньфань разбирается с этим, он задается вопросом: является ли происшествие удачей, способной восстановить давно утраченную связь, или лучше оставить прошлое в прошлом?

title: The Reason Why That Villainess Picked Up a Sword
alt_titles: The Reason Why That Villainess Picked Up a Sword
The Reason the Villainess Took Up the Sword
The Reason Why the Villainess Picked Up a Sword
Why the Villainess Carried a Sword
description:
Erin suffered her entire life from the abuse of the Marchioness and the malicious rumors she spread, until she finally died.

After two reincarnations, she returned as a genius Sword Master.

This time, everything will be different.

---
"Your Majesty wants you to hear this. Your family will soon follow you."

Murdered after years of abuse and false accusations from her stepmother. Thought it was over, after two reincarnations, she returned to her original self, Erin Rexus, known as the greatest villainess. Before losing everything and even losing her loved ones.

"I know there are things you can't tell me. When you're ready, tell me."

The kind and compassionate Second Prince, Ferdin Rexus. When she returned to the past and faced him again, she vowed to herself. She would save him. Even if it meant becoming a true villainess.

title: The Steel Emperor
description:
가우리의 영웅들, 이세계를 정복하라!
이 땅에 가장 영광된 이름, 가우리.

그 이름을 지킨 자.
사람들은 그를 강철의 열제라 부른다!

***

멸망한 가우리(고구려)의 마지막 대장군 ‘고진천’.
패망의 순간, 그는 정예부대 ‘묵갑귀마대’와 함께 이세계로 떨어진다.

엘프, 오크, 드워프, 마법사 등 다양한 종족이 살아가는 낯선 땅.

다시 돌아갈 수 없다면
새로운 가우리를 세우는 수밖에 없다.
고진천은 대륙 정복을 위해 다시 깃발을 든다.

title: Painful Dating
description: The timid Na Jiwoo wants to break up with his scary girlfriend, so he lied about joining the army. After that, he gets a part-time job, but as if by fate, his co-worker is his girlfriend's roommate. Jiwoo must now hide his identity in front of his girlfriend while his co-worker is crushing on him

title: Ordinary Love
description: An ordinary woman with a freelancing career named Mina encountered a troublesome customer online. It turns out that her troublesome customer is Jinho, her timid and shy next door neighbor. With Mina and Jinho going through personal troubles, will they be able to find solace together?

title: The Devil’s Body Temperature
description:
Bei Yao, a cheerful four-year-old, was reborn into 1996 and found herself living next door to a boy destined to become a formidable villain in the future. This boy, Pei Chuan, was only five at the time, confined to a wheelchair and deeply insecure.

Years later, when they were teenagers, Bei Yao had blossomed into the school's most admired beauty. Despite her popularity, Pei Chuan remained guarded and distant. When Bei Yao confessed her feelings for him, he reacted with a mixture of fear and longing.

Having known each other for two lifetimes, Bei Yao was determined to understand the complexities of Pei Chuan's character. As their bond deepened, she discovered a sensitive and vulnerable soul beneath his tough exterior. Their story is one of a healing love that blossoms between childhood sweethearts, as Bei Yao's warmth gradually melts away Pei Chuan's emotional barriers.

title: The Glutton
description: The human world was destroyed by the demon lords. Having lost everything, the awakened warrior Si Chen chooses to launch a desperate, final attack… sacrificing himself in order to take down the demon lord of gluttony, Lan Yue. But when he wakes up again, he finds himself transported ten years into the past, before any of this happened. Realizing that his powers have awakened earlier, he decides he must act early. With his return, everything else in the world seems to have changed as well…

title: Empowering My Kind in the Apocalypse
alt_titles: Try to Save the World by Level Transfer
description: Gates have suddenly appeared, summoning monsters leading the world to doomsday. Can Xiao Haiyun, the only one with the ability to upgrade, become the final savior?

title: She and He
description: Receiving an invitation from her childhood friend Xingqing, Chuyu bids farewell to her boyfriend and returns to her hometown where she crosses paths with her first love, Weilai. The three join Dasheng's art studio to create a manhua: "Heart Of The Forest".  Weilai confesses to Chuyu, leaving her to choose between her boyfriend and Weilai...

title: The Twin Trigrams
description: The young Kan Xing, untrained in Daoist techniques, brings the genius Daoist priest Li Li to an odd escape room establishment to find his missing sister. However, the store's evil spirits far surpass their comprehension.  it all seems to suggest that untold secrets lie beyond the righteous facade of Daoism. And so, for the first time, these two youths come face to face with the complexity of human nature.

title: Longing and Lies
description:
Edelweiss Millen, a transfer student who purely admires music.
However, if he wants to keep attending the music academy, he must pretend to be the successor.
Threatened by the real successor, he struggles to maintain his false identity.

title: I Owe Billions in Debt, So I Was Forced to Work for an Evil God
alt_titles: I Owe Billions in Debt, So I Was Forced to Work for an Evil God
description:
Overworked corporate drone Zhou Chen transmigrates into a magic-powered metropolis, only to inherit a dying teenager’s sky-high debt: over 10 billion in loan shark interest.

Even worse, the original body’s final act was a failed summoning of an evil god, leaving Zhou Chen bound by a cursed contract. Now he must fulfill 999 wishes for the evil deity or face complete annihilation, body and soul.

His only lifeline is a mysterious, talking artifact known as the “Divine Notebook.”

Watch as this modern-day office warrior uses corporate strategies, overwork tactics, and relentless grind to rise through a brutal world where power rules all.

He’s not just surviving. He’s rewriting fate.

This evil god’s employee refuses to lie flat!

title: A Night To Remember
description: When I opened my eyes, the first thing I realized is that I am not a living person. Who am I? Why am I wandering around this place? And who is that man who visits my grave every week?

title: 99 Boss
description:
Born with the heart of a tiger, Na Seon-wook was a troublemaker. But at the request of his parents, he hid his strength and transferred to Gukyang High School, a school located in a remote area that he thought would be quiet. 

However, it was a place where various old-fashioned cultures and dangerous people gathered. 

Seon-wook, who wanted to graduate quietly, eventually he couldn’t help but feel his hot blood and began educating them!

title: Iljin Demonic Cult
alt_titles: Heavenly Demon Goes to High School
description:
He was the unrivaled tyrant who trampled over the martial world—Gucheon, the Supreme Lord of the Demonic Cult, feared across the orthodox sects as the Living Heavenly Demon.

Leading his cult to dominate the peak of Murim, Gucheon became the symbol of terror itself. But during the final, brutal Great Demonic War, where all sects of Murim united against him, Gucheon was ultimately struck down— not by warriors, but by an unknown force.

Just when he thought it was the end… He opens his eyes— not in the blood-soaked plains of Murim, but inside a frail, modern-day teenager’s body! “What is this weird world?! Someone send me back!!” Now stranded in the modern era, the once-unstoppable demon lord must navigate a new jungle: high schools, city streets, and an unfamiliar world without qi or swords. Gucheon descends upon the modern world—
and a new era of chaos begins!

title: A Wimp’s Tower Strategy Guide
alt_titles: A Wimp’s Strategy Guide to Conquer the Tower
description: Mysterious black towers have appeared all over the world. Inside them are monsters, danger, and the promise of power and fame. Only a select few are chosen to enter as players. Everyone calls it a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but 25-year-old Juhyeok Bong calls it a death sentence. He is a timid, anxious self-proclaimed “wimp,” perfectly content with staying under the radar… That is, until he is named as a player. Will he risk everything by entering the tower, or keep running from the one chance that could change his life?

title: The Possessed Acting Prodigy
description: Struggling actor Hyeonsu Kim suddenly gains a strange ability after an accident: he can dream the dreams of the dead. These aren’t hazy nightmares or random visions, but vivid relivings of emotions and experiences that don’t belong to him. When Hyeonsu channels those experiences into his roles, his acting becomes terrifyingly real, as if he’s truly possessed. But how far can a haunted genius go before the dreams start consuming him?

title: There's No Such Thing as a Naughty Munchkin
alt_titles: There's No Such Thing as a Naughty Munchkin
There Are No Bad Precious Children
There is No Such Thing as a Bad Golden Child in The World
description: Korean childcare worker Boyoung awakens in a mysterious land and a bygone era, trapped in the body of governess Edith Bruissel. Thrust into a world of secrets, magic, and noble intrigue, she is determined to find a mage who can send her home. But her plans are quickly complicated by a secretive duke with a troubled past, a marriage contract, and children who need her more than ever. Can Boyoung find her way back to the world she came from, or is she trapped in Edith’s life for good?

title: The Painter's Salvation
description: After years of chasing his dream of becoming an artist, Zhu Chengming finally decides to give it up. However, he soon discovers a difficult question: Is life after abandoning your passion truly as easy and relaxed as he imagined it would be?

title: Special Yellow Day
description: There is a day when even the smallest things are tangled up and messed up. But was it to meet a precious relationship? The story of a summer day that can happen to anyone and is more precious.

title: The Last Trump Card
description: The magnificent "Mu's Game City" is alive with the sound of music and revelry almost every night. Essentially, the wealthy of Macau gather here in their leisure time. Here, money and time turn to dust—utterly worthless—as the very air is saturated with the scent of luxury and indulgence. Under the amber lights, Han Kexin grits her teeth, staring at the cynical woman before her, her grip tightening on the cards in her hand.

title: Are We Just Seeing Each Other for Your Looks?
alt_titles: Are We Just Seeing Each Other for Your Looks?
description:
Seong Yigyeom, 27 years old, has nothing going for him in life except his face. Living up to the saying that he makes his living with his looks, he started working as a rental boyfriend the moment he became an adult, and even after seven years, he still holds onto his unshakable status as the ★ace★ of the industry.

Swearing that he will land one big client and finally quit this line of work for good, Yigyeom suddenly finds Jin Gyutae standing in front of him. With his frizzy hair, thick prescription glasses, a checkered shirt that looks like it came from who knows where, and an aura of pure loser energy you could spot even from a speeding train, Gyutae seems hopeless.

Just when Yigyeom is about to casually strip him bare for fun, once those damn glasses and shabby clothes come off, he actually looks a lot better. Still, honestly, is it even fair for a loser to be that big when he probably cannot even use it anyway…

[A romance from another world between a low self esteem handsome bottom and a nerdy top who dotes on his hyung ♥]

title: Once an Assassin, Now a Royal Nanny
description:
A year after her lover stabs her in the back, legendary assassin Kyla Angel wakes up in the body of Rachel Brown, a nanny tasked with caring for a neglected prince and princess. 

Knowing the man who betrayed her is still out there, Kyla must bide her time before she can sneak out of the palace and get revenge. But in the meantime, she must face her deadliest challenge yet: childcare. 

Now it's up to Kyla to figure out how to soothe a crying toddler with hands meant for throwing daggers and slitting throats...

title: SAMADHI
description: Yibak Kim has only ever dreamed of living an average, peaceful life -- nothing more, nothing less. But when he finds himself with supernatural powers, Yibak must now learn how to hone his new abilities and get used to the fact that, from now on, his life will be anything but normal...

title: Horn
description: A legend says: "A long time ago, God created numerous hardships, he made statements to the world. That statement made each gatekeepers with outstanding abilities stay all around the world. They are called Hon."

title: Red Paper
description: A murder has occurred and the painter is the killer. Desperate, she tried to kill herself but was unsuccessful.

title: Hibiscus and Bamboo
description:
A rich little heiress runs away from home and meets a swordswoman in seclusion deep in the mountains. What sort of story will unfold between the two of them? (Probably a simple and sweet little love story)

---

**Note:** Please support the creators and read the original webcomic [here](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/9747/).

[Artist Weibo](https://weibo.com/u/5282101552)
[Artist BCY](https://bcy.net/u/3325067)
[Artist Mihuashi](https://www.mihuashi.com/profiles/88557?role=painter)

title: Will the Sea King Tip the Boat Today?
description:
I thought I could swim into this beautiful jiejie's heart, but I didn't realize she was a sea king! Encountering love and turmoil from the very first page, Li Haijue decided to let go of herself—to embrace the role of Sea King—and experience a different kind of love story! At the same time, this hidden, mysterious world begins to unravel itself. What does the “Sea King” title on top of her head truly mean..?

TL/N: “Sea King” is Chinese slang for someone who keeps many lovers at the same time! Much like how a King of the Sea rules over all the fish, so does Haijue over the people in her world.

title: Be by My Side
description:
"From the embrace of the golden lion, the sun’s destined companion shall arise."  

On the day Eira Goldwyn was born, a prophecy foretold she would become the Empress. But on her wedding night with the Crown Prince…  

"Are you truly the woman of the prophecy?"  

The golden mark, said to appear only on the chosen one, fails to manifest. Cast aside and humiliated, Eira is unilaterally rejected by the Crown Prince.  

With rumors branding her as an illegitimate child, relatives scheming to seize her family’s legacy while her father lies gravely ill, and relentless headaches and insomnia leaving her vulnerable, Eira's life spirals into chaos.  

Until one fateful evening. At the Twinveil social club in the capital, Eira encounters a man who holds the cure to her afflictions.  

"I’ve found him. My remedy."  

With his help, Eira vows to reclaim everything she lost—her honor, her family’s legacy, and her rightful place in the prophecy.
___
Aylah Goldwyn’s destiny had been determined since her birth: she was to marry the crown prince. However, on the day after her wedding, the prince asks for their marriage to be dissolved. Now, she suffers from near-constant headaches and insomnia, made bearable only through the embrace of a man. One night, she discovers a man who can make her headaches disappear entirely with nothing but a touch. But the next morning, she discovers that he left without a word, and she doesn’t even know his name. Will she be able to find this mysterious man, her “cure”?

title: I Thought I Was the Main Character
description:
Transmigrated into a romance-fantasy novel, the narrator wakes up as a nameless extra and convinces herself she must be the heroine. Enjoying the “main-character route,” she grows close to the supposed male lead, the second lead, and even the hidden villain...

Until blunt questions get blunt answers: none of them actually likes her. Facing reality at last, she drops her beliefs, decides to find a husband who suits her status, and walks away before she’s deluded again.

title: The Count's Beloved Contract Young Lady
alt_titles: Beloved Contract Lady of the County
The Beloved Contract Daughter of the Count's Family
description:
“Maybe I’m the unluckiest person in the world…”

Unloved by her family and alone to her last breath, she reincarnates into a novel’s world as a girl raised in hardship. One day, the heir apparent of a count’s house appears, claims to be her father, and proposes a contract father–daughter arrangement. Confused but desperate to escape, she accepts. She may be his real daughter, but their bond starts as a contract—what future awaits this unusual reunion?

title: Sun and Moon Undecimber
description:
There are countless undead feeding on humans in this world. Countless Sorcerers have been fighting against them for millions of years but defeat is always the end result.   
  
It was not until the emergence of ‘San Zhen' Clan, 3 successors, in 3 different eras fighting against the undead. They are the last chance in this “Man vs Dead" war.

title: The Detective is Not Working Today: Today is For You
description: Di Miao Miao is a detective who has an extremely high IQ but lacks the ability to take care of himself. Having once cleared Bai Wang Wang's name in a case, he gained an assistant (a maid) to take care of his daily life. Since then, a cat-like person and a dog-like person now live under the same roof. During this time, Miao Miao applies his reasoning skills in every aspect of his daily life, while Wang Wang simply looks after him

title: I’m in Love with My Foe
alt_titles: I Confessed to My Mortal Enemy
description: Jiang Mi se réincarne dans le corps d'Olive, la méchante d'un roman populaire qui est destinée à être exécutée par le prince héritier Reynold pour son terrible comportement. Mais Olive aspire à changer son destin et à vivre une vie longue et épanouie. Elle travaille donc dur pour changer sa mauvaise image et prouver sa gentillesse. Bientôt, ses efforts attirent l'attention de Reynold, l'homme même qui est censé la tuer. Si Olive parvient à conquérir le cœur de Reynold, elle sera assurée de vivre une vie heureuse avec un bel homme ! Mais si elle n'y parvient pas, elle sait comment cette histoire se terminera...

title: Worth the Wait
alt_titles: The Struggles of a Younger Top
description:
It was an exhausting love.  
I’ve only experienced it once. It was an unrequited love that shook my entire life.  
However, I met him again. That drunkard guy who got dumped by a man.  
Although I had promised that I won’t waver again like I did last time, I still can't control my heart.  
Why are you still struggling for me?  
  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Author’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/boriri_p)

title: Hush Now, Saintess!
alt_titles: Speech Is Silver While Silence Is Golden, Saintess!
description:
I transmigrated into a crazy novel and came to possess the body of ‘Roella’, a fake saintess who’s destined to die young. A moment of despair. A determined plan to survive.

When the real saintess comes out, I’ll just say, ‘I knew it, I guess I’m a fake!’ then stand down! The perfect plan provided a moment’s repose.

Ding—!
〈 Mission : A villainess, but forcibly turning over a new leaf!

Raise your reputation.
Apply the automatic curse word censorship.
Penalty upon mission failure: Death within six months of the recognition of Sylvia as the real saintess.

Reward upon mission success: Survival.

Would you like to accept this mission? ( I want to ♥ / YES! ) 〉

A ruthless system window with no conscience appeared before my eyes. To ensure my survival, I followed what the system window said.

title: My Girlfriend Is a Warrior From Another World?!
description:
jae-yi lee, who had a crush on his classmate Luna lee, musters up a lot of courage to confess, but doesn't get a response. when he meets luna
 again the mext , day luna has changed and looks like a different person.

title: I'm Attracted to You
description:
Kang Ha-young, who works at a so-called family-like small company, spends every day... Overtime, overtime, and more overtime! 

Then one day, Min Tae-hoon, a contract worker who might just help her escape the endless overtime, appears in front of her! But something's suspicious about this guy... Why would someone with such high qualifications come to our company? 

Wait... is he gay? Or bi? Or maybe a player!? 

They say to avoid trouble, but she just can't help being curious about Min Tae-hoon.

title: The Second Proposal Was Sweet
description:
"Where can you find a crazy woman living with her ex-husband!"

...there it is. Here.

Dan-Bi, who was on the verge of being thrown out on the streets after being scammed for rent, asked the current landlord to let her stay in the empty house until she could come up with the deposit, but that landlord was none other than her ex-husband, who she had broken up with after a one-year contract marriage! Unexpectedly, her ex-husband readily accepted Dan-Bi's request, but "But there's someone already living in that house."

"...Who is it?"

"Me."

Dan-Bi suddenly ends up living with her ex-husband, Do-Young. The two of them are sweet... no, will they be able to end their cohabitation safely?

title: Kimmy & Joy
description: A romance unfolding in a secluded countryside in France in the 1980s! Joy, a shoe designer, came to enjoy a break for the first time in his life, stopping his exhausting daily life due to burnout. However, unlike the plan, the accommodation located at the end of the vast vineyard is very rough from the way. Joey, who was walking tirelessly because he couldn't find a taxi, ended up getting covered with muddy water that his old truck splashed on, and finally arrived at the inn after suffering so much. And in front of her eyes, the old truck and the owner of the truck, Kimi, appear...! The two did not like the first impression. Will Joy be able to spend a peaceful rest here?

title: The Princess Goes To School
description: Kim Seol is the candidate to become North Korea’s next leader and its very own “Princess.” However, Seol lives as an ordinary South Korean high school student, completely unaware that she is the daughter of Kim Jeong-un. To protect her daily life, the youngest-ever “Black Agent,” Jeong Su-hyeon, has infiltrated into her high school. A School Romance Comedy that unfolds as a secret agent meets an oblivious princess!

title: Uncontrollable gravity
description: My ex-girlfriend, with whom I had a precipitous breakup five years ago, is causing a scene at my blind date? The docile and obedient girl I remember now sports striking pink hair, a cigarette between her fingers, and an aura of mystery and danger. She arrives with a burning desire for revenge and to subdue him, only to find that the once-respectable "Teacher Zhang" has long since lost his youthful edge. But why is this seemingly inevitable confrontation spiraling out of control?

title: Pay-to-Win Martial God
description:
Mo Hwiyoung, the great merchant of Central Plains, is attacked by the Demonic Cult and meets his end.
But just as he believes he has died, he awakens in his childhood, thirty years in the past, when he was still training as a lay disciple of the Wudang Sect.

title: Seducing the Jerk
description:
Lingering feelings can haunt you.
Eunsung has always been genetically blessed in the looks department. But what happens when his good looks catch the attention of a ghost? And what will he do when the ghost refuses to pass on till Eunsung helps him get revenge on his first love... by turning him gay?!

title: We Hate the Male Lead
alt_titles: The Male Lead? I Don't Want Him
description:
I reincarnated as Luna, a supporting character who is accused of ruining the heroine and hero’s relationship, and is murdered. I’m not interested in someone else’s man, but the heroine’s friends bully me every day.

*“Why are you trying to get close to someone who’s already taken?”*

*“That’s right, please stop! Why are doing this?”*

*“Stop doing such terrible things!”*

So Luna decides to announce it in front of everyone: “I don’t want someone like Fersen even if you beg me to take him so stop bothering me. I’d rather date Anthes Vincent, who’s rumored to be insane.”

And soon she meets someone who she never expected to meet…

“I heard you have an interest in me? The truth is, I do too. Is it a coincidence?”

title: Angry Thatcher
description: Thatcher, the princess of Molten, who inherited the power of the Flame God, possesses great power, but she is deeply trapped in the curse of "anger", unable to control her emotions and power, and because of this she was framed by the Dragon Clan and had to leave her kingdom. In order to return to her family, Thatcher was determined to go north to find the Flame Sword that could control the power of the Balrog, but waiting for her was a huge conspiracy that swept the world…

title: Liar, Where Are Vampires!
alt_titles: When I Shared My Room, Everyone Was a Vampire
ルームシェアしたら、全員吸血鬼だった
description:
Dongha, who has lived with his father all this time, followed the will of his father to go to the city. Luckily with 30, 000 won, he rented an amazing house and met friends from the same department. They are kind and angelic friends who generously gave the nude Dongha food and daily necessities but…   
  
Dongha's friends are real-life vampires, who droll secretly as Dongha get chubbier. All the while, they laughed in glee, saying "There are many nice people in the world."- seeing that they've caught an innocent and naive human. But they soon fell in love for Dongha's innocence…   
  
One day, when they showed off their pale shoulders in bed to Dongha (who lives by the motto of paying back with whatever he has), the vampires get into a situation and started to nosebleed…  
  
Will they be able to drink Dongha's blood safely while keeping their hearts in line?

title: Arachi: First Irregular
description: Born to a mother who was sealed in a mysterious ark with ten longevity on it, Arachi, who has tremendous power, hides her power and is now the wife of HS group and an ordinary housewife. While leaving for Gangwon-do with her family, they got hit by a truck and her two sons Soo-hyuk and Seon-mi were seriously injured and lost consciousness. In order to protect her precious family, Arachi borrows the status of Sunmi, instead of Hwang Shin-hye, and awakens her past power to find the person behind the attack. Arachi, she’s coming out into the world!

title: Rhinoceros Beetle GF
description: Monster Girl

title: 3ITCHES
description:
"We are the 3itches!"

Follow Olivia, "The Fighter", Vivian, "The Spell Seller", and Tina, "The Pharmacist", on their fantastical and magical adventures. Original in Chinese by Hong Kong artist, KIU, now serialized in Japanese bimonthly magazine Aokishi.

---
Read as "Witches". Think of the 3 as being a vertically oriented W.

title: For the Rest of My Life
description:
She fell in love with an older woman when she was a child, but was never taken seriously. Years later, now both adults, they met again and started living together by chance. She discovered that the woman was a famous book editor, but also had a painful past and a wounded heart. She decided to protect and heal her with her pure and sincere love.

But, they faced many obstacles and prejudices because of age and gender differences. Could they overcome the difficulties and stay together forever? This is a love story between an innocent young girl and a mature woman, who found each other and lost each other in life, but never gave up on loving each other.

title: Her Moonlight
description: Gu Qingying and Fu Shiyu are a couple of girlfriends, the duae are studying in a dance academy, Gu Qingying is known as a genius dancer, but also in school during the professional dance troupe, she is such a perfect pair of lovers, but Gu Qingying one day without saying goodbye to declare a breakup, from then on, for four years, Fu Shiyu has been looking for Gu Qingying until one day, on the dark stage of the bar, she saw a big change in style, it is a dance sexy and hot! Gu Qingying...

title: 999 Girls Chased Me
description: Chen Fan, who was rejected by 999 girls after confessing his love, surprisingly succeeded on his 1000th attempt! What's more, the 999 girls who had previously turned him down came back to chase after him, creating the ultimate harem chaos!

title: Roach
description: In the dead of night, you shed your skin, a husk of a thing, leaving you sticky, renewed… and repulsive. Everyone that lays eyes on you lunges towards you, their eyes full of disgust and intent to kill. You need to run. Nearly overnight, Taesu Im goes from a terminally ill family man to the most reviled existence on Earth. But it’s not just people’s perception of him that’s changed… it’s him. Something has turned him into a half-man, half-cockroach, and he needs to find out what—or who— did this to him before he gets squashed.

title: Black-Haired U.S. Army Marshal
description: Kim Yu-jin, in the second chapter of her life, retracing to the 1910s, conquers history with her future knowledge. A Korean company commander died trying to save a child from Letona, who was rolling down the hill. When I came to my senses, I had reverted to being Kim Yu-jin, a Korean-American in the 1900s, with knowledge of the future. Will those who know the future become chaebols, or will they?

title: The Perfect Contract
description: Junwon, a perfect man, and Ju-i, a woman who knows her abilities and charms, strike an unusual deal: they will date with one strict condition—no falling in love. What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes complicated as unexpected feelings begin to surface. Can they stick to their promise, or will emotions get the better of them? Dive into a world where love is both the goal and the enemy, and find out if their hearts will follow the rules or break free.

title: XinMo
description:
If Li Yunxin were merely human, his deeds would say otherwise. Once a psychologist, now a **painter** wielding sorcery, his true art lies not in ink, but in the unseen threads of the human heart. A hunted man among mortals, a trusted ally among demons—he stands at the crossroads of fate, turning saints into sinners and monsters into pawns.

The righteous sects seek his head. The demons whisper his name with reverence and fear. Even the Black and White Lords of the Underworld, merchants of lost souls, hesitate before him.

Where does the demon that feasts on human hearts come from?

Li Yunxin devours flesh, but his true hunger is for something far more exquisite—the hearts and minds of those who dare to stand in his way.

title: Sungnyung Bubble Tea
description:
If you find that your life is boring and lacking anything special, all you have to do is make something happen yourself!

After realizing that her life doesn't have any impact, Sunhee Hong decides to define the genre of her life herself.

Through a sparkling romance, will Sunhee, who decided to become the protagonist herself, be able to live a special life with the male lead?

---
**Link:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11652736)

title: Taming the Possessive Girl
alt_titles: Di Shao Zhuan Chong Badao Qi
description: "100 Yuan, your tips. Take care." Take advantage of the Lord of this city, you dare want to take it as if nothing happened?

title: The Unyielding Ancient Cultivator
alt_titles: Shi Shang Zui Qiang Lian Ti Lao Zu
The Strongest Grandmaster of Body-strengthening Cultivation
The Strongest Body Refiner in History
Shǐ Shàng Zuì Qiáng Liàn Tǐ Lǎo Zǔ
description:
Ye Cangxuan, the grandmaster of Body-strengthening Cultivation died while passing through the Eternal Heavenly Tribulation.

When he wakes up again, he becomes mortal and returns to the sect he founded.

This time, the invincible grandmaster is set to punish the villains and restore his godly might!

title: Don't Look for the Resurrected Villainess
alt_titles: Don’t Look for the Revived Villainess
description:
Ô Dieu, je t'ai demandé de faire preuve de miséricorde, alors pourquoi m'as-tu ressuscité ?

« Avez-vous une dernière volonté ? »

« Seigneur, aie pitié d'eux. »

J'ai été trahi par ceux en qui j'avais le plus confiance, et ma vie s'est terminée sous la guillotine. Mais ensuite, le monde a été bouleversé par un oracle. Le mal sévit ; c'est pourquoi je vous confie la Ressuscitée. Restez forts et affrontez-le.

Attends, cher Dieu. Je t'ai demandé d'avoir pitié d'eux, je ne t'ai jamais demandé de me ramener à la vie ! Tu ne peux pas simplement les laisser aller en enfer ?

title: How to Conquer the Yanderes
description:
While playing a dating simulation game, the male protagonist Zhao Xun is struck by electricity and becomes bound to a dating-sim system. This system not only allows him to see girls’ affection levels, but also lets him save and load progress, equip items, and effortlessly charm his way through romantic encounters.

Just when Zhao Xun believes he can use the system to reach the peak of life, the girl he successfully wins over suddenly turns yandere and tries to kill him.

Fortunately, the heroine Ling Yu, a bloodline bearer, arrives in time and kills the corrupted girl, allowing Zhao Xun to narrowly escape death. Through his conversation with Ling Yu, Zhao Xun learns the truth about ancient gods and bloodline bearers, realizing that the girl’s transformation was caused by possession from an ancient god’s soul.

Determined to save the girl, Zhao Xun resolutely reloads his save and starts over. In order to dispel the ancient god’s influence and save her life, he begins a targeted “romance strategy” to win her over once again.

title: When the Day Comes
description:
We're in a relationship where we've broken up but haven't really broken up.  
What will happen to us when we haven't been truthful?

title: Don't XXXX Where You Work
alt_titles: Let's Distinguish Between Public and Private Matters
description: Dabi works as an assistant manager in the same company as Jeongheon. Dabi and Jeongheon have met before in college on a blind date. Dabi remembers Jeongheon as one of the worst dates in her life. On the first day they met, Jeongheon talked about his thesis which felt really boring for Dabi. Then on the second date, he ran off from a movie theater while watching a horror movie and never came back. Now, Dabi and Jeongheon work in the same company, but Jeong-heon still has no social skills whatsoever. When Jeongheon accidentally discovers Dabi's sex toy on a business trip, they decide to make a deal. Dabi will train Jeong-Heon to be a more sociable man as Jeongheon tells her that he tries to win someone's heart.

title: The Wind and the Four-Leaf Clover
alt_titles: The Wind and the Four-Leaf Clover

title: Reincarnated as a Disaster Witch, I Don't Want to Be Captured
alt_titles: Zhuǎnshēng Chéng Zāi È Mónǚ De Wǒ Bùxiǎng Bèi Gōnglüè
description: Xia Xin, a serious lily lover, traveled into the game world and became the villain "Disaster Witch". In order to reverse the destiny of being trained, Xia Xin completed tasks under the guidance of the system to change her destiny. Unknowingly, she conquered the Holy Knight, the Saint of Light, the Demon King of the End, the Savior of the World, and the Emperor of the Abyss...

title: Funerals for the Damned
description: It all begins with a meteor shower. Soon after, reports spread of so-called Immortals. Each time they die, their bodies reset to an earlier point in time, with every wound, scar, and even the smallest scratch gone. Humanity is thrown into chaos, unable to explain the strange phenomenon. Two hundred years later, scientists still haven't been able to uncover the mystery of immortality. The Immortals now live in hiding: hunted, captured, and exploited as test subjects. They are forced to live, unable to die. Then, a rumor begins to spread of a man known only as the Undertaker— the one who can kill the Immortals.

title: You’ve Never Reached Me Like This
alt_titles: You’ve Never Reached Me Like This
description: For 500 years, Mujin has been offering prayers to guide lost spirits to their rest. Then, in front of him, appears Geumji—his lover who died 300 years ago—reborn. But even in this life, she is already a dead soul. Unaware that she has died, she has returned to Mujin.

title: Romance Starting with Parenting
alt_titles: A Romance That Begins With Childcare
description: At a young age, just after graduating from university, Na-eun suddenly finds herself raising her older sister’s child, Jiho. Five years later, while working as a kindergarten teacher, she meets Kang-woo—the uncle of Minho, a child suffering from selective mutism who only speaks in front of her. Shocked by this, Kang-woo offers Na-eun a live-in tutor position with a generous monthly salary. As they begin living together—not quite as a couple, but not quite apart—while caring for the children, their relationship slowly deepens.

title: How Did I, the Main Character of a Gal Game, Find Myself in a Yuri Manhua?
