description: MC has lived narcissistically within a gal game, but the game suddenly embraces a yuri and yaoi theme, and he now lives as a frustrated loser.

title: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord
alt_titles: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord
The Demon King Overrun by Heroes
I’m the Demon King, but There Are Too Many Heroes
description: Berje Deias was once a by-the-book Demon King, but after being reborn, he is determined to break every rule there is. His second attempt at life, however, takes a chaotic turn when a kidnapping of a princess doesn’t quite go to plan! Can he defeat an entire continent of heroes with his wild, untested methods?

title: [Traditional Erotic Fairy Tales] The Goblin's Hat
description: Muwon marche dans les pas de son défunt père en devenant à son tour un voleur qui se bat pour la justice. Un jour où il est poursuivi par un seigneur suprême du palais et ses gardes, il rencontre un homme suspect qui connaît sa véritable identité. Il est à deux doigts de se faire prendre quand cet homme étrange prête à Muwon un chapeau noir qui, lorsqu'il le porte, lui permet de disparaître aux yeux des autres. Mais ce mystérieux cadeau a un prix...

title: Seeing Double
description: Ohn can’t stand men, and he’s determined to stay away from them at all costs. Little does he know that the shy, soft-spoken Seo-woo is crushing on him hard. So hard, in fact, that he’s recruited his more confident twin brother, Jae-woo, to act as his double and approach Ohn. But as Jae-woo starts putting a little too much of his own heart into the act, the line between who’s courting Ohn gets blurred. Will the brothers break through Ohn’s hatred of men? And if so, which twin will be the one to win Ohn’s heart?

title: 0 and 1
description: I possesed the target character in a female-oriented dating simulation game. As the second prince, who seduces the female protagonist to eliminate his feelings of inferiority towards the first prince, Edward. I don't want to be killed by Edward. I don't want to interfere with other people's relationships, and I don't want to be hated. "He's the one you like." "I don't have feelings." "Okay. You better not like him. Because I won't have anything to do with him."

title: Imitation
description:
Maha is a member of the girl group, Tea Party. She became famous by imitating other popular stars and for this very reason, Ryoc, a member of the boy band, Sharks, holds a strong hatred towards her. However, as they continue to cross paths, his feelings towards Maha begin to change and their relationship develops into an unexpectedly sweet romance that they must now hide from everyone around them.  

---
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)
Alt. Official English: [Yen Press (book ver.)](https://yenpress.com/series/imitation)

title: Be Strong! Lee Seo Young
description: School's strongest, Kim Woo Jun and his formidable rival Lee Seo Young who threatens (?) his position. Woo Jun is always vying with Seo Young for the uneasy top spot, but somehow, to Seo Young, it's just a cute game. As the competition becomes a part of their daily routine, new feelings start to sprout between them...

title: Got It?
description: Seungjeong inherited the abilities of his ancestors, who were famous shamans, but those abilities can only be used when they get pleasure from sexual contact with the right person. Seungjeong, who went to the casino because of a friend's trick, lost all of his fortune and was looking around to use his ancestor's abilities. Seungjeong, who found Gayoon, followed him and forcibly rubbed his body to get pleasure. After winning money at the casino, he was able to return to Seoul safely. Afterwards, he reunited with Gayoon at the club where he was playing with his friend, and after being struck in the head and passed out, he woke up and found himself buried in the ground.

title: Why You Shouldn't Enter a Haunted House
description: Hyeon may seem like a normal high schooler, but he can see and interact with spirits. While he tries to live a quiet life, everything changes when he meets Jeseung, a classmate obsessed with live-streaming in haunted houses. Soon, Hyeon finds himself visiting eerie places and uncovering a sinister mystery--someone is manipulating spirits, promising to bring them back to life. As he confronts dangerous forces, Hyeon must navigate a dark world he never expected to be part of. Will he uncover the truth before it’s too late?

title: The Demon-Slaying Madman—reborn as a demon.
alt_titles: A Mountain of Corpses, A Sea of Blood
description: In a final battle that claimed them both, the mightiest of heroes, “Gelong”, perished alongside the Demon Lord. Five years later, he is reborn—only to awaken in the heart of his enemies’ domain, his soul now inhabiting the frail body of a lowly demon. But an unforeseen power stirs within this feeble vessel, ignited by his very soul: the ancient evolutionary might of the Serpent God. Gelong, a man once renowned for a ferocity that surpassed the demons themselves—what seas of blood will he now ignite with a truly demonic body?

title: You're the Only One I Can See
alt_titles: You're the Only One I Can See
I'm Telling You, I Only See You
description: Following the advice of his imaginary friend Jason, who told him, "Treat all girls like stones," Park Jin-yong starts seeing every girl as a stone. But then Sunwoo, a female student who doesn’t look like a stone, appears before him, and for the first time in five years, the sight of a girl’s face sends Jin-yong’s happy little circuits into overdrive...

title: Hidden Powerhouse Peace-loving Maid
description:
Andert the Hero. A great swordsman who ended the great war by sacrificing himself. One of the greatest heroes of all time.

…But in truth, I was a woman disguised as a man, living under the identity of my dead younger brother. That was me.

And then—

“Huh?”

I came back to life… four years after dying?

With nothing but this body left, there was only one way to survive.

A maid.

“Which kind of household would you like to work in?” “A place so harsh and awful that even if one of two workers dies, no one would notice.” “And what kind of employer are you looking for?” “A vicious employer who squeezes their workers dry.”

That way, I’ll be the only one willing to work there—and they won’t be able to fire me.

“……”

The interviewer looked at me like I was completely insane.

Still, it doesn’t matter.

Here, I’ll start over.

Not as the hero Andert. Not as my dead younger brother.

But as a maid— Daisy.

title: Journey of Iron and Ice
description:
They embark on a pilgrimage to Antarctica to discover their true identities. 

"Who are we, and where are we going?"

title: I Just Want to Be a Normal Idol
description:
Maknae of the girl idol group "Europa", Shine, gained a burst of popularity after a double nosebleed on a live stage.

For a moment, she was excited about her future success, but she quickly learns that her body has changed since that day.

Along with Chan Seon, member of boy group "Awaken", they dig into the suspicious things happening around them and find themselves involved in dangerous situations.

But they're in too deep. Why they be able to maintain their idol status until the end in a bloody and chaotic daily life...?

title: Rin of the Demon
description: An Earth-like planet one-fourth the size of Earth hit the Earth, triggering a worldwide disaster that caused the Earth's population to be reduced by more than half. This Earth-like planet also brought another far more powerful race than humans "the demon race". Human civilization was forced to the brink of extinction, and in the end, humans barely managed to keep the last five forest settlements, and the demon race became the new master of the Earth.

title: A Fleeting Spring Dream
description:
In a lonely world where nothing is left except the frigid cold, a man named "Chang Jo" survives bravely due to his naturally healthy body. 

In an empty town where everybody has died, Chang Jo works as the groundskeeper. And through the knowledge he gained while reading books, he completes various tasks.

One day, he discovers "Yeonhwa" collapsed outside in the snow and carries him to his house... 

"After I suck your penis, then we combine our bodies." 

Chang Jo tries his best to save Yeonhwa with the knowledge he gained from the book.

title: Continued Love
description: In the year A.D. 4443, on Planet Hera, Cheng Jin has finally decided to let go, after being treated coldly in his love life and later experiencing bankruptcy. However, with a turn of fate, his beloved suddenly loses memory and falls in love with him. He is overwhelmed with just as much joy as agony, as he waits with great anxiety for the arrival of this love.

title: Intense
description: Crime lord Yoonshik takes a little boy named Jiwoon as collateral when the child's father hangs himself from debt. Eight years later, the boy is working as Yoonshik's bodyguard. When the boss gets locked behind bars, Jiwoon is sent to work for another middle boss in the city's red-light district. There, Jiwoon meets a mysterious mute, Soohan, and everything just might change for him.

title: A Fruitless Harvest
description: On the surface, Chen Qingyan and Chen Ke appear to share a close and harmonious relationship, but in private, they both conceal their true identities and unexpectedly cross paths. A dangerous deal triggers a relapse of Chen Qingyan’s old illness, and their fates become increasingly intertwined.

title: Ark Angels
description: From a small lake nestled in a secluded forest far from the edge of town something strange emerged one day: Three young girls. The three girls, Shem, Hamu and Japheth, are sisters from another world. Equipped with magical powers, they are charged with saving all the creatures of Earth from becoming extinct. However, there is someone or something sinister trying to stop them. While saving our world from destruction, these sisters live like normal human girls: They go to school, work at a flower shop, hang around with friends and even fall in love…

title: Weightlifting Fairy Kim Bok-Joo
description: Bok Joo is a weightlifter who is pursuing her dream of winning the gold medal but she then finds romance for the first time in her life. While she is a woman who trains with heavy steel weights, she is also very feminine when it comes to relationships. Focusing solely on weightlifting would jeopardize her relationship but leaving her weightlifting career for love would keep her from attaining her dreams. Can she find a way to have love as well as glory at the age of 20? The characters within this drama are elite athletes in weightlifting, swimming, and rhythmic gymnastics who work hard to reach their goals in life. It covers their coming-of-age stories and relationships through hectic life.

title: Lord of all beings
description: After falling into the sea and going missing, Woo Young-jang returns to civilization after spending 7 years on a deserted island! His body has become firm and muscular, he can now communicate with all sorts of animals and even employ their special abilities. However, incidents and accidents seem to follow him wherever he goes. Will Young-jang be able to survive in the city, which is said to be even more terrifying than the jungle?

title: Obsessed Butler
description:
Джи Тэ Кван, хладнокровный, жесткий и высокомерный одиночка.
Вдруг в один прекрасный день в его скудную жизнь врывается кое-кто маленький и пушистый...
И в конечном счёте, он становится одержимым дворецким кота!?
Это тот ли Джи Тэ Кван, которого мы все знаем?
Это будет история Квангонга одержимого котом.

title: Fresh Teacher After 90s
description: When the second generation was intention to modify his stigmatization. Which you could not imagine it what it is. Yu Shou Ren decide to become a "Ordinary" teacher in high school to face the group of "Rogue Students". While others mention his special identity and how he will deal with this thing?!

title: Containment Zone Management
description: Welcome to the Containment Zone, where every space is warped by anomalies and bound by deadly rules. From unholy hospitals to sinister arcades, the four-man team of Department 2 ventures in daily to study the spaces and bring back supplies. Things are always guaranteed to get bizarre, but the job has to be done... no matter how many deaths it causes.

title: A Quiet Relationship
description: The person I only ever watched from afar lost his wife. I'm crazy! I'm married, you know...

title: You're No Good
description:
Why does Alfred insist on living as an outcast?  
And why does Hollie try so hard to keep him company?  
Is there something going on between the two?

title: Only I Have an EX-Grade Summon
description:
After being in a coma for three years due to a traffic accident, I woke up to find that the world of a certain game had become reality.

In a world where systems and summons are the norm, people say that in order to climb the Tower of Trials, they must find God Ji-nu.

But... God Ji-nu?

That’s me.

title: The Villainess Is a Millionaire Fixer
alt_titles: The Villainess Is a Millionaire Solver
The Villainess Is a Millionaire Who Solves Everything
description:
I opened my eyes to find myself living as Aristina Bianca Rosen—the Empire’s most stunning woman and the cherished only daughter of its wealthiest Duke. At first, it felt like a perfect fantasy: beauty, status, and limitless luxury.

But that illusion didn’t last long.

I had become the Empire’s most notorious villainess… and to make things worse, I’d just barely survived an assassination attempt. I may still be alive, but whoever tried to kill me hasn’t given up - and they’re still out there, waiting for another chance. With Aristina’s terrible reputation, I’m surrounded by enemies on all sides. Anyone could be the culprit. Still, the biggest threats might be the three men who won’t stop getting involved in my life. The Crown Prince - kind and charming on the surface, yet hiding a chilling coldness beneath. The Second Prince, who never fails to pick a fight every time we meet. And the leader of the Holy Order - sharp-tongued, secretive, and far from saintly. I’m trying my best to avoid them all…

So why do they keep becoming so obsessed with me..?!

title: Elaine's Unique Situation
description:
Elaine lived an unassuming life as a maid. She thought she finally got her big break when the princess recognized her abilities and promoted her. But then Elaine fell in love with someone she shouldn't have liked. She tried to close her heart and hide her love away.

"Don't avoid my eyes."

Why would he care about me?

Contrary to his harsh words, he was surprisingly kind, which only made it more difficult. The life of a palace maid who has to endure the temptation of the handsome prince who smelled like forget-me-nots. Will she be able to live like this?

---
After giving up her dream to become a priestess, Elaine resignedly applies to work as a maid in the imperial palace and earn money for her family. While working, she runs into a mysterious man who treats her with unusual kindness. Moved by his gestures, Elaine begins to fall for him... until she finds out he's none other than the war hero, Prince Theo Veronica! But just when she tries to distance herself from the prince, he offers her a unique deal that will change her life forever.

title: Raffine’s Plan: Save My Favorite Character
alt_titles: I Will Seduce the Male Lead for My Older Brother
For Older Brother, I Will Seduce the Male Lead
I Will Try to Seduce the Male Lead for My Brother
description:
*I'll marry the male lead myself!*

Raffine is in a predicament, and there are three reasons why. One, she's been reincarnated into a super angsty, highly depressing novel. Two, her older brother is destined for death in said novel. And three, the only way to save him is by marrying the male lead. What the hell is going on?!

---
I possessed Raphine, the youngest sister of the second male lead, who had no dreams nor hopes, in an impoverished and obsession filled novel. That was also because he had a crush on the female lead, who married the male lead on a contract, and eventually died.

I can't believe it's such a miserable ending for my favorite character and kind eldest brother. No way!

Raphine decided to brainwash Prince Jerkan, the male lead of the novel, to prevent the female lead's contract marriage.

So that he can think of me when he needs a contract marriage!

"Jerkan! I want to marry you!"
"If you're grateful, you have to marry me next time."
"I need a simple marriage, so I'll get married through a contract."

And when the brainwashing finally succeeded, Raphine cheered inside.

"Okay. Definitely, I'll marry you."

I never imagined what kind of eyes he was had. Yeah, I really didn't know then. I didn't know this would happen.

"Didn't you pester me because you wanted to marry me?"
"Will you run away?"

title: Botanic Romance
description:
In a world where humans gain plant characteristics (botanomorphism), our cactus-infected protagonist, Zhu WuLiang, is faced with a dilemma. He'll lose hair whenever he gets shy! Now, enter Hao Xiaofeng, WuLiang's tumbleweed-infected crush, whose carefree lifestyle involves getting blown away by the wind on a daily basis… Surely, it's more than enough to wreck WuLiang's mundane life!   
  
Shy cactus x Happy-go-lucky tumbleweed!  
Our main couple's shenanigans are packed with tons of sweetness, sure to give you a severe case of toothache! Stay tuned!

title: Her Tiny Highness, the Mastermind
description: The martial arts world's most dangerous mastermind finds herself reborn in the weakest possible form: a tiny toddler and holy monarch’s successor, destined to die young. But Danye Jin didn't survive centuries of martial arts intrigue just to accept defeat in diapers. Armed with ancient techniques and disarming baby charm, this mysteriously capable little girl is turning imminent death into the realm's greatest adventure. Who knew saving yourself could be so adorably dangerous?

title: Psychic Studies
description:
“You are getting very sleepy…” Chankyu Kim learns hypnosis from watching YouTube videos so that he would become popular amongst the girls at his school. However, things don’t go according to plan as he finds himself encountering repeated failures. He later meets mind reader Euijoo Yeo, who has extraordinary abilities just like he does. Their interesting but unfortunate story kicks off from there…

---
Alternate Official Raw - [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6447101)

title: Transference
description: Su-a, a college freshman in Creative Writing, struggles to understand and express her emotions, leaving her isolated from those around her. When she meets Taeyang, a second-year Sports Coaching student who can sense emotions through touch, their unexpected connection sparks a journey of discovery. Paired for a class assignment that involves a "date," their bond deepens. This is a story about a man who feels too much and a woman who feels too little, and their journey toward emotional growth.

title: #Killstagram
description:
Remi Do has everything -- she's super pretty, has the best brand sponsorships on social media, and gets 10,000 likes within seconds of posting a selfie. Oh, and she also has a serial-killing stalker following her every move.
  
[Official Spanish Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/es/thriller/killstagram/list?title_no=2101)  
[Official French Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/fr/thriller/killstagram/list?title_no=2120)  
[Official Indonesian Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/id/horror/killstagram/list?title_no=1592)  
[Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/thriller/yingsitagram/list?title_no=1680)  
[Official Thai Translation](https://m.webtoons.com/th/thriller/killstagram/list?title_no=1611)  
[Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://m.dongmanmanhua.cn/SUSPENSE/yingsitagram/list?title_no=1476)

title: Noble in Name, Vulgar at Heart
alt_titles: Noble in Name, Vulgar at Heart
description: Ariana, born into a politically arranged marriage, was nothing more than a tool, used and abused by her family her entire life. On her 28th birthday, she was tragically killed, yearning for a love that never came. Perhaps out of pity, a mysterious force sent her back to when she was 16. Reflecting on her painful past, she makes a vow: "I shall beg for love no longer. I will never love nor be loved again."

title: I Only Need the Duke's Child
alt_titles: I Only Need the Duke's Child
description:
"If I could go back to the past, I wouldn't love him."

After her regression, her second marriage to her ex-husband was solely for the sake of the child. Unlike her previous life, where she craved love, she chose to marry him in this second life, which she obtained like a miracle, driven by the single-minded determination to reunite with her child.

"Please keep us married for just one year."

The price was that she would cooperate with him to uncover the secrets of the incident from ten years ago, just as he wanted. She thought they were a couple in name only, bound by a contract...

"It is not absolutely necessary to consummate the marriage on the first night—"

"I want to."

He was different from her previous life.

title: Marriage Strategy
description: Haru has a secret. She has the ability to go back to a fixed point in time every time she gets married. One moment, Haru is standing at the altar. But suddenly, she’s back on the subway on her way to work. But this secret of hers turns out to be not so secret after all. Oneul, who has the same ability, meets her and tells her that she and Oneul are both players in a dating simulation game. Will they be able to see the game to its end by getting married to their main storyline characters and escape from the time loop?

title: Becoming the Tyrant's Substitute Bride
description:
The Third Prince of the human race, determined to uncover the truth behind his eldest sister's disappearance, chooses to disguise himself as a woman and take his younger sister's place in a political marriage. The "husband" he must face is the bloodthirsty Beastman Crown Prince, Ming Sheng.
To buy time for his investigation, Lu Mi plays the role of a deeply infatuated princess, meticulously studying the Prince's preferences and professing his love in increasingly creative ways.
Meanwhile, Ming Sheng—discriminated against due to his "impure" bloodline—uses the mask of a tyrant for protection. Though he had intentionally terrified all previous suitors away, he unexpectedly encounters Lu Mi, who refuses to play by the rules. Having never been truly loved, Ming Sheng gradually loses his composure, revealing his weaknesses under Lu Mi's feigned yet burning "affection."

title: The Hero I Curse
description: 'When I was about to give up, my first love came back to me after 10 years.' Si-woon, who had left the neighborhood 10 years ago and whom I thought I would never see again, suddenly came to see Harim. And he had become the best hero in the country! Seeing Si-woon's appearance that seemed to have changed but didn't, Harim realized the feelings that she had thought had disappeared long ago, and she began to feel differently about her boring life. However, just a few days later, she learned a shocking truth...

title: FLUFFY LAND
description: FLUFFY LAND is an original project by GoodSmile China. This is a collection of the FLUFFY LAND manga chapters posted on the official FLUFFY LAND Twitter.

title: Interstellar Cloud
description: Uika Misumi x Sakiko Togawa

title: Melo Holic
description: Love story that incorporates various romantic tropes into the plot. without actually using them. Or does it?

title: Savior
description:
Wohn Ku is a vampire that needs human blood to survive.

As a tenderhearted child, she led a tortured existence until a girl named Seyeon willingly became her steady blood source. Seyeon stood by Wohn throughout their school years, defending her from bullies. 

Fast forward to the present where they move in together ahead of their freshman year of college. Seyeon remains fiercely protective of her friend, but Wohn is ready for a fresh start.

When a devoutly religious sophomore girl named Juyi showers her with kindness, Wohn emerges from her shell only to realize that Juyi had once been her father’s kidnapping victim, a potential blood source she had refused to bite. Juyi grows closer to Wohn without remembering the incident, fueling jealousy in Seyeon.

Will Juyi prove to be a savior washing away Wohn’s guilt, or will she ruin a vampire’s dream of redemption?

[MU]

title: On a Restless Night
description:
Born with the ability to see ghosts, Jong-eon inevitably grew into someone dark and gloomy. One day, while working on a group project in a gen-ed class, he discovers that Hyesung, a junior from another department, is miraculously able to drive ghosts away.
“No matter what it takes, I have to bring him into my life.”
Thrilled by the thought of a life without ghosts, Jong-eon begins stalking Hyesung. But it doesn’t take long before Hyesung catches on…
“Hyung, why do you keep following me?”
“…Because I really like you.”

title: The Two-Faced Witch And The Villainous Crown Prince
alt_titles: The Two-Faced Witch And The Villainous Crown Prince
description: Lillian is a sealed witch who is awakened by Lanfil, the daughter of a dying duke. In order to take revenge, Lillian made a pact with Lanfil and decided to enter the court as Lanfil and become a princess. Her goal is to find out the murderer of her, however, the prince she is about to marry turns out to be her old friend, which adds complex emotional entanglements and suspense.

title: Why has the world line collapsed again?
alt_titles: Why has the world line collapsed again?
description:
【2023 Webtoon Competition Entry】
No synopsis. Follow the protagonists and explore this world little by little!
Gentle sword cultivator younger brother x Sunshine-oriented older brother
The art style will differ between the early and later stages, because I'm trying my best to draw better.
To avoid an abrupt cancellation ending, I will not sign with any platform.
The workload for a solo creator is heavy, so please understand that updates will be relatively slow.
Finally, thank you again to every friend who appreciates my work! I hope you can leave more comments and interact!

title: ShaMONEYism
description:
Where does one find the top shamans and the most reliable fortune tellers in the country?

Welcome to the stock exchange, where one prediction could make or break billions. This is their all-star match, world series, medal of arts, and olympics all rolled into one. 

Follow the story of Jiseung Cheon, as he breaks into the world of occult and finance, one shamanic ritual at a time.

title: The Maid Holds the Leash of the Tyrant
alt_titles: The Maid Holds the Tyrant's Leash
The Maid With a Dictator on a Leash
The Tyrant's Leash Is Held by a Maid
description: “Your Highness, then would you like to make a bet with me? You might forget my maid's name in a month or not.” “It’s fortunate. She is a maid who is difficult to make eye contact with, but her name is easy to remember.” Lianna Theodore was a maid who knew her subject. The lady I serve is enough to understand the bet she made with the prince she has a crush on. She's a maid and has a crush on the prince, but she's not worthy. She tried to put a short crush on her so she did. “His Highness Prince Illid has awakened as Manish. According to the order of the priest, she has come to take care of Lady Riana, the only being who can calm him down, Aradna.” If he is not confident, he will die.

title: Daily France
description:
I share my personal experiences after living in France for several years. And this is not a success story if you think of it as one. It's a story of how I failed. Or is it??

---
- [Original Book <Yes24>](http://www.yes24.com/Product/Goods/71839167)

- [Original Book <Aladin>](https://www.aladin.co.kr/shop/wproduct.aspx?ItemId=187920961)

title: Rotten Pink Law
description: 'Bae Geumjoo', a freshman with a good head but a screw loose, decides to join a school club after seeing 'Jang Haneul'. But as she gets to know Haneul, shadows of the past begin to mess with Geumjoo's emotional development...  Ownership vs pure love, absolute certainty vs thrill from the unknown, what does Geumjoo truly desire?  'Hip Hop Fresh' presents a sweet and spicy taste. (Not to the point of a stomachache!) (wisteria villosa)

title: Phantasm: Three Nations
description:
In a war-torn Central Plains, peasant-born Xin joins the army with pure hope. His tough-but-kind captain dies in battle, and victory brings only a hollow revolution.
As the second uprising begins, Xin becomes the new leader. He learns true responsibility, only to face crushing defeat. Seeing his rebel comrades lost and without a future, Xin vows to fight for a better world.

title: Reborn As a Character That Never Existed
alt_titles: I Was Born as a Character that Wasn’t in the Original Story
description: After meeting her death, Thalia is reborn as the female protagonist’s older sister, a character that never existed in the novel she wrote in her past life. She tries hard to get attached to the world inside the novel, but she gets caught up in the thought that everything is just a mere creation of her own. “Please make Tilly love me.” Aegis, who was supposed to fall in love with Thalia's younger sister, makes a wish to God on his coming-of-age birthday. Will Thalia be able to love Aegis?

title: Osaka Loop Line
description:
Kim Yong, a Zainichi Korean boy from Osaka, accidentally gets caught up in a fight with the nephew of a yakuza. 

Kim Yong is given the mission of infiltrating a Korean village and stealing an ID card by order of the yakuza. The villagers, who seemed ordinary, seem to be up to something... 

At first, he only thought of completing the mission and receiving money, but Kim Yong gradually becomes one with the villagers and joins the village's goal of establishing a homeland in Osaka.

title: Privacy Check
description: Society is corrupt, but no society is as corrupt as Hanbit High School. Chaseong, a student at the bottom of the school’s social hierarchy, struggles to survive… until he unexpectedly gains a mysterious ally who claims that together, they can uproot it all. But how? No one knows, but one thing is certain, Chaseong’s secret WeTube channel is about to go viral.

title: Fantasy Sketch - The Game
description: This video game would take you to the bottom of the world.

title: Scorching Romance
description:
If you don't want to die, date!  
A romance story of a girl named Hwa-Ja full of heat trying to live her life.

title: My Little Sister is the Demon Lord!
alt_titles: My Little Sister is the Demon Lord!
description:
After their parents' sudden passing, Gyeonwoo finds himself in the role of caregiver to his younger sister, who harbors a startling secret — she's the Demon Lord with plans for world domination! 

Undeterred, Gyeonwoo is committed to nurturing his sister with love and guidance. Join them in this unique tale as they navigate everyday life amid their extraordinary circumstances.

title: No Scope
description: PSI BOND: it’s the hottest online game in the world. Self-confident high schooler Suho Kang is a Grand Master, a title only the top 1% of players can achieve. He decides to take clueless Doyoon Lee, a loner who may or may not be a gaming genius, under his wing. Join them on the battlefield of PSI BOND, where high-speed connections and high school will never be the same again.

title: Teenage Dragon
description: “Hi! My name is Minji Kim. I used to be a teenage girl but after waking up from a nap one day, I turned into a fugly lizard! I want to go home! Somebody help! Wait… but, if I'm in this strange body, who’s in mine?!” Minji is a high school girl living a normal life in an ordinary world. After waking up from her usual nap in class one day, she discovers that she has transformed into a powerful dragon who lives in an out-of-the-ordinary land. Minji forms a group of eccentric friends by using her wits, and together they embark on a journey to help Minji find her way back to her own world. Will Minji ever be able to return home?

title: The Strange Lord Demon
description: On the "last day of life", Xuan met the devil's lawyer and made her a proposal that no one would refuse... In the one-year contract marriage, the tragic comedy of love between a girl and a man full of mysteries .

title: No Office Romance!
description: Are first loves overrated, or can a reunion as adults bring back emotions of the past? Yunji and Saebom share a first love story left unfinished, abruptly interrupted by ten years of being apart. Now, as adults, both seem to have moved on from that unfinished chapter of their lives and agree to remain friends and coworkers. However, the surface is not everything there is to be seen, as an unspoken tension lingers between them. Will they merely stay friends, or does destiny have other plans for them?

title: Fake Humans
description: Having escaped her abusive mother, twenty-year-old Ji-a lives a modest life with her little sister, Su-a. When Su-a does not return from her field trip under sinister circumstances, Ji-a vows to do anything she can to get her sister back. As she and her high school friend Wonseung delve further into the mystery, they find that there might be a larger conspiracy under the surface -- a tangled web that includes a cult, a mystery, and powerful figures that might shake South Korea to its core.

title: Falling for It
description: Sujeong writes romance novels but has never lived one. A proud homebody and a self-proclaimed loner, she's content on her own—until the sly and irresistible Seunghyeon crashes into her life and turns it upside down. His charm feels dangerous, yet impossible to resist. Now Sujeong must find out: is he the love that she's been waiting for... or the heartbreak she never saw coming?

title: Forged in Flames: The Piece Maker
alt_titles: Forged in Flames: The Piece Maker
description: It’s red, hot, and burning with flames! Sage is a young boy from a small village who dreams of becoming a renowned Piece Maker like Edmond Dantes. But when his antics to help others with crafting skills get him in trouble with the local mercenary gang, a trio of rowdy blacksmiths who call themselves the Red Pepper Guild show up and come to his aid. He joins the Red Pepper Guild in their quest to solve the mystery of strange dungeons and mana stones, but can he survive the battles and the blazing dishes his eccentric guild master cooks up?

title: Seeking Your Forgiveness
description: "I want a divorce." The arrogant Christoph believed Marianne would eventually return. That she'd left home on a whim. After all, the facts had always said he was right. Well, he couldn't have been more wrong. Filled with regret, he tries to bring Marianne back, but she refuses to change her mind. Can Christoph earn Marianne's forgiveness and win her heart again?

title: The Scent That Binds Us
description: Idel Fleure was born without a scent in a noble family where fragrance defines one’s lineage, causing her to be ostracized. She escapes a forced marriage by being accepted into Euphiter Imperial University, but finds herself bound in another marriage– one to Archduke Chaeron, who is drawn to her scent that only he can smell. Chaeron proposes a contractual marriage, and agrees to take her as his wife for three years and then divorce her. Will this seemingly contractual partnership conclude as smoothly as planned, or will the Archduke’s fascination with Idel’s scent lead to a different ending?

title: Divine Delivery
description: Enter the world of Hajun Lee, just your average delivery guy trying to make ends meet. But when he's summoned to Olympus for a special delivery, his life takes an unexpected turn. Suddenly, he's the personal delivery man for the gods, earning big bucks and upgrading his gear with each risky delivery. Follow his daring escapades through dungeons and battles with monsters as he learns to outsmart them all. From one divine job to the next, Hajun faces it all with wit and guts. But can he keep up the hustle of being a regular delivery guy while also serving the mighty gods?

title: What a Boss Wants
description:
No taste in life! Kwon Do-hyeok, a chaebol man with appearance, wealth, ability and fatal charm meets Lee Eun-chae, a free singer-songwriter who completely disarms him. His father's new interest in his complicated private life... is this woman? Do-hyeok's blatant plot to uncover Eun-chae's identity begins!

---
[Official French Translation](https://www.webtoons.com/fr/romance/what-a-boss-wants/list?title_no=4242)

title: Press Play, Sami
description: After her parents died, Sami gave up her life of fortune to live independently, doing odd jobs to make ends meet. When she starts to get involved with two of the most popular boys at her high school, Sami faces twists and turns -- Chan is her neighbor, and Pyojun makes her have conflicted feelings. Things get more complicated when she finds out that Chan has feelings for Pyojun as well! With her mom’s only keepsake in hand to keep her feet on the ground, Sami navigates obstacles that she wasn’t prepared for -- and aren’t even in her budget!

title: Just One Bite!
description: Returning student Do Sang-gu. Ko Young-hee, the center of the top idol <Sugar Red>, appeared in front of him, who suffered from health anxiety and trauma from an accident as a child. Because of the delicious scent, she felt for the first time in her life, she chases after Sang-gu, a poor returning student...?

title: Chasing Tails
description: After nine college students are trapped under a collapsed building for 14 days, only six come out alive, and only four of them can speak. The dead bodies of their fellow students are viciously mangled, leading police to investigate the case as a possible homicide. Detective Lieutenants Jeongdo Kwon and Yeongchae Shin, together with renowned neuropsychiatrist Dr. Yeongwha Ju, must parse through witness testimony and inconclusive physical evidence to uncover the truth. But how do you solve a locked-room murder case when every witness is a suspect?

title: DEEP
description: Families that went missing decades ago...started to resurface.

title: Who’s That Long-Haired Senior?
description:
Sol Song has a uniquely quirky taste in men: they absolutely must have long hair. Otherwise, she sees them as literal "stone heads," devoid of facial features. 

So, when her first love — and the only long-haired guy on campus — shows up with a buzz cut, she's devastated. 

But as they start to reconnect and emotions deepen, Sol must discover whether she likes Okseok for who he truly is or just for his hair.

title: Too Late for Regrets
description: The tale of Princess Ines is a tragic one. Born a royal of the Zener Empire, she is reviled and neglected as a child born out of wedlock. To compound her misfortune, Ines is married off to Grand Duke Ryan of Eleanor, a renowned war hero of the Lezan Empire who fought against Zener. Ryan proves a stern and distant husband to Ines, and she soon determines that she must fight for a life of dignity – if not in Eleanor, then elsewhere. Thus begins a marriage of emotional reserve and regrets…

title: Banhyang: The Remote Island
description: Sehim’s field trip to Banhyang Island takes an ominous turn when a fierce storm leaves everyone stranded. As three students inexplicably vanish amidst the storm, Sehim and his friends scramble to find out why. But, their desperate efforts only seem to drag them deeper into the island’s sinister secrets— every revelation intensifying the chilling forces lurking on the island, their chances of leaving the island seem uncertain by the day.

title: The Knight Becomes a Black Flower
alt_titles: The Knight Becomes a Black Flower
description:
A sword was pointed at Diana’s neck. It was a rather pathetic end for a female knight who once swept through the battlefield.

“I’ll never wield a sword again…”

Diana exhaled her last breath. With a chilling sound, the blade fell downward. She thought everything had ended that way. But… everything was reversed.

At the age of 10, before she had ever held a sword, Diana made a decision.

---
Diana Lesley, a renowned knight of the Agripana Kingdom, is killed by her rival Cornelius Heimann in the war against the Heverunia Empire. However, when she wakes up, she finds herself at 10 years old and decides to pursue the life of a proper lady instead of a knight—much to her family's disapproval. After becoming Princess Juliana's lady-in-waiting, she must contend with conniving noblewomen, the threat of oncoming war, and the affections of Cornelius who, in this life, dreams about her past life and falls for her. Can she keep her loved ones safe and live in peace?

title: Unstoppable Hayeong
description: Yeonji, a high school girl who tries to help her classmate from abuse, ends up making herself the target of a bully. Her struggles only seem to get worse until the new girl Hayeong steps in for support, declaring war on the bullies. But the more Hayeong fights against mistreatment, the more hostility she attracts, and she must fight her way to keep the ones she cares for safe.

title: The Worst Villainess
description: Possessing a character in a fictional story is one thing, but possessing a character in your own story is another… especially when you’ve become a dramatic villainess in a typical K-drama series. The only way Miso can escape from this world is to live through all of the episodes, but she has to deal with cliché tropes such as an arranged marriage with the male lead and an unnecessary rivalry with the female lead. Will Miso be able to break away from this predetermined destiny and find another happy ending for all of her characters?

title: Human Faced Flower
description: Third year master's student, Wang Juo Chun, by chance picked up a flower with a face. The flower not only can talk but the voice is exactly the same as his ex-girlfriend! One day, the flower began to persuade him to kill…

title: Do Not Hold on to the Broken Branch
alt_titles: Do Not Hold on to the Broken Branch
description:
After two failed engagements and the downfall of her family, Deatrice, the Duke's daughter and once the most celebrated socialite in high society, finds herself in a reluctant reunification with Lucius. Lucius is her former fiance and currently the Emperor's favorite knight whose life had been ruined by her own father six years ago. 

Is this forced marriage the beginning of Lucius' vengeance? Could fate turn it into a second chance for them to get over the shadows of their painful past and find true love?

title: So, Who Got Screwed?
description:
Kang Hyo-in has been secretly in love with his best friend of eight years, Jin Ye-geon. So smitten that he’s practically lost a screw, Hyo-in comes up with a meticulous plan to finally become Ye-geon’s boyfriend. But all his careful effort is rendered pointless when, after a one-night stand he barely even remembers, their “relationship” suddenly begins—more like Ye-geon squeezing it out of him than anything else(?)!

Wait a sec… so between the two of us, who was on the bottom last night? ... Don’t tell me—it was me?!

title: The Scent Of Desire
description: Comic description: [Innocent spy girl x beautiful devil gangster] The devil leader who lives on human desires accidentally tied his fate with the spy girl "Pearl", and the cold devil had his only weakness. In this sweet and dangerous love chase, the two opened up the most painful forbidden areas in each other's hearts and learned about each other's unknown past. At this time, a deeper conspiracy and danger are approaching them...

title: Dragon Ball GT
description:
Unofficial Dragon Ball GT adaptation by the chinese “Xinjiang Youth Publishing House”.  
  
Age 789: Five years have passed since the 28th Tenkaichi Budokai, and all is peaceful around the world as Goku and Oob finish their training in Kami-sama’s palace. However, this peace soon ends as Pilaf makes a terrifying wish, transforming Goku into a child. The rush is on to retrieve all seven Ultimate Dragon Balls from around the Universe before the Earth and its inhabitants are destroyed…

title: Don't Press the Plum
description:
Hong Ijeong, who naturally likes people and is highly sociable, one day hears rumors about Ki Taerim, the biggest outcast in their department. With his thick glasses, messy hair, and loosely worn checkered shirt, Taerim looks exactly like a stereotypical loner. But Ijeong notices that everything he’s wearing is actually luxury brand items. Just as he decides to avoid getting involved with him at all costs, he runs into Taerim at the semester opening gathering… and somehow finds himself constantly drawn to him, taking care of him in subtle ways.

Feeling uncomfortable with Ijeong’s kindness, Taerim decides to tease him after Ijeong notices a hickey on him, deliberately trying to seduce him. And Ijeong, falling for Taerim’s inexplicable charm, ends up spending the night with him…!

title: Do You Believe in Fate?!
description: As fate would have it, men appeared in front of Jinah who didn't believe in fate! Who will be her fate?

title: I Helped the Imprisoned Male Lead and He Became an Obsessive Man
description:
I possessed an errand child who brought meals to the male protagonist who was captured as a test subject at the lab. If the experiment was successful and the male protagonist gained power, the lab would be engulfed in flames. So I tried to run away before that, but I felt bad for the male protagonist who was suffering from the cruel experiment. So I secretly took care of various things while avoiding the researchers' eyes.

"Come to think of it, what's your name?"

"I don't have a name..."

"You make me one."

"Huh?"

I somehow became a little close to the male protagonist.

"Are you going to abandon me? Don't do that."

"Ah... but-"

"Anis, do you mind if I'm wrong?"

"Ugh... No. No, I don't."

"Then stay by my side."

However, the only one who can cure him who is suffering from the side effects of the experiment is the original female protagonist.

I tried to help him and leave secretly so that he could find his partner...

"You promised not to abandon me. But, was it all a lie?”

With the burning laboratory in the background, Emilien smiled with cold eyes.

“A good child should keep his promises.”

The temperature of the hand touching my cheek is cold. The red eyes close as if they are going to engulf me.

“Answer, aren’t you going to tell me?”

...What should I do?

I think I missed my chance to run away.

title: The Hero's Ready to Retire
alt_titles: I'm Done Being a Hero, Even If It's Retirement
description: Everyone's shocked when 9-year-old prodigy Adelia Ester suddenly refuses to enroll in the elite knights' academy. They don't know that Adelia was magically sent back in time after wasting her life on the battlefield and suffering an early death! Now, Adelia's out to protect her peace from her ex-boss, the evil future emperor, by setting her ally on the throne instead. Will Adelia succeed in one last mission and finally retire for good? Or will she find herself forced to be a hero once more?

title: FALSA ILUSIÓN
description: Dos personas que se desprecian mutuamente pero creen que son extremadamente atractivas, al mismo tiempo piensan que la otra se ha enamorado de ellas, y en una serie de malentendidos, se ven profundamente atrapadas, incapaces de separarse.

title: The Student, The Witch, and The Academy
alt_titles: The Student, The Witch, and The Academy
description:
For Nam Juho, life as a repeat student aiming for med school is supposed to be simple: study, eat convenience store kimbap, and sleep, preferably in that order.

But peace is impossible when Yeo Jiwoo, his eccentric classmate from the same cram school, suddenly decides he’s her new favorite target.

From stolen pens and playful pranks to unsolicited “study motivation,” Jiwoo seems determined to turn Juho’s quiet, disciplined life into a daily comedy of chaos. He swears she’s doing it just to annoy him… but why does his heart race every time she flashes that mischievous smile?

Between mock exams, caffeine highs, and emotional confusion, Juho finds himself stuck in the most distracting kind of competition—a love-hate study war that’s way harder than any entrance test.

Who knew the toughest subject in cram school would be romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: How About a Cosmic Horror?
description: Irae wakes up in the hospital, married but with no memory of the wedding or her husband. To everyone else, he’s the perfect man, but to her, he’s a tentacled cosmic horror! Bewildered by the gap between memory and reality, she wonders... Is this really just an aftereffect of her accident? (Source: Manta)

title: Can I Cry Now?
description:
After killing his brother, Clois ascends to the throne. His desire to become emperor was not for personal gain but for the sake of his beloved wife and soon-to-be-born child. However, upon his return, the corpses of his wife and child greeted him, demonstrating the futility of his efforts.

Seven years later, he couldn’t find joy in anything in the world. So, he didn’t care about the re-opening of the gifted academy’s admissions after seven years. Until he saw a wrinkled application form rolling on the floor. Instead of trying to enroll the child in the gifted academy, he offered various excuses. The document, thrown away like trash without even being considered due to being from a workhouse.

“I approve this child’s admission.”

He wasn’t particularly interested. It was just a warning to those who tried to act arbitrarily. So he couldn’t even remember the name of the child he picked.

“My name is Ivy Alden.”

The child he met in front of his wife’s and daughter’s graves resembled the daughter he had always imagined.

title: Devil & Ice
alt_titles: The Devil and the Ice Witch
description:
The strongest from another world are reborn—so much for a normal life.

The Heavenly Demon, who was on the brink of conquering the world.

After dying together in a final showdown with his archenemy, the Ice Witch, the two are reborn as ordinary twins in the human world. But their peace is short-lived. Now that they are teenagers, organizations of Reincarnators are shaking up the world. The world refuses to leave these siblings alone, even as they try to hide the powers of their past lives. Old subordinates begin to gather, one by one. And the Ice Witch stands by his side—not as an enemy this time, but as a partner.

Will the Heavenly Demon be able to become the world’s strongest once again?!

title: Return of the Immortal Monk
description:
"He eats poison instead of food three times a day… and still won’t die?"

An immortal monk who couldn’t die no matter how hard he tried — finally meets his end... or so he thought.

Reborn as a third-rate bodyguard in a brothel in Shandong, he finds that his powerful martial arts still lie dormant within him.

Amidst chaos in the martial world, political strife for the throne, and enemies from his past life returning — Cheongpung must fight once again to reclaim his power.

Will he be able to reclaim his martial arts from his immortal monk days — and finally reach Nirvana?

The legend of the immortal monk begins anew!

title: Crimson Reset
alt_titles: How to Live as the Vampire Lord
description:
After half a year on the run, the vampire Eugene was ultimately killed, offered up as a sacrifice to boost a holy knight’s fame.

Just as his life ended in bitter regret, a chance to return came to him.

“I will never die like that again. If I’ve truly returned to the past, then I’ll never regret anything a second time… no matter what it may take.”

title: The Berserker's Second Playthrough
alt_titles: The Berserker's Second Playthrough in the Game
description:
After possessing the body of a berserker in a game, overcoming countless hardships, finally killing the great demon, and at last reaching the ending, the text the man was confronted with was this:

[ New Game + ]

“No… Fuck….”

title: Underworld Invasion
description:
A massive war erupts between angels and aliens, with the very fabric of the afterlife at stake. Kim Ria, the last surviving human on Earth who has no lingering attachment to life, and Azazel, an angel who despises the god exiled from the afterlife, become the pivots upon which the fate of both humanity and the afterlife turns.

In the afterlife, angels and aliens clash into an all‑out war. At the same time, on Earth, Azazel and Kim Ria undertake a tense survival adventure as they evade pursuit squads hunting the final human.

title: How to Survive as a Wandering Knight
alt_titles: The Way of the Wandering Knight
description:
After dying due to an unexpected accident, Kim Yohan reincarnated as Johann Aitz of the prestigious Aitz Family.

He may have been born a noble, but Johann Aitz ranks at the very bottom of the family hierarchy. To make matters worse, this world revolves around a ruthless medieval society.

“The only person you can trust is yourself.”

In a world ruled by the law of the strong, survival requires only two things: money and power.

While training relentlessly using the knowledge he gained in his modern life, Johann ends up encountering Kaegal, the Master of Poison of the Empire’s greatest assassination guild, the Nesos Guild.

This is the fierce struggle of Johann, who refuses to become just another prey of this brutal era.

title: The Abandoned Wife's Rebirth
description: Wu Ruo couldn't see the true colors of the people around him until the day he died. The family of the friends who he treasured had been using him, and the husband who he neglected was the one who rescued him in the last moments. God's mercy allowed him to be reborn, reborn into his most useless, most hateful, and fattest times. At this period of his life, not only was he a waste unable to cultivate, but as a man, had to relive being married off to another man. But he found that this man... was actually pretty good to him. This time, he will have revenge on those who wronged him, and pay off his debts to those who were kind to him.

title: Juhee's Surroundings
description:
Minni can see ghosts. And Juhee was once her closest childhood friend.
Whenever Minni was with Juhee, she couldn’t see ghosts, so she was able to grow up like a normal person. But due to an unexplained accident, Juhee died at a young age.
At least, that’s what Minni believed… until she reunites with her in high school, alive and well.
But the Juhee she once knew is nowhere to be found, and something about her feels off.

title: La Mosca
description: Kashoo, the incredibly popular confectionery and coffee company, produces the most addictive products. However, there is a mystery behind how the company obtains its raw materials. What lurks on the island from which they obtain their caffeine-laden goods? Just what type of contract are people hired to work on this island signing to?

title: Save the World in 80 Days
description:
Kuini and Yilou must travel to Tyzzer, an unknown village, to prevent a nameless threat, or the world will end in 80 days. Along the way, they team up with the apprentice artist Lang, who is also traveling to Tyzzer to find the mythical dragons. The way to Tyzzer is filled with danger, mystery, mischief, and… fatal hilarity.  
  
Will they ever get to their destination?  
  
Please read left to right!

title: Do Whatever You Want
description: When an angel is challenged to seduce a demon, the demon is quickly routed by someone more powerful than him... Meet Metatron and Mammon, and discover their hellish story...

title: I Don't Want to Ascend
alt_titles: The Little Junior Sister Doesn't Want to Ascend
description:
Sealed inside a secret realm for three hundred years, the notorious archvillain has finally been released by a massive fool. Jin Xun bursts into a wild laughter. He prepares to make his triumphant return and settle an old grudge— huh? What happened to his maxed-out cultivation level? What happened to all of his divine-grade artifacts? Why is no one obeying his commands anymore?! 

As long as Su Yuan stays by Jin Xu's side, her constantly depleting cultivation returns to normal. In order to survive, Su Yuan decides to tightly cling onto Jin Xun by offering him every treasure in the world— as long as he stays by her side, of course. However, just being near her makes Jin Xun lose all of his powers and causes him to become as weak as an ordinary person. In order to seek his revenge, he has to leave her... Until Su Yuan tightly binds him with her Immortal-binding rope.

Su Yuan: Quit struggling. In this lifetime, you and I are never going to be apart!
Jin Xun: I'll never give up my quest for revenge just for the sake of love!   
(A few days later…)  
Jin Xun: Fine, I accept you.
Su Yuan: ？？？？？？

title: The Sinister Pervert Next Door
alt_titles: The Gloomy, Sexy Guy Next Door

title: One Too Many Supporting Male Leads
alt_titles: There are too many sub-male leads!
There Are Too Many Second Male Leads!
description:
The life of Jeong Eunjae, a terminally-ill patient, has ended. She didn't have any regrets about her life, however...

[Allotted time: One year! Fine the 'real male lead’ within the allotted time!]
“” Ho-Hold on! Hold on a minute! What is this?! What on earth is this?!

I thought I died, but when I opened my eyes, I found myself in a strange world. What was even more shocking was that I have a healthy body now.

[If you can’t find ‘the real male lead’, you will die a year from now! It will be fun, right?]

As I saw this message, I looked at the green text above their head.

[Affection level: 0%]

[The affection level of the men you haven't met before, will start at 0%. Of course, there is an exception!]

[If you cannot raise the affection levels, prepare to be bombarded with missions!]

Whoa, it's really happening.

"" He...llo?

For now, let's try to live.

Among you men, who is the real male lead?

title: I'm... A Cat?
description:
It's exhausting to live as a human, so I hope I become a cat instead.

Then one day, my wish was granted?

title: I Opened an Illegal Werebeast Hospital
alt_titles: I Opened an Illegal Veterinary Hospital in Another World
I Opened an Illegal Veterinary Clinic in Another World
I Started an Illegal Veterinary Clinic
Running an Illegal Veterinary Hospital in Another World
description: Reincarnating after a life of tragedy, Shana's ready to live her best life. As the only child to a doting Duke, how hard could it be? That is until the Crown Prince claims she's his... and a handsome werewolf says only she can heal his kind! Well, time for Shana to open her (illegal) Werebeast Hospital!

title: Scissor Seven: Black and White Twin Dragons
alt_titles: Scissor Seven: Black and White Twin Dragons
description: Mo Lang, a bad boy, and Bai Qi, his genius friend, lived a quiet life in a village in the distant country of Niuzhan. Until one day, a mysterious assassin from the country of Xuanwu appears, who completely subverts their lives, forcing the two youngsters to embark on an adventure that will change the world. The manhua is a prequel to the animated series Scissor Seven, chronicling events from before the original series.

title: Talking Arrogantly
description: A cocky leader of a gang takes out on others for his own pleasure. A mysterious man starts to follow him. What are his intentions?

title: The Egoistic Courtship
description:
As the last of the divine beasts who protected the land, Lionel Milliard was coveted by women for his power and influence. But after an accident with an ancient relic binds him to an inn worker named Hanna, he finally finds one woman with no interest in him! Lionel, intrigued by Hanna's rejection, convinces her to go on a journey with him to free them of the relic's power. Hanna reluctantly agrees, but will she be able to fend off Lionel's advances, or will this beast devour yet another woman?

---
*The webtoon was released as R15, it's not R19 like the novel.*

title: Thought It Was the End, Only to Return to a Changed Genre
alt_titles: Ending Jul Algo Dorawatdeoni Jangneuga Bakkwim
I Thought It Was the Ending, but When I Came Back, the Genre Had Changed
Thought It Was 'the End', Only to Return to a Changed Genre
I Returned Thinking It Was the Ending, but the Genre Changed
description:
I was the villainess in the original novel, but I skillfully avoided every death flag, staged my death, and escaped.

I saved the poor child who was destined to die, sacrificed myself so the main characters could live peaceful lives, then I hid away while waiting for my own happy ending.

I was happy when I finally heard that the original leads were getting married —only for a moment.

Then I received news of my mother’s death and returned to my hometown…

That’s when the original male lead, my childhood friend and fiancé, said, “If I’d known you’d fall for something as trivial as a funeral notice, I would’ve sent it out sooner.”

The male lead, whom I thought had married another woman, looked at me with crazed eyes and smiled.

What’s wrong with you? You were never like this.

“Now, you can’t go anywhere.”

title: I Will Dedicate My Life to Revenge
alt_titles: I Dedicate My Life to Revenge
description: Irene, the wife of a minor noble in the Kingdom of Westaria, receives devastating news—both of her parents have died. When she searches for her husband, Cosmos, she discovers that their marriage was a sham, meant only to bring down her family. Unable to bear the betrayal, Irene takes her own life—only to awaken six months before her wedding day. This time, armed with her exceptional medical skills, she vows to take revenge by drawing close to the kingdom’s regent, Base. Meanwhile, Cosmos still engaged to Irene—begins to falter in the face of her sudden coldness. Between these two men, will Irene succeed in carrying out her revenge?

title: How to Choose Your Knight
description: When Jade Browen wakes up inside a dark cabin, she thinks her enemies have finally defeated her. After all, a talented young fire mage is bound to be targeted. And ever since her parents’ death, Jade’s family members have had their sights set on her claim to House Browen’s title as well as her life. Now that she’s been abandoned in a remote forest that nullifies all magic, she’s forced to rely on her mysterious rescuer, Axel. But as she tries to escape her predicament, the forest starts to unravel some dark past secrets...

title: The Unnamed Sea
description: The moonlight fell deep into the dream world, trapped in the nameless sea. A ticket to the unknown is the compass that will guide him to that lost island. Phineas Rolle is a "lonely nerd who can't make friends" who owns an antique shop called Nautilus on Oak Street. One day, a mysterious package is left in his mailbox along with a letter that will lead him to the mysterious Mirage Island his mother once told him about in his childhood. On his journey, he accidentally resurrects Zhuo Lin, a male merman, and together they uncover a carefully orchestrated conspiracy and the secret of Mirage Island, hidden for thousands of years...

title: To you whose wishes remain unfulfilled
alt_titles: To you whose wishes remain unfulfilled
description: A friendship story about a bright young man and a melancholy ghost who help other ghosts fulfill their wishes.

title: It’s Reasonable to Use a Butcher Knife to Chop Down Everything in the World, Right?
alt_titles: It’s Reasonable to Use a Butcher Knife to Chop Down Everything in the World, Right?
A Pig-Slaughtering Knife Cutting Through All Realms — Makes Sense, Right?
The Butcher Blade That Pierces All Realms
description: Ye Chuan is a mentally ill patient. In his eyes, all creatures in the world look like pigs. On the day of his job change, he awakened to the life-oriented pig-killer profession. His teachers and classmates were disappointed, and his childhood sweetheart also left him. However, the pig-killer profession allows him to cause extra damage to pigs, which reduces the damage caused by pigs to him by half. In addition, in his eyes, everything is a pig. With a pig-killing knife, he counterattacks and becomes a god!

title: I'm Here to Destroy
description:
Born as the almighty god of plants, but falsely accused of being an evil deity that will destroy the world and imprisoned in an isolation cell for 200 years.
Elijah, who became addicted to melodrama and novels while locked in his room, escapes to the human world and possesses Roselita Derman, a dying marquis.
He thought that human life would be easy with dramas and novels, but things don’t go as he pleases.
Roselita didn’t commit suicide by drinking poison!?
To clear the name of Roselita, who is as miserable and unjustly accused as he is, he must find out the truth, even if it means breaking things here and there.
“Aak! Who are you, really?!”
“Me? I’m the fairy of the mallet who protects love and justice.”
And he’s going to have a fateful love that he’s only seen in dramas and novels!
“No one will ever point fingers at you again.”
The Derman family, especially his uncle Benjamin, can’t stand it even if I move a finger.
Damn it. This is the first time I’ve felt this kind of affection!
“You like my face. Look at it slowly, I won’t allow it.”
And to top it all off, the broken-down crown prince is my fiancé…?
What about my romance? My fateful love!?

title: Unhinged
description:
A story of murder and violence, **"Unhinged"** follows Erika as she walks a path of vengeance. Seven years ago, Erika came home to find her husband murdered. Unable to find any other suspects, Erika was found guilty and spends most of a decade plotting her revenge from the inside of a cell.
Once freed, she finds herself moving past the boundaries of *"respectable"* society and beyond the shackles of morality. Laws will be broken, lives will be lost, and, yes, there will be blood.


---

**Note:** The series was cancelled by Lezhin after Season 1 (72 chapters+ Prologue). It has since resumed serialization on Comico.

---

**Links:**
- [Original Webtoon <RidiBooks>](https://ridibooks.com/books/3498015731)

title: Abstract Magical Girls
description: In this world, career magical girls have it easy, and are entrusted with the mission of protecting the world. However, away from the limelight, there is another type of magical girls — part-time magical girls. They have no insurance and no money, no mandated breaks or minimum wage. Despite this, they still hold on to their own beliefs, working this thankless job in the shadows. This is our story, and it all starts with a unknown magical girl...

title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
description: Woo Young-woo is a rookie attorney on the autism spectrum at one of Korea’s most prestigious law firms, Hanbada. Using her encyclopedic memory and creative thought process, she can find unconventional solutions to the toughest cases — but can she succeed while facing discrimination and stigma?

title: Rebirth Two Lives - I Still Love You
alt_titles: The General Who Always Sees Himself As Substitute
Jiāngjūn Zǒng Bǎ Zìjǐ Dāng Tìshēn
description: Mu Zhi Ming dated a scumbag, and was cruelly killed when on exile. After being reborn, he swore to never let history repeat itself. But as he was devising plans, he discovered that the cold general Gu He Yan is actually warm-hearted and sincere. Mu Zhi Ming decided to fall into the enemy’s hands and get married. But on the wedding night, Gu He Yan said to him: I know that I’m just a substitute for him. Mu Zhi Ming never said anything and just pushed him onto the bed, Gu He Yan: What are you doing? Mu Zhi Ming: We’re! Sleeping! Together!

title: Hiding the Archduke's Humiliating History
alt_titles: The Male Lead Is in Charge of the Successor
The Dark History of the Male Lead
description: After being neglected in her past life, Izelle is ecstatic to be reborn as a rich character until her family suddenly goes bankrupt! While thinking about what to do, she's given the perfect chance to solve her financial crisis when she saves young Archduke Karl Byron from being bullied. Unfortunately, Karl doesn't remember her at all when they reunite as adults, and she has no choice but to coerce him into helping her. Can Izelle get what she wants, or will Karl be more trouble than he's worth?

title: Cookie Run Sweet and Crunchy MBTI Exploration!
Necessity
description: Miorine and Suletta are still adjusting to life with each other. To Nika and Chuchu's surprise, through a small exchange Miorine ends up opening up a little about her feelings towards Suletta. With both Suletta and Miorine wanting each other but being clumsy about it in their own ways, just what path will their relationship take in the end...?

title: The Turn-Bound Mage
description:
"You criminal bastard… Are you still not coming to your senses?!"

All I did was start the final difficulty of the game Abyss of the Labyrinth — and the next thing I knew, I had possessed a game character in another world. But the character I ended up in... was a criminal who became a slave?!

Every time I’m in danger, a mysterious magic called the Turn-Based Hourglass activates — stopping time for 60 seconds.

I don’t know whether it was a developer or a god who threw me into this mess, but as the Turn-Based Mage, I swear I’ll survive.

title: Archmage Curriculum
description: Eugene, a kind and righteous, yet somewhat intimidating wizard, takes in his master's daughter, Ain, as his apprentice and aims to raise her into a great wizard. In a world both saved by magic and thrown into chaos by magic, join Eugene and strive towards becoming a great wizard!

title: The Archmage Doesn't Want to Be a Hero
alt_titles: The Archmage Doesn't Want to Be a Hero
description:
Pendant près de 300 ans, les trois royaumes de la péninsule de Karektia se sont livrés à une guerre territoriale épuisante.
Après la signature d’un traité de paix visant à reconstruire les nations, deux anciens « héros de guerre » — le grand archimage Yures et son compagnon, le chevalier Karka — se retirent pour vivre dans la tranquillité d’une forêt, près d’un petit village éloigné de la capitale.
Yures souffre d’agoraphobie, tandis que Karka veille sur lui avec inquiétude.
Alors qu’ils mènent une vie paisible, un jour, un jeune frère et sa sœur, perdus dans la forêt, font irruption chez eux.
Mais très vite, Yures remarque un étrange symbole gravé à l’arrière du cou des enfants…

title: We Don't Know Each Other Anymore
alt_titles: Let's Pretend We Don't Know Each Other
description:
"The reason I am leaving this letter—though you may already know—is to keep a promise."

Elisha, the Archmage of the Cardion Empire and fiancée of Emperor Erich.

"Your Highness, no, you know what His Majesty the Emperor always used to say. 'I will never marry you, not even if I die!'"

One day, she suddenly vanished, leaving only a single letter behind for her fiancé. However, contrary to Elisha's expectation that he would not look for her, Erich immediately began searching for her...

"Whether she is within the Empire or has left the country. I just have to find her and bring her back."

If he finds her and brings her before his eyes, then...

"We must make a new promise."

title: Prince Snow White Is Taken by the Queen
description:
Once upon a time, there was a prince famous far and wide for his beauty. His skin was white as snow, and he had blood-colour-... Blood-colored?! That is not just blood-coloured, that is actually blood though?! The temper of the beautiful prince grew nastier with each passing year, and what caused such a tyrannical beauty to explode most of all was... hHs new, young, and supercute stepmother! "You'd be somewhat pleasant to look at if you'd just fix your attitude", she said with a big smile, teasing the short-tempered prince who threatens to kill her every day. The prince refused to accept the new queen. Failing to overcome his burning anger and quick temper, was angry with his father - but the king had truly run out of patience with his idiot son, and finally chased him out of the house. Ah, the pitiful (?) Prince Snow White... He did not even realise that the queen's true identity is that of the evil witch, who was hired by the king to fix his son's horrid demeanor. 

Meanwhile, Prince Snow White has yet to figure out what dangers await him...

A fantasy romance between a horrible prince and a suspicious queen - a reverse-gender Snow White fantasy romance smut by the author of [Good Girlfriend](https://mangadex.org/title/9efbfa57-76f7-4690-a8f3-de9188beb335/good-girlfriend)!

title: You At First Sight
description: Being able to see people's mind on their faces, Yechan always had trouble socializing to the point that she ended up ostracized. But one day, at the convenience store where she works, she meets an office worker whom she can't read for the first time !

title: Martial God Chat Group
alt_titles: The Great Tang: Chatroom of the Martial Gods
description: He stepped into Li Jing’s mansion as a poor man and became the son-in-law of Li’s mansion. After 15 years, I finally got to the day when the system was activated, and the Wu shen chat group was launched~

title: Murim Psychopath
description:
[Welcome to Murim Online, the world where the strongest reside.]
[Your device has malfunctioned, and logging out failed.]
[Would you like to attempt to disconnect once more?]
[Yes] [No]

When he tried returning to virtual reality, the place he logged into was instead the "real Murim."

A once-in-an-era psychopath fell into the Murim due to the Grim Reaper’s mistake.

Dong Bongsu's merciless fangs cast a shadow over Murim, which is rife with schemes and malice.

title: Lucky Mia!
description: Nam Eunho, a student living alone with his younger sister, has known nothing but misfortune since a childhood accident. His only wish is to lead a normal, quiet life. But an unexpected encounter with the “campus goddess” turns everything upside down and may well change his fate…

title: The Elementary School Student That I Love
alt_titles: The Elementary School Student That I Love
description:
For Shim Chung-ah, becoming a teacher is a dream come true. But her joy is short lived! She gets dumped by her boyfriend, meets a pervert on the bus… All these upsetting events just keep making her suffer. After deciding to escape reality by jumping into a video game, the gosu player she ends meeting is actually one of her students?! Without even trying, she find her heart continuously beating. Could this be love?  
  
**The series has since been taken off Lezhin.**  
  
Nevertheless, since 2019 the manwha is available on series naver and pocket comics.

title: Just A Volunteer Club
description: Besides students, don't teachers and the principal have worries too? We, the volunteer club, aims to solve problems for anyone who is troubled! Share your worries with us~

title: Boy's Dormitory 303
description: The stupid antics of four dudes living together, their “no pain, no gain” lifestyle in school, and maybe there’ll be some romance in the mix~

title: Your Tears are Sweet
description: In order to become a normal person who can cry, Zuo Xiaoxia began to collect other people's tears. But who would've thought that she'd become entangled with the school hunk in the process?

title: Winter Carnival
description:
A new employee, Myeongjin, will enter the mountaineering department where the manager died in an accident on a mountain climbing and the lungs were decided.

With that opportunity, the darkness of the mountaineering department, which was scheduled to be buried deep, appears, Myungjin will also be caught up in it...

title: Enemies Should Settle but Not Be Friends
alt_titles: Enemies Should Settle but Not Be Friends
Enemies are better off joined than separated.
description: The male and female lead's first encounter was a heavily remembered thing! They hated each other, but just out of luck, they became classmates! Not only were they classmates, but also seatmates! These two, like enemies that fought and battled! They both despise each other and tortured each other. But what will this continuous torture and bothering result in...

title: Daily Life in Campus
alt_titles: This is actually Campus Daily Life
description: This is a simple and funny daily life between campus friends.

title: Gentle Beast
description: A cat? A dog? No, it's obviously a beast! In a small town where a bloodshed occurred, Chana, a typical female high school student met Yumu, a popular male high school student, who was suspected of being a murderer. As the relationship between the two changed as time passed, the man who seemed to be gentle and kind in front of her gradually showed his true self, and the truth of all the incidents also surfaced.

title: Someday I Never Knew
description: A lot happened that day… An older brother flees with the adopted younger sister. The two survive with only each other after getting labeled as “The Murderer’s Children”. In those days where they accompanied each other, the two children carried their own concerns. And during someday no one knew, they developed feelings for each other…

title: Impossible
description: A complicated web of relationships between two sets of childhood friends. How can all of them reach their happily ever after?

title: The Best of Us
description:
You always said that youth would never last forever, and the us of that time– was the best of us.  
  
This time, we will bid farewell to our whole youth.  
  
Do you still remember your high school deskmate? That boy with the world’s brightest smile, that girl with the world’s most beautiful silhouette?  
  
In the three years of high school, the shadows of two people intertwine with the chalk, black and white both distinct, drifting around within the memories.  
  
With You paints a reminiscence of the story of the female lead, Geng Geng, and the male lead, Yu Huai, during their three years as deskmates. Taking troubles to heart,* the small moments of their growth throughout the entire story touch the heart and bring nostalgia and memories to their peak.  
  
**(Geng Geng Yu Huai, put together, form a homonym of the idiom “to take troubles to heart.”)*

title: Moon Shark: Sangeo ga Star-seong eul Tagonam
alt_titles: Moonshark: Sharks Are Born to Be Stars
Moonshark: Sharks Are Born With Stars
Moon Shark: From Underwater Princess to Celebrity
description:
Princess Sid of the Underwater Kingdom is destined to inherit the throne of the sea. However, she becomes a fan of the land idol 'Raon', and she becomes eager to see her favourite star, so she runs away to the surface.
While leading a satisfying life as an ordinary fan, Sid's world is suddenly turned upside down when she meets the famous actor 'Jihan'. Unintentionally, the two keep getting entangled with each other, and Sid unexpectedly becomes an SNS star overnight…!!
This story captures Sid's journey of growth and love as she navigates her new life on land, discovering herself between the two worlds of the underwater kingdom and the human world.

---
Sid, who is a Shark Princess of the underwater kingdom, falls in love with Raun, a member of the boy band BUB, and runs away to the surface to see him. Things are going great until the famous teen actor, Jihan Kang, steps into her life unexpectedly and they keep crossing paths.
