Will Sid be able to keep her secret and get what she came up to the surface for?

title: I Drank It Instead of My Husband
alt_titles: I Ended up Drinking It Instead of My Husband
description:
어렸을 때부터 짝사랑했던 호위기사, 아른프리트와 정략 결혼을 하게 된 루드베키아. 
그러나 결혼 생활은 기대와 달리 순탄치 않았고, 결국 루드베키아는 마지막 희망처럼 사랑의 묘약을 준비한다. 

“이, 이혼을, 하자는 건가요?” 
“원래 자리로 돌아가자는 뜻입니다. 서로가 원치 않은 결혼이었으니까요.” 
그러나 약을 먹이기도 전에 돌아온 건 남편의 이혼 통보. 

설상가상으로, 아른은 그녀가 음료에 무언가를 탔다는 사실을 눈치채고 
오해는 돌이킬 수 없을 만큼 커져 버린다. 

모든 게 망가질 것 같던 순간, 
루드베키아는 사랑의 묘약이 든 음료를 남편 대신 마셔 버리고— 

그날 밤, 
이혼 직전이던 부부는 예상치 못한 동침을 하게 된다. 

끝나야 할 결혼에서 시작돼 버린 관계. 
서로를 좋아하면서도 끝없이 엇갈려 온 두 사람의 결혼은 과연 어디로 향할까.

title: My Dog-Like Junior
description:
“An office romance where you find yourself hopelessly entangled with the exact type of junior colleague you hate”

Han Song-I, who, despite her outstanding work performance, constantly has her credit stolen by a clique within her team. But another source of stress arises for her. Kim Ji-Hun, a hopelessly unprofessional rookie who’s been a thorn in her side since his first day on the job. When Ji-Hun moves into Song-I’s neighborhood, the two start running into each other more often. In the process, Ji-Hun helps Song-I get rid of her clingy ex-boyfriend and even takes down a man she considered her sworn enemy. As a result, Song-I begins to develop a personal fondness for Ji-Hun…

Is romance even possible with a junior colleague who’s as stubborn as a dog—biting when provoked and turning fierce when you try to protect her?

title: The Returned Extra Becomes a Genius
alt_titles: The Returned Extra Becomes a Genius
The Regressed Extra Becomes a Genius
description:
The story delves into the life of Kim Seon-woo, who got pulled into a famous novel and decided to live a quiet life as a side character. One day, the protagonist of said novel died…

“Do you expect me to believe this?”

He ends up regressing back in time – back to his first day within the novel.

title: How to Extend a Marriage Contract
description:
Emily, the only daughter of an earl, is looking for a marriage partner to inherit the title. Kyle, the captain of the Order of the Holy Knights, appears before her at just the right time.

‘I need you,’ he says, ‘and you need a suitable husband.’

The two agree to pretend to be married for the duration of the contract. But Emily falls for Kyle during their fake marriage, and soon the three years are over and their contract comes to an end. However, Kyle returns from an expedition with an unexpected case of amnesia.

‘So does that mean he doesn’t remember the marriage contract?’ Emily thought, realizing that if Kyle knew, he would be horrified.

title: Male God, Your Persona Has Collapsed!
alt_titles: Male God, Your Persona Has Collapsed!
description:
Reborn back to his college days, Zhou Yuwen knew well the importance of maintaining one’s image.
In this life, his labels were: maturity and extraordinary talent!

“I’m a rather traditional guy. I believe love comes with responsibility — so one must be cautious when falling in love.”

“Zhou Yuwen, let’s remarry!”

“Get lost! I already have a girlfriend!”

He runs, she chases — and even with wings, there’s no escape!

title: Tyrant of the Otherworld Prison: My Shadow Can Evolve Infinitely
alt_titles: Tyrant of the Otherworld Prison: My Shadow Can Evolve Infinitely
description: In the year 2035, rifts to alien realms tore through the world’s defenses. Swarms of insectoids and beastkin ravaged the land, and humanity struggled to survive through the strength of “Evolvers.” Li Yi was betrayed by his teammates during an attack by alien beings and left for dead. On the brink of death, he awakened the “Titan Shadow” System—his shadow could evolve without limits! It could devour ores to enhance defense, tear through enemies to form deadly blades, and even split into an army of shadow soldiers… From insect hives to haunted lands, wherever his shadow passed, enemies were shredded into pulp. This is the revenge of the weak—begun with a shadow that devours all.

title: After the weirdness came, I unlocked the Tower of Babel
alt_titles: After the weirdness came, I unlocked the Tower of Babel
After the Supernatural Descended, I Unlocked the Sky Tower
description: On the day when the Demon Suppressing Tower appeared, the world turned into a hell where demons were rampant, and Su Zhe became the demon hunter who could never improve, until a monster got into his brain!

title: Lord Of The Star Souls
description: The world has changed dramatically, and "dungeon games" have randomly appeared everywhere, and the monsters that appear are bloody killings on humans! The Chuunibyou manga artist Qin You has experienced countless dungeons in his dreams, and knows......

title: After Rebirth, I Married the Scumbag’s Mortal Enemy
alt_titles: After Rebirth, I Married the Scumbag’s Mortal Enemy
After Rebirth, I Married My Scumbag Ex’s Arch-Enemy
description: In her previous life, An Nuan was murdered by a scumbag and his family due to her naiveté. Upon waking up, An Nuan returns to the time before her marriage to the scumbag. Drawing on her memories from her previous life, she decides to team up with the scumbag's nemesis, Ye Jinghuai, to forge a fake marriage and undo the scumbag's and his family's betrayal. However, during this engagement, the two gradually begin to fall in love, developing genuine feelings for each other.

title: Nuclear Explosion Sword Technique, I kill one with one sword
alt_titles: Nuclear Explosion Sword Technique, I kill one with one sword
description: Comic Synopsis: Special Forces soldier Jin Quan is betrayed during a mission and becomes a living coordinate for missile guidance. Upon awakening, he finds himself a destitute man unconscious on the streets of Downtown, a place where the underclass gather, their people serving as cannon fodder in the mines. Faced with a life-or-death struggle, Jin Quan awakens as a Demon Swordsman, gifted with the radiation from a dirty bomb explosion in his past life. In this world, Jin Quan will battle the Chosen One.

title: Ten Thousand Kinds of Love
description: What is love? After their father passed away in an accident, the only ray of light to the Zheng family’s three sisters is their brother Zhinian. The family’s ongoing misfortunes quietly bury the seeds of growth in the three sisters - Yihua, Erye and Sanguo, and their future takes an unexpected turn. This story is all about love and the the bonds between family, friends and lovers.

title: My Handmade Diary
description: A fragrance sachet on an autumn day, alterations on an old shirt, a knitted cap in early spring… in each chapter, this young lady will show the reader how to make all sorts of knick knacks. A warm and beautiful slow life begins with handicrafts.

title: Perfect Honeymoon
description: After getting married, the bride went on a honeymoon alone? Their honeymoon is at stake from the start!

title: The Hero Who Has Sex With a Demon
description:
One year after the Demon King’s fall, Belphegor, a former officer of the Demon King’s army, is living a lazy, hedonistic life. Unable to stand it anymore, the strategist Media gives him an order:

“Belphegor, go kill the Hero.”

Reluctantly heading to the human world, Belphegor waits for a chance to assassinate the Hero, only to stumble upon the Hero’s secret by accident… the Hero is not a man, but a woman?!

After learning the Hero’s secret, Belphegor proposes a deal, claiming he can lift her curse, and the two begin an uneasy journey together.

title: The Vampire Lord's Obsessive Love
description:
The God Kronos went down to the mortal realm for a "vacation" (or was it to escape?), only to have his soul cast into the body of a succubus thanks to the "System".  While following a quest from the "System", Kronos (now a succubus) crosses paths with Rhea, the heir to the vampire clan. Swept into the internal conflicts of the vampire clan, Kronos eventually discovers the truth behind his arrival in the mortal realm.

God-turned-Succubus x An Obsessive Vampire x A Twist of Fate!

title: Orca Mansion
description:
"Devo simplesmente devorá-lo?"

Orca Ware, o jovem mestre da família Ware — um clã de metamorfos Orca — retorna de um campo de batalha banhado em sangue. Para um homem que prefere a carnificina à paz e encontra conforto na guerra em vez do luxo, a Mansão Orca é simplesmente de um tédio insuportável.

Então, um servo patético e tolo chamado Nia aparece diante dele. Atormentado pelos outros funcionários por ser um metamorfo Peixe Dourado, Nia está secretamente saciando sua fome no lago da propriedade tarde da noite... quando dá de cara com Orca.

"Jovem Mestre, eu estava errado... Por favor, eu imploro, me poupe..."

Ele é mais fraco e patético do que qualquer um, mas sua luta para sobreviver... é absolutamente irritante.

Orca tenta ignorar, mas seu olhar continua voltando para o pequeno e frágil Nia. A mansão, antes definida por seu tédio, agora está preenchida com um tremor inexplicável.

title: The Country is Saved!
description: A 28-year-old female prosecutor Min-seo is just about to go out with Jun-hyun, a good looking prosecutor whom she has had a crush on since high school. With a successful career and her soon-to-be boyfriend, it seems like she is the happiest woman in the world. However, she suddenly time travels to her high school life while she is chasing a male suspect named Sang-woo; he was a senior in her high school. She genuinely does not want to relive her high school life because it was just the stereotype of a nerd. With a strict moral code as a prosecutor, a teenager’s appearance, and two attractive men, namely Jun-hyun and Sang-woo, around her, her second high school life will be nothing like her previous one.

title: Falling For Danger
description:
I could kill you if I wanted.
Hale Windsor was a renowned hitman until he is betrayed and loses the love of his life. With nothing left to live for, he begins a war of revenge on the very organization he used to work for. That is, until he meets Marine, a girl who brings color back into his black and white existence.

title: The End of the World as We Know It
The Red Over There Is Our Home
description:
A very short comic about the city and the stars.  
Read left to right.

title: General I Love You
description: In the middle of a historical fight, there was a time warp? The Emperor opened a film company and forced the General to debut?! The Prince that the General liked ended up being a Princess who crossdressed?! Come and watch the hilarious antics by the most dramatic General in history!

title: Immortal Maestro
description:
The person who is ranked No.1 in the world rankings of the AOS League of Infinity game and the strongest person who is nicknamed the devil on the battlefield.
However, a man wearing a golden mask appeared before the strongest person who had suffered a setback in a traffic accident and was abandoned by everyone and proposed.
“If I come back, can I become a world championship winner?”
The strongest person who goes back to the past becomes the maestro who leads the battlefield between earth and other worlds and shows the best game of all time.

title: One Step Divine Fist
description:
Born as the son of a wealthy family, 'Jang Geon' was destined for ruin. To turn his fate around, he had to live a simple life under the guidance of a virtuous monk.

Given to the frugal monk 'Gyeongmok' at Shaolin Temple, Jang Geon spent his days in rough cotton robes, barely getting by on plain rice...

While enduring hunger and minimizing movement in his daily life, he stumbled upon martial arts and managed to apply his mindset of thrift to it…?

title: I Have Revived the Chinese Gods!
alt_titles: I Have Revived the Chinese Gods!
description: Glaciers are melting, and the sea clans are invading. The Western gods rule over humanity, while the Huaxia people, without gods, become the target of everyone. Until a giant stone statue crosses the starry sky and crashes into the land of Jiuzhou, Zhao Feiyu comes through the void...

title: Maze in Memory
alt_titles: I Was Mistaken for the Villain
description: Haechan, who was too weak and ignored by everyone, meets the mysterious child Miro and gains great strength, but at the same time, he learns that the sealing stone that he thought would protect everyone was actually the main culprit that was destroying the world. He tries to fix this on his own, but those who do not know the truth see him as a villain.

title: Should I Make You a Nuclear Weapon?
alt_titles: Should I Make You a Nuclear Weapon?
I Make Nuclear Weapons for You?
description:
Director Kim Jun of the Defense Science Research Institute faces a tragic end while protecting the ADD chip, a military secret of South Korea, during a terrorist attack in 2024.

However, he suddenly finds himself with an unexpected opportunity: he is reborn in the body of his friend Jeon Hyun-seung, who died in 1998!

Revived as Kim Jun, he discovers that he can access future technologies using the ADD chip engraved in his body.

"If you give me the chance... I’ll show you what I can create within three months."

Create the ultimate weapon to overcome the IMF crisis with future technology! Let me know if you need anything else!

title: Player Super Justice
description: Annan, a senior game producer, traveled to the foggy continent of another world and became a rare elite NPC with a player system. But he still has a heart that belongs to a player. Although I love to stir up trouble and act recklessly, I am a good player and a righteous partner favored by this world. Now I am carrying the main quest, as a righteous player, I am ordered by heaven to eliminate you, the evil NPC!

title: The Young Master of Namgung Is an Impersonal Person
alt_titles: The Young Master of Namgung Is an Impersonal Person
description:
"I won't let you live again."

Facing the monumental task of unifying the martial arts world, the head of the Namgung family, 'Namgung Hyun-ho,' watches in horror as his beloved 'dog' annihilates his entire clan. In the moment he feels his neck being severed, he suddenly finds himself back seven years to when he first met that 'dog.' 

But things are unfolding differently this time around…

On top of that, the 'dog,' 'Baek-gyeon,' returns completely wrecked, making his vow of revenge seem meaningless. Was it really you who killed me back then? 

Truths gradually cast shadows on everything that has been concealed.

The past shifts little by little. A bizarre intertwining of the slain Hyun-ho and the slayer Baek-gyeon unfolds in a thrilling tale of revenge and action.

title: The King of Microtransactions Conquers the Game World
alt_titles: The King of Microtransactions Conquers the Game World
description:
Tatsumi Kyou, the heir of a prestigious family, is diagnosed with a terminal illness and given a grim prognosis.

Determined to complete his unfinished business, he sets out to achieve an unprecedented milestone in his favorite game, Divine Fantasy Chronicle, by using ten different accounts. After finally accomplishing this feat, he falls into a coma.

But when he wakes up—he finds himself inside the world of the game! Even more shocking, the friends and family he encounters bear the same names and appearances as in the real world.

Which world is real?

title: In the Spirit of the Law
alt_titles: In the Spirit of the Law
Overpower Your Enemies by the Law
description: After a mysterious accident on a scorching summer day, high school student Jaehun wakes up to a startling discovery - his soul is now sharing his body with that of an enigmatic ascetic. Over the next three years, Jaehun adjusts to life with his unexpected companion while undergoing rehabilitation. Just as he begins to settle into this strange new reality, he faces a pivotal moment: choosing his path for college. A conversation with his defense attorney father opens the door to a world he had never considered before.

title: Noah's Contract: I'm an NPC in Another World
alt_titles: Noah's Contract: I'm an NPC in Another World
description: Players, this is a continent overrun by monsters. Danger lurks everywhere, so please make full use of your talents and help us eliminate the monster army. What? You ask who I am? I’m just an NPC.

title: Unstoppable Lust
alt_titles: Bad Things That Can't Be Stopped
Bad Bastard That Can't Be Cheated
description:
"Meet me three times."

"Is it that you want to meet three times, or do you want to sleep together three times?"

A faint smile curved his lips.

"Of course, the latter."

A bold and intense romance between two people, with no compromises.

title: My Blood-Curdling Campus Life
description: My life of comparing myself to my perfect older sister is over. Now I'm going to live as the main character! Shin Seon-ha, a freshman who entered college with big dreams. However, I thought there was something strange in that department, but I never thought they were all vampires!!... Sunha's bloody college life with her fellow vampires begins.

title: Legal Scandal
description: "Prince Flynn of Albion is adored for his charm and good looks-but the endless dating rumors? Not so much. Tired of the gossip, he proposes a bold idea to his secretary, Drew: pretend to date him to control the narrative. It’s all for show…until Drew starts seeing Flynn in a different light. Can a staged romance turn into something real?"

title: Conquer the Game With the Best Web Novels
alt_titles: Conquer the Game With the Best Web Novels
Conquer the Game With the Best of the Best in Web Fiction
description:
Leaving behind only a single key, Kim Woojoo's father, a renowned web novel author known for his 'Overpowered MC' stories, passed away. Ten years later, a virtual reality game called 'The Other World,' based on one of his works, becomes a place where people can make a living or even strike it rich.

Kim Woojoo has been living a tough life with no special advantages. By chance, he discovers that the key, a keepsake from his father, is being traded at a high price. He decides to use the key to open a limited edition book in his father's study and receives a special gift from the game.

Accepting the gift, Woojoo encounters the Great Demon King Lucia, a character from his father's web novel. Lucia grants Woojoo incredible abilities, but the power is so overwhelming that Woojoo struggles to complete even simple daily quests.

After much thought, Woojoo decides to eliminate the source of his power, the Demon King, by bringing in another character, Killer Zero. However, his actions draw the attention of Jason, a powerful player in 'The Another World,' who comes to confront him.

Will Woojoo be able to face the strongest characters in the game, the ultimate beings from his father's web novel?

title: The Privilege of the Second Life is Power Leveling
alt_titles: The Privilege of the Second Life is Power Leveling
Aiming for Maximal Volume in the Apocalypse
Aiming for Maximal Level in a Post-Apocalyptic World
description: Ten years after humanity’s fall, Earth lies under demonian rule. After losing his sister and his life, Yoon is offered one last chance by an angel statue. Sent back in time with a leveling system, he must reach Lv. 99 to save her and change Earth’s fate. Yoon fights, not for the world, but for her. One brother’s journey to save his sister may be humanity’s last hope.

title: The Villainess Tames the Crazed Devil
alt_titles: The Villainess Tames the Crazed Devil
description:
Making a deal with a demon is a small price to pay for a chance to enact revenge on the man who accuses you of having been seduced by one. 

This is the choice Isabella makes when her father unjustly has her and her mother burned at the stake for being witches. After returning three years into the past, Isabella starts fulfilling her half of the bargain: freeing the demon queen's tragically beautiful son, Kaiden, and unleashing his inner demon. 

Isabella has one year to avenge her mother's honor, and she'll definitely make good use of her new demon husband.

title: Winterbell
description:
One of the four dragons called upon to maintain the balance of the world—the Guardian Dragon of Winter, Seherbian Winterbell. Over time, he grows weary and jaded, burdened by a world that always prays to winter for fear, curses, and misfortune. But when the Dragon Priest who watched over him for years, Rowan, dies, Winterbell decides to finally honor his last wish by stepping out into the world...

"I hope you’ll come to know more of this world.
My dragon, Winterbell."

title: The Dark Duke's Pet Bird
description:
The poignant bluebird of the marriage market, Isabella Eloise, was betrayed by her blindly devoted fiancé of ten years, and lost her place in the social world. The one who found her on a rainy path was none other than the rumored ghost duke.

“Until your feathers grow anew, I shall care for you,” declared the duke.

She thought she had been rescued. But it was only until she discovered his secret…

“Beloved Isabella, I’m curious to hear what sounds you’ll make when I push you to your limits,” the duke mused.

By the time she realized something was terribly wrong, it was already too late to turn back.

“Aedan Holden, you’re insane.”

“Yes, I am. But did you only just figure that out now?”

---
What life is there for a creature forever trapped in a cage? Such questions ring true for Isabella Heloise, illegitimate child of an abusive count who uses her as a pawn for his political ambitions. When Isabella's betrothal to an influential noble is broken off, her value within the Heloise household plummets, prompting her to flee from her father’s violence. Isabella finds herself alone and destitute, only to be found by Ethan Holden, a dashing duke with a nonetheless ominous air. Can Isabella trust the handsome duke, or has she found herself in yet another cage?

title: I Became a Sales Prodigy
alt_titles: I Became a Genius in Sales
description: I chose to do what I could to immediately pay off my debt, and for me, that was sales. And I was given another chance at it.

title: This Life as a Villain
alt_titles: I'll Be a Villain in This Life
description:
Lee Joohyuk, and undercover detective, has spent 15 years infiltrating the corporate-style gang DG Group. He was planning on revealing the evil-doings of the DG Group to the world, toppling them, until… 

"Have a nice trip."

His identity was uncovered, and he was kicked out of the organization. Just as the life faded from his eyes, an apparition of his father, a former hero, appeared. 

"Son, return here only after achieving the dream you so desire."

Joohyuk was sent back to the year 2005. 

"This time! Certainly, I’ll bring you down with my own two hands!"

In an era where scoundrels and scum run rampant, I will become a villain, in order to eliminate all evil.

title: Rookie Employee Kim Cheolsu
description: On the day he was rejected by the company he had devoted his life to, he went back to the moment of his first day at work. Kim Cheol-su, a low-spec rookie employee who joined Han-young, a leading domestic company. Can he finally achieve his long-desired position as the ‘CEO’ in this lifetime?

title: Preview
description:
Cheon Sunwoo, a timid, fearful student, gains the ability to see the future.
If one cannot avoid fate, then stand against that fate.

---
**Links:**
- Alternative Official Raw - [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10442873)

title: Face Slap
description:
Cheon Taepyeong, the President of the Taepyeong Detective Agency, has a peculiar ability to see through a person once he slaps them. He enjoys this process, and has made money by solving requests using his ability alongside the gangster, Won Sangtaek, Special agent Yoo Jungik, and the scammer, Gu Kangjo. He was living a happy life with satisfaction… unlike his miserable past which has been holding him back.

---

- [Original Webtoon <Webtoon kakao>](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B7%80%EC%8B%B8%EB%8C%80%EA%B8%B0/2626)

title: Max Level Doctor Returns
description:
To survive as someone from a lowly background, I, as a doctor, had to abandon my pride. If I had to bark, I barked, if I had to beg, I begged.

Is this the outcome of the weak?!

When frustration and anger brimmed in both eyes, facing death in a traffic accident.
But when I opened my eyes again, I found myself back as an intern…!

On the outside, a novice doctor in their 20s, but on the inside, a top-tier thoracic surgeon.

The revenge and healing drama of Max Level Doctor Kim Yoon Chan begins.

"From now on, I will take control of every situation!"

title: Artifact Reading Appraiser
description:
Hae Jin has a father who devoted his whole life to finding the national artifacts that were smuggled out of the country.
Then one day, after receiving an unknown “artifact” sent by his father, whom he had lost contact with for a long time, a strange light suddenly came from it, granting Hae Jin a mysterious “power” and a “mission”…
“The magic of the Heavenly Object has been bestowed upon you.”
Thus, an adventure involving the artifacts scattered all over the world, including the ” Three Heavenly Objects”, which contains the soul of the Korean people, begins!

title: Even the Lottery Jackpot Winner Still Goes to Work
alt_titles: Even the Lottery Jackpot Winner Still Goes to Work
description:
Gong Eun-tae, an ordinary sales employee you can find anywhere,
wins the jackpot in the lottery—something he had only dreamed of!

After taxes, he takes home 1.8 billion won.
A large sum, but is it really enough to turn his life upside down?
"Let’s just live as I always have… I'll think of the lottery as insurance for my peace of mind."

With that reassuring safety net, he takes the leap—
and suddenly, everything he does starts going unbelievably well?!

Today, Eun-tae heads to work once again!
But this time, with a whole new mindset.

title: Reincarnated as a New Employee
description:
Oh Chang-seok, the self-made legend and owner of Shinwoo Tech…
After passing away in his early 50s, he is reincarnated into the body of an unemployed young man with no qualifications—Oh Chang-seok.

title: A Corporate Underling Who Excels at Work
alt_titles: A Corporate Underling Who Excels at Work
The Corporate Underdog Who Does Everything Right
description:
Chae Gyeong-jun, who gave up both college and his dreams due to the IMF crisis, once again faces despair in front of his grandmother's sudden hospitalization fees.

But then, a mysterious benefactor steps in to cover the hospital costs for his family...

"Who would provide support that doesn't help them at all, and why?"

In search of an answer, Gyeong-jun heads to Taeseong.

title: The New Employee is Incredible?
description:
A strange old lady appears before the 31-year-old protagonist, who graduated from a provincial university, has no connections, and no impressive credentials!

"Buy one for me..."

The old lady suddenly thrusts a piece of gum forward, claiming that chewing it will make you smarter, better at work, and even more likable.

The protagonist, caught off guard, ends up buying it. During a job interview, He absentmindedly swallows the gum, and from that moment on, things start to strangely go His way...

title: May the Congressman Protect You
description:
A fantastic duo of a political master and a complete novice!

I’m Gu Yeongjin, a six-term congressman — the pinnacle of South Korea’s political world, the nation’s hope!
One fateful day in 2008, betrayed by my closest aides, I faced a special investigation and chose to end my own life.
When I opened my eyes… it was Seoul, 10 years in the past?!

Now a ghost, no one can see me or hear my voice.
No one... except one person, Cha Jaerim, a 25-year-old Level 9 civil servant.

No connections, no money, stuck in miserable circumstances...
But look at that ambition, that fire in his eyes... I like it! Fine. I’ll make him my partner.

“You need to go into politics.”

And I’ll get my revenge.

A political genius ghost, Gu Yeongjin, teams up with a clueless rookie, Cha Jaerim, for the ultimate combo in
<May the Congressman Protect You>

title: God’s Cooking
description:
The greatest chef in Korean history, Hong Si-won, has passed away suddenly.
His final will shocked everyone — he decreed that all the chefs in his restaurant must compete for the position of head chef.

Into this fierce competition steps a young man with the “Tongue of God,” Park Geon-woo.
Can he survive the brutal battleground of "Beauty and Jade", where no one can be trusted?

A fiery culinary showdown filled with passion and growth, friendship and rivalry.
Who will emerge as the final victor?

title: Chairman Kang, the New Employee
description:
I’m Kang Yong-ho, the Chairman of Choi Sung Group, one of South Korea’s top 10 conglomerates.
Just when I was basking in the glory of my retirement declaration, out of the blue, a new employee fell from the sky and landed on my head. But hey, where’d my body go, and now I’ve turned into a new Employee?!

“What’s this? Are you telling me to start with Excel or something?

title: Echoes of Footsteps
description:
A world frozen beneath falling blue snow. Teenage boy 'Seo Sunwoo', who walks with a prosthetic leg, begins a journey south to return the lifeless 'Choi Yiseo' to her home.
A world that has forgotten warmth. A pace too slow to match the rhythm of the world. Limping forward, step by step, through thick layers of snow.
Where will his footsteps lead? Who will he meet, what trials will he face, and where will he arrive in the end?
Even though his tracks will soon be buried beneath the snow, they linger in the mind.

title: Face Genius: Top Star from Age 0
alt_titles: Face Genius: Top Star from Age 0
description:
Aspiring to live just one day as a handsome man, supporting actor Lee Han-jo is rewarded for his virtuous life with a beautiful face and a status window that grants wishes upon reincarnation.

Although abandoned as an orphan in front of a convent in the dead of winter, his luck doesn’t end there, he’s even adopted into the family of a wealthy actor.

Armed with the seasoned experience of a max-level supporting actor and a god-given face, maybe this time, he can aim for the life of a Top Star!

title: The Killer Attorney
description:
Hogil Byeon is a third-class killer in the criminal organization Glory Club, with no way up and only one way out. He pivots into law, but his knack for killing doesn’t disappear. Juggling courtrooms and bullets, Hogil starts redefining justice his own way. The law has limits, but Hogil doesn’t. When a lawyer has killer skills, justice is served… with a bang!

(Source: Naver Webtoon)

title: Worn-Out Romance
description:
Jeong Seoun, 32 ans, oméga dominant.
Après 6 ans de vie active et plusieurs relations amoureuses.  
Il a toujours connu le même schéma : des débuts exaltants, puis des fins épuisantes.
Il finit par comprendre que les émotions aussi demandent de l’énergie.

Mais lors d’une rencontre arrangée, un homme qu’il voit pour la première fois lui fait une demande en mariage sans détour.
“Seoun-ssi. Marions-nous.”

An Eujin, 31 ans, alpha dominant.
Un regard impassible, impossible à lire, et des mots toujours excessivement polis.
Il semble suspect… et pourtant, entre ses bonnes conditions et son visage presque irréel, il correspond parfaitement à ses goûts.

Alors pourquoi hésiter ?

C’est ainsi qu’un mariage purement rationnel commence, sans sentiments.

Au fil du temps passé ensemble , les émotions s’entrelacent et une excitation inexistante commence à fleurir...
Leur relation encore maladroite commence à naître...

title: Tiki Taka
description: After a handball injury left her shoulder out of action, Harang is stepping onto the futsal court! This time, she’s not using her hands, she’s competing using her feet! With 100% brainpower but 0% physical strength, can she take on this new challenge? Her futsal adventure begins!

title: Imprinted
description: "Even though I'm meeting you for the first time, it feels as if I'm reuniting with an old friend." The Young Master of the Cangxuan Clan and Ye Wuji, who has lost his memories, both fall victim to a love curse. Thus, the two embark on a journey to break it. But they begin to wonder... are those inexplicable heart beats and feelings of familiarity really because of the love curse, or is it something more?

title: I'd Love to Tell You Secretly
alt_titles: I Would Love to Tell You Secretly
description: A curious girl picks up an injured rabbit and takes it home. She goes out for a bit, but when she come backs, the rabbit has become a tall man and acts particularly viciously! That's the story of the weird relationship between a teenager and an elf.

title: My Husband Was Once a Long Aotian
alt_titles: Wei Fu Ceng Shi Long Ao Tian
description:
Before transmigrating, Qin Wanwan was the happiest second generation Immortal in the Immortal Realm.

She was a salted fish, a waste, but her parents bribed various outstanding figures who had fame and prestige to fabricate her achievement. Thus, she had a great reputation.

Until one day, Jian Xingzhi, who cultivated Zhanlian Dao and had fought with people all over the world, came over to fight her out of admiration of her strength. With a slash of his sword, she transmigrated from the Immortal Realm to the novel “Strongest Mary Sue” and became the vicious Supporting Female, Qin Wan.

title: My Queen Is the Leader of Martial Arts
description:
They says that for dominating martial arts, Ling Yun first established a small objective: To become the leader of martial arts. But when her objective was about to complete her brother used his identity to get with success the attention of the emperor. What she can do? She also is desperate.  So as not to commit the crime of cheating the emperor, Ling Yun had to “marry in his name”. She wanted to wait calmly death in the palace, but didn’t expect to cause more troubles.

Gong Dou? Is better to fight. Conspiracy? Is better to fight. Ling Xing? Is better to fight.  Ling Yung won’t use her mouth if she can explain with a punch!

title: The Return of Cambrian Period
description:
Cong Xia wakes up to a loud crash. An earthquake has struck a remote region of China. At first, nothing seems out of the ordinary—but on that very day, all food spoils, and panic spreads across the internet.

While browsing yet another forum, Cong Xia hears an insistent knock at the door and finds a handsome soldier on his doorstep, determined to take him to Beijing.

Once they step outside, they realize that animals and plants have evolved, and danger now lurks at every turn. What challenges await them, and will they be able to make it there alive?

title: Romance Between Regents
description: Yun Su, a principled regent, lived by a code of honor that demanded the repayment of bot kindness and vengeance. His greatest debt of gratitude was owed to none other than his destined nemesis, the Martial Regent. In a twist of fate, even as he was on the verge of death, the Martial Regent chose to protect and save his life. Perplexed by this act of selflessness from the man of noble status and immense wealth, Yun Su found himself at a loss for how to properly reciprocate. With no other means at his disposal, he decided to marry him.

title: Reborn as the Forsaken Baby Princess
alt_titles: Reborn as the Abandoned Baby Princess
I Became the Abandoned Baby Princess
I Reincarnated as the Forsaken Baby Princess
I Reincarnated as the Forsaken Baby Princess
I Was Reborn as the Abandoned Baby Princess
I Was Reborn as the Neglected Baby Princess
I Was Reincarnated as the Abandoned Baby Princess
I Was Reincarnated as the Abandoned Princess
Reincarnated as the Baby Princess Who Was Abandoned
description: Killed by her most trusted comrade, Assassin Agent Black is reborn as the baby princess of a historical novel. Immediately, she faces repeated assassination attempts and is even forsaken by the king when he refuses to give her a name, but she won't let anyone get her this time. As she uses her assassin skills to survive, she starts making allies, saves the prince's life, and even catches the king's interest. But with a target still on her, will that be enough to keep this little princess alive?

title: No Snooping, Please
description: Someone's snooping around CEO Park Sian's home, searching through his office, and even sending him strange texts. The suspect? Employee Yeh Damin! However, Damin isn’t interested in her boss at all. She’s just been tasked with secretly reporting information on him to someone dear from his past. Not knowing this, Sian fears that Damin is out to get him, which drives him to obsess over her. But could what seems like obsession be turning into… love? And when can Damin stop all the sneaking around?!

title: How to Survive as the Villainous Younger Sister
alt_titles: How the Villain Younger Sister Survives
How to Survive as the Villain's Younger Sibling
How to Survive as the Villain's Sibling
description:
Reborn as the youngest daughter of a ducal house, the narrator thinks she has landed in a sweet childcare-style romance world where everyone dotes on her, from a glamorous big sister to a watchful duke. 

Then the truth hits: this is a revenge story, and the role she occupies is the villain little sister who will be targeted by that very sister, a woman who remembers being killed by her in a past life. To survive, she resolves to keep a low profile and stay firmly in her sister’s good graces. Except the sister acts strangely protective instead, tossing out lines like “Found this on the way” and “If the family kicks you out, I will take you in.” 

As new wild cards appear, staying invisible gets harder, and the plan to simply avoid notice starts to unravel.

title: The Seventh Marriage Is Planned
description: A brilliant heiress from the empire’s richest house has it all: wealth, brains, power, and looks. After six marriages and divorces, she is still the continent’s most sought-after bride. For the seventh, she chooses a young marquis and war hero from an old, cash-strapped family and sets three terms: protect her from assassins, respect her as a wife, and keep a separate household. With conspiracies swirling around her fortune, this might finally be the marriage that lets her live a safe, ordinary life.

title: My Daughter Is Cute and My Husband Is Cool
alt_titles: I Love My Family Too Much to Get a Divorce
My Family Is Too Precious to Let Go
I Can't Divorce Because I Love My Family
I Love My Family Too Much, That's Why I Can't Get Divorced
description: I woke up inside my favorite novel, but with a huge twist, I’m not the heroine. I’m just a nobody side character with plain brown hair and brown eyes. My plan was simple, live quietly, mind my own business, and enjoy a peaceful life. It was perfect… until I somehow ended up married to the story’s male lead, the heroine’s father! My new goal? Be a kind temporary stepmom, make the little girl happy, and then get a clean divorce. There’s just one problem. My “husband” is incredibly kind and way too handsome, and our “daughter” is absolutely precious. My heart wasn’t supposed to get involved. What is a side character supposed to do when her exit plan starts falling apart because she doesn’t want to leave?

title: Reincarnation of the Fist King
description: Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

title: A Stepmother’s Märchen (Book Version)
alt_titles: The Fantasie of a Stepmother (Book Version)
Mǒu Gè Jìmǔ De Tónghuà Gùshi
Mou Ge Jimu De Tonghua Gushi
description:
They called her the Iron Widow. 

When her husband died, he left her to manage not only his vast holdings but also his four children. Young and inexperienced, Shuri nonetheless tried her best to raise them, despite their bitter attitude towards her. She is finally free to live her own life as her eldest son marries… only to find herself mysteriously reset to seven years ago — the night of her husband's funeral. 

Can Shuri find happiness with this second chance at a new destiny?

title: The King Is in Love
description: Surgeon doctor Su Kai Ji accidentally transmigrated into the past, the first thing he saw was himself dressed in wedding clothes and being sent to the palace to be a consort? On the wedding night, the emperor faces the beauty in front of him. And when he went on to touch the flat chest underneath the clothes, he felt his anger rise. Emperor: I actually married a man?! Su Kai Ji: Marry? I would never be the one at the bottom.

title: Irreverent Desires
description: The esteemed Grand Imperial Minister Lu Shuyu was assassinated by malicious individuals operating from the shadows, plunging the world into crisis. Unexpectedly, seven years later, he is reborn in the body of his "lunatic" younger brother, Lu Ziyin. Despite this peculiar situation, Lu Shuyu is pleased to learn that his most pampered young pupil, Crown Prince Song Zhao Xing, has ascended the throne as Emperor. Lu Shuyu is very happy to know that his work as a Laoshi has paid off. However, one day he is stunned to hear the Emperor's scandalous decree: a vast array of handsome men are summoned so the Emperor can choose a male concubine. "A male concubine?! How could my disciple be attracted to men? I must have made a mistake in his upbringing!"

title: The Lazy Devil Decides to Fight God
alt_titles: The Idle Demon King Decided to Fight God
description:
The gods suddenly descended on the human castle ‘Sodom’.
When told to bring the devil to the other side of Sodom, they begin massacring humans together.
In a situation where hell is unfolding, a knight who secretly escapes from the castle goes to pick up the devil.

(Namu.wiki)

title: I Became A Married Man in Another World
alt_titles: I Became A Married Man in Another World
description:
“I want to have a wife as gentle as a rabbit and a daughter as cute as a mongoose.”

On Christmas Eve, after making a wish to a mysterious Santa and heading...

title: The Ultimate Romanticist
description:
Ryu Woo-jin, the undisputed top dog at Dupal High School—the worst high school in the country.
No one can beat him in a fight, but in reality, he’s a romance genre fanatic and an aspiring webtoon author.

Determined to find true romance, Ryu Woo-jin decides to transfer to an ordinary co-ed school.

Will he be able to find sweet romantic material at his new school and create a proper masterpiece?

title: Evolution of Extreme Heat
description: Under abnormally high temperatures, monsters are stirring. Temperatures continue to rise in L City, Country A. A construction accident awakens strange insects slumbering underground, wreaking havoc on the city and parasitizing humans. Humans, once controlled by their emotions, transform into terrifying monsters. The apocalypse has arrived. Xiao Jie, an ordinary office worker, intended to leave L City with his mother on this day, escaping the shadow of domestic violence, but unexpectedly gets caught up in it all. To save his mother, he begins his escape, a desperate struggle for survival…

title: Low Orbit Human
description: Joo Jae-Yeol, a 39-year-old university part-time lecturer and unknown writer, is growing increasingly anxious about his life that is not on track. One day, a death changes his life.

title: My Beloved Snail Bride
description:
I come home from work to find a warm dinner waiting for me on the table.
Hold on… I live alone, don’t I?
Someone is secretly sneaking into my place to cook, clean, and even do my laundry…
and honestly? It’s so convenient that I’ve already gotten used to it!

title: Nine Fantasy
description:
A former warrior ends up falling into another mysterious plot? Can he save the world which he was pulled into again and escape back to reality?

---
- [Original Webtoon <Toomics>](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/4929)
---
- [Official Simplified Chinese Translation](https://toomics.com/sc/webtoon/episode/toon/4929)

- [Official Traditional Chinese Translation](https://toomics.com/tc/webtoon/episode/toon/4929)

title: The Legend of BuQie
description: It might look like a rabbit, but they're actually just a blade of grass. Join BuQie for a dose of delightfully absurd daily adventures—you might just find a little bit of yourself in BuQie's wacky world.

title: My Half Esper
description:
In a world where interdimensional gates unleash monstrous threats, a rare few are born with extraordinary powers. These gifted individuals are known as Espers and Guides.
Choi Kyuhyuk is officially classified as an S-class Esper, but there’s a catch. His self-regeneration ability is so weak that he's been downgraded to S-minus. People call him a “half-baked” Esper, and the name has stuck ever since. After sustaining a serious injury, he has been reassigned to a desk job in the Guide Line Department, where he now trains rookie Guides.
Life was relatively peaceful until one very specific problem arrived.
Yeon Soojung, a Guide Kyuhyuk once saved as a child and treats like family, has just come of age. And now, he wants to initiate a sex guiding session with Kyuhyuk.
Worse still, Soojung makes his intent painfully clear:
“Just sleep with me once. Let me give you the sex guiding, please.”
Sure, guiding is essential for Espers to stabilize their powers. But the idea of doing it with him sends Kyuhyuk into full panic mode.
“Wait, Soojung. I'm really not mentally prepared for this yet...”
“But sir, your erection says otherwise.”
Caught between professional ethics and personal chaos, Kyuhyuk now faces the most awkward guiding session of his life. And it’s with the one person he never expected.

title: Don't Pick Don Pig
description: Since ancient times, there have been fairies with powers of wealth, sexual desire, appetite, sleep and fame to maintain balance in the world. Among them, Baek Hwon, a money fairy who had the power of wealth and enjoyed power as the next chief of the fairy world. He is expelled and demoted to the human world for the crime of abusing his abilities to make people unhappy, and there he meets Eugene, who works day and night desperately to earn money.

title: Mr Tiger, You ate well
alt_titles: Mr Tiger, Thank you for the meal
description: In a world where carnivores are beasts, and herbivores are timid, Taejoon is a timid tiger who ends up meeting a drunk Seoyoon while working at his childhood friend’s convenience store. After an embarrassing and hot night together, Taejoon looks forward to meeting Seoyoon again. Meanwhile, Seoyoon, a lamb and model whose hobby is tormenting beasts that force him to act timid, finds himself drawn to the self-deprecating and passive Taejoon… Enjoy this cozy healing love story between Taejoon and Seoyoon as they find a sense of kinship and follow their inner nature.

title: I Want to Be an Incubus Too!
alt_titles: I Want to Be an Incubus Too!
I Want to Become an Incubus, Too!
description:
In the summer of 202X, a crisis comes for the majority of demons who have been receiving human souls and filling their mana.
As there are more devilish humans than demons, there is no need to seek help from demons even while selling their souls.
In order to overcome this employment difficulty, demons are preparing to move to a 'mongma' that can absorb energy without human consent.
It’s the same for Uffir, but it's not as easy as it sounds. In the end, a detective, Cheol-ho, appears in front of Uffir, who is trying to become a mongma by tricking him...

title: A Man Who Gives It All
alt_titles: A Man Who Gives It All
description: [Mature Audiences Only] Kang Jihan’s perfect gay life comes crashing down after drunkenly making out with Moon Heeseop, the nerdiest loser in his major. Though Jihan has sworn off dating, Heeseop begins following him everywhere, thinking their kiss has made them boyfriends. And Jihan isn’t faring any better with his casual partner of one year, Ji Jinyeong, who keeps wanting something more. With two obsessive guys begging for his love, Jihan could just cut things off with them both. If only they weren’t so packing where it counts, especially the nerd! But maybe Jihan can make a three-way work...? [via Tappytoon]

title: Make Me Cry
description: Joohan is a devout deacon with a fiery personality, actively volunteering at an orphanage. Songmi, intrigued by Joohan and attending the church out of curiosity, discovers that he, who appeared more abstinent than others, is unexpectedly getting turned on while whipping himself...

title: Dazzling Breath
description:
In a war-torn world, Espers wield incredible powers but risk going berserk, while Guides are the only ones who can calm them. Wonwoo, an awakened Guide and soldier who lost all his comrades, is suddenly swept into a parallel world through a mysterious, dense fog. There, he confronts his dying alternate self and gains a chance to live a new life. "Don't live a life filled with regret, without meaning…"
Shockingly, in this new world, all his dead comrades are alive! Wonwoo seeks them out, using his abilities to help, and in the process, comes face to face with Gye Yoon, the Ruler of the North. "It's because of those eyes. Those eyes that look exactly the same." Strangely, every time he sees Gye Yoon, someone else comes to mind…

title: Yellowtail Love
description: All Chulyong ever wanted was to sing. But dreams don’t pay rent, and now he’s stuck working part-time at a fish market, wondering when it all slipped through his fingers. One delivery gone wrong - a house, a famous composer, a bad first impression. Ruth touches him like he’s an instrument, and Chulyong, who’s had enough of life playing him, hits back - literally. A trophy to the head. A threat of a lawsuit. Words sharper than knives. Somewhere in the middle of the wreckage: a song that could change everything. Enemies. Rivals. Maybe something more. Defense carries more than just fish — it carries hope. It carries love.

title: Beta Testing
description: Jihyuk doesn’t do boyfriends, only one-night stands. So, when he’s on the prowl one night for someone to warm his bed…he gets punched in the face instead. The reason? He’s a beta and if you haven’t heard, betas aren’t exactly in demand right now. While he’s nursing his wound in the bathroom, someone falls out of one of the stalls. It is an alpha and one clearly in rut. Jihyuk is about to call the ambulance when the alpha tells him there’s only one thing he needs: a beta. Well, that can be easily arranged. But is Jihyuk prepared to get down and dirty to help the mysterious alpha? And why does the alpha look so familiar? But more importantly, will this one-night shenanigans end at that or will this force Jihyuk to break his own rules?

title: Scapegoat
description:
Haian was born an omega and lives his life diligently, working towards his small goals. However, his quiet life is disrupted when he reunites with Jeonghyun, a man tied to a sin from his past.
Jeonghyun demands that Haian work as his secretary and pay off a massive debt.
Can Haian untangle the threads of their complicated past?

title: She Is a Dragon
description:
Urban monster hunter and Her Dog, sorry I mean, Her Dragon.

A slightly unhinged Chinese urban fantasy adventure. A half-hearted project the author painstakingly “developed” over two weeks (?)

The parts that the readers think the author is slacking off on… the author is, in fact, absolutely slacking off on…

title: Sleeping Through Rain
description:
You are the distant star, streaking across the zenith of my sky.

After a failed confession in high school, Chang Le unexpectedly reunites with Song Yumian again in college, the very person she once liked. The reunion is awkward and yet tinged with quiet joy.

As they spend more time together, old feelings begin to resurface, and emotions long buried start demanding to be felt…

title: Trapped for Millions of Years: My Disciples Are All Over the Universe
alt_titles: Trapped for Millions of Years: My Disciples Are All Over the Universe
Bei Kun Bai Wan Nian: Dizi Bianbu Zhu Tian Wan Jie
description: Lu Chen, an immortal young man, was trapped in the Land of Desolation for over ten million years. After thousands of centuries of meticulous planning, he finally managed to escape... only to find a world vastly different from the one he remembered. The Old Continent had broken into countless pieces, the North and South Poles had been reversed, and the nine suns in the sky had been reduced to a single one; the oceans had sunk dozens of meters deep, huge and powerful prehistoric beasts had all but disappeared, and humans, who millions of years ago were only a small nation of tribesmen, had by now conquered the surface of the Earth. And that's not all: the mangy dog he had picked up by chance is now the leader of a sect, the little girl he had adopted out of kindness has become a fairy of a heavenly realm, and his disciple, whom he had been forced to take in, has become the Celestial Emperor.

title: The Supreme Poison Demon Becomes a Pharma Chairman
alt_titles: The Pharmaceutical Chairman is the Absolute Poison Demon
description:
300 years later… On an Earth shrouded in mana.

I was a ‘Mana Rejector’—someone for whom that very mana was a deadly poison.

Then one day, as I was waiting for death, unable to even Awaken…I connected with an identical soul from another dimension.

The soul of the Absolute Ruler of the Murim… The Absolute Poison Demon, Dang Gunak.

title: Sandwich Girl
description: Lee Jaekyung, a violent girl, just wants to live a peaceful and normal high school life. She goes to the same high school that her crush, Yu Minwoo attends, and even learned to sew and cook just for him. She finally sees him again when he gives his student body president speech, but she also finds out that the annoying playboy Sejoon Kang, is also at her school. How does Jaekyung know Sejoon? What will happen next?

title: The Fox Meets the Wolf
alt_titles: The Bear-Like Fox Meets the Wolf
description: Misunderstood in the dark, Na Na "saved" a girl from a "pervert." Now he has his eyes on her. He brought her many troubles continuously at school because he is a "hot boy" many likes. Now, Na Na is determined to get revenge, but maybe she met her match…

title: My Girlfriend Is a Wicked Lady!
alt_titles: My Girlfriend Is a Wicked Lady!
description: 【Ding… Ding.. System activated, game starts】【 If the Player taking over the capture target, points will be rewarded】… If it’s for the sake of conquering beauties, I’ll wear the golden crown; if it’s for reward points, I’ll move forward by any means…

title: God's ID
description:
Forensic medicine student Lu Lanqiao became the biggest suspect in "killing" his brother overnight. The words his brother said before his death set him on the road of escape. In order to find out who killed his brother, Lu Lanqiao and the detective who was chasing him, Fucheng, met and the relationship between the two fugitives and their pursuers gradually changed...

**Links:**
- Defunct Official English - [Bilibili Comics](https://www.bilibilicomics.com/detail/mc3397)

title: Forest Sea
description:
After a long war, the Avian Race and the Serpent Race finally signed a peace treaty.

Both races agreed to promote peace and coexistence and, as the first step, a new joint training center was established. Sa Hwa-hyeon, a long-time general of the Avian Race who made a significant contribution during the war, was going to start a new life as an instructor there.

While cadets felt great respect towards their instructor, they also distanced themselves from Sa Hwa-hyeon, who treated them with a calm but strict demeanor.

Among them, there was Yahyul, a cadet from the Serpent Race, who didn’t particularly stand out, but whose gaze followed Hwa-hyeon everywhere.

Their first meeting was a pure coincidence, but the two people started gradually becoming closer after a number of small encounters.

A light warm breeze that started to warf between them one day grew stronger as the instructor and the cadet were gradually getting closer to each other to become more than just two friends walking alongside one another…

title: Please Step on Me, My Prince!
alt_titles: Please Step on Me, My Prince!
description:
**"I want to be proposed to by a rich man! I'm confident I can work hard as a homemaker!"**

Hansol, a kindergarten teacher and aspiring perfect homemaker, is living a busy life, searching for a husband who will make him a Cinderella.

His biggest interest these days is Yushin, a single dad and a parent (of one of his students). A kind smile, a handsome face, a killer ass, sexy forearms, and even sexier, a ridiculously expensive imported car.

And that very Yushin suddenly asks Hansol on a date?! Can Hansol truly achieve the dream he has held for so long?

We thought he was an aspiring perfect homemaker, but it turns out he’s an aspiring Slave Seme, And a "reverse" Dominant Uke who is so perfect that even his demanding attitude is perfect.

A "Training the Slave Seme" rom-com!

title: The Wandering Earth
description:
Num futuro distante, cientistas descobrem que o Sol está entrando em colapso e que sua expansão inevitavelmente consumirá a Terra. Diante da extinção da humanidade, as nações do planeta abandonam todos os conflitos e unem forças em um projeto sem precedentes: transformar a própria Terra em uma nave interestelar.

Milhares de motores planetários são construídos para arrancar o planeta de sua órbita e conduzi-lo através do espaço profundo em direção a um novo sistema estelar.

Enquanto a Terra atravessa uma jornada que durará gerações, a humanidade passa a viver sob condições extremas, enfrentando catástrofes naturais, crises sociais e o peso psicológico de um futuro incerto.

Mais do que uma história sobre sobrevivência, Terra Errante retrata a fragilidade da civilização humana diante da escala implacável do universo.

title: Born Under the Calamity Star
description:
Sun Xian was born under the ominous sign of “Yinghuo,” the Calamity Star. Her life was forever marked by tragedy— Her parents, manipulated by the mysterious power known as “Imperial Throne” (帝座), committed atrocities that led to the deaths of hundreds of thousands. At just twelve years old, Sun Xian was branded a threat to humanity and imprisoned by a secret organization known as The Dark Zone. There, she was subjected to horrific experiments— altering her body and mind, and awakening within her a terrifying power: “To slay rulers and destroy thrones.” Five years later, she uncovers the truth:
The Dark Zone doesn’t protect peace. It profits from chaos, and it framed her family to cover its crimes— even driving her parents to suicide. Enraged, Sun Xian escapes.
No longer the child who was caged, she becomes the executioner, bent on vengeance.
In a simulated age of war and collapse, the girl once called a harbinger of doom will become the blade that severs corruption.

title: Love Is the Only Way to Stop You From Going Dark
alt_titles: Love Is the Only Way to Stop You From Being Corrupted
description: A high school girl ends up into a virtual game and becomes a 10 year-old girl! She finds out that her mission is to develop a romantic relationship with the prince regent who always killed her at the last stage of the game?! She needs to start gaining his affection when he's still a young, low status boy! However, look at how he despises her. This is definitely not an easy journey......

title: Fallen Angel+
description: "[Dystopian futuristic ABO] · The Godfather is hooked on his idol · This killer is too adorable · Reborn: The surrogate blood moon turned out to be myself. 'Even if your destiny is the abyss, I will fall with you.'"

title: Desire Me If You Can
description: Grayson Miller a pour objectif dans la vie de rencontrer son partenaire destiné. Un chamane lui a prédit que son âme sœur serait « quelqu’un lié au feu, avec une forte poitrine ». Plus tard, il croise par hasard un pompier oméga exceptionnel au milieu d’un incendie… et perd connaissance ! Pour retrouver cette personne, Grayson rejoint la caserne de pompiers, mais finit par s’embrouiller violemment avec le pompier Dane… et se retrouve mêlé à lui malgré tout…

title: The Youngest Keeps a Lot of Secrets
alt_titles: The Youngest Hides a Lot of Things
The Youngest Is Hiding a Lot
description:
A child-soldier mage regains memories of a past life on the battlefield—and realizes this world is a novel with a doomed, apocalyptic ending. To avert it, the plan is simple: stick to the story’s “hero” and keep him alive.

After some twists, the narrator sneaks into the duke’s household as the adopted youngest. One problem (actually three): the hero hates mages, the narrator is a deserter, and a messy mix-up has them living under a swapped-gender disguise. Now it’s constant tiptoeing to avoid being found out while plotting how to protect the hero… and somehow there’s always time for strawberry cake.

A cozy, chaos-filled tale of a secretive “maknae” with a lot to hide.

title: Shining Nananana
description: After being bullied and living as a reclusive loner addicted to gaming, she gains the courage through Chan, whom she met in a brilliant game. Could a disguise help her go outside? And on the day she went out in disguise for the first time, she couldn't even recognize the girl who used to torment her...?!From wigs, contact lenses, makeup, posture, to voice tone, she transforms her appearance and decides to go back to school. With this new look, she's confident! But the guy she ends up living with in a share house is so cold towards her! But... could that guy possibly...? Can she manage to keep her double life as "Bright" a secret?

title: Breaking Through the Calamity
alt_titles: Beginning From Passing Through the Calamity
description:
In this world, immortal cultivators have not been able to summon heavenly tribulation - a challenge one must complete to ascend to immortality. Lu Cheng, a transmigrator, has unfortunately been used by his sect master to help him ascend as he is the only one that can attract tribulations. At a dying moment, he finds himself with a system at hand, and every time he receives a tribulation, he levels up.
___
In a world where the path to immortality is broken, Lu Cheng, a cursed travellers, becomes the only person who can attract the heavenly tribulation. At the moment of death, the mysterious system is activated, Lu Cheng is determined to become stronger and change his fate, and upgrade himself by crossing the tribulation! Sun, Moon, and Death... is the end of the world? The most important thing is that the system is not only a way of life, but also a way of life. The heavenly dao slaughter mortal dust, floating life cause and effect between the fingers. A sword blade open chaos, three lives of fate and calamity to laugh! The road to immortality, starting from the sabotage!

title: Anti-Celestial Destiny
description: Wu You, who has been agonizing for 20 years, thought he would spend his whole life in a hurry, until he picked up the half fairy fairy jade in the trash can on a rainy day, and his fate was completely changed! Inherit the fairy body, the goddess as a companion, drop the demon and lay the devil, sitting on the one hundred billion! Start the counterattack!

title: The Perfect Curse
alt_titles: A Bad Example of a Perfect Curse
Perfectly Terrible Example of a Curse
description: Adrina has lived as her dead twin brother since she was eighteen. Known as the Mad Dog of Palesa Palace, she's assigned to guard Duke Julius. One problem: he should be older than her. So why does he look like a child?

title: The Royal Bridegroom
description:
“Anyone who touches this person will have to risk their neck.”  
The king's son-in-law who lost his wife before the wedding.
Due to the national law, he must remain as the royal bridegroom who can only live as a widower for life, while his two brothers-in-law become rivals in love over him.

title: Blossoms of the White Night
description: To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries’ royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom’s hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom - once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost…and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

title: The Tears of a Jester
description:
Two princesses, one throne.
Life is hard for a court jester. Not only do I serve as an emotional punching bag for the royals and aristocrats, forced to indulge their every whim, but now I'm also caught between two princesses. Is this a comedy? Or will this tale end in tragedy?

title: Princess of the Animals
description:
I'll be a voice for the animals! Though Elise is forced to live in isolation, she doesn't feel alone thanks to her ability to communicate with animals. That is until she's sent off to marry the ruler of what's known as the Land of the Barbarians! What adventures, and dangers, await Elise in this strange, new world?

Released on 2nd April.

title: Frost Will Always Fall
description: Unha is the granddaughter of a shaman, and she's next in line to become one herself. It's a fate she never asked for, but she's always known that an evil force is out there waiting to destroy her if she rejects her destiny. However, all hope is not lost, as her grandmother spoke vaguely of a person who holds the key to her survival. So when the handsome character she's only ever met in her dreams appears before her as a man named Jueon, she's almost certain he's the key. Still, Unha's fate only becomes more complicated with her old school friend Haesu reentering her life. If she and Jueon are fated, then why is her connection to Haesu so strong? Is it possible they're all connected, not just in this life, but in the past as well?

title: Red Fox
description:
From Netcomics :  
Welcome to Ibana, a beautiful country also known as the red country. Here, lives the red fox, a wily beast who takes on the form of a human and feasts on the livers of humans. For hundreds of years, the fox kills without hesitation until, thanks to one human woman, it comes to know what that human emotion called “love”, truly is. Out of the land of fire, erupts the cruel yet tragic love story of one evil spirit who yearns to possess the heart of one human woman.  
  
Official English: [NetComics](https://www.netcomics.com/comic/246), [Tappytoon](https://www.tappytoon.com/en/comics/red-fox), [Pocket Comics](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: I know your secret
description:
After she was nearly killed and then rescued, Ruan Ruan lost all her memories. Her savior, Ding Xiao, treated her with all the tenderness in the world; she completely let her guard down in the face of his perfect image. After figuring out the identity of her attacker, Ruan Ruan naively thought they were heading toward a happy ending. However, after discovering Ding Xiao's secret, her world turned upside down! With danger looming on all sides, will she continue to be the prey, or will she become the hunter?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: 4 Ways to Save Your Wife
alt_titles: Four Ways to Get a Wife
description: He posted an ad on social media for a contractual wife. She works hard to follow her family mottos everyday. Follow the story of a man who has a phobia of marriage, and suddenly fell into a contractual relationship with a strange woman who entered the interview room. How do the two of them fit into each other’s lives?

title: I Faked a Pregnancy, but My Husband Returned
alt_titles: I Faked a Pregnancy, but My Husband Returned
description:
Judith se réveille un jour pour découvrir qu’elle est devenue, du jour au lendemain, une baronne criblée de dettes suite au décès de son père – puis elle se rend compte qu’elle s’est réincarnée dans un roman qu’elle avait lu dans sa vie antérieure. Décidant de mettre à profit sa connaissance de l’intrigue originale pour rembourser ses dettes, elle entre au service de la maison du duc en tant que belle-fille sous contrat, se faisant passer pour la fausse épouse du fils disparu de la famille. Rembourser les dettes, profiter des luxes qu’elle ne pourrait jamais s’offrir dans sa vie réelle… Ce n’est que pour quelques mois, alors pourquoi ne pas en profiter au maximum ? Mais voilà que le mari, qui, dans le roman original, ne revient jamais, revient.

« Alors vous êtes ma femme. Celle qui porte mon enfant. »

title: The Scandal Maker Has Returned
description: They call Harriet Listerwell the Scandal Maker, but the reputation was carefully crafted by her cousin Bella. At an imperial banquet, another of Bella’s schemes unfolds—framing Harriet in a way which insults the handsome and formidable Duke Cedric Kailas. Disgraced, Harriet is sent to a convent. In exile, she discovers a troubling truth: Bella’s family may have been behind the death of her parents. Now Harriet is returning to the glittering society that condemned her. The Scandal Maker is back—and this time, she intends to live up to the name.

title: Osa and ghe Five Wastes
description:
A peek into the everyday life of Osa (@oreohunter)

~

[오사 (Osa) is an abbreviation of 오레오 사냥꾼 (Oreo Hunter)]

title: Adonai
description: You think you know everything about crazy Korean cults? You ain't seen nothing yet.

title: The Duke's Daughter Married the Fugitive
alt_titles: The Ducal Young Lady Had a Flash Marriage With a Fugitive
I Ran Away With My Contracted Husband
description:
The blind Duchess regained her sight—only to witness her fiancé cheating on her that very day. Determined to take revenge on the scumbag and reclaim her family title, she made a bold move at the wedding—swapping grooms and marrying the infamous, devilishly handsome fugitive instead! Thus begins the tale of a Duchess and a wanted man, where marriage comes first and love follows later. (Cr TL: Gourmet Scans)

----
The Duke's Daughter Windsor lost her parents in a car accident several years ago, and she herself was left blind. Supported by her fiancé and her younger sister—who is not related to her by blood—she somehow managed to get by day to day.

However, after secretly undergoing treatment and regaining her sight, Windsor discovers that the two have betrayed her and are plotting to take over the dukedom.

Driven into a corner, Windsor sets out to ask the person who treated her eyes for help in ruining the wedding ceremony—but she mistakenly approaches the wrong man.

That man is Theodore, the head of Blark Bank, who is currently being pursued by the police after being falsely accused of a crime by none other than Windsor’s fiancé.

With their interests aligned, Theodore proposes a contract marriage to Windsor.

How will the two of them confront and overcome the hardships ahead…?

title: 나의 일러레님!
description: 인기 작가이자 건축학과 저학년인 이명호와 그의 뮤즈이자 일러스트레이터 한나인 사이의 짧지만 눈부신 로맨스는, 두 사람이 여전히 활동을 이어가지만 이제는 연인으로서 관계를 맺게 되면서 시작된다!

title: By Chance, I Arrived With the Spring
alt_titles: By Chance, I Arrived With the Spring
description:
Educated Heiress x Blind Mortician
To corrupt her widowed sister-in-law, Song Zhimei resorts to every underhanded, disgraceful trick she can think of. But one night, she mistakenly stumbles into her sister-in-law’s secret chambers.
Behind one locked door lies her long-missing elder brother. Behind another stands a gilded cage, filled with nothing but Song Zhimei’s most cherished possessions. And the sister-in-law who has always seemed so frail now blocks her path, iron chains in hand…
In the end, who will be the real prey?

title: Just Outside Arm’s Length
description: She said she was transferring schools. From that day on, it felt as though a sudden distance had opened up between us.

title: Killing Darling Baby-Ying♡
description:
The last order of the dead boss. "Protect my daughter!"
Jason, a false killer who flew in from Mexico, starts a parenting mission in Suyu-dong, Seoul!
But is a three-year-old kid scarier than a boss?!

Eating and spitting, talking at the end, and throwing slime are basic. A devilish princess who runs out of the house and blows her panties in the face of a woman she doesn't know!

title: Orb of the Divine Water
description: This content is a brand webtoon of Bonghwa-gun, and is the story of Lee Yong-sang, the founder of 'Hwasan Lee', and his descendant Lee Jang-bal, told by Hong Writer.

title: Cartel
description: Won Do-yoon, a boy left alone in the most underdeveloped neighborhood. He was talented, but the world dragged him down. In a world where giant organizations grip and shake, we realize that the higher we go, the deeper we fall. Won Do-yoon finally chooses. The abyss instead of the top. And he stands at the center of the cartel himself and tries to bring down the huge organization.

title: Reincarnated into a Cursed Game
description: An overworked game developer dies and is reincarnated as the weakest character in the game he created himself. Challenged by Jaeseokcheon, the ruler of the game universe, he must complete a series of quests to survive and prevent a second death. Epic battles between monsters, celestial beings with magic powers, and Jaeseokcheon ensue. In this tug-of-war between the omniscient game designer and the hidden mastermind ruler… Who will win?

title: Black Pearl
description:
ヘイリーは悪魔の王の絆から自分自身を解放するために死を必要としています。
傭兵になって、彼女は世界中に散らばって遺物を収集し、多くの世界を探るが、そのうちの一つは、第一次世界大戦によってブロックされています。
結局のところ、彼女は彼女の将来の運命を決定する女の子を満たしています。..

title: Mission: Save the Hunter
alt_titles: Death Delayed for a Short Time Because of the Will
I Delayed My Death Because of a Will
Because of the Will, I Delayed My Death for a While
description:
Death delayed due to scheduling difficulties.
Chaeyoon, once a famous hero, now lives as an unknown hunter, fulfilling the odd dying wishes of ex-colleagues before he can end his own life. Haunted by the past and drawn to Jihan, a skilled hunter he meets, Chaeyoon questions whether fulfilling last wishes and finding his own solace is possible.

title: My System Is Serious
description: I’ll never stop fighting tooth and nail to safeguard humanity and all people under heaven. It’s time to power up the system once more, ramping up its capabilities to meet this crucial challenge

title: Drowsy, Bedded, Wedded
description: She thought she had met the one true love of her life; he thought he could have given her the perfect life with nothing left to be desired. But alas, fate loves to make fun of people. And after countless twists and turns in life, at the end, who was whose true love? And who would be the one to complete whose happiness? If she could, she would rather have met him a little earlier. If he could, he would rather have fallen in love with her a little sooner.

title: The White Tiger Clan's Little Fluff
alt_titles: The White Tiger Clan's Little Fluffball
The White Tiger Clan's Baby Cotton Ball
The Little Cotton Ball of the White Tiger Family
Baby Cotton Ball of the White Tiger Clan
description:
The cherished youngest daughter of the prestigious Jujak clan, Jeok Soya, is suddenly exposed as a fake.

“Strip her of her spirit core and lock her in the Cold Palace.”

Though her heart ached from her family’s cruelty and cold rejection, she endured it.
After all, she was just a wicked little fledgling who had deceived them and brought them sorrow.

“Please… get rid of that child.”

But even so, accepting death was a different matter entirely.

“What is this… little fluff ball?”

At the brink of danger, the one who saves Soya is a ferocious tiger—
No… the head of the Baekho clan.

“I think I’ll steal you, little fluff.”

Accepting his suspicious offer, Soya follows him to the land of Baekho.
She plans to live quietly, never drawing attention… but something about this clan is strange.

“Don’t worry, you’re no trouble at all. Stay here as long as you like.”

The clan head, infamous for his brutality, is unexpectedly gentle.

“Try calling me ‘Oppa,’ Soya.”
“Me too! I’m your oppa now, fluff ball!”

The young masters of the Baekho clan compete to become her older brothers.
And strangest of all—

“Our little fluff lady is just too adorable!”
“Hmph! Bet your old house didn’t have a fluff this cute, huh?”

“…Me? Cute? Not useless and dreadful?”

title: The Mouse Caught the Dragon's Tail
alt_titles: A Mouse Biting a Dragon's Tail
The Twenty-Day Mouse Biting the Dragon's Tail
description: After being thrown out into the streets at age 18, orphan Larin takes shelter at Saltator Manor and poses as a distant relative. Soon, she finds herself whisked away to the imperial palace, substituting for her adoptive sister as the emperor's new concubine. But Larin's noble disguise is not enough to hide her street rat past, and the imperial family threatens to have her killed for deceit. With the emperor vowing to protect Larin through marriage, can the pair overcome their doomed fate?

title: Poisoned Chalice: The Poisoned Princess
alt_titles: The Poisoned Goblet: The Princess Filled With Poison
The Princess of the Poisoned Chalice
description:
“If the Queen’s corpse troubles you, then just look at me, bare and waiting, Your Majesty.” 

Her husband’s mistress was a monster in human form, a woman vile enough to couple with him atop his dead wife’s coffin. Blinded by desire, he cast aside not only his wife, but the entire kingdom. 

On the brink of death, Adelaide clawed her way back, for vengeance. To destroy the man who betrayed her, she resolves to use Cadis, an innocent caught in her storm, promising herself she’ll release him once her retribution is complete. He must have mistaken her for a holy Goblet when in truth, she was a poisoned one. 

“What I fear most… is being abandoned by you. If you used me for your own ends, then at the very least you shouldn’t throw me away.”

title: Villain at Work! Is Crushing the Boss My KPI?
alt_titles: Villain at Work! Is Crushing the Boss My KPI?
! Beating Up the Boss Is My KPI?
description:
Seorang karyawan kantor modern terus-menerus disiksa oleh bosnya yang sangat menyebalkan. Namun suatu hari, setelah membuka pintu ruang kerja sang bos, ia tiba-tiba terlempar ke berbagai macam kisah fantasi yang berlatar di berbagai dunia dan era yang berbeda.

Di dunia-dunia baru ini, para NPC (karakter pendukung) semuanya menyerupai rekan kerja di kehidupan nyatanya, terutama si bos yang mengerikan itu. Namun kali ini, ia menjadi tokoh utama, sementara bosnya turun kasta menjadi serangkaian peran figuran yang lemah untuk ia hancurkan.

Dengan keadaan yang akhirnya berbalik, ia sudah lebih dari siap untuk membalaskan dendam atas semua penderitaan yang pernah dipaksakan bosnya selama ini.

title: Aching heart
description: My first love, Joo Arin, whom I met again after five years. Why has she changed so much?

title: Seonbae-wa hubae-ga aeching-i doeeodo johji ana?
description:
