Este libro es una colección de bocetos y notas ligeras sobre
“el senpai y el kouhai del club de judo”, dibujados anteriormente para la antología SUMMER SPLASH.

title: A Taste of Happiness for the Tragic Extra
alt_titles: I Became a Wretched Extra in a Healing Story
I Became a Miserable Extra in a Healing-Genre Novel
description: Once upon a time, a neglected princess died a tragic death, only to wake up as a child once more and find herself beloved by all. This is the novel Leivella wakes up in, but she’s not the princess. Instead, she’s a mere extra whose family was framed and slaughtered by the tyrannical emperor. Now serving as the princess’s food taster who tests for poison, Leivella must find a way to avoid meeting a tragic death of her own. The world may revolve around its protagonist, but the unmentioned extra might have a shot at writing her own fate!

title: A Magical Girl? I Saw in a Dream
alt_titles: A Magical Girl? I Saw in a Dream

title: You Loved Me First
description: Lie down and undo your underwear.” The cool man’s voice fell on her ears. As a famous star, Zuo Yuzu came to the hospital for a breast examination, but met the boy she had a crush on when she was young. After the examination, she pretended not to recognize him and asked: “Doctor, what is your name? Leave your contact information, I’ll contact you if anything happens.” Dr. Xi then looked up and looked at her with extremely raised eyebrows: “Miss Zuo, when you were in high school, don’t you remember who you wrote a hundred and twenty love letters to?”

title: Reborn into an Eroge World Just to Snuggle with Monster Girls
description: Monster girls are meant for snuggling! The genius game designer Luo Jia had just finished his dating sim, “Passion Continent,” when he was struck by lightning and died on the spot. With the help of a goddess, he was transported into the eroge world he designed—only to find that twenty years had already passed. The world has drastically changed; humans and monsters are now locked in a brutal slaughter, and the happy life of snuggling is a thing of the past. Luo Jia decides to completely rectify this world and transform “Passion Continent” back into the romantic utopia he originally designed.

title: The Forgotten Field
description:
I pray every dayfor this love to die.
That I may love you only until today,
and by tomorrow, may this love be dead.

-Born of an affair, the ill-fated imperial princess Thalia Roem Guirta.

She grows up twisted beneath the neglect of indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings,
and servants who look upon her with contempt.
To survive, Thalia learns to protect herself by baring her thorns at everyone who comes near.
And yet, even she becomes utterly defenseless before one man.

That man is Varkas Raedgo Seorkan, the noble young lord of the East.

A vassal of the imperial family and heir to a grand duke,
he was raised under relentless pressure to be perfect.
Shaped by discipline so harsh it bordered on abuse,
he grew up with most of his emotions long since numbed.
A man who exists solely for his family’s honor and duty.

To keep a promise made to the late empress,
he becomes engaged to Ayla, Thalia’s half-sister.

And Thalia, consumed by despair, begins to slowly break apart.

But then—

the love fated to end in her death reaches an unexpected turning point….

title: The Baby Demon King Has Too Many Dads
alt_titles: Agi Mawangnimeun Yongsa Appadeuri Neomu Gwichana
The Baby Demon King Finds the Hero Dads Way Too Annoying
The Little Demon King Is Too Bothered by Her Brave Dads
description:
Reborn into a novel as the unawakened Demon King, Tatiana is imprisoned and exploited by demons who use her power for themselves. When her captors are killed by three heroes—Duke Siegfried Orleans, Archmage Kyrios, and High Priest Cesar—she nurses her saviors back to health, and they adopt her! Now, Tatiana is determined to awaken so she can be independent... But with three protective fathers watching her every move, can this 4-year-old keep her secret long enough to become the Demon King?
___
Reborn as a weak 4-year-old demon king, I tricked three heroes into becoming my "dads" to survive. But now they’re fighting over who gets to spend time with me! Even the male lead, meant for the heroine, is obsessed. What’s going on?!

title: I Tried To Debut My Kid, But Ended Up Debuting Myself
alt_titles: I Tried To Debut My Kid, But Ended Up Debuting Myself
Nae Saekki Debut-Sikiryoda Naega Debut-Hage Saenggim
description:
Yoon Hyesung is just your average office worker — but in her heart, she’s the number-one fan of Na Yeonwoo, a trainee who keeps getting this close to debuting before every opportunity falls through. 

After yet another failed debut, Hyesung has a full-on meltdown in her room, bawling about the unfair system and her own helplessness.  But when she wakes up, she finds herself in a mysterious space with a strange window popping up: 

[Would you like to accept a reality where your dreams come true?] 

This must be one of those setups, right? but after a brief internal panic, Hyesung makes up her mind.

title: DIEZ MIL INTENTOS DE ASESINAR AL LÍDER DE LA SECTA
description: En un mundo donde coexisten humanos y demonios, Li Chenxiao fundó por sí mismo la Secta Xuanqing, poniendo fin a siglos de conflictos. Pero bajo esa aparente calma, bullía el descontento y la humillación de la raza demoníaca. Qing li, un joven demonio, se infiltró llevando consigo las esperanzas de su pueblo, ocultándose junto a Li Chenxiao, el líder de la Secta Xuanqing, para buscar la oportunidad de as3s*narlo. Así comenzó su doble vida como asistente del líder, trabajando durante el día y tramando un asesinato en secreto, lo que desencadenó una serie de historias disparatadas y divertidas…

title: His Prey
description:
Extreme survival, where both are each other's prey.

Karl, the illegitimate son of a nobleman, suffers from a bizarre and mysterious illness. Only through torture, near-death experiences, and bloodshed can he find pleasure and the means to survive. Under the guise of developing a deserted island, his older brother secretly builds a hunting ground filled with death row inmates for him.

Meanwhile, Dessa, a member of the King's Royal Guard, infiltrates this island of death in disguise to search for his missing younger brother. From mutual probing to forbidden entanglement, the two find their emotions and logic constantly torn apart as an ultimate game between hunter and prey begins...

title: The Fox Club
description: Meet Sangmok High’s Fox Club, home to the prettiest, wealthiest, and most popular girls in school. To ordinary Onyu Park, whose most extraordinary trait is being best friends with the gorgeous Chaeri Shin, the Foxes exist in a whole other world – or so she thinks – until she and Chaeri are suddenly thrown into the Fox Club headfirst! As if adjusting to high school wasn’t hard enough, the girls find themselves surrounded by prying eyes, rumors, catty schemes, and budding romance. Will Onyu and Chaeri’s friendship survive all of the drama and secrets? Who are the Foxes, really? And does Onyu have what it takes to become one of them?

title: This Emperor Commits Marriage Fraud
alt_titles: This Emperor Runs a Marriage Scam
description:
After adapting to the novel world, I possessed with my insane survival skills, a strange little kid suddenly appeared in my life. Even though I could barely make ends meet, I couldn’t ignore his cute eyes, so I took care of him lovingly.

“I’m going to marry you, noona. Please sign the marriage registration.”

“Later, later~ If you still feel the same when you grow up, then I’ll write your name.”

Minors can’t even register, so I just signed it playfully… but the marriage actually got registered?!

And on top of that… the little kid I raised is actually the emperor?!

I ended up marrying him after being fooled by the scheming male lead in disguise!

title: Little Did We Know
alt_titles: Things I Didn't Know Because It Was the First Time
Things I Didn't Know the First Time
Things I Didn't Know at First
description:
After losing critical memories, and discovering her husband’s betrayal through newspaper headlines, a woman divorces him to start anew as a clockmaker. But when the estranged man returns, insisting "If you hate me coming, then come back instead," their fragile dance begins: Can love rewrite the past when trust is broken?
___
When a shady police inquiry causes Scarlet Crimson to have a mysterious memory lapse and unknowingly betray her cold and distant husband, Victor Dumfeldt, their fragile marriage shatters in divorce. To start anew, she returns to her family’s watchmaking trade to rebuild her life and her parents' legacy. But when Victor reenters her life, Scarlet starts to wonder if what was broken can be repaired. Between memories lost and words unspoken, can they learn from what they didn’t know the first time?

title: Broadcast Genius, Youngest Writer
description: After losing both her job and her work due to the schemes of the PD she worked with, Yeonwoo learns the truth and faces death from a heart attack. She thought her life was ending there, but when she opens her eyes, she finds herself back to her youngest writer days 20 years ago. Can this second chance at life turn into a successful one unlike before? The story of Yeonwoo, the youngest writer in broadcasting with a career-oriented perspective, begins anew.

title: First Time for Everything
alt_titles: My First Time as a Mother
Because It's Also Mom's First Time
It's My First Time Being a Mother Again
It's My First Time Being a Mom Again
description:
Katelyn Grint has spent her whole life pining for a man who's in love with her best friend. But a chance encounter with Terius Hert, the no-nonsense and infuriatingly attractive commander of her brother's order of knights, turns her world upside down. What was supposed to be a one-time mistake quickly becomes something much more complicated... and permanent. Katelyn is about to discover that not everyone is who they appear to be—and that some firsts lead to the most unexpected beginnings.
____
"Please place your seal here, Lady Grint."

"No!"

"Don’t make this harder than it needs to be. Just do it." 

"I said no! Why on earth would I marry you?"

"Then who would you marry, my lady?"

At a distance close enough to feel each other’s breath, Therious Hurt gently raised his index finger and began tracing soft circles over my flat belly. My body stiffened at the strange, indescribable sensation.

"My child is right here. Who do you think you’re marrying if not me?" 

I got dumped by the man I’d loved for 10 years, and in a fit of anger... I slept with his superior!
It was fine up to that point, but what am I supposed to do now?!

title: The Duke's Fluffy Secret
alt_titles: The Secret of the Wolf Duke
description:
To maintain his "secret," Alto only engages in dry sex, even after marrying Viviana. Viviana, deeply distressed by this and having only experienced self-pleasure, regresses in time, determined never to marry Alto in this lifetime.

Unaware of her regression, Alto, wanting to curb her somewhat emotional behavior, promises to work towards a harmonious sexual relationship...
___
Viviana Lorentz, the Duchess of House Fortuna, becomes utterly displeased with her far-too-rigid husband, Alto Fortuna, the duke who rarely entertains her at night. When she finally snaps and clashes with him, she ends up tumbling back in time, exactly a month before their destined marriage. Determined to escape the marriage this time, Viviana requests to call it off, only to be taken aback by Alto's firm refusal. As a final measure, Viviana decides to make a rather lustful "deal" with her current fiancé, not realizing she will end up facing his unexpected secret.

title: The Top 100 Young Lady
description: A hundred women reincarnated in an otome game choose camaraderie over cutthroat competition—until life-changing rewards (massive cash + handsome leads) are announced. Now, their "let’s all relax in this fantasy world" pact shatters into a chaotic battle for first place. Will friendship survive when real-world temptations loom?

title: Wolf Groom
description:
A sweet and cheerful first-love story featuring a possessive and incredibly devoted male lead named Hwan, who is only sweet to his woman, and a cute, innocent female lead named Yeon. Based on the original work by Park Jojo.

Yeon, a wolf beast-kin abandoned by her pack, begins an accidental cohabitation with Hwan, a wandering wolf beast-kin she meets while trying to stand on her own. As she's swept off her feet by Hwan's daring romantic advances, she once again clashes with the pack that abandoned her, threatening their newfound happiness.

Can Hwan and Yeon resolve this crisis and find happiness together?
___
After being cast out from her wolf pack, Yeon resolves to survive on her own, but a chance encounter leads her to share a hut with a handsome young human named Hwan. Against all reason, Yeon finds herself drawn to the dashing human male, but it turns out... he’s a wolf, too?!

title: Blind Heart 99%
description:
Twenty-year-old Jenna Shin has the ability to read how much others like her.
But the more she learns about people's true feelings, the deeper her distrust grows...

Until one day, a man appears who shows an unusually high level of affection toward her.

(Source: DAYcomics)

title: God of Games: The Ultimate Evolution
alt_titles: Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything (Remake)
description: Betrayed by a subordinate, he lost his status, his sister, and was left with only a broken body. After being reborn, watch how he uses a game to complete his revenge!

title: Martina Will Tame the Heroes
description: Princess Martina of the Moran Empire met her fitting end as everyone expected, losing everything from her throne to her precious daughter Lily, a sacred guardian beast key to the empire's power. Reborn with a second chance, this former villainess faces an impossible quest: collecting kisses from heroes across her realm to protect everything she holds dear. But these heroes have their own agenda, asking to become the father of her child. Between plotting revenge and navigating messy romance, this bloodthirsty princess will stop at nothing for her daughter and revenge.

title: Teasing With Your Jade Fingers
description:
Shen Qingshuang is celebrated as the “Guanyin” of a prestigious family, yet she is also trapped like a beast within the house's inner chambers.

Mu Yunzhao is the “Rakshasa” of a famed military family, and a solitary wolf roaming the capital.

One despises the Rakshasa’s defiance of all norms while the other loathes the Guanyin’s arrogance and rigid propriety. Yet neither knows that, in her dreams, the Guanyin longs only to tear away silken robes, burn down discipline and doctrine, and fall into the abyss with her. Or that deep in her heart, the Rakshasa insists on laying snares, tempting sacred chants, binding her in a passion that ends only in death.
In the end, Will it be the Guanyin who subdues the Rakshasa, or the Rakshasa who ensnares the Guanyin?
The answer was already written in that late spring of their first meeting, when the Rakshasa grasped the reins, and the Guanyin struck a discordant tune.

title: Mortis's Friendship Plan ♪ Plan H
description:
Ave Mujica has once again run into a breakup crisis.
Mortis will use her intelligence to resolve the situation.
Where will Ave Mujica go in the future?

Mutsumi says she has no opinion.

title: A Witch's Fairy Tale
description:
A self-made continuation of the Witch PA from the previous event... 
It's about Witch Saki who finds a puppy and takes care of her, until her heat cycle is discovered~

title: In My Death, I Became My Brother's Regret
alt_titles: Si Hou Wo Chengle Gege De Zhusha Zhi
Sǐ Hòu Wǒ Chéngle Gēgē De Zhūshā Zhì
description: The half-demon, Jingmo, was killed by his older brother Jue Ming when his demonic energy lost control. He found himself in the body of a young man named "Bai Zhu", and this body seemed... abnormal. Due to suspicious circumstances revolving around the disappearance of Jingmo's body, Jueming kept an eye on Jingmo, who desperately hid his true identity. With one of them hiding a secret and the other looking for the truth, the pair landed in the middle of a life-or-death struggle that came with being "Bai Zhu"...

title: Ring
alt_titles: Ring - The History of Two Angels
description: A sweet story between a little angel and a big angel~

title: Scissor Seven Bonus Chapters — The Legend of the Xuanwu Heroes: The Short Swordsman
alt_titles: Scissor Seven Bonus Chapters — The Legend of the Xuanwu Heroes: The Short Swordsman
description: Manhua especial para celebrar el octavo aniversario de Scissor Seven.

title: I'm Only Embarrassed in Front of You
description:
A girl named Dana, who grew up on an island, loses the bucket list notebook she wrote while looking forward to her first school experiences.
The one who finds that notebook for her is Cheon Sehwa, a somewhat secretive boy in her class.
Dana approaches Sehwa, showing her interest in him, but Sehwa finds Dana’s attention overwhelming.
Yet the more he’s with her, the redder his cheeks get, and the tighter and more uncomfortable his chest feels.
But somehow… Sehwa doesn’t really dislike it.

title: Hūhuàn Shàonǚ
description:
Ye Xi is as ordinary as a girl can get. No matter what she tries, she’s never the worst at it—but she’s never the best, either. She’s practically invisible, completely unnoticed… until she meets Li Zhao.

Li Zhao has her own goal: she wants to become a top fashion designer. Since she was little, every step she’s taken has brought her closer to that dream.

This is the story of a group of girls brought together by fashion, who are all chasing their dreams. Along the way, there are occasional lighthearted, silly everyday moments thrown in!

title: Eating Me Is Not Allowed!
description: Nam Haesul, who is handsome but famous for his dog-like personality, is only nice to his childhood friend, Yang Miru. "It's clear that he's nice to me because he likes me!" But is it really like that? Miru has no idea about Haesul’s true feelings. Then one day, she finds out about the 'black heart' that Haesul harbors! Cracks are starting to appear in their 10-year friendship...! The wild growth story of a wolf boy and an innocent girl!

title: Let Loose
description: Jacqueline es una joven que  tuvo que sobrevivir en una tierra olvidada, en el límite entre naciones. Su mundo entero se reducía a una sola persona: su hermano menor.  Pero un día, en el instante en que su hermano despierta como una "Bestia especial", Jacqueline se ve forzada a entregarla al estado bajo el pretexto de protejerlo. Habiendo perdido todo, se vio abrumada por una nueva carga impuesta por Margo,  la misma persona que se llevó a su hermana y que había sido tutora Demi; una joven y misteriosa híbrida de ave y humana. Con el paso del tiempo, Demi y Jacqueline vuelven a encontrarse, con si el destino lo hubiera dispuesto así.

title: Beheader
description: How will Jack, who wants to pursue Father Joshua, conquer the man he loves?

title: Cure By Tissue
description: I wasn't being bullied, just isolated. That's all.

title: Answer Me, Please
description:
I can't escape his piercing blue eyes...

Soon to be wed, Princess Rosetta embarks on the final journey of her freedom. During the trip the party are saved by a strange woman. But when it turns out her injured savior is also due to be wed, Rosetta volunteers to help the ceremony proceed. Little does she know her world is about to change.

title: I Got Possessed into an Unknown Manhwa
alt_titles: I Got Possessed into an Unknown Manhwa
description:
'Amor descontrolado',
Un manga de comedia romántica japonesa enormemente popular con más de 10 millones de copias vendidas.
Estaba poseído como Kim Yoo-sung, un extra que no tiene mucho protagonismo en ese cómic que nunca había visto antes.

Pero este tipo, 
Resulta que eres un auténtico otaku que incluso hace cosplay, ¿no?
Para una vida cómoda libre de dudas 
Dominaré todo tipo de narices del amor y haré de extra otaku.

¿Pero por qué se activa el cliché de la heroína cuando estoy contigo?
Y no solo uno—esto sería problemático, ¿verdad?

title: I Became the Supreme Martial God by Dream Reincarnation
alt_titles: I Became the Supreme Martial God by Dream Reincarnation
description: A repeating dream causes a bizarre drop in Chen Mu's Qi and blood. After falling severely weak, he is cruelly expelled. Having endured a month of suffering, he finally explodes with rage!!! When the dream returns and the familiar Blood Crow swoops down at him, Chen Mu throws a furious punch. In that life-or-death crisis!!! he suddenly awakens a power that only the most supreme martial artists

title: Two Worlds: I Have an Ancient Martial Arts World
alt_titles: Two Worlds: I Have an Ancient Martial Arts World
description:
In the era of the resurgence of 'Qi' energy and the spread of monsters, the environment of humanity deteriorated catastrophically, leaving humans forced to hide and live inside fortified cities and isolated bases.

Han Lin, a student in the final year of high school in one of these cities, was doing his best in training in preparation for the 'College Entrance Examination'. In this world, universities are classified into:

Tier 1 universities for the 'Immortal Gate',

Tier 2 universities for the 'Divine Sect',

Tier 3 universities for the 'Dao Academy'.

Han Lin's ambition was initially modest, as he focused his choices on enrolling in one of the 36 universities belonging to the Divine Sect... but everything turned upside down when he discovered his ability to move to the world of High Martial Arts. From here, his ambitions and university goals began to take a completely different path."

title: Becoming Necromancer God Through a Skeleton Clone
alt_titles: Becoming Necromancer God Through a Skeleton Clone
description: The main character awakens the useless class "Necromancer" — but gains a skeleton clone in the underworld. Using this skeleton clone to kill monsters and level up in the underworld, he feeds the power back to his main body, continuously growing stronger. This is not limited to satisfying the feeling of pleasant growth for a character who depends on cultivation, but also takes advantage of information asymmetry to repeatedly create opportunities for "playing the fool to crush the strong." From a single skeleton, he embarks on the road to godhood.

title: Kill Me, Love Me
description:
Qianyue, a downtrodden woman beaten down by life, was on the verge of leaping from her balcony when her coworker Lin Che—someone she barely knows—suddenly appeared. Massive, inhuman, black hands dragged her back to reality. 

"Let's make a deal about life and death," he said. And before she knew it, Qianyue had stepped into Lin Che's sweet trap, falling deeper and deeper with every step... until she finally uncovers his dark intentions.

title: Dream Master
description: A strange illness known as Dream Syndrome is spreading through the city. Those afflicted fall into various dreams and cannot wake up. To save these patients, a new profession has quietly emerged, known as the Dream Masters.

title: So, who killed my wife ?
description:
To think the wife I thought was ordinary turned out to be a killer ?!

One day, upon discovering his wife's affair, 'Iman' becomes convinced that she is trying to kill him and decides to kill her first.

However, right before his eyes, Iman witnesses his wife being murdered by an unknown man, and simultaneously finds himself the target of assassins...

Enter 'Cinephile', a killer hired to protect Iman.

To survive, and to uncover the truth about his 'real' wife, he must find the culprit who killed her !

A spectacular assassin-action revenge drama featuring this newly formed duo !

title: Goodbye, Iveta
description: Under the starry sky, a young Iveta asks questions of the stars. Two civilizations that were meant to always stay separate meet, and transcending time, search to find their own answers...

title: Amongst the Tainted
description: Blessed be the devout who remain chaste among the tainted. A pious young debutante of the Kingdom of Brandt, Elke Eberhardt prays each day as she vies for the sacred title of Pontifex, which grants authority over the nation’s faith. Unfortunately for Elke, fate has other, crueler plans—as she catches the eye of Sir Reiner Mikhel, a notorious womanizer who has seduced countless noblewomen in Brandt. Despite her firm resolve to remain virtuous, Elke finds herself increasingly drawn to the temptations of this dark, ambitious nobleman, whose seductive gaze conceals his true intentions.

title: Castaway Marriage
description:
Burned out from work, Yeonseul’s long-awaited vacation takes a disastrous turn when she finds herself stranded on an island. Her only company? A maddeningly handsome stranger, infuriating as he is irresistible–but with survival forcing them together, sparks fly and an impulsive marriage marked by a night neither can forget transforms their relationship into something rather intimate. But as rescue brings an end to their rendezvous, Yeonseul reluctantly resigns herself to the end of her castaway romance–except her island husband doesn’t want to, their love story far from over.

----
*Note: The English adaptation is R15. The original work is R19.*

title: The Proxy of Yama
description:
Don't think that mediocre men have no spring time.   
A little gangster that takes protection fees in front of the school entrance strangely became the highest administrator of hell. Now, things are getting interesting. Being King Yama, fighting the heavens, reforming hell's system, and leading ghosts to resist the oppression by the gods of heaven… Finally, I'm at the highest position within the heavens and hell.  
Mwahaha…

title: Love Makes You Dumb
description: Serin, a cold and chic girl who keeps everyone at arm’s length, and Jinhyeong, an ordinary college student. In front of others, they seem perfectly normal—but when they’re together, they turn into complete fools.

title: I Saved the Whole Sect by Playing Badly
alt_titles: I Saved the Whole Sect by Playing Badly
The Junior Sister Is Obviously Super Strong, yet She Is So Dense
description: "Well then, I choose to be rotten bad!" Transmigrating into a book, Ye Qiao wanted to escape the fate of the cannon fodder* side female character, she left the mountain to join the new sect. Unexpectedly, she was not only taken as a direct disciple, but she was also given four Senior Brothers who doted her to no end. From then on, Ye Qiao decided to take the Senior Brothers away from the original female lead, and would go against the Heavens' will to change their fates!

title: Sweeten The Deal: Believe In Love
alt_titles: Sweeten The Deal: Believe In Love
One-Sided Love Rendezvous: Believe in Love

title: The Mighty Master is Crazy About me
alt_titles: Beware of the Strongest Man Who Is Crazy About Me
description: For her sister's happiness and happy ending, Charlotte decides to bring home the knight who holds her sister's heart. However, that means getting to the Black Dragon Order, where the mysterious Archduke Ludovika lurks. With rumors of the archduke's penchant for men, Charlotte dons a wig and becomes Charcharl, a new squire of the order! Despite trying to lay low, she keeps drawing the archduke's eye and suspicions. Can Charcharl keep up the act till the end, or will her cover get blown?

title: Days of Our Love
description: Nahee is sent to bring food to Hyunjin, the chaebol heir just back from England. She dreads seeing the boy she used to roughhouse with, yet feels sorry for how lonely his glittering penthouse seems—until he corners her and blurts, “How can I see you as just a friend when you’re so damn pretty?”

title: The Fateful Invitation
description: After Hillaria sees a future where her beloved nation is burned down to ashes just because she refused the emperor’s proposal, she accepts an invitation to the imperial palace with a mission to change this grim future and prevent the fall of her home country. How will the story unfold for Hillaria and her unique powers?

title: Bocchi the Rock! - Because Cigarettes are Harmful to Your Body (Doujinshi)
One Day I Became a Hatchling
alt_titles: One Day I Became a Hatchling
description:
“What the heck? Why is my body so tiny and chubby?!!”
A 999-year-old imugi, only one year away from ascension, is unjustly killed. When they open their eyes again, they have become a one-year-old hatchling.
With all the memories of their past life intact, their second life begins. Experiencing unconditional love for the first time, they slowly—and then completely—melt into it.
Surrounded by love, making companions, and expanding their world, the hatchling Rune begins a second life on the path toward becoming the dragon they could not become in their previous life!

title: Vigilante Part 2
description: After graduating from the police academy and being commissioned as an Inspector, Jiyong investigates the suspicious complainant Hwang Seong-gu and encounters a nationwide rental scam case. As Jiyong pursues the rental scam gang that evades proper legal judgment, he feels his vigilante rules being tested. And in the meantime, the four vigilantes involved receive threats from someone aware of their identities. They begin to sense the shadow of a great evil behind their adversaries.

title: The Sea of Falling Ash
description:
[Insecure Younger Top x Psycho Pretty Bottom]

Following the abrupt loss of his family, Yu Haemin suddenly develops a hearing impairment, making him unable to play the piano and ultimately leading him to give up on going to college.

While listening to someone's unfinished track found on an old laptop, Haemin hears a scream from the apartment above. Drawn upstairs, he ends up saving Shin Jaeyeon, who was in the middle of being physically assaulted.

As the two slowly grow closer after the incident, they realize just how similar their obsession with music and sudden death of their parents are, sparking an inexplicable mutual attraction…

title: Senior Brother Lee Hoe
description: Lee Hoo n'a jamais été un héros. Sans talent et ignoré, le frère martial aîné du clan Seongui a passé sa vie à cuisiner, nettoyer et se sacrifier pour les autres, pour finalement mourir impuissant des mains du Culte du Sang. Mais lorsqu'il ouvre les yeux dans le passé, il jure de vivre différemment cette fois-ci. Plus de regrets. Plus de sacrifices. Et il est hors de question de continuer à jouer les imbéciles pour les autres. Pourtant, d'une manière ou d'une autre, la vie qu'il voulait lui échappe complètement. Les arts martiaux qui le rejetaient autrefois se plient désormais sans effort à sa volonté. Des maîtres légendaires le qualifient de génie hors du commun, et le Murim commence à tourner autour de l'homme qui était autrefois considéré comme sans valeur. L'histoire d'une seconde chance commence.

title: Mid-Out
description:
Now that the monster extermination squad ‘Sretu’ has disappeared… humans have become prey to monsters. The reason is because an operator applicant named ‘Ian’ killed all the soldiers.

‘Jin Cheongdo,’ who has lived his whole life under constant threat of death, uses the legendary item ‘Mid-Out’ to travel back to the past in order to kill Ian, the one who massacred Sretu…

title: Daily Jojo
description:
Eunjo is an ordinary office worker who lives by the personal mantra, “There’s always tomorrow!” She’s lazy, messy, and clueless when it comes to looking presentable. Her colleague Wan Jo is the polar opposite. He’s religious about self-care, and particular about his carefully constructed image. But they both have something in common: they’re constantly at war with their past and future selves. 

(Source: Naver WebToon)

title: I Dare You
description: Sarang Yu, a second-year in high school, has never really fit in. She isn’t exactly bullied, but her classmates keep singling her out, even pushing the dares from their humiliation games onto her. No one says it out loud, but everyone senses something seriously off about her as the games take on a darker, more unsettling edge. Will these games help Sarang finally find acceptance among her peers, or will the escalating dares reveal the twisted side everyone suspects is already there?

title: The Unlikely Imprint of the Villainess and the Male Lead
alt_titles: I'm the Villainess, but I Imprinted With the Male Lead
I'm a Villainess, but I Imprinted With the Male Lead
I'm the Villainess, but I Bonded with the Male Lead
I'm the Villainess, but I Got Marked by the Male Lead
Marked by the Male Lead, Even as the Villainess
She's a Villain, but She Imprinted Herself With the Male Lead
description:
After accidentally spending the night with the story’s male lead, she tries to run away and let the original plot unfold. But fate has other plans as their last night entanglement left them spiritually bonded as one. Now trapped in a connection she never wanted, she must fight destiny itself to untangle their intertwined souls.
___
I accidentally spent a night with a stranger. And it was the male lead! 

I've tried so hard to live differently from the original! Even though things have turned out this way, the fact that the male and female leads had to be connected remained unchanged. Luciana tried to run away, no, to let it be a one-night stand, leaving Licht behind. 

"That's impossible."
"...Huh?" 
"Because last night, Young-Ae and I were imprinted on each other." 

Oh my. Her soul was already bound to the male lead, as if they were one body.

title: What's With Your Taste?
description:
Sooyoung, a firm believer in no premarital sex, is a young master from a wealthy family, a so-called third-generation chaebol. Despite facing various risky situations growing up, Sooyoung fiercely protected his beliefs. Then one day, upon returning to Korea, he falls in love at first sight with Hajun, whom he randomly meets at a  party.
He never intended for it to happen, but before realizing it, Sooyoung had suddenly given away his "first time" to Hajun. 
Like a true virgin, Sooyoung was already dreaming of a whole life with Hajun, from dating, getting married, and even having children. But the next morning, he wakes up to an empty spot beside him in bed.
So, Sooyoung tracks him down and, right in front of the university gates, boldly shouts… 
"You took my first time, so now take responsibility!”
But to his surprise, Hajun flatly rejects him, stating that chaebols simply aren't his taste. Not into rich guys? Seriously, what’s with his taste?!?!

title: The Cold-Blooded Warrior
description:
Han Jaewoo is a sweat in the world-famous game "Savior Of Humanity."

Once a hardcore player, now drowning in debt in his tiny room.

His long-awaited showdown with a demon lord ends in an unexpected failure.

The debt collectors are closing in... and all that's left to him are despair and stubborn grit.

That's when Aquila, the administrator, appears with an offer:

"Don't you want to see it? The true happy ending of this game..."

With a prize of 25 million dollars on the line, and the path to the true ending finally revealed, he accepts it.

However, there's a catch:

He's thrown back into the game world with all his stats reduced to rock bottom.

"Thanks for the 'realism,' Aquila... Screw it. I'm clearing this damn thing!"

title: Got Dropped into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work
alt_titles: Got Dropped into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work
Even if I fall into a ghost story, I still have to go to work
description:
I sacrificed my precious vacation to attend a pop-up event of “a certain modern fantasy” I loved so much.

And on that very day, I got transported into that fantasy world.
As none other than a newly hired employee at a renowned major corporation!

A dream workplace with tons of benefits, a high salary, and kind, competent supervisors.

Using my knowledge of the world, I quickly climb the corporate ladder!

But am I happy, you ask?

Please, let me go back home.

title: Salvation, About Its Cruelty
description:
"Commoner girl."

Olivia could never get used to those loathsome words.

Her titles, such as "first female university student’" and "valedictorian," were meaningless. Then one day, the Herod Royal Family presented her with Noah Astrid, the "Flower of the Royal Family." Though it seemed to be a flower full of poison, she had no choice but to take it. 

And she couldn’t help but love this flower, the first she had ever held.

Because it was like salvation.

title: Atonement, for Your Cruelty
description:
From the moment she set foot on a strange continent, Seo-Ah wasn't given a moment to rest. With a single "key" in her hand, her life is thrown into endless pursuit and threats. And the man who desperately desires that key is Oscar Reichinhardt. Notorious for his coldness and cruelty, the man was wary of Seo-Ah from the start, but at some point, his gaze begins to subtly change. A relationship where they must use each other to survive. However, as time passes while they are together, hatred and obsession transform into an inexplicable attraction.

A dangerous contract, an uncomfortable cohabitation. Political conspiracies that could explode at any moment, and forbidden feelings slowly spreading. The shadow of another person casts over the two, shaking their hearts even more.

Questions deepen as they approach the hidden truth, and an inescapable, fatal allure. At the end where hatred and love, atonement and betrayal are intertwined, who will truly survive?

title: I Became the Cheating Partner of a Trash Duke
alt_titles: I Became the Trashy Duke's Affair Partner
I Became the Mistress of a Despicable Duke
description:
“I need you to have an affair with me.”

To break off his forced engagement with the princess, the wealthy Duke Leopold Otero von Bern stages a perfect affair scam.

Violetta Hernandez is a fallen noble who became an affair consultant after all her previous lovers cheated on her for that very same princess. She barely manages to make a living on consultation fees from her clients. But one day, she receives a a notice to repay a massive family debt and finds herself in a desperate situation where she must urgently raise tuition for her younger brother…

“Tuition? I’ll cover your brother’s future too.”

“What about my future? Once I’m branded as a mistress, marriage is a fantasy.”

All she had ever dreamed of was a loving marriage—just enough to eat and live happily. Is becoming his “mistress” really the answer?

“I’ll make sure we don’t get caught. Just leave enough traces… something the princess will completely misunderstand.”

And so begins the affair scam. The man who promised to only pretend to cheat keeps crossing the line.

“You really think this flimsy evidence will convince anyone?”   
“I came to get my money’s worth.”  
“Show some sincerity, even if it means leaving a mark.”

…Looks like she's gotten tangled up with the wrong guy.

title: Drowning Sorrows in Raging Fire
description:
"Qi Zheng Emperor Sheng Lingyuan was reawakened a thousand years later after he jumped off the fiery Red Lake.

Xuan Ji, a newly transferred staff to the Reparations Division of the Deviant Control Office, finds himself having to clean up the mess of a revived tyrannical monarch.

The two seemed to share something from the past, but unbeknownst to them, a big conspiracy is stirring right underneath their noses that could destroy the balance of the world."

title: First Love Makeover Log
description:
Haejin and Kihyuk met at the same Taekwondo dojang when they were young. At one time, the two had been quite close, but as they went their respective paths in life, they became more distant, no better than strangers now.

In truth, from the days they went to taekwondo together, and even now, Haejin had always looked up to Kihyuk. And finally at the start of the 1st year of high school, the two reunite, now attending the same school, in the same class. However, his anticipation is hopelessly shattered when Kihyuk appears, looking by all means like a total trainwreck.

Still Haejin's feelings for Kihyuk refuses to fade, rather sparking his obsessive and control-freak side. Haejin vows to restore the object of his admiration to his former glory. So begins the inexplicable crackdown - Haejin's great Kihyuk makeover project.

title: All People Fled the Famine, and My Items Can be Upgraded
alt_titles: All People Fled the Famine, and My Items Can be Upgraded
Quanmin Taohuang, Wo de Wupin Neng Shengji
description: Traveling to the end of the world full of strange beasts, he was output by the drought demon riding his face at the beginning, and he also had two female oil bottles, one big and one small, by his side…… The sky collapsed? Ten deaths without life? No, watch me

title: Husband Thief
description:
Claycie, who must marry to inherit her fortune, repeatedly loses her chance at romance due to the interference of her niece, Meren, who is nearly the same age. Eventually, Claycie meets a man like a stroke of fate and marries him after finding true love. However, during their happy newlywed life, a jealous Meren travels back in time. In this new life, Meren goes as far as stealing Claycie's husband. Claycie, who had always been pushed around by Meren, declares that if Meren steals her husband, she will steal Meren's husband in return!

Having swapped husbands after the regression, a bitter love square begins, fueled by sharp psychological warfare between an aunt and niece who know each other all too well.

title: Girl's Baduk
description:
On a Go board as vast as the sea or the stars, a determined girl returns to the game to reclaim something precious she lost. 

With a quiet boy who shares her unspoken longing, each placed stone tests memory, resolve, and skill. 

A gentle, competitive coming-of-age where every move opens a new path forward.

title: Joker Danny
description: In a small town in the countryside lives a boy named Danny, an orphan with a tear-shaped birthmark. While the town is peaceful, there are rumors of a plague spreading in the outside world, which turns people into flower petals…

title: Solo Slime's Ascension
description: Reencarnei em outro mundo, mas acabei me tornando a criatura mais fraca que existe... Um slime! Alimentando-me de tudo, desde madeira podre até dragões poderosos, um dia chegarei ao topo e dominarei este mundo!

title: This Sweet Online Date Is a Disaster
alt_titles: Sweet Online Dating Has Been Overturned?!
description: I was helping my sister win the heart of the game's top-ranked player, but it turned out to be a total disaster! I was even ridiculed by that gaming master!!! I guess no one can defy Murphy's Law! Just as the game was loading... Ding! Notice: Your husband is now online!

title: Caregiving Alliance
description:
[Sunshine Person] [Youngest Daughter of a Prestigious Family] [A Pampered Child]

Juwon enjoys a popular campus life, having earned nicknames like the ones above thanks to her gentle, cheerful personality and adorably attractive appearance that anyone would find likable.

But the reality is the complete opposite.

Every evening at sunset, the place she heads to is a nursing hospital on the outskirts of the city.

There, a mother waiting for death and an ill-tempered daughter caring for that mother spend their days.

Juwon is living an exhausting double life to fulfill her mother's final wish: to be surrounded by lots of people.

Meanwhile, unlike Juwon, Hangyeol is living the life of an outsider after returning to university.

Despite his handsome looks, his intimidating aura and taciturn personality make it difficult for anyone to approach him, leaving him to endure a lonely college life.

Then one day, the two meet in a hospital room.

And not just under ordinary circumstances.

Han-gyeol appears as a magical girl, wearing a loud, tight-fitting pink character T-shirt, her hair in pigtails, adorned with colorful hair clips, and even holding a magic wand.

Like Juwon, Hangyeol is also caring for a sick younger sibling.

The moment they discover each other's secrets, the two form a caregiving alliance.

Thus begins their precarious double life—a campus-and-caregiving story shared by two secret caretakers!

title: miHoYo – Honkai Gakuen 2 - Red Dance Fantasy
Mumumu
description: The Heavenly Demon, born once every ten thousand years. Two geniuses born in the same era. Who among them is truly the Heavenly Demon? And are these two allies or enemies? The progenitor of authentic traditional martial arts!

title: Husband, the Emperor's Position Is Mine!
description: Chu Xi, the female emperor of a matriarchal nation, died from overwork and transmigrated into a patriarchal world. In a chance encounter, she met Xie Yi, a frail and sickly prince. Intending to kidnap the beauty, the two became acquainted. However, Chu Xi had always refused to surrender to fate and certainly didn’t plan on just going with the flow. What was the point of becoming a princess consort or empress? Doesn't opening her own harem sound better?

title: Janggun's Butcher Shop
description: A shopping district is under crises because of some local goons who runs a butcher shop is threatening other shops to do business only with them...But the scenario changes with the arrival of this mysterious new man , Choi Jang Gun who has newly opened his butcher shop, Jang Gun's Butcher Shop.

title: Summer Snow
description: One day, in the middle of summer, it suddenly starts to snow. What sort of changes will the snow bring?

title: Return of the Hound
alt_titles: The Returning Instinct of a Hound
The Return Instinct of the Hunting Dog
description: After being brainwashed by the emperor, Yahn has served him as his loyal puppet. Upon finding out that he has been played by the emperor, Yahn vows vengeance, but he falls to the mighty emperor’s powers. However, instead of dying, Yahn opens his eyes to find that he has gone back in time, to when he used to be a soldier in training. Will he now seek vengeance on the emperor, or will he go look for his family? The choice is now in his hands.

title: A Certain Month, a Certain Day
alt_titles: A Certain Month, a Certain Day
description: A birthday day for Wang An, an ordinary college student.

title: Flowers
description: A tender tale of love and loss, where someone dear reappears in a different form of life.

title: Love and Social Anxiety
description: Not wanting to be bothered, Yu Xiaoyou, who suffers from social anxiety, is always mistaken for being aloof and cold. During a temporary reassignment, she meets Lin Yan, who is exceptionally skilled at social interactions. Though they are complete opposites, Yu finds herself relating to him in some ways…

title: Daydreaming in the Hidden Mountain
alt_titles: Dream Talking in the Hidden Mountain
description: A masked person taking shelter at an old temple narrates a story, about a wayward princess and her ethereally handsome consort, to a girl painting there while they wait out a deluge.

title: Blind Devotion
description:
Young Hwa-Rim, having freed Jin, a serpent god sealed away by a shaman, has her body taken over by him, and the shaman sacrifices her own life to save Hwa-Rim. Years later, now a high school student, Hwa-Rim lives in hiding, constantly on the run from Jin, who is still relentlessly searching for her. One day, Bong-Gil, a classmate of hers, is possessed by Jin, and Jin attempts to use Bong-Gil to track down Hwa-Rim...

Note: This series serves as a prequel to the 2024 film Exhuma (파묘).

title: His Apple
description: Linling, an ordinary high school girl, is actually the daughter of the Scarlet-Haired Witch — an existence akin to a max-level top player! However, she’s being hounded by a handsome and frivolous miscreant prince from another world for an unpaid debt. Thus begins the countdown for an emotional game with debt on the line…

title: Lord Preston's Secret Tutor
description: Du jour au lendemain, Jacqueline Somerset s'est retrouvée sans le sou à la suite du décès de son père et de la faillite de sa famille. Elle est engagée comme treizième gouvernante au manoir des Preston. Malgré ses relations tendues avec le marquis, connu pour son caractère exigeant, elle va au-delà de la simple survie pour découvrir ses secrets cachés et se rapproche peu à peu de lui.

title: One Coin Closer to Holiness
alt_titles: I Will Buy Divine Power With Money!
description: When a former detective wakes up as Ordelle Kyris, the villainess and fake saint of the novel "Idella the Holy," she is entrusted with the task of saving the Sun God and this world from disappearing forever. However, being a fake, her divine power is close to nothing. And the only way to increase it is... money! From securing rich followers to starting a new business, Ordelle strives to gather funds and gain more power. Will this fake yet fiery saint successfully climb the ladder of holiness?

title: Teto X Egen
description:
Haeseon, a driven "Teto girl" whose entire life revolves around her career, and Seonho, a quiet "Egen guy" who wants nothing more than to stay home with his cat.

Living in entirely different worlds, the two were like parallel lines destined never to cross. That is, until they are forced onto the same Task Force team—and to make matters worse, they discover they live right next door to each other! As their daily routines become hopelessly entangled, Seonho's "first love" suddenly enters the picture...!

What will become of this chaotic, nerve-wracking, and strangely heart-fluttering romance between two complete opposites?

title: The Genius Spearman Who Doesn't Die
alt_titles: The Genius Spearman Who Doesn't Die
description: In this life, I’ll be the one who rules the battlefield.” Damian, a centurion in the Baroque Kingdom’s punishment unit, dies nameless on some forgotten front at the age of thirty, regretting only one thing: “Damn it… If I’d just had one more chance, I really would’ve ruled the battlefield with these guys.” When he opens his eyes again, he’s gone back seventeen years—this time with a perfectly intact mana core that actually lets him learn magic. This time, he swears, he won’t be swept along by an age of endless war. He’ll climb higher than anyone and become the one who dominates it. Reborn in the past, Damian raises his spear toward the world and begins carving out the future he couldn’t reach before.

title: The Lover who Only Exists In My Eyes
alt_titles: The Lover who Only Exists In My Eyes

title: Scissor Seven: Black and White Twin Dragons 3
alt_titles: Scissor Seven: Black and White Twin Dragons 3
description: Después del colapso de Mo Lang, Bai Qi se dispone a buscarlo y traerlo de vuelta a casa.

title: Wu Liu Qi: Heibai Shuanglong 2
alt_titles: Scissor Seven: Black and White Twin Dragons 2
description: Sequel to [Wu Liu Qi: Heibai Shuanglong](https://mangadex.org/title/757ffc27-5baf-40c3-9bad-3a1859837936)

title: Master's Pet
description: When Ein is brought in to the Marquess Howard’s manor, he finds himself serving TWO masters. Unaware of the tension between the two brothers, Ein seeks out ways to be as useful as possible. As he teaches the naïve Collin during the day and gives his body to the Marquess at night, Ein will find his eagerness to serve… put to the test. While one may lay claim to his body—for now—which master will be the one to claim his heart?

title: Gangster Champaign
alt_titles: Can a Gangster Leave the Gang?
description:
Hyungwon, a member of the Viper Gang, decides to leave the gang and flee the country. He still has a long way to go, but in a weak moment, he ends up having a one-night stand with Sungjin…But who really is Sungjin?

title: Emergency Stairway
description:
[From Kidari Studio's Penis Navidad Collection]  
  
Jonghyun, who works at a hotel to pay off his brother’s debt, scrapes by with just enough money to pay the private loan sharks, who also pay him visits at the hotel. He can barely stand it. Soon, Youngjin, a red-haired bully, tells him that he would help pay off his debts if he goes out with him…?

title: Home Five
description:
His hobby is to shop and film unboxing videos. Seo Doha, who lives in the present with the YOLO lifestyle, is in danger after being kicked out of his house in the middle of winter. Doha’s underclassman from college shows him a home-share + cafe called “HOME 5.” Seeing no reason to refuse, Doha immediately signs the contract. It’s only after signing the contract that Doha reads the name written on the contract. 
“Oh…Siwoon?” Why is he here?! This is the story of my first love and our future cohabitation!

title: Neo Antique Partner
description:
Sick of his repetitive lifestyle, Gaeul decides to go on the trip he’s been putting off due to his many fears. He arrives in Paris with an excited heart in anticipation of a new relationship, but Gaeul’s partner doesn’t show up. Tired of waiting, he goes to find his partner, but to make matters worse, he bumps into someone who takes Gaeul’s precious handkerchief as garbage…?

---
- **Note:** 
Part of Bomtoon [<Travel Short Stories Vacation Sex>](https://twitter.com/studio_Weiib/status/1471043087007105026) and the 10th Story (Ch.33-36) on [<Lezhin>](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/vacationsex)

title: Halloween Is Nothing Special
description:
Halloween. It might be a special day for some, but at the same time, it might be a meaningless day for others. Jinyoung, who lost his boyfriend, Eunchan, 3 years ago, spends his Halloween in the least special way possible. No wait, he was trying to spend it that way.
So why did the dead Eunchan suddenly appear next to him after all this time?

title: Starry Night
description: Chi Xing, who was nicknamed, “star of calamity”, would run into all sorts of bad luck every day. But after he met the arrogant, antisocial, Ling Ye, who had deformed legs, he unexpectedly discovered that his suffering physique improved. Whenever he was with Ling Ye, he could turn danger into safety, and Ling Ye’s gaze always made Chi Xing feel like they had met before, a feeling of familiarness. They both don’t know that their common past of suffering and agony would cause them to be tangled up together……

title: A Very Fine Cotton Candy
alt_titles: A Tiny Bit of Cotton Candy
description:
“How can someone not fall in love?”

Yohan, a 9-year-old rescued with the help of Sungjin, a high school student passing by. As a result, their relationship continued as Yohan’s family sponsored Sungjin. Yohan gives his heart to Sungjin who stood by his side.

Yohan and Sungjin, who became lovers over the time.

Yohan tries his best to become a great, competent, handsome, friendly, and mature lover who’s not an embarrassment to Sungjin... But, sometimes, he reaches his limit…

title: Antidote
description:
A good-for-nothing young master without a single redeeming feature is driven out of his house by his family with nothing but the clothes he has on. A street thug with a dark childhood who is plagued with a mental illness. A fight at the dumpster started a no discord, no concord* destiny between Cheng Ke, the young master who has an extreme disability in living and taking care of himself, and Jiang Yudou, the guy who loves using brute force without reason. Ever since then, they became the only redemption in each other’s dark life.  
  
You’re my antidote, and I’ll take you when I’m sick.  
  
(*Note: No discord, no concord is a chinese proverb that means if there is no fighting, there can be no friendship made.)

title: Poison Antidote
description: A dangerous journey gave Gu Ming the chance to meet the warm light that once existed in his heart -- Li Shuo. But now known as Wei San, he has already lost all memories about Gu Ming and is now an assassin. Does mutual destruction or mutual redemption await the two... A world ravaged by a mysterious organization, and a chaotic city filled with violence and madness. For the sake of revenge, and for the sake of saving Li Shuo from a cruel fate, Gu Ming will have no hesitation, even if he has to fall into a deep swamp of darkness.

title: Sissy
description: Paranoid and scumbag top x Gentle and feeble bottom. Since young, Li Chengxiu has already gotten his fill of all the bitterness life could offer. And now, he longs to be loved. Shao Qun is the heir of his impressive and wealthy family. His stubborn, boisterous, and unruly personality was on full display during his high school years. It all started from him getting close to him out of curiosity. From bullying him to being attracted to him. Those unripened and inexperienced feelings occurred at the wrong time, destined to hurt. Although originally wishing to ditch the past and start from scratch, they meet each other once again. Will their reencounter be the beginning of happiness or the continuation of pain?

title: Pick Me, Darling!
description:
“What’s there to think about? I’ll just have them all!!”   
Drinking after witnessing his boyfriend cheating on him, Yejun drunkenly runs into a telephone pole with a flyer stating it’ll grant a wish attached to it. He wishes for a gentle guy, a rich, good looking guy, and every other type of guy.   
From that day on, he gets strangely involved with the men around him..?

title: BL's Standard
description:
“Back then… Do you remember?”  
Lee Sihyun transfers schools on a warm spring day. But he bumps into “that guy” he didn't want to see!

title: How to Hate Mate
description:
Everyone’s twenties are sprinkled with regrets, but Subin’s is spent stumbling from one mistake to the next. He gets drunk, comes out of the closet and clumsily confesses his feelings to his straight roommate all in one night.   
It takes two years, but he starts to pull his life together. That is, until his old roommate, Hyunwoo, returns from the military.

title: Butterfly Trap
description:
Ling Feng is a true winner in life. Money, status, friends; he has it all. But on the very day he’s about to reach the peak of his life at 27, he suddenly finds himself in a parallel world, reduced to a miserable bottom-dweller of society... and even becomes a murderer?!

Just as he hits rock bottom, he receives a mysterious time-travel app from who-knows-where, asking him:

“Do you want to return to the life you were meant to live?”

title: How to Create Happiness
description: College student Soshin Kang has made a deal with the devil. When poverty and violent loan sharks force Soshin to take up an offer from Aram, Soshin’s high school friend-turned-bully, to live in Aram’s lavish house with all expenses paid, it seems like a dream come true. Although Aram appears sweet and gentle, in reality, she is a cold, manipulative stalker who is obsessed with Soshin and will stop at nothing to keep her to herself. As people around her begin to get hurt, Soshin finds herself in a race against time to uncover the truth and escape Aram’s grasp.

title: Donut and Circus
description: Welcome to the Cake Circus! The circus is leaving for another performance today. Donut wants to get on stage, but what if he messes up? Donut has a long way to go! Will he be able to finish the performance safely?

title: Senpai-chan's a Man?!
description:
Senpai-chan, who looks like a girl, is not only a man, but also seems like an airhead...?!

(Source: Bilibili, edited)
